text.body: <1> vaiyākaraṇasiddhāntamañjūṣāyāḥ prakaraṇānāṃ viṣayāṇāñca anukramaṇikā varṇasphoṭasāmānyanirupaṇam sphotapadārthaḥ prakṛtipratyayādīnāṃ kālpanikatvam sthānināṃ vācakatvādivicāraḥ śaktinirupaṇam vṛttibhedāḥ naiyāyikamatam apabhraṃ śeṣu śaktisiddhiḥ janakatvāniruktiḥ naiyāyikoktiḥ prakāśakṛduktiḥ sādhutvaniruktiḥ vākyapadīyoktiḥ bhāṣāśabdeṣu subutpattivimarśaḥ śaktitraividhyam lakṣaṇāniruktiḥ tatra tattanmatam lakṣaṇādvaṃvidhyam prakārāntareṇa lakṣṇādvaividhyam yaugyatāniruktiḥ prakāśakṛduktiḥ śuddhāyā bhedadvayam gaurvāhīkaḥ tatra navyamatam kuvalayānandamatam mīmāṃsakamatam vyañjanāniruktiḥ gato'stamarkaḥ śabdavalṛttivicāro vistareṇa jippaṇyām dhātvarthavicāraḥ gurumatam maṇḍanamiśramatam prācīnanaiyāyikamatam dhātvarthe navyamatavicāraḥ mīmāṃsakanavyamatanirāsaḥ akarmakatvasakarmakatvaniruktiḥ nipātasāmānyārthavicāraḥ naiyāyikamatanirāsaḥ vaiyākaraṇamatam ṭippaṇyāṃ nipātārthavistaraḥ nañarthavicāraḥ navyamatam evakārārthavicāraḥ ṭippaṇyāmekārārthavicāraḥ tatra naiyāyikanavyamatasamīkṣā ṭippaṇyāṃ parisaṅkhyārthaḥ vistaraḥ tiṅarthavicāraḥ ṭippaṇyāṃ tadvistaraḥ mūle naiyāyikamatam 'anabhihite' ityasyārthavicāraḥ kṛtiphalayorākhyātārthatvam ṭippaṇyāṃ tadādīnāṃ nānārthatvanirāsaḥ mīmāṃsakamatam ṭippaṇyāṃ tadupapattiḥ aruṇyāṃ piṅgākṣyā iti mantrārthavicāraḥ ṭippaṇyāṃ tadupapattiḥ aruṇayā piṅgākṣyā iti mantrārthavicāraḥ ṭippaṇyāṃ tadupapattiḥ ṭippaṇyāṃ tadupapattiḥ ṭippaṇyāṃ tadvetoriti nyāyaḥ nānṛtaṃ vadet ṭippaṇyāṃ tadvistaraḥ mūle bhaṭṭamatam ṭippaṇyāmākhyātārthasya vaividhyam mūle navyamatavimarśaḥ ṭippaṇyāṃ 'supa ātmanaḥ' ityasyārthavicāraḥ ākhyātārthavartamānatvādivicāraḥ tadanvayaprakāraḥ, lakṣaṇāni ca naiyayikanavyamatam naiyāyikanavyataramatam ṭippaṇyāṃ takranyāyasvarupavicāraḥ vidhyādivihitaliṅarthaḥ pravartakatvaniruktiḥ jyotiṣṭomavicāraḥ mīmāṃsakamatakhaṇḍanam bhagavadkītāvirodhaparihāraḥ arthavādaprāmāṇyavicāraḥ sanādyarthavicāraḥ kṛdarthavicāraḥ naiyāyikanavyoktinirāsaḥ ṭippaṇyāṃ kriyāvācakatvavicāraḥ ṭippaṇyāṃ tumunnarthavistaraḥ ṭippaṇyāṃ tumuntarthavistaraḥ naiyāyikamatam naiyāyikanavyamatam harimatam nāmārthavicāraḥ ṭippaṇyāṃ tadvistaraḥ mūle upalakṣaṇatvaniruktiḥ ṭippaṇyāṃ 'nāgṛhītaviśeṣaṇā' nyāyavimarśaḥ kubjaśaktivādaḥ ṭippaṇyāṃ tatsvarūpam bhaṭṭamatollekhaḥ tattadācāryadiśā vicārāḥ ṭippaṇyāṃ svarūpasūtraprāmāṇyam bhāṣyakṛduktyullekhaḥ śābdikadiśā liṅgavicāraḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ prātipadikārthatvacarcā ṭippaṇyāṃ nāmārthaniṣkarṣaḥ anukaraṇānukāryayorbhedābhedacarcā atītanalādiviṣayakavicāre naiyāyikanavyamatadūṣaṇam 'gavityayamāha' ityarthavicāraḥ 'udbhidā yajeta' iti śrutyarthavicāraḥ mīmāṃsakamatopanyāsaḥ kathitapadatvasya kvacidadoṣatvam ṭippaṇyāṃ śabdasayāpiśābdabodhaviṃṣayatvam sarvānāmapadeṣu śaktigrahavicāraḥ apūrve śaktigrahatvopapattiḥ haryādipadaśakyatāvicāraḥ subarthavicāraḥ prathamārthaḥ ṭippaṇyāṃ sambodhanārthavicāraḥ kārakadvitīyārthaḥ ṭippaṇyāṃ karmatvapariṣkāraḥ karmavevidhyam dvikarmatvollekhaḥ tadudāharaṇāni naiyāyikamatakhaṇḍanam mīmāṃsakamatam upapadadvitīyāvibhāktyarthanirūpaṇam kārakatṛtīyārthaḥ harimatam upapadatṛtīyārthaḥ kārakacaturthyarthaḥ śūlapāṇimatam navyataramatam tattadudāharaṇānāṃ śābdabodhaprakāraḥ upapadacaturthīnirupaṇam pañcamīvicāraḥ ṭippaṇyāṃ vividhamatavimarṣaḥ 'janikartuḥ' ityatra samāsavicāraḥ upapadapañcamīniruktiḥ ṣaṣṭhyarthaniruktiḥ ṭippaṇyāṃ tadvistaraḥ saptamyarthavicāraḥ saṅkhyāvivakṣānirṇayaḥ saṅakhyāprasaṅgāduddeśyavidheyayorvivakṣā'vikṣākathanam samāsaśaktiḥ ṭippaṇyāṃ tadviśeṣaḥ ṭippaṇyāṃ bhedapadārthavicāraḥ pradīpakṛnmatam mīmāṃsakamatam ṭippaṇyāṃmekārthībhāvaḥ ṭippaṇyāṃ niṣādasthapatiśabde samāsavicāraḥ jahatsvārthāniruktiḥ vyapekṣāvādaḥ pratyayatvaniruktiḥ samāsasayānarthakye prātipadikasañjñāsiddhiḥ katham? ṭippaṇyāṃ sāhityaśabdārthaḥ vidheyāvimarśaviṣaye ālaṅkārimatopanyāsaḥ puṣpavantaśabdārthavicāraḥ harikārikopanyāsaḥ aruṇayādivicāraḥ mīmāṃsakamatam bhāṣyoktadurupapādetiśabdārthasaṅghaṭanam vṛttimātre ekārthībhāvaḥ ekaśeṣe'pyekārthībhāvaḥ ekaseṣasyāvaiyarthyam ekaśeṣe sāhityamānam sāhityaprakārakabodhābhāve tantravyavahāraḥ ṭippaṇyāṃ harikārikāvimarśaḥ ṭippaṇyāṃ 'kapiñjalān' ityādi vākyārthavicāraḥ mīmāṃsakamatopanyāsaḥ kliṣṭāvyayībhāvasamastapadānāmarthāḥ tādṛśatatpuruṣapadārthāḥ tādṛśabahubrohipadārthāḥ tādṛśadvandvādipadārthāḥ subantaprakṛtikakyajādyārthāḥ subantaprakṛtikakyajādyārthaḥ bhāvapratyayārthaāḥ mīmāṃsakamatam kaiyaṭollekhaḥ kākatālīyaśabdavyutpattiḥ cvyarthavimarśaḥ sphoṭanirupaṇam padavākyasphoṭo svamatapratipādanam ṭippaṇyāṃ tadupapattiḥ vākyaśaktiḥ akhaṇḍapadavākyasphoṭaḥ jātisphoṭanirupaṇam granthasamāptiḥ iti vaiyākaraṇasiddhāntamañjūṣānukramaṇikā vaiyākaraṇasiddhāntamañjūṣā nāgeśabhaṭṭaviduṣā natvā 1 sāmbamiti laghumañḍīṣādau | sāmbasadāśivam | vaiyākaraṇasiddhāntamañjaṣeyaṃ viracyate 1 ka vilikhyate | || 1 || atha varṇaspoṭasāmānyanirupaṇam tatrāṣṭau sphoṭā iti siddhāntaḥ | varṇasphoṭaḥ, padasphoṭaḥ, vākyasphoṭaḥ, akaṇḍapadavākyasphoṭau ; ete pañca vyaktisphoṭāḥ | vyaktisphoṭatvañcaiṣām -- jātyanavacchinnasyaiva tadavacchinnasya vā, 2 kha nāsti kevalaṃ prakṛtipratyayapadādervācakatvāt | yathā caitat, tathārgre nirupayiṣyāmaḥ | varṇāpadāvākyabhedena trayo jātisphoṭāḥ, ityaṣṭau | tatra sphuṭatyartho'smāditi sphoṭo vācaka iti yāvat | evañca varṇasphoṭādipadānāṃ varṇādayo vācakā ityarthaḥ | 3 kha nāsti atra varṇaśabdena prakṛtipratyayo 2 grahyau iti śeṣaḥ | tatra 4 kha nāsti 'rāmaḥ', 'bhavati', ityādau 5 kha tatrādāvānu o tattadānupūrvyavacchinnavarṇasamudāyarūpāḥ, prakṛtipratyayabhāgāḥ prayujyamānapadavākyādau śrūyamāṇā vā vācakāḥ, na tu taiḥ smṛtā ādeśina iti varṇasphoṭapakṣaḥ | saro rasa ityādāvaviśeṣavāraṇāya tattadānupūrvyavacchinneti | prayujyamānapadāntargatā varṇā vācakā na vā iti vipratipattiśarīram | atra vidhikoṭiḥ, pareṣām, niṣedhakoṭirasmākam | syādetat - prayogasamavāyyādeśabhūtatibādīnāṃ bahutvādanantaśaktatāvacchedakaklapanāpatterna vācakatvam ; kintu taiḥ smṛtāḥ sthānibhūtā lādaya eva, tatra hi latvasya jātirupasyaikasyaiva śaktatāvacchedakatvāt | naca 1kha 'bhū talla' ityatretyadhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ | 'bhū talla' ityato'pi bodhaḥ syāditi vācyam, bodhe 'bhavati' iti samabhivyāhārasya kāraṇatāyāḥ 'bhū --- ti' ityato bodhavāraṇāya tavāpyāvaśyakatvena doṣābhāvāditi cet, na, lakāramaviduṣāṃ bodhānāpatteḥ | na ca tiṅkṣveva śaktibhramādbodaḥ, padatadarthaghaṭitaśakterbhramasyopapādayitumaśakyatvāt, bhramatve mānābhāvācca, vyākaraṇabhedena kaṭacaḍādibhedaiḥ 'rāmaḥ' ityādau su-si-vādibhedaiśca sthānināmapyanantatayā'nantaśakatatāvacchedakakalpanāpattestadavasthatvācca | na caika eva teṣu śaktaḥ, vinigamanāvirahāt | na ca vedāṅgatayā pāṇinīyavyākaraṇabodhitasthānināṃ vācakatvamiti vācyam, anyādhyayanavatāmetadapyajānatāñca2 kha nāsti bhodhānāpatteḥ | yattu, 'rāmaḥ' ityādau su- si-ru ityādeśibedādyena sarvaṃ vyākaraṇamadhītaṃ tasya vinigamānāviraheṇa bodhapratibandhaḥ syāditi | tat, na; smārakaliperiva smaryasmārakānanugamasyādoṣatvāt, yasyaibodbodhakasāmagrī, tenaiva smṛtena bodhasambhavāt | yatra tu bahūnāṃ sā, tatra sarvaistairityadoṣāt | kiñca, śaktigrāhakaśiromaṇinā vyavahāreṇa śrūyamāṇeṣveva 3 kha śaktigrahāt | śaktigraho na4 kha ' na sthāniṣu' iti nāsti sthāniṣu | api ca, ādiśināṃ smaraṇakalpanāyāṃ yajasmākaṃ vācakatāvacchedakam, tattavamate smārakatāvacchedakaṃ vācy, yena kenacidrūpeṇa smārakatave'tiprasaṅgāt | tathā ca 'taddhetoḥ' itinyāyena teṣāṃ vācakatāvacchedakatvamevocitam | 'papāca' ityādāvanekeṣāṃ smārakatāvacchedakatvāpatteśca | kiñca, sthānināṃ vācakatve tikṣu kṛtivācakatvam, śatrādisthale kartrādivācakatvam ; iti mīmāṃsakanaiyāyikasaṃmatā vyavasthā na sidhyet | na ca "kartarikṛt" 3|4|67 ityanuśāsanācchānajādīnāṃ5 kha śānactvādinā | karttārtha iti vācyam, tasya tadvidhāvapravṛttaiḥ1 ādinā subutpattiḥ | | anyathā karmaṇi śānaco daurlabhyāpatteḥ | na ca nāmārthayorbhedenānvayāyogāt 'caitraḥ pacamānaḥ' ityādau ananvayavāraṇāya tatra lasya kartā vācya iti vācyam, " laḥ karmaṇi " 3|4|69 iti sūtrasya vairūpyāpatteḥ | na ca latvasya śaktatāvacchedakatve'pi tibādyādeśajanyalakāropasthitereva kṛtyupasthāpakatvānnaḥ; śatrādismāritāt ; svarūpeṇoccāritādvā tatpratītiriti vācyam, yata evaṃ vadatā śatrādisthale kimādeśānāṃ vācakatvamamyupeyate, uta sthāninām ? nādyaḥ, ardhajaratīyāpatteḥ | nāntyaḥ, vairūpyāpatteḥ | nacādeśānāmeva vācakatve "laḥ karmaṇio"3|4|69 ityanuśāsanāsaṃgatiḥ, vastutastiṅādiniṣṭhāyā eva śakteranuśāsanalāghavāya kalpite lakāre kalpitatvāttadupapatteḥ | atredaṃ bodhyam - atra pakṣe'rthabodhānukūlā vṛttirvarṇaṃ samūha eva paryāptā, na pratyekam | tathā sati pratyekamarthavattvātprātipādikatvā1ādinā subutpattiḥ | dyāpattau 'dhanam, vanam' ityādau'na lopādyāpatteḥ | kuñca, pratyekaṃ śaktimattve pratyekaṃ varṇādarthabodhāpattiḥ | kiñca, dvitīyādivarṇoccāraṇasya vaiyarthyāpattiḥ | na ca pratyekaṃ varṇairarthasmaraṇamātraṃ janyate, carameṇa punaḥ spaṣṭaṃ janyate, pratyakṣa iva smṛtāvapi vaijātyasvīkāre bādhakābhāvāditivācyam, prativarṇamarthasmaraṇasyānubhavaviruddhatvād, gurutvācc | na ca pratyekāvṛttaiḥ kathaṃ samudāyavṛttitvam, dvitvādivadupapatteḥ | ata eva 'arthavanto varṇāḥ' iti praghaṭṭake "hayavaraṭ" [mā. sū. 5 sūtre 'dhātupratātipadikapratayayānāmekavarṇanāmarthadarśanāt prātipadikānyekārthāni 2tatratyā bhāṣyānupūrvī tu 'pratipadikānyekavarṇānyarthavanti ābhyām, ebhiḥ, eṣu' | -- ābhyām, ābhiḥ, eṣu,' iti bhāṣya uktam | spaṣṭantu "arthavat" 1|2|45 sūtre bhāṣye --- 'prakṛtiḥ prakṛtyarthe vartate, pratyayaḥ pratyayārthe' iti granthe | caramavarṇaṃ eva śaktaḥ, pūrvapūrvavarṇānubhavajasaṃskārāścarameṇārthadhījanane sahakāriṇa iti na tanmātrādarthadhīḥ, nāpi prativarṇaṃ prātipadikatvāpattirityekadeśinaḥ | iti varṇasphoṭa3 atra sāmānyanirūpaṇamiti yuktaḥ pāṭhaḥ | atha śaktinirūpaṇam atra ghaṭādipadādupasthitākāśādeḥ śābdaviṣayatvavāraṇāya śābdabodhe vṛttigrahajanyopasthitirheturiti siddhāntaḥ1 ayamāśayaḥ --- śabdānāṃ samavāyenākāśe vartamānatvāt 'ekasambandhijñānamaparasamndhinaṃ smārayati' iti niyamena ghaṭapadenākāśasyāpyupasthityā ākāśasyāpi śābdūbodhe bhānaṃ syāt | tacca neṣṭam, ititadviṣayakaśābdabodaṃ prati tatpadaniṣṭhavṛttijñānajanyopasthitiḥ kāraṇamiti kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ svīkarttavyaḥ | evañcākāśasya vṛttyā'nupasthitatvāt śābdabodhe bhānaṃ na bhavati | | vṛttiśca tridhā -- śaktirlakṣaṇā, vyañḍanā ca | vṛttitvaṃ śābdabodhahetupadārthopasthityanukūlapadapadārtha1 kha. padārthe | sambandhatvam | bodhakatvena padaviṣayakasaṃketarūpatātparyasya vṛttitvavāraṇāya padārthopastityanukūleti | tacca sākṣādeva śābdopayogi na padārthopasthitidvāreti bodhyam | tatra śaktiḥ kaḥ padārtha iti cet, atra nāyāyikāḥ2 tatra īśvarecchārūpā śaktiritimataṃ prācīnanaiyāyikānām | teṣāṃ naye ādhunikasaṃkete'pi śaktirastyeva, 'ekādaśe'hani pitā nāma kuryāt' iti īśvarecchāyāḥ tatrāpi sattvāt | sampradāyavidastu, ādhunikasaṃkete na śaktiriti manyante | gadādharabhaṭṭācāryārtu, icchāmātraṃ śaktiḥ, natvīśvarecchā, evañca ādhunikasaṃkete'pi śaktirastyeva | mimāṃsakamate tu śaktiḥ padārthāntaram | sā ca padapadārthayorvācyavācakabhāva niyāmikā | vaiśiṣṭyākhyambandhenārthaniṣṭhā sā śaktiḥ pratiyogitvasambandhena capadaniṣṭheti | prācīnavaiyākaraṇāstu bodhajanakatāṃ śaktimāhuḥ | tathā coktaṃ bhūṣaṇe dīkṣitaiḥ -- indriyāṇāṃsvaviṣayeṣvanādiryogyatā yathā | anādirtheśśabdānāṃ sambandho yogyatā tathā ||' śaktinio 37 kāo indriyāṇām = cakṣurādīnāmsvaviṣayeyu = cākṣuṣeṣu ghaṭādirūpeṣu yathā'nādiryogyatā = tadīyacākṣuṣādikāraṇatā, tathā śabdānāmapi arthena saha tadbodhakāraṇataiva yogyatā, saiva śaktirityarthaḥ | nāgeśamate tu, vācyavācakabhāva eva śaktiriti anupadameva sphuṭībhaviṣyati | asmācchabdādayamarthobodhya ityākārā, idaṃ padamimamarthaṃ bodhayatvikārā vā īśvarecchā śaktiḥ | tasyāśca yadyapi viṣayatvalakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ pade cārthe ca, tathāpi tasyāṃ bodhajanakatvena; bodhanikhaṣṭhajanyatānirūpakatvena; vā viṣayo vācakaḥ | bodhaviṣayatvena tasyāṃ viṣayo vācyaḥ | tena padaṃ na vācyam, artho na vācakaḥ |3 kha. etena adoṣāt, nāsti | eteneśvarecchāyā atiprasaktatvāt na tatra śaktitvamiti parāstam, tattadviṣayaviśeṣitāyāstādṛśavilakṣaṇaviṣayatāsambandena tattatpadaniṣṭhāyāstattatpadaśaktitvāmyupagamenādoṣāt | sā ceyaṃ sādhuśabdaniṣṭhaiva, nāpabhraṃ śādiniṣṭhā, teṣāṃ śaktatvavyavahārābhāvāt, sādhutvāpateśca | nanvapabhraṃśādapi śaktibhrameṇārthaṃpratyayāṅgīkārāt sanmātraviṣayake1 kha. sanmātraviṣakeccheti | bhagavatsaṃkete2 kha. nāsti | teṣāmapi viṣayatvāvaśyakatayā ca śaktatvāpattiḥ, anyathā bhagavadicchāyāḥ sanmātraviṣayakatvocchedāpattiḥ | evaṃ lākṣaṇikagahghādipadasyāpi tīrādivācakatvāpattiḥ, uktayukteḥ3 kha. nāsti na ca tādṛśecchayā bhagavaduccaritatvaṃ śaktirapabhraṃ śādayaścanārthapratyāyanecchayā bhagavaduccaritā iti teṣu nātiprasaṅga iti miśroktaṃ yuktameveti vācyam, vedasthalākṣaṇikeṣu śaktyāpatteḥ | kiñca, ādhunikasaṃketitamaitrādapade'vyāptiḥ devadattetyādisvarūpāṇāṃ bhagavadanuccāritatvāt | na ca nāmapadena sarveṣāmuccāritatvamastyeveti vācyam, 'nāpabhraṃśitavai' ityādinā'pabhraṃśatvenāpabhraṃśānāmapi taduccāritvāditi cet? na; tatpadabodhatvaprakāratānirūpitaviśeṣyatāsambandhena bhagavadicchāvattvameva śaktiḥ, tasyāśca padārthasmṛtyanyathānupapattayā kalpyamānasambandhatvasyāvaśyakatvāt sādhusaṃskṛte eva kalpanam, nāpabhraṃśalākṣaṇikādau, āropeṇaivopapatteḥ, vṛttyantareṇa nirvāhācca | kiñca, yathā samavāyaikyamate1 ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- samavāyasya ekatvavādināṃ tārkikāṇāṃ mate sparśasamavāyasya rūpasamavāyasya caikyāt sambandhasatvasya sambandhisattvaniyāmakatayā 'rūpavān rūpapratiyogikasamavāyasya abhāvāt na doṣaḥ | samavāyasya nānātvavādināṃ mate tu doṣaleśo'pi nāsti | ekasminneva rūpapratiyogikatvānuyogikatvobhayasattve'pi tanniṣṭhasāmānādhikaraṇyamātraṃ na 'viśeṣyatāvattvasya vā' ityasyāgre 'yadvāśaktitvenaiva tadgrahakāraṇ | atiriktaśkativādimate tattvenaiva tadgrahāt' ityānupūrvīkaḥ prakṛtagranthenāsambaddhaḥ pāṭho dṛśyate | vā tatpadaśakyatvarūpasya saṃskṛtanirūpitasyaiva pravāhādāveva ca svīkāreṇa nātiprasaṃṅgaḥ | na ca 1ekadaॉtarapakṣapātinī yuktirvinigamanā | vinigamanāvirahaḥ, prasiddhatvādeḥ sarvadeśīyaśiṣṭaparigṛhītatvādeśca vinigamakasya sambhavāt | na caivamapīśvarecchāyāḥ śaktitve īśvaramaviduṣāṃ2 [mīmāṃsakānāṃ bauddhādīnāṃ ca| | bodhanāpattiḥ, saṃketatvenaiva tasyāḥ śābdabodhopayogitvekṣatyabhāvāt | ata evāpabhraṃ śādapi śābedabodhaḥ, ādhunikasaṃketasya sattvāt | na ca īśvarasaṃketasyāpi gṛhītasyaiva tattvaṃ vācyam, anyathā vyutpannānāṃ bodhāpatteḥ, tadgrahaścāsmādādivyavāhārādityāvaśyakatvādasmadādyupadeśarūpasaṃketa eva śaktirastu, kimīśvarasaṃketakalpanayeti vācyam, ekārthanirūpitaikapadaniṣṭhā nānāpuruṣīyā nānā saṃketā vinigamanāviraheṇa tāvatāṃ śaktitvakalpanāpekṣayaikasminnīśvarasaṃketa eva tattvakalpanasyocitatvāt | sṛṣṭyādivyavahāre bhagavadvyavahārasyaiva3 kha. 'śaktigrāhakatvena ityata ārabhya 'tasyaiva' ityetatparyantaḥ pāṭho nāsti | ato nāpabhraṃśānāṃ sādhutvam | taḍjñānañca śābdabodhe kāraṇamataḥ 'grāma grāma' ityādito na bodhaḥ | lākṣaṇikānāmapi kvacicchaktisattvādastyeva tattvamitayāhuḥ | jñānaprayatnābhyāṃ vinigamanāviraheṇa pariśeṣe mānābhāvāt, sarveṣāṃ tattve gauravācca padapadārthayoḥ sambandhāntarameva śaktiḥ | sā ca prāguktayuktyā saṃskṛta eva, pravāhādinirūpitaiveti nāpabhraṃ śalākṣaṇikādīnāṃ śaktatvam | kiñca, saṃskṛtasya sarvadeśa ekatvād, bhāṣāṇāñca pratideśaṃ bhinnatvāt gauraveṇa saṃskṛtaiḥ saha paryāyatāpattyā ca na tāsu śaktiḥ | na ca kalpyamānadharmasayāpi jñānādibhirvinigamanāvirahatādavasthyam, kalpanasya vaiyarthyāpattyopajīvyavirodhena kalpyamānadharmaistadanaṅgīkārāt | yattu, īśvarasaṃketitatvādirūpaṃ śaktatvameva sādhutvamityuktam | tat, na; saṃketitatvādyajñānena sādhutvavyavahārāt | samāsādau sādhuśabde saṃketādisattve tasyaiva śaktitvena śaktvāpatteśca, prakṛtipratyayasamudāye śaktyabhāvena tasyādhutāpatteśca | pratyekaśaktimādāya sādhutve ca 'bādhate' itāyadivad 'bādhati' ityasyāpi sādhutvāpatteḥ, dyotakeṣu nipāteṣaavavyāpteśca | auṣasaṃdānikī śaktireva dyotaneti cet, prottarajitvo[dyottaraṭatvayoraviśeṣeṇa vinigamanāvirahācchaktatāpattau vyasajyavṛtti1anekādhikaraṇavṛttitvaṃ vyāsajyavṛtitvam | śakto vāśrāntyā aṭdvirvacanādyavyavasthāpattiḥ | etena 'vṛttimattvaṃ tat' ityādi parāstam, samāsādyavyāpanāt | na ca jātiviśeṣastat, katvādinā saṅkarāpatteḥ | kintu vyākaraṇaniṣpādyatvam | tajjñānaṃ śābdabodhe kāramamityapyuktam, tadajānatāmapi bodhāt | kintvasādhutvaniścayaḥ pratibandhakaḥ | ata eva sādhuto'pyasādhutvaniścaye na bodhaḥ | na caivamapabhraṃ śānāmaśaktatvenāsādhutvena ca tato bodhānāpattiḥ, vyutpannasya sādhusmaraṇāt, avyutpannasya śaktimramādeva tato bodhāt | vyutpannāśca dvividhā -- tattadvācakasaṃskṛtaviśeṣajñānavantaḥ, tadvikalāśca | tatrādyānāṃ sādhusmaraṇaṃ spaṣṭameva | dvitīyānāṃ sarvanāmasmṛtestadarthajñāpakatvena rūpeṇa sādhusmṛtervā bodha ityūhyam | na ca pāmarāṇāṃ 1 kha. 'śaktigrahe' iti pāṭhaḥ, sa ca nitāntaṃ prakṛte'pārthakaḥ | śaktyagrahe kathaṃ tadbhramaḥ, pūrvaṃpūrvabhramāduttarottarabhramopapatteḥ | na cātiriktaśaktyaṅgīkāre'pi kiṃ sā sarveṣāṃ śabdānāṃ sarvairarthaiḥ samaṃ svīkriyate, uta, kasyacitkenacideva | tathā hi -- āryā yavaśabdaṃ dīrghaśūke prayuñjate, tameva ca budhyante, mlecchāstu priyaṅgau prayuñjate, tameva ca budhyante, ityevaṃ niyamo na syāt | nahi dīpo rūpakāśanaśaktī rasamapi prakāśayatīti vācyam, kvacicchabdasya saṃketādapi bodhakatvena doṣāṅabhāvāt | evañca mlecchānāṃ saṃketādevabodha iti na doṣaḥ | na ca kvacitsaṃketasya, kvacicchakte rjñānaṃ kāraṇamiti vyabhicāradekasyāpi tattvānāpattyāḥ, goravema ca lāghavātsaṃketajñānatvenaiva hetuteti vācyam, vinigamanāviraheṇātiriktapadārthasiddheḥ prāmāṇukatve tatprayuktagauravasyādoṣatvāt, avyavahitottaratvādiniveśena vyabhicārasyāpyabhāvāt, mlecchānāṃ śaktibhrameṇaiva bodhācceti | navīnā vaiyākaraṇāstu, gauravānnātiriktatatsiddhiḥ, icchāviśeṣaṇatayā prathamopasthitatvena jñānasyaiva śaktitvasabhave'tiriktatatkalpane mānābhāvācca1 jñānajanyābhavedicchā hīcchājanyā kṛtirbhavet | kṛtijanyā bhavecceṣṭā ceṣṭājanyaṃ bhavet phalam || iti kramadarnāt jñānasya prāyamyaṃ siddham | kiñca, atiriktapadārthasyāśrayabhedena viṣayabhedena ca bhinnatvenānantapadārthakalpanāyāṃ viparītagauravāpatteḥ | anyathā sarvebhyaḥ sarvabodhāpattirdurvārā | 'paṭapadaṃ ghaṭatvaviśiṣṭaghaṭanirūpitaśaktimat' iti vyavahārāpatteśca | na ca ghaṭatvaviśiṣṭaghaṭanirūpitatvaviśiṣṭaśakterna paṭapade sattvamiti vācyam, viśiṣṭasyānatiriktvāt | ata eva navyamate samavāyanānātvasasiddhiḥ | etena, tadvācakatvaṃ tadviṣayakaśābdadhījanakatāvacchedakadharmavattvam | sa ca dharmo bahunyādau dāhādyanukūlaśaktivat padārthāntarameva | tathāhi -- tṛṇāraṇimaṇīnāṃ vahnitvāvacchinnaṃ prati kāraṇatve vbhicārāt, janyatāvacchedakatayā vahniniṣṭhavaijātyatrayamabhyupagamya kāryakāraṇabhāvatrayābhyupagame gauravāt, ekātiriktā vahnikāraṇatāvacchedikā śaktistṛṇādau 'tattatkāraṇavaiśiṣṭhyāniveśe gauravāt sakalaparyāyeṣvekā'tiriktatadarthabodhaḥ' iti pāṭhastruṭitaḥ | tattatkāraṇavaiśiṣṭyaniveśe gauravāt sakalaparyāyeṣvekā'tiriktatadarthabodhakāraṇatāvacchedakaśaktisiddhiḥ | iyāṃstu viśeṣa- --- dāhādyanukūlaśakteḥ svarūpasatyā evopayogaḥ, asayāstu jñātāyā eveti taḍjñānaniṣṭhaśaktyaiva nānubhāvakam, kintu lākṣaṇikapadaghaṭitavākye tadghaṭakārthāntaravācakameva padaṃ svārthasyeva tadanvayapratiyogilakṣyārthasyāpyanubhāvakam, ato na doṣa iti vācyam, tarhi ghoṣādipadasya gaṅgātīrādirūpārthānubhāvakatāvacchedakaśaktimattvena tadvācakatāpatteḥ | śaktapadāghaṭitavākyasyānubhāvakatānāpattai1 kha. anubhāvakatāpatteśca | śca | na ca lakṣyārthasya na śābdabodhe praveśaḥ, api ityākārakāvyavahitottaratvāviveśarūpaḥ | yatnaścāvaśyaka ityanyatra vistaraḥ | na ca tarhīśvarajñānameva tathā'stu, ekasyaiva bhagavajjñānasya sarviṣayakatvena, śabdārthavyavasthānupapatteḥ | prāguktarītyā vāraṇantu na yuktisaham, prasiddheraniyatatvāt, lākṣaṇikeṣu sarvedeśaśiṣṭarigṛhītatvācca, tattaddeśaniyatasaṃskṛteṣu sarvadeśaśiṣṭaparigṛhītatvābhāvena śaktisiddhyanāpatteśca | kiñca, jñānasya śaktitve bodhakatvaviśeṣaprakārakajñānatvena hetutvaṃ vācyam, tadapakṣayā bodhakatvajñānatvena hetutve lāghavāt, laukikānāṃ gavādipadebhyastādṛśe jñānagrahābhalave'pyarthaśābdadhījanakatvagrahānantarameva bodhācca tadviṣayakabodhajanakatvameva śaktiḥ1 kha. 'na ca padaryārthadhījanakatvamarthena sambandhaṃ vinā'nupapannamiti klṛptatvāt saṃketameva tattvena kalpayatīti vācyam, daraḍāvapi gha, ityadhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ | sa ca prakṛtānanukūlo'spaṣṭākṣaraścetyupekṣitaḥ | | na cādhunikadevadattādipade saṃketajñānādeva bodhaka etatkāraṇatāyā vyabhicāraḥ, viśeṣaṇatayā tacchābdadhījanakatvāsyāpi tatrāvagāhanenādoṣāt | na ca svāntryeṇa tajjñānamāvaśyakam, anyathā 'nedaṃ taddhījanakam' iti jānataḥ, 'asmācchabdādayamarthobuddho'nena' iti jānatastadbodhāpatteriti vācyam, tatra bādhena tdhījanakatvasyānavagāhanāt | anyathā 'nedaṃ rajatam' iti jānato bhrāntijñasya purovartini tulyayukttyā rajatatvabhāne bhrāntatvāpatteḥ | saṃketajñānād bodhasthale'pi kāryakāraṇabhāvalāghavānurodhena mānasasya taddhījanakatvajñānasya kalpanānna doṣa ityapare | na ca janakatvam ananyathāsiddhatve sati pūrvavartitvam | anyathāsiddhatvañca avaśyakalpyapūrvavatiṃna eva kāryasambhave tatsahacaritatvam | tena daṇḍarūparāsabhādīnāṃ na kāramatvam | niyatatvāṃśaniveśe tu na phalam, tadvyāvartyasya rāsabhāderanyathāsiddhatvenaiva vāraṇāt | anvayavyatirekau cāsya grāhakau, vyabicārajñāne sati anvayavyatirekāgrahamaprayuktakāramatvāgraha iti tasyānekapadārthaghaṭitasya kāraṇatāvacchedakatve gauravamiti vācyam, tavāpīcchāviśeṣamatayā tasya praviṣṭatvena gauravasya tulyātvāt, janakatvasya akhaṇḍopādhirūpasya svīkārācca2, kha. 'śaktitvasyaiva kāraṇatāvacchedakatvāccaca | tattvantu akhaṇḍopādhirūpam ityadhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ |' śabdatvasamānādhikaraṇajanakatāsambandhena bodhasyaiva śaktitvācca | pūrvoktasambandhena śaktimān śakta ityucyate, pūrvoktasambandhāvacchinnabodhaviṣayaḥ śakya ityucyate | tasya ca tattatpadārthaviṣayasya pratipadaṃ bhinnasya klṛpyatvāda gauravaṃ spaṣṭameva | kāraṇatāvacchedakabhedāt tasya bhinnatva āvaśyake lāghavāt kāraṇatāvacchedakadharmasvarūpaiva kāraṇatā | na caivaṃ satyabhede avacchedyāvacchedakabhāvānupapatti, ekarūpeṇa tadanupapattāvapi kāramatātvenāvacchedyatvasya svarūpo'vacchedakatvasya cābhyupagame kṣatyabhāvāt | kāraṇatātvasyātiriktasya sarvairapyaṅgīkārāditimate'pi nāsmākaṃ kṣatiḥ, kāraṇatāvacchedakadharmasya yatkāraṇatātvena jñānaṃ tadeva śaktijñānamiti svīkārāt | evañcedṛśajanakatvasyāpabhraṃśeṣvapi sattvena teṣāmapi śaktyava bodhakatvam | yattu, sādhusmaraṇācchaktibhramādvā bodha iti tat, na sādhusmaraṇaṃ vināpi vyutpannānāṃ bodhānubhavāt | bhavaduktasaṃskṛtairayamartho na buddhaḥ, kintvetaduktabhāṣayeti vyutpannavyavahārācca | tattatpadapadārthaghaṭiteśvarecchāyā ghaṭādipadavṛttitvena gṛhītāyā vibhinnānupūrvīkatvarūpaviśeṣadarśanasattvena sādhāraṇadharmadarśanābhāvena ca gagarīpadādau bhramānupapatteśca | ata eva tattatpadārthaghaṭitavyāpterna bhrama iti tatra tatra naiyāyikāḥ | atiriktapadārtharūpāyā gṛhītāyāḥ prāguktayuktyaiva gagarīpadādau ekatvena tatra śakterbhramo'nupapannaḥ1 kha. 'yadi tu kenacit gāvīti baṃḍuvetyādivat gauriti sādhuśabdasmaraṇāt prayojyasya bodhe ghaṭasthasya gāviśabdāde vārayabodha iti bhrameṇa śaktimapapādayituṃ śakyate tanmūlanyaṣāmapi ityucyate tathāpi' ityadhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ | | kiñca, vinigamanāvirahādapi bhāṣāyāṃ śaktiḥ sidhyati | na ca bhāṣāṇāmanekatvam, saṃskṛtavanmahārāṣṭrabhāṣāyāḥ sarvaṃdeśa ekatvena tatra śakterduṣpariharatvāt | etena bhāṣāntarairvinigamanāvirahānnaikatra śkatirityapāstam, saṃskṛtasyāpi pratyekabhāṣābhirvinigamanāvirahāt | na ca sakaladeśaśiṣṭaparigṛhītatvaṃ vinigamakam, evaṃ hi duścyavanaśabdasya indre'neḍamūkādiśabdānāṃ mūkavadhirādau śaktisidhyanāpatteḥ śiṣṭaistadaprayogāt | ata evāprayuktatvadoṣāvasare duścyavanādiśabdānudājahāra prakāśakṛt | na ca koṣaprāmāṇyena tatra tatkalpam, śaktibhrameṇa kośakṛtāṃ tatpāṭha ityasyāpi kalpayituṃ śakyatvāt, vācakasya vyañjakatve ālaṅkārikāṇāṃ prākṛtādibhāṣodāharamabalena tatrāpi śaktisiddhyāpatteśca, tattaddeśīyaśiṣṭānāṃ tattadbhāṣāsujāyamānasya nirvicikitsaśaktatvapratyayasya bādhakaṃ vinā bramatvāyogācca, bhramasyāsaṃbhavācca | kiñca lāghavena janakatvasyaiva śaktitve siddhe tasya cāpabhraṃśeṣvapi sattvāt śaktataṃ durvāram | apabhraṃśād bodhasya tvayāpyaṅgīkārāt | śaktigrāhakavyavahārādestulyatvācca | etena,'sādhuśabdamātraniṣṭhaṃ bodhakataṃ śaktiḥ' ityapāstam | na ca teṣvasādhutvaniścayena tato bodhānāpattiḥ, asādhutvaniścayasya tatpratibandhakatvāditi vācyam, tatsattve'pi saṃskṛtamaviduṣāṃ prākṛtādito bodhena tasyāpratibandhakatvāt . na ca tatra mānaso bodhaḥ, anyatrāpi tathātvāpattyā tīrādyaśaktatve sati tīrādisambandhiśaktatvaṃ tīralakṣaṇetyādikampāstamiti prāhuḥ | yattu, śakyādaśakyopasthitirlakṣaṇā | sā ca svarūpasatī hetuḥ | eka sambandhijñānavidhayā padajaśaktiprayojyaśakyajñānajanyāśakyatānavacchedakāvacchinnopasthitiriti hi tadarthaḥ | gaṅgāpadena pravāhopasthitau mukhyārthabādhasahakṛtaikasambandhijñānāt prāg gṛhītasambandhakasyopasthitasya tīrādeḥ śābdabodhe bhānam | śābdabodhe ca padaprayojyaivopasthitisvam, na tu padajanyaiveti niyama iti na doṣaḥ | ākāśapadaśakyasyāpyākāśasya yadākāśapadādeva samavāyasambandhenopasthitistatsambandhāccānyopastitiḥ, tasya śābde'nvayavāraṇāya śaktiprayojyeti | ghaṭarūpārthadarśanena śaktisambandhādupasthitaghaṭapadāt samavāyenopasthitākāśasya śābde'nvayavāraṇāya śakyajñānajanyeti | nānārthasthala ekārthasambandhena smṛtāparapadārthasya śābde'nvayavāraṇāyāśakyeti | nānārthasthala ekārthasambandhena smṛtāparapadārthasya śābde'nvayavāraṇāyāśakyeti | sāmānyaśabdasya viśeṣe lakṣaṇāsthale upasthitiviṣayasya viśeṣaprakārāvacchinnasyārthasya śakyārthabhitannatvābhāvāt tatsaṅgrahāya śakyatānavacchedakāvacchinneti tadarthakaraṇam | evañca śakyatānavacchedakaviśeṣarūpāvacchinnatvāt tatsaṅgrahaḥ | na caivaṃ tādṛśopastiteḥ svarūpato na mukhyārthabādhādhīnatvam, mbandhijñānādirūpodbodhakasattve tamanapekṣyaiva saṃskāreṇa mukhyārthasyeva tasyāpyupasthiteḥ sambhavāt | tathā ca lakṣaṇāyāṃ mukhyārthabādhādhīnatvavyavahārānupapattiriti vācyam, tajjanyaśābdānubhavasya tadadhīnatvena tasyā api tattvavyavahārāt | ata eva 'varṇasamudāyaśaktaṃ padapadam' iti jānataḥ padapadācchaktyopasthitavarṇasamudāyena svāśrayatayopastitākāśāderanvayabodhāpattiriti nirastam, mukhyārthabādhajñānābhāvāt | tatsattve sati ca tātparye iṣṭāpatteḥ | śābdakāraṇatāvacchedakaṃ ca prāguktatādṛśopasthitvamevetyāhuḥ | tat, na; etapekṣayā bodhakatvajñānasya hetutve lāghavāt | kiñca, śābdabodhahetupadārthopasthityanukūlapadapadārthasambandharūpavṛttibhūtalakṣaṇāyā nedaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ yogyam | upasthitiretorhi vṛttitvam, na tūpasthitereva | kiñcaivam 'lākṣaṇikaṃ padam' iti vyavahārasya gauṇatvāpattiriti dik | tasmād aprasiddhaśakyasambandhitvena gṛhītārthaviṣayabodhajanakatvaṃ lakṣaṇātvena vyavahriyate | prasiddhārthaviṣayañca tacchaktitvenetyeva sāmpratam | prasiddhatvañca praciraprayogaviṣayatvam | tajjñānañca1 prasiddhatvajñānañca | śaktigrāhavyavahārāt kvacit, kvacid vyākaraṇakośāditaḥ, kvacicchiṣṭaprayogādi2 anyathā vacantītyasya nivṛttiḥ, pika-nema-tāmarasāvīnāñca saṅgraho na syāt | tyādyūhyam | śaktyādiniyāmakatayā prasiddhyādestavāpyāvaśyakatvāt| tatra lakṣaṇājñānajanyaśābdabodhe'nvayavyatirekābhyāṃ mukhyārthabādhajñānaṃ kāraṇam | mukhyārthabādhaśca samabhivyāhṛtapadātparyaviṣaye tātparyaviṣayānvaye vā mukhyārthatāvacchedakarūpeṇa mukhyārthāsaṃsargarūpaḥ | tena 'chatriṇo yānti', 'kākebhyodadhi rakṣyatām' ityādau chatrikuntakākānāṃ mukhyārthānāṃ samabhivyāhṛtakriyāsu kartṛtvakarmatvābādhatvairanvayābādhe'pi tattātparyaviṣayībhūtecchatryacchatrigamanabhojanārthapraveśadadhyupagātakāvadhikarakṣaṇeṣu mukhyārthatāvaccedakarūpeṇa tadanvayabādho'styeveti na doṣaḥ | kecitu, lakṣyārthatātparyagrāhakatayā tasyopayogaḥ | tathā hi --- samabhivyāhṛtapadārthasaṃsṛṣṭamukhyārthakatvena bhramādirūpadoṣarahitāptapuruṣoccaritatvaviśiṣṭena mukhyārthaparatvābhāvānumānapūrvakaṃ sāmānyatātparyagrāhakasahakāreṇa tadanyaparatvagrahajananādityāhuḥ | evaṃ mukhyārthasambandhajñānamapi tathā anvayavyatirekābhyāmeva rūḍhiprayojanānyataradapi tatkāraṇaṃ bodhyam, anubhāvabalāt | nanvevaṃ sarveṣāṃ padānāṃ nānārthatvādakṣādipadavadarthasandehaḥ syāt | kḷñca, nānārthajabodhe tātparyajñānasya kāramatvāvaśyakatvena 'gaṅgāyāṃ kāṣṭhamasti' ityādivākyajapravāhabodhe'pi tātparyajñānasya tvanmate kāraṇatvakalpane gauravam | saṃkeśaktivādinastu tanneti lāghavam | api ca, tātparyasya saṃketātmakatvena saṃketajñānakāryakāraṇabhāvo'pi tabāvaśyaka iti cet, na; prasiddhanānārthaviṣayakabodhajanakatvasyaiva nānārthvenākṣateḥ | etena 'anyayāścānekārthatvam' iti nyāyavirodha ityapāstam | na caivam 'sarve sarvārthavācakāḥ' iti vaiyākaraṇasiddhāntavirodhaḥ hetutvābhiprāyeṇaupacārikatayā vyāvahārāditi dik1digarthastu -- yogināmeva sarvapadāt sarveṣāmarthānāṃ bodha, na tvasmadādīnām ;, ato nāyaṃ, pakṣo yukta iti | spaṣṭañcaitallaghumajjūṣāyāṃ lakṣaṇāprārambhe | | sā dvividhā --- śuddhā, gauṇī ca | sādṛśyātiriktasambandhena śakyasambandhyarthapratipādikā śuddhā | svanirūpitasādṛśyādhikaramatvasambandhena śakyasambandhyarthapratipādikā gauṇī | yattu, gauṇī na lakṣaṇāntargatā, viśiṣṭabuddhiyogyasambandhe satyeva lakṣaṇāpravṛtteḥ | na hi saṃyogasambandhena 'daṇḍī devadattaḥ' itivat sādṛśyasambandhena 'siṃhavān devadattaḥ' iti bhavatīti | tat, naḥ viśiṣṭabuddhyoyogyatve'pi viparītalakṣaṇāsthale svanirūpitavirodhādhikaraṇatvasambandhe'pi tasyāḥ klṛptatvāt | te ca pratyekaṃ dvividhe -- ajahatsvārthā, jahatsvārthā ca | śakyārthāparityāgenetarārthalakṣaṇamādyā | śakyārthāparityāgaśca śakyārthasya yena kenāpi rūpeṇa lakṣyārthānvayinānvayitvam | ataḥ 'chatriṇo yānti', 'kuntān praveśaya', 'kākebhyo dadhi rakṣyatām' ityādau na doṣaḥ, acchatryādisādhāraṇarūpeṇa cchatryādeḥ kuntavadviseṣaṇatayā kuntāderdadhyupaghātakatvādinā kākādeśya lakṣyārthānvayikriyānvayitvāt | svārthaparityagenetarārthalakṣaṇaṃ dvitīyā | ataḥ 'gāṃ vāhīkaṃ paśya,' ityādau na doṣaḥ | atra gosadṛśe lakṣaṇāyāmapi na gostadanvayidarśanakriyānvayitvam | tatra śuddhā ādyā yathā 'śuklamānaya' ityādau guṇaśaktānāṃ śuklādipadānāṃ tadvati dravye | sā dvitīyā yathā 'tvacā jñātam' ityādau tvagādiśabdānāṃ tvagindriye | gauṇī dvitīyā yathā --- lavaṇatvavācino lāvaṇyaśabdasya hṛdayaṅgamatvasādṛśyācchobhāviśeṣe | gauṇī ādyā tu nāstyeva, sādṛśyasambandhena lakṣaṇāyāṃ mukhyārthasya lakṣyāryānvayinānvayāt | govāhīkobhayapare 'gāva ete samānīyantām' ityādau govāhīkasamudāyaśchatrinyāyena lakṣyate, na tu gosadṛśatvena, svasmin bhedaghaṭitasvasādṛsyābhāvāditi prāñcaḥ1 vaiyākaraṇanye sādṛśyaṃ bhedaghaṭitameveti niyamaḥ, 'nañivayuktamanyasadṛśāṣikaraṇe tathāhyarthagatiḥ' pari. 3|75 | iti paribhāṣāyām 'anyasadṛśa' iti padena bhedādhaṭitasyāpi sādṛśyasya sūcanāt | sādṛśyasya bhedaghaṭitatvaniyamāṅgīkāre sadṛśapadādeva bhedārthalābhe'nyapadavaiyarthyāpattiḥ | yattu, mukhyārthaviśeṣaṇikā lakṣaṇā ajahatsvārthā | sā ca gauṇyapīti | tat, na; 'citraguḥ' ityādāvapi paramate jahatsvārthāpatteḥ | navyāstu, yadā yatkiñcid gosadṛśatvena govāhīkasamudāyapratipipādayiṣayā 'gāva ete yānti' iti prayuktam, tadā gauṇyapyādyā durvāraiva | vastuto rūpake bhedāghaṭitasādṛśyasyaiva sambandhatvādervakṣyamāṇatayā sā darvāraiveti prāhuḥ | prāguktodāharaṇādigatāśca lakṣaṇā rūḍhilakṣaṇātvena vyavahriyante | rūḍhiḥ prasiddhiḥ | na caiṣāmarthānāṃ prasiddhatve śaktirevāstu, aśvagandhādipadānāmivauṣadhiviśeṣādāviti vācyama, saprayojanalakṣaṇāsthalīyalakṣyārthāpekṣayā'sya prasiddhatve'pi tatpadaśakyārthāntarāpekṣayā'prasiddhatvasyaiva sattvenākṣaterityāhuḥ | vastuto yeṣāmekārthasambandhyaparārthabodhakatvam1 kha. 'aparārtha' iti nāsti |, tadarthabādhapratisandhānapūrvakameva teṣu prayojanābhāve nirūḍhalakṣaṇeti vyavahāraḥ | anyatra rūḍhiśaktireva | evañca yadi kusādipade mukhyārthabādhapratisandhānapūrvakaṃ dakṣabodhaḥ prāmāṇikānubhavasiddhaḥ, tadā lakṣaṇā, anyathā rūḍhiśaktireveti dik | evañca lakṣaṇā prakārāntareṇāpi dvidhā sampannā, rūḍhā prayojanavatī ca | tatra rūḍhodāhṛtā | prayojanavatī śuddhā ajahatsvārthā | yathā ---'kuntāḥ praviśanti' | atra bhītipalāyamānavākye kunatānāṃ tātparyaviṣayakuntipraveśānvayabādhāt kuntapadasya tatsaṃyuktapuruṣe lakṣaṇā | lakṣyeṣu kuntagatataikṣṇyapratītiḥ prayojanam | puruṣaviśeṣaṇatayā kuntānāṃ praveśanikriyānvayaḥ spaṣṭa eva | sā jahatsvārthā . yathā --- 'gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ' ityādau | atra hi pravāhe ghoṣādhikaraṇatvabādhād gaṅgāpadena tīraṃ lakṣyate | na ca pravāhasya tadanvayinānvayitvam | gaṅgāgataśaityapāvanatvādipratītiśca prayojanam | eṣā gauṇī jahatsvārthā | yathā --- 'gaurvāhīkaḥ' ityādau | atra vāhīke gautvabādhād gopadena gosadṛśo lakṣyate | sādṛśyatiśayamahimnā bhinnadharmaprakārakopasthitāvapyabhedapratītiḥ prayojanam | atra prayojanabhūtābhedapratītirmānasī,1 bādhajñānasamakālikecchājanyaṃ jñānamāhāryajñānam | āhāryābhedasyopasthiteriti kecit | viṣayaviṣayipadābhyāṃ tattaddharmaprakāreṇa tayoruṣasthitau prasiddhatvādinā ḍhaṭiti tatsādṛśyopasthitau lakṣaṇayā sadṛśaprakārakabodhe sādṛśyātiśayamahimnā gotvavāhīkatvayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyasambhāvanayā jātasyāpi bhedajñānasya tirodhānena bādhabuddherabhāvenānāhāryamevābhedajñānam | kḷñca, bodhasyaivānāpattiḥ | iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥ -- yatra prasiddhaḥ sādhāraṇadharmaḥ, tatra tadupādānaṃ na karttavyam | yatra tvaprasiddhaḥ, yathā -- 'sakalakalaṃ purametajjātaṃ sudhāṃśubimbamiva' ityādau | tatra tadupādānaṃ vinā sādhāraṇadharmānupasthitestadupādānamāśyakamityapare | abhedapratītervaiyañjanikatvavādināṃ tvanāhāryatvaṃ spaṣṭameva, vaiyañjanike bodhe bādhabuddherapratibandhakatvāt | vastutastu śabdaprayojye bodhe bādhajñānaṃ na pratibandhakam, bādhaniścayādeḥ sattve'pi 'asya kṣīṇipateḥ parārdhaparayā lakṣīkṛtāḥ saṅkhyayā,' 'eṣa bandhyāsuto yāti' ityādito vācyārthabodhadarśanāt | kiñca, evam 'vahninā siñcati' ityato'pi bodhānāpattau tadvākyaprayoktuḥ 'adraveṇa vahninā sekaṃ kathaṃ bravīṣi' ityupahāsaḥ śrotṛbhiḥ kriyāmāṇo'saṅgataḥ syāt | etadarthakadraviḍabhāṣāśravaṇottaraṃ pāścāttyasyeva mūkataiva ca parantasya syāt | tenekapadārthe'parapadārthasya prakṛtasaṃsargavattavaṃ yogyatā | 'devadatto gauḥ' ityatra devadatte svāmitvasambandhasattvād yogyatāvāraṇāya prakṛte tañjñānaṃ ca śābdabodhe kāraṇam | yadvā, ekapadārthaniṣṭhātyantābhāvapratiyogitvarūpāyogyatāniścayaḥ śābde pratibandhakaḥ | sa ca na svātantryeṇa, anumityādisādhāraṇaklṛptabādhabuddhipratibandhyapratibandhakabhāvena nirvāhādityapāstam | na cātra śābdabodhaḥ, kintu padārthopasthitimātramiti vācyam, anyatrāpi tatātvāpattau1 padārthopasthitimātratvāpattau | śabdaprāmāṇyocchedaprasaṅgāt | na ca pravṛttiṃ prati viśiṣṭajñānasya hetutvānurodhena śābdaviśiṣṭajñānasiddhiḥ, duḥkhadveṣecchāsukhādāvapi tadrītyā taddhetutvena satyapi bādhaniścaye mithyābhiśāpagālidānarūpādikāvya --- 'vahninā siñcati' ityādivākya śravaṇajasukhaduḥkho khe'pi tadrītyā taddhetuttvena satyapi vā pahāsādyanurodhena tadāvaśyakatvāt | anayathāḥ vyatpannānāṃ 'vahniḥ karaṇatvaṃ sekaḥ' ityākārakavākyaśravaṇottaramapi tadāpattiḥ, mukhatvamāśrayo'bhedaścandratvamāśraya iti vākyaśravaṇottaramapi 'mukhaṃ candaḥ' ityādivākyaśravaṇottaramiva camatkārāpattiśca | etenāsaṃsargāgrahamātreṇa tatsiddhirityāpāstam | kiñca, asaṃsargāgraho nāma saṃsargābhāvagrahābhāvaḥ | tathā sati bādhajñānābhāvena viśiṣṭabuddhyudaya eva syāt | na caivam 'vahninā sḷñca' ityādito bodhe pravṛttirapi syāt | prākṛtabādhajñānena jāyamānajñāne'prāmāṇyaśaṅkāyā jananāt tacchūnyajñānasyaiva ca pravṛttāvupayogitvādakṣateḥ | taduktam ---' atyantāsatyapi hyarthe jñānaṃ śabdaḥ karoti hi' iti | evañca bādhabuddhipratibandhyatāvacchedakakoṭau śabdaprayojyānyatvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ deyam, anubhavabalāt | evacānāhāryatvaṃ spaṣṭamevetyapi vadanti | yadi tu śabdajanyabhedakadharmopasthitikālikatvamātreṇāhāryatvavyavahāraḥ, tarhyastu, bāhīkābhiprāyeṇa prayukte 'gāṃ paśya' ityādau tātparyaviṣaye vāhīkadarśane mukhyārthasaṃsargabādhād gosadṛso lakṣyate | sādṛsyātiśayamahimnā lakṣye śakyābhedapratītiḥ phalam | eṣā anāhāryaiva | śabdajabhedakadharmopasthitikālikatvābhāvenādhikacamatkārakāritvam 'śabdaja' ityuktermukhyārthabādhajñānavidhayābhedasyopasthitatve'pi na kṣatiḥ | idamevābhipretya 'sarvethaivābhedāvagamo'tra prayojanam,' kā. pra. u. 2, pa. 52 iti prakāśakṛtaḥ | evañca vāhīkatvenānupasthitireva, śuktau rajatatvārope śaktitvenaiva | kecittu, gotvenaiva vāhīkasya bodhaḥ, śakyatāvacchedakātiriktarūpeṇa śakyabodhe1 kha. 'lakṣaṇāyāḥ .... bodhe'pi ' iti nāsti | lakṣaṇāyā iva śakyatāvacchedarūpeṇa śakyānyabodhe'pi tasyāḥ prasarāt, na tu sadṛśatvenetyāhuḥ | anye2kha. 'anye tu ..... ityāhuḥ' iti nāsti |tu, gotvavāhīkatvobhayadharmaprakārakavāhīkabodha eva, śakyatāvacchedakalakṣyatāvacchedakobhayaprakārakabuddherevaitallakṣaṇākāryatvāt | pṛthakpadajanyavāhīkatvānupasthitireva sāropāto'syā bhediketyāhuḥ | spaṣṭacedaṃ matam "puṃyogādākhyāyām" 4|1|48 iti sūtrabhāṣye |1 tatra bhāṣyaṃ tu --- kathaṃ punarayaṃ praṣṭhaśabdo'kārāntaḥ striyāṃ vartate ? tasyedamityanenātrabhisambandhena | yathaiva hyasau tatkṛtān snānodvavartanapariṣekān labhate, evaṃ praṣṭhaśabdamapi labhate | yadyevam, puṃyogādākhyāyāṃ taddhitasya lugvaktavyaḥ | tasyevam iti prāpnoti | na tarhīdānīmidaṃ bhavati prāṣṭhya imāḥ prācarya imā iti | bhavati ca | vibhāṣā lugvaktavyaḥ | yadā luk tadā praṣṭhī, yadā na luk tadā prāṣṭhī | yadyevaṃ nārtho lukā vibhāṣā taddhitotpattiḥ | yadā taddhitotpattistadā praṣṭhī | evamapi lug vaktavyaḥ, nahyantareṇa lukaṃ padārthe sabdo vartate .... naiṣa doṣaḥ, nāvaśyamayamekābhisambandho bhavati tasyedamiti ayamapyabhisambandho bhavati so'yamiti | kathaṃ punaratasmin sa ityetadbhavati ? caturbhiḥ prakārairatasmin 'saḥ' ityetad bhavati --- tātsthyāt tāddharmyāt tatsāmīpyāt tatsāhacaryāditi | idameva bhedadvayaṃ sāropāsādhyavasānātvenālaṅkārikairvyabahṛtam | śabdajaviṣayaniṣṭhāsādhāraṇadharmagrahe sati yatrānyasyānyatādātmyapratītiḥ sā sāropā | tadgrahe'satyapi yatrānyasyānyatādātmyapratītiḥ sā sādhyavasānā | idaṃ bhedadvayaṃ śuddhāyā api | yathā ---'jīvanaṃ ghṛtam' ityādau | atra hi jīvanapadena jīvanajanakaṃ lakṣyate | itaravailakṣyaṇyena tajjanakatvapratītiḥ phalam | nanvatra kiṃ bījam, evam 'gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ', ityādau gaṅgāgataśaityapāvanatvādipratītirapi katham, bījābhāvāt | na ca gaṅgādiśabdena taṭādipratītireva bījam, anyārthaśaktapadenānyārthabodhanasyānyārthe svaśakyagatadharmapratītiphalakatvāditi vācyam, evamapi prakṛti'nupapatteḥ | nahi prakṛte jīvanagatadharmapratītirlakṣye iti cet, na; tadvācakaśabdabodhyatvanimittavasād lakṣamājñānaprayojyāyā vaiyañjanikyā vā śakyābhedabuddherapi jananena tatpratītyupapatteḥ | tasyāñca yatyām 'jīvanaṃ ghṛtam' ityādau idameva jīvanarūpeṇa pariṇamatīti buddhyā itaravailakṣaṇyapratītiḥ phalati | evam 'jīvanamevāsau bhuṅkte' ityādāvavyabhicāreṇa tajjanakatvapratītiḥ | kāraṇakāryayorbhinnaśabdābhyāṃ bhedenopasthitau hi vyabicāraśaṅkā'pi syāt | iha tu tadabhāvāt sā'pi neti | na caivam 'upakṛtaṃ nāma' ityādau virodhilakṣaṇālakṣitāpakṛtādau tenaiva nimittena upakṛtābhedabuddhirapi syāditi vācyam, astyevopakārābhedabuddhirapakāre'pi, upakārābhedabuddhyaiva sādhatvaṃ vyaṅgyāmityāhuḥ | evam 'rājakīyaḥ puruṣo rājā' ityādau rājasvāmikādau lakṣaṇā bodhyā | na ca janakatvasādṛśyādiḥ śakyasya lakṣye na sambandhaḥ, tasya ca lakṣyakatāvacchedakatvaṃ katham 'gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ' ityādāvadarśanāt tīratvenaiva tatra tīrabodhāditi vācyam, bādhakābhāvena tadavacchinne'pi lakṣaṇāgrahasya sambhavāt | apare tu, sarvatraiva lakṣaṇājñānasya lakṣyatāvacchedakaśakyatāvacchedakobhayaprakārakaśābdatvaṃ kāryatāvacchedakam, tarthavānubhavāt | evañca gaṅgātvādinaiva tīrasya bodhaḥ | evañca śaityapāvanatvādipratītaye madhye śakyabhedaviṣayakaṃ jñānāntaraṃ nāṅgīkāryamiti lāghavam | etena 'kacatastrasyati vadanaṃvadanāt kucamaṇḍalaṃ trasati' ityādau kacatvādinā bodhe trāsakaratvānupapattiriti parāstam, 'kacatvaviśiṣṭo rāhuḥ' iti bodhena tadupapatteḥ, kevalarāhutvena bodhe camatkārānāpatteḥ | na caivaṃ pravāhatvaviśiṣṭe ghoṣābhāvajñānena tīrādau pravāhatvābhāvajñānena ca pratibandhāt kathaṃ lakṣyārthaśābdabodhaḥ, kathaṃ vā prāṅmate śakyābedabuddhiḥ, kathaṃ vā 'gaṅgāvṛttigharmābhāvavat tīram' iti jñāne tadgataśaityapāvanatvādipratītiriti vācyam, bādhabuddheḥ śābdabodhāpratibandhakatvāt | na caivamapi jāyamānabodhaprāmāṇyaśaṅkājanane tataścamatkārānāpattiriti vācyam, viṣayatāsambandhena śakyatāvacchedakatatsamānādhikaraṇadharmetadanyataraviṣayakatvādhagrahajanyāprāmāṇyajñānaṃ prati janakatārūpaviṣayaniṣṭhapratyāsattyā lakṣaṇājñānasya pratibandhakatvānna doṣa- | 'gaurvāhīkaḥ' ityādau tu sādṛśyamahimnāpi bādhabuddhisthaganamityuktamityāhuḥ | yattu 'gaurvāhīkaḥ' ityādau gauṇyāṃ sādhāraṇadharmāśrayo jaḍādirjaḍatvena lakṣyaḥ | govṛttyasādhāraṇajaḍatvapratītiḥ phalamiti tat, na; 'gaurvāhīko jaḍaḥ' ityādau paunaruktyāpatteḥ | na copāttadharmātiriktadharmamukhena lakṣaṇeti vācyam, tadatiriktadharmāsphuraṇe'pi vākyārthapratītidarśanāt, 'akṣasaṅghātāṅkitāni; śarīrāṇi, kamalāni' 'sakalakalaṃ puraṃ sudhāṃśubimbam' ityādau śleṣalabdhadharma vinā dharmāntarasya sarvathaivāsphuraṇācca | nanu 'gaurvāhīkaḥ' ityādisāropāsthale sadṛśatvena lakṣaṇeti tvaduktamapyayuktam | tathā sati sādṛśyasya śabdopāttatvenopamālaṅkārasya śabdopāttatvenopamālaṅkārasya prasaṅgena 'gauriva gavayaḥ' ityatropamā, 'gaurvāhīkaḥ' ityatra rūpakamityālaṅkārikasiddhāntabhaṅgāpattiḥ | nahi sādṛśyasya vācyatva evopamā, 'padmapratipakṣamānanam' ityādau lakṣyatve'pi taddarśanāt | kḷñca, 'vāhīko'yaṃ na gosadṛśaḥ, api tu gaureva' ityādau sādṛśayvyatirekamiśrite sādṛśyabuddhyayoga iti cet, na; bhedagarbhasādṛśalakṣaṇāyāmabhedapratītau rūpakāpattiriti vācyam, bhedaghaṭitasādṛśyavati tasya nirūḍhalakṣaṇābhyupagamena prayojanānapekṣātvādityāhuḥ | navyāstu --- "gaurvāhīkaḥ" ityādau na lakṣaṇā, kintu nāmārthayorabhedānvayarītyā viṣayaviṣayiṇīrabhedenaivānvayaḥ, prasiddhatvādinopasthitasādṛśyamahimnā prāgvadevāprāmāṇyajñānānāskanditānāhāryābhedabuddhyupapattai lakṣaṇāyā vyarthatvāt | kiñca, lakṣaṇāyām 'rājanārāyaṇaṃ lakṣmīstvāmāliṅgati nirbharam' ityādau viśeṣaṇasamāsāyattaṃ rūpakam, upamitasamāsāyattopamā veti sandehe 'yadyatropamā syāt, tarhi nārāyaṇasadṛso rājetyarthe nārāyaṇasadṛse lakṣmīkartṛkāliṅganasaṃsargabādha iti rūpakameva' ityālaṅkārikoktaṃ virudhyeta, rupake'pi sadṛśalakṣaṇāyāṃ rājābhinnanārāyaṇasadṛśamityarthe tattādavasthyāt | yadi tu nārāyaṇa sadṛśasya lakṣyasya śakyatāvacchedakanārāyaṇatvena bhānamityādimatenāyaṃ doṣaḥ, matāntare'pi bhedāgarbhasādṛśyasyaiva lakṣyatāvacchedakatvānna doṣa iti vibhāvyate, tarhi vyarthatvameva doṣaḥ | svīkṛtā, ca 'śoṇābhrasandhyākālasadṛśaḥ kāṣāyavasano yatiḥ' ityādau bimbuprativimbabhāvenopamāsthale sādhāraṇadharmāṃśe vināpi lakṣaṇāṃ sādṛśyatiśayamahimnā śabdāt svāsādhāraṇarūpeṇopasthitayorapi viṣayaviṣayiviśeṣaṇayorabhedabuddhirālaṅkārikaiḥ "gāmbhīryeṇa samudro'yaṃ rājā" ityādau jñānajanyajñānaprakāratvaṃ tṛtīyārthaḥ, tasya ca svaviṣayajñānajanyaviṣayatvasambandhena samudhre'nvayaḥ, 'vahnimān dhūmāt' ityādau tathā klṛptatvāt | lakṣaṇāpakṣe'pyevamevocitam | lakṣyamāṇaikadeśasādṛśye prayojanatvarūpasyābhedas vā tṛtīyārthasyānvaye 'padārthaḥ padārthenānveti, na tu tadevakadeśena' iti vyutpattibhaṅgāpattiḥ1 ghaṭatvagotvādāvanvayenanityābhinna yad ghaṭatvam, nityābhinnaṃ yad gotvam, tadvān ghaṭaḥ, tadvān gauriti tātparyeṇa nityo ghaṭaḥ, nityo gaurityasya prāmāṇyavāraṇāya vyutpattiriyaṃ svīkrīyate | svīkṛtāyāñcāsyāṃ ghaṭatvagotvayoḥ padārthekadeśatvāt tatra nityapadārthasyānavayābhāvena naitādṛśaḥ prayogaḥ prāmāṇyamarhati | kiñca, sādṛśye prayojyatvamapi svajñānajanyajñānaviṣayatvameva vācyamityāhuḥ | atredaṃ bodhyam -- 'bāhīko'yamaparo gauḥ' ityādāvaparādipadaiḥ prasiddhagorbhedapratipādanena virodhānnābhedabodho vācyayoḥ, kintu tatsadṛse lakṣaṇaiva | lakṣaṇāyāśca na śakyābhedabuddhiḥ phalam, kintu sādṛsyātiśayabuddhiḥ | evañca sakalatatkāryakāritvaṃ phalati | em 'upūrvo gauḥ' iti vāhīkābhiprāyeṇa pruyakte'pi bodhyam | tatrāpi na prasiddhagavābhedo lakṣamāphalam, apūrvapadenatiraskārāt | vāhīkatvādyapratītikṛtaścādhikacamatkāraḥ | idamevābhipretya 'gaurvāhīkaḥ' ityādābabhedarūpakātiśayoktī | īdṛśasthale ca tādrūpyarūpakātiśayoktī iti kuvalayāndakṛtaḥ | na caivamupamāyā api rūpakatvāpattiḥ, yatra sādṛśyapratītikṛtaścamatkāraḥ, tatropamā; yatra tvabhedapratītikṛtaḥ sādṛśyātiśayapratītikṛtaśca1camatkāra iti śeṣaḥ |, tatra rūpakam | camatkāranidānabhedakṛto hyalaṅkārāṇāṃ parasparaṃ bheda iti spaṣṭamasmatkṛtaṣaṭpadākhyakuvalayānandaṭippaṇe | yattu mīmāṃsakāḥ --- 'gaurvāhīkaḥ' ityādau gośabdena svaśakyagatajāḍyādiguṇasadṛśajāḍyādaya eva lakṣyante, taiśca 2ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- mīmāṃsakā jātiṃ padārthaṃ manyante | gaurityatra gośabdasya gotvamarthaḥ, āśrayamantarā jātiḥ kva tiṣṭhediti 'yena vinā yadanupapannam, tattenākṣipyate' itinyāyād vyakterākṣepād bodhaḥ | jātiśaktinaye ākṣepeṇa vyaktilābhavat svāśrayavyaktilābha iti | tat, na ; 'jaḍo gaurvāhīkaḥ' ityādau punaruktyāpatteḥ | kḷñca, svarūpato jātiviṣayaśaktijñānaṃ svarūpato jātiṃ smārayad vyaktiṃ smārayatīti yuktam, vyaktimaviṣayīkṛtya svarūpato jāterbhānasyānubhavasiddhāntaviruddhatvāt | jāḍyādeśca rūpāntareṇaiva bhānāt tasya viśeṣyatayāpi bhānasabhbhavena dharmismāraṇe mānābhāvāt | na caivaṃ guṇibodhakaśuklādipadānāṃ guṇe eva śaktiḥ, guṇino bodhaścākṣepāditi 'jātyādiḥ' kā. pra. u. 2, sū. 10 ityādinā prakāśādyuktamasaṅgataṃ syāditi vācyam, ita evāsvarasāt tatra 'jādireva vā' kā. pra. u.2, sū. 10 iti pakṣāntarasyokteradoṣāt | na ca3 evañca gaurityasya gotvāśrayo'rthaḥ phalati | dharmaśaktijñānaṃ tattadāśrayobhayabodhakamiti kāryakāraṇabhāve ko doṣa iti vācyam, 'śuklam' ityādiguṇaparādapi dharmibodhāpatteḥ | vastuto dharmiṇi lakṣaṇetyeva tadāśayaḥ | iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥ --- jātiśaktaghaṭādīnāṃ kevalajātibodhakatayānakvāpi prayogaḥ, śukalādīnāṃ tu kevalaguṇabodhakatayāpīti | evañca na kaścid doṣa iti dik | kecittu, 'gramo dagdhaḥ, puṣpitaṃ vanam' ityādiprayoge grāmādipadasya svārthekadeśaparityāgena tadekadeśe vattiḥ | tatra jahadajahallakṣaṇākhyo'nyo'pi bhedaḥ, dagvabhūyastvādidyotanaṃ phalamityāhuḥ | iti lakṣaṇānirūpaṇam | <3> atha vyañjalānirūpaṇam mukhyārthasamvaddhālādhāraṇamukhyārthabādhagrahādyaprayojyāprasiddhādyarthaviṣayakadhījanakatvaṃ vyañjanā | sā ceyaṃ śabdatadarthapadaikadeśavarṇaracanāceṣṭādiṣu sarvatra, tathaivānubhavāt, 'anayā kaṭākṣeṇābhilāṣo'bhivyañjitaḥ' iti sarvajaprasiddhestasyāṃ ceṣṭāvṛtitvasyāpyāvaśyakatvācca | etenārthādīnāṃ na vyañjakatvam, kintu padasyaivetyapāstam | 'ratikāle vilokya śrīrnābhipadme pitāmahame | rasākulā chādayate dakṣiṇaṃ nayanaṃ hareḥ ||' ityādau haripadena dakṣiṇanayanasya sūryātmakatve tannimilanena sūryāstamayaḥ, tena padmasaṃkocaḥ, tena pitāmahasthaganam, tenāpratibaddhaṃ rativilasitamiti ktameṇa vyaṅgyeṣu pratīyamāneṣu tatadarthapratityutarameva vyaṅgyapratiterarthaseyāpi vyañjakatvāvaśyakatvāt | 'paśyātra nalinīpatre balākā dṛśyate'calā | ramye mārakate pātre śuktikeva ca nirmalā ||' tatrāpi niścalatyupamāyā cāśvastatvam | tena tasya nirjanatvam, tena tadevāvayoḥ saṃtetasthānamityādiṣu krameṇa pratiyamāneṣu tattadarthavyaṅgyeṣvapi bodhyam | anayā cārthabodhe jananīye vaktṛboddhṛvācyādivaiśiṣṭacajñānaṃ pratibhā ca sahakāri taddhījanakatvajñānajanakameva vā | ato nātiprasaṅgaḥ | pratibhā ca navanavonmeṣaśālini buddhiḥ | taduktam-- 'prajñā navanavonmeṣaśālinī pratibhā matā'iti | navonmeṣo janmāntarīyataddhījanakatvajñānajanyasaṃskārodbodhaḥ | vaktrādivaiśiṣṭyasahakāreṇa tajjanikā buddhiḥ pratibheti phalitam | evañca śaktiretajjanmagṛhītaivārthavodhikā, vyañjanā tu janmāntaragṛhītāpītyapi śakterasyā bhedakam | idamevābhipretya vyañjanā svarūpasatī heturiti pravādaḥ | yadyapi prāguktarītyā lakṣaṇato'pi bhedaḥ siddhaḥ, tathāpi prakārāntareṇāpi bhedaṃ vaktuṃ mukhyārthetyādyuktam | 'paśyātra nalinīpatre' ityādau vaktutātparyaviṣayībhutavācyārthabādhābhāve'pa prārgdāśatavyaṅgyacapratītermukhyārthabādhajñānasattve tadapratīteśca na vaiyañejanikabodhe tasya sahakāritvam | evam 'gato'stamarkaḥ' ityādeḥ śiṣyeṇa sandhyāvandanādeḥ kartavyatvābhiprāyeṇa guruṃ prati prayuktād vaktṛtātparyābhāve'pi prativeśyādīnāmabhisaraṇopakramādibodhasya vācyārthapratītipūrvakasya vācyārthabādhajñāne'jāyamānasya lakṣaṇayopapādayitumaśakyatvācca | yattu, 'gato'stamarkaḥ' ityādau na vyañjanā, ekasambandhidarśanādaparasambandhismaramavadupapatteriti | tat, na ; 'gato'stamarkaḥ' ityādi śravaṇottaram 'sandhyāvandanakartavyatvaṃ mayā smṛtam' ityanuvyasāyābhāvāt, 'etaduktapadādayamartho buddhaḥ' ityanuvyavasāyācca, tatrānullekhācca, idaṃ padametadarthasya na vācakam, nāpi lakṣakam, nāpi smārakam, api tu vyañjanayā bodhakam' iti prāmāṇikavyavahāreṇāpyatiriktatatsiddheśca | etena tattadarthānāṃ vakrādivaiśiṣṭyapratibhādisahakṛtamanasaiva viśiṣṭadhīsambhavāt, camatkāraṃ prati śābdasyeva mānasasyāpi ceṣṭānurodhena hetutāyāḥ klṛptatvācca vyañjanāsattve na mānam | pratibhā ca tattatpadārthaviṣayasaṃskārodbodhako buddhiviśeṣaḥ | tatra ca tattatpadatattadarthajñānaṃ vakrādivaiśiṣṭyajñānaṃ ca sahakāri iti parāstam | vyaṅgyo'rtho'numeya iti tyuktameva | viruddhānaikāntikebhyo vyāptipakṣadharmatādinirṇayābāve'pi vyaṅagyārthapratīteḥ |kiñca, siddhisattve'pi vyaṅgyārthabodhadarśanena tatpratibandhyatāvacchedakakoṭau tattadbhedaniveśe'tigoravāpattyā vaiyañjanikabodhasyātiriktatva eva lāghavam | anyathā śabdaprāmāṇyasyāpyucchedāpattirityanyatra vistaraḥ | bodhakatvasya ceṣṭāyāṃ sattve'pi tanniṣṭhabodhaktavaṃ na śaktiḥ, 'ceṣṭā śaktā' iti prāmāṇikavyavahārābhāvāt | kintu tajjanyabodhe tajjñānasya kāraṇatvaṃ bodhyam | tattadvācakaśabdasmaraṇadvārā ceṣṭayā bodha ityāpi kaściditi sarveṣṭasiddhiḥ | iti vyañjanānirūpaṇam | vṛttivicāraḥ sampūrṇaḥ1 athedānīṃ tattadācāryāṇāṃ matapradarśanapurassaraṃ śabdavṛttiḥ samāsena samīkṣyate --- śrutimantaḥ saṅkhyātītāñchabdān pratidinaṃ ṛṇvanti, parantu samyak śrutā api same śabdā naiva sravānarthaān bodhayanti, api tu kecenaiva kāṃścideva kvacanaiva | yathā - sādhu śrutādapi kambugrīvādimadarthavyakterevāvagamo bhavati, na tu pravāhasya nāpi paṭasyeti ghaṭaśabdasya kambugrīvādimadarthena kaścana sambandho vartate, na pravāheṇa, nāpi paṭenaḥ, anyathā tāvapi prabodhayet | evañca śabdārthayoḥ parasparaṃ kaścana sambandho vācyaḥ, yena śabdaḥ sambaddhamevārthaṃ prakāśayati, nāsambaddham, pradīpavaditi kalpyate; parantvevaṃ sati śabdānāṃ samavāyenākāśe sambaddhatvāt 'śabdāśrayatvamākāśatvam' iti siddhāntād ekasambandhijñānamaparasambandhinaṃ smārayatīti ghaṭādipadenākāśasyāpi bodhaḥ syāt | sa ca neṣṭaḥ, tādṛśasya bodhasyānanubhavāditi padapadārthayoḥ samavāyādivilakṣaṇaḥ kaścana sambandhaḥ kalpanīyaḥ | sa ca jñāta evāpekṣyate, nājñātaḥ; anyathā'jñāte'pi tasminnarthabodhaḥ syāt | ayameva sambandho vṛttipadena śabdavyāpārādipadena cocyate | evañca śābdabodhaupayikaḥ, arthapratiyogikaḥ padānuyogikaḥ, padapratiyogiko'rthānuyogiko vā sambandho vṛttiḥ | athavā vṛttipadavyavahārthatvaṃ vṛttitvamiti | yena śabdavyāpāreṇa bhaṭityarthabodho bhavati, so'bhidhākhyavyāpāra ityucyate | bhaṭṭalollacaprabhṛtayastvabhidhārūpāmekāmeva vṛtiṃ manvate | tayaiva ca sarvavidhasyārthasya bodho bhavati | teṣāmayamāśayaḥ -- yathā balavatā prerita eka eva iṣurekenaiva vegākhyena vyāpāreṇa riporvarmacchedam, marmabedaṃ prāṇaharaṇañca vivate, tathā sukaviprayukta eka eva śabda ekenaivābidhākhyavyāpāreṇa padārthopasthitim, anvayabodhaṃ vyaṅgyapratītiñca vidhatte | ato nāsti vācyādanyo'rthastoṣāmiti | tathā coktaṃ kāvyaprakāśe -- 'so'yamiṣoriva dīrghadīrghataro'bhidhāvyāpāraḥ' (kā. pra. u. 5, pṛ. 225) iti katipaye vidvāsaḥ | 'gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ' ityādau bhagīratharathakhātāvacchinnapayaḥ pravāhārtha pratyāyya viratavyāpārāyā abhivāyā gaterabhāvāt tīrabodho na syāditi śabde tadanyamapi lakṣaṇākhyavyāpāraṃ manvate naiyāyikāḥ | te cābhidhāṃ saṃketamapi pratipādayanti | tathā coktaṃ śaktivāde --- ' saṃketo lakṣaṇā cārthe padavṛttiḥ ' iti | evañca tattatpadena jāyamāne'rthabodhe tattatpadavṛtterjñānāt padārthopasthiti ranvayavyatirekābhyāṃ kāraṇāmati vṛttijñānābhāve śruto'pi śabdo nārthabodhaṃ jayati | ghaṭapaṭādeścākāśādau vṛtterabhāvād naiva tadviṣayako bodhaḥ | eta eva vṛttyā padapratipādya eva padārtha ityabhidhīyate | tatrādhunikasaṃketaḥ paribhāṣā | tathā cārthabodhakaṃ padaṃ pāribhāṣikam, yathā śāstrakārādisaṃketitanadīvṛddhyādipadam | īśvarasaṃketaḥ śaktiḥ | tathā cārthabodhakaṃ padaṃ vācakam | yathā gotvādiviśiṣṭabodhakaṃ gavādipadam, tadbodhyo'rtho gavādirvācyaḥ | sa eva mukhyārtha ucyate iti gadādharabhaṭṭācāryaḥ | jagadīśatakaliṅkārastu -- ubhayāvṛttidharmaviśiṣṭasaṃketavatī sañjñā pāribhāṣikī | yathā''kāśaḍitthādi | śabdavatyākāśe vyaktau nityasaṃketavatī ākāśeti sañjñā | dārumayahastivyavatau ādhunikasaṃketavatī ittheti sañjñā | ākāśaḍitthādisañjñā hi dvitayāvṛttidhamaṇaiva śabdena dārumayahastivṛttitadvyaktitvena ca rūpeṇa śabādaśrayaṃ dārumayahastivṛttitadvyaktitvāśrayaṃ ca pratipādayati | ghaṭatvādijāteranekavṛtittavād ghaṭatvādijātyāśrayavācakaṃ ghaṭapadaṃ na pāribhāṣikam | ākāśādipadasya śabdāśrayatvavirahite kevale gaganādau saṅketakalpane tu paṭādīnāmapi pāribhāṣikatvaṃ syādityādi | tatrāpi paṭatvavirahite kevale paṭe saṅketasya kalpayituṃ śakyatvāt | evañcātivyāptiḥ pādaleṣṭukā syāt | yadi paṭe saṃketitamapi paṭapadam 'na paṭatvajātiviśiṣṭaśaktimat' ityādiniścayānantaraṃ paṭādipadaśaktigrahāt paṭapadāt paṭatvajātiviśiṣṭasya pasyānanubhavādavaśyaṃ paṭādipadaśaktiḥ kiñcid dharmaviśiṣṭārthanirūpitā, na tu kevalavyaktinirupitā; anyathā taddharmaprakārakataddhamiviśeṣyakaniścaye sati taddharmābhāvaprakārakataddharmiviśeṣyakajñānaṃ na bhavatīti siddhāntāt 'paṭapadaṃ na paṭatvajātiviśiṣṭaśaktimat' ityākārakaniścayānantaraṃ paṭādipadaśaktigrahāt paṭapadāt paṭasyānubhava āpadyota | tava mate śaktau paṭatvasya prakāratayā'niveśāt, pratibandhyāpratibandhakayoḥ samānaprakārakatvābhāvādityavaśyaṃ paṭatvāvacchinne śaktirabhyupagantavyetīdamucyake, tarhi tulyayuktyā''kāśādipade'pi kathaṃ gajanimīlikā''driyate | tatrāpi śabdavati śaktamapyākāśapadam -- 'na śabādaśrayaśaktimat' iti bādhaniścayadaśāyāmākāśādipadānna śabdāśrayatvena gaganasya pratītiriti śabdāśraya evākāśasya śaktiriti vibhāvyatām | evañca --- 'paṭatvādyupalakṣite dharmiṇyeva, na tu paṭatvādijātiviśiṣṭe śaktitagrahasya tādrūpyeṇa paṭatvādinā paṭaviṣayakānubhavaṃ prati hetutvād māstu paṭādipadasyāpi paṭatvādyavacchinne śaktiḥ | parantu paṭatvādyupalakṣitavyaktiṣveva itivadato dīdhitikārasyāpi gehe rajanītyaho vidhervaicitryam |' ekasambandhenānekeṣu vartamānā ye upādhayo dharmāstadviśiṣṭe saṃketavatī sañjñā tvaupādhikī | yathā -- bhūtayūtādīḥ | sā hi sacetanāvṛttiviśeṣaguṇavattvavārtāhārakatvādyanugatopādhipuraskāreṇaivaśakto bhavati | śabdāśrayatvādikantvakhaṇḍatvenopādhirapi nānugato dvitayāvṛttitvāt, ataḥ pāribhāṣike gaganādipade nātiprasaṅgaḥ | nanvevaṃ ghaṭapadasyāpi naimittikatvaṃna syāt, pratyuta ghaṭatvājāteravayavasaṃyogaviśeṣavṛttitayaupādhikatvaṃ syāditi cet, iṣṭāpattiḥ | yadi ca svāśrayāśrayatvarūpaparamparāsambandhena vaijātyavattvena śaktaṃ ghaṭapadam, tadā naimittikameveti na vyavahāravirodha ityāha | bhartṛ haripadāstu -- yasminnarthe yannāmādhunikasaṃketavat tadeva tatra pāribhāṣikam | evañca yādṛśānupūrvī yādṛśārthaviśeṣyakakiñcijjanyabodhaviṣayatvaprakārakānityasaṃketaviṣayatāviśeṣāvacchedikā tādṛśānupūrvīmattvaṃ tādṛśārthe pāribhāṣitvamiti paryavasitam | yathā pitrādibhiḥ putrādau saṃketitaṃ caitrādi, yathā vā śāstrakudbhiḥ siddhyabhāvādau saṃketitaṃ pakṣatādi | yasminnarthe jātyavacchinnaśkatimannāma naimittikam; evañca yādṛśānupūrvīyādṛśārthaviśeṣyakajātyavacchinnasvaśaktinirūpakatāvacchedikā tādṛsānupūrvīmattvaṃ tādṛśārthanaimittikatvaṃ payaivasitam | yathā - gavi gonāma, gavaye ca gavayādināma | yatrārthe yadupādhyavacchinnaśaktitamannāma tadaupādhikam | tathā ca yādṛśānupūrvī yādṛśārthaviśeṣyakasakhaṇḍadharmavaccinnaśkatinirūpakatāvacchedikā tādṛśānupūrvīmattvaṃ phalitam | yathā''kāśapaśvādi | nanu ādhunikasaṃketasyāpiśaktimattvāt pāribāṣikacaitrādiśabdānāṃ naimittikatvāpattiḥ, nadīvṛddhyādiśabdānāmaupādhiktavāpatiśaaca | iṣṭāpattau ca tena rūpeṇa vibhāgāsambhavaḥ, mithoviruddharmasyaiva vibhājakatāvacchedakatvāditi cet na; saṃketasya śaktitvenādhunikasya saṃketasya śaktitvābhāvāt | tathāhi --- ājānikaścādhunikaḥ saṃketo dvividho mataḥ | nitya ājānikastatra yā śaktirityabhidhīyate || kādācitkastvādhunikaḥ śāstrakārādibhiḥ kṛtaḥ || tatra = tayormadhye, nityaḥ saṃketaḥ ājānikaḥ = na janirutpatiryasyāsau ajaniḥ, ajanirevājānikaḥ, svārthe ikaṇitiājānikaśabdo yaugikaḥ | anye tu, ājātikaḥ kālatvavyāpaka ityarthaḥ | tathā cājānikaḥ śabdaḥ pāribhāṣika ityāhuḥ | tat na ; yaugikasambhave pāribhāṣikakalpanāyā anyāyyatvāt | na ca prāgabhāvāpratiyogitve sati dhvaṃsāpratiyogitvarūpasya nityatvasya yogālabhyatvena tadbodhane tasya kathaṃ yaugikatvamiti vācyam, prāgabhāvātiriktasyānutpannavastuno dhvaṃsāpratiyogitviyamāt | nityapadasyaivānupannapatatvād vā | na ca tayorekārthatvena paunaruktyam, ājādika ityasyājānikaśabdapratipādyaparatvāt | ata eva yā śkatirityatra yatpadsaya nityasaṃketaparatve'pi 'śaktirityabhidhīyate' ityanena śaktipadapratipādyatvakathanād na pauraruktyam | ata eva ca 'prajāvatī bhrātṛjāyā' 'śyālāḥ syurbhrātaraḥ patnyāḥ', 'satkṛtyālaṅakṛtāṃ kanyāṃ yo dadāti sa kūkudaḥ' ityādāvapi na ponaruktyam | kādācitkatvam = dhvaṃsapratiyogitvam | ādhinikaḥ = ādhinikaśabdapratipādyaḥ | sa ca ka ityāṅkṣāyāmāha - śāstrakārādibhiriti | ādinā mlacchādiparigrahaḥ | yathā strīkṛtekāre nadīpadasya,ārādiṣu vṛddhyādipadasya saṃketaḥ, raṅgau yavapadasya saṃketaḥ | na ca pitrādisaṃketite caitrādipade nityasaṃketavattve mānamasti, dvādaśe'hni pūrvapūrvaprayuktatvāpātācca, tasta tanniyatatvādityuktatvāt | caibhādipadānāmiva pārasīkādiśabdānāṃ saṃketavatvāviśeṣe'pi na teṣāṃ dharmakarmaṇyupayogaḥ, "sādhubhirbhāṣitavyaṃ nāsādhubhiḥ, nāpabhāṣitavai na mlecchitavai" iti śrutyā tatra tanniṣedhāt | mlecchitavai = mlecchamātrasaṃketitaiḥ, kharādiśabdāstu rābhasādau mlecchairivāryyairapi saketitā ityāhuḥ | śābdikāḥ, vyañjanāmapyekāṃ tṛtīyāṃ vṛttimabhyupagacchanti | tathā coktaṃ nāgeśena -- mukhyārthabādhagrahanirapekṣabodhajanako mukhyārthasambaddhāsambaddhasādhāraṇaprasiddhāprasiddhārthaviṣayako vaktrādivaiśiṣṭyajñānapratibhādyudbuddhaḥ saṃskāraviśeṣo vyañjanā | ata eva nipātānāṃ dyotaktvaṃ sphoṭasya vyaṅgyatā ca haryādibhiruktā | dyotakatvañca kvacit samabhivyāhṛtapadīśaktivyañjakatvam, iti vaiyākaraṇānāmapi tatsvīkāra āvaśyakaḥ | eṣā ca śabdatadarthapadapadaikadeśavarṇaracanāceṣṭādiṣu sarvatra, tarthavānubhavāt | vaktrādivaiśiṣṭyādijñānaṃ vyaṅgyaviśeṣabodhe sahakārīti na sarvatra tadapekṣetyanyatra vistaraḥ | (vaiyā. si. la. ma. pṛ. 133) śābdikaiḥ sā smṛkaiva trividhāpi svarādivat | abhidhā lakṣaṇā vyaktirityākhyā tritayaṃ matam || (kovidanande pṛ.1, ślo. 42) vividhā vṛttirekaiva vailakṣaṇye'pi vastutaḥ | ityāhuḥ śābdikāsteṣāṃ bhinnatve gauravādbhayam || (kauvidānande pṛ. 26, ślo. 16) yathaika eva svaro hrasvadīrghaplutabhedena trividho bhavati, tathā śaktireva śabdavṛttirabhidhālakṣaṇāvyajanābedena trividhā bhavati | vṛttīnāṃ bhede gauravamasti iti taṭṭīkā | atra vaiyākaraṇāḥ --- 'śaktireva śabdavṛttiḥ, tasayāśca prasiddhyaprasiddhibhyāṃ śaktilakṣaṇāvyapadeśaḥ, vyajanā tu tatrāntarbhavati dīrghavyapārāt (triveṇikā, pṛ. 36-37)' iti | evañca śābdikā vyañjanāvṛttiṃ nābhyupagacchantīti vaiyākaraṇamatamabhyūhya pratyākhyātā''śādharabhaṭṭena kovidānde trividānde triveṇikāyāñca | tasyāyaṃ bhāvaḥ syāt - yad bhāṣyādiprācīnatameṣvākaragranyeṣu kvacidapi vyañjanāviṣayako viśiṣṭo vicāro nopalabhyate | ṭākādigrantheṣu ca 'vṛttiśca śaktilakṣaṇā'nyatararūpā' (mano. śa. ṭippaṇam, pṛ. 25, pā. sū. 1-2-45) ityeva likhitam, na tu vyañjanābhiprayeṇa 'anyatamarūpā' iti | lakṣyārthasyamāṇavakāderniyatopasthitikatvābhāvena siṃhādipadarūpaprātipadikārthatvābhāvaśaṅkāṃ manasi nidhāya 'anvayānupapattipūrvikā lakṣaṇā pade eva' ( laghuśabdenduśe., pṛ. 516 ; pī. sū. 2-3-46) ityeva śekharakāreṇoktam, na tu vyañjanāsthale'pi śaṅkāsamādhāne samudbhāvite | vyañjanāsvīkāre tu tatrāpi niyatosthitikatvābhāve tayorudbhāvanamavaśyaṃ kartavyamāsīt | yadyapi sphoṭavāde ye śraddadhate, tairavaśyaṃ vyañjanāṅgīkartavyā | anyathā sakalaśābdikābhimatātasya vyaṅgyatā naiva siddhā bhavet | ata eva nāgeśabhaṭṭena vñjanāsvarūpaṃpradarśyoktm -- 'ata eva nipātānāṃ dyotakatvaṃ sphoṭasya vyaṅgyatā ca haryādibhiruktā | dyotakatvañca kvacit samabhivyāhṛtapadīyaśaktivyajakatvamiti vaiyākaraṇānāmapi tatsvīkāra āvaśyakaḥ' (vai. si. la. ma. pṛ. 133) iti, tathāpi tārkikeṣu śaśvatikavirodhānāṃ śābdikānāṃ tārkikamatapratyākhyānamātraphalako vñjanāsamarthanaprayāso bhavet, anyathā lakṣaṇāyāḥ pratyākhyāne 'jaghanyavṛttikalpanāyā anyāyyatvāt, dṛttidvayāvacchedakadvayakalpane gauravāt, sati tātparye 'sarve sarvārthavācakāḥ' iti bhāṣyāllakṣaṇāyā abhāvācca' (para. la. ma., lakṣaṇāni.pṛṃ 62) ityādayo yāvanto hetavo nāgeśenapradarśitāste, sarve'pi vyañjanāṃ kathaṃ na virundhyuḥ | vyañjanayā yāvānartho vyaṅgyo bhavati tāvān sarvo'pyaprasiddhaśaktyā vyakto bhaviṣyati | vyañjanāvṛttau śraddhāmāvahatāmālahkārikāṇāṃmate sahṛdayaireva vyaṅgyo'rtho'vagamyate, tādṛśo'rtho'prasiddhaśaktyā vaiyākaraṇairbhotsyate, kiṃ vyañjanayā ? tayā coktaṃ nāgeśena "śaktirdvidhā, prasiddhā aprasiddhaā ca | āmandabuddhivedyātvaṃ prasiddhātvam, sahṛdayahṛdayamātravedyātvamaprasiddhātvam | tatra gaṅgādipadānāṃ pravāhādau prasiddhā śaktiḥ, tīrādau cāprasiddheti kiṃmanupapannam |" nanu 'sarve sarvārthavācakāḥ, iti brūṣe cet, tarhi ghaṭapadāt paṭapratyaḥ kinna syāditi cet, na;: sati tātparye, ityuktatvāt tātparyābhāvāditi gṛhāṇa | tātparyañcātreśvaraṃ devatāmaharṣilokavṛddhaparamparāto'smadādibhirlabdhamiti sarvaṃ surūḍham' iti (parama - la. ma., laṃ. ni. pṛ. 63) | evañca yathā lakṣaṇāsthale tātparyavaśādaprasiddhayā śaktyaivaṣṭārthasya lābhaḥ, tathā vyajanāsthale'pi vaktrādivaiśiṣṭyasahakāreṇāprasiddhaśaktyaiveṣṭārthalābho bhaviṣyati, kiṃ vyañjanayā ? yadi haryādibhirnipātānāṃ dyotakatvasvīkārāt, sphoṭasya vyahgyatvasvīkārācca śābdikairdyotakatārūpā vyañjanā svīkriyate, tarhi prādīnāṃ dyotakatvāhgīkārānnaiyāyikairapi sā svīkriyate, tarhi prādīnāṃ dyotakatvāṅgīkārānnaiyāyikairapi sā svīkartavyā bhavet, na ca taiḥ svīkrīyate
