'vyāpra .... anāpattiśca' iti nāsti | kiñca, 'bhāvapradhānamākhyātam' iti nirukte pratipāditasyākhyātalakṣaṇasya 'pacati' ityādāvavyāptiḥ, dhātvarthaphalasyaiva dhātvartharūpakriyātvāṅgīkārema viśeṣyatvāṅgīkāre tu 'caitraḥ pacati' ityādau bedasambandhena nāmārthasya dhātvarthe'nvayo na syāt, uktayukteḥ -- ityadhikaśca pāṭho'sati | ] dik | yattu maṇḍanamiśramatānuyāyinaḥ -- phalameva dhātvarthaḥ, vyāpāraḥ pratyayārthaḥ, pratyayārthavyāpāravyadhikaraṇaphalavācakvaṃ sakarmakatvam | tatsamānādhikaraṇaphalavācakatvañcākarmakatvam | karmatvamapi pratyayārthavyāpāravyadhikaraṇadhātvarthāśrayatvameva | 'ghaṭaṃ bhāvayati' ityādāvapi ṇicpratyārthavyāpāravyāpāravyadhikaraṇotpattyāśrayatvena ghaṭādeḥ karmatvam | antarbhāvitaṇyarthe'pi pratyayasyaiva ṇijarthe lakṣaṇeti na doṣaḥ | pratyayārthavyāpāraśrayatvemeva kartṛtvam | ata eva 'ghaṭaṃ bhāvayati' ityādau karmaṇo'pi ghaṭasya 'ghaṭo bhavati ' ityādau kartṛtvameva | ṇicaḥ prayojakavyāpārārthakatve'pi 'bhavati' ityādāvākhyātasya kartṛvyāpāramātrārthakatvāt | evañca kālasya svavācakākhyātavācyavyāpārānvitatvamapi labhta ityaparamanukūlam | 'jānāti' ityatrāpi labhyata ityaparamanukūlam | 'jānāti' ityātrāpi jñānajanakamanaḥ syogarūpapratyayārthavyāpāreeva tadanvayona dhātvarthe | bhāvavihitaghañādīnāṃ vyāpāravācakatvācca na 'grāmo gamanavān' ityādyāpattiḥ | ghañarthabhāvanānvayādeva 'odanasya pākaḥ' ityādau kārakavibhaktayaḥ | kartṛkarmakṛtāñca kārakabhāvanobhayavācakatvāt 'odanasya paktā' ityādāvapi na kārakānvayānupapattiḥ | nanvevaṃ jānāteḥ sakarmakatvānāpattiḥ, dhātvarthajñānavyadhikaraṇavyāpārasya devadattādau bādhāditi cet, na ; phalatāvacchedakaviṣayatāsambandhena jñānānadhikaraṇavṛttitvarūpasyaiva vaiyadhikaraṇyasya vyāpāre sattvenākṣateḥ | anyathā kālikādi sambandhena sarveṣāmeva phalasamānādhikaraṇavyāpāravācitvena bahūpaplavaḥ syāt | na ca vyāpārasya dhātvarthatve kriyāvācakatve sati gaṇapaṭhitatvarūpadhātutvānupapattiḥ | tatra hi kriyātvaṃ na vyāpāratvam, kinatvākhyātārthanirūpitajanakatānāśrayatve sati liṅgasaṅkhyādyananvayitvam, ato na doṣaḥ | dhātvarthatvameva vā tat | na cānyonyāśrayaḥ, yato na prāguktaṃ dhātutvam, kriyātvasyaikakyābhāvenānanugamāt | kintu sañjñāviśeṣaḥ | sañjñīśabdāśca jātiśabdā eveti jātiviśeṣa eva tat | yad vā, saṅketaviśaṣasambandhena dhātuśabdavattvameva tat | tatparicāyakañca 'bhūvādi' sūtram | na ca vyāpārasyākhyātārthatve 'kriyāpradhānamākhyātam' iti yāskavirodhaḥ | tatra hyākhyātaśabdenākhyāyate sarvapradhānībhūto'rtho'neneti vyutpattyā dhāturūpamucyate | 'nāmākhyātopasarganipātāḥ' iti prakṛtīnāmeva tatroddeśāt, agre'pi tatra 'nāmānyākhyātajāni' iti śākaṭāyano nairuktasamayaśceti uktatvāt1 [Fn śabdaśāstre ākhyātaśabdena kvacit dhātoḥ, kvacicca tiṅantasya grahaṇam, vyutpattibalāt | ] | na hyākhyātapratyayajaṃ nāma sambhāvyate, kintu dhātujamiti vācyam, ākhyātaśabdena | tiṅantasyaiva grahaṇāt, tatra 'etannāmākhyātayorlakṣaṇam' ityupakramya 'bhāvapradhānamākhyātam' iti yāskokteḥ | tvadrītyā hi dhātulakṣaṇasya kṛtprakṛtibhūtavātāvavyāptyāpattiḥ | ata eva bhāva - kāla - kāraka - saṅkhyāścatvāro'rthā ākhyātasya | tatra 'bhāva pradhānam' iti tadbhāṣyaṃ saṅgacchate | kārakasyākhyātārthatvakathanaṃ ca tadarthākṣiptatvamātreṇa | ata eva 'devadattaḥ pacati' ityādau sāmānādhikaraṇyopapattiḥ | nāmākhyātopasargetyatra ca dhātuprakṛtikapratyayāntanāmasāhacaryeṇākhyātasyāpi tādṛśasyaiva grahaṇamucitam | ata eva bhāṣye "prarśasāyāṃ rūpap" [5 | 3 | 66] iti sūtre 'pacatirūpam, pacatorūpam, pacantirūpam' ityādyasiddhimāśaṅkya 'kriyāpradhānamākhyātaṃ dravyapradhānaṃ nāma, yataḥ kriyāṃ pṛṣṭastiṅācaṣṭe -- kiṃ devadattaḥ karoti ? pacatīti dravyaṃ pṛṣṭam, kṛtācaṣṭe kataro devadattaḥ, yaḥ pācakaḥ' ityuktaṃ saṅgacchate | upasarganipātayostudyotakatvādakriyāsamabhivyāhāravaśācca pṛthaguktiḥ | nāmānyākhyātajānīti tu lakṣaṇayā'gatyā dhātuparam | 'pacyate taṇḍulaḥ' ityādau taṇḍulādeḥ svaniṣṭhaphalajanakatvena sambandhena vyāpāre evānvayaḥ | eta evautsargikaṃ pratyārthaprādhānyamapyanugṛhītaṃ bhavatīti prāhuḥ, tat, na ; 'pacati, pakṣyati, pakvavān' ityādau phūtkārādīnāṃ pratītaye tatrānekapratyayānāṃ śaktikalpanāpekṣayaikasya dhātoreva śkatikalpanāyā ucitatvāt | kiñca, phūtkārādeḥ pratyayārthatve 'gacchati' ityādāvapi tatpratītivāraṇāya tadbodhe pacisamabhivyāhāraḥ kāraṇaṃ vācyamiti pacereva sā yuktā | kḷñca, astyādausattādyeva vyāpāraḥ, avacchedakatārūpā vyāptiḥ phalam | ata eva 'māsamasti' ityādau māsādeḥ karmatvamiti bhāṣyādau spaṣṭam | tathā ca tatra sattāṃśe klṛptadhātuśaktityāge, aklṛptapratyayaśaktikalpane ca mahad gauravam | kiñca, 'caitreṇa supyate' iti bhāvārthakalakāre pratyayasya kālātiriktārthābhāvena caitrasya kartṛtvānāpatteḥ | 'kriyāpradhānam' ityākhyātalakṣaṇāvyāptiśca | api ca, 'guruḥ śiṣyābhyāṃ pācayati' ityadyanāpattiḥ | tatra hi prayojakavyāpārasya pijarthatve sthate prayojyavyāpāla ākhyātārtho vācyaḥ | evaca saṅkhyāyāḥ svavācakākhyātārthavyāpāre'nvayinyevānvayāt śiṣyābhyāṃ dvivacanānāpattiḥ, 'pācayati' ityekavacanānāpattirvā, guroranabhidhānena tatra prathamāyā anāpatteśca, śiṣyaśabdāt tadāpatteśca, ṇirthavyāpārasyākhyātārthaprayojyavyāpāraṃ prati prakṛtyarthatvāt prādhānyānāpatiśca | na ca tatra phalaṃ dhātvarthaḥ, vyāpārānukūlaprayojakavyāpāro ṇyarthaḥ | tatra phalasyānukūlatayādyavyāpāre'nvayaḥ, tiṅastu kālasaṅkhye prayojakavyāpāraścārthaḥ, 'dvau' ityādivanna bodhāvṛttiḥ, pradhānatvāt "laḥ karmaṇi"[3|4|69] ityādisautrānuvādabalācca prayojakavyāpāreṇaiva dharmiṇa ākṣepaḥ, "anabhihite" ityādeśca śaktyākṣepasādhāraṇābodhita ityevārtha iti na doṣa iti vācyam, "hetumati ca" [ 3|1|26 ] iti sūtreṇa tathā'lābhāt | asmadrotyā'kleśenaiva sakalasāmañjasye kliṣṭakalpanānupayogāditi dik | yattu prācīnanaiyāyikāḥ --- dhātoḥ kevalavyāpāra eva śaktiḥ, phalaṃ karmapratyayārthaḥ, karmapratyayāpekṣayā bahūnāṃ dhātūnāṃ phale śaktikalpanasya gurutvāt | kiñca, dhātoḥ phalabodhakatāmate nāmārthadhātvarthayorāśrayatāsambandhena sākṣādanvayāsambhavena phalāśrayatvasya pratyayārthatvamabhyupagatya karmaṇi prakāratayā bhānasyopagantavyatayā tatsaṃsargasyādhikasya bhānaklpanena gauravam | phalasya pratyayārthatve ca tadāśrayatvaṃ sambandha iti lāghavam | saṃyogarūpaphalabhāne 'gam' samabhivyāhārasya, vibhāgabhāne 'tyaji' samabhivyāhārasya ca kāraṇatvānna 'grāmaṃ gacchati, tyajati' ityanayorvibhāgasaṃyogabodhakatvam | na caivaṃ tyāgo gamanamityanayoraviśeṣāpattiḥ, ekasyā eva sayogavibhāgajanakatvāditi vācyam, anāditātparyavaśena karmapadāsamabhivyāhṛtatādṛśaprayoge vibhāgādyavacchinne vyāpāre dhātorlakṣaṇasvīkāreṇādoṣāt | svānvipratyayārthaphalavyadhikaraṇavyāpāravācitvaṃ sakarmakatvam | karmatvañca dhātvarthanvitapratyayabodhyaphalattvameva | akarmakatvañca tadabhāva eva karmaṇi tādṛśaphalakṛtaviśeṣavattvameva | karmasthatvaṃ kriyāyā iti kriyata ityādau karmakatrtari yagādisiddhiḥ | saviṣayakadhātusthale viṣayitayānvayitvameva1 [Fn kha. 'viṣayitvameva sakarmakatvam' iti pāṭhaḥ | ] sakarmakatvam | ata eva 'karoti' 'jānāti' ityādeḥ karmaṇi pratyayaḥ | yatistu na sakarmakaḥ, yatastadupasthāpitayatne viṣayatvena nānvayaḥ, kindūdde śyatvenaiveti na doṣaḥ | ata evābhuñjāne'pi 'bhojanāya yatate' iti prayogaḥ | phalānvitasvārthabodhaktavaṃ ca gamyādeḥ svabhāvādhīm | tadabhāvāt spandiprabhṛtiṣvakarmakatvavyavahāra iti | tat, na ; gatyarthādikarmaṇi1 [Fn gatyarthakarmaṇi dvitīyācatuthyau ceṣṭāyāmanadhvani [ 2|3|12 ] ] dvitīyācaturthyorvidhānena, 'lyablope karmaṇi' [ vā. 2|4|31 ] pacamyā vidhānena 'ktesyenviṣyasya karmaṇi' [vā. 2|3|36 ] iti saptamyā vidhānenānekasupāṃ tiṅāñca phale śaktikalpanāpekṣayā phalaviśeṣabodhe tattaddhātusamabhivyāhārasya kāraṇatvakalpanāpekṣayā ca dhātoreva phale'pi śaktikalpanāyā ucitatvāt | mama tu karmavihitapratyayajanyāśrayabodhe dhātujanayaphalopasthitirhaturityeka eva kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ | 'grāmo gamyate svayameva' itayādikarmakartṛprayogānurodhena phalasyāpi dhātuvācyatvāvaśyakatvācca, 'grāmadhyāste' ityādāvāśrayasya dvitīyārthatayā klṛptatvācca | evañca dvītīyāyā nānārthatvāpattiḥ | kiñca, 'yā, gami' phrabhṛtīnāmiva 'tyaji, gami' prabhṛtīnāmapi paryāyateti bhramadaśāyām, 'yāti, 'gacchati' itayādivat 'tyajati, gacchati' ityādito'pyavilakṣaṇabodhotpattyā dhātuviśeṣasamabhivyāhārasya phaviśeṣabodhaniyāmakatākalpanāyanā asambhavaḥ |na ca'grāmaṃ gacchati' iti vākyajñānaghaṭitasāmagryāḥ samānaviṣayakānumityādipratibandhakatāyāṃ phalaḍanakatvaniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitavyāpāraviśeṣyatākadhātujanyopasthiterniveśyatayā tasyāstādṛśaviśeṣyatāśālitvena vyāpāraviśeṣyatānirūpitaphalaprakāratāśālitvena vā niveśa ityatra vinigamanāvirahāt sāmagrīpratibandhakatādhikyamavacchedakagauravañca | manmate dvitīyājanyaphalopasthiteḥ sāmagryantarniveśaśca bhavanmatasiddhatajjanyopasthitisthānīya iti na gauravamiti vācyam, dhātoḥ phalāvacchinnavyāpāre dvitīyāyāścāśrayatve śaktibhramavato lākṣaṇikatvagrahavataśca 'grāmaṃ gacchati' ityādiśābdasāmagrayāṃ tādṛśānumityanudayena tadanurodhāt tādṛśapratibandhyapratibandhakabhāvasya tavāpyāvaśyakatvāt | kiñca, 'viṣṇuṃ yajate, viṣṇuryaṣṭavyaḥ' ityādau caturthyarthavihitadvitīyāderuddeśyatvenaivānvayabodhakatvād yativad yajerapyakarmakatvāpattiḥ, viṣṇordhātvarthakarmatvābhāvena tasmina karmaṇi latavyādīnāmanāpattiśca | uddeśyatākhyāviṣayatayā viṣṇuryāgaviṣaya iti cet, bhojanamapi yatyarthasya tatheti tasyāpi sakarmakatvāpattiḥ | kiñcaivam 'bhojanāya kriyate' ityatra bhojanamiti syāt , yativat kṛño'pyakarmakatāpatteśca | na cākarmakabhinnatvaṃ sakarmakatvam | tatra ca prayogānurodhāt kṛñjānātyādibhedo na niveśya iti vācyam, sakarmakāṇāmapyarthantare'karmakatvenāsambhavāpatteḥ | tulyayuktyā'karmatvamapi sakarmakānyatvameva vācyam, anyādṛśsya tasya durvacatvāt | evañcānyonyāśrayāpattyā "laḥ karmaṇi" [ 3|4|69 ] ityāderbodhakatvānāpatiḥ | kiñca, pratyayārthavyadhikaraṇetyādiprāguktasakarmakalakṣaṇaṃ karmalakṣaṇaca 'ghaṭaṃ bhāvayati, edhayati' ityādiṇyantasakarmakeṣu tatkarmaṇi cāvyāptam | tatra phalasyānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ dhātulabhyatvenānyalabhyatvād gauravacca pratyayārthatvāsambhavāditi dik | tasmāt phalānukūlo vyāpāro dhātvarthaḥ | dvitīyārthāśrayānvayastu "karmaṇi dvitīyā" [ 2|3|2 ] ityādyanuśāsanād vyutpattivaicitryāccaikadeśe'ti phale | etena 'gamanaṃ na vyāpāraḥ' iti prayogaḥ syādityapāstam, vyāpārabhedasyaikadeśe phale'nvaye vyutpattyabhāvāt1 [Fn kha. 'nañarthasya samabhivyāhṛtapadajanyapratītiviśeṣya evānvayānutpatteḥ' ityadhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ | ] astu vā -- phalavyāpārayoḥ pṛthageva śaktiḥ | tatra phalāṃśa utsargato vyāpāraṃ prati viśeṣaṇam, janyatvaṃ saṃsargaḥ prāyeṇa | kvacit tu viṣayatvaṃ saṃsargaḥ | yathā paśyatyādestatparvakadarśane vṛttiḥ | evamanye'pi sambandhā yathāyathamūhyāḥ | phalatvañca kartṛ pratyayasamabhivyāhāre taddhātvarthaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpitaprakāratāvattvam | ekapadopasthāpyayorapi kṛtīṣṭasādhanatvayoḥ parasparānvayasya parairapyaṅgīkārāt | karmapratyayasamabhivyāhāre tu viśeṣyatā'pi | tatrāntaraṅgatvāt phalamādau vyāpāraviśeṣaṇatāmanubūyaivārthāntareṇānvayi | ata eva 'gamanaṃ na spandaḥ' iti naḥ, tañaḥ samabhivyāhṛtapadajanyapratītiviśeṣya eva svārthānvayavyutpatterautsargikatvāt | karmakārakātiriktasarvakārakāṇāṃ vyāpāre'nvayaḥ sākṣāt paramparayā vā, karmaṇastu phale | na ca kārakāṇāṃ bhāvanānvayaniyamavirodhaḥ, dhātvarthasyaiva bhāvanātvāt | astu vā---tasyāpi phaladvārā vyāpāra evānvayaḥ | vyāpāraśca phūtkārādiḥ | atra kriyāśabdasya sāṃketikī śaktiḥ, yāvatsiddhamasiddhaṃ vā sādhyatvenābhidhīyate | āśritakramarūpatvāt sā kriyetyabhīdhīyate || guṇabhūtairavayavaiḥ samūhaḥ kramajanmanām | buddhyā prakalpitābhedaḥ kriyeti vyapadiśyate || iti bhūvādi [ 1|3|1 ] sūtrasthābhāṣyārthapratipādakaharigranthāt kramajanmanāmeṣāṃ vyāpārāṇāṃ samūhaḥ svabhāvato guṇabhūtaiḥ = tatadrūpeṇa bhāsamānairavayavairyuktaḥ saṅkalanātmikayaikatvabuddhyā prakalpitābhedaḥ kriyate vyavahriyata iti dvitīyakārikārthaḥ | 'pacati' 'pakṣyati ' ityādāvasiddham, 'arākṣīt' ityādau siddhaṃ vā sādhyatvenābhidhīyamāṃ kriyā | āśriteti yogapradarśanam | kriyate = avayavānāṃ krameṇotpattyā krameṇotpādyate iti kriyatyarthaḥ | tatra siddhatvam -- uddeśyatvāvadhitvābhyāmanvayayogyatāvacchedakam | liṅgādyanvayayogyatāvacchedakaca yadvaijātyam, tadrūpam | idameva ca kriyāntarākāṅkṣotthāpakatāvacchedakam | sādhyatvaca pūravāparībhūtavayavatvasamānādhikaṇaṃ kārakānvayādiyogyatāvacchedakaṃ yadvaijātyam, tadūpam | tatra siddhatvam 'pākaḥ' ityādau ghañā bodhyate, sādhyatvaṃ tu sarvatraiva dhātupratipādyam | yattu, uddeśyatvādinānanvayitvaṃ liṅgādyananvayitvaṃ sādhanatvenānanvayitvaṃ kriyīntarākāṅkṣānutthāpakatācchedakaparūpavattvaṃ vā sādhyatvam | tatda na bodhe bhāsate, 'sādhyatvenāmidhīyate' ityuktyā tatprakārakabodhasya pratipādanāt, liṅgādyananvayitvameva kutaḥ iti praśne tanniyāmakavaijātyāṅgīkārasyāvaśyakatvācca | yattu, utpādyamānatvarūpaṃ tadbhāsate, ataeva kriyāyā na karamatvenānvayaḥ, utpannasyaiva loke karamatvadarśanāditi | tat, na ; 'jāyamānena pākena vairaṃ kṛtam' ityādyanāpatteḥ, 'jyotiṣṭomena yajeta' ityādyanāpatteśca, 'kṛṣṇaṃ nameccet sukhaṃ yāyāt' 'bhuktvā tṛpyati' 'māninīṃ natvā mṛdayati' ityādāvasiddhasya sādhanatvenānvayācca | mama tu na doṣaḥ, tādṛśavaijātyena tatra phalāṃśābhāvāt | vyāpāramātravṛttyeva vā tadvaijātyam | sa vyāpāra eva bhāvanetyucyate | na ca dhātutaḥ kriyāntarākāṅkṣābhāvenānvayo na syāditi, vācyam, yacchabdacecchabdasamabhivyāhāraprayuktakāṅtrotthānāt | 'bhuvatvā' ityatrāpi dhātusambandhe vidhīyamānaktvāsamabhivayāhārāt sā | 'pacati bhavati' ityādau pacatītyasayākāṅkṣābhāve'pi bhavatītyādeḥ kartrādyapekṣatvādyogyatāvaśādanyatarākāṅkṣyevānvayenādoṣāt | tatra sakalasādhāraṇakriyātvaṃ jātiḥ śakyatāvacchedikā | sakalasādhāraṇadhātutvameva śaktatāvacchedakam, phalaṃ viklititvādi tattadrūpeṇa vācyam | pacitvādi ca śaktatāvacchedakam | tattadrūpeṇa bodhastu tathā bodhe tattatsamabhivyāhārasya kāraṇatvena nirvāhya iti pऱcaḥ | navyāstu -- phūtkārādirvyāpāraḥ phūtkāratvādhaḥ santāpanatvāditattadrūpeṇaiva vācyaḥ, tathaiva bodhānubhavāt, sakalasādhāraṇānugataikadharmāntarasya vaktumaśakyatvācca | na ca viklityādyanukūlatvaṃ tathā, karaṇavyāpārasyāpi dhātvarthāpattāvekasañjñādhikārema kāṣṭhādaiḥ kartṛtvāpattau tasya coktatvena 'kāṣṭhairdevadattaḥ pacati' ityādau prathamāpatteḥ | na ca niravakāśatvāt kāraṇasañjñā kartṛsañjñāṃ bādhiṣyati iti vācyam, gatervakṣyamāṇatvāt | na ca jātiviśeṣaḥ kriyāśabdaśakyatāvacchedakatvādinā siddhaḥ, tathā jalaśabdaśakyatāvacchedakatayā jalatvātisiddherlīlāvatyupāye darśanāditi vācyam, tena rūpeṇa bodhānanubhavāt, tattadra5peṇa bodhasyaivānuvācca | tathā kāryakāraṇabhāvāvaśyakatve kalpyamānadharmeṇāpi kāryakāraṇabhāvāntarakalpane gauravāpatteḥ | anyathā saindhavādipadaśakyatāvacchedakatayā'śvalavaṇādivṛttyekadharmakalpanāpatte | aśvatvādinaiva tapratatītiranubhavasiddheti cet, prakṛte samam | ata eva vibhupadaśakyatāvacchedakatayā na vibhutvajātisiddhiḥ,paramamahatparimāṇavattvenaiva1 [Fn kha. 'sarvabhātasaṃyogitvena vā' ityadhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ | ] tato bodhāt | ata eva 'devadattaḥ pacati' ityukte 'devadattaḥ kṛtimān na vā' ityādisandeho na | na ca nānārthatā, iṣṭāpatteḥ, buddhisthatvādeḥ śakyatāvacchedakānāṃ tadādāvivānugamakasya sattvācca2 [Fn kha. 'na ca.... sattvācca' iti nāsti | ] tatra yadā yo buddhisthastadā so'bhidhīyate, tadā ca tadāśrayaḥ kartā | ata eva 'kāṣṭhāni pacanti ' ityupapannam | tadvyāpārasya dhavārthatvāvivakṣāyām 'kāṣṭhauḥ pacanti' ityapi | śaktatāvacchedakaṃ ca pacitvādikameva | dhātutvaṃ śaktatāvacchedakamiti tu na yuktam, dhātutvamajānato'pi bodhāt | etena phūtkārādikaṃ vināpi caitraniṣṭhakriyāntaramādāya siddhajvālayā jāyamāne odane 'caitraḥ pacati' iti prayogānāpattiḥ | tattadvyāpārasya tattadrūpeṇa vācyatve yāgaḥ, icchā, jñānaṃ veti vādivipratipattyanupapattiśceti mīmāṃsakanavyoktaṃ parāstam | phūtkāra eva gṛtaśaktikasya vyajanena vahniprajvālanadaśāyām 'pacati' iti prayogo na bhavatyeva | vādivipratipattirapi svīyasvīyatādṛśabodhānusārādevopapannā | na ca phūtkārasyātītatvamātrema vyāpārāntaravartamānatādaśāyām 'apākṣīt' ityādiprayogāpattiḥ, bhūtatvādaiḥ samudāya evānvayasya nirūpayiṣyamāṇatvādityāhuḥ | anye tu kṛtyatiriktavyāpāre pacitvaṃ śaktatāvacchedakam, kṛtestu sarvadhātuṣvanusyūtatayā pratīyamānatvena tatra sakalasādhāraṇadhātutvameva śaktatāvacchedakamāhuḥ | nanvevamastyādīnāṃ dhātutvānāpattiḥ, teṣaāṃ sattāmātrādyarthatvena vyāpārarūpakriyāvācakatvābhāvāditi cet, na ; tatrāpi sattādyanukūlavyāpārasyaivārthatvāt | bhāvanāphalayorekaniṣṭhatvācca gacchatītyādāviva sphaṣṭaṃ na pratīyate | na caivam 'kiṃ karoti' iti praśne 'pacati' ityasyeva 'asti' ityasyāpyuttaratvaṃ syāt | āsannavināśaṃ kañciduddiśya 'kiṃ karoti' iti praśne 'asti' ityuttarasya sarvasammatatvāt | itaratra tu susthataya nivicate 'kiṃ karoti' iti praśnaḥ pākādiviśeṣagocara evetyavadhāraṇāt 'asti' iti nottaram| asteḥ svasvarūpadhāraṇānukūlavyāpāro'pyarthaḥ, dhāraṇāṃ cottarakālasambandhaḥ, te 'ātmāsti' ityādau nānupapattiḥ | utpattyanukūlo vyāpāro'pi 'ghaṭo bhavati' ityādau | sakarmakatvaṃ ca vyāpāravyādhikaraṇaphalavācakatvam | tatsamānādhikaraṇaphalavācakatvaṃ cākarmakatvam | eta evāstyoderavacchedakatārūpavyāptayanukūlasattārūpavyāpārārthakatve 'māsamāste' ityādau sakarmakatvamapīti spaṣṭaṃ bhāṣya ityāhuḥ | anye tu --- astyādau vyāpāra evārthaḥ, na phalam | sa ca sattādirūpa eva, tasyaiva prāguktavaijātayākrāntatayā bhānāt | ata eva 'paśyati bhavaḥ' ityādau nivṛttapreṣaṇe viṣayatārūpasyaiva phalasya kriyātvamabhyupagatam | atastadāśrayas kartṛtvam 'bhavaṃ paśyati' ityādau tu na viṣayatvasya vyāpāratvamiti na tadāśrayasya kartṛtvam, karmasañjñāyā bādācca | kriyātvaṃ taddhātvarthaniṣṭānukūlatānirūpakatvānāśrayatve sati taddhātujanyaśābdabodhaviṣayatvameva | idañca 'bhavaṃ paśyati' ityādau viṣayatvasya neti na doṣaḥ | kevalavyāpāravācakatvamakarmakatvam | phalavyāpārobhayavācakatvaṃ sakarmakatvamityāhuḥ | nanvevaṃ jīvanṛtyādeḥ sakarmakatvāpattiḥ, phrāṇadhāraṇagātravikṣepaṇādirūpaphalasya sattvāt, vyāpāravyadhikaramatvācceti cet, na ; phalāśrayāvācakatve satyavivakṣāvirahaviśiṣṭaphalavyadhikaraṇavyāpāravācitvasya sakarmakatvādadoṣaḥ | eteṣāṃ hi prāṇagātrādirūpaphalāśrayavācakatvāt | avivakṣitakarmasvativyāptivāraṇāya vivakṣāvirahaviśiṣṭeti |1 [Fn kha. 'atrādyamatameva yuktam | antyamate hi 'uttiṣṭhati' ityādau ūrddhavadeśasamayogarūpa utthānādyevārthaḥ syāt | evañcorddhavadeśasaṃyogādervidyamānatvena 'utthitaḥ' ityādiprayogānāpattiḥ | mama tu tadanukūlavyāpārasyātītatvāt tasya vidyamānatve'pi tathā prayogo bhavatīti tattvam | apare tu -- akarmakatvaṃ vyāpārakhyādhikaraṇaphalavācakatvābhāvaḥ | sa evaṃ sa ca kvacit sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvāta, kvacit phalāṃśābhāvāt | evañcāstyādau kevalasattādyevārthaḥ, 'uttiṣṭhati' ityādāvubhayamiti na doṣa ityābuḥ' ityādhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ | ] pacerviklatyanukūlavyāpāro'rthaḥ | yattu -- tejaḥ saṃyogamātraṃ pacartha iti | tat, na ; agnisaṃyogānukūlakṛtyabhāvavati bhaktaviklityanukalāśrayaṇakartari 'pacati' iti prayogānāpatteḥ | jñādhātorviṣayata sambandhena jñānaṃ phalam, ātmamanaḥ saṃyogo vyāpāraḥ | yad vā, āvaraṇabhaṅgo viṣayatā vā phalam | naṣṭasyāpi buddhyupārohāt phalaśālitvam |2 [Fn kha. 'ghaṭaṃ karoti' ityādāvapi | ] satkāryavādābhyupagame tu na kācid doṣāśaṅkā 'ātmānaṃ jānāti' ityādāvāpyātmabhedaḥ kalpyaḥ | ekaḥ śarīrāvacchinno'paro'ntaḥ karaṇāvacchinnaḥ | tatrāntaḥ karaṇāvacchinanaḥ karttā, śarīrāvacchinnaḥ, karmeti phalavayāpārayorbhinnaniṣṭhatvākṣatiḥ | spaṣṭaṃ cedam 'karmavat' [ 3|1|86 ] sūtre bhāṣye |1 [Fn ' nanu 'hantyātmānamātmā' 'ātmanā hanyata ātmā' ityādāvekasyaiva vastunaḥ kathaṃ śabdabhedamātreṇa bhinnadharmatā ityarthake "kaḥ punarātmānaṃ hanti, ko vātmanā hanyate" iti praśne "dvāvātamānau śarīrātmā, antarātmā ca | antarāmā tatkarma karoti, yena śarīrātmā sukhaduḥkhe anubhavati | śarīrātmā tatkarma karoti, yenāntarātmā sukhaduḥkhe anucavati" ityuktam | ' ] janerutpattimātram, tatsamānādhikaraṇavyāpāro vārthaḥ | 'naśyati' ityatra nāśānukūlapratiyogisahitanāśasāmagrīsamavadānarūpo vyāpāro'rthaḥ | patergamivat sakarmakatvameva | ata eva "dvitīyāśrita" [ 2|1|24 ] iti sūtre 'narakapatitaḥ' ityudāharaṇaṃ saṅgacchate | akarmakatvamapi2 [Fn 'pata' dhātorita śeṣaḥ | ] vyāpāramātraparatve bodhyam | kṛña utpattivyadhikaraṇastadanukūlavyāpāro'rthaḥ, yatnamātrārthatve'karmakatvāpatteḥ | nanu yaddhaātūccāraṇe karmākāṅkṣā niyatā, sa sakarmakaḥ | evañca kṛño'pi yateriva yatnāmātrārthakatve'pi na doṣaḥ | karmatvādipadopasthaāpyasaya kriyākāṅkṣatvābhāve'pi dvitīyopasthaāpyasya tatsākāṅkṣatvavat kṛñpasthāpyasya yatnasya karmākāṅkṣopapatteḥ | avivakṣitakarmaṇāṃ sakarmakatvasya vāraṇīyatve cāvikṣābhāvavaiśiṣṭyamapi niveśyam | evamekasyaivārthabhedena sakarmakatvam, akarmakatvaṃ copapannam | yadarthe'vivakṣāvirahaviśiṣṭakarmākāṅkṣā yasya, sa tatrārthe sakarmaka itya(na) nugatasyaiva lakṣaṇatvāditi cet, na ; gacchatyādiṣu karmākāṅkṣāviraheṇāvyāpteḥ | atratya 'kutra', 'kim' ityākāṅkṣāyāḥ 'yatate,' 'bhavati' ityādiṣu 'kutrakim' ityākāṅkṣātulyatvāt | kiñca, kṛño lakṣaṇā bodhyā1 [Fn kha. 'dhātunāmanekārthatvād vā tatra vṛttiḥ' ityadhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ | ] | sakarmakadhātvanyatamatvaṃ sakarmakatvamiti tu na yuktam, ekasyaivārthabhedena sakarmakākarmakatvavyavahārāditi dik | iti dhātvarthavicāraḥ <5> atha nipātasāmānyārthavicāraḥ nanvevam 'anubhūyate sukham', 'sākṣāt kriyate garuḥ' ityādeḥ sakarmakatvaṃ na syāt, anubhavasākṣātkārarūpaphalayornipātārthatve'pi dhātvarthatvābhāvāditi cet, na ; nipātānāṃ dyotakatvenādoṣāt | yattu 'prajayati' ityādau prakṛṣṭajayo nopasargavācyaḥ, aprakṛtyarthatvenākhyātārthakṛtāvanvayānāpatteḥ | nacajayo dhātvarthaḥ, prakarṣaḥ praśabdārtha1 [fn kha. 'nāmārthadhātvarthayorvibhaktyarthamadvārīkṛtayasākṣād bhedasambandhena nānvaya itivyutpattistu upasargātiriktaviṣayā' ityadhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ | ] iti vācyam, evaṃ hi 'pratiṣṭhate' ityatra gamanatvena rūpeṇa bodho na syāt, dhātorgatinivṛttyarthatve'bhāvasya praśabdārthatve'pi gatyabhāvo nāstītyeva pratyayāpatateḥ | na ca tathā bodhānubhavaḥ, na ca viśiṣṭo jayo dhātvarthaḥ, arthāntarasyevopasargaṃ vināpyetadarthapratyayāpatteḥ | kiñca, pratyekātiriktaviśiṣṭābhāvāt pratyekamubhayatra dhātoḥ śaktirvācyā | eñca dhātorjaye klṛptaśakteḥ prakarṣe śaktāvupasargasya śaktyavacchedakatvaṃ śaktatāvacchedake viśeṣaṇatvamātrameva tattvam | evañca prottarajitvena prakṛṣṭajaye śaktiḥ | na ca jipūrvapratvena śaktirastu, aklṛptaśaktakalpanāpatteḥ, ākhyātārthānanvayapasaṅgācca | śaktyavacchedakatvameva ca dyotakatvam | yadvā, dhātostatra tatrārthe lakṣaṇā, upasargāstātparyagrāhakāḥ | etadeva dyotakatvam, 'vyatise' ityādau tadbodhastu luptasmāraṇāt, lopamajānato bodhastu na bhavatyeva | yadvā, śiṣyamāṇaṃ lupyamānārthābhidhāyīti pratyayasyaiva tadarthe lakṣaṇā | kiñca, upasargasya tadarthatve dhātorakarmakatvāt 'anubhūyate sukham' ityādau karmaṇi lakāro na syāt, svārthaphalavyadhikaraṇavyāpāravācakatvasyaiva sakarmakatvāt | anyathā yatkiñcit phalavaiyadhikaraṇyasya sarvatra sattvenātiprasaṅgāt | etena viśiṣṭārthatvamiti nirastam, viśiṣṭasyāpyadhātutvāt, dhātutve'ḍādivyavastānāpattiḥ | tasmādupasaragāṇāṃ dyotakatvam, cādayastu vācakā eva | 'sākṣātkriyate' ityādau viṣayatāsambandhena pratyakṣādirūpatattatphalavācakaṃ sākṣātpadādikameva | tadutpattyanukūlo vyāpāro dhātvarthaḥ | ata eva "sākṣātpratyakṣatulyayoḥ"[a. ko., kā. 3, nā. va.ślo. 2822 ] ityādikośa- saṅgacchate | namaḥ padena namaskārārthatvasya lokasiddhatvācca svasvayuktanipātānyatarārthaphalavyadhikaraṇavyāpāravācitvasya sakarmakatvāt | karmatvamapyetādṛśaphalāśrayatvemeva | evañca karmaṇi lakāro'pyupapannaḥ | na ca sākṣātpadādyarthasya sākṣāddhatvarthe'nvayo na yuktaḥ, 'odanaḥ pacati' ityādau karmatvasaṃsargeṇānvayabodhavāraṇāyābhedātiriktasambandhena nāmārthaprakārakaśābdabodhaṃ prati pratyayajanyopasthiterhetutvāditi vācyam, nipātetaratvaviśeṣaṇadānāt | na ca 'kīdṛśaḥ samuccayaḥ' itivat 'kīdṛśaśca' ityasayāpattiḥ | evaṃ 'śobhanaḥ samuccayo draṣṭavyaḥ' itivat 'śobhanaśca draṣṭavyaḥ ' ityasyāpyāpattiriti vācyam, nipātaiḥ svārthasya paraviśeṣaṇatvenaivopasthiterviśeṣaṇānvayāprasaṅgāt | na ca 'ghaṭaśca' ityādau vinā ṣaṣṭhīmananvayāpattiḥ, prātipadikārthayorvibhaktyarthamadvārīkṛtya bhedenānvayāyogāt | anyathā 'rājā puruṣaḥ' ityato'pi 'rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ' itivadanvayāpattiriti vācyam, nipātātiriktatvaviśeṣaṇāt | kiñca, cādīnāṃ samuccitābhidhāyakatvānna bhedanibandhanā ṣaṣṭhī | 'samuccito ghaṭaḥ' ityabedenaivānvayaḥ | svabhāvataśca cādyupasthāpyasyāsattvavācakatvam | na ca samuccite dharmyaṃśe śaktikalpanāgauravam, prāmāṇikatvāt | evaṃ samuccayasyaikadeśatvānna tatra sundarādiviśeṣaṇānvayaḥ | etena 'ghaṭaśca' ityādau viruddhavibhaktyanavaruddhaprātipadikārthatvādabhedānvayāpattiḥ 'ghaṭasamuccayayoḥ' iti parāstam | ghaṭapadasya ghaṭapadasya ghaṭapratiyogike lakṣaṇayā'bhedānvayasyaivāṅgīkārācca | na ca 'śarairusrairivodīcyānuddhariṣyan rasāniva' [raghu. 4, 66] ityasyosradṛśaiḥ śarai rasasadṛśānudīcyānuddhariṣyannityarthaḥ | tatrevaśabdārthasya karaṇatva'pyusrasyākaramatvenosrapadottaratṛtīyāyā 1 [ kha. 'nairarthakyam | ..... karaṇatvālābhaśca' iti pāṭhastruṭtiḥ | ]nairarthakyam | ivaśabdāt tu tṛtīyābhāvena sadṛśasya karaṇatvālābhaśca | usrapadottaratṛtīyayā tu na sadṛśagataṃ karaṇatvaṃ bodhayituṃ śakyam, aprakṛtyarthatvāt | dyotakatve tu na doṣa iti vācyam, ivaśabdottaratṛtīyayā tadbodhāt | na ca śravaṇāpattiḥ, avyayatvena lukaḥ sattvāt | na ca sattavavācakatvānnāvyayatvam, liṅgānanvayitvarūpāsattvasyākṣateḥ, cādau pāṭhasāmarthyāt sattvārthe'pyavyayatvasvīkārācca | 'usraiḥ' ityasyasadṛśe svapratiyogikasādṛśyasambandhenānvayaḥ | tṛtīyā tūpamānopameyayoḥ samānavibhaktikatvasya jñāpakasiddhātvāt | kiñca, dyotakatve nañsamāsādāvuttarapadārthaḥ, pradhānamiti vyavasthā na syāt, pūrvapadasyānarthakatvāt | kiñca, nipātebhyo vibhaktyutpattirna syāt, teṣāmarthavattvābhāvena prātipadikatvābhāvāditi naiyāyikāḥ | tat, na; upasargāṇāmapi vācakatvāpatteḥ | arthavattvamapi dyotyārthamādāyaiva | athaipratījijanakajñānaviṣayaśabdatvamarthavatvam, na tu śaktilakṣaṇānyatarasambandhena bodhakatvam | uttarapadārthaprādhānyamapi dyotyārthāpekṣayaiva | nanvevam 'rāmaḥ' ityādau 'rā' ityato'pi vibhaktyāpattiḥ, na ca saṅkhyāvācakatvābhāvānna sā, nipātebhyo'pyanāpatteḥ, autsargikaikavacanasyātrāpi durvāratvācca | na ca 'ekājdvirvacana'nyāyena1 [Fn "ekāco dve prathamasya" [ 6|1|1 ] iti sūtre bhāṣye -- 'nij, ij ni, i' iti catvāra ekācaḥ | tatra ijśabdasya, niśabdasya, iśabdasya vā dvitve rūpāsiddhiḥ, 'nenijuḥ, nenijati' ityādau jakāreṇa vyavadhānājjusādyaprāptyā doṣaśca, ityuktvā 'siddhantu tatsamudāyaikāctvāt śāstrāhāneḥ' iti | asyāyamarthaḥ -- samudāyasyaikāctvāt = ekājbhāvād dvirvacanaṃ bhaviṣyati | evaṃ hi śāstramahīnaṃ bhavati | agre ca -- tatra bahuvrīhinirdeśe'nackasya dvirvacanaṃ prāptotītyāśaṅkya tadguṇasaṃvijñānapakṣamāśritya samāhitam | tadevaṃ catuṣaprakārakam ekāctvameva dvirvacananyāyatātparyamiti bodhyam | ] yattu, jyāderlakṣaṇikatve tato'nubhavānāpattiḥ, lākṣaṇikasyānanubhāvakatvāditi | tat, na; bodhakatvenaivānubhāvakatvāt | ata evāpabhraṃ śāditaḥ paramate'nubhavaḥ | vastuto'numitiśābdayoḥ 'anubhūtam' ityapratyayādanubhavatvaṃ pratyakṣatvavyāpyameveti na doṣaḥ | śābdabodho'pi lākṣaṇikānneti tu vaktu mapyaśakyam | kiñca, dhātorlakṣaṇāsvīkāre ghaṭādipadasthacaramavarṇasyaikākṣaranighaṇ‍ṭuvaśāt tattadarthakasya ghaṭatvādiviśiṣṭe lakṣaṇayā bodhopapattau ghaṭādipadānāmapyāvācakatvaprasaṅgaḥ | na cāvayaśaktimaviduṣī'pi samudāyaśaktijñānāt tathā bodhāt teṣāṃ śaktikalpanam, dhātoḥ śaktimaviduṣo'pyupasargasya tadgrahavato bādhāt tathātvasyāvaśyakatvāt | na ca prakāratāsambandhenākhyātārthaviśeṣyakaśābdaṃ prati dhātujanyopasthiterhetutvarūpākāṅkṣāvirahādupasargaśaktigrahe'pina bodha iti vācyam, tādṛśakāraṇatvagrahaśālipuruṣīyaśābdaeva tasya hetutvāt | 'vyatise' ityādyanurodhādākhyātārthaviśeṣyakaśābdaṃ prati nipātajanyopastiterapi hetutvakalpanasyocitatvācca | vaiyākaraṇanaye'pi prakāratāsambandhena dhātvarthaviśeṣyakabodhaṃ prati nipātajanyāpyupasthitirheturiti na doṣaḥ | anyāśca vyutpattayo nipātātiriktaviṣayā iti nānye'pi doṣāḥ | astu vā, prakṛṣṭo dharmī prādyarthaḥ, tenābhedenaivānvayānna doṣaḥ | na ca vācakatve kevalānāṃ prayogāpattiḥ, 1 [fn 'na kevalā prakṛtiḥ prayoktavyā, nāpi kevalaḥ pratyayaḥ' iti bhāṣyād yathā kevalāyāḥ prakṛteḥ, kevalāyāḥ prakṛteḥ, kevalasya ca pratyayasya prayogo na bhavati, tathaiva kevalānāṃ nipātānāmapi prayogo na bhavati | idamatrākūtam -- loke arthapratyāyanāya śabdāḥ prayujyante, loke cayathā kevalayā prakṛtyā kevalena ca pratyayena nārthabodho bhavati, tathaiva kevalena kalpyeti goravam | ata eva nañaḥ paryudāse lakṣaṇeti mīmāṃsakoktiḥ saṅgacchate | tasmād vācakatvameva yuktamiti cet, na ; anyalabhye śaktikalpanāyogāt | anvayavyatirekau tu kha. 'heyameva' ityanantaram 'na ca nipātānā vācakatve' 'ivāsti' ityādyapi 'sādṛśyamasti' ityādivat syāditi vācyam, pratiyogyupamānādipadopādānenaiva bodhakatvāṅgīkārāt' ityadhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ | ] śaktisambandhena nipātapadavattvarūpasyākhaṇ‍ḍopādhirūpasya jātirūpasya vā nipātatvasyaiva sāmānye pramāṇānāṃ pakṣapātād dyotakatāyāḥ śaktatāyā vā avacchedakatvasya yuktatvāt2 [fn 'yuktatvāt' ityanantaram 'tattadarthanirūpitadyotakatvasya vācakatvasya vā tattannipātavṛttitayā tattadvṛttyasādhāraṇadharmasyāvacchedakatāyā āvaśyakatvenāsāmānyadharmasyāvacchedakatve mānābhāvāt, nipātatvādyajānato'pi bodhācca | dyotakatvasya vācakatvasya vācakatvābhāvasya vā sāmānyācchedena sādhakahetorubhayavādisammatasyābhāvācca -- ityādhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ | kvaciccopasargāṇāṃ vācakatvamapi, yathā -- 'pratiṣṭhate' ityādau dhātorgatinivṛttivācakatvam, 'pra'śabdasya tu gativācakatvam | taduktaṃ hariṇā -- sa vācako viśeṣāṇāṃ sambhavād dyotako'pi vā | [ vā. 2, 160 ] iti dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ | sambhūya dhātūpasargāvarthamāhatuḥ, upasargastu śaktimātraṃ kuruta ityarthabhidhāne sahakāriṇa upasargāḥ | uktañca vākyapadīye -- śakyādhānāya dhātorvā sahakārī prayujyate || [ vā. 2, 190 ] iti tṛtīyaḥ pakṣaḥ | ukteṣu triṣu pakṣeṣu katamaḥ pakṣaḥ śreṣṭha iti mīmāṃsāyāmupasargāṇāṃ dyotakatvameva samucitam | 'pratiṣṭhate' ityatra dhātūnāmanekārthatvāt 'sthā' -- dhātoreva gatirarthaḥ, praśabdastu tasyārthasya dyotakaḥ | taduktaṃ vākyapadīye -- sthādibhiḥ kevalairyacca gamanādirna gamyate | tatrānumānād dvividhāt taddharmā taddharmā prādirucyate || iti | [ vā. 2, 161 ] ayamarthaḥ -- tiṣṭhatirgatinivṛttiṃ prasiddhyā'bhidadhāti | atastena kevalena gamanaṃ na pha3tipādyate | 'anekārthā dhātavaḥ' iti kṛtvā'numānād gativācakatvamapi tasya vyavasthāpyate | upasargastu taddyotaka eva | dhātūnāmanekārthatvamupasargāṇāca dyotakatvamanumānena sādhayannāha -- tatreti | anumānaprakāraśca -- 'dhātu anekārthaḥ, dhātutvāt ; ubhayavādisammatānekārthayajadhātuvat' | 'pra' -- śabdo dyotakaḥ, 'pra' śabdatvāt, 'prapacati' ityādidṛṣṭapraśabdavaditi | evaṃ cādinipāteṣvapi pakṣatrayaṃ bodhyam | taduktaṃ hariṇā -- nipātā dyotakāḥ kecit pṛthagarthābhidhāyinaḥ | āgamā iva ke'pi syuḥ sambhūyārthasya vācakāḥ || iti | [ vā. 2, 164 ] atrāpi dyotakatvapakṣa eva nyāyyaḥ, kevalānāṃ cādīnāmaprayogāt | yadi vācakāḥ, syuḥ, tadāgavādivat kevalā api prayujyeran | tasmāt 'cādayo na vācakāḥ syuḥ, tadā gavādivat kevalā api prayujyeran | tasmāt 'cādayo na vācakāḥ, kevalānāmaprayogāt, pratyayavat' ityanumānaṃ phalitam | taduktaṃ vākyapadīye -- cādayo na prayajyante padatve sati kevalāḥ | pratyayo vācakatve'pi kevalo na prayujyate || iti | [ vā. 2, 166 ] evañca prādīnāṃ cādīnāñca nipātānāṃ dyotakatvameveti harīṇāṃ hṛdayam | nāgeśabhaṭṭasyāpi ayameva pakṣa iṣṭaḥ, mañjīṣāyāṃ punaḥ punastasyaiva samarthanāt | bhaṭṭojidīkṣitaprabhṛtayaḥ prācīnavaiyākaraṇāstu -- nipātatvavacchinnānāṃ sakalanipātānāṃ dyotakatvavācakatve manvate | prādīnāṃ dyotaktavaṃ cādīnāṃ vācakameveti naiyāyikarītistu na sādhvī, vaiṣamye bījābhāvāt | ata eva dyotakatvapakṣaṃ vyavasthāpya -- nipātānāṃ vācakatvamanvayavyatirekayoḥ | [ vai. bhū. nipātani, pṛ. 380 ] ityādinā vācakatvapakṣo'pi samarthito bhūṣaṇādau | upasargātiriktanipātā vācakā dyotakāśceti bhagavān bhāṣyakāraḥ | sa hi "avyayaṃ vibhakti." [ 2|1|6 ] iti sūtre bhāṣye 'sumadrāḥ, sumagādhāḥ, saputraḥ' ityādāvavyayābhāvasamāsamāśaṅkya pūrvapadapradhānasyāvyayībhāvatvenātra pūrvapadaprādhānyaṃ nāstītyuktvā 'ayavā neme samāsārthā nirdiśyante, kiṃ tarhi ? avyāyārthā ime nirdiśyante | eteṣvartheṣu yadavyayaṃ vartate, tatsubantena saha samasyate' ityavocat | kaiyaṭena cāvyayasya śrutatvādantaraṅgatvāt tasyaiva vibhaktyādayo viśaṣaṇāni | tatra yadottarapadārthāvacchinnāḥ samṛddhyādayaḥ pratipipādayiṣitāḥ, tadā'vyayaṃ samṛddhyādīnāṃ vācakamititeṣāṃ tadarthatā bhavati | sumadrā ityatra tu madraśabda eva samṛddhiviśiṣṭamarthamāha, suśabdastu samṛddhidyotakaḥ, na tu vācaka ityādi vyākhyātam | anena bhāṣyakaiyaṭavyākhyānena spaṣṭameva nipātānāmubhayaṃ pratibhāti, upasargāṇāṃ tu dyotakatvameva | spaṣṭañcaitat "gatirgatau"[ 8|1|70] iti sūtrabhāṣye | tatratyabhāṣyaṃ tu -- 'nanu pūrvaṃ dhāturūpasargeṇa yujyate, paścāt sādhanena | naitat sāram ... 'ñprasaḥ' ityādau sarvanāmakāryābhāvāpattiśca : abāve pratiyogino viśeṣayamatvasya sarvasiddhatvena gauṇatvāt | itarapadārthaviśeṣaṇatvenopasthitiviṣayatvaṃ hi gauṇatvamiti cet, naḥ āropaviṣayatvaṃ nañarthaḥ, āropa eva vā, viṣayatvaṃ tu saṃsargaḥ, tasya ca viśeṣatvāt 'āropikato ghaṭaḥ' iti bodhaḥ | evañca 'asaḥ'ityādau tatpadārthasya viśeṣyatvānna gauṇatvamiti na doṣaḥ | idañca samāsaviṣaya eva, asamāsaviṣaye tvabhāvo'rthaḥ | sa ddhividhaḥ--bhedo'tyantābhāvaśra | tatrāntyaḥ ktiyānvayyeva, nañaryātyantābhāvaviśeṣyakabodhe bhāvanopasthiterhetutvat | ata eva 'ahaṃ nāsmi' 'ghaṭo nāsti' ityādau ghaṭābhāvābhinnatvena tadupapatteḥ, ākhyātopasthāpyasaṅkhyābhāvanānvayinyanvaya iti nānvayabhaṅgāpatteśra, vakṣyamāṇarityā''khyātārthasya dhātvarthaviśeṣaṇatve tadbodhāsambhavācca | na cādhikaraṇāliṅgitābhāvabuddherabhāvāt 'iha ghaṭo nāsti' ityādau 'etadadhikaraṇābhāvapratiyogi ghaṭaḥ sattāśrayaḥ' iti bodhānna tadanupattiḥ, kāratāṇaṃ kriyānvaya eva sādhutvasya vyākaraṇasammatatayehetyādināmasādhutāpatteḥ | teṣāṃ sattāyāmevānvaye tu yatkiñcinniṣṭhabhāvapratiyogi ghaṭo nāstītyeva bodhaḥ syāt, na tu ghaṭābhāvasya | na ca teṣāṃ kriyānvayitatsamabhivyāhatanañaḥ sadvṛttyabhāve lakṣaṇāṅgīkārānna doṣaḥ | etaddeśavṛttyabhāvapratiyogighaṭe etadvṛttisattābhāvaniśrayasattvāt tatra satāśrayatvānvayānupapatteriti yat kiñcidetat | kiñca, tiṅopasthāpyakriyāyā na bhede pratiyogitvenānvayaḥ, 'na pacati gacchati' ityāditastathā bodhābhāvāt | ata eva tiṅantasamabhivyāhatanañopāttābhāvārthakatvamevetyapi bodhyam | etanmulakameva paryudāsāpekṣayā prasajyapratiṣedhasya balavattavaṃ vadanti | ] na caivamasamastanañaḥ ktiyānvaye 'yajatiṣu ye yajāmahaṃ karoti, nānuyājeṣu' ityatra vaikalpikatvāt samāsābhāve'pi paryudāsa eva, lāghavānna prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ | tathā sati niṣedhasya prāptipūrvakatayā prāpteścātra śāstrato'nyato'sambhavād 'yajatiṣu' iti śāstrādeva sā vācyā | evañca śāstriyavihitapratiṣiddhatvād vikalpāpattiḥ | na ca 'niṣedhasya vidhyunmūlakatvena balavattvam, upajivyatvena vidherapi balavattvāt' ityādimīmāṃsāsiddhānto bhajyeteti vācyam, asamāse pratiṣedhārthakanaña eva ktiyānvayābhyupagamāt | pratiṣedhapadenātyantābhāvaḥ | ata eva "suḍanapuṃsakasya"[1|1|43] iti sutre napuṃsakasya netyarthe nahi napuṃsakena sāmarthyam, kena rtāha bhavatinā'iti bhāṣyaṃ saṅgacchate | samāse 'asandehāḥ' 'avivādaḥ' ityādau pratiṣedhārthakanaño'pyaktiyānvāt 'asamāse' ityuktam | na cātra nityāvyayībhāvāpattiḥ, 'adrutāyāmra, asaṃhitam, asandehāḥ, prayojanam' iti bhāṣyābhyāmarthābhāve ubhayorapi pravṛtterjñāpanāt | evañca yatpadopasthāpitapratiyogino'nuyogini ādhārādheyabhāvasambandhenānvayaḥ, tatra tadatyantābhāvabodhaḥ |yathā 'bhūtale ghaṭo nāsti' ityādau, 'ghaṭo nāsti' ityādāvapyevam, ākhyātārthāśrayasya sattāyāmādheyatvenānvayāt | yadvṛttitvena ca pratiyogipratyayaḥ, tadvattitvaviśiṣṭa evaityantābhāvo nañā bodhyate, samabhivyāhārabalāditi bodhyam ṣa tena yatkiñcinniṣṭhābhāvamādāya 'bhutale ghaṭo nāsti' iti napratyayaḥ | etena 'bhūtale na ghaṭaḥ' ityādau tātparyavaśāt kadācid bhūtalādau ghaṭādyabhāvaḥ, kadācicca ghaṭādau bhūtalavṛtitvābhāvaḥ pratiyata ityapāstam, atyantābhāvārthakanañaḥ pratiyogibhūtaktiyānvayitvaniyamāt; kārakāṇāṃ ktiyānvayitvaniyamācca | kiñcaivamavyayibhāvasya nityasatvād vākyasyaiva durlabhatvāpattiḥ | na caivam 'pṛdhivyāṃ gandhaḥ, na jale' ityādau pratiterekaviśeṣyakatvānubhavo na syāditi vācyam, iṣṭāpatteḥ, tathā'nubhavasyaivābhāvāt | yatra tu pratiyogino'nuyoginyabhedānvayayogyatā, tatrānyotyābhāvaḥ, kadvān vā tadarthaḥ | [yathā] 'ghaṭaḥ paṭo na' ityādau | 'maitrasyedaṃ na caitrasya' ityādau tu svatvavān ṣaṣṭhacarthaḥ, tasyāpi śeṣatvāt | evañca maitrasambandhisvatvadidaṃ caitrasambandhisvatvavad bhinnamiti bodhaḥ | etenātra svatvābhāvasya bodhāt pratiṣedhārthakanañaḥ ktiyānvayitvamayaktamityapāstam' | anvayitāvacchedakāvacchinnapratiyogitākatvaṃ cātra vyutpattibalalabhyam, nilaghaṭavati atra 'ghaṭo nāsti' 'nīlaghaṭo na ghaṭaḥ' ityādyavyavahārāt, pitaghaṭavati 'nīlaghaṭo nāsti', 'pītaghaṭona nilaghaṭaḥ' ityādivyavahārācca | jātau 'jātirnāsti' ityādau tu yadyapi jātikartṛkajātyadhikaraṇakasamavāyasambandhāva cchinnasattā'prasiddheti kathaṃ tadabhāvabodhanam ? tathāpi khaṇ‍ḍaśaḥ prasiddhisattavānna doṣaḥ, svarupasatpadārthasattāyā bodhe'pekṣaṇāccetyādi prapañcitamanyatra| 'na ghaṭo'sti' ityādau ghaṭabhinno'stiti bodhaḥ, nipātātiriktanāmāvyavahitapūrvarvātanañaḥ prāyeṇa paryudāsabodhakatvāt | 'na khalu na khali bāṇaḥ sannipātyo'yamasmin' [abhi.a.2] ityādau tatpratītivāraṇāya nipātātirikteti | idamevābhipretya 'sajaṃ na kācid vijahau' iti śloke nañā.'sbhānatvamuktaṃ kāvyapratāśakṛtā | 'kācid bhīnnāvijahuḥ' iti viruddhārthasyāpi pratyayādityavadheyam | anyābhāvatvātyantābhāvatve cākhaṇ‍ḍopādhi ityāhuḥ | 'yatu 'ghaṭo nāsti' ityādāvapyaropitā ghaṭakartṛkā sattetyādiktameṇaiva bodhaḥ | evam 'pītaḥ śaṅgo nāsti' ityatrāropitā pītaśaṅgakartṛkā satteti bodhaḥ | na ca viśiṣṭasattāyā aprasiddheḥ kathamāropaḥ, khaṇḍaśaḥ padārthānāṃ prasiddheḥ | melanāprasiddhiścāprayojikā | astu vā āhāryā viśiṣṭaprasiddhiḥ, pratiyogijñānasyābhāvadhihetutve'nāhāryatvaniveśe gauravād viśeṣaṇatāvacchedakaprakārakajñānakāraṇataiva pratiyogijñānakāraṇateti pakṣe'pyāhāryajñānādāhārya eva | vaśiṣṭavaiśiṣṭacabodhaḥ | evañca pratiyogijñānasambhavānnānupapattiḥ | āhāryaḥ śābdabodho nāstīti tvaśraddheyameva | etanmate cāthikam 'ghaṭo nāsti' ityabhāvājñānamādāya nañarthaviśeṣyako bodha iti vyavahāraḥ | pratiyogijñānapratibanvādi ca saṅgamaniyamiti | tat, na; anubhavasiddherapalāpe mānābhāvāt | kiñta, [asamāse] kva ktiyānvaya inyānvaya ityatra tava mate niyāmakābhāvaḥ, mama tvāropitatvārthakatve' dravyānvāyaḥ; atyantābhāvārthakatve ktiyānvaya iti sambhavati vyavasthā | toñeca, 'ghaṭo nāsti' iti bodhottaraṃ ghaṭavattājñānapratibandho na syāt | na cāgre tajjñānaṃ jāyate, tena pratibandha iti vācyam, niyamatastajjñāpakābhāvāt | na cāropitatvajñānameva tathā, idañca tavāpyāvaśyakam; anyathā kadācidatyantābhāvabodhaḥ, kadācide bhedabodha iti vyavasthā na sidhyet | mama tusaṃsargārope ādyaḥ, tādātmyārope'ntya iti na doṣa iti vācyam, saṃsargādyāropaniyāmakas‌yaivātyantābhāvādibodhakatvasambhavāt2. [fn kha.lautitapratyakṣa evāropasya hetutvācca--pāṭhaḥ |] nacapramāyāṃ guṇasya kāraṇatvānurodhena pratiyogyāropasyābhāvapramāyāṃ hetutvāt sarvatraiva sa heturiti vācyam, pramāyā guṇajanyatve mānābhāvāt, pramātvasya kāryatānavacchedakatvācca | astu vā, aropaḥ kāraṇam, tathāpi śabdānna tadbodho'nubhavasiddhaḥ, abhāvabodhasyaiva sarvānubhavasiddhatvāditi sampradāyaḥ3.[fnkha. vastutastu--yatra nañasamabhivyāhāre . pratiyogyanuyoginorādhārādheyabhāvenānvayaḥ, tatraropitatadbodhottaraṃ niyamenātyantābhāvabodhaḥ | anyatra bhedabodha iti vyavasthā | evañca nañaḥ sarvatraikayaiva śāktyā nirvāhga ityapare--ityadhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ | navyāstu--samāse'pi bheda eva nañarthaḥ, parantu sa viśeṣaṇam, bhedapratiyogī ghaṭa ityeva bodhaḥ | ataḥ sarvanāmakārya tatpuruṣasyottarapadārthaprādhānyañca 'atvaṃ bhavasi,anahaṃ bhavāmi' ityādau puruṣavyavasthā ca | 'rakṣohāgamaladhvasandehāḥ' ityādāvapi abhāvapratiyogī sandeha ityeva bodhaḥ | evañca 'anekam' ityādāvekavacananiyamo'pyupapannaḥ | 'patantyaneke' iti tvekaśeṣeṇa sādhu | spaṣṭaṃ cedaṃ bhāṣye ityāhuḥ, tat, na;anubhavavirodhāt | 'adhaṭamānaya' ityukte ghaṭānayanānāpatteśca | yatkiñcidbhedapratiyogighaṭānayanasyaivāpatteśca | pare tu 'ghaṭabhinnaḥ' ityeva bodhaḥ | 'atvaṃ bhavasi' ityādau naño dyotakatvena yuṣmadastadbhinne lākṣaṇikatvād bhinnarūpayuṣmadarthena sāmānādhikaraṇyāt puruṣavyavasyā sarvanāmakāryamapi, "etattadoḥ sulopo'koranaña samāse" [6|1|132] iti jñāpakāt siddham, bhinnasyāttarapadārthatvācca | "anekamanyapadārthe"[2|2|24] ityekavacanaṃ bahuvacanamapīti vadanti, tat, na; "tasya bhāvaḥ" [ 6|1|111] iti sūtrasthabhāṣyavirodhāditi prapañcitaṃ śabdenduśekhare | iti nañarthavicāraḥ | <7> athaivakārārthavicāraḥ 1[fn ayamāśayaḥ-- ayogaṃ viśeṣyasaṅgatasya dvitīye | na ca 'pṛthivyāmeva gandhaḥ' ityādau viśeṣaṇasaṅgate'pi gvitīyasya bodhāt; 'jñānamartha gṛhṇātyeva' ityādau ktiyāyāḥsarvaviśeṣyatvena tatsaṅgate'pyādyasya bodhāt; idamatyayuktamiti vācyam, viśeṣaṇapadasya vigheyārthakatvena viśeṣyapadasya coddeśyārthakatvenāgoṣāt | uddeśyatvavidheyate cātirikto eva viṣayate,na tu viśeṣyatāprakāratārūpe, tatsamaniyate vā | ata eva tatra dhātvarthaktiyāvidheyatvapratītiḥ | ayamutsargaḥ--'candreṇaivāstu sadṛśaṃ mukham' ityādau viśeṣaṇabhūcavidheyacandrasamabhivyāhataivatāreṇāpyanyayogavyavacchedabodhanāt | tasmāt tathābodhe tātparyameva niyāmakam | ata eva mahābhāṣye "karmaṇi dvitīyā"[2|3|2] ityatra 'karmaṇyevadvitīyā' iti niyame yogavyavacchedaṃ hadi nidhāya 'asāmānyāpekṣaniyamaḥ' ityuktam | anyayogavyavacchedaṃ matvā 'prakṛtārthāpekṣaḥ pratyayaniyamaḥ' ityuktamiti bahavaḥ | tatrāyogaḥ=sambanvābhāvaḥ, tadabhāvaḥ | evameva sambandhābhāvo'nyogavyavacchedaḥ |'śaṅkhaḥ pāṇḍura eva' ityaidau pāṇḍuratvāyogābhāvavān śaṅkha iti bodha iti kecit, tat,na;itaraviśeṣaṇatvenopasthitasasyāpāyaṇḍurasyānyatve yoge'nvayāyogāt | tasmāt pāṇḍuratādātmyābhāvavān śaṅkha iti bodhaḥ | śaṅkhatvāvacchedna ca tadanvayaḥ, anyaśca | yatra 'eva' samabhivyāhṛtasya yena sambandhenetaratrānvayaḥ, sa eva yoga evakārarthatayā tatra tra bhāsate | samabhivyāhāravaśāt 'śaṅkhe pāyaṇḍuratvameva' ityādau pāṇḍuratvānyatādātmyābhāvavatkartṛkā śaṅkhādhikaraṇikā satteti bodhaḥ | yad vā, pāṇḍuratvāyogābhāvakartṛkā tadadhikaraṇikā sartteti bodhaḥ | tatra prāyaḥ pāṇḍuratvādisambandhatvāvacchinnābhāvābhāvaḥ śaṅkhatvādyavacchinne bhāsate | yatra tu tathā na bodhaḥ, tatra sāmānādhikaraṇyenāpyanvayaḥ | yathā 'nīlaṃ sarojaṃ bhavatyeva' ityādau | yathā atra hi 'nīlabhavanasambandhābhālasamānādhikaraṇasarojatvavatkartṛkā sattā iti sarojatvasāmānādhikaraṇyenaivānvayaḥ, na tvavacchedakāvacchedena, bādhāt | evāvataiva ktiyāsamabhivyāhṛte atyantāyogavyavacchedabodha iti prasiddhiḥ | yad vā sarojatvasamānādhikaraṇatādātmyasambandhena nīlābhinnasarojakartṛkamayogavyavacchedi bhavanamiti bodhaḥ | yattu, ktiyāsaṅgatasthale sarvatrātyantāyogavyavacchedaḥ pratīyata iti |tat, na; 'jñānamartha gṛhṇātyeva' 'ākāśaṃ, paramamahattvavad bhavatyeva' ityādau ayogavyavacchedamātrapratīteḥ | 'pārtha eva dhanurdharaḥ' ityādau pārthānyatādātmyābhāvavadabhinno dhanurdhara ityanyayogavyavacchedapratītiḥ | ata eva pārthākāśāveva dhanurdharāviti na, anyayogavyavacchinnatvāvacchinnasyetarapadārthe'nvayāt samabhivyāhṇatapadārthatāvacchedena ca pārthānyayogavyavacchedavadapratīterna 'pārtha eva agdharaḥ' ityādyāpattiḥ | ye tu pārthānyatādātmyābhāvavān dhanurdharaḥ pārtha iti bodhamāhuḥ, teṣāṃ pārthapadārthasya dvedhānvayo vyutpattivaiciñyāt pārthākāśāveveti vāraṇāyāvaśyaka iti bodhyam | atracānyasmin yoge vyavacchede tadvati ca śaktiḥ | etenānyayogatvāvacchinnavyavacchedaścet, anyatādātmyarūpayogasya sattvenāprasiddheḥ kathaṃ saktiḥ ? anyasambandhapratiyogikavyavacchedasyādravyatve sattvāt pārtha ivādravyamityāttiḥ | anyasaṃyogatvasamavāyatvāvacchinnavyavacchedaścet, 'pārtha eva dhanurdharaḥ' ityādau pārthānyatādātmyavyavacchedasya pratīyamānasyānāpattiriti parāstam | tatranyapadārthaikadeśe'nyatve pārthaderanvāyo ghaṭādanya ityādāviva, vyutpattivaiciñyāt | ekaprātipadikopasthitiviśayāṇāṃparasparānvayo'pi tata eva | atra vyavacchede śaktiḥ, itaratra lakṣaṇeti naiyāyikanavyāḥ | evamayogavyavacchede'pi bodheyam | evam 'rpathivyāmeva gandhaḥ' ityataḥ pṛthivyanyāvṛttirgandhaḥ pṛthivīvṛttiriti | ata eva 'pṛthivyāmevākāśaḥ' iti na, tasyāvṛttitvāt | yatpadasamabhivyāhāreṇa yaḥ sambandhaḥ pratoyate, evakārasamabhivyāhāre tasyaivānyayogasya vyavacchedapratītiriti na ko'pyatiperasaṅgaḥ | vibhaktyartha vinā kasyāpyarthasyāsattvāg nānvayaḥ, vyutpattivaiciñyāditi | kecittu, pṛthavyatādātmyābhāvavadvṛttirgandha iti bodhaḥ | evakārārthabalādeva samabhivyāhṛtapadārthativacchedakāvacchedena tadvṛttitvasya bodhānna pṛthivyāmeva rūpamiti prayogaḥ | evaśabedottaraṃ saptamyā luk, pṛthivyāmiti saptami sādhutvārthā, evaśabdasya saptamyantatvadyotanāya | vastutastasyāpi pṛrthatvāt tasyāpyādhāratvaṃ bodhyamityāhuḥ | 'caitrasyaivedaṃ dhanam, maitrasyaivāyaṃ ātā' ityādau caitrānyasvatvavyavacchedasya maitrānya ātṛtvavyavacchedasya ca boghaḥ | etena sarvatrāyogavyavaccheda evārthaḥ, ityapāstam, ubhayasvāmike'pi caitrasvatvāyogasyobhayaātṛke maitraātṛtvāyogavyavacchedasya ca sattvena tathāprayogāpatteḥ| kiñca, 'pṛthivyāmeva sattā' iti prayogāpattiḥ, pṛthivīyogābhāvābhāvasya sattāyāṃ sattavāt | anyayogavyavaccheda eva śattirityapi cintyam | athaivam 'gamanaṃ kuru' ityādāvayogavyavacchedasyaiva svarasataḥ pratīteḥ 'daṇḍādeva ghaṭaḥ' ityādervināpi lakṣaṇāmayogavyavacchede bodhe sādhorasādhutāpatteśra | nanu yatsamabhivyāhṛta evakāraḥ, tadanvitānyayogavyavacchedasya tadanvayinyeva pratītergandhe pṛthivyanyāvṛm, tat | 'śīta eva sparśo jale' ityādau śītānyatādātmyavyavacchedavān sparśo jalavṛttirityarthaḥ syāt | evañca 'śīca eva sparśo dravye' ityapi syāditi cet, na; sāghutvārthakaviśeṣaṇavibhaktyantasamabhivyāhṛtaivakārasthale bhedena svānvitaviśeṣyānyayogavyavacchedasyetarapadārthe'nvayāṅgitākānna doṣaḥ | evañca śītasparśāśrayatvābhāvavajjalavṛttiśītasparśa iti bodhaḥ | yadvā, jalavṛttisparśatvāvacachedena śītānyatvavyavacchedānvayaḥ | 'caitreṇaivāyaṃ yajñadatto dṛśyate' ityatra yajñadatte caitrānyasya svakartkadarśanakarmatvarūpasamvandhavyavacchedo yajñadatte pratīyate, vyutpattivaicitryāt, na tu darśanacaitrānyavṛttitvavyacchedaḥ | evaṃ hi caitradarṣanasya tadanyavṛttitvenobhayadṛśyamāne'pi tādṛśayogāpattiḥ syāt | yadvā, īdṛśaviṣaye svetarakārakānvitaktiyātvācchedena tadanyavṛttitvapratyayaḥ, vyutpattivaicitryāt, ato noktadoṣaḥ | anyayogetyatra yogaśra yatraiva sambandhabhedenānveti, tatra bhedarūpaḥ: yatrābhedenānveti, tatrābheda iti boghyam | anyayogavyavacchanno śaktau tu tādātmyameveti draṣṭavyam | 'ghaṭatvaṃ pṛthivovṛttyeva' ityādāvevakārasya pṛthivyanyavṛttitvavyavacchedādau jātimadanyānuyogikatvavyavacchedo draṣṭavyaḥ | samavāyasambandhāvacchinnādhāratvaṃ saptamyarthaḥ | jātimadanyatādātmyābhāvavadadhitakaṇikā satteti bodho vā | 'iha bhavane maitraṇaiva pakṣyate 1. itaranivṛttiphalako vidhiḥ parisaṃkhyā vidhiḥ | yathā 'pañca pañcanakhā bhakṣyāḥ' iti | anena vākyena na bhakṣaṇaṃ vidhīyate, tasya rāgataḥ nāyaṃ niyamavidhiḥ, yugapat prāpteḥ prāptatvāt | nāyaṃ niyamavidhiḥ, yugapat prāpteḥ | tathā ca pañcapañcanakhapaṭhcetarapañcanakhabhakṣaṇasya yugapat prāptau pañcapañcanakhabhakṣaṇenaina kṣunnivṛttiḥ kāryā ityanena parisaṃkhyāyate | pañcetarapañcanakhabhakṣaṇantu nivartate iti parisaṃkhyā vidhirayam |] | parisaṅkhyā copāttātirikte samabhivyāhṛtapadārthābhāvapratyayarūpā | yathā 'pārtha eva dhanurdharaḥ' ityatra pārthānyasmin dhanurdharatvābhāvaḥ | s ca naivakāraghaṭitavākyārthaḥ, kintvārtha eva, uktrīteḥ | śābdastu 'tvanmukhaṃ tvanmukhenaiva tulyam, nānyena kenacit' ityādau tu prāptānuvādasya vaiyyarthyād bhakṣeḥ pañcātiriktapañcanakhakarmakatvābhāvavati bhakṣaṇe lakṣaṇa | tādṛśabhakṣaṇakarmībhūtāḥ pañcasaṅkhyākapañcanakhā iti bodhaḥ | tatra 'lohitoṣṇīṣāḥ' ityādivat prāptāptavivekena bhakṣaṇae pañcātirāktapañcanakhakarmakatvābhāve vidheyatā bodhyā | tatra pañcātiriktapañcanakheṣu bhakṣaṇakarmatvābhāvapratītirārthī | eṣāpyārthyeva parisaṅkhyā | yattu pañcapadasya pañcātirikto lakṣaṇā, bhakṣyapadasya bhakṣyatvābhāvavati, tena 'pañcātiriktā bhakṣaṇakarmatvābhāvavantaḥ' iti bodha iti | tat,na; padadvayalakṣaṇāpekṣayoktaprakārasyaiva nyāyyatvāt, 'kimāsevyaṃ puṃsāṃ savidhamanavadyaṃ uttaratvānāpattiḥ, praśnasāmānyārthatvābhāvāt | na ca praśnavākye'pi lakṣaṇā, bādhādyabhāvāt |ata eva śabdaparisaṅkhayām 'ki bhūṣaṇaṃ sudṛṭhamatra yaśo na ratnam' ityudāhṛtaṃ prakāśakāraiḥ |e kiñca, karmātirikto'rthe tadvākaṇe'pi karmaṇi. vidhānābhāvenoktarājadibhyo nirarthakadvitīyādyāpāttirdurvārā | mama tu na goṣaḥ, 'dvitīyātiriktavibhaktibodhyatvābhāvavati karmaṇi dvitīyā, ityarthena kartrākhyāte vyāpāramukhyaviśeṣyakaḥ, karmākhyāte tu phalamukhyaviśeṣyako bodhaḥ | 'phale pradhānaṃ vyāpāraḥ' ityādinā vyāpārasya prādhānyabodhanaṃ tu kartrākhyātābhiprāyeṇa | athavā, tatra pradhānāpradhānobhayapadacchedaḥ | pradhānaṃ kartṛpratyayasamabhivyāpāratātparyakam; apradhānaṃ tu karmapratyayasamabhivyāhāratātparyakamiti na kāpyanupapattiḥ | ata eva "supaḥ ātmanaḥ kyac" iti sūtrasthaṃ bhāṣyaṃ sahgacchate | vartamānatvādikālo laḍādidyotyaḥ, vācyo'pi | pakṣadvayasyāpi bhāṣyādāvabhihitatvāt, yuktiyuktatvācca | tathāhi -- tattaddhānūnāmeva vartamāno'rthaḥ, laṭ tu taddyotakaḥ | na ca bahūnāṃ dhātūnāṃ tatra śaktikalpane śaktatāvacchedakanānātvāda gauravamiti vācyam, vyāpārasantānasyaiva kālatvenābhyupagamāt | tasya ca dhātvarthatvāt | kālasya vyāpārasantānātiriktatve pramāmābhāvāt | tathā ca tasmin dyotye laḍādaya iti "vartamāne laṭ" iti sūtrārthaḥ | tasmād dyotakatvameva | laṭaḥ | evaṃ vācakatvamapi, "vartamāne laṭ" iti sūtrād vartamānakāle laḍvidhānāt, vyāpārasantānasyakālātmakatvābhāvācca | tathā coktaṃ hariṇā -- 'kriyābhedāya kālastu saṃkhyā sarvasya bhedikā |' iti | anena spaṣṭameva kriyāparicchedakatvaṃ kālasyoktam | nahi svaparicchedakatvaṃ svasya sambhavati | tasmād vācakatvameva laṭaḥ | naiyāyikāstu --- lakārāṇāṃ kṛtau śaktiḥ, kṛtitvajāteḥ śakyatāvacchedakatve lāghavāt | 'ratho gacchati' ityādau vyāpāre lakṣaṇā | śaktatāvacchedakañca lakārasādhāraṇaṃ latvameva | tiptvādināṃ śaktatāvacchedakatve gauravam | ayamatra viśeṣaḥ -- latvena yatne śaktiḥ, ātmanepadatvena ca phale | anyūnānatiprasaktasya dharmasyaivāvacchedakatvaniyamepadatvasya tathātvādityāhuḥ | iti tiṅarthavicārasārāṃśaḥ | ] tatra kartṛ karmavihitatiṅāmāśrayo'rthaḥ | sa ca karttari vyāpārāśrayaḥ, karmaṇi phalāśrayaḥ | āśrayatvañcākhaṇḍopādhirūpaṃ śakyatāvacchedakam | na ca tasyāśrayasambandhanirūpakādibhedabhinnatvācchakyatāvacchedakānantyam, samavāyavadekatve'pi kṣatyabhāvāt | āśrayatāttvañcātiriktaṃ sakalāśrayatānāmanugamakaṃ bodhyam | na cāśrayaḥ prathamāntapadenaiva labdha iti 1[ 'tatra śaktiḥ, āśrayatvenatmābhāt' iti kha. pustake | ] na tatra śaktikalpanā yuktā, ananyalabhyasyaiva śabdārthatvāditi vācyam, 'caitraḥ pacati' ityādau caitratvādinā tallābe'pi pacidhātvarthavyāpārāśrayatvena tadalābhāt | yattu naiyāyikāḥ --- na karatṛkaramaṇī vācye, kṛtyāśrayādeḥ kartrāditvena tatra śaktau gauravāt | kintu kartṛlakāre kṛtiḥ | na dhātunaiva sā labdhā,'pacati -- pākaṃ karoti' iti yatnādeḥ pṛthaktayā vivriyamāṇatvena tasya dhātvaśakyatvāt | na ca ghañādisamabhivyāhṛtadhātoḥ phala eva śaktiḥ, 'gramo gamanavān' iti pratītyāpatteḥ, 'kāṣṭhaiḥ pākaḥ' ityādau tava kārakanvayānāpatteśca, tava bhāvanāyāṃ kārakānvayaniyamāt | tasmād yatnātiriktavyāpāra eva dhātuśakyaḥ | nanu 'ratho gacchati' ityādau kṛterbādhāt, karotervyāpārasāmānyārthakatvācca dhātvarthānukūlavayāpāra evākhyātārthaḥ | ata eva 'bījādināṅkuraḥ kṛtaḥ' iti vyavahāraḥ | 'pacati' ityasya 'pākaṃ bhāvayati' iti vyāpārasāmānyārthakabhāvayatinā vivaraṇam, 'ratho gamanaṃ karoti' iti ca vivaraṇaṃ dṛśyate | kartṛpadenāpi vyāpārāśraya evocyate | ākhyātārthāśraya iti1 [fn mīmāṃsakoktaṃ ityadhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ kha.] matantu na yuktam, āmante kṛti ca doṣāpatteḥ | kṛtirityādau ca kṛñaḥ kṛtau nirūḍhalakṣaṇā | taṇḍulakrayaṇādeśca na pākādyanukūlatvam, anukūlatāviśeṣaṇasyaiva saṃsargatvānna 'pacati' icājiprayogarūpo doṣaḥ2 [fn ityakiḥ pāṭhaḥ kha. ] | ' pacati ' ityādau yatnānubhavastu yatnāvinābhūtapākādikriyāviśeṣaṇa kāraṇasya yatnasyānumānāt | yatne vartamānatvapratītirapi tātparyaliṅgena yatnatvāvacchinne vartamānatvānumityupagamenavopapannatādṛśavartamānatvapratītau śābdatvaṃ tu savivādameva | vartamānatvādyanvayastu ākhyātārthavyāpāra eva, 'pacati, pākayatnavān' iti tu tātparayārthavivaraṇamiti cet, na; vyāpāratvāpekṣayā yatnatvasya jātirūpatvena śakyatāvacchedakatvāt | karoterapyevam, vātarogādinā kampamāne caitre spandānukūlavijātīyavāyusaṃyogarūpavyāpāravatyapi 'nā'haṃ spandaṃ karomi, api tu vātarogeṇa maccharīraṃ kampate' iti pratītyā karoteryatnārthatvasyaivaucityāt, paṭāṅ kurayoḥ kṛtākṛtavyavahārācca | bījādināṅkuraḥ kṛta ityādāvanukūlavyāpāre kṛño lakṣaṇā | bhāvayatīti vivaraṇamapi kṛtyabhiprāyakameva | na ca kṛño yatnārthakatve yataterivākarmakatāpattiḥ, śabda śaktisvabhāvāt | yadvā, kaॉña utpattyanukalā kṛtirarthaḥ, yataterhi kṛtirarthaḥ, yataterhi kṛtirevetyadoṣaḥ | na caivamutpādayatītyasyotpattiṃ karotīti vivaramasaṃgataṃ syāt, utpatterūtpattyabhāvāditi vācyam, tatra vyāpāramātre lakṣaṇāṅgīkārāt | na ca yatnatvasyākhyātāvācyanivṛttijīvanayoniyatnasādhāraṇatayā śakyatāvacchedakatvāsambhava iti vācyam, iṣṭasādhanatājñānajanyāvacchedakapravṛttitvajātirevākhyātapravṛttinimittatvopagamādadoṣaḥ | ata eveśvarakṛterjanyamātrajanakatve'pi 'īśvaraḥ pacati, īśvaro bhuṅakte' ityādayo na prayogāḥ | 'īśvako vedaṃ vakti' ityādau tu 'caitraḥ pacati' itivanna svārasikaḥ prayogaḥ | na ca 'karoti' ityādau tu vyāpāre lakṣaṇā, tasmād yatna evākhyātārthaḥ | ata eva 'caitra eva pacati, nācetanaṃ kāṣṭādi' iti svārasiko vyavahāraḥ | 'kāṣṭhāni pacanti' iti tu 'caitraḥ pacati' iti tu 'caitraḥ pacati' itivanna svārasikaḥ prayogaḥ | na ca 'karoti' ityādau dvedhā yatnabodhāpattiḥ, 'dvau' ityādivadupapatteḥ | 'ratho gacchati' ityādau ca kriyānukūlavyāpāre lakṣaṇā | kriyāyāśca sāmānādhikaraṇyānukūlatvābhyāṃ vyāpāre'nvayaḥ, vyutpattivaicitryāt | ato nānyadīyagamanānukūlatodanādilakṣaṇavyāpāravati 'gacchati' iti prayogaḥ | anukūlatāviśeṣasyaiva vā sambandhatvānnātiprasaṅgaḥ | yadi tu 'nidrāti' ityādau mitthānāḍīmanoyogarūpanidrānukūvyāpārāprasiddiḥ, 'ratho gacchati' ityādāvapi tathānanubhavaścetyucyate, tarhi 'jānāti,gacchati, yatate, dveṣṭi, karoti, nidrāti' ityādāvaśrayatve lakṣaṇā | nanu dhātvarthasyaivāśrayatāsambandhena prathamāntārthe'nvayostu, kiṃ lakṣaṇāyā ? kiñca, lakṣaṇāpakṣe āśrayatvāya sambandhasyādhikasya 'jānāti' ityādau bhānasvīkāreṇa gauravam | na ca 'taṇḍulaḥ pacati' ityādau taṇḍulādeḥ karmatāsambandhena pākādāvanvayabodhavāraṇāya nāmārthadhātvarthayorbhedena sākṣādanvayasyāvyutpattyā na tathā bodhasambhava iti vācyam, prātipadikārthaprakārakriyābodhasyāvyutpannatve'pi kriyāprakārakaprātipadikārthaviśeṣyakabodhasyāvyutpannatve mānābhāvāditi cet, na; 'ghaṭaḥ karoti' ityādau 'kṛtikarmībhūto ghaṭaḥ' ityanvayabodhavāraṇāya kriyāprakārakanāmārthabodhasyāpyavyutpannatvāt | sambandhabhānagauravaṃ tu na doṣāvaham, prāmāṇikatvāt | astu vā tathā, varttamānatvādyanvayastu sarvathedṛśe viṣaye dhātvartha eva,na tvāśrayatvādau | jñānādyasattve'pi svarūpasambandhaviśeṣarūpasyātiriktasya vāśrayatvādeḥ sambandhe'sya sattve jānātītyādiprayogāpatteḥ | jñānādiviśiṣṭe āśrayatvādau tadanvaye tu viśeṣaṇajñānādāvapi tadanvayasyāvaśyakatvena tasyaiva svīkāraucityāt | na ca yatnasyākhyātārthatve "karttari laḥ" ityādyanuśāsanavirodhaḥ, kṛtyabhidhānenaiva prathamāntārthaviśeṣaṇatayā kṛtyanvayena kṛtiviśiṣṭasya kartturbodhanirvāhe lasya tadbodhakatvād na tadvirodhaḥ, 'laḥ karmaṇi' ityatra bodhakatāyā eva saptamyarthatvāt, na tu vācakatā tadarthaḥ, gauraveṇa viśiṣṭadharmiṇi śakterbādhāt | na ca 'caitraḥ pacati' ityādau bhinnābhyāṃ rūpābhyāmekadharmibodhakatvalakṣaṇasāmānādhikaraṇyānubhavavirodha iti vācyam, tathānanubhavāt, tādātmyānantarbhāveṇa svārthānvitārthabodhakatvasyaiva sāmānādhikaraṇyasya pratīteḥ | astu vā tathā sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ lakṣaṇayā, śaktistu lāghavād yatna eva, ata eva "yuṣmadyupapade samānādhikaraṇe" [ 1|4|105 ] ityādīnāṃ nānupapattiḥ | ata eva ca 'kiṃ karoti' iti praśne 'pacati' ityevottare datte devadattādipadābhāve'pi manasopasthite karttari naikatvasaṃśayaḥ, lakṣaṇayopasthate dharmiṇi saṅkhyānvayenādoṣāt | 'pacati' ityādau kālānvayastu kṛtāveva, na tu dhātvarthe, yatnaśunye'pi puṣpe tadadhīnāgnisaṃyogādirūpacyādyarthasya vidyamānatve 'ayaṃ na pacati' iti prayogāt, 'ayaṃ pacati' ityukte idānīmayaṃ pākayatnavānna veti saṃśayanivṛttesca | jānātītyādau dhātvartha eva tadanvayadhrauvyāt | pacatītyādāvapi tathaiva, yatnanivṛttau pākānuvṛttau 'ayaṃ na pacati' iti tu na bhavatyeva pacatītyasyaiva darśanācca | evañca kālānvaye nānākāryakāraṇabhāvakalpanāpina | idānīmayaṃ pākayatnavānna veti saṃśayanivṛttistu tātparyaliṅgena yatnatvāvacchinne varttamānatvānumityabhyupagamenopapannetyanye | naśyatītyādāvutpattirapi dhātvarthaḥ, ākhyātārtho vā iti tatraiva kālānvayaḥ | ato dhvaṃsasya nityatve'pi na sarvadā naśyatīti prayogaḥ | yadvā, uttpatimadabhāva[tva!] syaiva nāśapadārthatvena tadekadeśotpattau tadanvayaḥ | "anabhihite karttari tṛtīyā" ityādeścānabhihitāyāṃ kṛtāvityarthaḥ | kṛtiścāśrayatvādīnāmupalakṣaṇ, kartṛdharme'nabhihite iti yāvaditi kecit | tat, na ; lakārasāmānyasyaiva kartṛtve śaktatvena 'pacyate taṇḍulaḥ caitreṇa' ityādāvapi tṛtīyānāpatteḥ | 'kiṃ kriyate devadattena' iti praśne 'pacyate' ityuttareṇa karttṛpadāsamabhivyāhṛte 'pacyate taṇḍulaḥ' ityādau 'phalajanakaspando varttamānakṛtijanyo na vā' iti sandehānudayena ca 'caitrema pacyate' ityasya 'caikṣeṇa pakvaḥ kriyate' iti vivaraṇena cākhyātamātrasya kartṛtvaśaktatāyā āvaśyakatvāt | na ca kartṛtvaviśeṣyatayā phratipadikārthe'vivakṣite sati tṛtīyā, karmatvaviṣeṣyatayā prātipadikārthe vivakṣite sati dvitīyā ityādyarthaḥ | ata eva sūtre dharminirdeścaritārthaḥ, ato na doṣa iti vācyam, caitramaitrobhayakartṛ kapākasthale caitrakartṛkapākakarttā maitra ityanvayatātparyeṇa 'caitreṇa pacati maitraḥ, caitreṇa pakvavān maitraḥ' ityāderapyāpatteḥ | na cāśrayātiriktāvaśeṣaṇatāpannaṃ yat kartṛ padam, tadviśeṣaṇātānāpannakriyāyāṃ viśeṣaṇatayā prātipadikārthaviśeṣyakartṛtvānvayavivakṣāyāṃ taduttaraṃ tṛtīyeti sūtrārthaḥ | 'caitreṇa pācayati maitraḥ' ityādau ṇyarthakartṛtvaviśeṣaṇatāpannapākādau caitrādikartṛ katvānvayena tatra tṛtīyāsiddhaye āśrayātariktāviśeṣaṇatāpanneti | taccākhyātārthāśrayatve viśeṣaṇam | tasya cāśrayātiriktatvaṃ spaṣṭameva | kṛtiviśeṣyakabodhābhiprāyeṇa 'caitreṇa pacati' ityetadvāraṇāyāśraviśeṣaṇatvamupekṣyāśrayātiriktāviśeṣaṇatvaṃ niveśitamiti vācyam sūtrākṣaraistādṛśārthālābhāt | pācayatītyādau tipa āśraye lakṣaṇāgrahavatpuruṣīya --- 'caitreṇa pācayati maitraḥ' iti prayoge tṛtīyāyā asādhutvāpatteśca | tasmāt 'anabhihite' ityāderanabhihitasaṅkhyāke ityarthaḥ | na ca 'caitreṇa dṛṣṭo gaṭaḥ, ghaṭaṃ dṛṣṭavān caitraḥ' ityādau vināpi tiṅaṃ saṅkhyāpratīteḥ klṛptaśaktikena supaiva saṅkhyopasthitisambhave tiṅāṃ na tadabhidhāyakatvam | evañca 'caitraḥ pacati' ityādavāpi tṛtīyāpattiriti vācyam, 'caitro maitraśca gacchataḥ' ityādau vināpi dvitvādibodhakasupaṃ dvitvādipratyayāt | na caikatvadharmitāvacchedakadvitvādibodhaḥ kutaḥ, ekatvadvayābacchedena dvitvadhīsambhavāt | na ca subaikavacanasyaiva dvitvādau lakṣaṇāstu, supaḥ prakṛtyarthagatasaṅkhyābodhakatvena caitradvayamaitradvayabodhāpatteḥ | nanu kutā saṅkhyānabhidhānāt tatra doṣa iti cet,na ; tatra kartṛ karmābhidhānānabhidhānābhyāmeva vyavasthāsaṃbhavāt | anyatarānabhidhāne tṛtīyeti sūtrārthaḥ | karmalakāre kṛtirna vācyeti mate tu kṛtyanabhidhānameva tartu ranabhidhānam | na ca saṅkhyābhidhānānabhidhānābhyāmevoktānuktavibhāge saṅkhyāyāḥ kartṛkarmasādhāraṇyanānvaye bādhakābhāvena kartṛ lakārādau karmādāvapi dvitīyādyāpattiriti vācyam, ekapadopāttatvena bhāvanāviśeṣye saṅkhyānvayaniyamasvīkāreṇādoṣāt | bhāvanāyāścetaraviśeṣaṇībhūtaprathamāntapadopasthāpye'nvayaḥ, tathaivākāṅkṣitatvāt | bhāvanāpadena saṅkhyākālātirikta ākhyātabodhyo gṛhyate | tena jānātītyādīnāṃ saṅgrahaḥ | 'nārāyaṇa iva naro hanti, candra iva mukhaṃ dṛśyate' ityatra nārāyaṇe candre ca saṅkhyānvayavāraṇāyetarāviśeṣaṇetit | vastutaḥ 'ghaṭo nityaḥ' ityādito'bodhāditaraviśeṣaṇatvenopasthiteḥ śābdamātrapratibandhakatvādatra viśiṣyatadaniveśe'pi kṣatyabhāvaḥ | evañca kāleṣṭasādhantvādyatiriktākhyātārthabodhe prathamāntapadajanyopasthitirheturiti kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ phalitaḥ | evañca 'na pacati' ityatra bhāvanānanvayinyeva karttari tadanvaye'pi na doṣaḥ | bhāvanā hi tatra nañarthānvayinī | 'caitreṇa supyate' ityatra caitraniṣṭhaḥ svāpa iti bodhād viśeṣye svāpe tadvāraṇāya prathamānteti | ata eva tatra bhāvalakāre prathamāntapadajanyopasthityabhāvādananvitaiva saṅ‌khyā | ata eva tatrautsargikamekavacanameva | kiñca, tavāpi kutra karttā vācyaḥ, kutra karttā vācyaḥ, kutra karmetyatra vinigamanāvirahācchabādikaṃ tātparyaṃ vā niyāmakaṃ vācyam | tathā ca mamāpi kutra saṅkhyānvaya ityatra kutra kṛtireva vācyā, kutra phalamapi, ityatra ca tadeva niyāmakamiti na kāpyanupapattiḥ . 'maitreṇa pacyate taṇḍulaḥ' ityatra maitraniṣṭhabhāvanāviṣayapākajanyaphalaśālī taṇḍula iti bodhaḥ | kṛtiḥ phalañcākhyātārthaḥ | tatra kṛtirdhātvarthaviśeṣaṇ, phalaṃ viśeṣyam, niṣṭhatvaṃ tṛtīyārthaḥ, saṃsargo vā, saṅkhyāmātraṃ tṛtīyārthaḥ, bhāvanāpadena saṅkhyākālātirikta ākhyātāthaṃ ucyate | ata eva bhāvanāviśeṣye saṅkhyānvayasya na bhaṅgaḥ | 'rachena gamyate grāmaḥ' ityatra rathaniṣṭhagamanānukūlavyāpārajanyaphalaśālīti bodhaḥ | atra niṣṭhatvaṃ tṛtīyārthaḥ | tasya dhātvarthe gamane'nvayaḥ | na ca phalamapi saṃsargeṇa gamane, nāmārthadhātvarthayormedanānvayasyāvyutpatteḥ | yadvā, tena saṃsargeṇa rathasyākhyātarthabhāvanāyamevānvayaḥ | na ca phalamapi saṃsargo'stu, kiṃ tatrātmanepadasya śaktikalpanayā, tasya prakāratayā bhānānubhavāt | na ca phalāvacchinnavyāpārasya dhātvārthatvād dhātunaiva tallābhaḥ, viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvavaiparotyasyāśakyatvena kriyājanyaphalālābhāt, yadrūpaviśiṣṭe śakti, tadrūpaviśiṣṭasyaiva padenopasthiteḥ | tasmād vyāpāra eva dhātvarthaḥ, phalaṃ tvātmanepadārthaḥ, kṛtiśceti | nanu kṛterapi tatrākhyātārthatva ākhyātopasthāpitabhāvanāyāḥ kriyāviṣayāyāḥ phale'nvayaḥ, uta bhāvanāviśeṣyakriyāyāḥ phale'nvayaḥ | nādyaḥ, phalasya kriyājanyaphalaśālitvarūpakarmatvaprakārakapratītivirodhaḥ | antye, tiṅapasthāpyabhāvanāyāṃ kriyāyā viśeṣaṇatvenānyatra klṛptānvayo bhajyeta, kintu tṛtīyārtha eva | 'caitreṇa pakvaḥ' ityādyunurodhena subarthakṛteḥ kriyāyāṃ viśeṣaṇatvenaivānvayavyutpaterdvitīyaprakāreṇaivānvayabodhaḥ | 'grāmaṃ gacchati' ityādau tu phalaṃ dvitīyārthaḥ | vastutastu prāguktānupapattyā kṛterapyatrākhyātārthatvamāvaśyakam | vyutpattayāntataramevātra kalpyamiti prāñcaḥ | kecit tu, dhātvarthanirūpaṇoktayuktibhistattalphalāvacchinnavayāpāravācitaiva dhātoḥ | na ca dhātvarthaviśeṣaṇatvenopasthitaphalasya karmaṇyanvayāvayutpatterātmanepadārthaphalasyānvayo vācyaḥ, tasya ca sāmānyarūpeṇa viśeṣarūpeṇa vā phalasāmānyavācakatvāt | evañca 'gamyate grāmaḥ' ityādau niyamataḥ saṃyogādirūpaphalaśālitvaṃ grāmāderna pratīyeteti vācyam, saṃyogādyavacchinnavyāpāraśaktagamyādisamabhivyāhārādeva sāmānyaphalaśaktasyāpyatmanepadasya saṃyogādirūpaphalamātrabodhakatāṅgīkāreṇādoṣāt | na ca viśeṣarūpeṇa phalasāmānyabodhakatve śaktyānantyam, iṣṭāpatteḥ | tadādivad buddhisthatvena śakyatāvacchedakānugamena vā na śaktyānantyam | evañca 'gamyete grāmaḥ' ityatra saṃyogāvacchinnavyāpārajanyasaṃyogāśrayo grāma iti bodhaḥ | 'grāmaṃ gacchati' ityādau dvitīyārthaścādheyatvaṃ vyutpattivaicitryād dhātvarthatāvacchedake'pi phale'nveti | ekadeśānvayāsvūkāre tu tatrāpi phalameva dvitīyārthaḥ | grāmaniṣṭhasaṃyogajanakasaṃyogāvacchinnakriyānukūlakṛtimāniti bodha iti vadanti | atra pakṣe'pi saṃyogasya dvedhābhānamanubhavaviruddhamiti dvitīyātmanepadayorna phalamarthaḥ, kintu dhāroreva, phalavyāpārau pṛthak śakyau | evañca dvitīyāyā ādheyatvaṃ karmākhyātasyāśrayatvam, phalaṃ tu kartṛpratyayasamabhivyāhāre dhātvarthe vyāpāre viśeṣaṇam | karmākhyātasamabhivyāhāre tu1 [fn idamatrākūtam --- yathā tadyavityādiśabdānāṃ ghaṭatvapaṭatvādirūpeṇa nānārthaśaktatayā nānārthakatvavāraṇāya svīyaviṣayatāvacchedakatvasambandhena vaktṛviśeṣopalakṣitā ye ghaṭatvapaṭatvādayo dharmāḥ, tadavacchinne tadādīnāṃ śaktisvīkāreṇa na nānārthakatvam ; tathā'trāpi svīyaviṣayatā'vacchedakatvasambandhena pacādidhātuprayoktṛsamavetabuddiviśeṣopalakṣitā ye phūtkāratvādayo dharmāḥ tadavicchinnaśakyatānirūpitaśaktatāvattvasya pacādau svīkārāt | anunugatanānādharmāvacichinnaśakyatānirūpitaśaktatāvattvasyaiva nānārthakatvena prakṛte buddhiviśeṣasyānugamakasya sattvena nānārthakatvābhāvaḥ | ] 1[fn kha. nāsti |] yagātmanepadādirūpatātparyagrākavaśād viśeṣyamityeva sāmpratam | 'devadattena jñāyate' ityādau viṣayatvaṃ karmapratyayārthaḥ, tṛtīyārtha ādheyatvam | 'kriyate ghaṭaḥ' ityādau sādhyatayā kṛtiviṣayatvameva karmapratyayārthaḥ | ataḥ 'ākāśaṃ karoti' ityādayo na prayogāḥ | nanvevaṃ kṛtāmapi kartṛkarmaṇoḥ śaktirna sidhyet, kṛtayāśrayatvādāveva śakterucitatvāt | avyayanipātārthavat pratyayasyāpi bhedenānvayānubhāvakatvānna nāmārthayorabhedānavayavyutpattivirodha iti cet, na ; caitro gantā gato grmaḥ, mitrā paktrī, gataṃ puram | bhoktā tṛpyati, pakvāni bhuṅkte, paktā'pasāryatām || ityādau puṃliṅgastrīliṅganapuṃsakaliṅgatvaniyamadarśanena pūrvārdhopāttānāmabhedānvaya eva sādhutvopagamena tasya dharmiśaktiṃ vinānupapatteḥ, bhojanānukūlakṛtau tṛptyāśrayatvasya bhojane pākaphalaviklityādikarmakatvasya bādhācca | tasmāt kartṛvihitakṛtāṃ kartari, karmavihitānāṃ tu karmaṇi śakti, caitrasya naptā ityādāviva padārthatāvacchedakakṛtyādau dhātvarthanvayaḥ | yadvā, paktetyādau svānukūlakṛtyāśrayatvasambandhena pākādeḥ kartrādāvevānvayaḥ | kartṛtvakarmatvādyanabhidhāne tṛtīyādvitīyādaya iti na doṣaḥ, kṛtā viśiṣṭasyāpyanabhidhānāt | nanu kṛtāmapi dharmavācakatvamevāstu, viśiṣṭe tu lakṣaṇāstu | 'bhoktā tṛpyati' ityādau sāmānādhikaraṇyānubhavānurodhāt 'caitro gantā' ityādāvapīti cet, na ; viśiṣṭaśaktyucchedāpatteḥ, sarvatraiva dharme śaktiḥ, viśiṣṭe lakṣaṇetyasya vaktuṃ śakyatvāt | śaktatāvacchedakañca śrūyamāṇatitvādikameva, na tu sakalasādhāraṇatiṅtvam, tasya durvacatvāt | na ca pāṇinīyasaṅketaviśeṣasambandena tiṅpadavattvaṃ tat, "ādirantyena" [ 1|1|71 ] ityetacca saṃketagrāhamiti vācyam, tadaviduṣāmapi bodhāt | kiñcaivaṃ ghaṭādivācakaghaṭādipadeṣvapi kasyacicchabdasya puruṣaviśaṣīyasaṅketasambhavena tulyayuktyā tatrāpi tacchabdasyaiva śaktatāvacchedakatvāpatteḥ | tibādiṣu pāṇinestiṅpadasaṅketavat puruṣāntarīyaśabdāntarasaṅketasyāpi sambhavena tattacchabdānāmapi pravṛttinimittatāpattau vinigamanāvirahācca | etena saṅketaviśeṣasambandhenākhyātapadavattvādirūpamākhyātatvādiśaktatāvacchedakamityapāstam | nāpi latvam, tadajāto'pi bodhāt | kiñca, tasya vācaktave śatrādyanurodhena salya nānārthatāpattiḥ | kiñca, smārakatāvacchedakaśaktatāvacchedakobhayakalpanāpekṣayā śaktatāvacchedakasyaiva kalpane lāghavena 'papāca' ityādāvanekeṣāṃ smārakatāpattyā ca sthanināmaniyatatvena cāvyavahṛtatvenādeśānāṃ vācaktve'syaiva yuktatvam | ata evaidhāmityādāvāmantenaiva kartṛ bodhaḥ | na ca 'hare'va' ityādau pūrvarūpādisthale paralopādividhānād vyākaraṇānāṃ kalahe kiyān sambodhanaviṣayārthasya, kiyān kriyāyā ityarthasya, vasnasādau kiyān dravyavācakaḥ, kiyāṃśca karmatvāderityarthasya ca niyantumaśakyatvena prathamavyutpatteḥ samudāya eva sattvena ca pade vākye ca śaktikalpanāpattau vākyapadasphoṭāpattiriti vācyam, pratyekaṃ padānāmavadhṛtaśaktikānāṃ samudāyena yathā vyutpattismṛtānāṃ tattadarthopasthapanadvārā vākyārthabodhakatvasambhavānna tadāpattiḥ | lasya tu na kvāpi śaktiravadhṛteti na doṣaḥ iti vadanti | atrāhuḥ -- lakṣyatāvacchedakatvasyeva śakyatāvacchedakatvasyāpi guruṇi svīkāre bādhakābhāvaḥ | na ca kāraṇatāvacchedakatvavat śakyatāvacchedakatvaṃ svarūpasambandhaviśeṣaḥ, tacca sambhavati 'laghau gurau' na kalpyate | lakṣyatāvacchedakatvaṃ tu na tatheti vācyam, vaiṣamye bījābhāvāt | kiñca, svarūpasambandho yadi tattatsvarūpam, tadā gurudharmāṇāmapi sattvāt kānupapatatiḥ, atiriktatve lakṣyatāvacchedakasyāpi gurau kathaṃ kalpanam ? kiñca, gurudharmeṣvavacchedakatvābhāvakalpanāpekṣayā anyatra kalpyamānāvacchedakatvīyasambandhasyaiva kalpanā yuktā, bhāvakalpanāyāṃ lāghavāt | kiñca, avacchedakatvaṃ na svarūpasambandhaḥ, nāpyatiriktam, mānābhāvāt | kintvanyūnānatiriktavṛttitvameva | tacca guruṇyapi | evaṃ kāraṇatāvaccedakatvapratiyogitāvacchedakatvādītyanyatra vistaraḥ | evañcāvacachachedakalāghavagauravacintā'yuktā | kiñca, yatra laghugururūpābhyāṃ bodho nirvivādaḥ, tatraiva laghurūpāvacchinne śakti, gurvavacchinne lakṣaṇā | prakṛte ca kṛtitvenākhyātād bodhaḥ savivādaḥ | nacānantakṛtīnāṃ śakyatāvacchedakatve tadbhedācchaktyānantyāpattiḥ, āśrayatvasyaikasyaiva śakyatāvacchedakatvāt | tasya nānātve'pyāśrayatātvasya śakyatāvacchedakānugamakasya sattvena śaktyānantyābhāvāt | kiñca, kartṛtaṅaḥ kṛtiḥ karmataṅaḥ phalam, āśrayatvaṃ veti tvatpakṣa eva śaktyānantyam, mama tu sarvatrāśraya eveti na tat | lakṣaṇāyāṃ vinigamanā virahācc | kiñca, karotirapi dhātvaṃśasyaiva vivaraṇam, vivaraṇe pākaśabdaśca viklittimātrābhidhāyakaḥ | ata eva phalānutpādadaśāyāṃ pāko jāto na veti praśne bhaviṣyatītyapyuttaraṃ dṛśyate | vyāpārāntarbhāveṇa praśne jāyata iti ca | na ca dhātvarthāt pṛthagvivaraṇānupapattiḥ, pacatītyatra dhātvarthakhyātārthayoḥ saṃsargamaryādayā bhāsamānasyānukūlatvasyākārakaśaktirūpasyāpi pākamiti dvitīyayā kārakaśaktirūpeṇa prakāratayā vivaraṇavad dhātvarthabhūtāyā api kṛtestathāvivaraṇopapatteḥ | api ca , kṛtervyāpāriviśeṣatayā kṛttiṅabhayānugatatvena phūtkārādau dhātoḥ śaktikalpanāyā āvaśyakatvena karotītyādau dhātornairarthakyāpatteśca | prakṛtereva śaktikalpanāyā yuktatvena dhātuta eva lābhāt tatrākhyātasya śakteruktisaṃbhava eva na | vastutaḥ kaॉño'pi na yatnārthakatvamiti dhātvarthaṃnirūpaṇe uktam | vātarogādinā kampamāne devadatte nāhaṃ spandaṃ karomīti vyavahārastu spandotpattyakūlāsādhāraṇavyāpārasya tadarthatvādupapannaḥ, tādṛśavyāpārasya devadatte'bhāvāta, vyāpāramadhye kṛterapi niveśācca | aṅkuro na kṛta iti vyahāraḥ, utpattyanukulakṛtyabhāvamātrābhiprāyeṇa, lakṣaṇā vā tatra kṛñaḥ, tava mate bījādinā kṛta ityādāviva vyāpārāṇāṃ tattadrūpeṇa vācyatve'pi śakyatāvacchedakānāṃ buddhisthatvenānugamānna śaktyānantyam | utpattyavacchinnavyāpāraśaktasayāpi vyāpāramātre lakṣaṇayā utpattiṃ karotītyādinirvāhaḥ | na ca tava mate abhedasambandenākhyātārthāśrayaprakarākabodhaṃ prati prathamāntapadajanyopasthitirhetuḥ, tadarthasaṅkhyāprakārakabodhe tadarthāśrayopasthitirhetuḥ, tadarthakālaprakārakaśābdabodhe dhātujanyopasthitirheturiti kāryakāraṇabhāvatrayam | mama tu kāleṣṭasādhanatvādyatiriktākhyātārthabodhe prathamāntapadanyopasthitirheturiti saṅkhyābhāvanayoreka iti lāghavamiti vācyam, kiṃ karotīti praśne kartṛ padāghaṭitapacatītyuttaramātradāne karttari ekatvasaṃśayanivṛttidarśanena tatra lakṣaṇayopasthite karttari ekatvānvayasya tvayāpyaṅgīkāreṇa saṅkhyāprakārakabodhe tadarthakartrupasthitikāryakāraṇabhāvasya tvayāpyavaśyavaktavyatvāt | sarvatra tathānaṅgīkārema tattadvākyoyatvaniveśenātyantagauravañca | saṅkhyābhāvanānvayakāryakāraṇabhāve kāleṣṭasādhanatvādyatiriktākhyātārthatvena nivase'dhikagauravañca | kḷñca, ākhyātena kvacit kṛteḥ, kvacidāśrayatvāsya bodhaḥ, kṛteḥ kvacid dhātunā, kvacit pratyayena bodha ityarthas paryavasitatvena tava mate'nekakliṣṭakāryakāraṇabhāvāpattiḥ, tattadvyutpattyanusāreṇa tathā tathā kāryakāraṇabhāvānāṃ sarveṣāmāvaśyakatvena tallāghavagauravavicārasyāyuktatvācca | kiñca, "yuṣmadyupapade" [ 1|4|105 ] ityādau samānādhikaraṇe ityakte ṛṣyanubhavasiddhasāmānādhikaraṇyasya tvanmate'nupapattiḥ | na ca tirṅthasaṅkhyānvayivācakatvameva tatra sāmānādhikaraṇyam, tādṛśasya sāmānādhikaraṇyapadenāvyavahārāt | na ca lakṣaṇayā sāmānādhikaraṇyam, śakterevocitatvāt | anyathā viśiṣṭaśaktyucchedaḥ, kṛtimātrūbodhasya kvāpyabhāvāt | yadi tu pacatītyetāvanmātroktau tanmātrabodha ityucyate, tarhi taduktau karttari ekatvasaṃśayāpattiḥ, paktā jāta ityādau kṛtyapi kṛtimātrābhiprāyeṇa prayogasya vaktuṃ śakyatvāt tiṅkṛtau vaiṣamyaṃ durupādañca | kiñca, kāleṣṭasādhanatvādyatiriktākhyātārthabodhe prathamāntapadajanyopasthitirheturiti kāryakāraṇabhāve vyabhicāraḥ | kāryakāraṇabhāvāntarakalpane tu gauravam | kiñca, vidheyasyoddeśyakoṭau praveśānaucityena tvaduktārtho'nucitaḥ, kartrādau yuṣmatsamānādhikaraṇe yo laḥ, tasya sthāne madhyama ityarthasyaivocitatvam | kiñca, saṃkhyānvayaniyamo'pi durupapādaḥ | na ca śabādikaṃ tātparyagrāhakam, kartrarthe sārvadhātuke śabityādyarthasya sattvena teṣāṃ saṅkhyānvaye tātparyagrāhakatvasya nirūpayitumaśakyatvāt, yadapi "anabhihite" ityasyānabhihitasaṅkhyāka ityartha iti | tadapi na ; devadattaḥ paktetyādau tṛtīyāpattiḥ | api ca, tiṅvidhau hyekayarityāderūpasthitasya kiṃ lakārārthasyaikatvādāvityarthaḥ, uta tiṅupāttārthānvayigataikatvādāvityādyarthaḥ ? ādye siddhaṃ na iṣṭam | antye tu devadattādipadottarasupaiva tasyoktatvena tatra tiṅvidhānānupapattiḥ | kiñca, tava mate pacati, jñātetyādau nānārūpaṃ kartṛṃ tvaṃ vācyam, mama tu sarvatraikarūpameva tat | kiñca, tava lavidhau kartṛgrahaṇasya nānārthatāpattiḥ, tṛtīyādividhāvapi kvacit kṛtau, kvacidāśrayatva ityādyarthe vairūpyam | na ca kṛtau tṛtīyetyādyeva sūtrārthaḥ, 'rathena gamyate' ityādāvanupapattyā tṛtīyādīnāṃ lakṣaṇeti vācyam, subvibhaktau na lakṣaṇeti tvatsiddhāntāt, arthanirdeśasya vyarthatvāpatteśca, anyārtho'sādhutvabodhanaṃ hi tatphalam, tvadrītyā lakṣaṇayā sarvatra sādhutvasyeṣṭatvāt, vyatyayānuśāsanavaiyarthyāpatteśca | kiñca, 'kūlaṃ pipatiṣati'tyādāvacetane cetanatvāropavad rathādāvapi cetanatvāropeṇa tiṅādīnāṃ kṛtyarthakatvopapattau lakṣaṇāśrayaṇaṃ vyartham | na ca vyākaraṇasmṛteḥ sādhutvamātre tātparyeṇārthavyavasthāpakatvānna doṣaḥ iti vācyam, arthaviśeṣapuraskāreṇaiva sādhutvasya vaktavyatvena ṛṣyanubhavānurūḍhārthānuvādabalena tādṛśārtha eva sādhutvasyaucityāt | ata eva pacatītyukte kaḥ kīdṛśa iti praśnaḥ, paṇḍito ghanaśyāma ityuttarañca saṅgacchate | anyathā kartturanupasthitau ka iti viśeṣajijñāsānupapattiḥ | kiṃ caivaṃ kṛtāmapi kartṛ vācakatvānāpatiḥ | na ca caitro gantetyādau samānādhikaraṇapratipādikārthayorabhedānvayavyutpatterbhedenānvaye caikapadottaraviruddhavibhaktimatpadajanyopasthiterhaitutvācca bhedenānvayāsambhavenābhedānvayo vācyaḥ, sa ca karturvācyatāṃ vinā'nupapanna iti vācyam, rājñaḥ sutasya dhanamityādau sati tātparye ubhayavidhabodhasyāpi darśanena kāryakāraṇabhāvadvayasyāpi vyabhicaritatvāt tathā tathā bodhe tātparyajñānahetutayaiva nirvāhasyāvaśyakatvena caitro gacchatītyādāviva kṛterāśrayatayā caitre'nvayenākṣateḥ | na caivamapi mitrā paktrīti liṅgasāmānādhikaraṇyāt kṛti karttā vācyaḥ, īdṛśānāṃ dharmavācatve'pi śuklādipadānāmiva viśeṣyanighnatvasya vaktuṃ śakyatayā vastvavyavasthāpakatvāt | kiñca samānādhikaraṇaviśeṣaṇasya viśeṣyasamānaliṅgatvavat tādṛśaviśeṣaṇasya viśeṣyasamānasaṅkhyatvaniyamādākhyātasyāpi dharmivācakatvamāvaśyakam | anyathā devadattāḥ pacatītyāderapyāpatteḥ | caitro maitraśca sundarāvityādau vyabhicārānna tathā niyama iti cet, 'kṣudupahantuṃ śakyam' ityādau vyabhicāreṇa tvaduktaniyamasyāpyabhāvāt | na ca kevalakṛtau prayogābhāvaḥ, ākhyāte'pi samatvāt, kṛtyāśrayasyātmano jananāsambhavena pācako jāta ityādeḥ sattvācca | na kṛti kṛtereva vācyatve caitre gantetyādyāpattiḥ, caitre gacchatītyasyāpyāpatteḥ | yadyapyākhyātārthasya prathamāntapadosthāpya evānvayaḥ, tathāpi kṛterviṣayatayā kāṣṭhādāvanvayavivakṣāyāṃ caitre pacati kāṣṭhamityāderdurvāratvam, bhoktā tṛpyatītyādau tu kṛtaḥ karttari lakṣaṇāstu, tasmādabhedānvayānubhava eva kṛtsu kartṛ śaktau pramāṇaṃ vācyaḥ, viśiṣṭaśaktyucchedāpattiśca | evaṃ ca 'pacati kalpaṃ devadattaḥ , ityādāvabhedānvayadarśanāt tvadrītyā yuktatvācca caitraḥ pacatītyādāvanvayānubhavacca viśiṣṭaśaktyucchedāpatteścākhyātasyāpi kartṛvācaktavāsiddhiḥ | yattu nāmārthayorityatra nāmatvaṃ na vaiyākaraṇaparibhāṣitam, kintu supaḥ pūrvavṛttitve satyarthavattvāt | evañca tibuttaraṃ subabhavānna doṣa iti, tat,na ; āmantottaraṃ supaḥ sattvena pācayāmāsetyādau kṛterbhedena sambandhenānvayānāpatteḥ āmantottaraliṭo dharmivācakatve āmantatiṅantayorabhedānvayo durlabhaḥ | kiñcaivaṃvidhanāmagrahaṇe chatrītyādau prakṛtipratyayārthayorabhedānvayāpattiḥ, anuśāsanabalādevārthānvayayornirṇaye tu siddhaṃ na iṣṭam | na ca kalpabādīnāṃ karttari lakṣaṇā, pācaka ityādāvapi supāṃ lakṣaṇayaivopapatteḥ | ācāryakalpāvityādivat kartṛ dvitvādivivakṣāyāṃ pacati kalpamityādāvapi dvivacanādyāpattiḥ, anuśā nabodhitārthe svecchāmātreṇa lakṣaṇāyāmasādhutāpatteśca | kiñca, tatra karttari lakṣaṇāyāṃ paktā gacchatītivat pacati kalpaṃ gacchatītyasyāpattiḥ | yadapi karmākhyāte phalamātmanepadārtha iti | tatra dhātvartha eva viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvyatyāsamātreṇopapattau pṛthak pratyayasya śaktiśalpane gauravāt | tatra tātparyagrāhakamātmanepadaṃ yagādi cāstu | kiñca, navyanaiyācayikanaye tatra kṛterākhyārthatvābhāvena tṛtīyāntāsamabhivyāhṛta 'kiṃ kriyate' iti praśne pacyata ityuttarānāpatteḥ, kṛñastava yatnārthakatvāt | na ca tatra kṛtirapyākhyātrthaḥ | tasyāṃ dhātvarthaviśeṣyatāyāḥ klaptatvenānānvayāpatteḥ | kiñca, kṛtyabhidhānenaivābhidhānavyavasthāṅgīkāreṇa karttari tṛtīyānāpattiḥ | kṛterdhātvarthatve tu siddhaṃ na iṣṭam | kiñca, prācīnanaye karotītyādau kālānvayasya dhātvartha'ṅgīkāreṇa pacatītyādau cākhyātārthe tadanvayena vaiṣamyāpattiḥ | mama tu sarvatra dhātvarthe evānvaya iti na doṣaḥ | etena kālasya dhātvarthe'nvayāt padadvayaghaṭitaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvastava, asmākantvākhyātārtha eveti lāghavamityapāstam | 'bhūtaṃ pakvaṃ jānāti' ityādau kālānvayāya tasya tavāpyāvaśyakatvācca | kiñca, kṛtau kālānvaye pākaśālāyāṃ kāṣṭhajvalanādyanukūlaṃ vyāpāraṃ kṛtvā pacyamānamodanaṃ paśyati nirvyāpāratayā tiṣṭha devadatte pacatītyanāpattiḥ | mama tu pākyavastutiṣṭhaviklityanukūlavyāpārādhikaraṇavṛttitvaviśiṣṭapākaśālāvasthānarūpavyāpārasya dhātvarthasya vidyamānatvānna doṣaḥ iti dik | mīmāṃsakāstu, phalāvacchinnavyāpārarūpadhātvarthanukūlo vyāpāraḥ, kṛtyādirūpa ākhyātārthaḥ | sa ca vyāpāratvenaiva | evañca jānātītyādau na lakṣaṇā | kṛtyādivyāpārastu naiyāyikoktayuktijālairviśeṣyatvānurodhena ca tiṅa eva vācyaḥ | kālānvayastu dhātvarthavyāpāre, ākhyātārthe'pi vā | dhātvarthavyāpārāśrayatvameva kartṛtvam, tadarthaphalāśrayatvaṃca karmatvam | "anabhihite" ityasyābodhite kartrādāvityarthaḥ, bodhaśca śaktyā, ākṣepad1[fn mīmāṃsakamate ākṣepaḥ = arthāpattiḥ, yena vinā yadanupapannam, tena tat kalpyate | yathā 'pīno'yaṃ devadatto divāna bhuṅkte' ityatra bhojanaṃ vinānupapannena yogābyasādyajanayapuṣṭatvena bhojanaṃ kalpyate | tasyadivā bādhe rātribhojane paryavasānaṃ bhavati | evaṃ prakṛte bhāvanāyāḥ kartāraṃ vinānupapattyā sā kartṛrūpamāśrayaṃ kalpayati | tathā cānupapatijñānamarthāpattyaparanāmākṣepaḥ | tajjanyaṃ jñānamapi tannāmakaṃ pramityantaram | tārkikamate ākṣepo'numānam | yathā 'bhāvanā kvacidāśritā, guṇatvāt,sakarttṛkakā vā kāryatvāt, ghaṭavat' ityanumitijanakaṃ vyāptijñānādikamākṣepaḥ | evacākṣepeṇa bāvanājñānottaramarthāpattyā, anumityā vā kartā bodhyate | mīmāṃsakairākṣepalabhyasyāpi śābdabodhaviṣayatvābhyupagamādākhyātajanyaśābdabodhe bhānamaviruddham | evaṃ phalasyāpi svāśrayaṃ vinā'nupapattyā tenasa ākṣipyate | nanu vṛttyā padajanyapadārthopasthiteḥ śābdabodhahetutvenākṣepalabhyasya śābdabodhe hetutvaṃ na sambhavati| kiñca, anupapattyādijñānavidhurāṇāmapyanubhavasiddhatadbodhānupapattiḥ, ākṣipte tatrākhyātārthasaṅkhyāndayānupapattisca, vṛttyā padānupasthitatvāt | tathā cocyate 'śābdī hyākāṅkṣā śabdenaiva prapūryate' iti | śābdī = śābdabodhaviṣayiṇī,ākāṅkṣā = jijñāsā, śabdenaiva prapūryate = vṛttyā padāryopasthitidvārā viṣayasiddhisampādanena nivāryate iti tadāśayaḥ | ityata āha -- lakṣaṇayeti | ] vā, lakṣaṇayā vā | tatra kṛti śaktyā, tiṅi bhāvanayākṣepeṇa lakṣaṇayā vā | na ca viparītameva kiṃ na syāt, prādhānyena pratīyamānatvāt | bhāvanāyāḥ pratyayavācyatve sthite tayā karturākṣepo yuktastiṅi, kṛti tvākṣepalabhyatve tiṅīva tasyāpradhānyāpattiḥ| prādhānyena pratīyamānatvācca tasya vācyatvam | saṃkhyānvayānupapattyā sāmānādhikaraṇyānupapattyā "laḥ karmaṇi" [ 3|4|69 ] ityādau dharminirdeśena ca kartrādau lakṣaṇāvasīyate | lakṣitakartāramādāyaiva ca 'devadattaḥ pacati' ityādau sāmānādhikaraṇyopapattiḥ |"laḥ karmaṇi" [ 3| 4| 69 ] ityādyanuśāsanaṃ tu lākṣaṇikādyanuśāsanamiti vadanti | yadyapīdamapi prāguktadūṣaṇairdūṣitameva, tathāpi kānicidanyānyapyucyante | tathā hi--- śābdayāmītyanubhavavirodhādākṣepona yuktaḥ| kiñcākṣepeṇa pratītasyābhidhānaniyāmakatve karmapratyaye'pi pacyate ityādeḥ 'pākaḥ kriyate' iti vivaraṇadarśanena bhāvanāyā vācyatvāśyakatve tasyāśca vināśrayamanupapattyā kartturākṣepasambhavāt | rtrabhidhāne tṛtīyānāpattiḥ | na ca kartṛpratyaye kartari vidhānasāmarthyāllakṣaṇāśrayaṇe'pi karmapratyayasthale ākṣepalakṣaṇayormānābhāvaḥ | āśrayākāṅkṣāyāścaitrādipadaireva śāntiriti vācyamam, evamapyākṣepalabhyāya api vyakteḥ prādhānyasya tava mate sattvena prādhānyānurodhācchaktikalpanā na yuktā | anyathā vyakterapi vācyatvāpattāvākṛtyadhikaraṇocchedāpattiḥ | vyakteraviseṣyatve tu vāhadohādyananvayaḥ | na ca paricchedyatayāvagatatvād dravyaṃ tathā ākhyāte paricchedyatayākṣiptakartustadvadeva viśeṣyatvāpatteḥ | kiñca, pratyayārthaḥ pradhānamityajā, chāgotyādau vyabicaritam | kiñca, kartrā bhāvanāyā evakṣopo'stu evākṣepo'stu, māstu bhāvanāyā eva vācyatvam | nanu bhāvanayā kartturākṣepo yuktaḥ, na tu kartā tasyāḥ | karmapratyayasthale bhāvanāpratītyannāpatteriti cet, na ; karmaṇo'pibhāvanānvayitvena tadākṣepakatvāt | karmakartṛkṛtsu tadākṣepāya tvayāpyevaṃ svīkartavyātvāt | ata 'eva kiṃ kāryaṃ pacanīyam, kiṃ kṛtaṃ pakvam' ityādi pakvān pākaṃ kṛtavāniti vyavahāraḥ |na ca 'kartari kṛt' [ 3|4|67 ] ityanuśāsanāt karttu kṛtivācyatā, "laḥ karmaṇi" [ 3|4|69 ] ityanuśāsanasya tiṅkṣvapi sattvāt tata eva hi tatra kartṛgrahaṇamanuvartate | na cedaṃ nirūḍhalakṣaṇātātparyagrahākamanuśāsanam, "kartturi kṛt"[ 3|4|67 ]
