ityasyāpi tathātvāpātteḥ | nanu "laḥ karmaṇi ca", "'tiptasjhi", "dvayekayoḥ" ityādīnāmekavākyatayā vidhāyakatve kartṛgataikatve'bhidheye lasya sthāne ekavacanaṃ tivādi prayoktavyamityādikrameṇārthānna kartturvācyatā sūtrādāyātīti cet, na ; jvivacādisañjñānāmājadeśaniṣṭhatvena tadvidhinā "dvayekayoḥ" ityādīnāmekavākyatve'pi tatra karttarītyasyābhāvena tasyaikatvādiviśeṣaṇatvāsambhavāt | na lavidhitivādividhyorapyekavākyatā'stīti cet, asti, parantu vākyaikavākyatā sā, na padaikavākyatā | lavidhilabhyalakārānuvādenādeśavidheḥ pravṛtteḥ | tathā ca lavidhisthakartṛgrahaṇaṃ svavākyarthavelāyāmekatvādīnāmanupasthityā kathaṃ tadviśeṣaṇaṃ syāt | na cādāntaravākyārthe'nvitasya tadekavākyatāvelāyāmavṛttyā ekatvādiviśeṣaṇamapīti vācyam, āvṛttau mānābāvāt | nanu "laḥ karmaṇi "[ 3|4|69] ityatra la iti ṅasantam ; ādeśāpekṣayā ṣaṣṭhī, lasya ya ādeśaḥ, sa karmaṇītyādikrameṇārthaḥ, lakāraśca "varttamāne laṭ" [ 3|2|123 ] ityanenaiva vihita iti na doṣa iti cet, na ; evaṃ hi lasyānarthakatvaṃ kālavācakatvaṃ vā sayāt | tathā ca śatṛśānacoḥ kartṛkarmādi vācyaṃ na syāt | tathā cāsyamāne gata iti bhāve kriyamāma iti karmaṇi ca śānac na syāt | na ca śāncaḥ "kartari kṛt" [ 3|4|67 ] ityanuśāsanāt kartaiva vācyaḥ, bhāvakarmaṇostu lakṣaṇeti vācyam śāstrātikrameṇa svecchāmātreṇa lakṣaṇāyāmasādhutāpatteḥ | na ca "laṭaḥ śatṛśānacau" [ 3|2|124 ] ityanenātmanepadarasmaipadavidhāyakānāmekavākyalupttavādabhāvasya vṛttyārthabodhakatvābhāvena tadartho nirdiṣṭaḥ syāt | na cāma ityādeśavidhāyakena saha "laḥ karmaṇi " [ 3|4|69 ] ityasya vākyaikavākyatvāllukśabdena tatsahacaritāmantalakṣaṇācca na doṣaḥ | evamapi jasantatve śrutenaiva sambandhaḥ, ṣaṣṭhyantatve tvādeśe ityadhyāhāryam | api coktārotyā "laḥ karmaṇi " [ 3|4|69 ] iti sūtre ādeśā apyanuvādyāḥ | te ca 'lasya' ityadhikṛtya "tiptasjhi" [ 3|4|78 ] iti vihitāḥ | tathā ca paripūrṇavākyasyaivānuvādyasamarthakatvānmahāvākyārthabodhaṃ prati kāraṇatvācca tadekavākyatayaiva padaviśeṣapuruṣaviśeṣavyavasthāpakānāmiva vacanaviśeṣavyavasthāpakasyāpi pravṛttidhrauvye punaridānīṃ pravṛttirnirmūlā, kartrādyarthānāṃ dvivacanādisajñāvinirmuktatvāt | kiñca, runaḥ pravṛttirvyarthā "tiptasḍhi" [ 3|4|7|8 ] "dvyekayoḥ" [ 1|4|22 ] ityādyekavākyatayaivaikatvādau vācyatāyāḥ siddhatvāt | na ca kartrādau saktyabodhanena mīmāṃsakamatasiddhireva phalam, matasiddhau punaranvayaḥ, punaranvaye ca matasiddhirityanyonyāśrayāt | api ca punaḥ pravṛttiraniṣṭāvahā, gauravasya sattvāt | kiñca, karttari ekatve ityarthāṅgīkāre'pi viśeṣaṇatayā kartrādīnāṃ praveśāt tadvācyatvaṃ duṣpariharam | na ca lakṣaṇayā tallābhānna vācyatvam, tatra tatra tātparyānyathānupapattyaukatvādiviśiṣṭe kartrādāveva lakṣaṇayopapattau tasyā api vācyatvānāpatteḥ | api ca, saṅkhyāyāḥ paricchedakatvena viśeṣaṇataivocitā -- ekasmin kartarīti | tathā ca dharmiṇi śaktirdurvārā | api ca, "bhāvakarmaṇoḥ" [ 1|3|13 ] "śeṣāt" [ 1|3|78 ] ityābhiḥ śatrādividhinaikavākyatayā yathā dharmiṇi śaktirbodhyate, tathā tibādividhyekavākyatave'pi yuktam, vaiṣamye bojābhāvāt | api ca tvaduktarītyā'nuśāsanena dharmiṇī śaktyabhāve siddhe tiṅāṃ dharme śaktirapi na sidhyeta, anuśāsanābhāvāt | taṃ vināpi tatsiddhau "kartari kṛt" [ 3|4|67 ] ityādīnāṃ vaiyarthyāpattiḥ | kiñca, jātiśaktinaye ghaṭamityādau jātyākṣiptadravye jācerviśeṣaṇatvavad bhāvanākṣipte bhāvanāyā viśeṣaṇatvāpattau bhāvanāpradhānakabodhānāpatteḥ | sa ca tavāpi sammataḥ | vyuttpayantarakalpane tu goravam | kiñca, lakṣitakartrā devadattādeḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyanirvāhe piṅgākṣyādiyaugikānāmapi dravyavācitvaṃ na syāt, sāmānādhikaraṇyasyākṣiptadravyeṇaivopapatteḥ | tathā hi -- daṇḍītyato daṇḍasambandhavāniti pratītiranubhavasiddhā | tatra "tadasyāstyasminniti matup" [ 5|2|94 ] matvarthe bahuvrīhirityādyanusāsanena vigrahe ṣaṣṭhyarthaṃsyaiva prādhānyadarśanena ca sambandha eva śaktiḥ syāt | tadākṣiptena ca sāmānādhikaraṇyopapattiḥ | tathā ca 1[fn atra kiṃ vākyaṃ bhaṅktvā aruṇimā prakāre niveśanīyaḥ ? kiṃ vā krīṇātinā sambaghyate ? iti saṃśaye krīṇātinā sambadhyamānaḥ ; tadyogāt krayamakaraṇaṃ syāt | na cāmūrtasya tadyuktamiti nāsya krayaṇasambandha itipṛthageva prakaraṇe niveśanīya iti pūrvapakṣaḥ | siddhāntapakṣastu -- sannihitapadārthānvaye prakaraṇaniveśātaucityāt piṅgākṣyadipadānāṃ dravyavacanatayā tasminnanvayasaulabhyena taddvārā krīṇātyarthenāpi sākamanvayalābhād vākyaghaṭakatvameva tasyeti | sa cānupapannaḥ, piṅgākṣyādiyaugikānāṃ padānāmuktayuktyā sambandhārthakatayā dravyasya tairanupādānāt | kiñca, pūrvapakṣo'pyanupapannaḥ, piṅgākṣyekahāyanīśabdārthasambandhasyāpyamūrtatvāt krīṇātikaramatvāsambhavena krīṇātikaraṇāvasyaitadvākyādalābhādāruṇyasyaiva vākyabhedaśaṅkāyāṃ mūlaśaithilyācca | bahuvrīhyauraruṇapadasya ca lākṣaṇikadravyavidhāyakatāyā aviśiṣṭatvena bahuvrīhyādereva dravyavidhāyakatvam nāruṇapadasyetyatra vinigamakābhāvāt | ] ' aruṇayā piṅgākṣyā ekahāyanyā somaṃ krīṇāti' iti vākye dravyānukterāruṇyasya svavākyopātte dravya evānvayapratipādakāruṇādhikaraṇocchedāpattiḥ | na ca lakṣaṇāpakṣe na doṣaḥ, ākṣepapakṣe'pi jātiśaktinaye vyakteḥ sākṣātprakṛtivṛttyupastāpyatvābhāve'pi vṛttiprayojyopasthitiviṣayatvamādāya tatra pratyayārthādyanvayavadākṣipte svavākyopāttatvasyāpi vaktuṃ śakyatvāditi vācyam, evamapi lākṣaṇikadravyaniveśe'ruṇapadasyāpi guṇinī lākṣaṇikatvāt padīyadravyaniveśanaivopapattau vākyīyadravyaniveśasiddhāntāsaṅgatiḥ spaṣṭaiva | mama tu śaktyupasthitadravyeṇaiva nirākāṅkṣatvāllakṣaṇāprasara eva,nāruṇapade iti siddhāntopapattiḥ | kḷñca, evaṃ sati viśiṣṭaśatyucchedāpattiḥ | na cākṛtyavikaraṇānyāyeneṣṭāttiḥ, tenaiva siddhau pṛthakkartradhikaraṇārambhavaiyarthyāpatteḥ | kiñca, ghaṭādipadebhyo ghaṭatvaviśiṣṭasyaiva niyato bodha iti ghaṭatvasya vṛttyaviṣayatve śābdaviṣatvāyogāt tadaṃśe vṛttikalpanāvaśyakatve 'nāgṛhītaviśeṣaṇa'nyāyena tanmātravācitvāsiddhau dravyākṣepo yuktaḥ | na cākṣiptasyāpadārthatvāt tatra pratyayārthādyananvayaprasaṅgaḥ, vṛttiprayojyopastitereva tatra niyāmakatvādadoṣaḥ, na caivaṃ daṇḍītyādau | nanvatrāpi daṇḍasambandhīti bodhāt sambandhī vācyaḥ, sambandhaḥ śakyatāvacchedakaḥ, sambandhatvaṃ ca śakyatāvcachedakānāmupalakṣaṇam | evañcātrāpi ghaṭatvasthānīyaḥ sambandhaḥ eva vācyaḥ syāditi cet, na ; jātau śaktirhi anantyādidoṣabhiyā 'nāgṛhītaviseṣaṇa'nyāyena anvayaḥ svīkriyate, sambandhaśaktāvapi tasya tadavasthatvena na vyaktipakṣād viśeṣaḥ | na ca sambandhaśaktāvapi vyāpāraparatve ākhyātasāmānyalakṣaṇasyāsya bhāvākhyāte'vyāptyāpatteḥ, 'caitreṇa supyate ityādau hi dhātvarthasyaiva viśeṣyatāyāstvayāpyaṅgīkārāt |' api ca, kiṃ kṛtamiti praśne pakvamityuttaradarśanāt pakvavānityādeḥ pākaṃ kṛttavānityādivivaraṇadarśanād dhātvarthāt pṛthak taddarśanācca kṛtyapi bhāvanā vācyā syāt | tasyāñca bhavadrītyā prādhānyāpattiḥ, pratyayārthatvāt | yadi tatra kartṛ karmabhyāmākṣepalabhyā, tarhi tiṅkṣvapi tathaiva syāditi tayorvaiṣabhyāṃ durupapādam | na ca kṛdupastāpye liṅgasaṃkhyānvayadarśanāt kartā vācyaḥ, saṅkhyānvayāya tiṅyapi karturvācyatāpatteḥ, liṅgasaṅkhyānvayasya ghaṭamityādāvivākṣiptenāpyupapatteśca, kartrā hi kṛdantamahāsaṃjñākaraṇena kṛttiṅostulyatvabodhanācca | kiñca, kārakāṇāmākhyātārthabhāvanāyāmanvaye sthālyāmityādikārakāṇāmanvaye svavṛttitaṇḍulaniṣṭhaviklitijanakatvaṃ sambandhastvayā vācyaḥ, mama tu svavṛttivṛttitvaṃ sambandha iti lāghavam | evaṃ kāṣṭhāderyatnarūpabhāvanākaraṇatvaṃ na svarasata upapādayituṃ śakyam | dhātvarthajanakatayā tatkaraṇatvena tadvārā bhavanānvaye tu 'taddhetoḥ'1 [fn 'taddhetorova tattve kiṃ tena' iti nyāyākāraḥ, lāghavamūlakaścāyam | tasya = hetu - bhūtasya, hetuḥ, taddhavetuścāsau nyāyaśca taddhetunyāyaḥ | kasmiṃścit kārye klṛptahetunaiva siddhe punastaddhetorhatukalpanaṃ niṣphalamiti niṣkṛṣṭo'rthaḥ | yathā samāptiṃ prati lāghavād vidhnadhvaṃsasyaiva hetutve klapyamāne vidhnardhvasajanakamaṅgalasya hetutvakalpane goravam | ] iti sambandhatavenopalakṣaṇībhūtenānugamānnānantyādidoṣaḥ, paramparayā tadupalakṣaṇīkṛtya sambandhinyeva śaktergrahītumucitatvāt | na caivaṃ sambandhatva eva śaktirastu, tadādijanyabodhe buddhisthatvāderiva daṇḍītyādijanyabodhe tadabhānāt | nīlādibhyaśca nīlatvenaiva nīlarapavataḥ pratīteranubhasiddhatvāt | teṣāṃ guṇagatajātāveva śaktiriti matopapattiḥ | evañca yajjanyabodhe yasya niyamena prakāratayā bhānam anugatvañca, tatraivākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyapravṛttiḥ, tatraiva tādakṣipte sāmānādhikaraṇyanirvāhaḥ, nānyatreti bodhyam | 'śaktiḥ kārakam' iti pakṣe'smākaṃ tu na doṣaḥ, kartṛkarmādibodhe'khaṇḍopādhirūpakartṛtvāderniyamataḥ prakāratayā bhānena tatraiva śaktisiddhau tadākṣiptena sāmānādhikaraṇyopapatteḥ, śaktiśaktimatorabhedād vā tadupapattiḥ karmapadena hi śaktimadabhedamāpannaiva śaktirucyata iti "sārvadhātuke yak" [ 3|1|67 ] ityatra kaiyaṭe spaṣṭam | tasmāt pūrvoktayuktibhirbhāvanā'pi dhātuvācyaiva | 'pratyayārthaḥ pradhānam' ityutsargasyāpi bhāṣyakāradyanubhavabalena tyāgaḥ | kiñcaivam " kriyāpradhānamākhyātam " iti nirūktādivirodhaḥ, tatratyakriyāśabdasya pratyayārthanyāyena dhātvarthe'nvaya evocitaḥ | kḷñca, "kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti" [ 2|3|65 ], "karaṇe yajaḥ" [ 3|2|85 ] "kartṛ karaṇe kṛtā" [ 2|3|32 ] ityādīnāmasaṅgatyāpattirityalam | nanu karttṛrākhyātārthatve darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇapaṭhita1 [fn tatra hi kimayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ puruṣārthaḥ, āhosvit kratvartha iti saṃśaye, vadedityākhyātāt kartṛ pratītyā kartṛ vācakatvanirṇayaḥ | "laḥ karmaṇi" ityanuśāsanāt tasya kartṛ pratītyā kartṛ vācakatvanirṇayaḥ | "laḥ karmaṇi" ityanuśāsanāt tasya kartṛ paratvalābhācca | pratyayārthatvena vadanaṃ prati prādhānyād vadanaṃ tāvat puruṣārthaḥ, ataḥ pratiṣedho'pi puruṣārthaḥ | niṣedhapratiyogitvena vadanakriyāmanuvadatā vadediti śabdena puruṣārthatayaiva bodhanāt tādṛśasyaivā'nṛtavadanasyāniṣṭasādhanatāyā viparītasvabhāvabodhakanañā bodhanādanyādṛśā'nutavadanasya cā'nupastathitatvāt | ata evānārabhyā'dhītasmārttavadananiṣedhasyāpyetadeva mūlaṃ bhavatītilāghavam | anyathā tanmūlabhūtaḥ puruṣārtho'nyoḥ = niṣedhaḥ kalapya iti goravaṃ prasajyeteti pūrvapakṣe 'ananyalabhya eva śabdārthaḥ' iti nyāyād bhāvanaivākhyātavācyā, karttā tvākhyātavācyabhāvanāyā avinābhāvādākṣepalabhya eveti na tatra tasya śaktiḥ | "laḥ karmaṇi" ityādismṛtiripi 'dvayekayoḥ' ityanenaikavākyatayā tatsaṅkhyātavācitcaparaiva | 'pacati devadattaḥ' ityādau ca 'gauḥ śuklaḥ' itivat sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ lakṣaṇayaiveti nākhyātasya karttṛ vācitvamiti karttuḥ śruteranupasthitatvānna puruṣārthatā tasya, kintu prakaraṇāt kratvarthataiveti nirṇītaṃ kartradhikaraṇe | ] nānṛtaṃ vadet ' iti niṣedhasya kratvarthatvaṃ na sidhyet, śrṛtyā puruṣārthatvaprasaṅgāt | prakaraṇāddhikratvarthatvam, tasya ca śrutyapekṣayā durbalatvaṃ spaṣṭameveti cet, na; kartṛ vācyatve uktasiddhāntaḥ, uktasiddhānte ca tadanurodhena tasyā vācyatvamiti parasparāśrayagrastatvāt | kiñca, karttṛrākhyātārthatve'pi śrutiprakaraṇābhyāmasyāstu kratuyuktapuruṣadharmatā | anyathā jañjabhyamānavākyasya vākyaprakaraṇābhyāṃ puruṣasaṃskāramukhena kratvarthatvasiddhāntastvadīya ucchidyeta | taduktaṃ bhaṭṭaiḥ stryupāyamāṃsabhakṣādiḥ puruṣārthamapi śrutaḥ | pratiṣedhaḥ kratoraṅgamiṣṭaḥ prakaraṇāśrayāt || iti | kiñca, kartturvācyatve'pi kriyāyā eva prādhānyāt kartturguṇabhūtatvāccānṛtavadanabhāvanāyā na puruṣārthatvam | evañca bhāvanāyāḥ kaimarthyākāṅkṣāyāṃ prakaraṇād bhavatāmiva śuddhakratvarthatvamapi vaktuṃ śakyam | kṛtpratyayasthale tu karturviśeṣyatvāt tatsaṃskāramukhenaiva kratvarthatvamiti | kiñca, bhāvanāyā vācyatvam,kartturākṣaya iti tava mate'pi prakaraṇopasthāpyārthāpekṣayā śrutyupasthitabhāvanākṣiptakarttuḥ prathamopasthityā kratvarthatvaṃ na sidhyet tatsiddham ; āśrayaḥ, āśrayatvaṃ vā kartṛkarmatiṅśakyam iti | spaṣṭañcedam "gatyarthaloṭā" [ 8|1|51 ] iti sūtre bhāṣye | tatra dhātvarthaphalaṃ tadarthavyāpāre prāyo viseṣaṇam, ākhyātārthaḥ kārakaṃ dhātvarthaṃ prati viśeṣaṇam, kālaśca, saṅkhyā tvākhyātārthānvayino | tatrāśrayasya kva phale'nvayaḥ, kva vyāpāra iti cet, atra vadanti -- taṅyak‌ciṇādayaḥ phale āśrayānvayadyotakāḥ, śap‌śnamādayo vyāpāre | vastutaḥ prakaraṇādyeva dyotakam, kartṛkarmaviṣaye vaiparītyadarśanāt | na ca tiṅāṃ śabādīnāñcānuśāsanabalāt kartṛvācakatve tasya vāradvayaṃ bodhapattiḥ, śabādīnāṃ dyotaktavasvīkārāt | syādetat -- āśrayasyava prādhānyamucitam, kālātiriktākhyātārthaprakārakabodhe prathamāntapadajanyopasthiterhetutvāditi cet, na ; ākhyārthaprakārakabodhe dhātujanyopasthitereva lāghavena hetutvāt | saṅkhyānvayastu samānābhidānaśratyākhyātārthāśraya eva | kāryakāraṇabhāvāntaraṃ tu tvayāpi kālānvayāya kalpyamānena tulyam | kintu tvaduktakāryakāraṇabhāvadvayamapi bhinnapadaghaṭitatvād guru, mama tvekaghaṭitatvāllaghu | kiñca, 'karoti,jānāti' ityādau kālānvayo'pi dhātvartha eveti so'pi tavāvaśyaka ityati goravam | kiñca, tvaduktakāryakāraṇabhāvasya 'na pacati caitraḥ' ityādau nañarthe ākhyātārthānvayena vyabhicāraḥ, tatraiva caitre saṅkhyānvayena bhāvanānvayinyeva saṅkhyānvaya iti niyamasyāpi vyabicāraśca | na ca nipātasamabhivyavahārasthale saṅkhyābhāvanayoḥ pṛthageva kāryakāraṇabhāvo vācya iti vācyam, anekakāryakāraṇabhāvakalpanayā gauravāpatteḥ | kiñca, 'caitreṇa supyate' ityādau bhāvākhyāte'pi prathamāntapadādhyāhārāpattiḥ, bhāvārthakabhinnatvaviśeṣaṇadāne ca sutarāṃ gauravam | kiñca, 'bhāvapradhānamākhyātam' iti yāskavirodhaḥ, tatsamānārthakakriyāpradhānamiti bhāṣyapaṭhitavacanavirodhaśca | tiṅarthāpekṣayā dhātvarthaḥ, pradhānamiti tadarthaḥ | na ca dhātvarthāpekṣayā prādhānyamastayeva, bhāvaśabdenāpi bhāvayatīti vyutpattyā kṛtirevācyata iti vācyam, bhāvārthakalakāre'vyāpteḥ | kiñca, tava paśya mṛgo dhāvatīti vākyaṃ na syāt, mama tu dhāvanakriyāyādṛśi karmatvānna doṣaḥ | na ca tasyā darśanaviśeṣaṇatve kriyāyāḥ prādhānyamiti tvat siddhāntavirodhaḥ, pratyāsattyā''khyātaghaṭakapratyārthāpekṣayā kriyāyāḥ pradhānanyabodhanādakṣateḥ, 'sattvapradhānāni nāmāni' iti vākyaśeṣeṇa sattvavācakavācyārthaviśeṣaṇatvābhāvasyaiva 'kriyāpradhānam', ityanena bodhānācca | atra śabdajanyopasthitereva śābdabodhakāraṇatve karmatvaṃ saṃsarga eva | tava tvīdṛśe viṣaye bhāṣyādisiddhaikavākyatā bhajyeta | na ca mṛgasyaiva darśane karmatvenānvayaḥ, vibhaktyarthamadvārīkṛtya nāmārthadhātvarthayoḥ sākṣāt bhedenānvayāyogād | na ca tato dvitīyāstu, evamapi prāguktavākyāsiddhireva | kiñca, prathamāntapadajanyopasthityabhāvena dhāvatītyasya mṛgaviśaṣaṇatvānāpattiḥ | kiñca, aprathamāsāmānādhikaraṇye tiṅo bādhitvā śatrādyāpattiḥ | na ca vāsarūpanyāyena tiṅo'pi, lādeśeṣu tadabhāvasya śabdenduśekhare pratipāditvāt | na ca vācanikī prathamaivātra karmatvārtheti vācyam, tādṛśavācanānupalambhāt | na ca yo dhāvati mṛgaḥ, taṃ paśya, ityadhyahāreṇānvayaḥ, vākyabhedāpatteḥ, utkaṭadhāvanakriyāyā eva darśanakarmatvasya pratipādayiṣitatvācca | na ca viśiṣṭasya vākyārthasva karmatāsaṃsargeṇa darśane'nvayaḥ | evaca na vyutpattivirodhaḥ, vyutpatternāmārthaviṣayatvāt | viśiṣṭavācakasyāpratipadikatvācca na dvitīyāpattiriti vācyam, viśiṣṭasya tvanmate'pyanatiriktātvāt | ata eva nīlaviśiṣṭaghaṭasya darśanakarmatve pratipipādayiṣite'pi 'nolaṃ ghaṭaṃ jānāmi' ityādau dvitīyāsiddhiḥ | kiñca, devadattakartṛkapacikriyākarmakotpattyanukūlayatnastvadvṛttirityarthakadevadattaḥ pacati karoṣītyasyānāpatatiḥ | ākhyātopāttakriyāyāḥ sarvanāmaparāmarśāyogyatvenādhyāhārādinā'pina nirvāhaḥ | api ca, pākakriyā bhavatītyarthe pacati bhavatītyāsyānāpattiḥ, pacati vajratītyasyāpatiśca | na ca tathā tathā vyutpannānāṃ tathā bodhasya tathā tathā śaktigrahasya sasattvena kathamāpattaya iti vācyam, bodhasya vyutpattyanusāriṇo jāyamānatve'pi tādṛśerthe sādhutvasyāpādyatvāt, sādhutvasyārthaghaṭitatvāt | tacca tadarthanirūpaṇābhiyuktavaiyākaraṇāsammatārtha eva, nānyatretyetāvadihocyate | na caivamedhāmityasya kriyāpradhānatvānāpattistiṅantatvābhāvāditi vācyam, liṭo vācakatvādāptasvārthikatvena cānyasya pradhānatvaṃ yogyasyābhāvena, arthāt tasyā eva prādhānyāt, 1 [fn ākhyātapadena kvacid dhātorgrahaṇam | ata eva 'nāmākhyātopasarganipātāḥ' ityatra bhāṣye prakṛtitvenollekhaḥ | ata eva ca 'nāmānyākhyātajāni' iti śākaṭāyanaḥ | "ākhyātamākhyātena kriyāsātatye" ityatra tvetanmate ākhyātaprakṛtikatiṅante lakṣaṇā | 'bhāvapradhānamākhyātam' ityatrāpi tvetanmate ākhyātaprakṛtikatiṅante lakṣaṇā | 'bhāvapradhānamākhyātam' ityatrāpi ākhyātapadena dhāturgrāhyaḥ | śabdaratnakārastu -- ākhyātapadena tiṅantasya grahaṇamabhipraiti | niruktaprāmāṇyāt śabdaśāstre kvacit tiṅantasya grahaṇam, kvacicca dhātorgrahaṇamākhyātapadena | ata ākhyātapadena tiṅo grahaṇamiti tārkikoktamanādaraṇīyameva | ] ākhyātapadena kṛdādeśarahitalāntagrahaṇe tu doṣaśaṅkaiva na, sattvavācakapratyayāntatvābhāvena 'sattvapradhānāni ' ityasyāpravṛtteśca | kiñca, 'nānṛtaṃ vadet' ityanārabhyādhīte vacane darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇasthe ca vinigamanāvirahācchabdānṛtamarthānṛtaṃ cetyubhayamapi niṣidhyata ityanyatra nirṇītam | tathā ca sādhutvanirṇāyakasūtravārttikabhāṣyakāraistiṅāṃ karttaryeva sādhutvakathanāt tadullaṅghanena yājñe karmaṇi bhāvanārūpe'rthe prayuñjānā mīmāṃsakādayaścaturthīmiva ṣaṣṭhacyādyarthe kathaṃ na pratyavayantu, kathaṃ vā yajño nāviguṇa iti vicāryam | na ca nirmūlametadanuśāsanam, tasmāt 'brahmaṇena niṣkāraṇo dharmaḥ ṣaḍaṅgo vedo'dhyeyo jñeyaśca' iti śrutermūlatvāt | pāṇinīyaṃ mahāśāstraṃ padasādhutvalakṣaṇam | sarvopakārakaṃ grāhyaṃ kṛtsnaṃ tyājyaṃ na kḷñcana || iti parāśarīyapurāṇācca | jaiminiprabhṛtīnāṃ tvatra tātparyābhāvad na taduktiḥ sādhutvanirṇāyikā | taduktam 'sādhutvajñānaviṣayā saiṣā vyākaraṇasmṛtiḥ' iti vyākaraṇasyāpi śaktigrāhakatvaṃ vṛddhairuktam "śaktigrahaṃ vayākaraṇopamāna" ityādinā | na caiteṣāmasādhutve tatastattadarthabodhasteṣāṃ teṣāṃ na syāditi vācyam, vastuto'sādhutve'pi bhramātmakatajjñānasambhavāt, sādhutvajñānasya kāraṇatvābhāvādasādhutvaniścayasya bodhapratibandhakatvābhāvācceti dik | kiñca, prathamāntaviśeṣyakabodhe kodṛśastaṇḍula iti praśne, kīdṛśaścaitra iti praśne, kīdṛśaścaitra iti praśne ca, pakvastaṇḍulaḥ, pācakaścaitra ityuttaravat pacyate pacatītyuttarasyāpyāpattiḥ | na ca 'paśya mṛgo dhāvati, pacati, bhavati' ityādau kriyāyāḥ kartṛtvakarmatvādinānvaye tasya asattvarūpatā na syāditi vācyam, kartṛ karmetarakārakatevenānvayitāmātreṇa tathātvāt, kriyānādhārakārakatvenānvayād vā, karmatvāderaprakāratvāṅgīkārād vā tattvam | na caivamapyasiddhasya daśanakartvāsambhavāt kathaṃ dhāvanasya darśanakarmateti vācyam, samūhasyāsiddhatve'vi avayavaśaḥ siddhatvena pratyakṣakarmatvopapatteḥ | nanvevamapi roditīva paṭhatītyādau kriyayorupamānopameyabhāvasattavāt sādhāraṇadharmādhāratvarūpasya sattvasya "tena tulyam" [ 5|1|195] iti sūtrakaiyaṭādyuktasya sattvenāsattvarūpatābhaṅgaḥ | na ca pratyayottaramivaśabdaśravaṇena dhātvarthayorupamā durlabhati vācyam, tiṅantottaramivaśabdaśravaṇena tadarthayostasayāḥ sulabhatvāt | na cātra kartrorevopamānopameyabhāvo'stu, tasya kriyāṃ prati viśeṣaṇatvena tattvāsambhavāditi cet, na ; tiṅatasabhabhivyāhṛtevaśabdasya sādaśyārthaktavābhāvāt | taduktaṃ bhāṣye "na vai tiṅantenopamāmastīti, kintu tatratya bhāvanārtha iva śabdaḥ" iti kaiyaṭaḥ | ata evālaṅkārikā api 'limpatova tamoṅgāni' ityādāvutprakṣāmevodājahruḥ | sarvanāmaparāmarśayogyatvarūpamevāsattvaṃ kriyāyā ityanye | nanu vaiyākaraṇamate'pi "pacati kalpaṃ devadattaḥ" ityatrānvayo durupapādaḥ, ākhyātāsya dharmivācakatve'pi kalpāntena kriyāviśeṣyakabodhajananenābedasya bādhāt | bhedenānvayastu nāmārthayoravyutpanna iti cet, na ; yato nāsmākaṃ bhāvanāyā devadatte'nvayaḥ, tasyā ākhyāte viśeṣyatvāt | nāpi devadattasya tasmāt, kārakavibhaktyantatvābhāvena tadanvaye mānābhāvāt, ākhyātārthāśrayānvayena tadaṃśe bhāvanāyā nirākāṅakṣatvācca | kintvākhyātārthāśraye'bhedena tasya viśeṣyakāṅakṣāyāḥ sattvena tadan‌vayasyaivocitatvād nāmārthayorityasyāsvanāmajanyapratītiviśeṣyayorabhedenaivānvaya ityarthaḥ, na tu tayorevābhedānvaya iti na doṣaḥ | nanvevamapi tvadrītyā pacati bhavatītyādau samānavākye tiṅdvayalābhena tadvyāvṛttyarthaṃ "tiṅṅatiṅa" [ 8|1|28 ] iti sūtre atiṅagrahamasyāvaśyakatvena tatpratyākhyānaparabhāṣyavirodha iti cet, na ; laukikaikavākyatvasatatve'pi 'ekatiṅvākyam' iti svaparibhāṣitasyāsattvāditi bhāṣyāśayāt | laukikaikavākyatvañca1 [fn 'tiṅsubantacayo vākyam' iti mudritāmarakośapustakasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ | ] 'suptiṅantacayo vākyaṃ kriyā vā kārakānvitā' itiyamareṇoktam | atra 'vā' śabdaḥ samuccaye | evañca?B, kārakānvitakriyābadhakasuptiṅantacaya ityarthaḥ | sup ca tiṅ ca suptiṅ, subbiśiṣṭaṃ tiṅ suptiṅ, tayorekaśeṣe'ntacayānāṃ trayāṇāmapi lābhaḥ | kriyā vetyanena nirarthakapadasamudāyavyāvṛttiḥ | yattu 'vā' śabdasvārasyādarthasyāpi vākyatvamiti| tat, na ; arthe vākyaśabdāprayogāt, "vaco'śabdasaṃjñāyām" [ 7|3|67 ] iti niṣedhena kutvānāpatteśceti dik | tatsiddhamākhyātārthāśrayāpekṣayā dhātvarthaḥ pradhānamiti | evañca devadattaḥ pacatītyatraikadevadattakartṛ kapākānukūlakriyeti bodhaḥ | taṇḍulaḥ pacyate caitreṇeti karmalakāre tvekacaitrāśrayikā ekataṇḍulābhinnāśrayikā yā viklittiḥ, tadanukūlā varttamānā bhāvaneti bhāvanāviśeṣyaka eva bodha iti prāñcaḥ | navyāstu 'pakvastan‍ḍulaḥ' ityādau karmakṛtsabhabhivyāhāre phalavyāpārayorvyatyāsena bodhasyāvaśyakatayā karmākhyāte'pi phalaviśeṣyakaeva bodhaḥ | ata eva pratyāyārthe sākṣātsambandhena prakṛtyarthaviśeṣyānvayitvasya sarvatra klṛptasya na tyāgaḥ | anvayitvaṃ viśeṣyatayā viśeṣaṇatayā vā | ata eva kartṛ lakāre na phalaviśeṣyako bodhaḥ, klṛptaprāguktaniyabhaṅgāpatteḥ | ata eva 'iṣyate putraḥ' ityarthe patrīyatati na prayogaḥ, bhinnārthatvāt | kintu 'putramicchata' ityatrārtha eva | kyajantāt karmaṇi pratyayastu durlabhaḥ, akarmakatvāditi spaṣṭam "sup ātmanaḥ" [ 3|1|8 ] ityatra 1 [fn atra hi ---'iṣṭaḥ putraḥ, iṣyate putraḥ' ityatra yadi kyac bhavati, tadecchāmātrasya kvacā'bhidhānādavaśyaṃ karmaṇo'bhidhānāya tadvācinā pratyayenotpattavyam | yathā putrīyatīti kartrabhidhānāya tipetyāśayikā icchākyajantāt karmaṇi pratyayotpattiḥ kathanneti śaṅkā 'atheha kyacā bhavitavyam -- iṣṭaḥ putraḥ, iṣyate putraḥ' ityādiśabdena kṛtā | yadā kriyāphalasya karṇaḥ prādhānyaṃ pratipipādayiṣitam, tadā vākyameva prayujyate -- 'iṣṭaḥ putraḥ' ityādi, na tu kyajantaḥ, tasyākarmakatvāt karmaṇi pratyayānutpādādityāśayena samādhānamāha -- 'kecit tāvadāhuḥ -- na bhavitavyamityādi | punaścāgre -- 'samānārthena vākyena bhavitavyam, pratyayāntena ca | yaścehārtho vākyena gamyate' iti | vivaraṇavivriyamāṇayoḥ samānārthakatvamiti tattātparyam | '] bhāṣye | kālasya tu vyutpattivaicitryāt sampūrṇadhātvartha evānvayaḥ | tena vyāpārāpagame viklittisattve 'pacyate' iti syāt, 'apāci' iti na syāt | evaṃ phūtkārādidaśāyāṃ viklittyanārambhe 'pacyate' iti na syādityapāstam | tatrābhimataphalajanane sati tanniṣpādakasakalavyāpārāpagame bhūtatvaṃ phalāvacchinnatādṛśasakalavyāpārasya bhāvitve bhaviṣyatvaṃ yāvaccābhimataphalaprayojakakriyāyāḥ samāptirna bhavati, tāvad vartamānatvamityādyanupadameva vakṣyāma iti prāhuḥ | bhāvalakāre tu vyāpāra eva viśeṣyaḥ ktāntādau sāmānādhikaraṇyasambandhena vyāpārayoreva parasparamanvayadarśanenautsargikasya vyāpāraniṣṭhaphalaviśeṣyatvasya tyāge mānābhāvāt tiṅkṣu dhātvarthānuvādaka eva kāladyotakatvaṃ tvastyeva, saṅkhyā tu tatra nāstyeva, saṅkhyānvayikartṛ karmaṇo'pratīteḥ, dhātvarthastu saṅkhyānvayāyogya eva, dhātvarthabahutve 'maitreṇa sthīyate, supyate' ityānāpatteśca | evañca saṅkhyāyā abhāve utsaragta ekavacanameva | madhyamīttāmavapina staḥ, tiṅsamānādhikaraṇayuṣmadādyabhāvāt | 'uṣṭrāsikā āsyante, hataśāyikāḥ śapyante' ityatra "sārvadhātuke yak" [ 3|1|67 ] iti sūtrasthabhāṣyaprayogadeva bahuvacanaṃ sādhviti vadanti | 'ākāśo'sti' ityādau caikākāśābhinnāśrayakaḥ svarūpadhāraṇānukūlo vartamāno vyāpāra ityādikrameṇo hyamiti dik | athākhyātārthavarttamānatvādīnāmanvayaprakārastallakṣaṇāni cocyante tatra vartamānatvādīnāṃ dhātvarthe'nvayaḥ, na kartṛ karmaṇoḥ, atītakriye karttari pacatītyāpatteḥ, apākṣīdityanāpatteśca, varttamānakriyāvācakāddhātorlaḍityādyarthaka - "varttamāne laṭ" [ 3|2|123 ] ityādibhiḥ sūtrairdhātvarthe'nvayasyaiva bodhanācca | sa ca sampūrṇadhātvarthavyāpāre ityuktameva | na cāmavātajaḍīkṛtakalevare bodhanācca | sa ca sampūrṇadhātvarthavyāpāre ityuktameva | na cāmavātajaḍīkṛtakalevare utthānānukūlayatnasya vidyamānatayottiṣṭhatīti prayogāpattiḥ, tasyotthānoddeśyakatve'pi utthānaprayojakatvābhavāt | ata eva tatra 'utthānāya yatate, nottiṣṭhati' ityeva prayogaḥ | yāgapākādyuddeśyakakuṇḍamaṇḍalakrayaṇādiyatnavyāpārāvādāya yāgādyartham 'yatate' ityādivat 'yajati, pacati' ityādivāraṇāya prayojakatāviśeṣasyaiva sambandhasyābhyupeyatvāt | evam 'gacchati' ityādivāraṇāya prayojakatāviśeṣasyaiva sambandhasyābhyupeyatvāt | evam 'gacchati' ityādivāraṇāya prayojakatāviśeṣasyaiva sambandhasyābhyupeyatvāt | evam 'gacchati' ityādāvuttaradeśasaṃyogādyanukūlakriyārūpe dhātvarthe tadanvayaḥ | taśyatītyatrāpi pratiyogisahitanāśasāmagrīrūpadhātvarthe tadanvayaḥ | atastasyāṃ satyāṃ naśyati, atītāyām 'naṣṭaḥ' ityādyupapadyate | kecittu -- ṣaḍbhāvavikāreṣu nāśasyāpi gaṇitatvādutpattivat so'pi caramakṣaṇasambandha eva tatsattve naśyatīti tadatyaye naṣṭa ityāhuḥ | 'naśyati, naṅkṣyati, naṣṭaḥ' ityatra krameṇa pratyayena varttamānā, bhaviṣyantī, atītā cotpattiḥ, pratiyogitvaṃ ca lakṣyate | tathā ca tādṛśotpattimananāśapratiyogītyādikrameṇa bodhaḥ | ata eva nāśasya nityatvāt sarvadā naśyatīti, śvo naṅkṣyati paṭādau paraśvo naṅkṣyati, prapūrvadinanaṣṭe pūrvedyurnaṣṭa ityāpattirneti naiyāyikanavyāḥ | nāśatvamutpattimadabhāvatvam | tathā ca dhātupratipādyatāvacchedakotpattāveva kālānvaya iti tannavyatarāḥ | kālaśya kriyārūpa eva, nātiriktaḥ,; mānābhāvād, gauravācceti tantrāntare sphuṭam | na ca 'kriyābhedāya kālastu saṅkhyā sarvasya bhedikā' iti vākyapadīyavirodhaḥ | nahi svaparicchedakatvaṃ svasyaivopapadyata iti vācyam, tatra kālaśabdena tadgatavartamānatvādereva vivakṣaṇāt | 'kālo'tiriktaḥ' iti mate vā tat | anyadīyakriyayā'nyadīyakriyāparicchedasambandha ityapi kecit | evañca tasya dhātunoktatvāt tadgataṃ vartamānatvādi laḍādidyotyam, dyotakatvañca śaktyādhāyakatvam | tacca nānārtheṣu śaktasya svasaṃnidhānena śaktiparicchedakatvam | nanu ca vācya evāstu, anekadhātūnāṃ tatra śaktikalpane gauravāpatteḥ, ekasya laṭa eva śaktikalpanaucityācca | kiñca, 'varttamāne laṭ' [ 3|2|123 ] iti viśiṣya vidhāne'pi tatrāśaktau karttā'pi vācyo na syāt, syācca dyotya eva, aviśeṣāt | kiñca, vartamānatvaviśiṣṭakriyābodhaṃ prati laṭsamabhivyāhārasya kāraṇatvaṃ vācyam | tathā ca tulyatvāllaṭo vācakatvamevocyatām | na ca vācyatve viśeṣeṇa sāmānyasya1 [fn atredaṃ bodhyam -- takranyāyena bādhyabādhaktavena sammataśāstrajanyabodhīyaviṣayatayoryatra vyāpyavyāpakabhāvastatra bādhakaśāstrīyavyāpyaviṣayatāśrayātiriktatvena bādhyaśāstrīyaviṣayatāśraye saṅkocaḥ | evañca -- ekakāryaviniyogoddeśyena pravṛttivākyakadambaghaṭakavyāpakadharmāvacchinne tādṛśavākyakadambaghaṭakavyāpyadharmāvacchinnātiriktatvena saṅkoca iti nyāyasvarūpam | atra kauṇḍinyātvarūpavyāpyadharmāvacchinnātiriktatvena brāhmaṇatvarūpavyāpakadharmāvacchinne saṃkocaḥ | evaca takradānataḥ pūrṇaṃ paraṃ vā kauṇḍinyoddeśakaṃ na dadhidānamiti dik | ] takrakauṇḍinyanyāyād vādhe kartṛrvācyataiva na syāditi vācyam, 'saḥ karmaṇi' [ 3|4|69 ] ityasya niravakāśatvāditi cet, na ;"māṅi luṅ" [ 3|3|175] "laṭ sme" [ 3|2|118 ] ityādau cāritārthyāt, ekadhātuprakṛtikānekalaḍādeśānāṃ tatra śaktikalpane gauravācca | tasmād dyotakatvameva | tatra varttamānatvaṃ prārabdhaparisamāptatvam, bhūtabhaviṣyadbhinnatm ; vā | bhūtatvaṃ 'vidyamānadhvaṃsapratiyogitvam' bhaviṣyatvañca 'vartamānaprāgabhāvapratiyogisamayotpattikatvam | prāgabhāvānaṅgīkāre tu śabdaprayogādhikaraṇakāladhvaṃsādhikaraṇasamayotpattikatvaṃ tat | tasya ca vyāpārasamudāyarūpakriyāyāmanvayaḥ | avayavavyāpāreṣvevānvaya iti tu na yuktam, tathā satyavayavānāṃ trikṣaṇāvasthāyitvena tatra tasyāsambhavena pacatīti prayogasya viṣayalābha eva na syāt | 'pañcakṛtvaḥ pacati' ityatrāpyatiśayatṛptyādiphalenaikīkṛtāvṛttigaṇitapākasamudāye varttamānatvādīnāmanvayaḥ |' kvacittu 'prakṛtaḥ kaṭaṃ devadattaḥ' ityādāvavayave samudāyarūpāropeṇa, avayavagatātītatvasyaiva samudāye āropeṇa vā bhūtakālaprayoga iti spaṣṭam "niṣṭhā" [ 3|2|102 ] iti sūtre bhāṣye | na cātmāsti, parvatāstiṣṭhanti, sthāsyanti, asthuḥ ; ityādivyavahārānupapattiḥ, kriyāyā ārabdhatvābhāvena prāguktavarttamānatvābhāvād bhūtatvabhaviṣyatvayorabhāvāt ; ceti vācyam, tattatkālikānāṃ rājñāṃ kriyā ādāya tadviśiṣṭātmasattāderuktavarttamānatvādisambhavāt | evam 'eko ha vai nārāyaṇa āsīt' ityādyupapadyate | spaṣṭañcedam "varttamāne laṭ" [ 3|2|123 ] ityatra bhāṣye | evaṃ bhūtādyatanaparokṣakriyārthakālliṭ | 'papācetyādivākyajabodhe bhūtatvasandehānudayād bhūtatvāderivānadyatanatvāderapi bodhaviṣayatvām | parokṣatvañca vaktṛsākṣātkāratajjanyāsaṃskārānyatarāviṣayatvam | nanvatra 'parokṣe' iti viśeṣaṇamasaṅgatam, sādhyatvenābhidhīyamānaḥ, guṇabhūtāvayavaḥ, kramikavyāpārāṇāmekaphalajanakatvarūpayaikabuddhyā viṣayīkṛtaḥ samūhaḥ kriyā | tatrā yadyapyavayavāḥ pratyakṣā eva, ata eva 'paśya mṛgo dhāvati' ityādau kriyāyā darśanakarmatā | tathāpyavayavānāṃ melanābhāvena samudāyasya sarvasyāpi parokṣatvenāvyāvartakatvāt | taduktaṃ bhāṣye -- kriyānāmiyamatyantāparidṛṣṭā, na śakyā piṇḍībhūtā nidarśayitum' iti sā [ sarvāpya ?] numānagamyeti cet, naḥ tadanukūlaśaktimatāṃ vyāpārāviṣṭānāṃ sādhanānāṃ pārokṣyasyeha vivakṣitatvāt | tena kriyānāviṣṭasādhanamātrapratyakṣe'pi liṭ, yathā -- papāceti | evaṃ svavyāpārasay varttamānasya vāyasaṅgādinā svayamapratisandhāne tattatkāryeṇānumitau sakhyādyuktyā vā jñāne bhavatyeva liṭ, yathā -- 'bahu jagadapurastāt tasya ma.tā kilāham' iti, 'vyātene kiraṇāvalīmudayanaḥ' ityapi "niṣṭhā" [ 3|2|102 ] iti sūtrabhāṣyoktarītyā bhūtvānadyatanatvaparotratvānāmāropeṇopapannam | āropaphalaṃ tu granthe'ti sukaratvaśīghraniṣpādyatvādipratyāpannamaiva | tatphalaṃ tu tatkālikādhyetṛṇāṃ svaśiṣyāṇāmarthapravivekādiphalakamamuṃ granthaṃ jñātumutsukānāmāhlādanameva | parokṣatvāropo'thaitatphalaka eva | evaṃ sūkṣmakālena kariṣyāmi yatnakaraṇakāle svenāpi sākṣātkartumaśakyamityevaṃ bodhanādanāyāsena granthakaramamapi vyaṅgyam | sūryopamāpyetatpoṣikaiva | itaragranthebhyo'smin granthe, tatkartṛbhyaśca svasmin vyatireko'pi vyaṅgyaḥ | bhaviṣyataḥ prayogakāle vāstavameva porakṣatvamiti na tadaṃśe āropāpekṣetyapi vadanti | kecitu kriyayāmeva pārokṣyam, na ca sarvāpi sā parokṣaivetyavyāvartakaṃ tat, avayavaśaḥ pratyakṣatvāt | na [ca] pratyekaṃ na kriyātvam, tāvatāpi dhātvarthatvakṣateḥ, kriyātvasyāvayavāvayavisādhāraṇatvācca | kiñca, dhātorityasya dhātvarthe lakṣaṇāyāṃ svavācyatvaṃ sambandhaḥ, sādhanalakṣaṇāyāṃ svavācyasādhanatvaṃ sambandha iti gauravam | avayavāśrayatvādeva ca devadattasya kartṛ tvādi saṅgacchata ityāhuḥ | anadyatanatvaṃ cātītarātreḥ paścārdhenāgāminyāḥ pūrvārdhena ca kālo'dyatanaḥ, tadbhinnatvam | evamanadyatane bhaviṣyati luṭ, bhaviṣyatsāmānye lṛṭ ; ityādi tattadanuśāsanavalād vyavahārācca bodhyam | atha vidhyādau vihitaliṅarthe kḷñciducyate tatra vidhiḥ = preraṇam, yathā nikṛṣṭasya bhṛtyādeḥ | nimantraṇam = niyogakaraṇam, āvaśyake śrāddhabhojanādau pravarttanam | āmantraṇam = kāmacārānujñā | aghīṣṭaḥ = satkārapūrvako vyāpāraḥ | taccatuṣṭayānusyūtapravartanāsāmānyaṃ vidhyarthaḥ | vidhyādisūtre caturṇāṃ pṛthagupādānaṃ spaṣṭārtham | pravartanātvaṃ śakyatāvacchedakam | tadatiriktāṃśasya pramāṇāntaralakṣyatvānna śakyatvam | na ca "preṣātisargaprāptakāleṣu kṛtyāśca" [ 3|3|163 ] iti sūtre praiṣādigrahaṇaṃ vyartham, nimantraṇādau kṛtyābhāvārthaṃ tasyāvaśyakatvāt | loḍvidhānaṃ prāptakālārtham pravartanā ca prakṛtyanukūlo vyāpāro vaktrabhiprāyaḥ | sa cecchāviśeṣarūpaḥ, icchāgatavaijātyasya śakyatāvacchedakatvena lāghavāt | ata eva prārthanasya pṛthag grahaṇ | tatra vaktricchāsattve'pi tasyāniyamenāpravartakatayā'tra vaijātyaniveśasyāvaśyakatvāt | icchā ca loke paruśaniṣṭhā, vede tvātīśvaraniṣṭhaiva, 'naiveśvara ajñāpayati, nāpidhmasūtrakārāḥ paṭhanti' iti bhāṣyāt | takṣa hīśvarājñā vedaḥ | pravartakatvaṃ ca svātāntrye sati tādṛśarthabodhakaliṅādyuccārayitṛtvādikameva | yattu, iṣṭasādhanatvameva savayāpāraḥ, iṣṭasādhanatājñānasya pravṛttisāmānye hetutvāvadhāraṇena tasyaiva vācyatvaucityāt | iṣṭaṃ ca kvacit sākṣātkartureva kvacit paramparā | ata e ca 'ācāryaprerito'haṃ gāmānayāmi' ityādāvācāryādeḥ pravartakatvavyavahāraḥ saṅgacchate | bhavatpreraṇayā'hamadhyāpayāmi, na kiñcinmameṣṭamiti vyavahārastu na me sākṣāt kiñcidiṣṭamityevamparaḥ | pravarttakatvañca pavṛttijanakeṣṭasādhanatvabodhaliṅādyuccārayitatvādikameva | na ca rājapreritapadātestādṛśaliṅādyuccārayitṛtvena pravartakatvāpattiḥ, na ceṣṭāpattiḥ, 'padātiprerito'haṃ nedaṃ kurve, kintu rājapreritaḥ' iti vyavāhārānāpatteḥ, iti vācyam,svātantrye satīti viśeṣaṇāt | piśunapreritarājñyapi svātantryamastyeva | balātkāreṇa gurvādipreritabālādyadhyāpane'pi tadabhāvaprayuktagurvādikrodhajanyatāḍanābhāva eveṣṭaḥ | yadyapi "svaritañi taḥ" [ 1|3|72 ] ityādau kriyāphalaśabdena pratyāsattyādhātvarthabhūtameva phalaṃ gṛhyate, tathāpīha tathāgrahaṇe na kiñcinmānam | ta ceṣṭasādhanatājñānaṃ na phravarttakam, aniṣṭasādhane udāsīne ca 'kaṣṭaṃ karma' iti nyāyena dveṣādapravṛtteriti vācyam,āntarālikaśrame dveṣābhāvadaśāyā tadajñānadaśāyāṃ vā pravṛttyāpatteḥ | na ca cikīrṣāyāṃ satyāmiṣṭāpattiriti vācyam, iṣṭasādhanatvajñānaṃ vinā tasyā evābhāvāt | evañceṣṭasādhanatvameva liṅaśakyam | tacca svargādisādhanatvenaiva, tena rūpeṇa jñānasyaiva pravarttakatvāt ; na tviṣṭatvena, tasya svarūpasata eva hetutvena tajjñānānapekṣaṇāt, bahuvittavyayāyāsasādhye āmuṣmike ca viśiṣya tajjñānaṃ vinā pravṛttyabhāvācca | tatra nānārthatvaparihārāya tadādāviva śakyatāvakchedakānāmanugamikeccheti bodhyam | yathā buddhiviṣayatvarūpeṇopastitaghaṭatvapaṭatvādiśāliṣu buddhiviṣayatāvacchedakavati tadādipadaṃ śaktamityeva tadādeḥ śaktigrahaḥ | buddhiviṣayatvamupasthitāvupalakṣaṇayānugamakamātram, na tu tadaṃśe śaktiḥ | evamihāpi liṅādiricchāviṣayatāvacchedakasvargatvādivatsādhanatvaśakta ityeva śaktigrahaḥ | na caivaṃ tāvatā tadādau buddhiḥ, iheccaā vā praviṣṭā | padārthopasthirapi tadādau prakaraṇādimahimnā buddhiviṣayatāvacchedakaghaṭatvādinovehāpi samabhivyāhṛtasvargapadamahimnā svargādisādhanamitye, na tu buddhīcchayoḥ śabdabodhe bhānam | evañca viśiṣyeṣṭavācchedakasvargatvādiprakāreṇa śābdabodhotpattyā vidhivākyāt pravartakajñānanirvāhaḥ | evañca icchāviṣayatāvacchedakatvopalakṣitasvargatvādiviśiṣṭasādhanatve vidheśaktiriti phalitam | na caitasyāpi svargakāmādipadāllābhena na tatra śaktiḥ, kāmāntapadāt svargādyupastitāvapi sādhanatvabodhakābhāvāt, viśvajidādau tatpadasamabhivyāhārasyāpyabhāvācca | sāmānyata iṣṭasādhanatvamātre jñāte'pi paścādviśeṣajijñāsāyāṃ tattatpadakalpaneti tvanyadetat | balavadaniṣṭānubandhitvajñānaṃ tu na pravartakam, vahvāyāsasādhye pravṛttyanāpatteḥ | tatra bahutaraduḥ khasyāpi jāyamānatvāt, alpaduḥkhasyāpi kutaścid balavattvenānugatabalavattvasya durvacatvācca | na caivaṃ madhuviṣasampṛktānnabhojanādau pravṛttyāpattiḥ, tattadviṣayakabalavadadveṣasya svātantryeṇa pratibandhakatvenādoṣāt | ata evāntarālikaśrame balavaddveṣavān jyotiṣṭomādau na pravartate, anyastu pravartata eva | etena kṛtisādhyatavajñānaṃ pravartakamitayapāstam | kṛtyasādhye candramaṇḍalādigrahaṇe pravṛttyabhāvaśca tata iṣṭābhāvena vṛthāśramajanakatayā dveṣāt | kḷñcāśaktasyāpi yatkiñcitkṛtisādhye pravṛttyāpattyā madaṃśaviśiṣṭaṃ pravartakaṃ vācyam | evañca vedena tathābodhayitumaśakyatvānna tacchakyam | yāgo matkṛtisādhyaḥ, matekṛtisādhyatvavirodhidharmānadhikaraṇatvāt ; ityādyanumānarūpalaukikapramāṇenāpi tadgrahasambhavenānvayalabhyatvācca | yāgo matkṛtisādhyo bhavatviti cikīrṣā tu lokatastadavagamenaiva siddhā | atheṣṭasādhanatvasya vidhyarthatve 'jyotiṣṭomena svargakāmo yajeta' ityādau tṛtīyā na syāt, karaṇānabhidhāna eva tadvidhānāt | na ca yajyarthagatasādhanatve'bhihite'pi tadviśaṣajyotiṣṭomādikārthagatasyānabhidhānena tṛtīyā siddhiḥ, jyotiṣṭhomayajyarthayorabhedāt | ata eva 'devadattaḥ pacati' ityādau devadattapadādapi na tṛtīyā | "anabhihite" ityasyānabhihitasaṅkhyāka ityartha iti vādibhirapi kṛtsādhāraṇyāya karamatatsaṅkhyānyatarābhidhāne ityartho'vaśyaṃ vācyaḥ; anyathā pacanīyasyālpetyasyāpyāpatteriti cet, na ; savyāpāranirvyāpārasādhāraṇasādhanatvābhidhāne'pi kāraṇatvaśakteḥ, tadāśrasya cānabhidhānenādoṣāt | nanvevamapi svargatvaviśiṣṭasādhanatvaṃ jyotiṣṭome bodhanīyam ; na ca tat sambhavati, svargatvādergaṅgāsnānavājapeyādijanyasvargādisādhāraṇyena jyotiṣṭomādajanyatānavacchedakatayā tatra svargatvādiviśiṣṭasādhanatvabādhāt , na hi janyatānavacchedakadharmo janakatvanirūpake viśaṣaṇaṃ vyabhicārācceti cet, na ; vijātīyatattatsādhanatvasyaiva vidhinā bodhād na doṣaḥ | vaijātyaṃ ca vidhestathāśaktisvīkārādupasthitam | etadarthameva vidhestattatsādhanatve śaktirityuktam | evañca kāryavacchedakadharmavattvarūpakāryatvasyāvacchedakāgrahe durgrahatvādeva vaijātyakalpanā, tadviśiṣṭe videḥ śaktiśceti bodhyam | yadvā, svargatvameva kāryatāvaccedakam ; atiprasaktasyāpyavacchedakatve doṣābhāvāt | nanu tathā sati svargatvāvacchinnasyāpi agnihotrājjyotiṣṭomarūpakāramabhāvenānutpattyāpattiḥ, tathāpyutpattau ca ghaṭādau rāsabhavad vyabhicārādagnihotrāderakāraṇatvaprasahghaḥ, evaṃ guṇādāvapi rūpādyāpattiriti nātiphrasaktamavaccedakamiticet, na ; agnihotrādijanyāpūrvaviśiṣṭasamavāyasambandhena svargatvasya tattadvidhāvavacchedakatvānna doṣaḥ | evaṃ tṛṇāderapi tṛmatvāvācchinnasaṃyogasambandhena vahnitvāvacchinnaṃ prati tṛmatvena hetuteti na tatrāpi vaijātyakalpanā | ata e 'vrīhibhiryajeta' ityādau parasparavyatirekeṇa pratyekaṃ phalajanakatvaṃ'pi na doṣaḥ, 'vrīhibhiryaṣṭavyaḥ' iti saṅkalpāpūrvācchinnasamayasambandhasyaiva vrīhikāryatāvacchedakatvenādoṣāt | saṅkalpāpūrve ca phalāpūrvotpattau naṣṭamiti prayogāntare yavādīnāmupādānaṃ nānupapannam | na caivaṃ rāsabhasyāpi ghaṭahetutvāpattiḥ, yavādeḥ śrutvā tṛṇāderaraṇimaṇyabhāvavati stome tṛmasattve tadabhāve'nutpattirityanvayavyatirekasahakṛtādyakṣāt tatsiddhāvapi rāsabhasya hetutve mānābhāvāt | kintvavaśyakalpyadaṇjādibhiranyathāsiddhireva | evaṃ guṇaādau rūpāpattirapi na; tattadrūpe tattaddravyasya samavāyikāraṇatāyā āvaśyakatvena viśeṣasāmargyabhāvādeva tadabhāvopapatteḥ | etena vidhilabhyārthavicārakālevaijātyāsvīkāre jyotiṣṭomāgnihotrayoḥ phalasāmyāpattau alpavittavyayāyāsasādhyāgnihotreṇaiva siddhau śramādyadhikyena dvaṣādapravṛttau jyotiṣṭomāśvameghādavidhīnāmananuṣṭhanālakṣaṇāprāmāṇyāpattiriti mīmāṃsakoktamapāstam | yasyaiva laukikapratiṣṭhādirūpaphalecchā, tasyaiva prṛvṛtteḥ sambhavācca | ata eva sakalaśāstravidāṃ yudhiṣṭhirādīnāṃ svalpaphalakarājyārthaṃ gotrajabrāhṇaādihananārthaṃ pravṛttiḥ | ata evādhunikānāṃ karmāsaṃgatvaṃ jānatāmapi bahuvitavyayāyāsasādhyeṣu agnihotrādyanuṣṭhāneṣu laukikapratiṣṭhārthaṃ pravṛttiḥ saṅgacchate | kiñca, 'sarvebhyaḥ kāmebhyo ha darśapūrṇamāsau' ityuktestasya nityatayā kāmyaprayogeṇaiva prasaṅgānnityakarmasiddhisambhavena prayaktilāghavalobhāt putreṣṭyādau pravṛttyanāpattau tavāpi putreṣṭyādīnāmānarthakyaṃ durvāram | na ca kṛtādhānasya putralolupasya darśapaurṇamāsāt prāgapi putreṣṭyādyanuṣṭhānasammatenānarthakyaparihāraḥ | evamapi māravadhūdarśapaurṇamāsānāṃ kāmyeṣṭipravṛttivilopo durvāraḥ syāt; na ca samānaphalānāmapi karmaṇāṃ śaktāśaktabhedena vyavasthā | ata eva -- sahasraśaktiśca śataṃ śataśaktirdaśāpi ca | dadyādayañca yaḥ śaktyā sarve tulyaphalāḥ smṛtāḥ || iti bhārataṃ saṅgacchata iti cet, tulye mamāpi | ata e 'vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kārayet' iti tattadvrataprakaraṇe paṭhyata ityalam | nanu 'na kalañjaṃ bhakṣayat' iti niṣedhavākyārthānupapattiḥ, kalañjabhakṣaṇādestṛptyādirūpeṣṭajanakatvena tadabhāvasya bodhayitumaśakyatvāditi cet, na ; īdṛśe viṣaye'niṣṭasādhanatvasya liṅarthatvāt tatraiva nañ tātparyagrāhaka ityadoṣaḥ | yadvā, ऩsamābhivyāhāre pratyavāyābhāvarūpeṣṭasādhanatvaṃ vidhyarthaḥ, tadabhāvaśca nañā bodhyate, sādhanatvañcāya tatsattve niyamataḥ pratyavāyābhāvaḥ, tadabhāve niyamataḥ pratyavāya ityanvayavyatirekavatvam | evañcārthāt tadbhakṣaṇādau pratyavāyaḥ sidhyatīti na doṣaḥ | 'jvarito na bhuñcīta' ityādau tu duḥkhavṛddhyabhāvarupeṣṭasādhanatvaṃ vidhyartha ityādyūhyam | na ca nityanaimittikayoḥ phalābhāvena tatreṣṭasādhanatvamartha iti vaktumaśakyam, pratyavāyaparohārūpaphalasya tatrāpi sattvāt | tādṛśaphale ṣṭasādhanatvajñānādeva ca tatra pravṛttiḥ | vidhibalena tadakaraṇe prāptasya pratyavāyasya tatkaraṇe parihārāvaśyambhāvāt | na ca vedabodhitatvānniṣphala eva pravattiriti kalpyam, vedasahasrairapi bodhite niṣphalatvajñānadaśāyāmapravṛtteḥ | na ca -- 'aphalākāṅkṣibhiyaṃjño vidhidṛṣṭo ya icyate | yaṣṭavyameveti manaḥ samādhāya sa sāttvikaḥ || (bhagavadgītā 17|11 ) iti bhagavadvacanavirodhaḥ, jño dānaṃ tapaḥ1[fn tapaścaiva iti bhagavadgītāpāṭhaḥ | ] karma pāvanāni manīṣiṇām | etānyapi tu karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tvaktvā phalāni ca || karttavyānīti me pārtha niścitaṃ matamuttamam | (bha. gī. 18|5,6 ) iṣyaṣṭādaśe bhagavataiva pāvanatvokteḥ | tasmādanuddiṣṭo'pi pratyavāyaparihāraḥ phalamiti phalaṃ tyaktvāpi kriyamāṇas pāvanatvamiti tadāśayaḥ | sandhayāmupāsate ye tu satataṃ saṃśitavratāḥ || vidhūtapāpāste yānti brahmalokaṃ sanātanam || iti kvacinnitye'pi phalaśravaṇācca | nanvidaṃ stāvakastutiśca prarocanārthā, prarocanā ca puruṣapravṛttyartheti cet, na; 'sarvebhyaḥ kāmebhyo darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta' ityādibhiḥ phalākāṅkṣānivṛtteśca | kiñcārthavādāprāmāṇyaṃ jānatastataḥ pravṛtterapyanupapattiḥ, 'bahudugdheyaṃ gauḥ' iti vākyāprāmāṇyaṃ jānatastadvākyādiva | na ca svargādyarthakatāyāmaprāmāṇye'pi prāśastyabodhakatvadvārā stāvakatvamityabhyupagate'rthe prāmāṇyamiti cet, na ; tatphalajanakatvātiriktaprāśastyasya kvāpyakalpanāt | dharmāntareṇa prāśastyajñānasya pravarttakatvāpāyācca | tasmāt svārtha evaiṣāṃ pramāṇyam | evañca 'sandhyāmupāsīta' ityādau vidhita iṣṭāvagame'pi tasyāvāntararūpeṇa bodhanadvārā śīghrotpattijñāpanadvārā vā pravṛttiviśeṣārthamarthavāda iti | ata eva sarvaśaktyādhikaraṇe 'kāmyaṃ yathā phalāyopadiṣṭaṃ tathā nityamapi' iti bhaṭṭairuktam | tasmādiṣṭasādhanatvaṃ vidhyarthaṃ ityāhuḥ | tat, na ; evaṃ hi anyeṣṭasādhane'nyasya pravṛttyāpattyā madiṣṭasādhanatvajñānaṃ pravartakaṃ vācyam | tathā ca kṛtisādhyatvavadasyāpi śakayatāyā vaktumaśakyatvam | kiñcaivam 'pṛcchatu māṃ bhavānityarthe ṇic kasmānna bhavati' iti "hetumati ca" ( 3|1|26 ) iti sūtrasthabhāṣyasaṅkāyāḥ 'dravyamātraviṣayapreraṇāyāṃ loṭ, sakriyapreraṇāyāṃ ṇic' ityādisamādhānasya cāsaṅgatyāpattiḥ | na hi ṇiceṣṭasādhanatvaṃ bodhyata iti kasyāpi sammatam | tasmāt prāguktapreraṇaiva vidhyarthaḥ | evañcāptapravartanayā tatrājñātajñapyatvamiva śreyaḥ sādhanatvamapyākṣipyata iti pravarttakeṣṭasādhanatvajñānopapattiḥ | kvacit tu svargakāmādasamabhivyāhārādādito mānasamapi tajjñānamityanyadetat | sā ca pravartanā liṅdyotyā vācyā vā ? tatrādye upapattiḥ, tasyāḥ pratyayārthatve kartrādīnāmarthānāṃ lakārāntare sāvakāśānāṃ vidhyādayo vācakāḥ syuḥ | evañca caitreṇa pacediti liṅdyotyā vācyā vā ? tatrādye upapattiḥ, tasyāḥ pratyayārthatve kartrādīnāmarthānāṃ lakārāntare sāvakāśānāṃ vidhyādayo vācakāḥ syuḥ | evañca caitreṇa pacediti syāt, dvivacanādikam, śabādayaśca na syuḥ puruṣavyavasthā ca na syāt | dvitīye tviyamupapattiḥ, virodhābhāvāt "laḥ karmaṇi" [ 3|4|69 ] ityatra sarvalakāraṅgrāhakabahuvacananirdeśācca na krartrādyarthānāmetaibadhiḥ, saṅkhyāyāḥ saṅkhyeyāpekṣitatvena teṣāṃ vācakatvāvaśyakatvāt [ca] laḍādau vartamānatvaparokṣatvādīnāṃ samāveśena "laḥ karmaṇi" [ 3|4|69 ] ityasya niravakāśatvācca | na ca "māḍi luṅ" [ 3|3|175] ityādibhiḥ kālasāmānyavihiteṣu tatsāvakāśam, tatrāpi viśeṣyāsattvabhūtabhāvanāyāḥ kālākāṅkṣitatvena kālasya vācyatavāṅgīkārāt | ata eva tasya sarvalakārāpavādatvaṃ saṅgacchate | na ca nimantrayeyaṃ bhavantamiti na syāt, nimantraṇāyā uktatvāditi vācyam ; prayojakaniṣṭhayornimantramayoranyayoḥ pratyārthatvasvīkārāt | tatra tatra dyotakatāpakṣo jyāyān, 'paca' ityādau pratyayaṃ vinā'pi pravartanāpratīteḥ, pacabhirhalaiḥ kṛṣatītyādau pravartanāyā dhātvarthatvasya dṛṣṭatvācca | evañcātra prayojakavyāpāro'pi dhātvarthaḥ, tasyāpi pākādyanukūlatvāt | tatra phalānukūlatvāt tadupastitavyāpārāṇāṃ madhye prayojakavyāpārasya viṣayitayā viśeṣaṇanavetnānvayaḥ, itareṣāṃ tu viṣayatayā viśeṣyatvena | evaṃ dviprakārakānvaye liṅādayastātparyagrāhakāḥ | tathā caikāśrayikā pravartanāviṣayībūtā pākānukūlā kriyatyādiprakāreṇa pacedityādau bodhaḥ | na caivaṃ pravartanāśrayasyāpi dhātvarthavyāpārāśrayatvena kartṛtvāt tatra kartari lakāraḥ syāditi vācyam, liṅādyutpatteḥ pūrvaṃ pravartanāyā apratipādanāt tadāśrayasya kartṛtvābhāvena tamādāya "laḥ karmaṇi" ityasyāpravṛtteḥ | liṅkṣu sūtradvayābhyāmeka vākyatāpannābhyāṃ vidhīyata ityadoṣa iti bahavaḥ | anye tu 'pācayati' ityādau pravartanāyā viśeṣyatvasya klṛptatvenātrāpi tathaivāstu | eñcaikāśrayapākānukūlakriyāviṣayā pravarttaneti bodhaḥ | na caitasyāḥ pratyayavācyatvapakṣe 'kriyāpradhānamākhyātam' iti vacanabodhitadhātvarthaviśeṣyatāyā eva bodhanenādoṣāt | na ca ṇicsanādau prakṛtyartha eva viśeṣya, autsargikapratyayārthaprādhānyatyāgemānābhāvāt, anubhavaviruddhatvācca 'pācayitā' ityādau ṇijarthādīnāṃ prādhānyasyāvaśkatvāccetyāhuḥ | tatra kārakaviśiṣṭadhātvarthasya pravartanāyām, tādṛśadhātvarthe,pravartanāyā vānvayaḥ, kārakānvayaṃ vinā dhātvarthasya nirūpayitumaśakyatvāt | evañca pravartanākṣiptamajñāpyatvaṃ śreyaḥ sādhanatvaca viśiṣṭa eva, kārakaviśiṣṭakriyāyā eva pravartanāviṣayatvāt | dhātvarthasya prāptatve tu tātparyato guṇāṃśe paryavasyata | yathā 'daghnā juhoti' iti | lihādau pravartanā ca vastuto vartamānakālaeva bhāsate, śabdaśaktisvabhāvād, vartamānakālasyāntaraṅgatvācca | dhātvarthastu bhaviṣyatkāla eva, śabdaśaktisvabhāvāt | etena preraṇā prayojyapākavartamānatādaśāyāṃ 'pacet' iti prayogāpattiriti nirastam | vidhiliṅyuttamastu na, svapravṛttau svecchāyāḥ svarūpasatyā eva kāramatvena tajjñānānupayogāt | idamevābhipretya 'uttamapuruṣo vidhiśaktipratibandhakaḥ' iti mīmāṃsakāḥ | 'na kalañjaṃ bhakṣayet' ityādau nañsamabhivyāhāre tu nivṛtirliṅartha iti sarveṣṭasiddhiḥ | iti tiṅarthavicāraḥ <9> atha sanādyarthavicāraḥ atha dhātuprakṛtikasanādyartho nirūpyate 'pipaṭhiṣati' ityādau sanarthaḥ = icchā | tatra dhātvarthasya karmatvasamānakarttṛ katvaitadubhayasambandhenānvayo vyatpattivaicitryāt, "dhātoḥ karmaṇaḥ samānakartṛkādicchāyāṃ vā" [ 3|1|7 ] iti sūtrasvarasācca | punaḥ punaratiśayena vā pacati 'pāpacyate' ityādau yaṅā tu prakṛtyarthagataṃ paunaḥ punyaṃ bāhulyaṃ vā bodhyate | kvacit kauṭilayagarhādyapi "nityaṃ kauṭilye gatau" [ 3|1|23], "lupasadacara" [ 3|1|24 ] ityāditattacchāstraprāmāṇyāt |'śvā mumūrṣati' ityādau āśaṅkā sanarthaḥ, śvakartṛkamāśaṅkāviṣayo maraṇamati bodhaḥ | evameva 'kūlaṃ pipatiṣati' ityatrāpi | icchāropeṇa pratyaya iti mate pūrvoktārthaḥ paścanmānasabodhaviṣayaḥ | tatra cedṛśasamabhivyāhāra eva kāraṇam | 'pācayati' ityādau ṇijarthaḥ preraṇetyādyūhyam | iti sanādyarthavicāraḥ | <10> atha kṛdarthavicāraḥ atha dhātuprakṛtikakṛdartho vicāryate tatra kartṛkarmavihitakṛtāmāśrayo'rthaḥ | tatra karttari vyāpāraśrayaḥ, karmaṇi phalāśrayaḥ, karmakṛtsamabhivyāhāre ca phalavyāpārayorvyatyāsaḥ | evañca 'gato grāmaḥ' ityādau vyāpārajanyottaradeśasaṃyogāśrayo grāma iti bodhaḥ | na ca tiṅante kartṛkarmaṇordhātvarthaviśeṣaṇatāyā dṛṣṭatvenātrāpi tathaivocitamiti vācyam, tiṅanta eva 'bhāvapradhānam' ityasya pravṛtteḥ, 'sattvapradhānāni' ityuttaraniruktena tayostatra viśeṣyatāya bodhanācca | nāmni sattvaprādhānyaṃ casvaghaṭaprakṛtibhūtadhātvarthāpekṣayaiva | tena vibhaktyarthasyāsattvabhūtasya prādhānyeṣapi na kṣatiḥ | nāmapadena cātra sattvavācakapratyayāntaṃ gṛhyate, ata eva 'pacati kalpam' ityādau na doṣaḥ | bhāvakṛtsu kṛtyasañjñakatavyādīnāṃ ktakhalarthānāñca sādhyāvasthāpannadhātvarthānuvādakatvameva | ata eva 'edhitavyam' ityādau na kriyāntarākāṅkṣādi | atasteṣvekavacanameva | 'sattvapradhānāni nāmāni' ityukteḥ sādhyāvasthasyāpi liṅgayogaḥ | liṅgayogānvayitvameva ca sattvam | tatra liṅgāntarāsambhavāt liṅgasarvanāmatvācca napuṃsakatvameva | ata eva "tayoreva kṛtyakta" [ 3|4|70 ] iti sūtre "laḥ karmaṇi" [ 3|4|69 ] iti sūtragṛhītabhāvakarmaṇoreva tayorityanena parāmarśaḥ saṅgacchata ityāhuḥ | ghañādivācyabhāvastu siddhāvasthāpannaḥ, 'pākaḥ' ityādau kriyāntarākāṅkṣādīnāṃ darśanāt | na caivam 'odanasya pākaḥ' ityādau kārakānvayo na syāt, sādhyāvasthāpannakriyāyāsveva tadanvayavyutpatteḥ ; 'kārake' ityadhikārāt ; 'kārakam' iti mahāsañjñākaraṇād veti vācyam, prakṛtyā sādhyāvasthāpannasyaivopasthāpanāt | na cādhyāhṛtatiṅantārthakriyāyāmeva 'odanasya pākaḥ' ityādau kārakānvayo'stviti vācyam, "kartṛkarmaṇoḥ" [ 2|3|65 ] iti kṛdyogaṣaṣṭhyanāpatteḥ, asāmarthyāt 'odanapākaḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsānāpatteśca | na ca śeṣaṣṭhyaiva samāsaḥ, samāsasya vaikalpikatvācca vākyamapi siddhamiti vācyam, karmatvādiprakārakabodhānubhavānāpatteḥ | kiñcaivam 'kartṛkarmaṇoḥ' ityarthasya vyarthatvāpattiḥ | na caivam, 'kāṣṭhaiḥ pākaḥ' ityapi syāditi cet, iṣṭāpatteḥ | na caivam 'pākaḥ' ityādau vāradvayaṃ kriyābodhaḥ syāditi vācyam, ekasyaiva padārthasya sādhyatvasiddhatvābhyāmupasthitirityatra tātparyāt | na ca viruddhābhyāmābhyāṃ kathamekapadopasthitiḥ, bhāṣyādiprāmāṇyena bodhakabhedena caikādhikaraṇavṛttitvenopasthitisvīkārāt | tayorvirodhasyaivābhāva ityanye | tatra dhātvarthaphalānvaye "śobhanaṃ pākaḥ" ityeva | pākādipadebhyo'pi phalasyaiva sādhyatvatenaivopasthāpanāt "kartṛkarmaṇoḥ" [ 2|3|65 ] iti ṣaṣṭhī tu na, kartṛsāhacaryeṇa karmaṇo'dhātvarthasyaiva tatra grahaṇāt | spaṣṭañcedam "pūjanāt pūjitam" [ 8|1|67 ] ityatrāṣṭame bhāṣye | vyāpārānvaye tu ghañā tatra siddhatvasyāpi bodhanāt 'śobhanaḥ pākaḥ' ityeva | tiṅante tu vyāpārānvaye'pi 'jyotiṣṭomena bhaktipūrvaṃ yajeta' ityādau napuṃsakataiva | parantu prathamā, na tu dvitīyā, tasya karmatvābhāvena tadviśeṣaṇe tadaprāpteḥ | 1[fn dhātūnāṃ subvibhaktyaprakṛtitvāt tadarthe subarthasaṅkhyākarmatvādīnāmanvayānupapattyā dhātoriva ghañantasyāpi kriyāvācakatvamabhyupeyam | prakṛtyekadeśārthe tadanvayā'bhcupagame tu yatra pākakartāderdvitvādikaṃ bādhitam, pākādeśca tadabādhitam, tatra 'pacantau paśyati' ityādiprayogāpatteḥ, dhātūpasthāpyārthe subarthānvayabodhaṃ prati taddhātūttaradharmikayatkiñcirthaparatvajñānasya pratibandhakatvopagame tu gauravam | evañca yatra dhātumātrasya pākādau tātparyyam tatra tadviśeṣamatāvācakastokapadād dvitīyaiva, yatra tu kṛdantasamudāyasya, tatra tadviśeṣaṇavācakapadaṃ tatsamānavibhaktikameveti kātantrapariśiṣṭakṛnmataṃ navyanaiyāyikamatatvenānūdya dūṣayati -- eteneti | ] etena 'saṅkhyāvartamānatvādyabodhakānāṃ ghañādīnāṃ prayogasādhutāmātram' iti naiyāyikanavyoktamapāstam | tadukatam --- sādhyatvena kriyā tatra dhāturūpanibandhanā | siddhabhāvastu yastasyāḥ sa ghañādinindhanaḥ || iti | siddhasya bhāvaḥ = siddhatvam | spaṣṭañcedam "sārvadhātuka" [ 3|1|67 ] iti sūtre bhāṣye | na ca sādhyāvasthāyā api bhāne 'pañcakṛtvaḥ pākaḥ' ityapi syāt, kṛtvasujādeḥ kriyānvaye eva sādhutvaditi vācyam, 'dviḥ prayogo dvirvacane'ci' ityādiprayogadarśaneneṣṭāpatteḥ | atiprasaṅgastvanabhidhānād vāraṇīya ityeke | anye tu -- kriyāyā evābyāvṛttigaṇane kṛtvasujityatra kriyāgrahaṇavairthyena tatsamārthyāt sādhyasvabhāvāyā eva kriyāyāstatra grahaṇena na doṣaḥ | 'dviḥ prayogaḥ' ityādi tu "durvacane'ci" [ 1|1|56 ] iti jñāpakānnirvāhyamitayāhuḥ | kiñca, tatra sādhyatvābhāne dhātusambāndhikāravihitaktvādayaḥ, kriyārthakriyopapade vidhīyamānatumunādayaśca na syuḥ, 'bhoktuṃ pākaḥ' ityādikriyāpadasya sādhyatvaviśiṣṭa eva saṅketāt | evam 'bhuktvā pākaḥ' ityādyapi | 'bhoktuṃ pācakaḥ, bhuktvā pācakaḥ ' ityādi tu na, 'guṇānāñca parārthatvāt' it nyāyena guṇabhūtakriyānvayānaucityāditi ktvarthanirūpaṇe nirupayiṣyāmaḥ | na ca 'yuktuṃ pacati paśya' ityādyapi na syāt, antaraṅgatvena padārthopasthitikālikāprādhanyasyaiva grahaṇāt | 'bhoktuṃ pācako'sti' ityādau tu "śakadhṛṣa" [ 3|4|65 ] iti sūtreṇa tumun, 'bhūktvā pācakaḥ' iti tu 'asti' ityādikriyāyāmapyanvayaḥ, ākāṅkṣāvaśāt | ata eva 'dattena gato grāmaḥ, katṛpūrvīkaṭam' ityādau kārakānvaya ityāhuḥ, tat, na ; 'guṇapradhānasannidhau guṇena nānvayaḥ' ityeva tadarthaḥ, pradhānāsannidhau tu guṇenāpīti 'bhauktuṃ pācakaḥ, bhuktvā gataḥ, bhūktvā pācakaḥ' ityādyapi sādhveveti vadanti | nanvevaṃ pākādipadopāttasya prasajyapratiṣedhārthakanañarthe'nvayāpattau pāko nā'stītyapi syāt, dvitvāvacchinnapākābhāvakartṛkā satteti bodhāditi cet, na ; vyutpattivaicitryeṇa pratiṣedhārthakanañaḥ sādhyāvasthaāmātrakriyāvācakārthānvayitvasyaiva svīkārāt | yadyapi "tena tulyam" [ 5|1|125 ] iti vatirapi kriyānvayī, tathāpi sa iṣyata eva yāgavat pākaḥ iti | ata e 'goṣu duhyamānāsu devadattasya gamanam' ityādau "yasya ca bhāvena" [ 2|3|37 ] ityādi ṣaṣṭhyādikam, dhātunā sādhyāvasthāpannasya bodhanāditi dik | evaṃ tumunādīnāmapi bhāva evārthaḥ, '1 [fn bhāṣyakṛtastu -- "tumarthe" iti sūtre "tumartho bhāvavaḥ" iti pratyācakṣaṇāḥ kvādīn bhāva evābhyupayanti | parantu ktvātumunāderasattvabhūta eva bhāvo'rthaḥ, pāka ityādāviva | ] avyayakṛto bhāve' ityukteḥ | sa bhāvo'sattvabhūta eva, avyayārthe liṅgādyanvayābhāvena pratyayārthe vailakṣaṇyānanubhavāt | tatra "tumun‌ṇvulau kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyām" [ 3|3|10 ] ityuktestādarthyamapi tumun‌dyotyam, tādarthyamud‌deśyatvarūpam | tacca saṃsargaḥ prakāro vā | prakṛtyupapadārthayoḥ samānakartṛ katvamapīhābhidhānabalāllabhyaḥ prayogopādhiḥ, dvayoḥ kriyāyoradhikaraṇākāṅkṣyāṃ pratyāsattyaikagrahamasyaivaucityāt | tacca saṃsragaḥ prakāro vā | pratṛtyupapadārthayoḥ samānakartṛ katvamapīhābhidhānabalāllabhyaḥ prayogopādhiḥ, dvayoḥ kriyayoradhikaraṇākāṅkṣāyāṃ pratyāsattyaikagrahamasyaivaucityāt | etadvihitaṇvul tu karttaryaiva | tatra tumun‌prakṛtyartha upapadārthaṃ prati viśeṣaṇ | evañca 'kṛṣṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ yāti' ityādau kṛṣṇakarmakabhaviṣyad‌darśanod‌deśyakaṃ ca yānamiti bodhaḥ2 [fn ayamatra saṅgrahaḥ -- 'bhoktuṃ pacati' ityatra bhojanaṃ pacikriyayorjanyajanakabhāvasambandhastumundyotyaḥ, "tumunṇvulau kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyām" ityukteḥ | tādarthyañca janyajanakabhāvarūpamiti bhāvaḥ | tādarthyavat samānakartṛ katvamapi kriyayoḥ saṃsargatayā bhāsate, śabdaśaktisvabhāvāt | ata eva vibhinnakartṛ kakriyādvaya tātparyakaḥ 'bhoktuṃ pacati' iti na prayogaḥ | tattvavidastu --- udde śyatvanirūpakatvarūpaṃ tādarthyaṃ tumunāpi dyotyaṃ saṃsargatayā bhāsate | tacca tadicchādhīnecchāviṣayatvam | "tumunṇavulau" itiytra 'bhaviṣyati' ityanuvṛtterbhaviṣyatavamapi tad‌dyotyam | tathā ca bhaviṣyadbojanoddeśyako bhojanakartṛkaḥ pāka iti bodhaḥ | tumun tu na kartari, 'avyayakṛto bhāve' ] ityukteḥ, "kartari kṛt" ityasyātrāpravṛtteḥ, anirdiṣṭārthakeṣvetatpravṛtteḥ | etena tumunākhyātārthakartroḥ parasparamabhedānvayenaiva vibhinnakartṛ kakriyādvayatātparyakatādṛśaprayogāpattyabhāvena samānakartṛkatvaṃ na sambandha ityapāstam, 'bhoktuṃ pacyate, bhokatuṃ sthīyate' ityādau tadasambhāvacca | na ca tatrāpi devadattenetyadhyāhārāt tṛtīyārthakartaryabhedānvayānnānupattiriti vācyam, adhyāhāraṃ vināpi vākyārthabodhasyānubhavasiddhatvāditi dik | "tumunṇvulau" iti sūtrāvihito ṇvul tu "kartari kṛt" iti kartayeva, sambandhaśca kriyayoḥ pūrvokta eva| evañca 'kṛṣṇaṃ darśako yāti' iti vākyāt kṛṣṇakarmakabhaviṣyaddarśanod‌deśyakaṃ darśanakarttṛkaṃ vartamānakālikaṃ yānamiti bodha iti vadanti | yuktañcaitat, kṛṇṇadarśanauddeśyakayānena mārgasthajanāntaradarśanotpāda'pi 'jānaṃ draṣṭuṃ yāti' iti prayogavirahāt, 'kṛṣṇaṃ draṣyuṃ yāti, na yavanādikam' iti prayogācca | ata e navyatārkikāḥ kartṛ kartṛ katvaviśiṣṭecchādhīnecchāviṣayatvasya tumunvācyatāmanumanyante | ata eva caturthīkārake vyutpattivāde 'atra cāhartu miti tumunantārthaḥ svamabhivyāhṛtakriyānvayisvārthaprayojanakatvānvayyāharaṇam' ityuktam | svārthaprayojanakatvasya vācyatāṃ vinā'nvayayītyukterasaṅgatiḥ | anyathā tasya vṛttyaniyāmakatayā tatsanbandhāvacchinnapratiyogitāyā aprasiddhyā tathāvidhapratiyogitākayavanādigocaradarśanābhāvasya bodhayitumaśakyātvā | uktambandhena yavanādigocaradarśanaviśiṣṭagamanāśrayatvābhāva eva prathamāntārtho bodhyata iti tu na, 'kṛṣṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ sthīyate, na yavavādikam' ityādau tadasambhavāditi dik | śabdikanaye tu sakalaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭamukhyaviśeṣyakriyāyā eva sarvatra bodhasvīkārānnānupapattiriti dhyeyam | 'bhoktumicchati' ityādau "samānakartṛkeṣu" iti tumun, icchārtheṣu tumun‌prakṛtibhūtadhātvarthasamānakartṛ kārthapratipādakeṣūpapadeṣu dhātostumunniti tadarthaḥ | kriyārthakriyopapadābhāvārthamidam | tumunarthaviṣayitvaviśiṣṭakartṛ kartṛ katvasambandhena prakṛtyarthakriyecchāyāmanvaye tātparyagrāhakastumun | paramate tu tasya tadavācyam | parakartṛ kabhojanecchāyāṃ bhoktumicchatīti prayogavāraṇāya samānakartṛkvasyāpi sambandhamadhyaniveśaḥ | "śaktimicchatīti prayogavāraṇāya samānakartṛkatvasyāpi sambandhamadhyaniveśaḥ |"śaknoti bhoktum, dhṛṣṇoti paṭhitum, jānāti paṭhitum " ityādau "śakadhṛṣajñāglāghaṭarabhalabhakramasahārhāstyartheṣu tumun" iti tumun | ādye sāmarthyāparaparyāyaśakti rūpadhātvarthe phrakṛtyarthasya prayojanakatvasambandhastumun‌dyotyaḥ | dvitīye śaṅkhārāhityapaprāgalbhyaghaṭakaśaṅkyāyā viṣayitvaṃ sambandhaḥ, prayojakatvaṃ voktaprāgalmye sambandhaḥ | tṛtīye viṣayitvaṃ sambandhaḥ spaṣṭa eva | atrāpi sarvatra samānakartṛ katvamapi sambandhe niveśyam | atra yaḥ sambandhaḥ, sa paramate tadvacyaḥ | atra saknoterarthe samabhivyāhṛtatattaddhātvartho'ntarbhāvanīyaḥ | tathā hi -- galādhassaṃyogānukūlakriyāyāṃ vyāpāre śaktau ca śaknotervṛttiḥ | tatra śaktau śaktyākhyā, itaratra lakṣaṇā | tatra tumunprakṛtibhujyādistātparyagrāhakaḥ | etādṛśe'rthe vṛttiḥ karmapratyayasthale eva, na tu kartṛ pratyayasthaleḥ ; prayojanavirahāt | tatra prayojyatvasambandhena śaktyānvitavyāpārasya janyatvasambandhenīktakriyāyāmanvayaḥ | tathāvidhakriyārūpaphalaśālitvādodanādeḥ janyatvasambandhenoktakriyāyāmanvayaḥ | tathāvidhakriyārūpaphalaśālitvādodanādeḥ karmatvam | evañca "śakyate odano bhoktum |" ityataḥ śaktiprayojyavyāpārajanyagalādhassaṃyogānukūlaudanāśrayikakriyeti bodhaḥ | tārkikanaye tu -- tathāvidhakriyāśrayatāvānodana iti bodhaḥ | śaktiśca mīmāṃsakanaye padārthāntaram | nyāyanaye tattatkāraṇānukūlāsādhāramakāraṇakalāpaḥ | yathā prakṛte pradīptaḍaṭharānalasaṃyogādiḥ, liṅgasaṅkhyānanubhavāt | tathā ca dhātvarthanuvādaka eva tumunādiriti paryavasannam | ] evaṃ ktvāpratyayasyāpi bhāva evārthaḥ | yattu -- "samānakartṛ kayoḥ pūrvakāle" [3|4|21] iti smaraṇāt kvādyarthaḥ kartā | anyathā 'iṣṭakāḥ paktvā'haṃ pāktvā'haṃ bhokṣye' ityatra tṛtīyāprasaṅgaḥ | na cākhyātena karturabhidhānānna seti vācyam, bhojanakriyākartturuktatve'pi pākakarttustattvābhāvāt | 'anabhihite bhavati' iti paryudāsāśrayaṇāt | ata eva 'prāsāde āste' ityatra prāsādanakriyādhikaraṇasyābhidhāne'pyāsikriyādhikaṇasyānabhidhānāt saptamīti bhāṣyādau spaṣṭamiti | tat, na ; 'prāsāde āste' ityatra dvitīyāpatterevamapyanuddhārāt, 'samāne kartari' ityava siddhe sūtre "samānakartṛkayoḥ" (3|4|21) ityasya vaiyarthyāpatteśca | tasmāt samānakartṛ katvaṃ pūrvakālatvañca dyotyameva | dyotakatvaṃ cārthayoḥ saṃsarge tātparyagrāhakatvam | tathāhi - atra bhāvaḥ sādhyāvastha eva, sa ca dhātunā labhyaḥ, ktvāprakṛtyarthabhūtā ca kriyā kriyāntare viśeṣaṇam | dhātusambandhādhikārāt tayoḥ sambandhaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyamuttarakālikatvañca | tatra sambandhatātparyagrāhakāḥ ktvādayaḥ | kvacittu janyatvāvyāpyatvādikamapyādhikaṃ bhāsate | tattu mānāntaragamyatvād na ktvādiyotyam | evañca 'bhuktvā vrajati', 'bhuktvaivāhaṃ tṛptaḥ, na pītvā', 'adhītya tiṣṭhati', 'īśvaro jñātvā tiṣṭhati' ityādau pareṣāmivāsmākamapi bodhaḥ | evañca 'katṛtiṅprakṛtyarthayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyasaṃsargabodhenaiva samānakartṛ katvalābhāt tat ktvāvācyam' iti mīmāṃsakoktamayuktam | 'samānakartṛ katā, pūrvakālatā ca pratīyate' iti granthāstu saṃsargatayā pratītisattvānnānupapannāḥ | tatprakārakabodhānubhavastu nāstyeva | sūtre tu "samānakartṛkayoḥ" iti nirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī, saptamī vā | 'pūrvakāle' iti bahuvrīhiḥ | evañca 1 [fn ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- samānakartṛ kayordhātvarthayormadhye pūrvakālaviśiṣṭārthabodhakād ityatra ktvāpratyayaśaṅkhā pūrvaśabdo'tra pūrvakālārthaḥ, na tu dhātostatra vṛttirityarthakena svaśabdenoktatvādityanena samāhitā | uktārthānāmiti nyāyaparatvaṃ tu na tasyā, tathā satīha kasmānna bhavati -- 'āsyate bhoktum' iti śaṅkāparābhāṣyasyātaṅgatyāpatteḥ | tatrāpi tumunā taduddaśyakatvarūpasambandhaṃ bodhayatā''sateḥ pūrvakālatvasya dyotitatvena tadaprāpteḥ | tatra pūrvakālānavagame tu bhoktubhyaḥ pūrvaṃ bhuktvānyebhyo vrajitṛbhyaḥ paścād vrajatītyarthaḥ' iti sādhanāntarakriyāvadhikameva pūrvakālatvaṃ pratīyata iti nāsya sūtrasya viṣayaḥ, kintu 'vibhāṣāgre prathamā' ityamyeti --- avyavahitapūrvakālikatvamātraṃ śakyam | varṣāntarīyabhojanamādāya tathā prayogavāraṇāya avyavahiteti | tacca yogyatā, sā ca tātparyādibhirdaṇḍamāsamurhūrttādibhiravasīyate | evañca ' bhuktvā vrajati' ityādau bhojanottaraṃ vrajatītyanvayabodhāt, vrajanapūrvakāle bhojanamityabodhācca tathā nāvyavadhānamapi | varṣāntarīyabhojane tathā prayogaḥ sati tātparye iṣṭa eva, asati tātparye tadabhāvādeva na bodhaḥ | autsargikaṃ punaravyavadhānamādriyata eva | ata eva 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmi [ ṣṭvā ] somena yajeta' iti vākyaṃ darśottarakālaṃ somāṅgatvena vidhatte | anyathā ktvāśruteḥ tātkālikaprāgabhāvapratiyogitvarūpam, tadadhikaramasamayadhvaṃsādhikaraṇasamayotpattimattvarūpaṃ vā ānantaryaṃ śakyam | na caivaṃ mukhavyādānottaraṃ tadabhāvakāle 'mukhaṃ vyādāya svapiti' iti prayogāpattiḥ, 'bhuktvaivāhaṃ tṛptaḥ, na pītvā' iti prayogānāpatiḥ ; ubhayānatantaryāviśeṣāt, 'īśvaro jñātvā tiṣṭhati' ityasya cānāpattiriti vācyam, tajjanyatvavyāpyatvādīnāmapi ktvādyarthatvāt | iha dyotyaḥ, na padārthabhūta iti karmapravacanīyebhyo vailakṣaṇyam | kiñca, teṣāṃ vācyatve kṛtipratyayārthaviśeṣyatvaniyamāt tasyaiva viśeṣyatvāpattiḥ) | na ceṣṭāpattiḥ, ktāntārthaviśeṣyapradhānatiṅantārthakriyānirūpitaśaktyabhidhāne guṇakriyānirupitaśakterapyabhihitatvasya bhāṣyādiprāmāṇyenāṅgīkārāt | uktañca hariṇā --- pradhānetarayoryatra dravyasya kriyayoḥ pṛthak | śaktirguṇāśrayā tatra pradhānamanurudhyate || pradhānaviṣayā śaktiḥ pratyayenābhidhīyate | yadā guṇe tadā tad‌vadanuktāpi pratīyate || iti | ata eva 'paktvaudano bhujyate' ityatraudane na dvitīyā | na ca paripūrṇaṃ padānatareṇānvetuṃ yogyamiti vyutpatteḥ kārakasambandhaṃ vinā kriyāsvarūpasyaivābhāvācca 'paktvā' ityasyāpi kartṛkarmākāṅkṣāsattvāccāntaraṅgatayā dvitīyādikaṃ durvāram, na hi tatkāle pradhānakriyānirūpitaśakterjñānamasti, nāpi tadabhihitatvasyeti vācyam, bhāṣyaprāmāṇyena dhātusambandhādhikāravihitāvyayakudatiriktaviṣayatvād vyutpatīnāmityadoṣāt | kiñca, pūrvaṃ kriyāntarānvayasya tanākāśatvābhākatvādīnāṃ ātitvābhāve'pi na kṣatiḥ | ] jātimātre śaktau hi 'gāṃ dadyāt' ityādau gotvadirdānāsambhavādanupapattiḥ | na ca lakṣaṇayā vyaktibodhaḥ, śakyasambandharūpalakṣaṇāyā agrahe'pi tadbhānāt, sarveṣu viśiṣṭabodhakavākyeṣau vṛttidvayakalpanāyāṃ gauravācca ityeke | kecattu --- gavādipadānāṃ dharma eva śaktiḥ, nānāvyaktīnāṃ śakyateve gauravāt | na ca pratyekaṃ vyaktibhirvinigamanāviharaḥ | evaṃ hi vyaktyantare lakṣaṇāyāṃ 2[fn svam = vyaktiḥ, tatra samavetā jātiḥ, tatsamavāyitvaṃ vyaktāviti lakṣaṇasamanvayaḥ | ] svasamavetasamavāyitvaṃ saṃsarga iti gorauvam, jātiśaktau ca3[fn svam = jātiḥ, tatsamavāyitvaṃ vyaktāviti | ] svasamavāyitvaṃ 4[fn saṃsarga ityarthaḥ | ] tatheti lāghavam | kiñca vyaktivādināpi ānantyavyabhicāravāraṇāyā tasyāḥ śakyatāvacchedakatvamavaśyaṃ vācyam, ata evaikākārapratītisiddhiḥ | evañca lāghavāt saiva vācyā|stu, vyaktau śakterjātau tadavacchedakatvasya kalpane gauravāt | yathā tava jātau śakyatāvacchedakatā niravacchinnaiva, evaṃ śaktirapi tasyāṃ tathaveti na gotvatvādiphraveśād gauravaśaṅkā | ata eva śābdabodhe vyaktau tasyāḥ svarūpeṇaiva prakāratā saṅgacchate | na ca gaupadaśakyamiti nirdharmakaśaktigrahāsambhavaḥ | prāthamikaśaktigrahasyānumityātmakatvena nirdharmitāvacchedikāyā anumiterabhāvāditi vācyam, atra pakṣe padaviśeṣyakasya śaktighaṭake bodhe gotvādiprakārakasyaiva śaktigrahasya svūkāreṇādoṣāt | nahi samavāyenaiva jāteḥ svarūpataḥ prakārateti niyamaḥ, 'ghaṭaṃ jānāmi' ityādau prakāritasambandhenāpi ghaṭatvāderjñānādyaṃśe prakāratvāṅghīkārāt | ata eva na viśiṣṭe śaktiḥ, 1[fn 'nāgṛhītaviśeṣaṇā buddhairviśeṣyamadhigacchati' iti nyāyasvarūpam | viśeṣaṇaviṣayakabuddhirviśeṣyaṃ nāvagāhate | viśeṣyaviṣayakatvasya viśeṣaṇaviṣakatvaniyatvamiti niṣkarṣaḥ | evañca viśiṣṭaśaktivāde viśiṣṭaśakatigrahasya viśeṣaṇaviṣayakatvāvaśyakatayā tadubhayaviṣayakatvasya padārthopasthityādikāraṇatāvacchedakatvakalpanāpekṣayā viśeṣaṇaviṣayakatvamātrasyaiva tadavacchedakatvakalpanā lāghaṅavāduciteti jātāveva śaktiḥ svīkartavyeti phalito'rthaḥ | ] 'nāgṛgītaviśeṣaṇa'nyāyena jātervācyatvāvaśyakatve tatraiva śaktericitatvāt | nanvevam, 'gāmānaya' ityādau vāhadohādyanvayānupapattiḥ, na ca sākṣātsambandhena jātau bādhe'pi paramparayā tadanvayopagamānna doṣaḥ, 'gaurjātā' ityādau viśeṣyabhūte gotve anvayitāvacchedakatayā gotvatvādibhānāpatteḥ | śaktau tadantarbhāvādyāpatteśca | jāterapi prakāratayaiva svarūpato bhānamiti niyamāt | evañca teṣāṃ padānāṃ vyaktibodhajanakatve vivādābhāvena vyaktiśaktiḥ siddhaiveti cet, atra vadanti vyaktiśaktāvasmākaṃ vaimatyam, api tu vyaktiśaktijñānahetutāyāmeva | ata eva vyaktyaṃśe kubjā śaktiriti gīyate, tadaṃśe tajjñānānapekṣaṇāt | eta eva vyakterna vācyatā, yadviṣayakatvena śaktijñānasya [yadviṣayaka] śābdadhījanakatā, tattvasyaiva tadvācyatāvyavahāraniyāmakatvāt | yathānvayāṃ'śe kubjaśaktisattve'pi tadviṣayakatvaṃ śaktijñānajanakatāyāṃ nāvacchedakam, tathā vyaktyaṃśe tatsattve'pi tadviṣayakatvasya śaktijñānakatānavacchedakatvānna vyaktau vācyatvavyavahāraḥ | gotvaviṣayakatvasyaiva ca niveśād gotvādervācyatā | evañcātra pakṣe kāryakāraṇabhāvāvacchedakakoṭau vyaktyanantarbhāvamātreṇaiva 'gaurgāpadaśakyā' iti śaktigraho'pi vaktuṃ śakyaḥ | parantu tasya gotvaprakārakajñānatvena vyaktiviṣayatāmanantarbhāvyaiva kāraṇatvād vyakteravācyatopapattiḥ | evañca tadaṃśe kubjatvavyavahāraḥ, padaviśeṣyakaśaktigrahamate tu tajjñānānapekṣaṇādapi kubjaśaktitvamiti | evaṃ vyaktiśaktivāde jātyaṃśe 1[fn ' hṛdayaṃ yadi vā pṛṣṭhamunnataṃ kramaśaḥ saruk | kruddho vāyuryadā kuryāt tadā taṃ kuṃbajamādiśet ||' ityāyurvede kubjalakṣaṇaṃ pratipāditam | sa yathā vikṛtenāṅgena kimapividhātumaśaktaḥ, avikṛtena hastapādādinā bhojanādikaṃ sampādayati, tathaiva śābdabodhāt pūrvamanupasthitā ata evānvayāṃśanirūpitā pade'jñātā śaktiḥ na śābdabodhamupakaroti, jñātā ca śābdabodhamupakarotyeva | yadyapi uktalakṣaṇalakṣitakubjatvaṃ cetanadharma eva, tathāpyatra samānadharmatvādacetanāyāṃ śaktāvapyāropa iti tattvam | ]'kubjā' śaktiriti bodhyam | yattu bhaṭṭāḥ -- padād vyakterna smaraṇam, anubhavo vā, nāpi tatra kubjā śaktiḥ, kintvākṣepaḥ ; ākṣepikā ca jātireva | ākṣepaścānumānam tādātmyena jāterādheyatayā vyaktyākṣepakatvena na vaiyadhikaraṇyam | anumānañca gotvaṃ gavāśritam, goniṣṭhapratiyogitānavacchedakadharmavattvāt, kiñcidāśritaṃ vā, jātitvāditi, tat, na; tādṛśahetūpastiterasārvatrikatvāt, gopadāt tādṛśarūpeṇa gotvāderanupasthiteśca | kiñca, ākṣepitavyaktau karmatvādyanvaye 'pratyayānāṃ prakṛtyarthānvitasvārthabodhakatvavyutpattibhaṅgaḥ, 2[fn 'ghaṭapadāt ekasambandhijñānidhayopasthaitākāśacaitrādeḥ ghaṭapadajanyaśābdabodhaviṣayatvavāraṇāya ca' ityapi bodhyam | ]'dhūmo'yaṃ jvalati' ityādāvanvayabodhavāraṇāya padajanyapadārthopasthiteḥ śābdabodhakāraṇatvenākṣepitena padārthāntarānvayānāpattaiśca | etenārthāpattirākṣepa ityapāstam | na ca samānasaṃvitsaṃvedyatvamākṣepa iti vācyam, dravyamityādighaṭajñāne ghaṭatvajñānābhāvāt | yadi tu 'gāmanāya' ityādau svāśrayavṛttitvarūparamparayā karmatvādau jāceranvayaḥ, tena sambandhena gotvādimattvasyādheyatāsambandhena gavādivyāpyatvāt ; gavādimattvaṃ vinānupapatteśca ; ānayanakarmatvādheyatvādisambandhena gavādivyaktiprakārikā dhīḥ ākṣepāt saṃsargaghaṭakatayā śābdabodhe vyaktibhāne'pi karmatvādyaṃśe gotvādyavacchinnavyaktibhānānurodhenākṣepādaraḥ | padājjāteḥ smaraṇaṃ tu nirvikalpakameveti tadāśaya ucyate sau'pi duṣṭaḥ, prāgukteḥ | jātiśaktasya vyaktau lakṣaṇeti maṇḍanānuyāyinaḥ | teṣāmayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- lakṣaṇayā jātiprākaraka eva bodha iti nānubhavavirodhaḥ, nīlādipadānāṃ śakyanīlādiguṇapuraskāreṇa lakṣamayā bodhakatvavat śakyajātipuraskāreṇa lakṣaṇayā gavādipadasya bodhakatvāt | śakyādanyena rūpeṇa jñāte bhavati lakṣaṇā | iti tu prāyikamiti | tat, na ; yato vyaktau lakṣaṇā niravacchinnā, sāvacchinnā vā . nādyaḥ, asambhavāt | nāntyaḥ, tatpakṣe hi jāterevā1[fn kha. pu. 'vacchinnatvam' | ] vācchedakatvaṃ vācyam | tathā ca lakṣyatāvacchedakatayaiva jātibhānopapattau tatra śaktikalpanā vyarthā | na ca śakyasambandharūpalaśraṇānirvāhāya tatra śaktirūpeyā | evañca svātantryeṇa śakteranupayogitayā tasyā vṛttitvānupapatteḥ | nanu "jātyākṛtivyaktayaḥ padārthaḥ" iti gautamasūtreṇa gavādipadāt saṃsthānaviśeṣarūpākṛterapi bodhasayānubhavikatvapradarśanena parairjātyākṛtyubhayaviśiṣṭavyaktau śaktiraṅgīkrīyate | tatra jāteḥ sākṣātsamavāyasambandhena vyaktiviśeṣaṇatvāt pravṛttinimittatvam, avayabasaṃyogarūpākṛtestu sāmānādhikaraṇyarūpaparamparayā viśeṣaṇatvānna tattvam | 'piṣṭakamayyo gāvaḥ' ityādau kevalākṛtiviśiṣṭagabādau lakṣaṇā | evañca jātiśaktivāde ākṛteravayava1[fn 'saṃyogaviśeṣakhpāyāḥ' iti pāṭhaḥ samīcīnaḥ | ] saṃyogarūpāyā anantatvena tadapekṣayā ekasyā jātereva śakyatvaucitayāt | na cāvayavasaṃyoganiṣṭhajātireva śakyā, tadanvayaśca svāśrayaghaṭitaparamparayeti vācyam, ākṛtiprakārakabodhasyaivānubhavāt | vyaktyanuparaktakevalajātau prayogavirahaśca na śaktyabhāvasādhakaḥ, aprayojakatvāt | na ca kadācit kevalajātimātreṇa 'gaurnityā' iti prayogāpattiḥ, śaktyā svarapeṇaṇopasthitāyāḥ jāteḥ samānapadopāttau dharmiṇyāśrayatāsambandhenaivānvayasya vyutpannatvāditi cet, na; evaṃ hi tādṛśabodhe ākāṅkṣāyā api kāraṇatvakalpane gauraveṇa viśiṣṭaśakterevocitatvāt | tasmāt kubjaśaktirityevocitam, vyañcanayā tadbadhaḥ - ityante | vastutastu jāciśaktyaiva jñātayā jātivyaktyorupasthitau tātparyāt kadācijjātirviśeṣyā, vyaktirviśeṣaṇam ; kadācid vyaktirvivaśeṣyā, jātirviśeṣaṇ | evañca jātau paramparyā vāhādyanvayaḥ, vayaktireva cānvayitāvacchediketi paramparayānavayapakṣe na prāguktadoṣaḥ | ata eva "jātyākhyāyāmekasmin" [ 1|2|58 ] iti "jātiraprāṇinām" [ 2|4|6 ] iti ca saṅgacchate | ata eva ca jātipradhānye samāhāradvandva eva, vyaktiphradhānye tvitaretarayoga eveti bhāṣyādivyavahārāśca saṅgacchante | 1[fn atrāyaṃ vivekaḥ -- "sarūpāṇāmekaśeṣaḥ" ityekaśeṣārambhād vyaktirapi padārtha ityeva siddham, na tu kevalavyaktistatheti, jātiviśiṣṭavyakteḥ padārthatve'pi tadārambhasyāvaśyaktavāt | aṇ‌grahaṇasya bhāṣyakṛtpratyākhyānena, sarūpasūtrasya śāstrīyaprakriyāmātravahikatvasyākare siddhāntitvena ca na tābhyāṃ vyaktimātrasya prātipadikārthatvaṃ siddhyatīti vyavahāramātrameva śaraṇaṃ kevalavyaktivādināmiti tattvam | vastutastu viśiṣṭasyaiva padārthatvam | yadyapi 'ākṛtipadārthasya dravyaṃ na padārthaḥ' ityādibhāṣyād viśakalitayorevākativyaktyoḥ padārthatvaṃ pratīyate, tathāpi 'kasyacit kiñcid guṇabhūtam, kiñcit pradhānam' ityuttarabhāṣyaparyālocanayā viśiṣṭe śaktiravasīyate | ] idaṃ sarvapakṣeṣūhyam -- jātiprakāraśaktidhiya eva jātiviśiṣṭavyaktibodhakatvād na ghaṭatvādipadād vyaktipodhaḥ | bhāvapratyayarahitapadaghaṭitajātiśaktidhīreva tadbodhe heturityanye | evaṃ śuklaśabdādiṣu guṇibodhakeṣu guṇaḥ, śakyaḥ, pācaka ityatra kriyāḥ, ḍitthādau śabda eva | tatra ca ḍitthapadaṃ ḍitthapadavati śaktamityevaṃ śaktigrahaḥ | na ca śaktigrahāt pūrvaṃ tat‌padavaiśiṣṭyasyamānāntareṇāgrahāt tathāśaktigrahāsambhavaḥ | sambandhasāmānyena tad‌vaiśiṣṭagrahāt, bhāvisañjñāvijñānavad vā na doṣaḥ | tādṛśaktigahasya ca vācakatāsambandhāvacchinnapadaprakārakabodhatvasyaiva kāryatāvacchedakatvād nātipraṅgaḥ | nanu pācakādīnāṃ kathaṃ kriyāśaktamityucyate -- paceḥ kriyāyāṃ śaktatvenākasya karttari śaktatvena tattatpadābhyāmupasthitayorākāṅkṣāvaśāt parasparānvayena pācakaśabdasya śakterevābhāvāditi cet, na ; kumbhakāra ityāderekārthībhāvaviṣayāṇāmatrodāhaṇatvenākṣateḥ | vastutastu "karttari kṛt" [ 3|4|67 ] itasyaikajātīyārthakatvāyapācakādāvapyekārthībhāvaḥ | ata eva pācakādipadānnoddeśyavidheyabāvenānvaya iti dik | vastuto guṇādīnāmapi śakyatve ānantyavyabhicārayoḥ sattvena tatrāpi guṇagatajātareva śakyā | evañca pācakādiṣu kriyāgatajātiḥ, guḍacaṇḍulapākādiṣu bhinneṣu pākatvasyaikasya jātirūpasyāṅgīkārāt | ḍitthādāvapi ḍitthādiśabdagatā jātiḥ, śukādyuccāraṇabhedena ḍitthādiśabdānāṃ nānātvāt | ākāśapadādeḥ śaktiruktaiva | yadvā, kalpabhedena bhinneṣu ākāśatvamapi jātirakhaṇḍīpādhirvā tacchakyamiti vadanti | padānniyamato jātiviśiṣṭavyaktimānena tatrāpi bodhakatārūpā śaktirastyeveti śakyam | ghaṭatvaprakārakaghaṭaviśeṣyabodhe ca ghaṭatvaprakārakaśaktijñānatvenaiva hetuteti na gauravam, nāpi ghaṭatvādipadebhyo vyaktibodhaḥ | uktaṃ hi bhāṣye -- 'nahyākṛtipadārthakasya dravyaṃ na padārthaḥ, nāpi dravyapadārthakasyākṛtirna padārtha iti' ityanye | atra pakṣatraye liṅgasyāvācyatve'pi na treliṅgyam, tattalliṅgābhidhāyi, pratyayatvenaiva śabdānāṃ tattalliṅgatābhyupagamāt | anvayavyatirekābhyām "striyām" ityadhikṛtya ṭābādervidhānena, "tasmācchaso naḥ pusiṃ" [ 6|1|103 ] ityādyanuśāsanena ca tathaiva yuktatvācc | evaṃ saṅkhyādāvapi draṣṭavyam | apare tu --- liṅgamapi nāmārtha eva | pratyayārthatve hi strītvalasya, striyā vā prādhānyāpattiḥ | vyaktiśaktāvapi strītādātmyāpannā'jābodha evānubhavasiddhaḥ, na tvajātādātmyāpannastrībodhaḥ1 [Fn ajapadāditi śeṣaḥ | ] kiñca, vāgādiśabde vinā'pi pratyayaṃ strītvasya bodhāt prātipadikasya śaktatvāvaśyakatvena ṭopo'pi śaktyantarakalpane gauravam [vāt], liṅgānuśāsanasya prakṛtāveva darśanācc | ata eva "kṛdikārādaktinaḥ" iti vārtike 'uktinaḥ' iti caritārtham | anyathā ktinā strītvasyoktatvān ṅīpo'prāptau tadvaiyarthyaṃ spaṣṭamaiva | ata eva vyāvakriśotyādau "ṇacaḥ striyāmañ" [ 5|4|24 ] ityañi striyāṃ vihite'pi strīpratyayasiddhiḥ | na ca tavāpi prakṛtyaivāsyoktvāt strīpratyayānāpattiḥ ; prakṛtyuktasya tasyāvyāvarttakatvāt | anyathā ṭābādividhīnāṃ vaiyarthyāpattiriti dik | nanu 'stanekeśavatī strī syāllomaśaḥ puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ' ityādilakṣaṇalakṣitāvayavasaṃsthānaviśeṣarūpaliṅgasyācetane khaṭvādau bādhāt strīpratyayānāpattiḥ | kiñcaivaṃ dārānityādau natvaṃ na syāt, tadarthasya puṃstvābhāvāditi cet, na ; āropem̐ nirvāhasambhavāt | ārope ca liṅgānuśāsanaṃ mānamiti kecit | bhāṣyakṛtastu -- sattvarajastamalāṃ prākṛtaguṇānāṃ vṛddhiḥ ; puṃstvam, apacayaḥ, strītvam, sthimimātraṃ napuṃsakatvam | ata evotkarṣāpakarṣasattve'pi sthitimātramādāya "sāmānye napuṃsakm" ityudadhoṣaḥ | utkarṣāpakarṣasāmyāvasthātrayasādhāraṇasthitimātravivakṣāyāṃ napuṃ sakaṃ bhavatīti tadarthaḥ | īdṛśāvasthātrayasya padārthamātre sattvādidaṃ kevalānvayi ; 'iyaṃ vyaktiḥ', idaṃ vastu, ayaṃ padārthaḥ' iti vyavahārāṇāṃ sarvatrāpratibaddhaprasaratvārthaniṣṭhañca | tathā ca bhāṣyam -- 'ekārthe śabdānyatvāddṛṣṭaṃ liṅgānyatvam, avayavānyatvācceti ' | ekasminnevārthe puṣyaḥ ; tārakā; nakṣatramiti śabdanānātvadarśanāt stanakeśādyatiriktameva liṅgam 'kuṭī, kuṭīraḥ' ityādau rephasyāvayavasyopajane liṅgabhedadarśanāccetyartha iti kaiyaṭaḥ | puṃlliṅgaḥ śabda iti tu vācyavācakayorabhedopacārād bodhyam | arśa ādyajantaṃ vā tat | na caivamavikāriṇi etadabhāvena 'brahman' śabde napuṃsakatānāpattiriti vācyam, ātmani sarvasyāstaddhetvena [ dhyastatvena ] paramparayā tatrāpi tatsattvāt | ata evātmā brahmetyādi vyavahārāḥ | na caivam 'kaścidapi sattvādiḥ svasminnātmani muhūrtamapyatiṣṭhate, varddhate vā, ca yāvadanana vardhitavyamapāyena vā yucyate' iti bhāṣyokterupacayādīnāṃ kṣaṇikatvamavaśyaṃ vācyam, | evañca yugapadviliṅgatvādivyavahārānāpattiriti vācyam, vyavahārasya svasamakālikapadārthasattānapekṣatvāt | ata eva bhūtabhāviviṣayakavyavahāraḥ saṅgacchate | na caivamapyupacayāderviruddhasyaikatra samāveśāyogādekasya triliṅgatānāpattiriti vācyam, kośādiprāmāṇyena virodhasyaivābhāvāt | tatra kaścicchabda ekaliṅgaviśiṣṭārthe eva śaktaḥ, kaściliṅgadvayaviśeṣṭe, kaścittu tritayaviśiṣṭe iti liṅgānuśāsanādibhyo nirṇeyam | evaṃ madhuśabdenopacayasthityubhayaviśiṣṭaṃ makarandādikamevocyate, upacayamātraviśiṣṭaṃ tu caitrādikamityapi tata eva nirṇeyam | eṣu ca puṃsādiśabdānāṃ vṛdhyādivat śāstrīyaḥ saṃketaḥ | ata eva bhāṣye uktam "avaśyaṃ kaścit svakṛtānta āstheyaḥ" iti | tatra ṭighubhādivallaghubhūtasañjñākaraṇasya yuktatvena gurubhūtasañjñākaraṇasāmarthyād natvādiśāstrapravṛttau laukikamapi liṅgaṃ nimittatvenāśrīyate | tatra laukike'sambhave śāstrīye eva | tatsambhave tu sāmanādhikaraṇyasambandhena śāstrīyaviśiṣṭe laukike, na tu kevalalaukike, nāpikevalaśāstrīye, mahāsañjñākaraṇasāmarthyāt, puṃsādisaṃketānāṃ saṃkhyāṃjñāyā ivārthāntarasaṃgrahārthaṃ pravṛttatve'pyarthāntaranirāsārthamapravṛtteśca | ata eva 'cañcāḥ paśya' ityādau śabdaśaktisvabhāvādapacayaviśiṣṭasyaiva pumāderbhānaṅgīkṛtya "lupi yuktavat" [ 1|2|51 ] iti sūtrasya "tadaśiṣyam" [ 1|2|53 ] ityanena pratyākhyānaṃ saṅgacchate | anyathā yuktavadbhāve'bhāvasyāpyatideśānna puṃstvaprayuktaṃ kāryam, pratyākhyāne tu prāpnotīti phalabhedaḥ syāt | evañca striyāṃ paśunetyādiprayukte śāstrīyaliṅga eva, nābhāvādikam | puṃpaśau prayukte tu śāstrīyaviśiṣṭe laukike | ata eva 'paśunā yajeta' ityādau puṃstvasya vivakṣitatvānna striyā yāga iti mīmāṃsakodgheṣaḥ | tatra puṃstvasyetyasya laukikapuṃstvasyetyarthaḥ | 'chāgo vā mantravarṇāt ' iti ṣaṣṭhāntyādhikaraṇanyāyena chāgarūpapaśuviśeṣasyeva mantravarṇasya laukikapuṃstvavivakṣāyāṃ tātparyagrāhakasya sattvācca, 'chāgasya vapāyāḥ' iti mantre 'chāgasya' iti paṭhitasya chāgabhinne iva striyāmasambhavāt | ākārāntacchāgaśabdasya strīvyaktāvaprayogeṇa laukipuṃstvasamānādhikaraṇapāribhāṣikapuṃstvaviśiṣṭe śaktatvāt | śāstrīyamapi liṅgaṃ laukikaliṅgatavat śābdabodhe bhāsate, tathānubhavāt, kośādiprāmāṇyācca ityāhuḥ | vākyapadīye tu -- jātitrayamuktam | tatrāpi pūrvavadeva prakriyā | tistro jātaya evaitāḥ keṣāñcit samavasthitāḥ | aviruddhā viruddhābhirgāmanuṣyādijātibhiḥ || ityuktam | kecit tu -- śabdaniṣṭhameva pāribhāṣikaṃ liṅgam, pum̐lliṅgaḥ śabda ityādivyavahārasyāsati bādhake gauṇatvāyogāt | 'bhāṣitapuṃskāt' ityapyarthabhedena śabdabhedādupapannam | liṅgabhedastu na bhedaprayojakaḥ, 'ekaḥ śabdo'yaṃ dviliṅgaḥ' ityādivyavahārāt | tatra puṃstvenābhāvaḥ strītvādau ṭābādikaṃ dyotakam | tacca śabdaniṣṭhamapi śabdavācyam arthaparicchedakatayānveti | liṅgaviśeṣaviśiṣṭasyaivārthaviśeṣavācakatāyā liṅgānuśāsanaśāstrasiddhatvāt | svāśrayavācyatvasambandhena liṅgārthavyāvarttakatvopapatteḥ | ata eva prayoganiyamo'pi | evañca paśunetyatra puṃstvasya paricchedakatvānna paśustriyā yāgaḥ | na ca paśuśabdasya nityapuṃstvāt padārthādiśabdoditaliṅgavat sādhāraṇyāt kathaṃ strīpaśuvyāvṛttiḥ, 'paśvānaya' iti ṛgvede darśanāt paśuneti puṃstvasya vivakṣitatvamiti nirṇayena ca tasya nityapuṃstvābhānirṇayāt, 'chāgo vā mantravarṇāt' iti ṣaṣṭhāntyādhikaraṇanyāyena nirvāhācca | yathā 'sārasvatau meṣau' ityatra taddhitaprakṛtiḥ [ śabdaḥ ] strīliṅgaḥ, pum̐lliṅgo veti sandehe 'sandigdhe ta vākyaśeṣāt' iti nyāyena 'etadvai daivyaṃ mithunam' ityarthavādādekaśeṣeṇa dvayorgrahaṇaṃ nirṇīyate | na caivaṃ sarvanāmaniṣṭhaliṅgasya cetanācetanasādhāraṇastrīpuṃsasādhāraṇatvāt 'devadatto yajñadattā cāneyā asyai ca mudrā deyā' iti preraṇāyāṃ yajñadattāyā api mudrādānāpattiḥ | pūrvopasthitatattadrūpeṇopastāpakāt sarvanāmno devadattatveneva puṃstvenāpi vyāvṛttapūrvopasthitaparāmarśānna doṣaḥ | ata eva guṇiparaśuklādiśabdānāṃ guṇāṃśasyādhikasya bhāne'pi viśeṣyapadoditaliṅgasaṅkhyāṃśe'nuvādatvena viśeṣyanidhnatopapattiḥ | ata eva padārthamātravivakṣāyāṃ guṇotkarṣāpakarṣarūpaliṅgasyāvivakṣitatvādavarjanīyasāmyāvasthāyā prayogamabhipretya " sāmānye napuṃsakam" iti vidhānaṃ saṃgacchate | "autsargikaikavacana" nyāyādajahalliṅgānāṃ dārādiśabdānāṃ nityabahuvacanāntānāmekasminniva liṅgasyārthaāparicchedakatve'pi tathāprayoga ityāhuḥ | evañca trikaṃ pratīpadikārthaḥ, saṃkhyākārake tu pratyayārtha eva, anantaprakṛtīnāṃ saṃkhyākārakayoḥ śaktikalpanāmapekṣya pratyayānāmeva tatra śaktikalpanāyā ucitatvādita vadanti | pare tu -- saṃkhyāpi prakṛtyartha eva, 'dadhi, madhu' ityādau vinā'pi pratyayaṃ tatprītateḥ | anantaśaktatāvacchedakakalpanāgauravaṃ tu phalamukhatvānna doṣāvaham, tathā gṛhītabodhakatvasya prakṛtimātrādapi tadbodhena teṣāmapi tadbodhakāraṇatvāvaśyakatvena kalpyasyābhāvācca | atiprasaṅgastu tattatsaṃkhyābodhe tattadvibhakatisamabhivyāhārakāraṇatayā parigaraṇīyaḥ | sa ca 'ayaṃ ghaṭaḥ' ityato bodhavāraṇāya tavāpyāvaśyaka ityāhuḥ | kecittu, kārakamapi tathetyābuḥ | na caivam 'nāmārthaprakārakabodhe subādajanyopasthitirhetuḥ' ityādikaṃ vilīyeteti cet, na ; vibhaktidyotyārthamādāyopapatteḥ | ete ca sarve pakṣāḥ "sarūpa" -- sūtrādau bhāṣye spaṣṭā iti dik1 [fn svārtho dravyañca liṅgañca saṅkhyā karmādireva ca | amī pañcaiva nāmārthastrayaḥ keṣāñcidagrimāḥ || iti pañca pakṣā ityarthaḥ | atrāyaṃ vivekaḥ -- saṃkhyāmātraṃ vibhaktyarthaḥ, itaraccatuṣṭayaṃ prātipadikārthaḥ | tathā coktam --- 'vācikā dyotikā vā syurddhitavādīnāṃ vibhaktayaḥ' iti | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- liṅgādinirūpitā ghaṭādiśabde pṛthak pṛthak śaktiraṅgīkarttavyā, ekapadopasthitānāmpyarthānāmākāṅkṣāvaicitryāt parasparamanvayaḥ | tatra liṅgasaṃkhyayoḥ prakṛtyarthe viśeṣaṇatvam, kārakasya viśeṣyatvam | athavā kārakasyāpi dyotakatvād viśeṣaṇatvam | prātipadikasya liṅgasaṃkhyāviśiṣṭārthakatve tvekatvaviśiṣṭe dvitvādiviśiṣṭe ca śaktikalpane gauravam, 'gorūpam' ityādi saṃkhyābhānavaccitrabodhānupapattiśca | viśakalitapadārthatvapakṣetātparyagrāhakatvābhāvāt tādṛśabodhanirvāha iti kecit | anye tu --- dhātuvad viśiṣṭa eva śaktiḥ | kevalaghaṭatvādiviśiṣṭe'pi pṛthak śaktisvīkārāt saṃkhyādyaviṣyakabodhanirvāha ityāhuḥ | eke tu -- pañcānāmapi prātipadikārthaprakārakaśābdabodhe subādijanyopasthitirhetuḥ' ityādervibhaktidyotyarthamādāyopapattiḥ kāryetyāhuḥ | pare tu -- tad‌vilaye'pīṣṭāpattireva, dyotyārthasya viśeṣaṇatvena tādṛśabodhasyaivābhāvāt | ] na ca lakṣaṇayā nirvāhaḥ, 'jabagadetyāha' ityādau śakyāgraheṇa tatsambandharūpalakṣaṇāyā agrahāt | bādhādipratasaṃdhānaṃ vinaiva bodhācca | kiñcānukaraṇasthale yadyanukāryānukaraṇayorbhedaḥ, tadvivakṣā vā, tadā śabdo'pi prātipadikaśakyaḥ | yathā paṭaditi kurvityādyanukāryadhvanīnāmanukaraṇād bhedodhvanimayatvavarṇamayatvādiviruddhadharmapratītyā siddhaḥ | "bhuvo vuk" ityādau tu vivakṣā arthapadārthakatvaśabdapadārthakatvābhyāṃ bhedācca | tathā ca tatra tadupasthityarthamupasthitasya tasya śābdabodhaviṣayatānirvāhārthaṃ ca śaktiravaśyamabhyupeyā | ata
