eva vṛttyārthabodhakatvarūpārthakatvāt prātipadikatve subādyutpattau jaśtvādisiddhiḥ | tayorabhedavivakṣāyāṃ tu śrotreṇopasthita eva śābdabodhe bhāsate, na tu tatra svatantravṛttikalpanā | tathā hi -- 'vattiviṣaya eva śābdaviṣayaḥ' iti niyamo'tiprasaṅganirāsāya kalpyate | sa ca nirūpakatāśrayatānyatarasambandhena vṛttimān tadviṣaya iti niyame'pi naiva bhavati tasya śābdabodhaviṣayatā | nanu evaṃ sati pratyakṣopasthitaghaṭāderapi śābdabodhaviṣayatvāvāraṇāya śābdabuddhiṃ prati vṛttisaṃskārajanyapadārthopasthitirheturityaśyaṃ vācyam | evañcātra vṛttimattve śrotrādupasthitau ca satyāmapi tādṛśopasthiviṣayatvāt kathaṃ śābdabodhaviṣayateti cet, atra vadanti -- gakārādayaḥ kvacicchaktāḥ, varṇatvāt, naktādipadaṃ kvacicchaktam, sādhupadatvāditi sāmānyato'numānena tatpadavācyaḥ kaścidartho'stītyākārakaḥ sāmānyataḥ śaktigrahaḥ eva vācyatvasambandhena padaprakārakabodhe heturityanubhavasiddham | ata evājñātārthakeṣvidamekaṃ padamiti jñāteṣu caitragavayanalādipadeṣu śruteṣu 'ka edarthaḥ' iti praśyane upamānatallakṣaṇakathanādinā kaścit tannāmā rājetyādinā tatprativacanādi ca dṛśyate | ata eva sādṛśyādyupāyena tadbodhakatvenopamānādeḥ prasiddhapadasāmānādhikaraṇyāditastad‌bodhakatvena kośādeśca prāmāṇyaṃ vyutpādayanti | evamevāprasiddhārthakapadeṣavanubhavaḥ, sarvasiddhaḥ, na tu ghaṭādipadeṣviva tattajjātyādirūpeṇa asambhāvitaśca tathābodhaḥ, nalatvādirūpeṇa śaktigrāhakābhāvena tena rūpeṇa bodhakatvāsambhavāt | na cātītanalādibhāvicaitrādirttamānaprasiddhāsannikṛṣṭavastugocarā anādayo dhārārūpeṇa viśiṣyabodhānyathānupapattyā kalpyanta iti naiyāyikanavyoktam [ samīcīnamiti vācyam ], hetvasiddheḥ; vinaiva tattadvācakapadaśravaṇaṃ teṣāṃ smaraṇāpatteśca | ud‌bodhakādhīnavyavasthāyāṃ jñānasaṃskārayoḥ kāraṇatvasyaivāsiddhyāpattiḥ | padaprakārakabodhasyaivānubhavācca | anyathoktapraśnādayucchedaprasaṅgaḥ | kiñca, deśāntaraprasiddhaṃ caitraṃ kāśyāṃ śrṛṇvatāṃ viśiṣṭāgṛhītasaṅgatikānāmapi nalādipadādiva bodhānubhavāt tadanurodhenānādisaṃskārādviśiṣyaśaktigrahasattvābhyupagame teṣāmeva kālāntare gaṅgātaṭe taṃ paśyatām ' caitro'tra nāsti ' iti vākyād bodho na syāt, gaṅgātaṭatvaṃ dharmitāvacchedakīkṛtya caitratvāvacchinnapratiyogitākābhāvavattājñānaṃ prati tadeva dharmitāvacchedakīkṛtya caitratvaprakārakatadvattādhiyaḥ pratibandhakatvasya sarvasiddhatvāt | kiñca, viśiṣyagṛhītasaṃgatikānāmiva taddarśanāt padasmaraṇaṃ syāt 'caitro'tra na vā' ityādisaṃśayaścana syāt | etena premayatvādirūpeṇa sakalānubhavottaraṃ prametvāṃśamoṣe prathamatastajjātiviṣayaṃ nirvikalpakaṃ smaraṇ, tatastattad‌rūpeṇa tattatpadārthopastitimādāya śaktigrahaḥ | na ca sarveṣāmarthānāmevaṃ bodhāpattau sārvajñyāpattiḥ, phalavalakalpyod‌bodhakavaśādeva smṛteḥ kvācitkatvakādācitkatvaniyamādityapāstam, anubhavaviruddhatādṛśasmaraṇakalpane mānābhāvācca | etena varuṇādipadānāṃ pāśahastādipadādupasthite śaktigrahaḥ | na ca tasyāpi śaktigrahāsambhavādanupapattiḥ, yaugikeṣu samudāyaśaktigrahānapekṣaṇāt, avayavānāñca pāśādipadānāṃ loke śaktigrahāt | evamadṛṣṭādipadeṣvapyūhyamiti parāstam, jātiviśeṣarūpeṇa pāśahastādipadādupasthityabhāvena tena rūpeṇa śaktigrahāsbhavāta | anyathā pratyakṣata upasthite varuṇe varuṇādipadeṣu gṛhītaśaktikānāmiva tvaduktarotyāpāśādipade tadgrahavatāṃ pāśādyadarśane'pi vyaktimātradarśanāt 'varuṇo'yam' ityādipratyayāpattiḥ | ata eva 'viṣṇuḥ, nārāyaṇaḥ, kṛṣṇaḥ' ityatra sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ saṅgacchate | anyathā 'ghaṭo ghaṭaḥ' ityetreva tanna syāt | padaprakārakabodhānukūlaśaktigrahastūkta eva | evañca nalādipadebhyo nalapadavācya ityādikrameṇaiva bodhaḥ | tathā ca ghaṭatvādijātivacchaktisambandhena śakyaviśeṣaṇatayā ghaṭādipadajanyaśābdabodhe padasyāpi bhānaṃ nānupapannam | tatra ghaṭatvādijātivacchabdāṃśe na vṛttiviṣayatvam, mānābhāvāt, āśrayatvenaiva tatkāryasiddheḥ | tathā ca sambandhobhayanirūpyatvena sambandhidvayopasthāpakatvāviśeṣād ghaṭatvādyavacchinnaśaktyaiva ghaṭādivacchabdasyāpyupasthitau satyāmarthabodhanatātparye sati viśeṣamatayā śabdo bhāsata iti na doṣaḥ| tatrāpi ghaṭatvādirūpeṇa viśiṣya śaktigrahavadbhyo ghaṭādiradebhyaḥ padajātyubhayaprakārako bodhaḥ | nalādipadebhyastu pūrvoktaprakāreṇa tadasādhāraṇadharmānupasthityā sāmānyarūpeṇopasthitavyaktau śaktigrahāt 'kevalavyaktiviśeṣyakaḥ, kevalapadaprakārako nalādipadavācyaḥ kaścidarthaḥ' ityākārako bodhaḥ | 'gavityayamāha' ityādau 'iti' śabdasamabhivyāhāravaśāt kvacit "svaṃ rūpam" [ 1|1|68 ] ityādiśāstrabalāt kvacit prakaramādivaśāt, kvacidanvayayogyatākāṅkṣādivaśāt śabdamātre tātparyaṃ gṛhyate | tatra 'ghaṭo nityaḥ, svargrī dhvastaḥ' ityādau viśeṣaṇāṃśavacchabdasvarūpamātraṃ prādānyena tayā śaktyā bodhyate | vṛttisattve'pi tātparyavirahādarthāṃśo na bodhyate, lavamamātratātparyadaśāyāṃ saindhavaśabdādaśvavad buddho vā tyajyate | na cārthaśaktyaiva tātparyavaśāt prādhānyena śabdasyāpi bhānamityayuktam, tatprakārakavyaktiviśeṣyakabodhatvasyaiva tadvṛttijñānakāryatāvacchekatvāt | anyathā 'ghaṭo nityaḥ' ityādau ghaṭatve lakṣaṇā na syāt | prādhānyena bodhārthaṃ khalu tatra lakṣaṇāśrayaṇamiti vācyam, tatra ghaṭatvatvādirūpema bodhānurodhena lakṣaṇābhyupagamāt | anyathā ghaṭatvanirvikalpakāpattiḥ | atrānupūrvīviśiṣṭavarṇānāṃ padarūpatvena kevalatadupasthitāvapyānupūrvyā avacchedakatvena bhānānnoktadoṣaḥ | viśeṣyavyaktyaṃśābhānāt padasya viśeṣaṇatvaṃ nāstīti prādhānyamapyarthā [dā] yātam | moṣavādinyāyanaye prameyatvaprakārakasakalānubhavāt pramuṣṭaviśeṣaṇakavyaktimātrasmaraṇābhyupagamavat pramuṣṭaviśeṣaṇakaśabdamātrasmaraṇe bādhakābhāvāt, 'uccāraya' ityādisambhivyāhārasya moṣa evopayogāt | evañcārthaśaktijñānasyaiva padaprakārakabodhatvādikāryatāvacchedakamiti na doṣaḥ | śaktigrahavatsaṃskārairapūsthitatvena vṛttijanyopasthitiścāstīti bodhyam | etena 'gāmuccāraya' ityukte vikṛtasyaivoccāraṇāpattiḥ, tādṛśasyaiva śrotreṇopasthiteḥ | śabdasayāprakṛtyarthatvāt tatra dvitīyārthādyanvayānāpattiḥ | svasyaiva pratyakṣaema śīghramupasthityā gaurastītyādāvapi svaparatvāttiścetyādi parāstam | uktatātparyavaśād vṛttyā'vikṛtasyaiva śabdādupasthiteḥ | na caivaṃ tātparyeṇaiva sarvanarvāhevṛttimātroccedaḥ, tasya śabdasāmānye'hetutvāt | kintu kvacicchabdajanyabadhasya pramātve niyāmakam, kvacit tathābodhe'pīti na vṛttiṃ vinā nirvāha ityādivākyasphoṭe nirūpayiṣyāmaḥ | evañca sati tātparye śabdaḥ pradhānam, tadabhāve dhātvarthaviśeṣaṇameveti siddham . ata eva 'udbhidā yajeta' ityādau nāmadheyatvaṃ vyasthāpya tasya viśeṣaṇatvenānvayāt 'udbhidabhinnena yāgeneṣṭaṃ bhāveyet' iti vākyārthaḥ | sañjñātvāvagamastu sāmānādhikaraṇyāt | yataḥ sāmānādhikaramyaṇyaṃ viśaṣaṇaviśeṣyayorvā, sañjñāsañjñinorvā | tatrodbhitpadaprasiddhārthasya vinā lakṣaṇāṃ yāgasāmānādhikaraṇyānupapatternīlamutpalamityādiviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvāsambhave na padaparatvamāśritya dvitīye paryavasānam | viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvapadena ca vācakatātiriktasambandhāvacchinnaparicchedyaparicchedakabhāva ucyate | guṇaguṇyādyoriva vācyavācakayorabhedasyāpi 'ayaṃ gauḥ' ityatra kaḥ śabdaḥ iti bhāṣye tadvyākhyānakaustubhe, "vṛddhirādaic" [1|1|1] sūtrabhāṣye ca spaṣṭamuktatvāt | yāgavācakatā codbhitpade yogarūḍhibhyām | evañca tadbodhottaraṃ vijātīyayāgatvāvacchinne tatpadaśaktigrahe vṛtte'nyatrodbhitpadena tenaiva rūpeṇa yāgopasthitiḥ, padaprakārikaiva vetyanyat | "vṛddirādaic" [1|1|1] ityādāvapi 'vṛddhipadābhinnā ādaicaḥ' iti vākyārthaḥ, prasiddhavṛddhipadārthasyādaicpadārthābhedabodhe pūrvoktānupapatteścārthapadobhayaparatā | sāmānādhikaraṇyasambandhenārthaviśiṣṭapadābhedastatra vākyārthaḥ | evañca saṃjñina uddiśca sañjñābhūtapadābheda eṣu vidheyaḥ | na ca padam uddiśya sañjñyabheda eva vidheyo'stu | ata eva "vṛddhirāraic" ityatrādaicāṃ paranirdeśa iti vācyam, "adeṅ guṇaḥ" [1|1|2] ityādau doṣāpatteḥ, maṅgalārthaṃ vṛddhiśabdasya pūrvaṃ pāṭha ityādibhāṣyaprāmāṇyena saṃjñāpadasyaiva vidheyatvaucityācca, ṭighubhādisaṃjñāpadānāṃ mānāntarāsiddhatvenoddeśyatvāsambhavācca | uccāraṇakṛtaśabdasiddhistu nāsmacchāstre vidheyatāpratibandikā, paṇādīnāṃ vidheyatvānāpatteriti dik | kecittu, pūrvoktānupapattyevodbhidādipadānāṃ tatkāla eva naladipadavat tatpadavācyatvena sāmānyarūpeṇa śaktigrahaḥ, tenaiva ca bodha ityāhuḥ | yattu,mīmāṃsakamate nāmni lakṣaṇeti | tat, na ; uktarītyā klṛptaśaktyaiva siddheḥ | kiñcaivaṃ nāmadheyatvocchedaḥ guṇavidhau matvarthalakṣaṇābhiyā hi nāmadheyatvamuktam, sā nāmadheyatve'pi cet kuto guṇavidhitvatyāgaḥ ? sāmānādhikaraṇyānupapatterguṇavidhāvivātrāpi bījatvenāpekṣaṇāt | nahi vinā bīje lakṣaṇeti dik | ata eva kathitapadatvaṃ doṣo'pi kvacinna doṣaḥ | udeti savitā tāmrastāmra evāstameti ca | sampattau ca vipattau ca mahatāmekarūpatā || ityatra tāmrapadaṃ vinā na tādṛśo bodha iti kāvyaprakāśoktaṃ saṅgacchate | taduktaṃ hariṇā --- grāhyatvaṃ grāhakatvañca dve śaktī tejaso yathā | tathaiva sarvaśabdānāmete pṛthagavasthite || asyārthaḥ -- andhakāre cākṣuṣavāraṇāya dravyacākṣuṣamātre ālokasaṃyogo heturityavaśyaṃ vācyam | evañca ghaṭālokasaṃyogādeva ghaṭasyevālokyāpi yathā pratyakṣam, tathārthagocaraśabdaniṣṭhaśaktyaiva śabdasyārthasya ca bhānam | yathā vā ghaṭacakṣuḥsaṃyogābhāve tasmādevālokasaṃyogādālokasyaiva bhānam, tathārthe tātparyavirahe tad‌vṛttyaiva śabdamātrabodha iti | pera tu, vṛtyānupasthitāvapi abhihitānvayavāde vṛttiṃ vinaiva yathā''kāṅkṣādi vaśāt saṃsargasya śābdobodhe bhānam, tathā śābdajñānasāmānyasāmagryaiva tātparyā'|ñakāṅkṣādivaśāt 'gaurnityā, gauranityā' ityādau gotvāderiva svātantryeṇa viśeṣaṇatvena vā bhānam | 'parvate bahniḥ' iti śābdānumityāditaḥ sahaiva vahnyarthipravṛttidarśanāt 'astirbhavanatīparo'prayujyamāno'pyasti' iti bhāṣyācca jñānasāmānyasāmagryā evārkhaviśeṣaṇatayā varttamānakālabhāsakatvakalpanavat sarvatra śābdavodhe 1 [fn śabdasya śābdabodhaviṣayatvaṃ svīkurvatāṃ śābdikānāmayamāśayaniṣkarṣaḥ -- pravṛttinimittatadāśrayādyarthasya śabdasya ca jñānamātre viṣayatvam | śabdasya ānupūrvyāśca nivikalpakajñānavad viśakalitayorbhānam | tataśca 'paṭaḥ paṭaśabdavācyaḥ' iti viśiṣyaṃ jñānaṃ jāyate | paramata iva vaiyākaraṇamate'pi kālaviśeṣasya adṛṣṭaviśeṣasya vā kāraṇatvakalpanena ghaṭapadaprayogakāle ghaṭarūpārthasya vācakasya sarvasya kalaśādipadabhānaṃ na syāt | yathā paṭatvasya nirvikalpakabodhakāle dravyatatvasya bhānaṃ na bhavati | 'omityekākṣaraṃ brahma' iti śruteḥ, 'rāmeti dvayakṣaraṃ nāma' iti vacanāt, "vṛddhirādaic" (1|1|1) iti sāmānādhathikaraṇyānurodhācca śabdārthayostādātpye | arthaviśeṣyakaparāmarśa eva śabda numittau kāraṇam | tādātmyasya bhedābhedaghaṭitatvena bhedasyolvaṇatvavivakṣāyāṃ 'paṭarūpo'rthaḥ paṭaḥ śabdo na' ityādivyavahārāḥ saṃgacchanta ityala prapañcena | ]śabdabhānānubhavāt śābdasāmānyasāmagryā eva śabdabhāsakatvakalpanāt | evañca prakāratāviśeṣyatānyatarasambandhena padabhinnaviṣayakaśābdaṃ pratyeva padajanyapadārthopasthiteḥ kāraṇatvaṃ kalpyate | pratyayānāṃ prakṛtayarthānvitasvārthabodhakatvamiti vyutpattau prakṛtyarthatvañca 'prakṛtijanyabodhaviṣayatvam' iti 'gāmuccāraya' ityādau na karmatvādyanvayānupapattiḥ | na ca ghaṭapadajanyabodhe sakalaparyāyāṇāṃ prakāratayā bhānāpattiḥ, vinigamakābhāvāditi vācyam, tattatpada prakārakabodhe tattatpadajñānaghaṭitaśābdasāmānyasāmagryā hetutvenādoṣādityāhuḥ | evañca vṛttyāśratayā padopasthitāvapi tasya vṛttiviṣayatvābhāvena vṛttiviṣayabodhakatvarūpārthavattvābhāvāt prātipadikatvābhāvena 'bhū sattāyām' 'gavityayamāha' ityādau vibhaktyanutpattiḥ, tadanutpattāvapi sādhutvamastyeva pariniṣṭhitatvāt | "bhuvo vug luṅliṭoḥ" [ 6|4|88 ] ityādi tu bhedavikṣāpakṣe sādhu | anayośca lakṣyānurodhena vyavasthā | samānānupūrvīkaśabdamātraviṣayakabodhajanakatvamanukaraṇatvam | na caivaṃ gaṇapaṭhitānāmanukaraṇatvena kriyāvācakatvābhāvaḥ, prayogasthānāṃ gaṇapaṭhitatvamiti bhūvādisūtrasaṅ gatiriti vācyam, gaṇapaṭhitaśabdavācyatvarūpasya gaṇapaṭhitatvasya vivakṣitatvānna doṣa ityāhuḥ | kecittu, anukaraṇaṃ sādṛsyasambandhena svasadṛśaśabdānupasthāpayati, tathopasthitasyāpi ākāṅkṣādivaśādupasthitasambandhasyeva śābdabodhe'nvayapratiyogitvaṃ vyutpattivaicitryāt, anubhavabalāt, tātparyavaśācca svīkriye | kṛtyapadajanyapadārthopasthiteranukaraṇājanyaśābdabuddhitvameva kāryatāvacchedakam | 'pratyayānāṃ prakṛtyarthānvita' ityādivyutpattau prakṛtyarthatvañca prakṛtijanyabodhaviṣayatvam | ato 'gāmuccāraya' ityādau na karmatavādyanvayānupapattiḥ | anukaraṇatvañca svasadṛśaśabdamātratātparyakoccāraṇaviṣayatvamityāhuḥ | sarvanāmnāñca 'baddhiviṣayatāvacchedakatvopalakṣitadharmāvacchinnabodhakaṃ tadādipadam' ityākāraḥ śaktigrahaḥ | tatra śaktigrahaviṣayatāyā ananugataghaṭatvapaṭatvādiniṣṭhāyā apyanugatarūpāvacchinnatayā śaktyaikyam | ghaṭādipadasaṃketaviṣayatānāṃ nānāghaṭavyaktiniṣṭhānāṃ ghaṭatvādyanugatadharmāvacchinnatvena tatpadaśaktyaikyavat | ityāṃstu viśeṣaḥ --- tatra ghaṭatvādiprakārakabodhānubhavāt teṣāṃ dharmitāvacchedakatākhyaviṣayatayā śaktigrahaviṣayatvamupeyate ; śaktigrahaviṣaye bodhe viṣayatāyāḥ prakāratvañca | evaṃ paśvadiśabdānāṃ lomatvenānugatalomavallāṅgūlaśaktānāṃ tacchaktigrahaviṣayatvam | tayā viṣatayā lomatvādīnāmupeyate | prakṛta buddhisthatvasya śābdabodhe'bhānāt tasya tayā viṣayatayā śaktigrahāviṣayatvena śaktigrahaviṣayabodhe viṣayatayā'prakāratvena ca tasyopalakṣaṇatvamiti | dharmitāvacchedakatvañca tadāśrayaniṣṭhaviṣayatānirūpakatvam | buddhisthatve ca tādṛśaviṣayatā sāmānādhikaraṇyamātramiti na tatprakārakabodhāpattiḥ | dharmitāvacchedakatvena, viśeṣyatvena vā śaktigrahaviṣayasyaiva śaktigrahaviṣayabodhe viṣayatayā prakārasyaiva ca tajjanyabodhaviṣayatvaṃ phalabalāt kalpyate | na cāpūrve dharma śaktigrahāsambhavaḥ, buddhiviṣayatāvacchedakatvasāmānyalakṣaṇāpratyāsattyopasthite dharmamātre śaktigrahākṣateḥ | sāmānyapratyāsattyanaṅgīkāre tu buddhiprakāratayā gṛhītapaṭatvādiviśiṣṭavyavahāradarśanāt tatra tatpadasya śaktiṃ gṛhītvā yadyattatpadaṃ yādṛśayādṛśadharmāvacchinniviṣayakabuddhyā prayujyate, tattatpadaṃ tādṛśadharmāviśiṣṭaśaktamiti sāmānyato vyāptimavadhārayati | tadanantarañca pratyakṣeṇa gṛhītacaitracatvādiviśiṣṭaviṣayakabuddhiprayojyatvaṃ prakaraṇādinā yatra, tattat‌padetādṛśahetunā caitratvaviśiṣṭavācakatvasya prāgasiddhasyāpi pakṣadharmatābalādanumityātmakaniścayenāvagāhanānnānupapattiḥ | ata eva tatpadāt kadācid ghaṭa iti, kadācijjatimāniti, kadācijjātimān ghaṭa iti, kadācid buddhistho ghaṭa iti bodhaḥ saṅgacchate | na ca haryādipadaśakyatāvacchedakānāmapyupalakṣaṇībhūtena buddhiviśeṣaviṣayatvādipadenānugamasambhavena nānārthocchedāpattiḥ, tadādibhyaḥ pūrvoktarītyā nānārūpeṇaikasyāpi bodhānubhavāt tathāṅgīkāre'pi haryādipadebhyastathā'nanubhavena tatkalpanāyogāt | ata eva teṣāṃ nānārthatvemava | anyathā haryādipadebhyo'pi kadācijjātimān harirityādyākārabodhāpattiḥ | na ca kiñcitprakāreṇa bhāsamāne dharme'vacchedakatvabhāne tadviśiṣṭa eva bhāsate, na tadupalakṣita iti niyamaḥ | ata eva jātimānnāstītyato na svarūpeṇa ghaṭatvāvacchinnābhāvabodhaḥ | evañca buddhisthatvaviśiṣṭa eva dharmitāvacchedakatvāvagāhanāt tadviśiṣṭasyaiva bodhāpattiriti vācyam, avacchekatvasya saṃsargavidhayā bhāna eva yathā niyamāt | śaktigrahastvavacchedyāvacchedakabhāvaprakāra eveti na doṣaḥ | na cedānīmuccāritatatpadāt kālāntarīṇadeśantarīṇabuddhisthadharmāvacchinnasyāpi bodhāpattiriti vācyam, tātparyajñānakāraṇatayā nirvāhāt | vyaktisthānīyā pattyabhāvācca | śakyatācchedakāvacchinnabodhasya jāyamānatvena tadāpādakābhāvācca | evaṃ yuṣmadasmadoḥ svasambodhyatāvacchedakatvasvoccārayitṛtvācchedakarūpānugatadharmopalakṣitacaitratvādikaṃ pravṛttinimittamiti bodhyam | "devyuvāca --- mayā tvayi hate'traiva garjiṣyantyāśudevatāḥ" ityādau ṛṣyuccāritavākyena tādṛśānupūrvīrūpasāmānyapratyāsattyā devovākyasyāpi jñānād devīmahiṣāsurayostādṛśavākyaprayoktṛtvasambodhyatvapratisandhānādeva yuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ devīmahiṣāsurādipratītirnirvāhyā | anivādakaṛṣitatsambodhyayostu tātparyābhāvānna pratītiḥ | na caivaṃ maunipuruṣajñānaparāt 'ayamahaṃ paṇḍitaḥ' iti jānāmīti vākyasthāsmatpadena mauninaḥ pratītyanāpattiḥ, tasyoccārayitṛtvābhāvāditi vācyam, uccāraṇenānusandhānopalakṣaṇānna doṣaḥ | na caivaṃ buddhiviṣayatāvacchedakarūpāvacchinna eva yuṣmadasmadauḥ śaktirastu, kiṃ sambodhyatvādyavacchedakāvacchinne śaktikalpanayā ? ati prasaṅgabhaṅstu tātparyavirahādeveti vācyam, tātparyasattve'pi caitroccāritāt 'ahaṃ karomi' iti vākyādanyaṃ bodhayituṃ prayuktāt 'tvaṃ gaccha' iti vākyāccoccārayitṛtvasambodhyatvabhramaṃ vinā maitrādibodhasya sarvānubhavaviruddhatvāt | anyathā tātparyeṇa svarasta eva tathāprayogāpatteḥ | buddhiviṣayayāvattvāvacchinnaḥ sarvaśabdārthaḥ, yāvattvamatraikatvātiriktasaṅkhyākṛtaḥ paricchedaḥ | yāvattvānāñca buddhiviṣayatavanānugamaḥ | 'sarvaṃ odanaṃ bhuṅkte' ityādau tvavayavagatasaṅkhyāparicchedasyāvayavinyāropo bodhyaḥ | yatra tu yāvattvena ghaṭatvādiviśiṣṭānāmapi sarve āneyā iti sarvaśabdamātrād bodhaḥ, tatra lakṣaṇā bodhyā | yadvā, buddhiviṣayāvacchedakayātavattvena buddhiviṣayaghaṭatvādiśāliṣu sarvaśabdasya śaktiḥ | 'sarve ghaṭāḥ' ityādau tu viśeṣanirṇayāya ghaṭādiśabdaprayoga ityāhuḥ | kiṃpadasya jijñāsāviṣayadharmāvacchinne śakti, ata eva svīyajijñāsājñāpanāya kiṃpadaghaṭitapraśnavākyaṃ saṅgacchate | evañca kaḥ pacatītyato jijñāsā viṣayadharmārvācchinnakartṛkaḥ pāka iti bodhaḥ | tadviṣayakajijñāsāyāstadicchāviṣayībhūtajñānajanakāt 'vipraḥ pacati' ityādita eva nivṛttiriti tādṛśapraśnānantaraṃ tadevottaram | na ca prameyaṃ pacatītyapyuttaraṃ syāt, tajjanyajñānasyāpi tādṛśecchāviṣayatvāditi vācyam, uddeśyavācakakiṃpadasya svasamabhivyāhṛtapadopasthāpyakartṛvṛttidharmavyāpyadharmāvachinna eva śaktyabhyupagamenādoṣāt | evam 'ko brāhmaṇaḥ pacati' ityādau abhedena svārthānvitoddeśyavācakapadāntarasamabhivyāhṛtakiṃpadasya svārthābhedānvayipadārthatāvacchedakadharmavyāpyadharmāvacchinne śaktiḥ, atastatra 'caitraḥ pacati' ityevottaram, na tu 'manuṣyaḥ pacati' iti | evaṃ prāyeṇa yatra kiṃpadārthānvayaḥ, tad‌vṛttidharmavyāpyadharmāvacchinna eva padasya śaktirbodhyā | kvacittu svānvayidharmavyāpyadharmāvacchinna eva śaktirityādyūhyam | evam 'ayaṃ kaḥ' ityādau bidheyavācakakiṃpadasya samabhivyāhṛtapadopasthāpyatāvacchedakatvopalakṣitadharmāvacchinnoddeśyatānirūpitavidheyatāvacchedakatayā jijñāsito yo viśeṣadharmaḥ, tadavacchinne śaktiḥ | ata eva tatrāyaṃ brāhmaṇa ityevāttaram | 'mukhaṃ kiminduḥ' ityādau avyayakimo vitarko'rthaḥ | vitarkaśca prayoktuḥ sambhāvanātmakaṃ jñānam | evañcābhedenenduprakārakasambhāvanāviśeṣyo mukhamiti bodhaḥ | evaṃ dhanimidaṃ kiṃ caitrasyetyādāvāśrayatvādisambandhena caitrasvaprakārakasambhāvanāviśeṣyo dhanamiti bodhaḥ | kimindurityādau sambhāvanābodhottaraṃ tatprayojakāhlādakatvādisādharmyapratītistvarthāt | kiṃ gaurityādau kutsārthakamapi tat | tatpadapratipādyatayā vaktṛbuddhiviṣayatāvacchedakatvopalakṣitadharmāvaccinne yatpadasya śaktiḥ | atastenārthapratyāyane niyamatastatpadāpekṣā, tatpadasamabhivyāhāraṃ vinoktānugamakadharmāgraheṇa śaktiparicchedasyāsambhavāt | tacchabdajanyapratipatteḥ pūrvamapitatpratipādyatayā vakturabhisambandhaḥ prakaraṇādinā sugraha iti na tacchabdajapratīteryatpadaśaktigrahe'pekṣā | tatrottaravākyagatayacchabdasya tacchabdākṣepasamarthatvena na tatra tacchabdopādānāpekṣā | yathā 'candramasi puṣkarauḥ kṛtaṃ milinaṃ yadabhirāmatādhike' ityādau | evaṃ yatpadopasthāpye tatpadaśaktirbodhyā | tatra prasiddhānubhūtaprakāntārthakatacchabdasya yacchabdākṣepaḥ, samarthatvāt | na tatra yacchabdopādānāpekṣeti kāvyapradīpādau vistaraḥ | idametadoḥ pratyakṣabuddhiviṣaye, adasaḥ parokṣabuddhiviṣaye śaktiḥ | svapadasya svasamabhivyāhṛtapadopasthāpye śaktiḥ | samabhivyāhāraścātraikavākyaghaṭakatvam | samabhivyāhṛtapadopasthāpyaśca samabhivyāhṛtakriyākārakapadārtha eva gṛhyate | tena caitrasya bhrātā svaputraṃ paśyatītyādau svaśabdena na caitrapratītiḥ | svaputradarśitaṃ caitraṃ maitraḥ paśyatītyādau ca na caitraputrabodhānupapattiḥ | ata eva 'kalaśe nijahetudaṇḍajaḥ kimi cakrabhramikāritā guṇaḥ' ityādāvadhyāhṛtakriyākārakasya kalaśasya svaśabdasamānārthakanijapadena pratītiḥ | yadā tu ṣaṣṭhyarthasya kriyāyāmanvayaḥ, tatra tadarthabodhako'pi svaśabdaḥ | yathā 'svavyāpakavahnisāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ dhūmasyāsti' ityādau | idamevābhipretya 'sarvanāmnāmutsargataḥ pradhānaparāmarśitvam' ityucyate | tatra pradhānaparāmarśitavamityasya prādhānānvayiparāmarśakatvamityathaḥ | ekaḥ śabdaḥ kaivalyādiviśiṣṭe śaktaḥ | kaivalyañca sajātīyadvitīyarahitatvam | tacca sajātīyaniṣṭhabhedāpratiyogitvam | tathā ca 'ayameko'tra bhuṅkte' ityādāvetaddeśādhikaraṇakabhojanakarttṛniṣṭhabhedāpratiyogī | 'ayamatra bhuṅkte' ityākārako bodha ityādyūhyamiti sarveṣṭasiddhiḥ | iti nāmārthanirṇayaḥ | <12> atha subarthavicāraḥ athaitatprakṛtikasubartho nirṇīyate tathādau prathamāvibhaktacarthavicāraḥ tatra prathamādvitīyātṛtīyācaturthīpañcamīṣaṣṭhīsaptamītyākhyā vibhatkayaḥ sapta |tatra prathamāyāḥ śaktigrāhakaṃ sūtram "prātipādikārthe prathamā" iti | yasmin prātipadike uccārite yasyārthasyopasthitiḥ, sa tatprātipadikārthaḥ| tena śakyalakṣayagauṇālāṃ sarvāṣāṃ saṃgrahaḥ | 'kṛṣṇaḥ sundaraḥ' itayādau prakṛtyarthānuvādikā vibhaktiḥ, abhedaḥ saṃsargaḥ, kṛṣṇābhinnaḥ sundara iti bodhaḥ | liṅga tu prātipadikasya vārthaḥ | prātyayo dyotaka itinirūpitaṃ nāmārthavāde saṃkhyā'pi vācyā, dyotyā vetyapi tatraiva nirūpitam | 'siho māṇavakaḥ, droṇo brīhiḥ' ityādau sihadiroṇādiṇādipadānāṃ sihasadṛśe droṇaparicchedau ca lakṣaṇā bodhyā | atra sūtre prātipadikaśabdena tatprakṛtikaliṅgabodhakapratyayaviśiṣṭamapi gṛhyate, prātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇam iti paribhāṣaṇāt | tena 'indrāṇī' ityādau prathamāsiddhiriti dik | idamapi sūtraṃ ktiyāyoga eva pravarttate, "karmaṇi dvitīyā" [2|3|2] ityādisāhacaryāt, tathaivākāṅkṣitatvācca | ata eva 'tiṅsamānādhikaraṇe prathamā' | ata eva 'astirthavantīparo'prayujyamāno'pyasti' iti bhāṣyādigranthaḥ saṅgacchate | yatra tu ktiyā na śrūyate, tatrāp‌yadhyāhāro bodhyaḥ | ekaśabdādāvapi ananvitārthakaprayogāpekṣayā'nuvādakaprayogasya nyāyyatvādekavacanādi bodhyamityāhuḥ | saṃbodhanamapi prathamārthaḥ, "sambodhane ca" [2|3|4|7] iti sūtrasvarasāt | tatra sambodhanaṃ jñāpanam, ata eva jñāpyarthakaḥ 'sambodhyamāno dvadattaḥ' iti vyavahāraḥ saṅgacchate | tajjñāpanārthameva sambodhanavibhatkyantapadaghaṭitavākyaprayogaḥ, tatphalaṃ pravṛttinivṛttyādikam | tatra samityupasargopādānaṃ samyaktvabodhanārtham | tenasambodhanavibhaktipanuvādyaviṣayiṇī 1. [fn ata eva sambodhanavibhakterapi kārakavibhaktitvaṃ sidhyati | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-- 'siddhasyābhimukhībhāvamātraṃ sambodhanaṃ viduḥ | prāptābhimukhyo hyarthātmā kriyāsu viniyujyate ||' iti haryutkeḥ, lādhavācca bodhāya sammukhībhāvaḥ sambodhanamiti vyutpatteḥmukhaparāvṛttayādyabhivyaṅgaco'bhimukhībhāva evātra sambodhanam | tasya ca saṅkhayāyā iva prakṛtyarthe devadattāderāśrayatvasambandhenānvayaḥ | tasya vibhaktyarthatvam, prakṛtyarthatvameva vtyanyadetat | prakṛtyarthasya ca kriyāsu viniyujyate ityuktyā pravartanānvayadvārā vidhyarthapravartanāyāmevānvayaḥ | tathā'nvayasvīkārādeva 'nāmārthadhātvarthayorabhedānvaya eva' iti vyutpattivirodho'pi na | pravartanāyāśca viṣayatvasambandhena gamanakriyāyāmanvayaḥ | evañca 'devadatta tvaṃ gaccha' ityādau abhimukhībhavaddevadattābhinnayuṣmaga ryoddeśyakapravartanādiviṣayo gamanamiti bodhaḥ |] ktiyānvayinī ceti bodhyam | tena 'rājā bhava , yudhyasva, indraśatrurvardhasva' ityādau na sambodhanavibhaktiḥ, idānīmapi rājatvasyāsiddhatvenānuvādyatvābhāvāt | ata eva 'rājan yudhyasva' ityasya kumārāvasthāyām ; 'rājābhava, yuvyasva' ityasya ca rājāvasthāyāṃ na prayogaḥ | heśabdādikañca sambodhanatātparyagrāhakam | acetane tu cetanātvāropeṇa gauṇaḥ prayogaḥ | atra ca samabodhanaṃ prakṛtyartha prati viśeṣyam, krayāṃ prati ca viśeṣaṇam | tena 'rāma pāhi' ityādau rāmasambandhisambodhanaviṣayastrāṇamiti bodhaḥ | sambodhanavibhaktoranuvādyaviṣayatayā anuvādyasya ca vidheyasākāṅkṣatayā, vidheyasya ca kriyārūpatvena tadanvayasyaivaucityāt | 'he devadatta tvaṃ sundaraḥ' ityādau 'asi' ityadhyāhāro bodhyaḥ | ata eva dhiṅ mūrkhetyādau kriyādhyāhāre prathamā | mūrkhasambandhisambodhanaviṣayā nindyā kriyeti vodhaḥ | kriyāyā nindyatvañca sarvāsaṃtamūrkhādikartṛkatvameva | tadabhāvedvitīyā, mūrkhasambandhinindeti bodhaḥ | ata eva 'vrajāni devadatta' ityādau 'ekatiṅvākyam' ityekavākyatvādāmantritasya ceti nighātasiddhiḥ | kriyāṃ pratyaviśeṣaṇatve tu naitatsighyet | e yattu, 'rāma pāhi' ityatra sambodhyarāmakartṛkaṃ rakṣaṇamarthaḥ | sambodhanaṃ prakṛtyartha prati viśeṣaṇam, prakṛtyarthaścākhyātārthe'bhedena viśeṣaṇam | uktarītyā bodhe tu 'bho bkāhyaṇāstva paca' iti prayogāpattiḥ | na caivam 'rāma pāhi' ityādau prathamapuruṣāpattiḥ, "yuṣmadyupapade" [2|4|205] ityatra yuṣmadityasyārthaparatvena yuṣmadaśca sambodhyamānārthakatayā rāmetyasyāpi tadarthatvādakṣateriti, tat na: 'hi rāma śivo gacchati kāśīm' ityādau pratyayārthānvasya vaktumaśakyatvāt | kiñca yuṣmadityārthaparatve 'herāma bhavān gacchati' ityatra madhyamapuruṣāpattiḥ: bhavadarthasya sambodhyāsambodhyasādhāraṇatve'pi prakṛte sambodhanasamabhivyāhāreṇa sambodhyamātrārthatvāt | arthaparatvābhāve tu 'rāma pāhi' ityādau madhyamo durupapādaḥ, tvamityādhyāhāre tu tasyaivākhyātārthenābhedānvayāt 'rāma' ityanenānvayo durupapādaḥ | yattu, bho brāhyaṇāstvaṃ paceti syāditi, tat,na :kimatra sarveṣāṃ sambodhyamānabrāhyaṇānāṃ kartṛtvam, uta anyatamasyaiva, uta sambodhyamānātiriktasya ? nādyaḥ, tvamityekavacanāntenollekhānāpatteḥ : na dvitīyaḥ, anyeṣāṃ jñāpane phalābhāvena tajjñāpanasya vyarthatvāpatteḥ | 'tvaṃ bhuṅakṣva, tvaṃ snāhi' ityādibhinnakriyāpratipādanatātparye tviṣṭāpattiḥ | etena tṛtīyo'pi nirastaḥ | kiñca, śabdaśaktisvābhāvyena sambodhanavibhaktyantapadasamabhivyāhāre yuṣmadastatpadabodhyaparāmarśakatvasyaiva lokasiddhatvena tadatiriktasya tvaṃpadārthatāvaktumaśakyā | ata eva tava mate 'he devadata ayaṃ pacati' ityādau sambodhyamānasya kartṛ tvaṃ na, śabdaśaktisvābhāvyena sambodhyena sambodhyamānātiriktasyaivedārthatvāditi dik | iti prathamāvibhaktyarthavicāraḥ | <13> atha dvitīyāvibhaktyarthavicāraḥ dvitīyādayo dvividhāḥ -- kārakavibhaktayaḥ, upapadavibhaktayaśca | tatra kārakāṇi ṣaṭ -- karttā, karma, karaṇ, saṃprādānam, apādānam, adhikaraṇañceti | tatra kārakatvaṃ kriyānyitvam | ata eva 'brahmaṇasya putraṃ panthānaṃ pṛcchati' ityādau brahmaṇasya na kārakatvam, kriyānvayitvābhāvāt | anyathā sundarādiviśiṣṭasya putrasya kriyāvyāpyatvena sundarādīnāṃ karmakārakatvavad brāhmamasambandhiputrasya viśiṣṭasya kriyāvyāpyaptena tasyāpi tattvaṃ syāt | sundarādīnāñca 'arūṇādhikaraṇa'nyāyena, kriyānvayitvam ; putradvārā [vā] evañca sākṣātkriyānavayyabhinnatayā [vā ?] kriyānvayitvaṃ kārakatvam, taditiriktasambandhahaṇe mānābhāvāt, bhedasambandhasya bahiraṅgatvācca | yatu, kriyāntavitapratyāyārthānviyitvaṃ kārakatvamiti, tat , na ; pakva ityādau pratyayārthasya kārakatvānāpatteḥ | etena kriyānvitavibhaktyarthānvayitvaṃ kārakatvamityapāstam, pakva odana ityādau odanādeḥ karmakatavānāpatteḥ | yadapi, 1[fn atrāyaṃ niṣkarṣaḥ -- kriyājanakatvaṃ kārakatvamiti kārakasāmānyalakṣaṇ | tacca janakatvaṃ kāraṇatvarūpam | kāraṇatvañcāthāsiddhiśūnyatve sati kārayāvyavahitaprākakṣṇāvacchedena kāryasamānādhikaraṇātyantābhāvapratiyogitvānavacchedakadharmavattvam | evañca 'caitrasya taṇḍulaṃ pacati' ityādau caitrasyānyathāsiddhatvena kriyājanakatvābhāvānna kārakatvam | sampradānasya tvanumatiprakāśanadvārā kriyājanakavam | anumatisattve dānasya pravṛttiḥ, tadabhāve tadabhāva ityanvayavyatirekābhyām | evam 'kaṭe āste' ityādāvadhikaraṇakārakasyāpi sthitiṃ prati kāraṇatvāt kriyājanakatvamakṣuṇṇameva | na ca 'ghaṭaṃ karoti' ityādau ghaṭasānutpannatvena kriyājanakatvābhāvāt kārakavānāpattiriti vācyam, kapālaniṣṭhajanakatvasya ghaṭe āropeṇādoṣāt, bauddharthakarmatvād vā | evamapādānasyāpi kriyājanakatvam, vṛkṣābhāve parṇavibhāgasyaivā sambhavāt | naiyāyikāstu, vibhaktyarthadvārā kriyānvayitvaṃ kārakatvam | kriyāviṣayitānirūpitavibhaktyarthaviṣayatānirūpitaviṣayatāśrayatvamiti niṣkarṣaḥ | 'stokaṃ pacati' ityatra kriyāviśeṣaṇasya stokasya kārakatvāvāraṇāya vibhaktyarthadavāreti . 'caitrasya taṇḍulaṃ pacati' ityādau tu caitrasya vibhaktyarthadvārā kriyānvayitvābhāvānna kārakatvamiti pariṣkurvanti | tat na ; 'kaṭe āste, sthālyāṃ pacati' ityādau kaṭasthālyoḥ kartṛ karmadvārā kriyānvayitvena vibhaktayarthadvārā kriyānvayitvābhāvāt kārakatvānāpatteḥ, karturapi kārakatvānāpatteśceti | kartṛtvaśca -- prakṛtadhātuvācyavyāpārāśrayatvam | tena prayojyaprayojakānuktakartṛṇāṃ sarvaṣāṃ saṃgrahaḥ | 'māṣeṣvaśvaṃ vadhnāti' ityatra tu galavilādhaḥ sayoganukūlavyāpārāśrayatvenāśvasya kartṛtve'pi prakṛtadhātuvācyavyāpārāśrayatvābhāvānna kartṛ tvāpattiriti | karmatvañca -- prakṛtadhātvarthapradhānībhūtavyāpāraprayojyaprakṛtadhātvarthaphalāśrayatavenoddeśyatvam | idameva karmalakṣaṇe īpsitatamatvam | 'gāṃ payo dogdhi' atra payasaḥ karmatvasiddhaye prayojyatvaniveśaḥ | 'prayāgāt kāśīṃ gacchati' atra prayāgasya karmatvavāraṇāya prakṛtadhātvarthaphaleti | naiyāyikāstu -- dhatvarthatāvacchedakavyāpāravyadhikaraṇaphalāśālatvaṃ karmatvam | tādṛśaṃ ca phalaṃ gamesseyogaḥ, tyajervibhāgaḥ, pateradhodeśasaṃyogaḥ | adhodeśarūpakarmaṇo dhātvarthaniviṣṭatvādakarmatvena parṇaṃ vṛkṣād bhūmau patati, saṃyogamātraphalapakṣe vṛkṣād bhūmiṃ patati iti prayogaḥ ityāhuḥ | karaṇatvañca -- svaniṣṭavyāpārāvyavadhānena phalaniṣpādakatvam | idameva sādhakatamatvam 'rāmeṇa bāṇena hato vālī' ityatra bāṇavayapārāvyavahitottaraphalaniṣpādakatvaṃ bāṇasyeti lakṣaṇasamanvayaḥ | sampradānatvañca -- kriyāmātrakarmasambandhāya kriyāyāmudaddeśyaṃ yata kārakaṃ tattvam | yathā 'brāhmaṇāya gāṃ dadāti' ityatra bāṇavyāpārāvyavahitottaraphalaniṣpādakatvaṃ bāṇasyeti lakṣaṇasamanvayaḥ | sampradānatvañca -- kriyāmātrakarmasambandhāya kriyāyāmuddeśyaṃ yat kārakaṃ tattvam | yathā 'brāhmaṇāya gāṃ dadāti' ityādau dānakriyākarmībhūtagosambandhāya brāhmaṇo dānakriyoddeśyaḥ | gobhrāhmaṇayoḥ svasvāmibhāvaḥ sambandhaḥ | apādānatvañca -- tattatkartṛ samavetatattakriyājanyaprakṛtadhātvavācyavibhāgāśrayatvam | tadevāvadhitvam . vibhāgaśca na vāstavasambandhapūrvako vāstava eva,10 kintu buddhiparikalpitasambandhapūrvako buddhiparikalpito'pi | 'māthurāḥ pāṭaliputrakebhya āḍhyatarāḥ' ityādau buddhiparikalpitāpāyāśrayaṇenaiva bhāṣye pañcamīsādhanāt | adhikaraṇatvañca -- karttṛkaramadvārakaphalavyāpārādhāratvam | yathā 'sthālyāmodanaṃ gṛhe pacati' ityādau karmadvārākaviklittirūpaphalādhāraḥ sthālī, karttṛdvārakavyāpārādhāro gṛhamiti | kārakaprātipadikārthavyatiraktaḥ | svasvāmibhāvādiḥ sambandhaḥ ṣaṣṭhyā vācyaḥ | 'rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ' ityādau ṣaṣṭhīvācyasambandhasayāśrayibhāvasambandhena puruṣe'nvayaḥ, rājanirūpitasambandhavān puruṣa iti bodhāt | atra sambandhatvena rūpeṇa tattatsambandhe śaktiḥ | evañca śakyatāvacchadakasya sambandhatvasya karttṛ tvakarmatvādiṣu vidyamānatvāt sambandhatvena rūpeṇa ṣaṣṭhyarthatā'styeva | ata eva sambandhatvavivakṣāyam 'satā gatam, sarpiṣo jānīte' ityādau ṣaṣṭhī sādhitā siddhāntakaumudyāmiti prācīnānāṃ hṛdayam | navīnāstu -- na samabandhetvana rūpeṇa svasvābhibhāvādisambandhaḥ ṣaṣṭhyā vācyaḥ | ata e 'ekaśataṃ ṣaṣṭhyārthāḥ' iti sūtrasthaṃ bhāṣyaṃ saṅgacchate | 'rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ' ityatra svatvasvāmitvarūpaḥ samūhaḥ ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ, na tu svatvam, svāmitvaṃ vā, tasyaikamātravṛttitvāt sambandhasya ca dviṣṭhatvaniyamāt | ṣaṣṭhyarthasambandhastu saṃsargavidhayaiva bhāsate, na tu prakāravidhayā | evañca rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ ityatra svasavāmibhāvasambandhena rājaviśiṣṭaḥ, puruṣa iti mūloktaṃ tu prakāravidhayā bhānānurodhenetyāhuḥ | ] kriyājanakatvaṃ kārakatvamiti, tat, na ; pūrvodāharaṇe putrasya kārakatvānāpatteḥ | taṃ vinā praśnakriyā'niṣpattestasyāpi janakatvamiti cet, tathāpi saṃpradāne'vyāptiḥ, avidyamānasaṃpradānakasyāpi dānasya jāyamānatvena tasya niyatapūrvavṛttitvābhāvāt | 'jāyata, karoti' ityādau kartṛ karmaṇoravyāpteśca | na ca yāgasya pūrvavṛttitvābhāve'pi apūrvadvārā janakatvāvat saṃpradānādijñānasya pūrvavṛttitvena taddvārā tasyāpi janakatvaṃ sūpapādimiti vācyam, kriyāniṣṭhaśābdaviṣayatānirūpakaviṣayatāśrayatvarūpakriyānvayitvāpekṣayā'nanyathāsiddhaniyatapūrvavarttitvaghaṭitakriyājanakatvasya gurutvāt | āśrayatvarapakṛdarthopapattistu janaka ivānvayinyapi asūpapādā | akhaṇḍajanyatānirūpakajanakatvamakhaṇḍopādhirūpaṃ tatra niviṣṭamityapi vinigamanāvirahagrastam | kiñcāśraye ṇvulo vidhānāt kriyāśrayatvasya saṃpradānāpādānayorbādhena dhātunā kriyānirūpitajanakatvalakṣaṇāpekṣa[ṇa]yā viṣayatālakṣaṇaṃ nyāyyām, tasyāḥ svarūpasambandhaviśeṣarūpatvenātiriktatvābhāvāt | kriyāyāmanvayaśca prakāratvena viśeṣyatvena vā | ata eva 'pācako devadattaḥ, pakvastaṇḍulaḥ' ityādau pākanirūpitakartṛtvakarmatvāditakaṃ saṃgacchate | ata eva kārakāṇāṃ kriyāyāmevānvaya iti siddhāntaḥ | "kārakād‌ttaśrutayoḥ" [ 6|2|148 ] ityādau ca kārakaśabdaḥ svaryate, tena kārakādhikāroktaṃ kartrādiṣaṭkaṃ gṛhyata iti nātiprasaṅgaḥ | evañca saṃketaviśeṣasambandhena kārakaśabdavattvaṃ kārakatvamiti paramārthaḥ | tatra karmalakṣaṇabodhakasūtram "kartuṃrīpsitatamaṃ karma" [ 1|4|49 ] iti | karturiti kartari ṣaṣṭhī, āpnotteḥ sanantāt, "matibuddhi" [ 3|2|188 ] iti sūtreṇa vartamaine ktaḥ, matiriccheti hi tatrākaraḥ | evañca kartrāptumiṣyamāṇaṃ karmetyarthaḥ | āptiścātra sambandhaḥ | tatra kartrā karmaṇaḥ sākṣāt sambandhasyāsaṃbhavāt kriyādvārakaḥ paramparāsambandho gṛhyate | kartṛviśeṣaṇatayā tasyā upasthitayā upasthitaparityāgenānupasthitakalpanāyāṃ mānābhāvāt | evañca kartṛniṣṭhvāyapāreṇa samband‌dhumiṣyamāṇamityarthaḥ | sambandhaśca phalavyāpārayoḥ saṃsargatayā bhāsamāno janyatādirūpaḥ, tatphalāśrayatārūpaśca | iṣyamāṇatvañca, tad‌vyāpāroddeśyatvameva |1 [fn evañca prakṛtadhātvarthapradhānībhūtavyāpāraprayojyaprakṛtadhātvarthaphalāśrayatvenaicchoddeśyatvaṃ karmatvamiti phalitam | tathāhi -- 'kulālo ghaṭaṃ karoti' ityatra prakṛto dhātuḥ kṛñ dhātuḥ, tadarthaḥ pradhānībhūta itaraniṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpitopasthitīyaprakāratvānadhikaraṇībhūtaḥ utpattyanukalo vyāpāraḥ, tatprayojyam -- prakṛtadhātvarthaphalam = utpattiḥ, tadāśrayatvenoddeśyatā ; 'ghaṭa utpatyāśrayo bhavati' ityākārikā ghaṭe karturuddeśyatvāditi ghaṭasya karmatvaṃ siddham | phalāśrayatvañca phalatāvacchedakasambandhena grāhyam | phalatāvacchedaka sambandhaśca yena sambandhena phalāśrayatvaprakārikecchā bhavati, sa sambandhaḥ | sa ca tattaddhātubhedād bhinnaḥ | yathā 'grāmaṃ gacchati' ityatrānuyogitvaviśiṣṭaḥ, samavāyaḥ phalatāvacchedakasambandhaḥ | 'tena sambandhena saṃyogāśrayo grāmo bhavatu' ityākārakecchīyaphalaniṣṭaviṣayatāvacchedakatvasya samavāya eva sattvena, tatsambandhena phalāśrayasyaiva karmatvat, na tu kālikādinā phalāśrayasya, tasya sambandhasya phalatāvacchedakatvā bhāvāt | ata eva saṃyogasya dviṣṭhatvena tasya samavāyena grāma iva caitre sattve'pi caitro grāmaṃ gacchatītivaccaitraḥ svaṅgacchatīti na prayogaḥ, anuyogitvaviśiṣṭasamavāyasya caitre'sattvāt | tasya ca phale kartṛniṣṭhavyāpāraprayojyavibhāgarūpaphalāśrayatvasya sattvena sakarmakatvam | na ca caitramaitrobhayakartṛkavibhāgasthale pratiyogitvaviśiṣṭasamavāyena caitre vibhāgarūpaphalasattve'pi 'caitro maitraṃ vibhajate' iti prayogāpattiriti vācyam, akarmakadhātusthale phalasāmānādhikaraṇyasya vyāpāre sattvena tatra phalādhikaraṇatāyāḥ samavāyena vivakṣitatvena maitravṛttitvaviśiṣṭasamavāyena phalasya caitre'bhavenādoṣāt, paratvāt kartṛsaṃ5yā bādhācca | ] etena 'ratho grāmaṃ gacchati' ityādau karturacetanatvena tatrecchāyā asaṃbhavāt tatkarmaṇaḥ kartṛgatecchāviṣayatvābhāvena karmatvaṃ na syādityapāstam | tadupalakṣitodaddeśyatvasya tatrāpi sattvāt, tatrottaradeśasaṃyogasya rathādivyāpārod‌deśyatvāt | bhāṣyanaye kūlaṃ pipatiṣatītyādivaccetanatvāropeṇa na kṣatirityapyāhuḥ | taduddeśyatvañca sākṣāt phalarūpe dhātvarthe kriyāyāḥ phalecchāpūrvakecchāviṣayatvena phalasya tattvāt | tatra phale karmasaṃjñāyāḥ phalābhāvāt tadibhinne pravartate | yathā stekaṃ pacantīti | evañca tatrābhinno'bhedo vā dvitīyārthaḥ | phalāśrayattvāt tuṇḍulādīnāmapyuddeśyatvam | ata eva "laḥ karmaṇi" [ 3|4|69 ] iti sūtraṃ saṃgacchate | tatra hi kartṛsāhacaryeṇādhātvarthakarmaṇa eva grahaṇam | ata eva viklityādikarmaṇi na lakāraḥ | ata eva prayāgāt kāśīṃ gacchati devadatte prayāgaṃ gacchatīti prayogaḥ, anyathā prayāgasyāpi devadattavyāpārajanyavibhāgāśrayatvena sa durbāra eva | tasya prakṛdhātvarthod‌deśyatā tu neti spaṣṭameva | na ca kālikādisambandhena phalāśraye'tivyāptiḥ, phalatāvacchedakasambandhena phalāśrayasya grahaṇāt | na ca 'caitro grāmaṃ gacchati' ityatra grāmasaṃyogādirūpaphalāśrayacaitrādeḥ karmatvaṃ syāditi vācyam, parayā kartṛsaṃjñayā bādhāt | grāmaniṣṭhānuyogitāyā eva phalatāvacchedakasambandhatvena tena sambandhena caitre tadabhāvācca | ata eva 'ātmānamātmanā hanti' ityatra śarīramanorūpavacchedakabhedena karmatvakartṛ tvopapādanaṃ bhāṣye kṛtam | 'vṛkṣād bhūbhau patati' ityatra kartṛkarmadvārā tadvivakṣāyāmādhāratvam | sākṣāt tadāśrayatvavivakṣāyāṃ tu karmatvaṃ bodhyam | ata eva 'dvitīyā śri' [ 2|1|24 ] iti samāsavidhānaṃ saṃgacchate | 'ghaṭaṃ karoti' ityatrotpattirūpadhātvarthaphalāśrayatvāt karmatvam, 'ghaṭaṃ jānāti' ityādau jñānajanyaviṣayāvacchinnājñānabhaṅgarūpaphalaśālitvāt karmatvam | na caivamapi naṣṭe bhāvini ca taṃ jānātītyanupapannam, tatrāpi sūkṣmarūpeṇa sthityabhyupagamāt, nyāyanaye viṣayatāyā atīte kṛtisvīkāravadāraṇatadbhaṅgayorapi vṛttisvīkāre kṣatyabhāvācca | yadvā, jānātīcchatītyādau jñānecchādyanukūlo vyāpāro dhātvarthaḥ | sa ca jñānajanako manaścakṣuḥ saṃyogādireva | ata eva 'mano jānāti' ityādiprayogāḥ saṃgacchante | icchānukūlaśca jñānādiḥ, phalatāvacchedakasambandho viṣayatā | yadvā, viṣayatānirūpakajñānecchādireva vyāpāraḥ | na ca viṣayatāyā jñānā janyatevena kathaṃ phalatvam, anupadavakṣyamāṇaphalatvasya tatrāpi sattvenākṣateḥ | nanvatra sūtre kartṛ grahaṇaṃ kimartham, tadabhāvo'pi kenāptumityākāṅkṣāyāṃ kārakādhikārāt pratyāsatitanyāyena prakṛtadhātvarthalābhaḥ | na caivaṃ karturapi karmatvaṃ syāt, paratvāt kartṛtvena bādāditi cet, na ; yataḥ saṃkoce mānābhāvena phalāvacchinnavyāpārarūpasaṃpūrṇadhātvarthenepsitasya taṇḍulādereva karmatvaṃ syāt, na phalasyeti tasyāpi karmatvāya tat1 [fn karttṛgrahaṇam | ] | kiñca, 'yavebhyo gāṃ vārayati' atra padānāmapi karmatvaṃ syāt, tatra bhakṣaṇādiphalajanakavyāpārābhāvānukūlo vyāpāro vārayaterthaṛ | na ca "vāraṇārthānām" [ 1|4|27 ] iti sūtraṃ vinigamanāvirahādubhayatrāpi phravartate | kartṛ grahaṇe kṛte tu na doṣaḥ, kartṛ niṣṭhavyāpārajanyaphalānāśrayatvādityāhuḥ | nanu tamab‌grahaṇaṃ kimarthamiti cet, 'payasaudanaṃ bhuṅkte' ityādau payasaḥ karmatvavyāvṛttyartham | na cātra payaso mṛduviśadatvasaṃpādanarūpasvavyāpārajanyasambandhena bhujadhātvarthe'nvayavivakṣāyāḥ sattvena phalāśrayatvavivakṣāyā asattvena ca kathaṃ tamab‌grahaṇābhāve'pi dvitīyāprasaktiḥ, nahi yugapadvivakṣādvayaṃ kartuṃ śakyamiti vācyam, pañcakaprātipadikārthapakṣe payaḥ śabdenaivobhayaṃ pratipādyamiti vivakṣāyāḥ sattvenādoṣāt | payo niṣṭhamuduviśadatvasaṃpādanarūpavyāpārajanyapayoniṣṭhagalādadhaḥkaraṇānukūlavāyapāra ityādibodhāt, tatra tamabagrahaṇābhāve paratvād dvitīyaiva syāt | patantvatra mukhyatayā bhujikrayod‌deśyatvamodanasyaiva, na payasa iti bodhyam | na ca "tathāyuktañcānīpsitam" [ 1|4|50 ] iti karmatvaṃ payaso durvāram, sarvathānuddeśya eva tatpravṛtteḥ, anīpsitapadena tathaiva lābhāt | yadi tu tasyāpi mukhyatayā tattvam, tadā bhavatyeva karmatvamiti bodhyam | uddeśyatāyāṃ mukhyatvañca taddhātvarthaprakārecchāviśeṣyatve sati taddhātvarthopayuktadhamantiraprakārakecchāviṣayatvābhāvāvattvam | prakṛte ca galadadhaḥ karaṇarūpaphalāśrayatvāprakārecchaviṣyatve'pi tadupyuktamṛduviśadatvasaṃvādakatvaprakārecchāviṣayatvasyāpi sattvānna doṣaḥ | satyantābhāve tu "agnermāṇavakaṃ vārayati" ityatrāgnerapi karmatvāpattiḥ | na ca'vāraṇārthānām' ityatrāgnerapi karmatvāpattiḥ | na ca 'vāraṇārthānām' ityasya vaiyarthyam, prāgukārthakavārayatyādiyoge cāritārthyāt | atra vāraṇaṃ sayogābhāvānukūlo vyāpāraḥ | na ca pravṛttividhāto vāraṇamiti vṛttyādivirodhaḥ, dhātūnām 1[fn ayamāśaḥ -- 'parau bhuvo'vajñāne' [ 3|1|55 ] ityanena paripūrvakād bhūdhātoravajñāne'rthe ghañ vidhīyate | tacca 'anādaraḥ paribhavaḥ parībhāvastiraskriyā' iti kośāt siddhameva | punaravajñāne'rthe ghañvidhānaṃ vyarthībhūya jñāpayati -- dhātūnāmanekārthatvam | atha ca 'kurda krīḍāyāmeva' atra dhātūnāmanekārthatvābhāve 'eva' grahaṇasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt | ] anekārthatvāt | mama tvagneḥ saṃyogābhāvaprakārakecchāviśeṣyatvābhāvānna doṣaḥ | na hyagnirmāṇavakasaṃyukto mā bhavatviti icchā, api tu māṇavako'gnisaṃyukto mā bhavatviti | dhvanitañcedamatraiva bhāṣye | evañca dhātvarthatāvacchedakaphalam, kartṛ vyāpāraprayojyaphalatāvacchedakasambandhena dhātvarthaphalāśrayaścaitadanyataratvaṃ karmaṃtvamityetatsūtraniṣkarṣaḥ | atra phalatvaṃ kartṛ pratayayasamabhivyāhāre taddhātvarthaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpitaprakāratāśrayataddhātvarthatvam, na tvatra janakatvapraveśaḥ, āsyādīnāṃ tatpūrvakadarśanādau lakṣaṇāyāmanena karmatvapratipādakabhāṣyādivirodhāpatteḥ | devadattakartṛ kapacikriyākarmakotpattyanukūlo yatnastvatkartṛka ityādyarthakadevadattaḥ pacati karoṣītyādau paśyamṛgo dhāvatītyādau capākadhāvanādeḥ kriyāphalatvavāraṇā taddhātviti | tathā hi sati devadattasya karmatve tato dvitīya syāt | pakvaudano yujyate itivat pradhānānurodhisaṃjñāyā balavattvād na dhātvarthakartṛtvena tadvādhaḥ | idamapi tattatkriyābhedabhinnameva bodhyam | tena 'puṣpebhyaḥ spṛhayati' ityatra 'hariṃ prīṇayati' ityarthakaharaye rocate bhaktirityādau ca puṣpaharyādau nātiprasaṅgaḥ, tadyoge dhātvarthaphalāśrayasya sampradānapadārthatvāt | nanu tamabgrahaṇe sati yatra prītīyogyupādānaṃ payasaudanaṃ bhuṅkte ityādau tatraiva syāt, na tu 'grāmaṃ gacchati', 'ādityaṃ paśyati' ityādau | na ca tatrāpi kriyāpekṣayotkṛṣṭatavamastyeva, sā hi phalārthamiṣyamāṇatvādīpsitā bhavati, paśyatyādāvapi prākaṭyarūpaṃ phalamastyeveti vācyam, tulyajātīsyaiva pratiyogitvāt | kārakatulyajātīyaṃ hi kārakam, na kriyā | na ca kriyāyā api saṃdarśanaprārthanādyapekṣayā karmatvamastyeveti vācyam, sarvatra tadbhāne mānābhāvāt | kiñcaivaṃ kriyāyā apīpsitatamatvena tadapekṣayā prakarṣānupapatteriti cet, atrāhuḥ, 'lalāṭacakukkuṭyau paśyati, yenādarśanamicchati' ityādinirdeśaiḥ pratiyogyanupādāne'pi karmasaṃjñājñāpanāditi | tatra dvitīyāyāḥ karmaṇi śaktigrāhakaṃ sūtram "karmaṇi dvitīyā" iti | atra karmapadenaitacchāstravihitakarmasaṃjñakamātraṃ gṛhyate, aviśeṣāt | atra "karturopsitatamam" iti sūtrabodhitakarmavihitadvitīyāyā āśrayo'rthaḥ, phalasya dhātunaiva 1[fn 'ananyalabhyohi śabdārthaḥ' ityāptavacanāditi śeṣaḥ | ] lābhāt, iṣṭatamatvasyāpi mukhyoddeśyatārūpasya tato'bhānāt, vākyārthavidhayā lābhācca | tatra prakṛtyartho'bhedena viśeṣaṇam viṣeṣyañcādheyatayā phalam | evañca 'hariṃ bhaḍati' -- ityādau haryābhinnāśrayavṛttiprītijanako vyāpāra iti bodhaḥ | prītijanakvayāpāro hi bhaj‌dhātvarthaḥ | na ca 2[fn tatra hi ākṛtāveva śaktirabhyupagantavyā, lādhavāt | vyaktau śaktisvīkāre śakyatāvacchadake gauravamāpadyeteti siddhāntitam | ] ākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyenāśrayatvamevārtha iti vācyam, tāvatā'pi dharmibodhasya tata āvaśyakatvena bodhakatārūpāyāḥ śaktestatra durvāratvāt | anyathā vibhaktito dharmamātrabodhāpattau 'gāṃ vāhaya' ityādau vāhādyananvayāpattiḥ | bodhakataiva cāsmākaṃ śaktiriti prapañcitam | pañcamyādyarthakasamāsānāṃ dharmiparatāyā nirṇītatvena tathaiva nyāyyatvācca | "karmaṇi" ityādisūtrasvarasācca | karmetayādikṛdantamahāsaṃjñākaraṇena tadarthasyeva vibhaktyarthasyāpi itaratrābhedenaivānvaye vibhaktīnāṃ sādhutvabodhanācca | ata eva tiṅsupoḥ samānārthatvapratipādakabhāṣyādigranthāḥ saṅgacchante | tiṅśca dharmiṇyeva śaktiriti nirūpitamākhyātavāde | āśrayatvañcākhaṇḍopādhiriti na śakyatāvacchedakagauravam | guruṇyapi avacchedakatvasya nirūpitatvācca | na cāśrayatā nirūpakabhedena sambandhibhedena ca bhinnā | anyathā ghaṭāśrayatādigrahāpattiriti śaktyā'nantyamiti vācyam, paṭagraha iṣṭāpatteḥ | tadagrahe ca na doṣaśaṅkā | iyameva ca samavāyasyaikatvavādināṃ śuklādiguṇānāmekatvavādināṃ ca gatiḥ | astu vā āśrayatvaṃ nānā, tathāpi tadādau buddhiviṣayatāvacchedakatvabādākāśapadaśaktau śabdatvaccāśrayatātvasya śakyatāvacchedakatāvacchedakasyaivaikatvānna śaktyānantyam | yattu āśrayasya śakyatve ādheyatvasya saṃsargatavamupeyam | tathā ca 'taṇḍulaḥ pacati' ityato'pi bodhāpattiḥ | na ca dvitīyāsamabhivyāhārastādṛśabodhe kāraṇam, prathamāyāḥ karmatve śaktigrahadaśāyām 'taṇḍulaḥ pacati' ityato'pi tathābodhena vyabhicārāditi | tat, na ; karmatvasya śakyatve'pi tato bodhāpatterdurvāratvāt | na ca karmatvabodhakapadaprāgvartipadajanyajñānatvena hetutvamevamādheyatāsaṃsargakaghaṭaphrakārakaśābdobadhe ghaṭabodhakapadottarapadajanyajñānatvena hetutvam, ato noktātiprasaṅgaḥ, nāpi ghaṭaḥ karmatvamityato viparītavyutpannasya tathābodhe vyabhicāra iti vācyam, karmatvaṃ ghaṭaḥ, am ghaṭaḥ ityetādṛśasamabhivyāhāravyutpannānāṃ tatastathābodhe vyabhicāratādavasththāt, ghaṭaḥ karmatvamityatoviparīta1[fn svasvaśāstrābyāsajanitasaṃskāraviśeṣo vyutpattiḥ | yathā vyāraṇaśāstrābhyāsavatāṃ subantādīnāmeva padatvam, na tu śaktatvasayāpi | tārkikāṇāṃ tu tsāyapīti bhāvaḥ | ] vyutpattirahitasyāpi tathābodhāpatteśca | yadi tattatsamabhivyāhārajanyatathābodhe tattatsamabhinyāhārajanakatvagraho'pi heturiti brūṣe, tarhyasmākamapana kṣatiḥ | etāvān viśeṣaḥ -- pareṣāṃ karmatvabodhakapadaghaṭitānupūrvītvena praveśaḥ, asamākaṃ tu karmabodhakapadatveneti | na ca tvanmate āśrayavācakapadapraveṣaḥ, tasya tacchakyatvāt | tathā ca 'devadattena pacyate' ityāto'pi karmatvabodhāpatatiriti vācyam, karmakāraṇādau śakyatāvacchedakāśrayatvasya tattacchaktirapasya bhinnatāmyupagamenādoṣāt | anyatā dvitīyādeḥ paryāyatāpatteḥ | astu vā, phalāśrayatvarūpakarmatvena kāryakāraṇabhāve praveśaḥ, aśakyasyāpi phalasya tanniṣṭhatāmātreṇetaravayāvartakatvasaṃvāt praveśa itina doṣaḥ | yadapi, karmatvatvādinā bodhānubhavāt tattad‌rūpeṇa śakyateti tadapi na, tathābodhasya tādṛśavyutpattyadhīnatvenāpramāṇatvāt, sarveṣāṃ tathānanubhavācca | na cāśrayo'pi na śakyaḥ, anyalabhyatvāditi vācyam, haritvādinā lābhe'pi āśrayatvādinā alābhāt | etena prātipadikasyāpi tadarthakatvāt prātipadikārthavihitaprathamayā saha vikalpāpattiriti nirastam, āśrayatvena tadarthatvābhāvāt | anayaiva diśā sarvāsāṃ kārakavibhaktīnāṃ dharmibodhakatvaṃ draṣṭavyam | nanu 'āśrayatvenālābhaḥ' ityasya āśrayatvaṃ na labdhamityevārthaḥ, tathā ca tatreva śaktirucitā | "karmaṇi dvitīyā" ityādyanuśāsanaṃ tu śaktitadvasatādātmyamabhyupetya | anyathā "dvayekayoḥ" ityādyanurodhād ekavacanādeḥ saṃkhyāviśiṣṭāśrayavācakatāpattiḥ | tiṅkṛdādestu 'kṛtaḥ kaṭaḥ, devadattaḥ pacatikalpam' ityādau sāmānādhikaraṇyānvayānurodhāt "yuṣmadyupapade" ityādyanurodhācca dharmivācakatvaṃ tallakṣakatvaṃ veti nirūpitamākhyātavāde | "anabhihite" ityasya ca tattacchaktyanabhidhāne ityarthaḥ | ākhyāte'pyavacchedakatayā śaktisattvānna doṣaḥ | tasya nirūpakatāsambandhena dhātvarthe phale'nvayaḥ | yadvā, pratyayārthatve'pi rametyādāviva prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇatvam | ata eva tadarthabahuvrīhyādīnāṃ dharmiparatvam | vibhaktiprakṛtimātrārthatvena vā teṣāṃ tattvam | ata eva ṣaṣṭhyarthabahuvrīherapi paramate dharmibodhakatā saṃgacchate | na ca tasya śakyatve tattvasya śakyatāvacchedakatvamiti gauravam, uktottaratvāt | tādāmyena tasyevāvacchedakatvācca, āśrayatānāṃ nānātve tvāśrayatvatvamevākhaṇḍopādhirūpamiti gauravābhāvācca | na cātra mate āśrayatvatvasyāpi śakyatvaṃ syāditi vācyam, aśakyatve'pi tadavacchedakatvasaṃbhavāt, alakṣyāderlakṣyatāvacchedakatvādivaditi cet, satyam | ata eva 'śaktireva vā' iti pakṣāntaramuktaṃ hariṇā | sā ceyaṃ dvitīyākṛdādibhiranukte eva karmaṇi,"anabhihite" iti sūtrāt | tena 'kṛtaḥ kaṭaḥ' ityādau na dvitīyā, 'anabhihite' iti karmaṇītyādīnāmeva viśeṣaṇam, saṃnihitatvāt | etena karmatvādeḥ kṛdādibhiruktatve'pi ekatvādisaṃkhyāyāmanuktatvād dvitīyā syādeva | yathaikādiśabdebhyaḥ saṃkhyoktāvapi karmatvādibodhanāya sā kriyata iti nirastam | saṃkhyābodhasya prathamayāpi saṃbhavācceti vistaraḥ śabdenduśekhare draṣṭavyaḥ | aparañca karmatvabodhakaṃ sūtram -- "tathāyuktaṃ cānīpsitam" iti | tatrānīpsitatvamanuddeśyatvam | 'parādhīnatayā viṣaṃ muṅkte' ityādyudāharaṇam | anuddeśtvañca pratyāsattyā yaddhātvarthaphalāśrayatvena karmatve taddhātrthakartureva bodhyam | tathāyuktañca prakṛtadhātvarthaphalāśrayatvam | tena 'veṣeṇaudanaṃ bhuṅkte, prayāgāt kāśīṃ gacchati devadattaḥ' ityādau viṣaprayāgāderna karmatvam | atra ca viṣayasya svavyāpārajanyatvasambandhena vyāpāre evānvayavivakṣeti na phalāśrayatvam | evañca sarvathānuddeśyatve sati dhātvarthaphalāśraya ityetatsūtraniṣkarṣaḥ | 'payasaudunaṃ bhuṅkte' ityādau payasi karmatvavāraṇāya satyantam | ata evātra sūtre anīpsitagrahaṇaṃ caritārtham | anyathā takrakauṇḍinyanyāyenānīpsita evaitatpravṛttiḥ siddhā, kiṃ tena | anyathā'mukhyoddedeśye'pi syāditi tad‌vyāvṛttyarthaṃ tat | aparañca tadbodhakaṃ sūtram -- "akathitañca" [ 1|4|51 ] iti | atra pūrvasūtrāt 'yuktam' ityanuvartate | tatra kenetyākāṅkṣāyam upasthitakarmaṇyevānvayaḥ | tenāyamarthaḥ -- apādānasampradānādhikaraṇakarmarūpairavivakṣitaṃ sambandhatvena ca vivakṣataṃ karmaniṣṭhadhātvarthasya nimittatayā sambandhi tatkarmeti | ata eva karaṇahetvoranupādānam, karmayuktatvābhāvāt | idaṃ ca --- duhyāc‌pac‌daṇḍarudhipracchicivrūśāsujimath‌muṣām | karmayuk syādakathitaṃ tathā syānnīhṛkṛṣ‌vahāmiti | iti parigaṇitadhātuyoga eva pravartate | karmaṃyuk karmaniṣṭhaprakṛtadhātvarthasya nimittatayā sambandhītyarthaḥ | evañcaitadanyatamadhātvarthapradhānavyāpārajanyaitadanyatamadhātvarthavyāpāre sambandhitayānvayitvametadanyatamagaumakarmatvam -- ityetatsūtraniṣkarṣaḥ | gauṇatvañcāsya 'gauṇe karmaṇi duhyādeḥ' ityādivyavahārājjñāyate | evañcaitatkarmavihitadvitīyāyāḥ sambandho'rthaḥ | asyodāraharaṇam -- 'gāṃ dogdhi payaḥ' iti | atra duherantasthitadravadravyavibhāgānukūlavyāpārānukūlavyāpārorthaḥ | tatra vibhāgānukūlo vyāpāro goniṣṭhaḥ, kartṛvyāpāragovyāpārobhayaprayojyaphalāśrayatvāt payasaḥ prādhānyam, gostu tadvaiparītyād goṇatvam | tatra yadyapi "tathāyuktam" iti, "karturīpsitatamam" iti vā karmatvaṃ sidhyati, tathāpi śeṣatvavivakṣāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhībādhanārthamidam | payoniṣṭhavibhāgīyasambandhasyaiva phalatāvacchedakatvād na goravibhāgāśrayatvena karmatvam | evañca gosambandhī payoniṣṭhavibhāgānukūla vyāpāraḥ, tadanukūlo gopaniṣṭho vyāpārā iti bodhaḥ | yadā tu dravadravyaniṣṭhavibhāgānukūla vyāpāra eva dhātvarthaḥṣa tadāpādānatvavivakṣāyāṃ goriti pañcamyeva | tadavivakṣāyāṃ tvanena karmatvameva | spaṣṭañcedaṃ kaiyaṭe | apādānatvādyavivakṣā ceyam -- yaddhātorvyāpāradvayārthatvavivakṣā, tadarthavibhāgādyavadhitvāvivakṣā ceti bodhyam | 'baliṃ yācate vasudhām' [ityatra] yāc‌dhātoḥ svatvanivṛttijanakavyāpārānukūlavyāpāro'rthaḥ | tatradyo vyāpāro baliniṣṭhaḥ, tadanukūlo dīyatāmityādyabhilāṣādirūpo yācakaniṣṭhaḥ | tathā ca balisambandhī basudhāniṣṭhasvatvanivṛttijanako yo vyāpāra, tadanukūlo yācakaniṣṭho vyāpāraḥ iti bodhaḥ | svatvanivṛttyanukūlavyāpāramātrārthatve svatvavad dravyīyavibhāgāśrayatvavikṣāyāmapādānatvaṃ balerityeke | yācikarmaṇābhipreyamāṇatvat sampradānatvamityanye | yattu, yācanaṃ svod‌deśyakadāneccheti | tat, na ; 'putrārthaṃ kanyāṃ yācate' ityanāpatteḥ | putrod‌deśyakaṃ tvatra dānam | svasampradānecchāvati phalalābhaśaṅkayā dehīti prayogādyabhāvavatyapi 'devadatto yācate' iti prayogāpatteśceti dik | 'avinītaṃ vinayaṃ yācate' atra svīkārānukūlavyāpārānukūlavyāpāro yācerarthaḥ | svīkāraśca 'idamavaśyaṃ kariṣyāmi' ityādiśabdaprayogādijanako jñānaviśeṣaḥ | tadīyaphalatāvacchedakasambandho viṣayatā | evañca vinayaḥ pradhānam, svīkārānukūlavyāpāramātrārthakatve'vinītasya sampradānatvam | ayameva cānunaya ityāhuḥ | evañca cāvitītasambandhī vinayaviṣayakasvīkārānukūlavyāpārānukalo vyāpāro devadattaniṣṭha iti bodhaḥ | 'taṇaḍulānodanaṃ pacati' [atra] utpattijanakaviklityanukūlavyāpāraḥ pacerarthaḥ | tatraudanataṇḍulayorutpattau viklittau cāśrayatayānvayaḥ | ubhayavyāpārod‌dheśyatvādodanaḥ pradhānam, odananiṣṭhotpattijanikā yā taṇḍulādisambandhinī vaklittiḥ, tajjanako vyāpāra iti bodhaḥ | yadā tu viklittijanyotpattyanukūlo vyāpāro'rthaḥ, tadā taṇḍulānāmodanaṃ pacatīti | taṇḍulavikāramodanaṃ viklityotpādayatītyarthaḥ | viklityanukūlavyāpāramātravācittave taṇḍulānāmeva karmatvamiti dik | 'gargān śataṃ daṇḍayati' [atra] svampradānakadānānukūlavyāpārāranukūlavāyāpāraḥ śāsanarūpo daṇḍerarthaḥ | śasanaṃ niyantraṇam, śataṃ pradhānam, uddeśyatvāt | dānānukūlavyāpāramātrārthakatve vibhāgāśrayatvāvivakṣāyāṃ gargāṇāmapādānatvam, tadavivakṣāyāṃ sampradānatvam | 'vrajamavaruṇaddhi gāma' [atra] uttarakālikadeśāntaragatipratibandhānukūlānuyogitāsambandhāvacchinottaradeśasaṃyogānukūlo vyāpāro rudherarthaḥ | anuyogitāsambandhāvacchinnaḥ sa vrajaniṣṭhaḥ | gauḥ pradhānam, uddeśyatvāt | pratiyogitāsambandhāvacchinnottaradeśasaṃyogārthatve karmadvārā kriyāśrayatvavivakṣāyāmadhikaraṇatvam | 'māṇavakaṃ panthānaṃ pṛcchati' praśnaviṣayārthajñāpanānukūlavyāpāraḥ pṛccherarthaḥ | sa ca vyāpāraḥ kena pathā gantavyamityādyabhilāṣādirūpaḥ | jñāpanāśrayatvād māṇavakasya jñānaviṣayatvācca pathastattvaṃ bodhyam | jñānānukūvyāpāramātrārthatve māṇavakasya sampradānatvam | 'vṛkṣamavacinoti phalāni' vibhāgānukūlavyāpārānukūlo grahaṇopasarjanavyāpāraściño'rthaḥ | vibhāgānukūlvāyapārārthatve vṛkṣasyāpādānatvam | 'māṇavakaṃ dharmaṃ brūte, śāsti vā' -- pratipattijanakvayāpārānukūlavyāpāro brūñaḥ, pravṛttiparyavasāyipravṛttijanakaḥ sa śāseḥ | yadā tu viṣayatayā jñānānukūlavyāpārorthaḥ, tadā sampradānatvaṃ māṇavakasya | 'śataṃ jayati devadattam' -- dānānukūlaḥ parābhavākhyo vyāpāro jayaterarthaḥ | svatvotpattyanukūlavyāpāramātrārthakatve'pādānatvaṃ sampradānatvaṃ vā | 'sudhāṃ śrīranidhiṃ mathyāni' --- dravadravyagatasārabhāgotthānānukūlavyāpāraphakalavyāpāro mantherarthaḥ | utthānamūddharvadeśe saṃyogaḥ | utthānānukūvyāpāramātrārthakatve karmadvārā kriyāśrayatvavivakṣaṇe'dhikaraṇatvam, vibhāgāśrayatvavivakṣaṇe'pādānatvaṃ vā | 'devadattaṃ śataṃ muṣṇāti' -- parājñānatad‌dravyāgahaṇobhayānukūlo vyāpāro muṣerarthaḥ | yadā tu grahaṇānukūvyāpāra evārthaḥ, tadā devadattasyāpādānatvām | 'ajāṃ grāmaṃ nayati, harati, karṣati, vahati vā' -- uttaradeśasaṃyogānukūlavyāpāranukūlo vyāpāro nayaterarthaḥ | sa eva skandhagrahaṇādipūrvo vaheḥ, gatyanukūlo vyāpāraviśeṣaḥ kṛṣeḥ, balād‌grahaṇapūrvakaṃ deśāntaraprāpaṇaṃ harateḥ | ajānayanasyod‌deśyatvād ajā pradhānam | gamanamātrāthakatve grāmasyādhikaraṇatvaṃ bodhyam | yadā tu grāmīyā'jāsaṃyoga evod‌deśyaḥ, tadā grāma eva pradhānam | etena 'tapte payasi dadhyānayati, sā vaiśvadevyāmikṣā' ityatra tacchabdena prādhānyāt payasaḥ parāmarśa iti mīmāṃsakagranthā vyākhyātāḥ | payaḥ sthāne dadhyāgamanenārthaprādhānyamādāya vā teṣāmupapattiḥ ata eva saptamyupādānaṃ sārthakamiti dik | aparañca 'akarmakadhātubhiryoge deśaḥ kālo bhāvo gantavyo'dhvā ca karmasañjñaka iti vācyam' iti | deśaḥ kurupañcālādiḥ, akarmakaśabdena deśakālādibhinnakaramarahitā avivakṣitakarmāṇaśca | tena 'māsaṃ pacati' ityapi gantavyo'dhvā krośādiḥ, bhāvo bhāvādyarthavihikaghañajādyantaḥ | 'kurūn svapiti, māsamāste, krośaṃ śete, godohamāste |' śeṣatvavivakṣāyāmetatpravṛtterdvitīyārthaḥ sambandhaḥ | adhikaraṇatvavivakṣāyāṃ saptamyeva | etaddhātvarthasambanditvena vivakṣitādhāratvañcaitatkarmatvalakṣaṇaṃ bodhyam | "gatibuddhipratayavasānārthaśabdakarmākarmakāṇāmaṇi kartā sa ṇau" [ 1|4|52 ] iti sūtrabodhitakarmatvaṃ tu ṇijarthavyāpārajanyatattaddhātvarthavyāpārāśrayatvam | tattaddhātubhedena karmatvalakṣaṇānāṃ bhinnatvānna lakṣaṇātivyāptyādikam | ṇyantahṛkṛghaṭitakarmatvalakṣaṇe tṛtīyāntapadānabhidheyatve satīti viśeṣaṇaṃ deyam | 'tena devadattena hārayati kaṭam' ityādau nātivyāptiḥ, ṇyantābhivādidṛśostu tattve sati ātmanepadapratyayāntataddhātūpāttaphalāśrayatvaṃ karmatvam | vaikuṇṭhamadhiśete,adhitiṣṭhati, adhyāste, upavasati, anuvasati, adhivasati, āvasati, vetyādāvādhāro dvitīyārthaḥ | etad dhātuyoge'dhikaraṇatvameva karmatvam, 'ādhāra' ityanuvarttamāne "adhiśīṅsthāsāṃ karma" [ 1|4|46], "upānvadhyāṅvasaḥ" [ 1|4|48 ], iti sūtrasvarasāt | upavasateścābhuktyarthakātiriktopavatyādhāratvaṃ bodhyam | tena 'vane upavasati' ityādau nātivyāptiḥ | abhiniviśatikarmatvañca saptamyantapadānabhidheyatad‌dhātvarthadhāratvaṃ bodhyam | 'krūramabhikrudhyati, abhiduhyati' ityādau viṣayatāsambandhitvaṃ bodhyam | atra ca bodhaḥ 'haraye krudhyati' ityādau vakṣyamāṇarītyā bodhyaḥ | krīḍārthakadiv‌dhātuyoge 'śataṃ dīvyati' ityādau tṛtīyāntapadānupasthāpyataddhātvarthasādhakatamatvameva tatkarmatvaṃ bodhyam | sakalasādhāraṇakarmatvaṃ ca saṅketaviśeṣasambandhena karmaśabdavattvameva bodhyam | dhātūnāṃ sakarmakatvamapi etacchāstrabodhitakarmasaṃjñakārthānvayyarthakatvaṃ bodhyam | yattu, vyāpāravyadhikaraṇaphalavācakatvaṃ sakarmakatvam, tatsamānādhikaraṇaphalavācakatvakarmatvamiti | tat na; 'adhyāste' ityādeḥ sakarmakatvānāpatteḥ, akarmakatvāpatteśca | na ceṣṭāpattiḥ, "antaḥ kañcukibhirlasanmaṇidharairadhyāsitā bhūmayaḥ" ityādau 'dīvyante akṣāḥ' ityādau ca karmaṇi pratyayāpatteḥ, bhāve tadāpatteśca | akarmakatavañca ca karmasaṃjñakārthaninvayyarthakatvamiti dik | 1[fn naiyāyikamataṃ dūṣayitumipanyasyati -- 'yattu' ityādinā | ayambhāvaḥ -- 'caitraścaitraṃ gacchati' iti doṣavāraṇāya 'paramavetatvam' iti kriyāviśeṣaṇamupādadate naiyāyikāḥ dvitīyāprakṛtitvena vivakṣitārthabhinnasamavetvayāpārajanyaṃ yat phalam, tādṛśaphalāśrayasyaiva karmatvamiti teṣāṃ tātparyam | prakṛte ca dvitīyāprakṛtitvana vivakṣitacaitrārthapratiyogikabhedasya caitre'sattvāt tatsamavetavyāpārajanyasaṃyogarūpaphalāśrayasya na karmatvam | grāmapratiyogikabhedavaccaitrasamavetavyāpārajanyaphalāśrayatvād grāmasya karmatvaṃ siddhayati | ]yattu, parasamavetakriyājanyadhātvarthatāvacchedakaphalāśrayatvaṃ karmatvam | paramaveteti viśeṣaṇāt 'caitraścaitraṃ gacchati' iti na prayogaḥ | iyān viśeṣaḥ --- dvitīyayā svaprakṛtyarthāpekṣayā paratvam | ākhyātena svārthasaṃkhyānvayya pekṣayā tad bodhyate | tacca dhātvarthakriyāyāmanveti | gamipatyoḥ pūrvasmin deśe tyajeḥ, uttaradeśe spandeśca pūravāparayoḥ karmatvavāraṇāya dhātvarthatāvacchedaketi | evañca gameḥ saṃyogaḥ, pateradhaḥsaṃyogaḥ, tyajervibhāgastatheti | spandeśca na kiñcat phalaṃ tatheti na doṣaḥ | nāpi tyāgo gamanamityanayoḥ paryātāpattiḥ | tatra kriyāyāḥ phalasya dhātunaiva lābhād ādheyatvam, bhedaśca dvitīyārthaḥ | phalasya padārthokadeśatve'pi tatra dvitīyārthānvayo vyutpattivaicitryāt | yadvā, phalaṃ pṛthageva dhātuśakyam | dhātvarthatāvacchedakatvañca dhātvarthaviśeṣyakajanakatvasaṃsargakabodhaprakāratvam | dhātvarthaprakārakajanyatvasaṃsargakabodhaviśeṣyatvānyataratvam | ata eva karmākhyāte phalasya viśeṣyatve'pi na kṣatiḥ | tatra 'grāmaṃ gacchati' ityādau dhātvarthatāvacchedake saṃyoge vṛttitvaṃ bhedaśca sāmānādhikaraṇyena vyāpāre bhede ca pratiyogitayā prakṛrtho'nveti | tathā ca grāmavṛttisaṃyogajanakagrāmabheda samānādhikaraṇakriyānukūlakṛtimānitibodhaḥ | evaṃ karmākhyāte'pi bheda ādheyatvaṃ cākhyātārthaḥ | tatra phalāṃśe ādheyatvam, kriyāyāñca yathoktasambandhena bhedaḥ, bhede ca phalā(yaḥ pratiyogitayetyūhyam | nanu bhede karmaṇaḥ kiṃ pratiyogitāsāmānyenānvayo'nvayitāvaccedakāvacchinnapratiyogitayā vā | nādyaḥ, 'caitraścaitraṃ gacchati' ityāpatteḥ | dvitvādyavacchinnapratiyogitākacaitrabhedasya caitre'pi sattvāt | nāntyaḥ, 'devadatto dravyaṃ gacchati ityāderanāpatteriti cet, na ; phalānvayivyaktiviśeṣāvacchinnaṃ pratiyogitayā tadanvayenādoṣāt | ' 'grāmaṃ gamayati yajñadattam' ityādau śuddhagam‌dhātvarthavyāpārasya ṇyantadhātvarthavyāpāraṃ prati phalatvam, prāguktamavacchedakatvaṃ cāstyaveti prayojyakarttuḥ karmatvaṃ bodhyam | pācayatyādiyoge tu gatyādisūtrasya niyamarthatvānna doṣaḥ | kriyābhedena karmatvasya bhedāt ṇijantaṃ pācayatyādibhinnakriyāghaṭitameva lakṣaṇaṃ kāryamiti tattvam | na ca parasamavetatvaviśeṣaṇadāne caitramaitrobhayakamaṃsaṃyogasthale karmaṇaḥ svānyamaitrasamavetatvāccaitrasya ca tajjanyasaṃyogādirūpaphalaśālitvāccaitre karmalakṣaṇātivyāptiḥ | 'taitraḥ svātmānaṃ gacchati' iti prayogāpattiśceti vācyam, kriyābhedena lakṣaṇabhedāt | yasya parasamavetayatkriyājanyayādṛśaphalāśālitvam, tattatkriyākarmeti, caitrasya ca savakriyāyāḥ parasamavetatvābhāvāt tāmādāya nātiprasaṅgaḥ | maitrakriyāmādāya tattvaṃ tviṣṭameva, tatraiva 'maitraścaitraṃ gacchati' iti prayogāt | etena prayogaprasaṅgo'pi vāritaḥ | caitraniṣṭhasaṃyogajanakacaitrānyavṛttikriyāśraya iti śābdabodhāsambhavāt | svaniṣṭhakriyāyāḥ parasamavetatvabādhāt paramavetakriyāyāśca svasminnasattvāt | 'ghaṭaṃ karoti' ityādau 'bahmimanuminomi, jānāmi' ityādivad viṣayatāyāṃ lakṣaṇā | evañca nāmārthānvitod‌dośyatvātiriktaviṣayatvarūpavibhaktyarthānvayyarthakatvaṃ gauṇasakarmakatvaṃ jānātotyādīnām | ata evābhuñjāne'pi 'bhojanāya yatate' iti prayogādyatadhātvarthe nāmārthānvitasya caturthyarthyod‌deśyatvasyaivānvayānna yateḥ sakarmakatvam, na vā 'bhojanaṃ yatate' iti prayogaḥ | yattu, ghaṭapadaṃ kapālaparam, tasya ghaṭarūpaphaśālitvāt karmatvam, kapālasya siddhatve'pi ghaṭatvena kṛtiviṣayatā bodhyeti | tat, na ; ghaṭasya dhātvarthatānavacchedakatvāt kapālaṃ ghaṭaṃ karotīti prayogānāpatteśca | jñātatārūpaphalāśratvena karmatvamiti tu na yuktam, naṣṭe ghaṭe taṃ jānātītyanāpatteḥ | jñātatā viṣayatvāparaparyāyaiveti cet, iṣṭāpatterityāhuḥ | atredaṃ praṣṭavyam -- kiṃ bhede śaktiḥ, caitraścaitraṃ gacchatītyādito bodhavāraṇāya kalpate, uta sādhutvavāraṇāya ? nādyaḥ -- tasya śakyatve'pi tasyānyatrānvayavāraṇāya tatprakārakabodhe dhātujanyavyāpāropasthitirheturiti kāryakāraṇabhāvāntarasyāvaśyakatayā tadapakṣayā tatra śaktimakalpayitvā dvitīyārthābhidheyatvānvitaphalaprakārakabodhaṃ iti dvitīyāntārthānyavṛttivyāpāropasthirhetutvamevocyatām, phalānvayānurodhena tavāpyāvaśyake kāryakāraṇābhāve tajjanakatāvacchedakakoṭau dvitīyāntārthānyavṛttitvamātrapraveśena na kḷñcinme gauravam | tava tu bhede śaktestadanvaye hetuhetumad‌bhāvāntarasya ca kalpanena gauravaṃ spaṣṭameva | na ca'taitramaitro parasparaṃ gacchataḥ' ityatra vyāpārasya dvitīyāntārthavṛttitvād vyabhicāraḥ, dvitīyāntārthavṛttyanyonyābhāvaphratiyogitāvacchedakvayāpāropasthitervivakṣitatvāt | na ca bhede śaktigrahaśūnyasya caitraścaitramityato bodhānna tathā kāryakāraṇabhāva iti vācyam, tatkāraṇatvagrahasyāpi bodhe kāraṇatvādakṣateḥ | ata eva viparītavyutpannasya ghaṭaḥ karmatvamitto bodhaḥ, 'ghaṭamānaya' ityataścābodhaḥ | kiñcaivaṃ bhedasya śakyatvameva na sidhyet, caitraścaitramityato viparītavyutpanna prati bodhasyoṣṭatvāt, parasamavetatvaśaktigrahavato'nanvayādeva bodhābhāvāt | nahi paṭapadasya ghaṭe śaktigrahavato ghaṭabodhāt paṭapadaṃ paṭaśaktaṃ bhavati | nāntyaḥ, kartṛsaṃjñayā bādhena tadasambhavāt | kiñca, tvaduktakarmatvasya dvitīyādyutpattau tat sādhutve vā na prayojakatvam, 'ghaṭaṃ jānāti' ityādau saviṣayakadhātuyoge davitīyānutpattiprasaṅgāt | na ca saviṣayānyasminnetat, tatra tu viṣayatayānvaya eva tatheti vācyam, 'kṛṣṇāya rocate', 'devadattāya krudhyati', 'puṣpebhyaḥ spṛhayati' ityādāvatiprasaṅgāpatteḥ | 'devadattamabhikrudhyati' ityādau 'vaikuṇṭhamadhitiṣṭhati' ityādau cāvyāpteśca | atha sañjñaiva tanniyāmikā, tarhi bhedasya vācyatvakathanaṃ niṣphalam | kiñca, 'ghaṭaṃ jānāti' ityādau viṣayatve lakṣaṇetyapyuktam, svecchāmātreṇa tasyā anucitatvāt | kiñca, dvitīyā karmaṇyeva sādhuḥ, karmaṇi dvitīyaiva ca sādhuriti krameṇa niyamānāṃ bhāṣyādāvuktatvenānyatra lakṣaṇāyāpyasādhutvabodhanāt | ata eva 'sub‌vibhaktau na lakṣaṇā' iti tvadīyavaddhānāṃ vyavahāraḥ | karmasūtre tu 'kṛtrimākṛtrimanyāyena' svaśāstraparibhāṣitakarmagrahaṇasyaiva nyāyyātvena viṣayatāyā agrahaṇāt | kiñca, tvaduktalakṣaṇasya phale vyāptiḥ | tathā ca stokaṃ pacatīti na syāt | na ca 'kriyāviśeṣaṇānāṃ dvitīyāntatvaṃ napuṃsakatvaṃ ca' iti vacanāt tadupapattiḥ, tādṛśavacanābhāvāt 'somena yajati' ityādau tṛtīyānāpatteśca | kiñcaivamavacchedakamapi vyartham, dhātvarthaphalaśālitvasyaiva yuktatvāt | dhātvarthaphalatvañca dhātvarthā rūpitajanyatāśrayatapadarthatvam | yadvā, prakāratāviśeṣyatānyatarasambandhena dhātvarthavyāpārānvayitvamityāhuḥ | yattu, mīmāṃsakāḥ,sādhyatvaṃ dvitīyārthaḥ | uktañca --- 'śrutyā sādhyābhidhāyitvaṃ dvitīyāyāḥ pratīyate' iti | evañca 'vrīhīnavahanti' ityādāvahanena vrīhīn bhāvayedityarthaḥ | yadyapi vrīhayaḥ siddhā eva kriyāyāḥ sādhanāni ca, tathāpyadṛṣṭaviśeṣasādhanatvarūpasaṃskāryatvamevātra sādhyatvaṃ bodhyam | 'saktuñjuhoti' ityatra tu bhūtabhāvyanupayuktatvena saktūnāṃ prāyuktasādhyatvāsambhavena saktukaramakahomānukūlavyāpārapratītaye tṛtīyārthaḥ karaṇatvaṃ dvitīyayā lakṣyate | evañca saktu bhirbhāvayedityarthaḥ | yadyapi prāgurītyā lakṣaṇāyāmasādhutvam, tathāpi chandasi "supāṃ suluk" [ 7|1|39 ], 'bahulaṃ chandasi', "tṛtīyā ca hośchandasi" [ 2|3|3 ] ityādibhirarthāntare'pi sādhutvakathanānna doṣaḥ ityāhuḥ | tatra sādhyatvaṃ śaktiviśaṣa eveti na kaścidvirodhaḥ | etāvān viśeṣaḥvede karmatvaśaktiḥ prāguktasaṃskāryatvasamānādhikaraṇaivetyalaṃ pallavitena | athopapadavibhaktibhūtatadartho nirupyate tatra sāmānyata upapadavibhaktīnāṃ sambandho'rthaḥ, tāsāṃ śeṣaṣaṣṭhyapavād‌tvāt | tadviśeṣāṃśca tatra tatra vakṣyāmaḥ | 'ubhayataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ gopyaḥ' kṛṣṇasambandhi pārśvadvayavarttinya iti bodhaḥ | 'dhik kṛṣṇābhaktam' dhigartho nindā, kṛṣṇābhaktasambandhinindeti bodhaḥ | 'uparyupari, ado'dhaḥ, adhyādhi, vā lokam' | dviruktoparyādeḥ samīpordhvabhāgavṛttitvasamīpādhastanabhāgavṛttitvasamīpadeśavṛttitvāni krameṇārthāḥ | sāmīpye dvitvavidhānāt pratiyogitvarūpaḥ sambandho dvitīyārthaḥ | lokapratiyogikasamīpyavadūrdhvabhāgavṛttirityādikrameṇa bodhaḥ | 'abhitaḥ parito vā kṛṣṇaṃ gopāḥ' --- anayoḥ khaṇḍaśaḥ saktyā sarvāvayavāvacchedenetyarthaḥ | tadekadeśe sarvasmin dvitīyārthasambandhānvayaḥ | kṛṣṇasambandhisarvāvayavācchedenetyarthaḥ | 'abhitaḥ' ityābhimukhye'pi | kṛṣṇasaṃmukhe ityarthaḥ | 'samayā, nikaṣā vā grāmam' ityatrāvyayaṃ sāmīpyārthe, dvitīyārtho nirūpitatvam, grāmanirūpitasāmīpyavaditi bodhaḥ | 'hā kṛṣṇābhaktam' ityatra hāśabdaḥ śoke tatsambandhī śoka iti bodhaḥ | 'hā pitaḥ kvāsi' ityādau pitṛsambodhyakapraśnaviṣayasattā śocyetyarthaḥ | ata eva piturna dvitīyā, hāśabdayogābhāvāt | 'bubhukṣitaṃ na pratibhāti' ityādau bubhukṣitasambandhikiñcidviṣayapratibhānābhāva ityarthaḥ | pratibhā bhaṭiti sphūrttiḥ | 'antarā tvāṃ māṃ ca hariḥ' ityatrāntarāśabdo madhyārthakaḥ, avadhitvarūpaḥ, sambandho dvitīyārthaḥ | evañca tvanmadavadhikamadhyavṛttirhaririti bodhaḥ | 'antarā hariṃ na sukham' ityatrātyantābhāvavānantarāśabdārthaḥ dvitīyārthaḥ pratiyogitvamabhāve'nveti | hariśabdaśca tad‌bhakyādilākṣaṇikaḥ | evañca haribhaktikābhāvavad‌vṛttisukhapratiyogiko'bhāva iti bodhaḥ | evamantareṇaśabdo'pyubhayārthaḥ | pratiyogiyogitadyoge'pi dvitīyā | 'japamanuprāvarṣat' ityatra dvitīyārtho lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvaḥ sambandho hetuśca | anuśca sambandhaviśeṣadyotakaḥ | lakṣyatavañca jñānajanyajñānaviṣayatvam | japajñānena hi japakālajñānadvārā kālaviśeṣaviśiṣṭā vṛttirjñāpyate | ata eva 'kadā vṛṣṭo devaḥ' iti paśne idamuttaram | tatra prakṛtyartho hetāvabhedenānveti | sa ca lakṣyatvaikadeśajñāne, ekapadārthayorapyevakāradau parasparānvayadarśanāt, japābhinnahetujñānajanyajñānaviṣayo varṣaṇamiti bodhaḥ | 'nadīmanvavasitā senā' -- dvitīyārthaḥ sāhityamanudyotyam | nadyā saha sambaddheti bodhaḥ | 'anuhariṃ surāḥ' -- apakarṣarūpahīnatvasambandho'nudyotyo dvitīyārthaḥ, haripratiyogikāpakarṣavanta iti bodhaḥ | uparimityatrāpvevam | 'vṛkṣaṃ prati, paryanu vā vidyotate vidyut' lakṣyatvasarvabodho dvitīyārthaḥ pratyādidyotyaḥ | vṛkṣaprakāśena vidyujjñānāt tasya lakṣaṇatvam | tena hi digviśeṣāvacchinnā vidyud jñāpyate | vṛkṣajñānajanyajñānaviṣayo vidyud‌vidyota iti bodhaḥ | bhakto viṣṇuṃ prati --- viṣayatvaṃ dvitīyārthaḥ | tasya caikadeśabhaktāvanvayaḥ |viṣṇuviṣayakabhaktyāśraya iti bodhaḥ | lakṣmīrhariṃ prati -- svatvamaryarthaḥ | haripratiyogikasvatvavīti bodhaḥ | 'vṛkṣaṃ vṛkṣaṃ prati -- siñcati ' atra vīpsā dirvicanadyatyā | vīpsāpadena bodhayitumicchāviṣayavyāpyatvaṃ buddisthāyāvatprakṛtyarthaniṣṭhamucyate | vyāpyatvaviśiṣṭavṛkṣādīnāñca svavṛttivyāptinirūpakatvena secanādyanavaya ityatra pratyādayastātparyagrāhakāḥ, karmapravacanīyatayā sambandhāvacchedakatvasya yuktatvāt | yadyapi 'vṛkṣaṃ vṛkṣaṃ siñcati' ityādau pratiṃ vināpi mānāntaragṛhītatātparyavaśāt tenaiva sambandhenānvayaḥ, tathāpi tatsattve so'pi tannirṇāyaka ityetāvataiva sambandhāvacchedakatvam | tatra vṛkṣādīnāṃ secanakarmatve'pi prathamataḥ pratidyotyasamabandhenāntaraṅgatvāt tannimittopapadavibhaktibhūtadvitīyaiva | ata eva pratyarthaṃ śabdaniveśa ityādāvarthasya niveśanakriyānirūpitādhikaraṇatve'pi arthamarthaṃ prati ityeva vigraho bhāṣyādau darśitaḥ | etena "upapadavibhakteḥ kārakavibhaktirbalīyasī" iti nyāyāt karmaṇyevātra dvitīyetyapāstam, yugapadubhayānvayasya buddhyā rūḍhatva eva tatpravṛtteḥ | pratidyotyasambandhenānvaye'pi āśrayatvenānanvayācca | vṛttiviṣaye tu pratireva vīpsāyā api dyotakaḥ | kiñca, karmaṇi dvitīyāyāṃ pratinā sāmarthyābhāvāt prativṛkṣaṃ siñcatīti prayogānāpattiḥ | etenātra karmaṇyeva dvitīyā, paryādayastu kriyāviśeṣakā eveti haradattādyuktamapāstam, kriyāviśeṣakatve'nvarthatayā karmapravacanīyasañjñāyā evānāpatteḥ | "avyayaṃviṅakti" [ 2|1|6 ] itisūtre haradattena sambandhaparicchedakatvasyaivoktatvācca | ata eva bhāṣye'pi 'kimarthaṃ punaridamucayate , na copasargādisañjñābādhanārtham, kriyāyogābhāvāt' ityuktvā 'dvitīyārtham' iti siddhāntitam | vṛkṣaṃ prati siñcatītyudāraṇe kvacit kriyānvaye karmatvādeva dvitīyā siddheti praśnaḥ | pratyādyavacchedyasambandhānvayenāntaraṅgātvāt prāptaṣaṣṭhībādhanārthamakarmakārthañcāvaśyakamityuttaramiti mama pratibhāti | 'yadatra mamābhiṣyāt, taddīyatām' atra yacchabdo buddhisthatvena bhāgavācī, matsambandhiyadbhāgakartṛkā etadadhikarayaṇikā sattā preraṇāviṣayaḥ, tatkarmakaṃ dānamiti bodhaḥ | 'sarpiṣo'pi sayāt' atrāpi bindurapapadārthadyotakaḥ | syāditi ttiṅāṃ kartṛsāmānyavācakena bindutvena tadviśeṣo lakṣyata iti tattvam | sambhāvanāyāṃ liṅ, dyotyabindau sarpiṣa ityavayavāvayavibhāvenānveti | binduśca kriyāyāmādheyatayā daurlabhyasambandena cānveti | atrāpyapireva tātparyagrāhakaḥ | evañca sarpiravayavabindudaurlabhyaprayuktadaurlabhyavatī tadabhinnaikakartṛkā sambhāvanāviṣayaḥ satteti bodhaḥ | 'api stuyād viṣṇum' sambhāvane liṅ | apirlirṅthasambhāvanāviṣayatayā śakyatvasya dyotakaḥ | viṣṇukarmakaitatkartṛkāśakyatvena sambhāvyamānā stutiriti bodhaḥ | viṣṇuviṣayāyāḥ1[fn 'stuteḥ' śeṣaḥ | ] śakyatvasambhāvane vānyaviṣayāniścayena śakyeti phalati | etena 'api vedāntapāragam' ityādāvapiyoge svārthe na tātparyamiti dharmaśāstragranthā vyākhyātāḥ | īdṛśeṣu sambhāvanāviṣayatayaucityaṃ dyotyam, sambhāvitaucityasya cānuṣṭhānamayuktamiti svārthe tātparyābhāvo bodhyaḥ | yadvā, śakyatvādinā sambhāvanaṃ kriyāviṣayamapi dyotyam,liṅ tu vidhyādau | evañca sambhāvane'pi "karmapravacanīye" ityanuśāsanaṃ yathāśrutameva | ādye tu sambhāvanāviṣaye varttamānaḥ 'apiḥ' iti tadartho bodhyaḥ | 'api stuhi' -- stutāvicchāpravṛttiviṣayatāpi dyotyā | icchāpravṛttiviṣayā stutiriti bodhaḥ | 'api stuyād vṛṣalam' kriyāgataṃ garhyatvamapidyotyam | vṛṣalakarmikā garhyā stutiriti bodhaḥ | stutergarhyatve tatkartturapi garhyatvaṃ phalati | tadeva dhigdevadattamityādinānūdyate | 'māsamadhīte' atra triṃśaddinasamudāyo māsapadārthaḥ, tattatasambandhaśca dinaparyāptatriṃśatvavyāpakatvam | tatra triṃśattvādermāsādipadādeva lābhād vyāpakatāmātraṃ dvitīyārthaḥ | atastraṃśatsu dineṣu kiñcitkālāvacchedenādhyayanasambandhe'pi tatprayogopapattiḥ | vyāpākatñca triṃśattvavanniṣṭhapratiyogivyadhikaraṇātyantābhāvapratiyogitānavacchedakāvacchinnatvam, taccadhyayanādāvanveti | pratiyogivyadhikaraṇetiviśeṣaṇādināvāntaradaṇḍādāvadhyayanābhāva'pyuktaprayogīpapattiḥ | māsapadañca triṃśaddinaparameva, na tu tāvatkālasthāyyakhaṇḍavastuparam, ekadinādhyayane'pi tādṛśākhaṇḍakāle pratiyogivyadhikaraṇadhyayanābhāvena māsamadhīta iti prayogāpatteḥ | māsaghaṭakaṃ dinañca sūryodayāvadhi sūryodayāntakaparyantasthāyyakhaṇḍavastuparam, na tu kriyāsamūhaḥ | tathā satyekaikakriyādivyakterapi māsatvādhikaraṇatayā tatra pratiyogivyadhikaraṇādhyayanādyabhāvasattvena bādhāpatteḥ | 'dinaṃ svapiti' ityādau dinapadaṃ triṃśaddaṇḍakūṭaparam | sūryodayāvadhi sūryāstaparyantakṣaṇakūṭaparaṃ vā | ato naikadaṇḍādisvapne tathā prayogaḥ | triṃśattvādikaṃ ca tātparyavaśādviśiṣya tatra triṃśattvameva bhāsate | etenaikamāsavyāpakādhyayanasthale'pi māsāntare'dhyayanābhāvasattavena māsavyāpakatāyā adhyayane bādhena māsamadhīta ityādyupapattiriti parāstam | evam 'krośaṃ kuṭilā nadī' ityādāvapi yat kiñcit krośatvavanniṣṭhapratiyogivyadhikaraṇātyantābhāvapratiyogitānavacchedakāvaccinnatvaṃ kuṭilādau bhāsate | krośatvādikañca buddhisthadaṇḍādiparicchannasaṅkhyāviśeṣavad deśatvameveti na kaścid doṣaḥ1 [fn nanu 'māsamāste' ityadāviva 'māsamadhīte' ityatrāpi dhātorvyapana paryantaṃ vṛttisvīkāreṇaiva "karturīpsita" iti karmatvena dvitīyāsiddhau "kālādhvanoḥ" iti sūtraṃ vyartham | hariṇāppuktam --- kālabhāvādhvadeśānāmantarbhūtakriyāntaraiḥ | sarvairakarmakairyoge karmatvamupajāyate || iti | atrākarmakairityuktāvapi nyāyasāmyena sakarmakadhātorapi tadarthāntarbhāveṇa bādhakābhāvaḥ | ata eva 'prākṛtamevaitat kama' iti prakṛtasūtrasthabhāṣyeṇāśaṅkitamiti cet, satyam ; 'yatra akriyayā saṃyogaḥ, tadarthāmadaṃ vaktavyam' iti bhāṣya eva samādhānāt | na ca kathaṃ tarhi 'māsamadhīte' ityudāharaṇamiti vācyam, saṃbandhasāmānyavivakṣāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhībādhanāthatvena kriyāyogārthamapyāvaśyakatvena yatra kriyākārakabhāvena nānvayavivakṣā tatrātyantasaṃyogārthamiti tadbhāṣyavyākhyānasyo citatvāt | ]| iti subarthavāde dvitīyāvibhaktyarthanirūpaṇaṃ samāptam | <14> atha tṛtīyāvibhaktyarthanirūpaṇam kārakatṛtīyāyāḥ kartā, karaṇañca vācyam, "karttṛ karaṇayostṛtīyā" [ 2|3|18 ] iti sūtrasvarasāt | tatra kartṛtvabodhakaṃ sūtram -- "svatantraḥ kartā" [ 1|4|54 ] iti kārakādhikārāt kriyāyāṃ svatantraḥ kartṛsaṃjñaka iti tasyārthaḥ | svātantryañca vyāpāratāvacchedakamasambandhena tad‌dhātvarthaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpitaḥ prakāratānāśrayatve sati tannirūpitaviśeṣyatārūpamukhyaviśeṣyatāvaddhātvarthāśrayatvam | taddhātvarthaniṣṭhetyatra dhātvarthaśca tātparyagrāhakānapekṣadhātuśakya eva grāhyaḥ | tena ṇico dyotakatve'pi 'devadattena yajñadattaḥ pācayati' ityādau pac‌dhātvarthaprayojyavyāpāraśrayaprayojakavyāpārāśrayayoḥ kartṛtvasiddiḥ | kālikādisambandhena vyāpārāśraye'tivyāptivāraṇāya sambandhaviśeṣaniveśaḥ | etena sāmagrīsādhyāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ sarveṣāṃ svasvavyāpāre svātantryāt 'svatantraḥ' ityavyāvartakamityapāstam, prāguktasvātantryasya yugapat sarveṣvabhāvāt | mukhyaviśeṣyatālakṣaṇe daladvayopādānana 'rūpavantaṃ gacchati' ityādāvuttaradeśasaṃyogarūpe phale rūpādau ca na mukhyaviśeṣyatvamiti tadāśraye rūpavati nātivyāptiriti bodhyam | atra kartṛpratyayasamabhivyāhāre ityapi viśeṣaṇaṃ bodhyam | tena 'pakvastaṇḍulo devadattena' ityādau phalasya viśeṣyatve'pi devadattasya kartṛ tvasiddhiḥ | atrāpi vyāpārasyānyata eva lābhād āśrayamātraṃ tṛtīyārthaḥ | tatra ca prakṛtyarthasyābhedenānvayaḥ | sa ca dhātvarthe ādheyatāsambandhenānveti | evañca 'cetraiṇa supyate' ityādau caitrābhinnāśrayavṛttiḥ svāpa ityādi bodhaḥ | yattu, tattatkriyānukūlakṛtyāśrayatvaṃ tattatkartṛtvam | karttetyatra kṛdhātoḥ kṛtivācakatvena tṛcaścāśrayavācitvena yogārthabalāt tathaiva lābhāt, gurutarabhārotolanādiviṣayakayatnasattve'pi tattatkriyāyā aniṣpattau tat‌karttṛtvāvyavahārād viṣayatvamapahāyānukūlatvamupāttama | tatrāśrayasya prakṛttyaiva lābhāt kṛtirevārtha iti | tat, na ; kṛterapi dhātulabhyatāyā ākhyāte nirūpitatvāt, āśrayatvena tasya prakṛtyā'lābhācca | 'daṇḍaḥ pacati' ityādau 1[fn kṛteścetanavṛttitvāditi śeṣo bodhyaḥ | ] acetane'vyāptiśca | tatrāśraye lakṣaṇeti cet, svecchāmātreṇa tasyā anucitatvāt | lakṣamayā bodhopapādane'pi tatra sādhutve mānābhāvācca | etenācetane gauṇaṃ kartṛtvamityapāstam | śāstrīyakāryavailakṣaṇyādarśanena bhāṣyakārādonāmaikarūpyeṇa vyavahārācca tvaduktimātreṇa tasyāyuktatvāt | kiñca, kṛñaḥ kṛtivācakatvameva neti nirūpitamākhyātavāde | yattu, matto bhūtam, na tu mayā kṛtamiti vyapadeśād 1[fn antarā bhavam = antarīyam, gahāditvāt chaḥ | antarīyameva antarīyakam | na antarīyakam = nāntarīyakam| 'saha supā' iti samāsāt nasya lopābhāvaḥ | ] nāntarīyakakṛtisādhyapiṣṭakamadhyasthaśarkarābhojananirūpitakartṛ tvasyāpi niveśe tu yāgādikṛterud‌deśyatayā svargādiviṣayakatvena yāgādikartari svargādikartṛ tvāpatteriti | tat, na ; sādhyatvena viṣayatāyā eva vyavahārābhāvācca tatrātivyāptiḥ , kṛtau kriyāviṣayāviniveśāt, yāgādikṛtāvud‌deśyatayā svargādiviṣayakatve'pi svargānukūlatvābhāvācca | anukūlatāviśeṣasyaiva niveśāt | tādṛśaśarkarābhojanāśraye kartṛtvasyeṣṭatvamityapi kaścit | yadapi, kārakacakraprayoktṛtvaṃ kartṛ tvamiti | tadapi na, acetane'vyāpteḥ | kiñca kārakacakraprayoktṛ tvaṃ kārakāntarajanyavyāpārajanakatvam | evañca karmajanyaphalajanake karaṇe kuṭhārādāvativyāptiḥ | na ca kārakāntarajanyavyāpārābhāvavattvarūpakārakāntarāprayojyatve satīti viśeṣaṇānna doṣaḥ, puruṣādijanyasaṃyogādirūpavyāpārattvāt karaṇaderiti vācyam, īśvaraprayojyānāṃ kartṛtvānāpatteriti dik | nanvevaṃ ghaṭo bhavatītyādau ghaṭādeḥ kartṛ tvānāpattiḥ, utpatteḥ pūrvaṃ teṣāmabhāvena dhātvarthavyāpārānāśrayatvāditi cet, na ; 2[fn satkāryavāde kāryasayātyantiko'bhāvo na bhavati, kintu nāśakāraṇasāmagrīsamavadhānadaśāyāmapi sadeva kāryaṃ tirohitaṃ bhavati, utpattikāramasāmagrī samavadhāne ud‌bhūtaṃ bhavati | evañca ghaṭāderapi upatteḥ prāk sūkṣmāvasthayā vartamānatvena dhātvarthavyāpārāśrayatvena kartṛtvaṃ setsyati | ]satkāryavāde doṣābhāvāt | matāntare'pīdṛśe viṣaya upādānakāraṇasya vyāpārāśrayatvavikṣāyā eva kartṛ tvaprayojakatā bodhyā | etanmate ca dhātvarthavyāparāśrayatvatadvyāpārāśrayopādānakatvānyataratvaṃ svātantryaṃ bodhyam | kecittu padārthasattā na bodhe prayojikā, kintu vivakṣaiva | ata eva khapuṣpamityādito'pi bodhaḥ | evaca prakṛte'pi bodhaḥ | evañca prakṛte'pi na doṣa ityāhuḥ | atra kecid dhātvarthavyāpāraśrayatvaṃ sākṣāt paramparayā vā | tatrādyaṃ prasiddham, dvitīyaṃ tu pañcabhirhalaiḥ karṣatīti | tatra hi -- svāśrayaprayojakatvasambandhena karturdhātvarthavyāpāraśrayatvam, anyathā prayojyavyāpārasya dhātvarthe tadāśrayāṇāṃ bahutvād bahuvacanāpattiḥ, prayojanakavyāpārasyāpi dhātuvācyatve tu ṇicāpattiḥ, antarbhāvitaṇyartha iti pravādasyāpyayamevārtha iti | tat, na ; antarbhāvitaṇyarthatvena sakarmakatāyā ucchedāpatteḥ | ata eva sakarmakāṇāmantarbhāvitaṇyarthakatve dvikarmakatāmāhuḥ | tasmāt prayojakvayāpāro'pi tatra tadarthaḥ, parantu yatra ṇijaṃ vinā tadarthadyotakamasti, tatraivedam | yathā pratṛte pañcabhibhirhalairiti | kvacittu ekānte tūṣṇīmāsīnatvādikam | tasmāt kṛṣerṇyarthāntarbhāveṇa lakṣaṇetyeva tattvam | spaṣṭaṃ cedaṃ kaiyaṭe | yadi tu, dvitīyakarmarahito'pi tatra prayogaḥ, tadā prayojakavyāpārasyaiva dhātvarthatvamāśritya samādheya iti dik | kartṛtvaṃ ca vivakṣānibandhanam | tena sthālyādivyāpārasyāpi dhātvartha [tva-] vivakṣāyāṃ sthalī pacatīti bhavati | evamekasyaivopādhibhedena kartṛ tvakarmatvakaraṇatvān‌yapi bhavanti | yathātmānamātmanā sṛjasīti | taduktaṃ hariṇā -- etena jñānasvarūpasyātmanaḥ svarūpajñānaṃ viṣayatvarūpasvaprakāśatve kartṛ karmavirodhaḥ | abhede ādārādheyabhāvasya viṣayaviṣayibhāvasya cābhāvāditi vācaspatyuktiḥ parāstā, śabdaviśeṣopādhikasya kartṛ tvādeḥ pratyakṣādāvuktisambhavābhāvāt | yadi tu, kartṛkarmaśabdayorāśrayaviṣayalakṣakatvam | yadi vā svaprakāśatve ityasya svaprakāśapadavyavahāryatve ityarthaḥ, svaṃ prakāśayatīti hi svaprakāśapadavyutpatatiḥ, tadā samyagevetyalaṃ pallavitena | karaṇatvabodhakañca sūtram "sādhakatamaṃ karaṇam"[ 2|4|42 ] iti | kartṛvyāpārādhīnayad‌vyāpārāvyavadhānana kriyāniṣpattiravivakṣyate, tatra kriyā karaṇamiti tadarthaḥ | caitraścaitreṇa pacati, kāṣṭhaṃ caitreṇa patratīti vyāvṛttyarthaṃ kartṛvyāpārādhīneti, adhikaraṇādivyāpārāvyavadhānenāpi yadā kriyāniṣpatirvivakṣyate, tadā teṣāmapi karaṇatvamiṣṭameva | yadāha hariḥ --- vastutastadanirdeśyaṃ nahi vastu vyavasthitam | sthālyā pacyata ityeṣā vivakṣā dṛśyate yataḥ | iti kāraṇavibhaktervyāpāro'rthaḥ | tatra prakṛtyarthasyādheyatayānvayaḥ, vyāpārasya ca svaniṣṭhajanakatānirūpitāvyavahitottarotpattikatvasambandhena dhātvarthe'nvaya iti kecit | ata eva āśrayo'vadhiruddaśyaḥ sambandhaḥ śaktireva vā | iti vibhaktyarthanirūpaṇe haryuktiḥ saṃṅgacchata ityapare | div‌dhātuyoge tu idameva dvitīyāntapadānupasthāpyatvaviśiṣṭaṃ karaṇalakṣaṇaṃ bodhyam | 'pitrā pitaraṃ saṃjānīte' ityatra tṛtīyāyāḥ karmārthaḥ | athopapadavibhaktitṛtīyāsu bodho likhyate 'prakṛtyā cāruḥ' ityatra prakṛtiryāvadāśrayabhāvidharmaviśeṣaḥ | tena tatsambandhicārutvavānityarthaḥ | tṛtīyārthaḥ sambandhaḥ | 'prāyeṇa yājñikaḥ' ityatra prāyaśabdo baharthaḥ, bahutvavāṃścācārādiḥ | tena bahutvavadācārasambandhiyājñikatvavān iti bodhaḥ | sambandhaśca jñāpyajñāpakabhāvaḥ | yadvā, prāyaśabdaḥ sambhāvanārthaḥ, sambhāvanāviṣayayājñikatvavānityarthaḥ. dṛśyate ca tasyāṃ prāyaśabdaḥ, 'prāyeṇa niṣkrāmati cakrapāṇau' iti | 'prāyeṇāsmin vaṃśe yājñikāḥ' ityādau tu bahutvārthaḥ | bahutvavanto yājñikā iti bodhaḥ | 'gotreṇa gārgyaḥ' ityatra gotrasambandhigārgyatvavānityarthaḥ | sāmānyaviśeṣaṇabhāvaḥ sambandhaḥ | 'dvidroṇena dhānyaṃ krīṇāti' --- droṇadvayaparicchin‌nadhānyakarmakaḥ kraya iti bodhaḥ | sukhena yātītyatra sukhajanakaṃ yānamiti bodhaḥ | 'nāmnā sutīkṣṇaḥ'-- jñāpyatvarūpaḥ sambandhastṛtīyārthaḥ | nāmajñāpyasutīkṣṇatvavāniti bodhaḥ | evam 'caritena dāntaḥ' ityatrāpi | suratho nāma rājetyādau suratha ityatra surathaśabdavācya ityarthaḥ | nāmetyavyayaṃ saṃjñārtham | nāmaśabdārthasaṃjñāyāḥ surathaśabdaikadeśe śabde'nvayaḥ | tena saṃjñābhinnasurathaśabdavācya iti bodhaḥ | yadvā, suratheti śabdaparaṃ saṃjñābhinnasurathaśabdabhinno rājeti bodhaḥ | yadvā, nāmetyapi śabdaparatve tātparyagrāhakam | nāmnā candrakaletyādāvanavyayanāmayoge'pyevameva | abhedastṛtīyārthaḥ | evamavacchedakatvāvacchedyatvādīnāṃ sambandhatvavivakṣāyāṃ paṭatvena ; janyatvam, prakāratvam, abhāvaḥ, ityādiṣu prakṛtyāditvāt tṛtīyā bodhyā | 'ahnā krośena vānuvāko'dhītaḥ' ityatra tṛtīyārthaḥ sambandhaḥ, ktapratyayārthātītatvaikadeśe nāśe, phalaprāptipūrvakatvañca dyotyam | evañcāhassambandhiphalaprāptipūrvakanāśapratiyogi anuvākaviṣayakamadyayanamiti bodhaḥ | 'putreṇa sahāgataḥ' ityādau "sahayukte'pradhāne" [ 2|3|18 ] iti tṛtīyā, sahārthaviśeṣaṇatvamaprādhānvam | 'kriyāpradhānam' ityādau pradhānaśabdasya viśeṣyaparatāyā dṛṣṭatvāt | sahaśabdārthaśca svānvayisamabhivyāhṛtapadārthagatasamānakālikatvam | tṛtīyārthaśca kriyāsamabhivyāhāre tattatkriyākartṛ tvādikameva | evañca śiṣyeṇa saha sthūlaḥ, śiṣyeṇa sahāgataḥ, śiṣyeṇa sahopādhyāyasya gaurityādau śiṣyavṛttisthaulyasamānakālikasthauliyavān,
