śiṣyakartṛkāgamanasamānakālikāgamanavān, śiṣyasambandhisvatvasamānakālikopādhyāyasvatvavatī gaurityādikrameṇa bodhaḥ | antye ca ṣaṣṭhyarthasambandha eva sahārthānvayaḥ, tathaivānubhavāt | kvacit samānadeśatvaṃ tadarthaḥ | ata eva māṣavāpottaraṃ tasminneva kṣetre tilavāpe'pi tilaiḥ saha māṣān vapatismeti bhavati | spaṣṭañcedamatraiva bhāṣyādau tu samānakālikatvamātramarthaḥ, tātparyādityāhuḥ | apare tu sahaśabdārthaḥ sāhityam | pitrādyanvayiputrasāhityavān pitā āgata iti bodhaḥ | sāhitayañca samānakālikādisamabhivyāhṛtakriyādyāśrayatvasamānādhikaraṇo'khaṇḍopādhiḥ, padārthāntaraṃ vetyanyadetat | asyāpi dharmasya prāguktasāhityasamānasaṃvitsaṃvedyatvasvīkārāt tadviṣayakabodhasyānubhavasiddhatve'pi na doṣaḥ | ata eva pitari tṛtīyāpādanaṃ bhāṣyoktaṃ saṅgacchate | anyathā pūrvoktamate sahārthasya kriyādāvanvaye'pi tenānvayāt tadāpādanamasaṅgatameva syāt ; ityāhuḥ | evaṃ vidyamānatāvācisahaśabdayogi'pi tṛtīyā | 'sahaiva daśabhiḥ putrairbhāraṃ vahati gardabhī ityādau' 1 [fn asyāyamāśayaḥ -- sahaśabdo luptasaptamyantaḥ, sā ca satī saptamī apiśabdādhyāhāraśca | tenoktārthalābhaḥ | kecuttu -- atra vidyamānetyadhyāhāraḥ | tathā ca vidyatikriyāprayuktasāhityanirvāha iti pratyapīpadan | ] daśasaṃkhyākaputrāṇāṃ vidyamānatve'pītyarthaḥ | evaṃ sahārthapratiyoginaḥ śābdāprādhānye'pi ārthaprādhānyameva | ata eva samakakṣayormaṃdhye'nyatarasayāpareṇa sahāgantavyamityukte duḥkhaṃ dṛśyata iti bodhyam | 'akṣṇā kāṇaḥ' ityatra cakṣurnāśavān | sacakṣuṣkaḥ kāṇapadārthaḥ, cakṣuḥ padārtho golakam, tṛtīyārtho vikāraprayuktatavādirūpaḥ sambandhaḥ | golakavikāraprayuktacakṣurnāśavān sacakṣuṣka iti bodhaḥ | evam 'pādena khañjaḥ' ityādau pādivikāraprayuktasaṃsthānavaidhuryavaccaraṇavāniti | 'kāyena daśavaktraḥ, mukhena trilocanaḥ' ityādau prakṛtyāditvāt tṛtīyā bodhyā | 'jaṭābhistāpasaḥ' ityādau jñāpyatvarūpasambandhastṛtīyārthaḥ | jaṭājñāpyatāpasatvavāniti bodhaḥ | 'daṇḍena ghaṭaḥ' ityādau hetustṛtīyārthaḥ, hetutvāñca ananyathāsiddhaniyatapūrvavarttitvādirūpaṃ kāraṇatvameva | tatsamānādhikaraṇo'khaṇḍopādhirvā | prakṛtipratyayārthayorabhedaḥ saṃsargaḥ | pratyayārthasya ca janyatāsaṃsargeṇetaratrānvayaḥ | evañca daṇḍābhinnahetujanyo ghaṭa iti bodhaḥ | 'adhyayanena vasati' ityādau phalasyāpyadhyayanasya hetutvaṃ 2[fn atra 'svajñānadvārā' iti pāṭhaḥ samīcīnaḥ, arthānukūlatvāt | eñca adhyayanasya vāsaphalasyāpi svajñānadvārā vāsanimittatayā hetutvena vivakṣāyāṃ tṛtīyā | adhyayanābhinahetuka ekakartṛko vāsa iti bodhaḥ | kāśyādestu adhyayananimittatve'pi adhikaraṇatvavivakṣāyāṃ saptamī | vastutasatu "hetau" iti sūtre phalasyāpi hetutvena vivakṣaṇād adhyayanarūpaphalajanako vāsa ityanubhavasiddhabodhasya nirvāhaḥ siddhyati | ] sujñānadvārā bodhyam | 'dāsyā saṃyacchate' ityatrod‌deśyastṛtīyārthaḥ, dāṇayoge aśiṣṭavyavahāre caturthyarthe tadvidhānāt | dāsyud‌deśyaṃ kāmukakartṛkaṃ dānamiti bodhaḥ | iti tṛtīyāvibhaktyarthanirūpaṇaṃ samāptam | atha kārakacaturthyarthanirūpaṇam kārakacaturthyāḥ samprādānamarthaḥ, "caturthī sampradāne" [ 2|3|13 ] iti sūtrāt | sampradānatvabodhakañca "karmaṇā yamabhipraiti sa sampradānam"[ 1|4|32 ] iti sūtram | dhātvarthakarmaṇā samband‌dhumicchati sampradānamiti tadarthaḥ | karmasambandhaśca karmaniṣṭhaphalanirūpakatvādi | evañca tattaddhātukarmaniṣṭhaphalanirūpakatvādinā icchāviṣayastattaddhātusampradānamiti phalitam | karmaniṣṭhetyanena karmaṇaścaturthīnimittatvapradarśanāt karmaśrutyapekṣayā caturthīśruterbalavattvaṃ bodhyate | atha eva krīte some maitrāvaruṇāya daṇḍaṃ prayacchatīti daṇḍadānaṃ na pratipattiḥ, kintu dvitīyāpekṣayā balīyasyā caturthīśrutyā maitrāvaruṇasaṃskārakamiti mīmāṃsakāḥ | atra kecit, kartturicchāviṣayaścaturthyarthaḥ, phalasya dhātunā nirūpitatvasya 1[fn ākāṅkṣayetyarthaḥ | ]saṃsargamaryādayā lābhāt | ayameva coddeśya ityucyate | evañca 'viprāya gāṃ dadāti' ityatra svatvatannivṛttyubhayānukūlvayāpārarūpadādhātvarthaikadeśe svatve caturthyarthasya nirūpakatayānvayaḥ | evañca viprābhinnecchāviṣayānirūpitasvatvasvīyatannivṛttyubhayānukūlo vyāpāra iti bodhaḥ | yattu, nirupitatvena karturicchāviṣayatvaṃ caturthyarthaḥ, dādhātvarthatāvacchedakasvatve ca tadanveti, svatvajanakatyāgaśca dadātyarthaḥ | evañca vipranirūpitatvenecchāviṣayagoniṣṭhasvatvajanakatyāgakartteti bodha iti | tat, na ; nāmārthavibhaktyarthayoḥ klṛptasyābhedānvayasya bhaṅgāpatteḥ | sampradānasyecchāviṣayatvabodhakasūtrasvarasabhaṅgāccetyāhuḥ | taccintya; pitṛbhyaḥ śrāddhaṃ dadyādityādau anupapatteḥ, pitṛnirūpitatvasya svatve bādhāt | ata eva śrāddhasya pitrapekṣayā bhāgātvameva, dānatvaṃ tu viprāpekṣayeti śūlapāṇyādayaḥ | tasmāt svarūpasambandharūpamud‌deśyatvaṃ padārthāntaraṃ vā tadāśrayaścaturthyarthaḥ | svavṛttyud‌deśyatānirūpakatvena dhātvarthaḥ tasyānvayaḥ | dādhātvarthaśca svatvanivṛttipūrvakaparasvattvotpattyanukūlastyāgaḥ | na ca tyāgo na parasvatvahetuḥ, pratigrahādereva tattvāditi vācyam, viprod‌deśena tyaktāyāṃ gavi gauriyaṃ viprasya na mametyādisārvajanīnapratītereva pramāmatvāt | ata eva videśasthapātruddiśya tyaktadhane svīkāramantareṇaiva pātrasya maraṇe'pi uddeśyaputrādibhireva pitṛdāyatvena taddhanaṃ vibhajyate, anyathā tairivodāsīnairapi taddhanasyāraṇyakakuśāderivopādāne pratyavāyo na syāt | na caivaṃ svīkāro vyarthaḥ, 'labdhāvaṣṭaguṇaṃ puṇyam' iti smṛteḥ pratigṛhītadhanadānasya phalātiśayahetutayā tādṛśatvasampattyarthameva tadupayogāt | adṛṣṭārthaṃ dattasvīkāra eva pratigraha iti paritoṣadattatilaturagādeḥ | svīkāro na doṣāvahaḥ . na ca saṃsṛṣṭisthale'sādhāraṇasvatvanāśottaraṃ sādhāraṇasvatvotpādāt tatra dadātīti prayogāpattiriti vācyam, paramatra svatvānukūleti viśeṣaṇānna doṣaḥ | na tatra svatvanāśaḥ, kintu parasvatvotpattimātram | svatvavati svatvotpattistu tatratyecchayā uttejakatvādityanye | tyāgābhāvānna tathāprayoga ityapare | na copekṣāsthale doṣaḥ, tatra niyamataḥ parasvatvotpattyabhāvāt | ata eva vikrayasthale na tathā prayogaḥ, tasaya parasvatvājanakatvāt | krayasyaiva tajjanakatvāt | mūlyadānapūrvakasvīkārasyaiva krayapadārthatvāt | nanu kimatra svatvamiti cet, śāstrāniṣiddhayatheṣṭaviniyogopāyabhūtakramapratigrahādiviṣayatvam | tacca na vahirindriyavedyam, pratigrahādermānasajñānaviśeṣasya bahirindriyāyogyatavāditi prāñcaḥ | navyāstu, pratigrahādināśottaramapi svatvavyavahārād dānāditaḥ svatvaṃ naśyati, pratigrahāditaścotpadyate ityādivyavahārācca svatvamatiriktaḥ padārthaḥ | tacca bahirindriyavedyam, svaṃ paśyāmītyādivyavahārāt | tatsākṣātkāre ca tadīyasvatvavyāpyatadīyayatheṣṭaviniyojyatvavadidamityākārakajñānaṃ hetuḥ | ato na tad‌grahe tadīyayatheṣṭaviniyojyatve tadīyasvatvavyabhicāritvagrahe ca na tad‌graha ityāhuḥ | anumeyameva svatvam | svaṃ paśyāmīti tu surabhi candanaṃ paśyāmītivanna viśeṣaṇāṃśe laukikaviṣayatvāvagāhīti navyatarāḥ | evañca viprābhinnoddeśyakaḥ prāguktastyāga iti bodhaḥ | evañca pitṛbhyaḥ śrāddhaṃ dadyādityādāvapina doṣaḥ | tatra pitṛṇāmapyuddeśyatvāt | khaṇḍikopādhyāyastasmai capeṭāṃ dadātatyatra saṃyogaviśeṣānukūlo vyāpārodārthaḥ | capeṭā prasṛtakaratalam | na śūdrāya matiṃ dadyādityādau dadātirbodhanārthaḥ, matiśabdena tajjanakaṃ śāstramucyate | śeṣatvavivakṣāyāṃ rajakasya vastramityapi sādhu iti bodhyam | kecit -- tu, karmatvasya kriyānirūpitatvāt 'kārake' ityadhikārācca 'tatkriyākarmaṇā karaṇabhūtena tatkriyākarmasambandhajanyaphalabhāgitvena yamabhirpraiti, sa saṃpradānam' iti sūtrārthaḥ | karmasambandhajanyaṃ phalañca, golābhajanyaṃ viprasukhādi | tacca samabhivyāhārabalāt tātparyataśca viśeṣarūpeṇa bhāsate | karmasambandhajanyaphalabhāgitvenoddeśyaścaturthyartha | evañca viprābhinno yo gosambandhajanyasukhāśrayatvenoddeśyaḥ, tannirūpatigovṛttisvatvotpattisvasvatvanivṛttyubhayānukūlo vyāpāra iti bodhaḥ | evañca karmaṇetyasya cāritārthyaṃ spaṣṭameva | evaṃ kriyayā yamityetat sampādyacaturthyā kriyājanyaphalāśrayatayoddeśyo'rthaḥ, phalañca ratilābhādītyāhuḥ | tat, na; "gatyarthakarmaṇi" [ 2|3|12 ] ityādi1[fn ayamāśayaḥ -- "karmaṇā yamabhipraiti" ityatra kriyāgrahaṇamapi kṛtvā 'grāmāya ityatra caturthī saṃsādhya' "karmaṇi dvitīyā" ityanena 'grāmam' ityatra dvitīyāṃ saṃsādhya ca sūtramidaṃ pratyākhyātaṃ bhagavatā bhāṣyakāreṇa | yadyapi tatra kriyāgrahaṇaṃ pratyākhyātam, tathāpi tatphalasyānyayāsādhanena tad‌vacanapratyākhyānānnāpūrvaṃ vacanaṃ karttavyaṃ bhavati | abhedaṃ tattvam -- sūtramate dvitīyācaturthyoḥ karamamātramarthaḥ | grāmakarmakaṃ gamanamiti bodhaḥ | bhāṣyamate ca "kriyayā yamabhipraiti" iti sampradānasaṃjñāyāṃ caturthīti grāmasampradānakottaradeśasamayogānukūlavyāpāraviṣayaka ārambha iti bodhaḥ | ] pratyākhyānaparabhāṣyādivirodhena īdṛśārthasyāyuktatvāt, evaṃ śābdabodhe mānābhāvācca | atra sūtre karmaṇetyāvarttate, āvarttamānañca kriyāparam | tena karmarahitakriyoddeśyasyāpi sampradānatvāt 'patye śete' ityādisiddhiḥ | patyuddeśyakaśayanamiti bodhaḥ | 'paśunā rudraṃ yajate' ityatra phalāśrayastṛtīyārthaḥ, uddeśyo dvitīyārthaḥ | paśukarmakarudrasampradānakadānamiti bodhaḥ 2[fn rudrod‌deśyakaḥ paśuniṣṭhasvatvanivṛttyanukūlo vyāpāra iti tvārthaḥ | ] | 'karmaṇaḥ karaṇasañjñā, sampradānasya ca karmasañjñā' iti vārttikāt | haraye rocate bhaktiḥ -- viṣayatāsambandhāvacchinnaprītyanukūlastatsamānādhikaraṇo vyāpāro rucerarthaḥ | āśrayarūpasambandhaścaturthyarthaḥ, 'rucyarthānāṃ prīyamāṇaḥ' [ 1|4|33 ] iti sūtrasvarasāt | 3[fn atra 'rucyārthaḥ' ityataḥ pūrvam 'rucirartho yeṣāṃ te' pāṭhastruṭitaḥ kalpanīyaḥ, anyathā granthāsaṅgatiḥ | ] rucyarthaḥ | śeṣaṣaṣṭhyapavādo'yaṃ rucyarthaphalalasambandhitvamevātra sampradānatvam | evañca hariniṣṭhā bhaktiviṣayā yā prītiḥ, tadanukūlo bhaktiniṣṭho vyāpāra iti | abhilaṣatestu tatsambandhāvacchinnaprītivyadhikaraṇo vyāpāro'rtha iti na sa rucyartha iti harirbhaktimabhilaṣyatītyādau na hareḥ sampradānatā | 'gopī smarāt kṛṣṇā ślāghate' ityatra ślāghaterbodhaphalikā stutirarthaḥ | stutiśca guṇavattvapratipādakaśabdaprayogādiḥ | smarāditi hetau pañcamī | catuthyarthaḥ karmatvaṃ bodhe'nveti | "ślāgha hanuṅasthāśapāṃ jñūpsyamānaḥ" [ 1|4|34 ] iti sūtrasvarasād jñīpsyamānapadena ca pradhānabhūtaṇyarthakarmaṇa eva grahaṇaṃ bodhyam | evañca gopīkartṛ kā smarahetukā kṛṣaamabodhaphalikā stutiriti bodhaḥ | stutiścātmanaḥ parasya veti tu prakaṇādigamyam | ata eva kṛṣṇāyātmānaṃ ślāghata ityapi bhavati | idamevābhisandhāya kṛṣṇāyātmānaṃ paraṃ vā ślāghyaṃ kathayatītyartha iti prāñcaḥ | kṛṣṇasyaiva stutatve tu paratvāt karmatvameva | hanute ityatra hnauterbodhaviṣayetarādarśanayogyadeśasthāpanamarthaḥ | ātmānamiti karmapadādhyāhāraḥ | sapatnībhiyā ca svasya tathāvasthānaṃ bodhyam | evañca kṛṣṇaniṣṭhabodhaviṣayātmakarmakatatha vasthānānukūlavyāpāro gopīvṛttiriti bodhaḥ | tiṣṭhateḥ svābhiprāyabodhānukūlā sthitirarthaḥ | svābhiprāyabodhānukūlaṃ śapathakaraṇaṃ śaperarthaḥ | kṛṣṇakarmakabodhānukūlā sthitiḥ | tatkarmakabodhānukūlaṃ śapathakaraṇamiti bodhaḥ | evañca śalāghādidhātvarthaphalāśrayatvamatra sampradānatvamiti bodhyamityāhuḥ | apare tu --- evaṃ hi jñāpyamāna ityeva siddhe sana upādānavaiyarthyāpattiḥ | ṇyante karttuśca karmaṇa ityuktayā jñāpyamānapadena tasyaiva grahamasiddhe jñīpsyamānapadena yad‌viṣayakajñānānukūlavyāpārānukūlavyāpāraḥ, sa[nā] gṛhyate, prathamopasthitatvena prakṛtyarthakarmagrahaṇasyaivaucityācca | tasyāpi jñāpanaviṣayecchāviṣayatavānna śānajanupapattiḥ | ślāghādeśca stutyādipūrvikā bodhanārthaḥ | stutyā kṛṣṇamanyasya bodhayati, hanutiviśiṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇamanyasya bodhayati, sthityā ; śapathena ca kṛṣṇamanyasya bodhayatītyartha ityāhuḥ | sanaḥ svārasyenobhayorapi jñīpsyamānapadena grahaṇamiti bahavaḥ | 'bhaktāya dhārayati mokṣo hariḥ' atra "dhāreruttamarṇaḥ"1[uttamamṛṇaṃ yasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ | ata eva nipātanād niṣṭhāntasya paranipātaḥ | uttamarṇo dhanasvāmī | ] | [ 1|4|35 ] iti bhaktaḥ saṃpradānam | tatra 'dhṛṅ avasthāne' iti dhātorṇici avasthānānukūlo dhārerarthaḥ | sambandhaścaturthyarthaḥ | evañca bhaktasambandhimokṣakarmakāvasthityanukūlo vyāpāro hariniṣṭha iti bodhaḥ | dhārayatyarthāvasthityāśrayasambandhatvametat sampradānatvaṃ bodhyam | nanu ṛṇaṃ nāma sajānīyadravyāntaradānamaṅgīkṛtya paradattaparakīyadravyādānaṃ tajjanyo'dhamarṇaniṣṭhapariśodhananāśyo'dṛṣṭaviśeṣo vā, ubhayathāpi neha prāptiḥ, mokṣasyoktarūṛṇatvābhāvena bhaktasyottamarṇatvābhāvāditi cet ; avaśyadeyatvena tatrāpi ṛṇavyavahārādityāhuḥ |1 [fn gadādharabhaṭṭācāryāstu -- dravyāntaradānābhyupagamapūravakapadattadravyādānajyo'dṛṣṭaviśeṣo dhārayaterarthaḥ | tadghaṭadānānviyi kartṛtvaṃ caturthyathaṃ ityāhuḥ | ] 'puṣpebhyaḥ spṛhayati' ityatrāpi sambandhaścaturthyarthaḥ | puṣpasambandhīccheti bodhaḥ | spṛhyarthaphalasambandhitvenepsitatvaṃ tatsaṃpradānatvaṃ spṛhyarthaphalāśrayatvamevaitatsampradānatvam | 'puṣpāṇi spṛhayati' ityādi tu adhyāhṛtadṛśyādikriyākarmatayā bodhyam | śeṣatvāvivakṣāyāṃ tu ṣaṣṭhyeva | ata eva "spṛherīpsitaḥ" [ 2|4|36 ] iti sūtraṃ saṅgacchata ityapare | 'haraye ṛdhyati, druhyatīrṣyati, asūyati' ityatra "krūdhadruherṣyāsūyārthānāṃ yaṃ prati kopaḥ" [ 1|4|37 ] iti sūtrād hariḥ saṃpradānam | tatra cittavṛttiviśeṣaḥ krodhaḥ krudherarthaḥ | yatra jñānaviśeṣaḥ krodha iti, tatra sakarmatāpatteḥ | apakāraviṣayecchaā druheḥ2 [fn 'arthaḥ' iti śeṣaḥ | ] | tatrāpakāro duḥkhajanikā kriyā | ayamapyakarmakaḥ, dhātvarthopasaṃgṛhītakarmakatvāt | etadd‌vayayoge sambandhaścaturthyarthaḥ | harisambandhī krodhaḥ, tatsambandhyapakāreccheti ca bodhaḥ | viṣayatayā svārthakomasambandhitvameva caitadyoge sampradānatvam | utkarṣagocaro dveṣa īrṣyā | śaucācārādiguṇaviṣaye dambhādikṛtatvadoṣādhyāso'sūyā | etadyoge karma caturthyarthaḥ | harikarmakotkarṣaviṣayo dveṣaḥ | hariniṣṭhaguṇaviṣayakaṃ doṣāviṣkaraṇamiti ca bodhaḥ | taddhātvarthamalabhūtakopaviṣayatve sati taddhātvarthaphalāśrayatvaṃ tatsaṃpradānatvaṃ bodhyam | satyantena 'bhāryāmorṣyati, maināmanyo'drākṣīt' ityādervyudāsaḥ | 'mitrāya druhyati pratāpo'pi' ityādau cetanatvāropo bodhyaḥ | 'kṛṣṇāya rādhyati, īkṣate vā' ityatra praśnaviṣayaparyālocanaṃ dhātvorarthaḥ | tadekadeśe praśnaviṣaye kṛṣṇasyānvayaḥ | sambandhaścaturthyarthaḥ | svārthapraśnaviṣayasambandhitvametadyoge sampradānatvaṃ bodhyam | viprāya gāṃ pratiśrṛṇoti, āśrṛṇoti vetyatra dhātoḥ pravarttanājanyābhyupagamo'rthaḥ | caturthyartha āśrayatvaṃ pravartanānvayi | vipraniṣṭhapravarttanājanyo devadattaniṣṭho'bhyupagama iti bodhaḥ | svārthapravarttanāśrayatvametadyoge saṃpradānatvaṃ bodhyam | hautre'nugṛṇāti, pratigṛṇāti vetyatra śaṃsitṛkarmakaśaṃsaniviṣayaharṣanukūlavyāpāralakṣaṇaṃ protsāhanaṃ dhātorarthaḥ | hotuśca śaṃsitaryabhedenānvayaḥ | karmasāmānādhikaraṇyācca hotā karma | hotrabhinnaśaṃsitṛkarmakaharṣānukūlo vyāpāra iti ca bodhaḥ | dhātvarthaśaṃsanāśrayatvametatsaṃpradānatvaṃ bodhyam | 'śatena śatāya vā parikrītaḥ' ityatra caturthyarthaḥ karaṇatṛtīyayā samānaḥ, śatavyāpāraśca dānameva | evañca tṛtīyāntapadabodhyakaramatvamevātra saṃpradāntavaṃ bodhyam | 'phalebhyo yāti' atrāharttamityadhyāhāraḥ | tadarthaphalāśrayarūpaṃ karma caturthyarthaḥ | nanu padajanyapadārtopasthiteḥ śābdabodhāṅgatvāt phalebhyo yātītyādau caturthyarthānvayogyāharaṇasya tathopasthiterabhāvāt kathaṃ bodhaḥ, na cāharttumpadādhyāhāraḥ, adhyāhāraścānumānamupanītabhānaṃ vetyaprayogo'styeva | ata eva prakṛte caturthīvidhāyake "kriyārthopapadasya ca karmaṇi sthāninaḥ" [ 2|3|14 ] iti sūtre'prayujyamānārthakasthānipadena virodho na, prayogaśabdasyoccāraṇārthatvāditi vācyam, "spṛherīpsitaḥ" itivat "yuṣmadyupapade" [ 1|4|105 ] ityāderapyuccāritapade'dhyāhṛtapade ca pravṛttyupapattau sthāninyapītyasyavaiyarthāpatteḥ | tasmāt sthaānipadamajñāyamānārthakam | evañca padānadhyāhāre'pyarthamātrādhyāhāre madhyamārthaṃ tatsārthakyam | anyathā padanimittakatayā tatra na syādati cet, na ; sthānigrahamasāmarthādeva padajanyopastityabhāve'pi arthamātrādhyahāreṇa śābdabodhaviṣayatvāṅgokārāt caturthyaiva svavṛttyopasthitatvād vṛttiprayojyopasthiterna kṣatiḥ | spaṣṭañcedam "aiuṇ" sūtre kaustubhe | "spuherīpsitaḥ" ityādau ca padādhyāhāra eva | tatrārthādhyāhāro gamakasattva eva, padādhyāhārastu sarvatreti vyāsthā | evañca phalakarmakāharamaphakaṃ yānamiti bodhaḥ | yattu, phalakarmakāharaṇe phalapadasya lakṣaṇā, caturthyāśca phalamarthaḥ | yadvā, kriyāmātraṃ tadarthaḥ, karmatvaprayojakatve pūrvaṃparayoḥ saṃsargāviti | tat, na ; sūtre karmaṇītyasyoktatvenedṛśe'rthe sādhutve mānābhāvāditi dik | yāgāya yātītyatra bhaviṣyatkālāvacchinno yāgo yajerarthaḥ | phalaṃ janakatvasambandhaścaturthyarthaḥ | bhaviṣyadyāgajanakaṃ yānamiti bodhaḥ | 'na tvāṃ tṛṇāya, tṛṇaṃ vā manye' ityatra karma dvitīyācaturthyorarthaḥ | prakṛteśca svārthasadṛśe lakṣaṇā | tathā ca tvadabhinnatṛṇasadṛśakarmakamadvṛtatijñānābhāva iti bodhaḥ | tvadviśeṣyakartṛṇasadṛśatvaprakārakajñānābhāva iti phalati | sa cātyantāpakarṣaṃprayukta eva, manyateḥ caturthīsamabhivyāhāre 'budhyate' ityarthaḥ, śabdaśaktisvabhāvāt | grāmaṃ grāmāya vā yāti - atrāpi dvitīyācaturthyoḥ karmaivārthaḥ | anye -- tvatroddeśyaścaturtharthaḥ, yāteścottaradeśasaṃyogānukūlavyāpāraviṣayakasaṃdarśanaprārthanādikamarthaḥ | evañca saṃdarśanādikaṃ pradi tatsaṃyogānukūlavyāpārasya kṛtrimakarmatayā tenābhipreyamāṇatvād grāmasya saṃpradānatvam | phalāśrayatve'pi tattvasyāvivakṣaṇāduddeśyatvasya ca vivakṣaṇādadoṣaḥ | evañca grāmoddeśyakottaradeśasaṃyogānukūlvayāpāraviṣayakaṃ saṃdarśanādīti bodhaḥ | atiprasaṅgastvanabhidhānena vāraṇīyaḥ | grāmaṃ yātītyādau tu saṃyogānukūlavyāpārārthakatvamevetyāhuḥ | iti kārakacaturthīvibhaktyartha vicāraḥ | <15> athopapadavibhaktyarthanirūpaṇam athopapadanibhaktyartha ucyate 'viprāyaudanaḥ' ityatra tādarthyo | tādarthyamupakarakatvarūpaḥ sambandhaḥ | prakṛtyarthasya pratyayārthe kvacit paramparayā'nvayaḥ | yathā prakṛte samavakartṛkabhojananiṣṭhajanyatānirabapakatvenaivānvayaḥ | brāhyaṇakarttṛkabhojanajanaka odana iti bodhaḥ | kvacittu sākṣāt | yathā muktaye hariṃ bhajati | atra svaniṣṭhajanyatānirūpakatvenaivānvayaḥ | muktijanakaṃ haribhajanamiti bodhaḥ | adhyayananirūpitopakārakatāvān vāsa iti bodhaḥ | 'bhaktirjñānāya kalpate' atra sambandhaśrvaturthyarthaḥ | bhaktikartṛkā jñānasaṃbanvinī utpattiriti bodhaḥ |tādarthyacaturthyāstu bhaktikartṛkājñānajanikotpattiriti bodhaḥ | prakṛtivikṛtyorbhedavivakṣāyāṃ vikṛtivācakāccaturthi | abhedavivakṣāyāṃ tu kartṛtvāt pratharmava, 'bhaktirjñānaṃ kalpate' ityādīti | yadā tu "janikarttuḥ" [2|4|30] ityapādānatvavivakṣā, tadā pañcamī | bhakterjñānaṃ kalpata iti | jñānasyābhihitakartṛtvātataḥ prathamaiva | atredaṃ tattvam--'kalpate' ityadeḥ 'pariṇamate' ityarthaḥ | pariṇāmaśca rūpāntaraprāptiḥ | tadekadeśe rūpāntare jñānādervikāravācakasyābhedenānvaye dvitīyāyāṃ prāptāyām 'klṛpi saṃpadyamāne ca' ityanena caturthī vidhīyate | kvṛptyarthadhātuyoge utpadyamānārthavācakāccaturthotyarthaḥ | evañcātra caritārthā caturthī caturthī tayorabhedavivakṣāyāṃ paratvāt prathamayā bādhyate | kalpāderutpattimātrārthatve uktarūtyā pañcamyādītyāhuḥ | vātaya kapulā vidyudityatra jñāpakatvarūpaḥ | sambandhaścaturthyarthaḥ | vātajñāpikā tapilā vidyuditi bodhaḥ | atra 'utpātena jñāpite ca' ityanena caturthī | prāṇināṃ śubhāśubhasūcako vikāra utpātaḥ | 'viprāya hitam' atra sambandhaśrvatuthyarthaḥ | iṣṭasādhanaṃ hitapadārthaḥ | viprasambandhīṣṭasādhanamiti bodhaḥ | 'haraye namaḥ' atra "namaḥ svastisvāhāsvacālaṃvaṣaḍayogācva" [2|3|16] iti sūtraṇa caturyī | namaḥśabdārtho natiḥ | sā cāpakṛṣṭaclajñānabodhānukūlo vyāpāraḥ | tatrāpakarṣako vyāpāraśca namaḥṣabdena, vyutpattivaiciñyāt | svaprayoktṛpuruṣaviśeṣāśrayatvanamaskāryāvadhitvoparakta eva pratīyate | anyoccāritapadnānyadiyanatyabodhanāt | sa ca vyāpāraḥ karaśiraḥsaṃyogādiḥ kvacit, kvacidīdṛśaśabdaprayoga eva | tthā ca haryavadhikasvaniṣṭhāpakṛṣṭatvajñānabodhānukūlaḥ prayoktṛniṣṭho vyāpāra iti bodhaḥ | 'eṣo'rghyaḥ śivāya namaḥ' ityādau tyāgo namaḥśabdārthaḥ | tyāgaśrva śivasvatvasvasvatvanivṛttyubhayānukūlo vyāpāraviśeṣarūpaḥ | śivaḥ svaṃ na pratigṛhṇīyādityādiprāmāṇyena dravye devatāyā api svakārāt | caturthyarthaśrvoddeśyatvarūpaḥ sambandhaḥ | uddeśyatvañca viṣayatāviśeṣarūpam | evañca śivoddeśyakatyāgaviṣayo'rghya iti bodhaḥ | acetanadevatāpakṣe tu svasvatvābhāvānukūlavyāpārastyāgaḥ | sa ca vedabodhitasvaprayogakartṛ katvoparakta eva pratīyate, vyutpattivaicitryāt | anyoccāritanamaḥ pradenānyadīyatyāgāpratīteḥ | ṛtvigbhaśrva yajamānīyatattadamaddravye sviyatvamāropyeva namaḥśabdaḥ prayujyata iti na doṣaḥ |saṃpradānacaturthī tvatra nāśaṅkacā, namaḥpadārthasya kriyātvābhāvāt | vedabodhitetyukterna nīcoddeśyake teyāge namaḥśabdaprayogā ityāhuḥ | namaskaroti devān ityatra 'upapadavibhaktoḥ kārakavibhaktirbalīyasī' iti nyāyāt karmatvena dvitīyā | dhātvarthasya pradhānatvena nāmārthasya cāpradhānatvena pradhānāpradhānayośca pradhānanimittakārthasyaivaucityamiti hi tannyāyabījam | nanu kathamatra karmatvaṃ devānām, na ca svaniṣṭhāpakṛṣṭatvajñānabodhānukūlavyāpārarūpanamaskāraphalasya tādṛśajñānabodhasyāśrayatvāt ttvamiti vācyam, prekṣitustaṭasthāderapi karmatvāpatteriti cet, na: svaviṣayaviṣayāvadhitvasamānādhikaraṇasamavāyasya phalatāvacchedakasambanvatvādadoṣaḥ | svam=apakṛṣṭatvajñānarūpaṃ phalam, avadhitāsambandhenāpakarṣāśrayatvāt karmatvamityanye | nanvenamapi 'hareya namaḥ' ityādyanurodhānnamasśabdasya vācakatvāvaśyakatvād namasśabdārthabodhāśrayatve'pi dhātvarthaphalāśrayatvābhāvāt kathaṃ karmatvamiti cet, na: sākṣātprabhṛtiṣu paṭhitasya kṛñyoge nipātādisaṃjñakasya dyotakatvāṅgīkārādadoṣaḥ | 'haraye namaḥ' ityādo tu svarādipaṭhitaḥ, prakṛte tu na saḥ | ata eva satvasamāsādisiddhiḥ | na caivamapi namasśabdārthānvayābhāvenopapadavibhaktoḥ kathaṃ prāptiḥ, taddyotyānvayamātreṇa tatprāpteḥ | yadā tu karmaṇo'pyasya śeṣatvena vivakṣā, tadā ṣaṣṭhiṃ bādhitvā "namaḥsvasti" iti caturthī eva | yattu, ekasyā evopapadavibhaktitve, kārakavibhaktitve cāyaṃ nyāya iti | tat, na : "namovarivaḥ" [3|2|22] iti sūtrasthabhāṣyavirodhāt | tatra hi 'namasyati devān' ityatra caturthīvāraṇāyāyaṃ nyāya upanyasto bhagavatā | etena svastisāhacaryāt satvavācakanamasśabdasyaiva grahaṇam | 'namasaskaroti' ityādau na sattvavācakaḥ, satvakaraṇena nipātasaṃjñakatvāditi parāstam | namasyatītyādāvapi kriyāvācakatvenāsattvavācakatvādaprāptau bhāṣyavirodhāpateḥ | yogagrahaṇenaitadyogamātre curthīvidhānena karmatvāvivakṣāyām 'namasyati devebhyaḥ, ityanātteśca | avyayamiti mahāsañjñayā svarādipaṭhitasyāpi liṅgasaṃkhyākārakānvayitvācceti dik | 'prajābhyaḥsvasti' ityādau svastiśabdo maṅgalārthaḥ | sambandhaścaturthyarthaḥ | maṅgalāśaṃmāsthale 'svastyastu gobhyaḥ' ityādau svastiśabdārthānvaye caturthī, kriyānvaye tu ṣaṣṭhī | tatra caturthyante āśaṃsāviṣayagosambandhimaṅgalakartṛkaṃ bhavanamiti bodhaḥ | ṣaṣṭhacante āśaṃsāviṣayamaṅgalakartṛ kaṃ gosambandhibhavanamiti bodhaḥ | yattu, 'āśīḥ svastiśabdarthaḥ, sā ca parahitaviṣayiṇīcchā, hitānvāyīsambandhaścaturthyartha iti | tat, na :bhūyādityāśīrliṅādeḥ prayogānāpatteḥ, svasti vṛṣalāyetyādau caturthyanāpatteśca, aṅgīkārārtho hi tatra svastiśabdaḥ | maṅgalāṅgīkārārthatvasyaiva prāmāṇikairuktośceti dik | svāhāsvadhāvaṣaṭśabdastyāgārtakanamasśabdena vyākhyātāḥ | 'gaityebhyo hariralam' ityatralamśabdārthaḥ sāmarthmavān | caturthyarthaśca māraṇādisambandhitvarūpasambandhaḥ | evañca daityamāraṇādisambandhisāmarthyasāmarthyavān iti bodhaḥ ityupapadacaturthovibhaktyarthanirūpaṇam | <16> atha pañcamīvibhaktyarthavicāraḥ kārakavibhaktirūpañcamyā apādānamarthaḥ | "apādāne pañcamī" [ 2|3|28 ] iti sūtrāt | tallakṣaṇabodhakañca "dhruvamapāye'pādānam" [ 1|4|24 ] iti sūtram | atrāpāyo viśloṣaḥ sambandhābhāvaḥ | sa ca na vāstavasambandhapūrvakaḥ, kintu buddhiparikalpitasambandhapūrvako'pi | evamabhāvo'pi buddhiparikalpito bodhyaḥ | ata eva jugupsādipūrvakanivṛttilakṣakatāmāśritya 'jugutsāvirāma' ityādipratyākhyānaṃ bhāṣyoktam ; "yataśca nirddhāraṇam" [ 2|3|141 ] iti sūtraprayogaḥ, 'yato yato virajyate' ityādiprayogaśca saṃgacchate | tajjanakagativiśeṣo'pyatrāpāyaḥ --- 'gatirvinā tvavadhinā nāpāya iti kathyate' iti harisvarasāt | avadhyanvayayaugyavibhāgānukūlatvaṃ vinā kriyāyā nāpāya śabdavācyeteti tadarthaḥ | ayāya iti cāvarttate, anvetīti cādhyāhriyate, tenāpāyānvayi yadapāye dhruvaṃ gatirūpāpāyānāśrayaḥ, tadapādānamiti tadarthaḥ | evañca vyāpāratāvacchedakasambandhena vibhāgajanakaprakṛtadhātūpāttatatkriyānāśrayatve sati āśrayatayā tadupāttaviśleṣānvayi tadapādānamiti phalitam | kartṛ vāraṇāya satyantam, dhāvato'śvāt patati, kuḍyāt patato'śvāt patati ityādisaṃgrahāya prakṛtadhātūpātteti | parasparānmeṣāvapasarata ityādisaṃgrahāya tatkriyeti | 'nivarteta tatastataḥ' ityādau pravṛttyabhāvarūpadhātvarthasya viṣayatāsambandhāvacchinnaviśeṣaṇatayā'vadhau sattvāt tatrāvyāpaptivāraṇāya sambandhaviśeṣaniveśaḥ | udāsīne'tivyāptivāraṇāya viśeṣyadalam | sa cārtaādavadhireva | avadhitvañca pūrvoktaviśleṣāśrayatvasamānādhikaraṇaḥ svarūpasambandhaviśeṣaḥ, padārthāntaraṃ vā | tatra viśleṣasya dhātulabhyatvādavadhitvenāvadhiḥ pañcamyarthaḥ | na cāvadhitvena bhāne mānābhāvaḥ, avadhyupalakṣakadhruvagrahaṇasya mānatvāt | anyathā hyapāyarūpakriyānvayyapādānamityarthakenāpāye'pādānamityanenaiva siddhe tadvaiyarthyaṃ spaṣṭameva | na ca vṛkṣasya sambandhasāmānyena patanakriyānvaye'pādānatvābhāvārthaṃ tat, vācyavṛttyā'lābhāt | mātuḥ smaratītyādau karmatvabhāvavattadupapatteśca | na ca karttuḥ parṇasyāpādānatvavāraṇāya tat syāt, tadanukūlavyāpārenvaye'pi vibhāge'nvayābhāvāt, paratvāt kartṛsaṃjñayā bādhācca | ata eva 'āśrayo'vadhiruddeśyaḥ' ityādinā'vadhereva pañcamyarthatvamuktaṃ hariṇā | etena vibhāga āśrayaśca pañcamyartha ityapāstam | 'vṛkṣādvibhajate' ityādau vibhāgasya bodhāvṛttyāpatteśca | tatrāvadhereva pañcamyarthatve kimardhajaratīyena tvad‌rītyā pañcamyāstatrāsādhutāpatteśca | nyāyanaye ghaṭaṃ jānātītyādau dvitīyāyā bhavatāpyasādhutvasyoktatvāt ; apāyavadapādānamityeva siddhe dhruvagrahaṇaiyarthyāpatteśca, vibhāgasya dhātulabhyatvācca | na ca vṛkṣāt parṇaṃ patatītyādau vṛkṣasya viśleṣāśrayatvāt paratvena karmatāpattiḥ, vṛkṣaṃ tyajatītivaditi vācyam, phalatāvacchedakasambandhena tasya tadanāśrayatvāt, kartṛ niṣṭhavibhāgīyasambandhasyaiva tattvāt | vṛkṣaṃ tyajatītyādau vyāpāravyadhikaraṇavibhāgasyaiva dhātvarthatvena bhavatyeva karmatvam | etena vibhāga eva pañcamyarthaḥ, āśrayatva prakṛtipratyayārthayoḥ saṃsargaḥ, vibhāgasya janyatāmbandhena dhātvartha'nvaya ityapāstam | vibhaktyarthaprakṛtyarthayoḥ klṛptasyābhedānvayasya tyāgāpatteśca | apāyo'pādānamityeva siddhe itaravaiyarthyāpatteśca | evañca vṛkṣātparṇaṃ patatītyādāvavadhitvenāvadhiḥ pañcamyarthaḥ | tatrābhedena prakṛtyartho viśeṣaṇam| sa ca saṃyogānukūlavibhāgānukūlavyāpārarūpapatidhātvarthaikadeśe vibhāge viśeṣaṇ | bhūminiṣṭhasaṃyogānukūlavṛkṣāvadhikavibhāgānukūlo vyāpāraḥ parṇavṛttiriti bodhaḥ | na caivamapi 'vṛkṣāt syandate' iti syāditi vacyām, āsanāccalita itivadiṣṭāpatteḥ | kriyāmātrārthatve tu va-kṣe syandata ityeva | 'valāhakād vidyotate'1[fn 'vidyut' ityasya śeṣo bodhyaḥ | ] ityādau vidyotaterniḥ saraṇapūrvake vidyotane lakṣaṇā | niḥsaraṇaṃ vibhāgajanakakriyā | evañca valāhakāvadhikavibhāgajanakakriyottarakālikaṃ vidyotanaṃ vidyudrūpāśrayavṛttīti bodhaḥ | idamupāttaviṣayamityucyate | yadā tu pratyakṣasaddhamāgamanaṃ manasi nidhāya kuto bhavāniti praśne pāṭaliputrādati cottarayati, tatra padajanyapadārthopasthiteḥ śābdabodhajanakatvānaṅgīkartṛnaye pratyakṣadṛṣṭopasthitāgamana evānvayaḥ | matāntare tu pratyakṣadṛṣṭārthena sambandhividhayā smṛtapadādupasthitāgamaneneti bodhyam | idamevābhipretyāhuḥ --- 'gamyamānā'pi kriyā kārakavibhaktau prayojikā' iti | kecittu, padādhyāhāre'pi sākṣāt padasyānuccāraṇād gamyamānāpi ityasyaiva viṣayamāhuḥ | tatra kim‌śabdaḥ praśnaviṣayārthaḥ | evañca praśnaviṣayāvadhikavibhāgānukalo vyāpāra iti bodhaḥ | praśnavākye uttaravākye ca pāṭaliputrāvadhiketyādiḥ | etadevāpekṣitakriyamityucyate . vṛkṣāt patatīti tu nirdiṣṭaviṣayamityāhuḥ | 1 [fn atra 'jugupsāvirāma' ityanenāpādānatvam | yad‌viṣayakatvena jugupsādayovivakṣitāḥ, tadapādānamiti tadathaḥ | aniṣṭasādhanatvajñānarūpā nindā jugupsaterarthaḥ | viṣayatvādiḥ pañcamyarthaḥ, apādānatvaśaktirvā | tādṛśanindāpūrvakanivṛttau dhātorlakṣaṇāṃ svīkṛtya "dhruvamapāya" ityanenaiva apādānatvam | evameva idaṃ vārtikam uttarasūtrāṇi ca pratyākhyātāni bhāṣyakṛtā | ] 'adharmājjugupsate, viramati, pramādyati' ityatrāniṣṭasādhanatājñānarūpā nindā jugupsaterarthaḥ | viṣayatvaṃ pañcamyarthaḥ | adharmaviṣayakāniṣṭasādhanatājñānamiti bodhaḥ | viramateḥ kṛtyasamānādhikaraṇavṛttidhvaṃsaviśiṣṭakṛtyabhābo'rthaḥ | kṛtiśca sarvatraikaviṣayaivākāṅkṣāvaśād bhāsate | vaiśiṣṭyañca samabhivyāhṛtakartṛpadabodhyaśarīrajātīyaśarīraghaṭitasāmānādhikaraṇyena | caitrādipadairviśiṣṭātmabodhanena śarīrasyāpi bodhanāt | sājātyañca devadattādipadopasthāpitadevadattatvādijātyaiva | tena bhāvidehāntarāvacchedenādharmakaraṇe'pīdānīntanadehamādāya devadatto'dharmādviramati iti prayogasiddhiḥ | nāpi yuvaśarīrāvacchedenādharmaṃ kurvatyapi bālaśarīrāvacchinnacaramavṛttidhvaṃsamādāya viramatīti prayogaḥ | nāpi pūrvāparakālayoradharmakaraṇe madhye muhūrttamātramakaraṇe viramatīti prayogaḥ, tatkṛtidhvaṃsasya kṛtisamānādhikaraṇatvāt| nāpi tattad‌dehāvacchinnacaramakṛtidhvaṃsamādāya viramatīti prayogaḥ | pañcamyarthastu viṣayataiva | eñcādharmaviṣayakṛtyasamānādhikaraṇakṛtidhvaṃsaviśiṣṭakṛtyabhāvo devadattiriti bodhaḥ | evaṃ pramādyateḥ samānadeśatvasamānakālatvobhayasambandhenādhikāraviśiṣṭeṣṭasādhanatājñānābāvaḥ pañcamyartho viṣayatvamiṣṭasādhanatājñāne'nveti | atra jugupsādīnāṃ yadviṣayakatvena vivakṣā, tadapādānam | corādvibeti ; trāyate vā ityādau aniṣṭajñānaṃ bhayam, tannivṛttyanukūlo vyāpārastrāṇaṃ pañcamyartho hetuḥ | "bhītrārthānāṃ bhayahetuḥ" [ 1|4|25 ] iti sūtrasvarasāt | sa ca dhātvarthaikadeśe'niṣṭe'nveti | bhayaheturityasya bhayaikadeśāniṣṭaheturityarthaḥ | 1[fn anena 'corāpādānakamaniṣṭajñānam ityākārako bodho mañjūṣākṛnmate' iti likhantaḥ kāśikākārāḥ 'anyasyoṣṇīṣamanyamastake stāpitam' iti vākyaṃ caritārthitavantaḥ | ] corahetukāniṣṭajñānam, 2 [fn nanu yasya corahetukamaniṣṭamaprasiddham, tathāpi taddhetukatvena svasyāniṣṭaṃ saṃbhāvayati, tatra 'corādayaṃ bibheti' iti prayogo na syāt, tadīyāniṣṭe corahetukatvasya bādhāditi cet, na ; taddhetakānyadīyāniṣṭasya tasmin, tadīyāniṣṭe vā corahetukatvasyāropeṇādoṣāt | atrāpi sambandhitvena vivakṣāyāṃ corapadātṣaṣṭhī bhavati | ata eva 'kasya bibhyati devāśca jātaroṣasya saṃyuge' iti rāmāyaṇaprayogaḥ saṃgacchate | athavā 'kasya saṃyuge' ityākārako'nvayo bodhyaḥ | naiyāyikāstu --- prayojyatāpakārakatvaṃ pañcamyarthaḥ | tasya saṃbhāvanāyāmanvayaḥ | ataḥ corādhīnāniṣṭasyāprasiddhatvāsthale na doṣaḥ, coraprayojyāniṣṭasaṃbhāvanayā bhayasya sattvāt 'coro mamāniṣṭaṃ kuryāt' iti sambhāvanāyāḥ sattvāt | evañca śatrubhrameṇa 'mitrādapi bibheti' iti vākyasyāpi prāmāṇyaṃ saṃgacchate | evañca bhayārthakadhātṛyoge bhayahetutvena saṃbhāvanamapādānamityeko vākyārthaḥ, trāṇārthakadhātuyoge'niṣṭaprayojakaṃ tadityaparavākyārthaṃ ityāhuḥ | ] taddhetukāniṣṭanivṛttyanukūlo vyāpāra iti ca bodhaḥ | na ca yatkaṇṭakādijanyabhayameva na prasiddham, tataḥ pañcamī na syāt, iṣṭāpatteḥ | pañcamyā iṣṭatve tu tatra hetutvāmāropyaiva prayogaḥ | evameva cākāśo na paśyati, paramāṇuṃ na paśyati ityādiphrayoganirvāhaḥ, darśanādāvākāśakarttṛtvādikamāropya tasyaiva niṣedhakaraṇād, bodhācca, śaśaśrṛṅgaṃ nāsatītyādivat | tatra hi śabdabalāt pratītasya śaśaśrṛṅgāstitvasya niṣedhaḥ kriyate "atyantāsatyapi jñānamarthe śabdaṃ karoti hi" ityabhyupagamāt | ayogyatāniścayastu na śābdabodhapratibandhakaḥ | anyathā'nyathā vyutpannaṃ prati prativādiśabdo mūka eva syāt | prativādinaḥ śabdād vākyārthāpratītau tatkhaṇḍanakathā'pyucchidyeta | āhāryaḥ śābdabodhaḥ ityapare | ata eva śaśaśrṛṅgaṃ nāstītyādeḥ śabdasādhutā iṣyata evetyāhuḥ | 'adhyayanāt parājayate' ityatra kṛtyasādhyatvadhīsamānādhikaraṇaḥ kṛtyabhāvodhātvarthaḥ | pañcamyartho viṣayatvam | kṛtyoścaikaviṣayatvaṃ vyutpattibalalabhyam | evañcādhyayanaviṣayakṛtyasādhyatvadhīsamānādhikaraṇakṛtyabhāvo devadattavṛttiriti bodhaḥ | 'śatrūn parājayate' ityatra tiraskārānukūlo vyāpāro dhātvarathaḥ | yattu, aniṣṭaṃ dhātvarthaḥ, janyatvaṃ pañcamyarthaḥ, "parājerasoḍhaḥ" [ 1|4|26 ] iti sūtre ca ' asoḍhaḥ' ityasayāniṣṭasādhanatvena vivakṣito'rtha ityāhuḥ, tat, na ; hetupadānuvṛttyaiva siddhe 'āsoḍhaḥ' ityasya vaiyarthyāpatteḥ, karmaktapratyayāntāsoḍhaśabdāt tvaduktārthālābhācca | 'yavebhyo gāṃ vārayati' bhakṣaṇādiphalajanakavyāpārābhāvānukūlo vyāpāro dhātvarthaḥ | "vāraṇārthānāmīpsitaḥ" [ 1|4|27 ] iti sūtreṇāpādānatvaṃ yavānām| tatrepsita ityasya vāraṇārthadhātvarthatāvacchedakaphalāśrayatvenecchāviṣaya ityarthaḥ | udāharaṇe ca dhātvarthatāvacchedakasaṃyogarūpaphalāśrayatvena gavepsitatvād yavānāmapādānatvam | tatra karmaniṣṭhavyāpārasya bhakṣaṇāderbhakṣaṇatvāvacchinnapratiyogitāka evābhāvo bhāsate, vyutpattivaicitryāt | tātparyavaśācca viśiṣyaiva śaktiḥ, nānārthatvamiṣṭamevetyapi kaścit | evañca yavaniṣṭhasaṃyogajanakavyāpārasya bhakṣaṇādergovṛtatiryo'bhāvaḥ, tadanukūlo vyāpāra iti bodhaḥ | yadi tu pratiṣiddhe gavi bhakṣayatyapi vārayatīti prayogaḥ, tadā tādṛśābāvaprakārikecchāviśiṣṭo vyāpāra eva dhātvartha iti bodhyam | atra kecit, yatra nāntarīyakatayā caitrāderviṣādibhojanaṃ prasaktam, na tu svecchayā, tatra tad‌bhojananivarttakvayāpārakarttari caitraṃ viṣādvārayatīti prayogavāraṇāya san‌prayogaḥ | ata eva tatra saviṣādannādavārayatītyeva prayogaḥ | na ca kūpādandhaṃ vārayatīti na syāt, na hikapapatanamandhasyecchāviṣaya iti vācyam, kapapatanatvenecchāviṣayatvābhāve'pyabhimukhadeśagamanatvena tasyāpīcchāviṣayatvād ityāhuḥ | māturnilīyate kṛṣṇaḥ "antardhau yenādarśanamicchati" [ 1|4|28 ] ityapādānatvam | tatra niyanamanyavṛttivyāpārajanyasvakarmakadarśanābhāvaprayojanakadeśaviśeṣasthitiḥ | ayameva ca sūtre antardhipadārthaḥ | pañcamyartho vṛttitvaṃ dhātvarthaikadeśe vyāpāre'nveti | 'upādhyāyādadhīte' ityasya coccāraṇottarakālikaniyamapūrvakasvīkārakānukūlovyāpāro'dhīterarthaḥ | pañcamyartho vṛttitvaṃ tadekadeśe uccāraṇe'nveti | 'upādhyāyādadhīte' ityasya coccāraṇottarakālikaniyamapūrvakasvīkārānukūlo vyāpāro'dhīterarthaḥ | pañcamyartho vṛttitvaṃ tadekadeśe uccāraṇe'nveti | 'brahmaṇaḥ prajāḥ prajāyante' atropādānaṃ kāraṇaṃ pañcamyarthaḥ, "1 [fn jananaṃ janiḥ, tasyāḥ karteti ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣaḥ | tṛnpratyayāntatvānna samāsaniṣedhaḥ | nanu "na lokāvyaya" iti ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhaprasaṅgaḥ, kārakaṣaṣṭhyā eva sa niṣedha iti siddhāntāt śeṣaṣṭhīpravṛttau bādhakābhāvāt | vastutastu -- śeṣaṣṭhyāstṛjantenāpi samāsaḥ sulabha iti manoramākārāḥ | ] janikarttuḥ prakṛtiḥ " [ 1|4|30 ] iti sūtrasvarasāt | tatra hi prakṛtiśabda upādānakāraṇapara iti spaṣṭaṃ bhāṣyādau | evañca brahmābhinnopādānakāraṇajanyā prajāvṛttirutpattiriti bodha | 2 [fn vṛttikṛtastu -- etatprayogānurodhena "janikarttuḥ prakṛtiḥ" ityatra prakṛtipade hetumātraparigraha ityāhuḥ | ] 'putrāt pramodo jāyate' ityādau "vibhāṣā guṇe'striyām" [ 2|3|25 ] ityatra vibhāṣeti yogavibhāgāt hetau pañcamī | upādānatvāropeṇetyanye | 'himavato gaṅgā prabhavati' ityādau prabhavateḥ prathamaḥ prakāśo'rthaḥ | himavaddhetuko gahghākartṛkaḥ prathamaḥ prakāśa ityarthaḥ | hetuḥ 3[fn apare tu -- adhikaraṇatvaṃ pañcamyartha ityāhuḥ | vyutpattivādakṛtaḥ -- sambandhādhīnatvaṃ pañcamyarthaṃ ityāhuḥ | tārkikaratnākarakṛtaḥ -- tādātmyaṃ pañcamyarthaḥ, darśanayogyatvābhāvāvacchedaka deśāvyavahitadeśāvacchedena darśanayogyatvaṃ dhātvarthaḥ | tādātmyasya dhātvarthaghaṭakadeśe'nvayaḥ | evañca himavadabhinno yo darśanayogyatvābhāvāvacchedakadeśāvyavahita ādyabahiḥ saṃyogo dhātvarthaḥ | prakṛte bahiḥ padārthaḥ rasātalam, saṃyogadhvaṃsāvyavahitottarakṣaṇavṛtattitvaṃ pañṭamyarthaḥ | āśrayatavamākhyātārthaḥ | evañca himālayānuyogitasaṃyogadhvaṃsāvyahitottarakṣaṇavṛttyādyapṛthivīsaṃyogāśrayatvavatī gaṅgeti bodhaḥ | ] pañcamyarthaḥ, "bhavaḥ prabhavaḥ" [ 1|4|21 ] iti sūtrasvarasāt | prabhavatyasmāditi hi tatra prabhavaḥ | 'prāsādāt prekṣate' ityādau āruhyetyādilyabantārthādhyāhāreṇa bodhaḥ | pañcamyartho'dhyāhṛtakriyākarma | 'āsanāt prekṣate' ityādāvupaviśyetyādyadhyāhṛtalbantārthādhikaraṇaṃ pañcamyarthaḥ | atrāpi śabdādhyāhāra eva, anuccāraṇasyaiva 'lyablope karmaṇi ca' iti vārttike lopapadārthatvāt | 'ājaghne viṣamavilocanasya vakṣaḥ' iti tu bhettumiti tumunantādhyāhāreṇa vyākhyeyamityanye | iti pañcamīvibhaktayrathavicāraḥ | <17> atho papadavibhakatirnirūpyate | 'vanād grāmo yojane yojanaṃ vā' iti | avyahitottaratvaṃ pañcamyarthaḥ | prathamāsaptamyostu svāvyahitottaradeśavṛttitvādirūpaḥ sambandho'rthaḥ | evañca vanāvyavahitottarayojanāvyavahitottaradeśavṛttirgrāma iti bodhaḥ | 'kārtikyā āgrahāyaṇī māse' ityatra svāvayavakāvyavahitottaratvaṃ pañcamyarthaḥ| saptamyarthaḥ svāvyahitottarakālavṛttitvam | kārtikyavayakottaratriṃśattithyātmakamāsāvyavahitottarakālavṛttirāgrahāyaṇīti bodhaḥ | 'anyo mitraḥ, itaro vā kṛṣṇāt' ityatra "anyārāditararte dik‌śabdāccattarapadājāhayukte" [ 2|3|29 ] iti sūtreṇa pañcamī | tatrānya ityarthagrahaṇ | tadarthaśca bhedavān | anyaśabdaśca bhāvapradhānaḥ, anyatvārthaka ityarthaḥ | ata eva ghaṭādbhedo ghaṭādbhinnaḥ ityādinnaḥ ityādisiddhiḥ | na caivaṃ ghaṭaḥ paṭo netyādāvapi pañcamyāpattiḥ, tasyāpi bhedārthakatvāditi vācyam, anyārthakasya tatsadṛśasya liṅgasaṃkhyārthapratipādasyaiva grahaṇātaḥ | ata eva tadarthakasyetaraśabdasyāvayutyānuvādaḥ | sa hīdṛśānāmeva tadarthakānāṃ grahaṇamiti bodhanārthaḥ | na ca 'itarastvanyanīcayoḥ' iti nīcārthasya grahaṇārthaṃ taditi vācyam, vidhivākyākalpanalāghavena sāhacaryeṇa cānyārthasyaiva grahaṇāt, asmāt tāro mdo vetyādivat "pañcamī vibhakte" [ 2|3|42 ] ityeva siddheśca | na cānyārthayāge'pi tena siddhiḥ, nirdhāraṇaprayojakībhūtajātyādirūpaviruddhadharmānabhidhānāt parasparaphratiyogitabhedasya parasparavṛttitvenānirdhārakatvācca | kiñca, naño dyotakatayā ghaṭādipadānāmeva lākṣaṇikatvād bhedanibandhanapañcamyā aprāpteḥ | na ca 'eko'nyārthe pradhāne ca' iti kośād anyārthakaikaśabdayoge 'ghaṭādekaḥ paṭaḥ' ityādau pañcamyāpattiḥ, iṣṭāpatteḥ | evamanyo'nyābhāvavadādapadayoge'pi | na caivaṃ 'ghaṭīyo bhedaḥ' ityāderanāpattiḥ, ṣaṣṭhīsamarthādvihitacchasyāprāpteriti vācyam, 'ghaṭasyāyam' itīdaṃśabdārthānvaye tasyasulabhatvāt ; idamaḥ saṃnikhṛṣṭatvana buddhisthabodhakatvanānyārthakatvābhāvāt | ata eva teṣāṃ sarvārthatvena sarvanāmatvam | taddhi ekarūpeṇa sarvārthabodhakatvam | tattadrūpeṇa bodhastu prakaraṇādivaśāt pārṣṇiko mānasa eva | etena 'ghaṭāt saḥ' iti syādityapāstam | vastutastu ghaṭe paṭād bhedaḥ, na tu ghaṭādeva sa iti prayogādiṣṭāpattiḥ | ghaṭīyo bhedaḥ ityatra tu "?Btata āgataḥ" [ 4|3|74 ] ityarthe cha iti vadanti | na ca bhinnaśabdo nānyārthaḥ, ghaṭaṃ bhinatītyādāvavayavavibhāgānukūlavyāpārārthakatvena klṛptatvād bhideḥ ktasya sattvāditi vācyam, ghaṭād bhinatti paṭamityādiprayogānurodhena dhātūnāmanekārthatvena cānyo'nyābhāvaprakārakajñānārthakatvasyāpi svīkārāt | bhedānukūlavyāpārārthakatvaṃ tu na, tasya nityatvāt | anyo'nyābhāvārthakatvamātreṇa karmaṇa eva kartṛtvavivakṣāyāṃ ghaṭād bhidyate, ghaṭād bhinna ityādayaḥ prayogāḥ | vibhāgārthakatvābhāvācca na "dhruvamapāye" [ 1|4|24 ] ityanena siddhiratreti bodhyam | yastu, itaragrahaṇaṃ pṛthaktvārtham | ata eva 'ghaṭaḥ paṭāt pṛthak' ityādau pañcamī | na ca so'nyārthaḥ, pṛthaktvasyātiriktaguṇatvāṅgīkārāditi | tat, na ; tasya guṇatvānaṅgīkārāt | ata eva rūpaṃ rasāt pṛthagityupapadyate | "pṛthagvinā" [ 2|3|32 ] ityādinā siddhatvācca | pratiyogitvaṃ pañcamyarthaḥ | 'ṛte kṛṣṇāda notpadyate sukham' ityatra ṛteśabdārtho'tyantābhāvaḥ, pañcamyarthaḥ pratiyogitvam ; kṛṣṇaśabdaśca tad‌bhakyādilākṣaṇikaḥ | evañca kṛṣṇabhaktyādipratiyogikātyantābhāvaprayojyaḥ sukhakartṛkotpattyabhāva iti bodhaḥ | kṛṣṇād ṛte duḥkhamityatra ṛteśabdārthasya sāmādhikaraṇyenetaratrānvayaḥ | kṛṣṇātyantābhāvasamānadhikaraṇaṃ duḥkhamiti bodhaḥ | kṛṣṇādṛte naraḥ śocya ityatrātyantābhāvavān tadarthaḥ | kṛṣṇātyantābhāvān naraḥ śocya iti bodhaḥ | kṛṣṇādṛte na dhumurdhara ityādau bhedavānarthaḥ | kṛṣṇābhinno na dhanurdhara iti bodhaḥ | etadyoge dvitīyāpi yathā ṛte vātaṃ vṛkṣaḥ patitaḥ | atra vātābhāvavān vṛkṣaḥ patanāśraya iti bodhaḥ | vṛkṣapatane vātajanyatvābhāvalābhastvārthaḥ | anye tu --- svaprakṛtyarthaniṣṭhajanakatānirupitajanyatāpratiyogitvaṃ vibhaktyarthaḥ | tasya ṛte śabdārtha'bhāve'nvayaḥ | tasyacaṭa patane'nvayaḥ | tasya ca patane'nvayaḥ | evañca vṛkṣakartṛkaṃ vātajanyatvābhāvavat patanamiti bodha ityāhuḥ | 'pūrvo grāmāt' atrodayācalasaṃnihitadeśatvaṃ pūrvatvam | tadekadeśe saṃnihitatve pañcamyarthāvadhitvasyānvayaḥ | evaṃ paścimatvamastācalasanihitadeśatvam | sūryodayadigabhimukhasthitasya savyahastasaṃnihitadeśatvaṃ dakṣiṇatvam | tathāvasthitasya vāma hastasaṃnihitadeśatvamuttaratvam | grāmāvadhikodayācalasaṃnihitadeśa [tvam] ityādi krameṇa bodhaḥ | 'caitrāt pūrvaḥ phālgunaḥ' pratiyogitaddhvaṃsānadhikaraṇakālaḥ pūrvaśabdārthaḥ | caitraśabdārthasya pratiyoginyabhedena dhvaṃse pratiyogitayā kāle ca tātparyavaśādavyavahitvādinānvayaḥ, ekasayāpyanekadhā'nvayo vyutpattivaicitryāt | evañca caitrābhinnapritayogitaddhvasaitadubhayānadhikaraṇacaitrāvyavahitakālavṛttiḥ phālguna iti bodhaḥ | 'caitrāt pūrvo māghaḥ' ityādau tātparyavaśād yathāyathaṃ triśadditavyavahitatvādinā kāle caitrasyānvayo bodhyaḥ | prāgabhāvāṅgīkāre tu tadadhikaraṇakālaḥ pūrvaśabdārthaḥ | caitra tu para ityādau dhvaṃsādhikaraṇakālaḥ paraśabdārthaḥ| caitrasya ca dhvaṃse pratiyogitayā kāle cāvyavahitvādinānvayaḥ, tātparyavaśāt prāgvat | kṛṣṇāt pūrvo valabhadra ityatra kṛṣṇaśabdaḥ svotpattikāle lākṣaṇikaḥ, kṛṣṇītpattikālataddhvaṃsobhayānadhikaraṇakālotpattika iti bodhaḥ | kṛṣṇāt para ityādau kṛṣṇotpattikāladhvaṃsādhikaraṇakālavṛttiritibodhaḥ | prayāgāduttaraṃ kāśītyādau saṃyuktasaṃyogavaddeśatvamuttaratvam | tasya ca pūrvatvadakṣiṇatvapaścimatvādinā tattadrūpeṇa tātparyavaśāt tattatprayogeṣu bhānam | 'gṛhād gaṅgā mama parā kāśyāḥ saivāparā mama |' ityādau viprakṛṣṭadeśasthatvasaṃnikṛṣṭadeśasthatve parāparaśabdasyārthau, pañcamyartho'vadhitvākhyaḥ, sambandhaḥ | tena gṛhāvadhikamatsambandhiviprakarṣavatī gaṅgetyādikrameṇa bodhaḥ| mametyatra tu na iti navyāḥ śābdikāḥ, tārkikāśca miśrādayaḥ | prāñcastu -- atrāpi kriyākārakabhāvamūlakaṃ viśeṣaṇatvarūpam, viṣayatvaṃ nimittatvaṃ vā sambandhatvena viśeṣaṇarūpeṇa vā prītayate | taduktaṃ bhartṛhariṇā -- sambandhaḥ kārakebhyo'nyaḥ kriyākārakapūrvakaḥ | śrutāyāmaśrutāyāṃ vā kriyāyāmabhidhīyate || sarvatraiva hi sambandhaḥ kriyākārakabhāvamūlaka etanmate | 'rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ' ityatra svasvāmibhāvasambandho'pi kriyākārakabhāvapūrvaka eva | 'yato hi rājā puruṣāyavetanadānena tasya svāmī bhavati' ityarthakaṃ bhāṣyamevātra eva | 'yato hirājā puruṣāya vetanadānena tasya svāmī bhavati' ityarthakaṃ bhāṣyamevātra mānaṃ vartate | kriyā hi siddhasvabhāvānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ kriyāṃ vinā parasparasambandhamabhajatāṃ nirāśrayeva sambandhaṃ karoti | 'mātuḥ smarati' ityatra kriyā śrutā, 'rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ' ityādau tu aśrutā dānādikriyā'numīyata ityāhuḥ | idamatra bodhyam -- 'rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ' ityatra rājādiḥ sambandhe viśeṣaṇam, sambandhaśca puruṣe viśeṣaṇam | 'rājasambandhi puruṣaḥ' iti bodhaḥ | evañca sambanghasya svasvamibhāvasya dviṣṭhatve'pi viśeṣaṇavācakād rājaśabdādeva ṣaṣṭhī, na tu puruṣādipadāt, prakṛtyarthaṃ prati pratyayārthasya prādhānyānurodhāt | yadyapi ṣaṣṭhyarthasambandhasya saṃsargatayaiva bhāṣyamate bhānam, tathāpi prakāratāyāḥ sāṃsargikaviṣayatāviśeṣyatobhayanirūpyatayā prakāratānirūpakaviṣayatāśālitvarūpaprādhānyamakṣatameva | puruṣādiśabdāt ṣaṣṭhyāṃ satyāṃ tu nedaṃ nirvahet | atha ca viśeṣyapuruṣādau kārakapratipādikārthā'nyataratvasyāvaśyakatvena aśeṣatvāt tato na ṣaṣṭhī | vastutastu śabdaśaktisvabhāvād viśeṣaṇa eva sambandha ud‌bhūtatayā pratīyata iti viśeṣaṇavācakapadādeva ṣaṣṭhī | taduktaṃ hariṇā -- diṣṭho'pyasau parārthatvād guṇeṣu vyatiricyate | tatrābhidhīyamānaśca pradhāne'pyupayujyate || ayamāśayaḥ -- prakāratayā abhedasya sambandhatvānaṅgīkartṛ naye 'nīlo ghaṭaḥ' ityādau vyabhicārād bhedasāhityānusaraṇam | bhedasahitāyāḥ sambandhaniyatatayā viśeṣaṇa eva tadākāṅkṣodayena tatraiva sambandha udbhūtatayā pratīyata iti tatraiva sambandha udbhūtatayā pratīyata iti tatraiva ṣaṣṭhī | viśeṣyasya tu padāntarāsannidhāne svaniṣṭhatvādeva na viśeṣyatāniyāmakasambandhā''kāṅkṣā | svaniṣṭhatvañca svārthapravṛttinimitattanirūpitaviśeṣyatayā bhāsamānatvam, tacchālitvaṃ vā | apradhāne ṣaṣṭhyādinā aṃśataḥ pratītipathāvatīrṇaḥ sambandhaḥ pradhānopayogyapi, tasya dviṣṭhatvāt | ]"ṣaṣṭhī śeṣe" [ 2|3|50 ] iti sūtrasvarasāditi prāñcaḥ | nanu ṣaṣṭhyā sambandhaviśeṣāṇāṃ tattadrūpeṇaiva bhānādidamayuktam | ata eva saṃyogādisambandhasattve'pi sambandhaviśeṣatātparyeṇa 'cetrasya nedaṃ vāsaḥ' iti prayujyate | ata eva 'ekaśataṃ ṣaṣṭhyarthāḥ' iti asteranantare samīpe veti ca "ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā" [ 1|1|46 ] iti sūtrasthabhāṣyam, 'ekā'pi ṣaṣṭhī viṣayabhedād bhidyate' iti " ādeśapratyayayoḥ " [ 8|3|59 ] iti sūtrasthaṃ bhāṣyañca saṃgacchata iti cet, satyam ; "ṣaṣṭhī śeṣe" iti sūtre śeṣaśca uktādanyaḥ | sa ca tattadrūpeṇa svatvādisambandhatvena ca sambandhatvena rūpeṇa karmatvādiśca, karmādipadebhya āśrayatvenaivāśrayabodhasyānubhavasiddhatvena tattadrūpeṇa bodha eva dvitīyādividhānāt | tatrāsati bādhake nahi nirviśeṣaṃ sāmānyamiti nyāyāt tattadrūpeṇaiva bodhaḥ, kadācit sambandhatvenāpi ṣaṣṭhyā janyate, 'mātuḥ smarati' ityādau ca tattadrūpeṇa bodhe dvitīyādīnāṃ bādhikānāṃ sattvāt sambandhatvenaiva bodha ityāhuḥ | kecittu, śeṣapadārthasyoktādanyarūpatvenāvadhyavadhimatoḥ sājātyasyaucityāt cānyo dharmirūpa eva sambandhī sambandhitvena ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ | pratyayārthaikadeśe sambandhe prakṛtyarthasya pratiyogitāsambandhenānvayaḥ | pratyayārthaścānuyogirūpetarapadārthe'bhedenānveti | yadvā, sambandhapratiyogyarthaḥ | evañca prakṛtyarthasyābhedenaivānvayaḥ | tasya cetarapadārthe svāvacchedakapratiyogitānirūpitānirūpitānuyogitvasambandhanaivānvayaḥ, vyutpattivaicitryāt | evañca pratyayārthasaṃkhyāyā itaravibhaktivat pratyayārthe evānvayo bhavati | tathā ca vibhakyatyarthasaṃkhyāprakārakaśābdabodhe vibhaktijanyopasthitirheturiti kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ | tava tu ṣaṣṭhyarthasaṃkhyāprakārakaśābdabodhe prakṛtijanyopasthitirheturiti kāryakāraṇabhāvāntaramapi kalpyaṃ syāt | na ca sambandha eva tadanvayaḥ, ekarājakīyasambandhadvayādyabhiprāyeṇa rājñorityādyāpatteḥ | 'sambandhaḥ śaktireva vā' iti harikārikāyāmapi sambandhaśabdaḥ 'arśa ādyajantaḥ' ityāhuḥ | 'śaktireva vā' iti matāntare tu sambandha evārtha iti dhyeyam | sa ca sambandho'pi prakāraeva, padārthatvāt | etena karmatvādau śaktiriti pakṣe dvitīyādīnāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāśca viṣayavibhāgo na syāt | dharmiṇi śaktiriti meta tu dharmiṇi pratipādye dvitīyā, dharme ṣaṣṭhīti vyavasthā sambhavatīti parāstam, dharme śaktāvapi karmatvatvādinā bodhe dvitīyādayaḥ sambandhatvena bodhe ṣaṣṭhati vyavasthāsambhavāt | iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥ -- dharmiṇi śaktiriti mate dharmiṇaḥ sambandhitvena vivakṣāyāṃ dharmamātrasya bhedenānvayavivakṣāyāñca ṣaṣṭhyeva, ubhayārapi viśeṣatvāt | dharme śaktiriti mate tu dharmasya sambandhatvena vivakṣāyāmevetyalam | evañca 'rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ' ityatra rājanirūpitasvatvavān puruṣa iti bodhaḥ | sambandhaviśeṣatātparyavirahe tu sambandhatvenāpi sambandhaḥ ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ | rājasambandhī puruṣa iti ca bodhaḥ | mātuḥ smaratītyādau, mātṛsambandhismaraṇakarttīta bādhaḥ | annasya hetorvasati -- ṣaṣṭhyartho janyatvam | hetvabhinnānnaniṣṭhajanakānirūpitajanyatāvān vāsa iti bodhaḥ | grāmasya dakṣiṇataḥ puraḥ, upari vā'stotyatra dakṣiṇadeśādhikaraṇatvarmāgramadeśādikaraṇatvamūrdhvadeśādhikaraṇatvaca dakṣiṇata ityāderarthaḥ | sambandhaḥ ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ | 'agnaye chāgasya vapāyāḥ haviṣo medasaḥ preṣye' iti | atra medasa iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī chāgasyetyavayavāvayavibhāvasambandhe vapāyā iti ca sambandhe chāgāvayavībhūtavapāsambandhihavirbhūtamedaḥ karmakaḥ, praiṣa iti bodhaḥ | 'kṛṣṇasya kṛtiḥ' ityatra karttā ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ, kṛṣṇakarttṛkā kṛtiriti bodhaḥ | 'jagataḥ karttā kṛṣṇaḥ' ityatra karma ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ, jagat‌karmakotpattyanukūlavyāpārāśrayaḥ kṛṣṇa iti bodhaḥ |1 [fn tārkikāstu -- karttṛtvaṃ karmatvamarthaḥ | prakṛtyarthasya tatrādheyatāsambandhenanvayaḥ | kartṛtvādenirūpakatāsambandhena dhātvartha'nvayaḥ | kṛṣṇavṛttikarttṛ tānirūpakakṛtimān jagad‌vṛttiviṣayatārūpakarmatānirūpakakṛtimān kṛṣṇa iti bodha ityāhuḥ | ] yattvatra kartṛ karmaṇoḥ ṣaṣṭhyāḥ lakṣaṇeti | tat, na ; "karttṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti" [ 2|3|65 ] ityādeḥ śaktigrāhakānuśāsanasya sattvena lakṣaṇāyā ayuktatvāt | nedaṃ śaktigrāhakamiti tu riktaṃ vacaḥ | "śeṣe ṣaṣṭhī" ityāderapi śaktigrāhakatānāpatteḥ, suvibhaktau na lakṣaṇeti vṛddhapravādācceti dik | 'rāhoḥ śiraḥ' ityādau tvanekāvasthāprayuktaśirasa idamekāvasthāyuktamavayava iti bhedamāropyaiva ṣaṣṭhī nirvāhyati "ādyantavat" sūtre bhāṣye spaṣṭam | iti ṣaṣṭhīvibhaktyarthanirūpamam | <19> atha saptamīvibhaktyarthanirṇayaḥ kārakaspatamyāścādhikaraṇamarthaḥ, "adhikaraṇe saptamī" iti sūtrāt | adhikaraṇatvamalakṣaṇabodhakañca "ādhāro'dhikaraṇam" [ 1|4|45 ] iti sūtram | tatra kārakādhikārāt pratyāsattyā kriyāyā evādhāro gṛhyate | tatra sākṣāt kriyādhārayoḥ kartṛkarmasaṃjñābhyāṃ bādhāt paramparayā tadāśrayasya grahaṇam | na ca te eva paramparayā''dhārasya syātāmiti vācyam, karttṛkriyājanyadhātūpāttaphalaśālitvena mukhyoddeśyatvarūpasya kartturīpsitatamatvasyābhāvāt | svatantrapadasāmarthyācca karttṛ saṃjñāsūtre na paramparayā''dhārasya grahaṇam | paramparā ca karttṛkarmadvārikaiva | yadyapi prakaraṇāt kriyayā sarvakārakāṇāmupasthitiḥ, tathāpi yogyatābalena vyākhyānenānubhavabalena ca tayoreva grahaṇam | evañca karttṛkarmadvārā kriyāśrayatvamadhikaraṇatvaṃ phalitam | na caivaṃ phalasya karmatāyāḥ pūrvaṃ vyutpādanāt karmabhūtaphaladvārā kriyāśrayataṇḍulāderadhikaraṇatvaṃ durvāramiti vācyam, vyāpārajanyaphalāśrayatvasyāpi karmasaṃjñāprayojanakatvena tayā bādhāt | karttṛdvārā kriyāśrayatvaṃ tu taṇḍulāderasambhāvitameva, ādhārapadasārthyena sākṣād vṛttiniyāmakasambandhenaiva karttṛdvārakatvasya vivakṣaṇāt, kālikādisambandhasyātiprasaktatvena kālavyahārātiriktasthale tasyādhikaṇatāniyāmakatvāsvīkārācca | atra kartrādidvārā kriyāśrayatvavivakṣāyāṃ saptamī, sākṣāt phalāśrayatvavivakṣāyāṃ dvitīyā | ata eva 'grāme gacchati, grāmaṃ gacchati' ityubhayaṃ sādhu | ata eva hṛdayaṃ spṛśati, hṛdispṛgityādi saṅgacchate | na ca devadattaḥ pacati bhavatītyādau pākadvārā bhavanāśrayatvavivakṣāyāṃ devadattasayādhikaraṇatvāpattiḥ | yataḥ karttṛkarmaṇoḥ kriyābhinnayoreva grahaṇaṃ takrakauṇḍinyanyāyāt, tena na doṣaḥ | anye tu, satyabhidhāne iṣṭāpattiḥ | anyathā'nabhidhānādeva netyāhuḥ | na ca mokṣe icchāstītyatrādhikaraṇatvānāpattiḥ | pratyayopāttecchāyāḥ siddhatvena tāmādāyopapatterityāhuḥ | yattu, pacati bhavatītyādau pākādidvārā bhavanāśrayatvavikṣāyāṃ pākādāvanvayasyāvaśyakatvenāntaraṅgatvāt karttṛtvasyaiva pravṛttiḥ | mokṣe icchāstītyādau pratyayopāttasiddhecchādvārāstikrīyāyāmanvayasya vivakṣitatvenādhikaraṇatvaṃ sūpapādam | nahi tāmādāya karmatvapravṛttiḥ, tasya akriyātvāt | prakṛtyarthadvārā tatrānvayavivakṣāyāṃ tu tasya kriyātvāt karmatvena ṣaṣṭhyīveti | tat, na ; | vastutaḥ karttṛdvārakasambandhena kriyāyāmanvaye'pi karttṛvācakapadopāttārthānvaye mānābhāvenāntaraṅgatvāderdurvāratvāt | tasmādicchāpadārthānvaye ṣaṣṭhī, tadvārakasambandhena kriyānvaye saptamītyeva tattvam | nanu karttṛ karmakaraṇādhikaraṇārthakavibhaktīnāmāśrayamātramartha iti kuta āsāṃ vailakṣaṇyamiti cet, nirūpakabhedāt sambandhabhedāt tattatsaṃjñāviśiṣṭasyaiva tattadvibhaktibhirbaudhācceti gṛhāṇa | tatra kartari dhātvarthavyāpāraḥ, karmaṇi tadarthaphalaṃ nirūpakaṃ sambandhaścādheyataiva | karaṇe svavyāpārajanyatvaṃ sambandhaḥ, adhikaraṇe ca svavṛttikartṛkatvādiriti phalībhūte śābdabodhe vailakṣaṇyaṃ bodhyam | tatrādhārastridhā -- aupaśleṣikaḥ, vaiṣayikaḥ, abhivyāpakaśceti | tatra saṃyogasamavāyādisambandhena kartṛkarmasambaddha ādyaḥ | viṣayatāsambandhena tatsambaddho dvitīyaḥ | vyāpakatvasambandhena tṛtīyaḥ | tatra "kaṭe śete" ityatra svavṛttikartṛ katvasambandhena kaṭavṛttiśayanamiti bodhaḥ | mokṣe icchāstītyatra svaviṣayakarttṛ katvasambandhena mokṣavṛttiricchākartṛkā satteti bodhaḥ | sarvasminnātmāsti itayatra svavyāpakakartṛ kvasambandhena sarvavṛttirātmakartṛkā satteti bodhaḥ | mūle vṛkṣaḥ kapisaṃyogyastītyādāvavyāpyadharmavat‌karttṛkakriyāsamabhivyāhāre svavṛttisvāvacchedyadharmāśrayakartṛ katvasambandhena kriyāyāmanvayo vyutpattivaicitryāt | yatrāpi kriyāpadaṃ na śruyate tatrāpyavyāhāryamiti dik | adhītī vyākaraṇe -- atra na karmaṇi ktaḥ | tathā sati karmaṇo'bhihitatvena 'ktasyenviṣayasya karmaṇyupasaṃkhyānam' iti saptamī na syāt | ataḥ "napuṃsake bhāve" [ 3|3|144 ] iti sūtrem̐ṇa ktaḥ, tasya sakarmasvapi pravṛtteḥ | tasyāpyakarmakeṣveva pravṛttiriti mate tu avivakṣitakarmakatvāt pūrvaṃ bhāvekte, paścāt karmasambandhe'pi antaraṅgajātasaṃskārasya nivṛttau mānābhāvaḥ | na caivaṃ pacyate, devadattena taṇḍulamiti prayogāpattiḥ, pragogānurodhenaiva vivakṣāyāḥ sattvenādoṣāt | anyathā 'pūrvaṃ dhātuḥ sādhanena yujyate' iti pakṣe vijayatīti parasmaipadāpattiḥ | adhītamaneneti vigrahe "iṣṭādibhyaśca" [ 4|2|88 ] iti karttarīniḥ | adhītavān vyākaraṇāmityādāviva ca guṇībhūtakriyāyāmapi kārakānvaya iti bodhyam | karma saptamyarthaḥ | vyākaraṇakarmakādhyayanakartteti bodhaḥ | nanvastītyadhyāhārasyāvaśyakatayā kartṛdvārā vyāpāraśrayatvenātra saptamī siddheti cet, na; adhyayanānvaye karmatvena dvitīyābādhanārthamasyāvaśyakatvāt | carmaṇi dvīpinamityādau phalaṃ saptamyarthaḥ | carmaphalakaṃ dvīpikarmakaṃ hananamityādirītyā bodhaḥ | carmaṇaḥ phalatvam, hananakriyāyāstallābhādiviṣayakecchādhīnatvāditi bodhyam | 'goṣu duhyamānāsu' ityatra 'yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇ' [ 2|3|37 ] iti sūtreṇa saptamī | yasya bhāvena kriyayā kriyayā kriyāntaraṃ jñāpyate tato jñāpakakriyāvācakāt saptamīti tadarthaḥ | nanu jñāpyajñāpabhāvo bhūyo darśanāśrayo dṛṣṭaḥ, yathāgnidhūmayoḥ | tataścodite āditye tamo naṣṭamityādyeva tadudāharaṇaṃ syāt, na tvidam, kadāciddhigoṣu duhyamānāsvasāvāgata iti cet, na ; nirjñātadeśakālakriyāyā anirjñātadeśakālakriyāparicchedakatvena lakṣaṇatvākṣateḥ | anye tu, kālaviśeṣa etadīyaitadgamanavyaktyāśrayaḥ, etad‌godohanāśrayatvāt, yatra yatrai tadgamanāśrayatvābhāvaḥ, tatraitadgodohanāśrayatvābhāva iti vyatirekyumānavidhayā jñāpakatvamāhuḥ | jñāpakatvañca tatacchabdaprayogabodhitamevaitacchāstrapravṛttau nimittam, na tu tasya mānāntareṇa niyamato grahaṇāpekṣeti bodhyam | tatra deśodāharaṇaṃ sati guṇe dravyatvamastītyādau | jñāpakatvañca saptamyarthaḥ, tatra prakṛtyarthasya svapravṛttinimittībhūtakriyādvārakatvasambandhenānvayaḥ | ata evāsya kriyāyāmevānvayaḥ, kriyādvārakasambandhena yanniṣṭhajñāpatānirūpitajñāpyatvaṃ kriyāntaraniṣṭham, tataḥ saptamīti sūtrārthānurodhāt | evañca svāśrayakriyāśrayatvasambandhena varttamānadohanakarmībhūtagoniṣṭhajñāpakatānirūpitajñāpyatāvadgamanāśraya iti bodhaḥ | goṣu dhokṣyamāṇāsvāgata ityādau bhaviṣyāddohanasyāpi buddhyupārūḍhasya jñāpakatvaṃ bodhyam | tatrāgamanādau bhaviṣyaddohanapūrvakālatvādibodhastvārthaḥ | yadvā jñāpakatvarūpasartamyarthasya tātparyavaśāt pūrvakālavṛttitvādisamānādhikaramasvanirūpitajñāpyatāsambandhenānvayaḥ | ata eva 'jale pīte tṛṣā śāmyati' ityādāvatītārthakakṛt‌sabhivyāhāre kāryakāraṇabhāvo'pi sambandhatayā bhāsata ityāhuḥ | yattu, etatsaptamyāḥ svaprakṛtibhūtakṛdantanāmapravṛttinimittībhūtakriyāsambandhivarttamānakālavṛttitvādikamarthaḥ | tathā ca gavābhinnavarttamānadohanakarmatadīyadohanasambandhavarttamānakāle āgata ityādyākārastatra bodha iti | tat, na ; sūtrasvarasavirodhāt, goṣu dugdhāsvityādāvuttarakālavṛttitvāderbhānenānantaśaktikalpanāpatteśceti dik | na caivaṃ gavāṃ dohe āgata ityādau dohaśabdāt saptamyanāpattiḥ, gośabdācca tadāpattiriti vācyam, satītyadhyāhāreṇa dohakartṛkasattāyā lakṣaṇatvenākṣateḥ | etena vivāhe nāndīmukhaṃ kuryādityādi vyākhyātam, kariṣyamāṇe ityadhyāhārāt | etena 'rāhuparāge snāyāt,' kṣīyante cāsya karmāṇi tasmin dṛṣṭe parāvare' ityādyapi vyākhyātam, satītyadhyahārāt | rāhūparāgādīnāṃ nimittatvaṃ siddhasādhyasamabhivyāhāranyāyena phalatīti dik | kṣīyanta ityatra karmakarttari yagāda karmasthakriyārūpārthasyaiva karmasvāropād bodhyam | evam 'bhidyate hṛdayagranthiśchidyante sarvarsaśayāḥ' ityatrāpi bodhyam | apare tu, idaṃ sutraṃ yatra mānāntarasiddhasyārthasya kālaviśeṣasambandhādipratipādanāya śabdaprayogaḥ, tatraiva pravarttate, tathaiva sūtrabhāṣyasvarasāt | evañca 'vivāhe nāndīmukham, rāhūparāge' ityādi naitadudāharaṇam | tasmāttatra vivāhapadena tatprākkālo lakṣyate | rāhūparāgapadena catadāśrayaḥ kāla iti tatrādhikaraṇasampatamyeva | nimittatvaṃ tūktanyāyenaiva phalatītyāhuḥ | 'rudati rudato vā prāvrājīt' ityatra jñāpakatvaṃ ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyorthaḥ | dhātoścānādaraviśiṣṭaṃ pravrajanaṃ lakṣyam | atrāpi ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyau tātparyagrāhike | anādaraśca pratyāsattyā putrādiviṣayaka eva | vaiśiṣṭyañca sāmānādhikaraṇyasyottarakālikatvābhyām | evañca rodanakartṛputrādijñāpyamanādaraviśiṣṭaṃ pravrajanamiti bodhaḥ | 'nṛṇāṃ nṛṣu vā dvijaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ' ityatra "yataśca nirdhāraṇām" [ 2|3|41 ] iti sūtreṇa ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyau | jātiguṇakriyāsaṃjñābhiḥ samudāyādekadeśasya pṛthakkaraṇaṃ nirdhāraṇaṃ yataḥ, tataḥ ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyāviti tadartha iti vṛttikṛtaḥ | tatra jātiguṇakriyāsaṃjñābhirityatra viśiṣṭasyetyadhyāhāraḥ | karaṇe vā tṛtīyā | pṛthak‌kakaraṇañcasvetaravyāvṛttadharmavattvaprakārakārakajñānaviṣayīkaraṇam | yata iti pañcamī nirdhāraṇāghaṭakavyāvṛttatve'nveti | evañca svetarayaddharmāvacchinnavyāvṛttadharmattvaṃ jātyādiviśiṣṭasya pratipādyate, tataḥ ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyāviti phalitam | yata iti kim, yasya jātyādiviśiṣṭasya svetaravyāvṛttadharmavattvapratipādanam, tata e vibhaktirmā bhūditi | na ca ṣaṣṭhīvadviśeṣaṇādevocitā, "dūrāntikārthabhyaḥ" [ 2|3|35 ] itivat prathamāpavādasyāpi sambhavāt | 'narāṇāṃ kṣatriyasya śauyam' ityādau kṣatriyāderviśeṣaṇatvasya sattvācca | 'asti ca narāṇāṃ vipraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ' ityādau vipratvādiviśiṣṭasya taditaranarādivyāvṛttaśreṣṭhatvadharmavattayā pratipattiḥ | 'narebhyo rākṣasaḥ krūraḥ' ityādau rākṣasatvaviśiṣṭe taditaranarādivyāvṛttakrūratamatvavivakṣāyāmapi na ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyau | "pañcamo vibhakteḥ" ityuttarasūtreṇāpavādabhūtāyāḥ pañcamyā vidhānāt | eñca vyāvṛttatvākhyaḥ sambandho nirdhāraṇavibhakterarthaḥ | vyāvṛttatvañca vidheyatāvacchedakāvacchinnābhāvāpratiyogitvam | tena dvitvādyavacchinnādyabhāvamādāya nātipraṅgaḥ | taccābhedānvayi vidheyasamabhivyāhārasthale vidheyatāvacchedake'nveti, bhedānvayitatsathale ca vidheya eva, vyutpattivaicitryāt | abhāve ca prakṛtyarthasya sāmānādhikaraṇyasambandhena vipratvādyavacchinnabhedaviśiṣṭasvāvacchedakāvacchinnādhāratānirūpitādheyatāsambandhenānvayaḥ, ākāṅkṣāvaśāt; kevalādheyatāsambandhena śreṣṭhatvābhāvasya naratvāvacchinne bādhācca | svāvacchedakāvacchinnādhāratvādeḥ sambandhatvāt 'gavāmiyaṃ sampannakṣīrā' iti na prayogaḥ, kintu 'etāsāṃgavāmiyaṃ sampannakṣīrā' ityeva prayogaḥ, tatra sāmānādhikaraṇyasambandhena vipratvādyavacchinnabhedaviśiṣṭeti viśeṣaṇād 'gavāṃ sāsnāvatī sampannakṣīrā' iti na prayogaḥ | vidheyasyoddeśyatāvacchedakāvacchedenānvayāt 'paśūnāṃ kṛṣṇā sampannakṣīrā' iti na prayogaḥ | tathā ca tādṛśasambandhena naravṛttyantābhāvapratiyogiśreṣṭhatvavadibhinno vipra ityādikrameṇa bodhaḥ | narāṇāṃ kṣatriye śauryamityatra tādṛśasambandhena naravṛttyabhāvapratiyogiśauryakartṛkā kṣatriyavṛttisatteti bodhaḥ | udbhūtāvayavabhedavivakṣayā nṛṇāmiti bahuvacanam| tirohitāvayavabhedavivakṣāyāmekavacanamapi bodhyam | ata eva 'dvandvaḥ sāmāsikasya ca ' iti gītā saṃgacchate | yadyapi gosamūhasyādhāratvavivakṣāyāṃ saptamyāḥ siddheḥ, avayavāvayavibhāvavivakṣāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhīsiddheścānyataravibhaktervidheyatvābhāvalāghavānurodhena sa eva vibhaktyartho vaktumucitaḥ | bahukṣīrātvādau kṛṣṇetaragavādyavṛttitavābodhastu mānaḥ, devadetto vāmenākṣṇā paśyatītyukte dakṣiṇena na paśyatītivat | ata eva gomaṇḍale varttamānā yā kṛṣṇā gauḥ., sā bahukṣīretyādhārasaptamīghaṭitavākye tadbodhaḥ saṅgacchate, tathāpi etadapavāda "pañcamī vibhakte" [ 2|3|42] iti sūtrodāharaṇe etatprakārasya vaktumaśakyatvāduktaprakārasyaivāvaśyakatvāt, tadaikarūpyāyeyameva saraṇirāśritā'smābhiḥ, anubhavasiddhatvācca 'puruṣottamaḥ' ityādau sāmarthyābhāvāt samāsānāpatteśca, pañcamīvidhāyakasyaitadapavādatvoktayasaṃgatatāpatteśca, mamāpi ṣaṣṭhyaṃśe'nuvādatvasya sattvācca | gomaṇḍale vartamānā yetyatra tu gavāmiti nirdhāraṇavibhaktyantādhyāhāreṇaiva bodhaḥ | astu vā kvacit tatheti na sarvatra tathaiveti niyama ityāhuḥ | nanu javapṛthivyorjalaṃ snehavādityādau jalabhinnayorjalapṛthivyoraprasiddherjalapṛthivyubhavattyabhāvapratiyogitvasya snehe bādhena ca nirdhāraṇāsambhava iti cet, na ; tatrāpyubhayaparyāptasāhityāvacchinne jalabhedasya tadavacchinnavṛttyabhāvapratiyogitvasya snehe cābādhāt | na caivamapyubhayaparyāptasāhityāvacchinnatvasya jale sattvena "pañcamīvibhakte" ityasyaiva pravṛttiḥ syāditi vācyama, ubhayaparyāptasāhityāśrayābhedasyāpi sattvena tadaprāpteḥ | etena sāṃkāśyakānāṃ pāṭaliputrakāṇāṃ ca pāṭaliputrakā abhirūpatamā ityādibhāṣyaprayogā vyākhyātāḥ | nṛṇāṃ madhye dvijaḥ śreṣṭha ityādau tu madhye ityavyayena vibhaktyā ca he caitra ityādau saṃbodhanavat samuccitya sambandho dyotyata iti vadanti | māthurāḥ pāṭaliputrakebhya āḍhyatarā ityatra "pañcamī vibhakte" iti sūtreṇa pañcamī | tatra hi vibhāgo vibhaktaṃ bheda ityarthaḥ | "yaśca ca nirddhāraṇam" ityunuvarttate | nirddhāraṇāvadherniddhāryamāṇasya kenacidrūpeṇābhinnasya yatra rūpāntareṇa bhedaḥ, tatra nirdhāraṇaṃ bhavati | yathā nṛṇāṃ vipraḥ śreṣṭha ityādau naratvenābhinnasya śreṣṭhatvena bhedaḥ | evañca nirddhāraṇe bhedasya sattvena vibhaktagrahaṇasāmarthyād yatra bheda eva, na tu kenāpyupāttarūpeṇābhedaḥ, tatraivāsya pravṛttiḥ | evañca svetarayaddharmāvacchinnavyāvṛttadharmavattayā nirdhāraṇāvadhitāvacchedakāśrayanirūpitabhedavata eva jātyādiviśiṣṭasya pratipādanam, tataḥ pañcamīti sūtrārthaḥ | sāṃkāśyakānāṃ pāṭaliputrakāṇāṃ ca pāṭaliputrakā abhirūpatamā ityādau nirdhāryamāṇeṣu pāṭaliputrakeṣu nirdhāraṇāvadhisāṃkāśyakabhedasattve'pi nirddhāraṇāvadhitāvacchedakasāhityāśrayapāṭaliputrakanirūpitābhedasyāpi sattvena bhedasyaivābhāvānna doṣaḥ | sāṃkāśyakatvaṃ tu na nirddhāraṇāvadhitāvacchedakam, pāṭaliputrakapadasya ca śabdasya vaiyarthyāpatteḥ | atra pañcamyartho vyāvṛttitvameva | pāṭaliputrakavyāvṛttāḍhyataratvavanto māthurā iti bodhaḥ | bhāṣyakṛtastu, sāṃkāśyakapāṭaliputrakayorabhirūpatvena sāmyaṃ jñātavān hi etatprayuṅkte sāṃkāśpakebhyaḥ pāṭaliputrakā abhirūpatarā iti | tatra buddhikṛtasambandhābhāvarūpaviśleṣasya pratīterapādānatvenaiva pañcamī siddhā, tatra vibhaktā ityadhyāhāraḥ, sāṃkāśyakābadhikavibhāgavantaḥ pāṭaliputrakā abhirūpatarā iti bodhaḥ | viśleṣapratiyogī sambandhaścātraikadharmāśrayatvameva | viśleṣaprayojakaṃ cābhirūpataratvameva | pratyāsatteḥ tasmin hi pratīte ekajātīyābhirūpatvapratītirnotpadyate iti sarvasaṃmatam | gavāṃ kṛṣṇetyādau tu na viśleṣapratītiḥ, na hi sampannakṣīrātve jñāte'pi gotvavāttābuddhirnivarttate | etatsūtrodaharaṇaviṣaye kriyānvayaṃ vinā nāmārthanvayavivakṣā tu na, anabhidhānāt | tena na ṣaṣṭhyantaprayogāpattiḥ | atra pakṣe'bhirūpataratve sāṃkāśyakavyāvṛttatvamārthamityetat sūtraṃ pratyācakhyuḥ | māthurapāṭaliputrakayoḥ pāṭaliputrakamādhurāvādyapaṇ‍ḍitāviti prayoge pañcamī na bhavatyeveti dik | 'mūlenāvāhayed devīṃ śravaṇena visarjayet' | 'mūle śravaṇe vā' ityādau mūlaśravaṇaśabdau tattannakṣatrayuktakālalakṣakau tṛtīyāsaptamyoradhikaraṇamarthaḥ | mūlanakṣatrayuktakāladyabhikaraṇakaṃ devīkarmakamāvāhanamityādikrameṇa bodhaḥ | adya bhuktvā'yaṃ d‌vyahe, dvyahādvā bhoktā | atra vibhaktyarthaḥ svānantarakālavṛttitvam | samabhivyāhṛtakālānantaratvañca dvitīyaṃ prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇam | ādyaṃ tu tadviśeṣyam, kriyāyāṃ viśeṣaṇam, vyutpattivaicitryāt | tenaivaddivasādhikaraṇabhojanottarakālikametaddivasānantarad‌vyahānantarakālavarti yad bhojanam, tadāśraya ityarthaḥ | ihastho'yaṃ krośe krośādvā lakṣyaṃ vidhyedityatra svānantaraṃ deśavṛttitvaṃ samabhivyāhṛtadeśāntaravṛttitvañca vibhaktyarthaḥ | anvayaḥ prāgvat | etaddeśādhikaraṇakasthityāśrayakartṛ kametaddeśānantarakrośāntarasthitalakṣyakarmakaṃ vyadhanamiti bodhaḥ | atra "saptamīpañcamyau kārakamadhye" [ 2|3|7 ] iti sūtreṇa vibhaktiḥ | tatra kārakaśabdena tacchaktirāśrayatvādirūpocyate | śaktidvayamadhye yau kālādhvānau, tayoḥ saptamīpañcamyāviti sūtrārthaḥ | kecittu, svānantarakālavṛttitvamevārthaḥ, uttaratra svānantaradeśavṛttitvameva | śaktidvayamadhyavartitvaṃ tu kālādhvanorvastusannimittamityāhuḥ | adhibhuvi rāmaḥ, adhirāme bhūrityatra bhūnirūpitasvāmitvavān rāmanirūpitasvatvavatī ceti bodhaḥ | iti saptamīvibhakyarthanirṇayaḥ | <20> atha saṅkhyāvivakṣā'vivakṣānirṇayaḥ eṣāñca supāmekavacanatvadvivacanatvabahuvacanatvarūpeṇa, tattadrūpeṇa vā ekatvadvitvabahatvarūpasaṃkhyāta'pyarthaḥ, "dravyekayordvivacanaikavacane" "bahuṣu vahucanam" [ 1|4|2 ] iti sūtrasvarasāt | 'supāṃ karmādayo'pyarthāḥ saṃkhyā caiva tathā tiṅām' iti bhāṣyācca | atrāpinā saṃkhyā samuccīyate, uttaratra cena karmādaya karmādaya iti bodhyam | tatra karmādayo'rthā iti mate saṃkhyāyāḥ pratyayārthe evānvayaḥ | karmatvādi karmārtha iti mate tu prakṛtyarthe, tatra kvacit prakṛtyarthaviśeṣye'nvayaḥ, kvacit prakṛtyarthatāvaccheke'nvayaḥ | ata evānekavrīhitātparyake sampanno brīhiriti vākye ekavacanaṃ saṅgaccate, tatra vrīhitve tadanvayāt svāśrayāśrayatvarūpaparamparāsambandhena vā prakṛtythaṃ evān‌vayaḥ | idamevābhipretya jātyabhiprāyeṇaikavacanamiti prācāmudghoṣaḥ | ata eva vedāḥ pramāṇamiti bahuvacanāntasamabhivyāhāre'pyekavacanam, pramākaraṇatvarūpa prakātyarthatāvacchedake tadanvayāt | tatphalaṃ tu sarveṣāmekajātīyapramāṇopapādanameva | 'śataṃ brāhmaṇāḥ' ityādau tu 'viśatyādyāḥ sadaikatve' ityādikośaprāmāṇyāt samudāyaikatvābhiprāyamekavacanameva, na kadāpi pratyekāśrayaṃ bahuvacanam, prakṛtyarthatāvacchedaka evātra saṃkhyānvayaḥ, śabdaśaktisvabhāvāt | anyatra tu prayogānurodhād vyavasthitam, tena ghaṭā nīla ityādi nāpādyam | ata eva 'agnīṣomau devatā, pitaro devatāḥ' iti vyavasthita eva prayogaḥ | ādye ekadevatvasya pratipipādayiṣitatvādekavacanameva | dvitīye pratyekaṃ bhinnasyaiva tasya pratipipādayiṣitatvena bahuvacanamevetyāhuḥ | dārā ityādau tvavayavagabahutvasyāvavinyāropādekasyāmapi vyaktau bahavacanānta eva prayogaḥ | kiñca, tatrāropitabahutvāśrayaiva vibhaktiḥ, na tu svaniṣṭhaikatvāśrayāpi, kośādiprāmāṇyāt | yatra tu, kośādyudāsīnaṃ tatra yathecchaṃ prayogānusārāt | etenaikasminnapi 'ācāryāḥ kathayanti' 'gurava āgatāḥ' ityādiprayogāḥ samarthitāḥ | yattu, ajahat‌svārthalakṣaṇayā dārādipadānāṃ nānāguṇaviśiṣṭattadvyaktivācaktavana prakṛtyarthatāvacchedake saṃkhyānvaya iti| tat, na; mukhyārthaparatatpadottarabahuvacanasyāsaṅgatatāpatteḥ | yadi tu nirūḍhalakṣaṇayā vinā kevalamukhyārthakaprayoga eva netyucyate, tarhi tena rūpeṇa śaktirevāstu, kiṃ lakṣaṇayā ? kośādikañca tādṛśārthaśaktāveva tātparyagrāhakaṃ bodhyam | yadapi, sādhutvamātrārthametādṛśasthale bahuvacanādikamiti | tadapi, na; anuśāsanābhāvāt | na ca tavāpi mate sarvadā āropasattve mānābhāvena tadabhāve ekavacanāntaprayogāpattiḥ, kośādiprāmāṇyena niyatāropasvīkārāt, nānāguṇaviśiṣṭe śaktisvīkārācca | aneya tu, ayogyatāniścayasya śābdabodhapratibandhakatvābhāvādekavyaktāvapi bahutvānvayaḥ | ata eva gālidānādijanyaduḥkhānubhavaḥ, rūpakādikāvyajasukhādyanubhavaśca saṅgacchate | "bahuvacanam" [ 1|4|21 ] ityādeśca bahutvavaiśiṣṭyena bodhe bahuvacanamityādirarthaḥ | taduktam ---- "atyantāsatyapi hyarthe jñānaṃ śabdaḥ karoti hi" iti | āhārya eva śābdabodhaḥ | dārānānayetyādito bahvīnāmānayane pravṛttyādikaṃ tu nāpādyam, anāhāryāprāmāṇyajñānānāskanditajñānasyaiva pravarttakatvāt | yadā tu vyaktiniṣṭhabahutvābhiprāyeṇaiva tathā prayogaḥ, tadā bhavatyeva bahvonāmānayanam | tātparyāditastu tannirṇaya ityāhuḥ | yattu ; etādṛśasthale padārthopasthitimātraṃ na śābdabodha iti, tat, na; saṃvatraivamevāpattau śābdabodhocchedāpatterityanyatra vistaraḥ | saṃkhyāprasaṅgādudveśyavidheyayoḥ saṃkhyāvivakṣā'vivakṣe nirūpyete yattu mīmāṃsakāḥ, 'paśunā yajeta' ityādau vidheyaviśeṣaṇatvādekatvaṃ vivakṣitam | tathāhi -- samānapratyayopāttena prātipadikādapi sannihitena pradhānabhūtena ca kārakeṇāvaruddhamekatvaṃ prātipadikārthamanādṛtya kriyāṅgamavagamyamānaṃ vākyāsamarpitena kriyāviśeṣeṇa sambandha paścāṭ 'aruṇaihāyanī' nyāyena paśunārthāt sambandhena | evañca ekatvasya vivakṣitatvāt tadviśiṣṭapaśoreva vidhānānnānekapaśubhiryāgaḥ | evaṃ vidheyaviśeṣaṇe sarvaṃ vivakṣitam | 'grahaṃ sammārṣṭi' ityādāvaddheśyagrahagatamektavamavivakṣitam | anyathā vākyabhedaḥ syāt | tathāhi -- "prājāpatyā navagrahāḥ" ityatra vihitagrahoddeśena sammārgo vidhoyate | tatraikatvavivakṣāyāṃ grahaṃ saṃmārṣṭi, taṃ caikamityarthaḥ syāt | evañcoddeśyānekatvakṛto vākyabhedaḥ spaṣṭha eva | kiñca, grahamiti dvitīyā grahasya saṃskāryatvalakṣaṇaṃ prādhānyaṃ prītayate | evamekatvasyāpi | tathā ca grahasvarūpavadekatvavivakṣāyāmapi 'pratipradhānaṃ guṇāvṛttiḥ, iti nyāyāt sarvatra grahe samgārgasiddhirvyarthaiva tadvivakṣā | ' yadi tu paśuvadgrahāṇāṃ guṇatvaṃ bhavet, tadā yena kenāpi siddheryāvadguṇaṃ pradhānāvṛtterayogācca paricchedakatvena paśuvat saṃkhyāvivakṣā syāt | nanvevaṃ guṇatvaṃ cātra saṃskārakatvamasaṃskāryatvaṃ vā ? atha saṃkhyāviśiṣṭapaśvādividhivadekatvaviśiṣṭagrahānuvādena sammārgavidhiḥ syāditi cet, tathāpi sarveṣāṃ pratyekamekatvāt syādeva prasaṅgaḥ | na caikatvaviśiṣṭasammārgavidhiḥ, vaiśiṣṭyañca svāśrayakarmakatvasambandheneti vācyam, tathāpi dvitīyoktaprādhānyānurodhena 'pratipradhānaṃ guṇāvṛttiḥ' iti nyāyāt sarvatra sammārgraprasaṅgāt | tasmāduddeśyagatā saṃkhyā'vivakṣitaiva, yathā prakṛte grahatvamityāhuḥ | tadvaiyākaraṇernāśrayituṃ śakyam, "ārdhādhātukasyeṅvalāde" [ 7|2|35 ] ityatra valāditvaviśaaṣaṭamārdhadhātukamanūdyeṅvidhānenārdhadhātukaviśeṣaṇavalāditvādivivakṣāyāḥ sarvasammatatvāt | na cava graheṣvapi na doṣaḥ, tatrākāṅkṣāvirahāt phalābhāvāccetyuktam | tat kimanuvādyaviśeṣaṇaṃ vivakṣitameva, na ; "upeyivānanāścānanūcānaśca" [ 3|2|106] ityādau nañ‌prabhṛtervivakṣāyā upetyasyāvivakṣāyāśca svīkārāt | supsupetyādāvekatvasya vivakṣaṇācc | evaṃ videyaviśeṣaṇaṃ vivakṣitamitpi na niyamaḥ, "radābhyāṃ niṣṭhāto naḥ pūrvasya ca daḥ" [ 8|2|42 ] ityatraikatvavivakṣaṇāt ; tathātve bhinna ityatra nadvayalābho na syāt | na ca vākyabhedena tallābhaḥ, tatkalpane gauravād mānābhāvācca | 'pūrvasya ca ' iti cakārasya "ekaḥ pūrvaparayoḥ" [ 6|1|84 ] iti sūtrasyaikagraṇavat sattvāt | na ca tatraikatvāvikṣāyāmanantakārāpattiḥ, na caikena śāstrasya cāritārthyāt na bahūnāmāpattiḥ, bhinna ityatra nadvayānāpatteḥ | savarṇadīrghādivadubhayorekatopatteḥ | mama tu vākyabhedād na doṣaḥ, tatra cakārastāparyagrāhaka iti vācyam, cakārasya pūrvoktarītyaikadeśavidhānārthatvasyāpi vaktuṃ śakyatvena vākyabhede tavādi mānābhāvāt | tasmād yadi lakṣyānurodhena vākyabheda eva, cakārastātparyagrāhaka ityucyate, tadā ekatvavivakṣā vyarthaiva, vākyabhedena nakāradvayasya mamāpi lābhāt | ekena śāstrasya cāritārthyād na bahunāmāpattiḥ | nanvevamaniyame sati "ādaguṇaḥ" [ 6|1|87 ] ityādāvekatvaṃ vivakṣitaṃ kṛtvā 'ekaḥ parvaparayoḥ' ityatraikagrahaṇaṃ pratyākhyeyamiti cet, iṣṭāpatteḥ, bhāṣye pratyākhyānāt | evañca, "asya cvau" [ 7|4|32 ] ityādau anuvādyaviśeṣaṇatvād hrasvatvāderavivakṣetyādikaiyaṭādigranthāścintyā eveti dik | iti saṃkhyāvivakṣā'vivakṣāvicāraḥ | itisubarthanirṇayaśca samāptaḥ | <21> samāśaktinirūpaṇam 1 [fn 'padaśaktyaiva nirvāhe padasamūhātmakasamāsaśiktasvīkāro niṣphalaḥ' matimidaṃ nirākariṣyan samāsaśaktiṃ samarthayitumupakrameta -- atheti | samāsaśaktau nirūpaṇīyāyāṃ ghaṭakatayā praviṣṭasya samāsasāmānyasya pūrvaṃ nirvacanamāvaśyakamapi mūle upekṣitamiti tatra kiñcit prastūyate --- pāṇinyādisaṃketasambandhena samāsapadavattavaṃ samāsatvam | idañca lakṣaṇaṃ vyākaraṇaśāstraviṣayakameva | ato'nyatrāsya viparītārthakatve'pi na kṣatiḥ | ata eva cedaṃpāribhāṣikapadamityapi na kṣatiḥ | ata eva cedaṃ pāribhāṣikapadamityapi vaktuṃ śakyate | atha 'arthabodhaphākavibhaktyavyavahitapūrvavarttitvaprakārakajñānāviṣayapūrvapūrvapadaghaṭitanāmasamudāyatvaṃ samāsatvam' ityevāstu | 'rājapuruṣaḥ' ityādāvapi rājādipade kasyacit puṃso vibhaktyanusandhānasattve'pi tasyārthabodhaphalakatvābhāvād nāsambhavo'vyāptirvā | 'dadhi sundaramasti' ityādau tattadvibhaktyanusandhānasattva eva śābdabodhodayād na tatrātivyāptiḥ, samāsasthale tu pūrvapade vibhaktyanusandhānaṃ vinaiva śābdabodhopagamād na doṣa iti tu na vaktavyam, 'dadhi sundaram' ityādau vibhaktimajānato'pi bodhodayāttatrātivyāpteḥ | nanu vibhaktayanusaṃdhānaṃ vinā bodhānaṅgīkāreṇa nātivyāptiriti cet, na ; vinigamanāviraheṇa samāse'pi tathā vaktuṃ śakyatayā'saṃbhavāpatteḥ | na ca samāse padayoravyayahitapūrvāparībhāvarūpākāṅkṣāyāḥ śābdabodhe hetutvena vibhaktyanusandhānaṃ nāpekṣyate, asamāse tu prātipādikasya vibhaktyavyavahitapūrvavartiviprakārakajñānaviṣayasyaivākāṅkṣātvena vibhaktyanusandhānamapekṣyata ityeva vinigamakamiti vācyam, alukmāse vyabhicārāditi cet, evamapi 'paryabhūṣat','pacatabhūjjatā' ityādāvavyāpterdurvāratvāt | alakṣyatvena parihārastu buddhisambandha śūnyatāmeva prakāśayet | kecana tārkikāstu -- yādṛśamahāvākyottarastvatalādipratyayo yādṛśāryaviṣayatānirūpitasvārthaviṣayatāśālibodhajanakaḥ, tādṛśavākye tādṛśo'rthaḥ samāsaḥ | tādṛśabodhakatādṛśavākyatvaṃ samāsatvamiti yāvat | bhavati hi 'kṛṣṇaśritaḥ' ityādau taduttatvādipratyayena pūrvapadārthaviśiṣṭottarapadārthanvitasvārthabodhajananāt | pācakādikaṃ pākakriyākartrārthavākyamapi svaghaṭakānekanāmalabhyatādṛśārthapratipādakatvarūpamahāttvābāvād na mahāvākyamiti na tatrātivyāptirityāhuḥ | adhikantu tata evāgavantavyam | ] atha subantaprakṛtikasamāsaśaktirnirūpyate | tatrādāvajahatsvārthānirūpaṇam tatra "samarthaḥ padavidhiḥ" [ 2|1|1 ] iti sūtram | sāmarthyañcātraikārthībhāvaḥ, 'kiṃ kamarthaṃ nāma ? pṛthagarthānāmekārthībhāvaḥ samarthavacanam | kva punaḥ ? pṛthagarthāni kvaikārthāni ? rājñaḥ puruṣa iti vākye pṛthagarthāni, rājapuruṣa iti samāse ekārthāni' iti bhāṣyāt | asyārthaḥ --- ekārthatvaṃ nāmaikopasthitiviṣayārthakatvam | anyathā ghaṭapadasyāpi ghaṭaghaṭatvatatsambandharūpanānārthatvādekārthatvaṃ na syāt | evaṃ pṛthagarthatvaṃ nānopasthitiviṣayārthakatvam | idameva dhvanayituṃ pṛthagarthānāmityuktam, na tvanekārthānāmiti | vṛttivākyayorbhinnatvāt cvipratyayo'nupapanna ityāśayena 'kva punaḥ' ityādi praśnabhāṣyam | uttarasyāyamāśayaḥ ---- kāryaśābdikā hi vākyādeveyaṃ vṛttirniṣpanneti manyata iti | matāntare'pi sādṛśyād vākyīyatvādhyavasāyamāśritya cvipratyaya iti| cvipratyayārtha eva pṛthagarthānāmityanenānvākhyāyate | idameva dhvanayituṃ samāse punarekārthīnītyatra cvipratyayānupādānam | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- vākye yatā pṛthak padaiḥ padārthānāmupasthitāvākāṅkṣādivaśād viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvāpannaviśiṣṭārthapratītiḥ, naivaṃ vṛttau, kintvavayavaśaktibhyāṃ samudāyaśaktisahakṛtābhyāṃ padārthopasthitireva jāyamānā 1[fn 'saṃsṛṣṭārtha samartham' iti bhāṣyāditi śeṣaḥ | ]viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvāpannaviśiṣṭaviṣayā bhavati sarvatraiva | na ca vaiyākaraṇanaye tatra viśiṣṭasya śaktigrahaḥ | itthaṃ rājapuruṣādipadaṃ rājasambandhavat puruṣe śaktamityādyākāraḥ prāptāprāptavivekena viśiṣṭaśaktiḥ sambandhamātrādyaṃśe paryavasyati | saṃsargāśe samudāyaśaktisvīkāreṇa ko viśeṣo vākyavṛttyoriti vācyam, tatra hi phalabalāt padārthopasthitisamaye niyamataḥ saṃsargāṃśe udbodhakāsamavadhānakalpanena pṛthagupasthitayoḥ padārthayoḥ paścāt saṃsargabodhaḥ | vṛttau tu padārthopastitikāla eva niyamataḥ saṃsargāṃśe'pyubodhakakalpanād viśṣaṭaivopasthitiriti viśeṣāt | ata eva 'prāptedakaḥ' ityādau viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvavaiparītyena bodhaḥ | tatrāprayujyamānaṣaṣṭhyādyarthaḥ, saṃsargaścetyubhayameva samudāyaśaktisādhyam, ananyalabhyatvāt, klṛptaśakyaiva rājāderupasthisambhave tatra samudāyaśaktiklapne gauravācca | nāmārthayorabhedānvayādivyutpattayaśca pṛthagupasthitanāmārthādiviṣayāḥ | ata eva rājapuruṣaikadeśe rājñi vākya iva ṛddhasyetyādiviśeṣaṇānvayo na, tasya padārthaikadeśatvāt | na ca rājapadārthatvaṃ tasyāstyeveti vācmay, viśeṣaṇānvaye viśeṣyasyetarānanvitvenopasthitestantratvenādoṣāt | rājña ityādau tu pṛthagupasthitayoreva prakṛtipratyayārtharanvayena viśeṣaṇānvaye vādhākābhāvāt | etanmūlakaiva 'padārthaḥ padārthenānveti, na tu padārthaikadeśena' iti vyutpattiriti bodhyam | ata eva ca rājñaḥ puruṣo'śvaścetivad rājapuruṣo'śvaśceti na, ekatra viśeṣaṇatvenānvitasyāparatra viśeṣamatvenānvayāyogāt | evaṃ rājñaḥ puruṣo bhāryāyāścetivat ekatra dvayamiti viṣayatāśālibodha janakaṃ rāpuruṣo bhāryāyāśceti na | ekaviśeṣaṇavaiśiṣṭyenaivopasthiteḥ | ata eva rājño yaḥ puruṣaḥ, sa bhāryāyā iti vākyānna tathā bodhaḥ | rājasambandhaviśiṣṭe bhāryāsambandhabodhakaviśiṣṭavaiśiṣṭyaviṣayatāśālirājapuruṣo bhāryāyā iti prayogastu 'rājapuruṣaḥ sundaraḥ' itivadiṣṭa eva | na caivaṃ pradhānasya saviśeṣaṇatvāt tatra vṛttiriti vyavahārādyucchedaḥ, tvadrītyā vṛttau kevalaviśeṣye viṣaṇānvayasyaivābhāvāditi vācyam, sundaratvādeḥ puruṣādimātre viśnāntisattvena tathā vyavahāropapatteḥ | yattu --- bhedaḥ1 [fn bhedo'trānyonyābhāvaḥ | nanu bhedasya vācyatvaṃ rājapadārthasya puruṣe bhedaḥ, puruṣasya, rājaviśiṣṭapuruṣasya vā rājñi bhedaḥ pratīyeta | tatra nādyaḥ pakṣaḥ sambhavati, puruśaviśeṣaṇatāpannasya rājño bhede ekatra viśeṣatvenānvitatavābhāvāt, rājabhedasya rājasambandhipuruṣamātre satvena tadbhedasyāvyāvartakatvācca | na dvitīyaḥ, puruṣatvarūpānvayitāvacchedakāvacchinnapratiyogitākabhedasya rājani bādhitatvāt tatpratiyogitākabhedasyāvyāvartakatvāt, 'rājadhanam' ityādau dhanatvāvacchinnapratiyogitākabhadasya pūrvapadātha sattye'pi tadbodhatyānupayogācca | ata eva na tṛtīye'pi, tadbodhasyānuyogāditi cet, na ; rājasambandhīti bodhenādoṣāt | ] saṃsargaścādivācyaḥ | evañcāpuruṣasvāmibhinnarājasambandhī arājakīyabhinnaḥ puruṣa iti bodha iti, tat, na ; anubhavavirodhāt, gauravācca, rāmakṛṣṇāviti dvandve bhedāvervācyatāyā upapādayitumaśakyatvācca | devadattayajñadattobhayasvāmike gajāśvabhāryādisvāmidevadattasvāmike ca devadattasambandhamātravivakṣāyāṃ devadatta puruṣa ityasyānāpatteśca | yudhiṣṭhirabhāryā draupadītyasyānāpatteśca | etena bheda eva vācyaḥ, 'arājakīyabhinna puruṣaḥ' iti ca bodhaḥ | tathā caitadvirodhādeva rājapuruṣo bhāryāyā iti na prayogaḥ | saṃsargastvanumeya eva | yadvā, saṃsarga eva śakyaḥ, rājasambandhītyeva bodhaḥ | atra pakṣe arājakīyabhedo'numeyaḥ, tathā ca tadvirodhānnātiprasaṅga iti parāstam | bhedasaṃsargayorvyābhicaritatvācca | apṛthagupastitereva ca noddeśyavidheyabhāvenānvayaḥ, pṛthagupasthitestathānvaye tantratvāt | etadevābhipretyāvimṛṣṭavidheyāṃśadauṣanirūpaṇāvasare 'yatroddeśyavideyayoḥ padābhyāṃ pṛthagupasthitiḥ, tatraiva tathānvayaḥ | na ca samāse padāt pṛthagupasthatiḥ, apṛthagupasthitau ca na tathā vyatpattiriti pradhīpakṛtaḥ |' yattu mīmāṃsakāḥ -- uddeśyavidheyayorapi kriyānvayena parasparamananvayādasāmarthyamiti, tat, na; arūṇādikaraṇarītyā kārakamātrasya kriyāyāmanvayena parameṇa kāraṇeṇa kṛtam, paramakārakeṇa kṛtamiti samāsānāpatteḥ | pārṣṇikaparasparānvayakṛtaṃ sāmarthyaṃ tatreti cet, satyaṃ phrakṛte'pi | draṣṭuṃ gataḥ kṛṣṇam, śrito gurukulaṃ rāmaḥ' ityādau ca na samāsaḥ, kṛṣṇaśritayoḥ parasparamasambandhanaikārthībhāvābhavāt | ata eva ca samāsasyārthavattvāt prātipadikatvasiddhiḥ | yattu, rājapedana rāpuruṣobhayopasthānaṃ puruṣapadenāpi tadubhayopastāpanamityekārvībhāvaḥ | rājapuruṣābhinno rājapuruṣa iti bodha iti | tat, na; bodhāvṛttyāpatteḥ, anubhavavirodhācca | idamevābhipretya vākye pṛthagarthatve'pi padānāmākāṅkṣādivaśād viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvena viśiṣṭārthapratītiḥ | vṛttau tu viśiṣṭa evārtho rājapuruṣaśabdābhyāmabhidhīyata iti kaiyatenoktam | nanu viśiṣṭabuddhiṃ prati viśeṣaṇajñānasya hetutvād vinā pṛthakpadārthopasthiti viśiṣṭabuddhyanupapattiriti cet, na ; ghaṭapadād ghaṭatvaviśiṣṭasmaraṇavadupapatteḥ, viśeṣaṇaviṣayakatvenaiva tasya hetutvācca | ata eva viśiṣṭakṛtisākṣātkāropapattiriti spaṣṭamanumānadīvitau | vṛttijanyopasthitestu nāpekṣā, padārthopasthiteḥ smṛtitvāt | nanvidaṃ vṛtterviśiṣṭārthatvam, kiṃ lokavyavahārasiddham, uta śāstraikagamyamiti cet, atra kecit ----- lokavyavahārasiddham | na hyatra śāstre'rthavidhānaṃ kriyate, "acatura" [ 5|4|77 ] ityādi anuśasanaṃ tu cārthe yo varttate, sa dvandva ityevaṃ lokasiddhārthānuvādena dvandavasaṃjñāmātravidhānārtham | arthasyāpi vidhāne vākyabhedaḥ syāt | svasamānārthakavākyasyānivṛttaye vibhāṣādhikāraśca kartavyaḥ syāt | mama tu vṛttyavṛttyoḥ svabhāvasiddhatavānna tadāvaśyakam | kiñca, vṛttilakṣaṇaṃ ca kartavyaṃ syāt, arthatvattvasyāpi śāstraikagamyatvāt | mama tu lokavyavahārādeva tadapi siddham ityāhuḥ | anye tu,
