śaktigrahapadārthopasthitilāghavānurodhād niṣādarūpe tatraiva kalpyate | pareṣāmapi sati tātparye 'yaṣṭīḥ praveśya' itivat lakṣaṇāyā durvāratvāt tātparyameva kalpayakoṭāvavaśiṣyata iti na doṣaḥ | idamevābhipretya --- paryavasyacchābdabodhāvidūraprākkṣaṇasthiteḥ | śaktigrahe'ntaraṅgatvabahiraṅgatvacintanam || itivaiyākaraṇamatonmajjane dīkṣitāḥ | ityajahatsvārthanirūpaṇam <22> atha jahatsvārthanirupaṇam yadvā, avayavaśaktiṃ lakṣaṇāṃ cājānatāṃ bālānāṃ samudāyaśakyaiva bodhasya sarvānubhavasiddhatvena prāguktarītyā cāvaśyakalpyayā tayaiva rājaviśiṣṭapuruṣabodhasaṃbhave rājapuruṣāpadayoḥ punastadbodhakatvaṃ na kalpyam, vṛṣabhādipade vṛṣādivat | ānupūrvyantaraghaṭakatvābhāvaviṣṭānupūrvyā eva śaktatāvacchedakatvāt | anyathā rāmādipadādapi dravyacaturmukhanārāyaṇādīnāmavayavārthānāṃ padārthopasthitiśābdabodhayorāpattiḥ, avāntarasubutpattyāpattiśca, dhanamityādau jastvādyāpattiśca, paṭujātīyāyetyādau sarvanāmatvādyāpattiśca | vākaye tu padānyarthavantyeva |'rājasambandhavān puruṣaḥ' itayādyarthe 'rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ, rājñaḥ' iti viśiṣṭānupūrvīdvayasya śaktatāvacchedakatvakalpanāpekṣayā padaśaktikalpanāyā eva laghīyastvāt | ekārthatvañcaikavattyārthabodhakatvam | cvipratyayastu prāgvadeva | na ca vṛttyantargatānāmarthavattvahānau tannimittakaprātipadikatvāpadatvayorapi hānyāpattiḥ, samāsādiṣu tayorupajīvyatvena tadānīṃ vṛttisvīkārāt, "samartha"sūtraprāmāṇyenopajīvyasyāpyarthasya bādhācca | "sāsya devatā", "karttari kṛt" [ 4|2|24], "cārthedvandvaḥ" [ 3|4|67 ] ityādi tu "laḥ karmaṇi" [ 3|4|69 ] itivat kālpanikārthamādāya | na ca vṛttighaṭakadhātupratipadikādīnāmanarthakatvātteṣāṃ viśiṣṭarapopādānavihita "pathimathi" [ 7|1|85 ] ityātvādyanāpattiḥ, arthavadgrahaṇe'narthakasyāgrahaṇāditi vācyam, "pratyayottarapadayośca" [ 7|2|98 ] ityādisūtrasthabhāṣyādiprāmāṇyena vṛttiprāgvarttyarthāropeṇa śāstrapravṛttyā'kṣateḥ | na caivam 'vāpyaśvaḥ' ityādau "īdūtau ca saptamyarthe" [ 1|1|11 ] iti pragṛhyatvamāśaṅkya jahatsvārthāyāṃ vṛttāvānarthakyād na doṣa iti bhāṣyoktaṃ virudhyeta, āropitārthamādāya itaraśāstravat tasyāpi pravṛttisambhavāditi vācyam, tatrārthagrahaṇasāmarthyenedṛśārthasyāgrahāt ; spaṣṭamasmatkṛtaśabdenduśekhare | yattu, 'arthavadgrahaṇa'paribhāṣā nāstyeva, tajjñāpakaiḥ "ṭiṅḍhāṇaño" [ 4|1|15], " dayāyāsaśca " [ 3|1|37 ] ityādisūtrasthāñ‌ṭhañ‌dayādigrahaṇairviśiṣṭarūpopādā 1[fn atra ".... viśiṣṭarūpopādānādanyatrekadeśabhūtasyaiva ....." iti pāṭhaḥ prakaraṇānukūlaḥ pratibhāti, anyathā arthāṅgatiḥ | ] ne'nyānekadeśabhūtasyaiva grahaṇaṃ jñāpyata iti na doṣa iti, tat, na ; laukikanyāyasiddhyā 'arthavat'paribhāṣāyāḥ pratyākhyātumaśakyatvāt | tvatpakṣe 'prauḍhaghaṭa' ityādau vṛddhyanāpattiśceti, yatkiñcidetat | na ca samāsāt pūrvaṃ padānāmarthavattvam, taduttaramanarthakatvaṃ viruddhamiti vācyam, ekasyaiva maṇeruttejakāsamavadhānasamavadhānābhyāṃ pratibandhikatvāpratibandhakatvavadupapatteḥ | praśnopaniṣaduktamātrābhayasyātharvaśikhoktasārdhamātrātrayasya caramārdhamātrāyāṃ nādabindukalāvikaleti bhedasyānekaśrutipurāṇādyuktasyaivamapyanupapatteḥ | apāsanātvena ca tadvadeva pakṣe rājādipadeḥ sarvathā svārthasya tyāge tadbhānaṃ na syāt, puruṣamātrasyānayanañca sayāt | kiñca, rājapadārthaḥ puruṣe viśeṣaṇamiti ca vyavahāro na syāditi cet, na ; viśiṣṭenaiva rājasambandhipuruṣopasthānonādyadoṣābhāvāt | 1[fn atra 'sumanas' iti śabdo nityabahuvacanāntaḥstrīliṅgaḥ, ata eva 'niṣkīrṇāsu' iti viśeṣaṇaṃ saṅghṭate, uktañcaitat 'striyaḥ sumanasaḥ puṣpam....' ityādi kośāt | (drao nāmaliṅganuśāsanasya dvitīyakāṇḍe vanoṣadhivargaḥ ) | ]niṣkīrṇāsvapi sumanassu āmodānvayamātreṇa campakapuṭa ityādivyavahāravat tatsadṛśārthānvayamātreṇa tathā vyavahāropapatteśca | ayameva ca pakṣo grantheṣu jahatsvārtheti vyavahriyate | yadyapīdaṃ pakṣadvayaṃ prāguktarītyā bhāṣyasammatam, 'ekārthībhāvo vā sāmarthyam, vyapekṣā vā' iti pratīkamupādāya 'pṛthagarthānām' iti ca pratīkamupādāya kaiyaṭena spaṣṭamevoktam "īdūtau ca saptamyarthe" [ 1|1|19 ] ityādisūtreṣu bhāṣye vyavahṛtañca, tathāpi jahatsvārthāpakṣo na yuktaḥ, avayavānāṃ klṛptārthavattvatyāgenāro pitatatsvīkāre gauravāt | kasyacid‌viśiṣṭaśaktigrahād bodhastu nānarthakatvamavayavānāṃ sādhayitumīṣṭe | vākyādapi kasyacit tathābodhena tatrāpyavacavānarthakyāpattau vākye 'pṛthagathau' iti bhāṣyavirodhāpatteḥ, ardhajaratīyāpatteśca | etadevābhipretya haradattenoktam 'jahatsvārthāvṛttiravayavānāṃ nairartharkyamiti vayaṃ na rocayāmahe' iti | boddhṛbhedenedaṃ pakṣadvayaṃ kasyacidavayavaśaktyajñānapūrvakaviśiṣṭaśaktyaiva bodhena kasyacit tajjñānapūrvakameva bodhenobhayorapyāvaśyakatvād iti tattvam | iti jahatsvārthānirūpaṇam ayañcaikārthībhāvaḥ pacatītyādau na, kalpakābhāvāt | ata eva tatra uddeśyavidheyabhāvenānvayaḥ saṅgacchate | taduktaṃ bhāṣye --- 'ekārthībhāve sāmarthye samāsa ekaḥ saṅgṛhītaḥ, vibhaktividhānaṃ parāṅgavadbhāvaścāsaṅgṛhītam' iti | atra samāsapadaṃ1[fn kṛdantādivṛttīnāmirtthaḥ | ekopasthitijanakasamudāśaktirūpattyāśrayatvāt teṣāṃ vṛttitvavyavahāraḥ | 'vigrahavākyabhidhāne śaktaḥ san sādhuḥ' iti sūtrārthasya bhāṣyāllabhāt samāsapadaṃ vṛttimātropalakṣaṇ | padoddeśyakavidhitvañca kṛttaddhitasamāsaikaśeṣasanādyantadhātarūpāsu pañcasvapi vṛttiṣvastyeva | ] vṛttimātropalakṣaṇam | ata eva 'padavidhi' grahaṇaṃ caritārtham | padoddeśyakavidhimātragrahaṇārtha hi tat | śeṣamupariṣṭād vakṣyāmaḥ | ye'pi nityā akhaṇḍā niravayavāḥ sarve śabdāḥ, śāstraṃ tu 2 [fn yathā citre citritasya gavayādilāṅgūlādeḥ sādṛśyena vāstavalāṅgūlādibodhanadvarā vāstavapaśubodhakatvam, tathā prakṛtipratyayādisādṛśyena akhaṇḍapadavākyagataprakṛtipratyayādibodhadvārā vāstavapadavākyabodho bhavati | śāstraṃ tu paricāyakamātram | ] rekhāgavayanyāyena prakṛti pratyayādivibhāgakalpanayānvākyānamātramiti vadanti, teṣāmapi vṛttau pacatītyādivadviśeṣaṇānvayādivāraṇāya vilakṣaṇavyutpattikatvarūpaikārthībhāva āvaśyaka ityalaṃ pallavitena | vyapekṣāvādinastu parasparānvayarūpā vyapekṣaivātra sāmarthyam, 'isusoḥ sāmarthye' [ 8|3|44 ] ityādau tathā klṛptatvāt, parāṅgavadbhāvānurodhācca | anyathā parāṅgavadbhāve etat samāsādāvekārthībhāva iti vākyabhedaḥ syāt, tatra paribhāṣāpravṛttyabhāve tu 'ṛtena mitrāvaruṇāvṛtāvṛdhāvṛtaspṛśa' ityādau ṛtenetyādeḥ "subāmantrite" [ 2|1|2 ] parāṅgavadbhāve "āmantritasya ca [ 6|1|188 ] ityādyudāttatāpattiḥ | mitravaruṇāvityasya sambanodhanaprathamāntatayāmantritasya parasya sattvāt |" na ca 'tannimittagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam' iti vārttikāt, tasyāmantritārthasya yannimittaṃ tatpratipādakaṃ yat, tadeva parāṅgavat syādityarthakād nāyaṃ doṣa iti vācyam, samarthaparibhāṣāmāśritya tatpratayākhyānasyaiva nyāyyatvāt | ṛtena mitrāvaruṇāvityetayorānaśāthe ityarthakenāśāthe ityanenānvayena parasparamasāmarthyāt | mitrāvaruṇāvṛtāvṛdhā ityanayostu pārṇṇikānvayasattvādastyeva sāmarthyam | spaṣṭacedaṃ vedabhāṣyakaustubhayoriti dik | ata eva 'purapaṣo rājñaḥ' 'bhāryā devadattasya' ityatra samāso na | 'ṛddhasya rājapuruṣa' ityapi na, rājapadasya rājasambandhini lakṣaṇayā rājñaḥ padārthokadeśatvena tatra viśeṣaṇānvayāsambhavāt | na ca 'śobhanāyāṃ gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ' ityādau lākṣaṇike liṅgaśobhanādiviśeṣaṇānvayavat prakṛte'pi tadanvayo durvāra iti vācyam, tatrāpi gaṅgāpadasyaiva śobhanaṅgātīre lakṣaṇāyāṃ padantarasya tātparyagrāhakatvāt | na caivamapi 'caitrasya naptā' ityādāvivekadeśā1 [fn yatkiñcit padārthaniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitaviśeṣyatāsambandhena śābdabuddhitvāvacchinnaṃ prati mukhyaviśeṣyatā yatkiñcit padajanyopasthitiḥ kāraṇam, ityetādṛśakāryakāraṇabhāvamūlakena 'padārthaḥ padārthenānveti na tu padārthapadeśena' iti niyamena virodhāditi bhāvaḥ | ] nvayo durvāraḥ, tatra hi naptṛtvaṃ svajanyajanyapuṃstvam, tadekadeśe janyatve caitrasyānvaya iti vācyam, 2 [fn ghaṭatvagotvādau nityapadārthānvayatātparyeṇa 'nityo ghaṭaḥ, nityo gauḥ' ityādeḥ prāmāṇyavāraṇāyoktavyutpattisvīkāre'pi 'devadattasya naptā' ityādau devadattasya nirūpitatvasambandhena gurutvādāvevānvayasyābhimatatayoktakāryakāraṇabhāve abhedasambandhāvacchinnāyāḥ prakāratāyā nityasākāṅkṣetarāvṛttiviseṣyatāyā vā kāryatāvacchedakakoṭau niveśena devadattaniṣṭhaprakāratāyā abhedasambandhāvacchinnatvābhāvena, janyatvasya nityasākāṅkṣatvena vā vyutpatterviṣayatvābhāvād na doṣa iti phalitārthaḥ | ] sasambandhikātirikte tathānaṅgīkārāt | yadvā --- tatrāpi svajanyaputrasambandhena naptaryevānvayaḥ | evaṃ ghaṭādanya ityādāvapi svapratiyogikabhedasaṃsargeṇānyasminnevānvaya iti na doṣaḥ | ata eva 'devadattasya gurukulam' ityādau samāso bhavatyeva | pakṣadvayamapīdaṃ samarthasūtre bhāṣye spaṣṭam | na ca rājasambandha eva lakṣyostu, tasya ca bhedena puruṣe'nvayo'stu, kiṃ sambandhilakṣaṇayeti vācyam ; 'odanaḥ pacati' ityādāvanvayabodhavāraṇāyābhedātiriktasaṃsargakanāmārthakārakaśābdabhode tadvihitapratyajanyopasthiterhetutvāt | pratyayatvañca saṃṅketaviśeṣasambandhena pratayayapadavattvaṃ jātiviśeṣo veti nānanugamaḥ | na caivaṃ rājasambandha ityādau sambandhādipade ṅsapadatvabhramadaśāyāṃ jāyamānasya bhedasambandhena rājādiprakārakasambandhādiviśeṣyakānvayabodhasyānupapattiḥ, vastutaḥ pratyayajanyopasthiterabhāvāt | tathā 'rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ' ityādau ṅasādiṣu sambandhapadatvabhramadaśāyāṃ sambandhādyaṃśe bhedasambadhena rājādiprakārakānvayabādhāpattiriti vācyam, sādhāraṇadharmadarśanābhāvena tathāvidhabhramasyaivābhāvāt | yadi tu astyānubhavikastava tathā bhramaḥ, tadā pratyayabhinnatvenāgṛhītaṃ yat, tajjanyopasthiterhetutvād na doṣaḥ | pratyayatvena gṛhītamititu noktam, 'rājñaḥ paruṣaḥ' ityādau ṣaṣṭhyādeḥ pratyayatvādinā'nupastitidaśāyāmapi tathābodhānubhavādityalaṃ bhrāntavicāreṇa | abhedasaṃsargakatadbodhe ca dātuprātipadikānyatarajanyaivopastitirhetuḥ | 'nīlo ghaṭaḥ' ityādau ca viśeṣaṇavibhaktiḥ sādhutvārthā | tathā ca "anabhihita" sūtre bhāṣyam --- 'kaṭa eva karma, tatsāmānādhikaraṇyādbhīṣmādibhyo dvitīyā' iti | 'bhīṣmādīnāṃ svayamakarmaitve'pi viśeṣyasambandhinyaiva vibhaktyā bhāvyam, tadekayogakṣematvāt' iti kaiyaṭaḥ | ata eva "puraṇaguṇa" [2|2|19] iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaniṣedhaḥ saṅgacchate | na caivam "ghaṭo na paṭaḥ, candra iva mukham" ityādau nañathabhede ivārthasādṛśye ca ghaṭapaṭāderbhedenānvayo na syāt, nañādyarthasya ca paṭādau tathānvayo na syāditi vācyam, bhedānvaye nipātapratyayānyatarajanyopasthitestantratayā'bhedabodhakāryakāraṇabhāve nipātātiriktatvāvaviśeṣaṇadānena cādoṣāt | na ca samāsātiriktvāviśeṣaṇadānād mamāpina doṣaḥ, gauravāpatteḥ, klṛptalakṣaṇāyāṃ sambandhiviṣayakatvakalpanayaiva nirvāhācca | nipātānāṃ dyotakatvanaye ghaṭapadasya ghaṭabhinne, candrapadasya tatsadṛśe lakṣaṇayā tatrākṣateśca | na ca devadatto ghaṭamānayatītyatra sati tātparye devadattaghaṭayorabhedānvayāpattiriti vācyam, viśeṣyatāsambandhenābhedasaṃsargakatannāmārthaprakārakaśābdabodhaṃ prati tannāmottarasārthakavibhaktyupasthityakālikatannāmasamabhivyāhṛtapadajanyopasthiteḥ kāraṇatvādakṣateḥ | ata eva rājñaḥ sutasya ghanamityādau na doṣaḥ | sārthakatvaṃ ca saṅkhyātiriktārthakṛtaṃ vivakṣitam | tena 'vedāḥ pramāṇam' 'śataṃ viprāḥ' ityādau na kṣatiḥ | ādye ekajātīyapramāmatvavyutpādanāya vibhakteḥ prakṛtyarthatāvacchedakagataitvārthakatve, dvitīye samudāyagatatadarthakatve ca nakṣatiḥ | 1[fn atra 'samānavacanatvaṃ samānaliṅgatvañca' iti pāṭhaḥ samīcīnaḥ| yathāśrutapāṭhe casya vaiyarthyaṃ tyāt | ] samānavacanatvasamānaliṅgatve na nābhedānavayabodhe tantram, 'vedāḥ pramāṇam' 'rājñaḥ sutasya dhanam' 'śaityaṃ hi yatsā prakṛtirjalasya' ityādau vyabhicārāt | yadvā, tathā bodhaṃ prati tannāmasamabhivyāhṛtanāmajanyāviruddharūpeṇānupasthitistantram | prakṛtyarthatāvacchedakagataikatvañca vyaktigatabahutvena na viruddhamiti na doṣaḥ | ata eva vyaktigataikatvādyabhiprāyeṇa prayuktānnīlī ghaṭa iti vākyād na tathābodhaḥ | virodhaśca liṅgātiriktakṛto grāhyaḥ | 2[fn atra 'tena' ityataḥ pūrvam 'ata eva' iti 'tena' iti vā pāṭho'pekṣyate | anyathā parasparamasambaddhatvāpattiḥ syāt | ]"tena tulyaṃ kriyā" [ 5|1|115 ] ityādau na doṣaḥ | evañcāsi viśeṣavidhau śiṣṭaprayode ca samānādhikaraṇaviśeṣyabodhakapadayoḥ samānaliṅgasamānavacanavibhaktyantaprayoga eva sādhuḥ, nānya iti bodhyam | nāmajanyopasthitiśca viśeṣyatvāvacchinnaiva grāhyā | ato ghaṭo nitya ityādau lakṣaṇaṃ vinā na ghaṭatve nityābhedānvayaḥ | abhedaścātra tādātmyaṃ svavṛttyasādhāraṇadharmarūpam | etenābhedo bhedatvāvacchinnābāvaścet, aprasiddhaḥ bhedapratiyogikābhāvaścedvavahnyādāvapi dvitvādinā nīlabhedābhāvasya sattvād vahnirnīla ityāderāpattiriti parāstam ityāhuḥ | na ca pratyayāntatannāmārthaprakarākābedātiriktasaṃsargaṃkabodhaṃ prati tadvihitapratyayajanyopasthiterhetutvānna doṣa iti vācyam, 'dadhi bhuktam' ityādau sati tātparye prathamāntadadhipadārthasya bhojane karaṇatvenānvayāpatteḥ | na ca luptapratayayatayedaṃ pratyayāntameva, prakṛte'pi tulyatvāt, gurutarakāryakāraṇābhāvāpekṣayā sambandhini lakṣaṇāyā eva laghutvācca | ataḥ sambandhinyeva laśraṇā nirādīnāñca krāntādyarthe laśraṇāsvīkārānna niṣkauśāmbyādau krāntādīnāṃ pṛthak prayogaḥ, 3[fn 'uktārthānāmaprayogāt' iti niyamāt | ] uktārthatvāt | sā ca nirūḍhalakṣaṇā, niyatatātparyānurodhāt | tena lakṣaṇāyā abhāve tathā prayogāpattiriti nirastam | nanvatra pakṣe samāsasyānārthakyāt prātipadikatvaṃ na syāditi cet, na; arthavatpadasāmarthyenārthavācakaghaṭitasamudāye'narthake'pi tatsvīkārāt | anyathā 'adātuḥ' ityādiparyudāsenārthavattve labdhe spaṣṭameva | ata eva pratyayāntaparyudāsaścaritārthaḥ, 'bahupaṭavaḥ, śaśaśrṛṅgam' ityādau doṣābhāvaśca | pacatakītyādau ca pratyayāntatvānniṣedhaḥ, samāsagrahaṇasya niyamārthatvācca vākye na doṣaḥ | 1[fn 'asati prayojane śakyārthabādhapratisandhānapūrvakatatsambandhaparārthabodhe nirūḍhā lakṣaṇā' yathā 'tvacā jñātam' ityādau tvagādiśabdānāṃ tvagindriye lakṣaṇā | atra lakṣaṇāyāṃ kimapi prayojanaṃ nāsti | paramparevātra pramāṇm | ] 2yattu, sarvatra samāse uttarapade lakṣaṇā prātipadikasaṃjñāpi tasyaiveti | tat, na ; tanmātrasya prātipādikasaṃjñāyāṃ pūrvapadottarasupoluganāpatteḥ, uttarapadamātrasya pratyayāntatvena tadasambhavācceti dik | karmadhāraye tu, avayavaśaktyopaśthāpitapadārthayorabhedasya saṃsargavidhayaiva mānasambhavena śaktiḥ, na vā lakṣaṇā | 'upakumbham' ityādyavyayībhave samīpakumbhādipadānāṃ lakṣaṇā | upādipadaṃ tātparyagrāhakam | ato dhavavantamānayetyādau karmatvādyanvayavāraṇāya klṛptayā 'pratyayānāṃ sannihitapadārthagatasvārthabodhakatva' vyutpattyā virodho na | ata eva pāṇipādamityādisamāhāradvandve'pi uttarapadasya pāṇipādādisamāhāre lakṣaṇā | yattu, samudāye lakṣaṇeti | tat, na ; tasya śaktyabhāvāt | 'śkayasambandho hi lakṣaṇā' | nanu 3jñāpyasambandha eva lakṣaṇā, 'gabhīrāyāṃ nadyāṃ ghoṣaḥ' ityādyanurodhena tasyā evocitatvāt | tathāhi -- na tāvad gabhīrapadaṃ toralakṣakam, nadyāmityananvayāpatteḥ, nahi tīraṃ nadī | ata eva na nadīpade'pi gabhīrapadārthānanvayāptateḥ | na ca padadvaye pratyekam, viśiṣṭanadītīrāprāptiprasaṅgāt | na ca nadīpadena gabhīranadītīraṃ lakṣyate, gabhīrapadaṃ tātparyagrahakamiti vācyam, vinigamanāvirahāt | na ca padadvaye pratyekam, viśiṣṭanadītīrāprāptiprasaṅgāt | na ca nadīpadena gabhīranadītīraṃ lakṣyate, gabhīrapadaṃ tātparyagrahakamiti, vācyam, vinigamanāvirahāt | na ca 'pratyayānāṃ prakṛtyarthānvitasvārthabodhakatva'vyutpattyā nadīpada eva, na gabhīrapade, tadvibhakteḥ sādhutvārthatvāditi vācyam, naiyāyikairabhedārthakatayā mīmāṃsakaiśca 'arūṇādhikaraṇa'nyāyenārthavattvasvīkārāt | gabhīrapade lakṣaṇāyāṃ tasyaiva viśeṣyatvasambhavācca | na ca nadīpadasya dravyavācakatayā sākṣātsambandhāturodhena tatraiva seti vācyam ; gabhīrapadasyāpi nityaguṇivācakatayā tenāpi sākṣāt sambandhasyaiva sattvāt | tasmāddhinigamanāvirahāt padadvayalakṣaṇāyāṃ goravāt lāghavena samudāye eva sāṅgīkāryā | ata evārthavādavākye prāśastyalakṣaṇāhuriti cet, na ; apabhaṃśe'pi lakṣaṇāpatteḥ | tajjñāpyasya sattvāt | kiṃñcaivaṃ pratyekaṃ padaivākyena ca vinigamanāvirahāt padayorvākye ca tadāpattāvatigauravaṃ syāt | api ca, "jñapyasambandhaḥ" ityasya svaniṣṭhajñāpakatānirūpitajñāpyatāvadarthasambandha ityarthaḥ | tatra jñāpakatvaṃ kiṃ vṛtyārthabhodhajanakatvam, utārthabodhajanakajñānaviṣayatvamātram ? nādyaḥ, vākye lakṣaṇānāpatteḥ | nāntyaḥ, pratyekavarṇānāmapyarthavattvāpattau vibhaktyādyutpattyāpatiḥ | api ca evaṃ sati padaghaṭatāpyānupūrvī lakṣakatāvacchedikā vācyetyagigauravam | mama tu vākye tadvirahād na sā tatheti lāghavam | jñāpyasambandhasya lakṣaṇātve etatsambandhijñā kamidamiti jñānajanyopasthitireva lakṣaṇā, janyeti paryavasitam | tathā ca samavāyādinā ghaṭādipadajñāpyā kāśasambandhino'pyupasthitasya śabdabodhaviṣayattirityapi vadanti | tasmāt 'śakyasambandho lakṣaṇā' ityeva yuktam | sā ca na samudāya iti spaṣṭameva | samāhārasya vādanakarmatvādikaṃ tu svāśrayavṛttitvādirūpaparamparayā bodhyam | yadvā, na tatra samāhāraḥ pratīyate, ato na lakṣaṇā | evañca sākṣādeva karmatvam | dvivacanādikaṃ tvanuśāsanesādhutvabodhanād ca | samāhāradvandvādivyavahārastu prāṇyaṅgādidvandave ekavacanavidhānāt samāhāra iva dvandva ekavacananimittatvāditi gauṇo bodhyaḥ | evamitaretarayoge'pi sāhityaviśiṣṭayorlakṣaṇā | ata eva dvivacanādyanvayaḥ | samāhāre tu sāhityaṃ viśeṣyamiti tato bhedaḥ | yadvā, nātrāpi lakṣaṇā, ekasmṛtyupārūḍhapadadvāyāt svasvaśaktyopasthitatayorarthayordvitvādyanvayasambhavāt, ekakriyānvayitvarūpasyaikabuddhyavacchinnatvarūpasya vā 1[fn ekadharmāvacchinnasya ekadharmāvacchinnasaṃsargeṇa ekadharmāvacchinne'nvayaḥ sāhityam | ekadharmaśca samudāyatvarūpaḥ | evañca 'īśvaraṃ guruñca bhajasva' iti prayoge īśvarasya gurośca dhyānasevanarūpavibhinnakriyāyāmanvaye sāhityasyābhāvāt samāsābhāvaḥ | evam 'bhikṣāmaṭa, gāñcānaya' ityādau bhikṣāyāḥ, karmatayā 'aṭa' dhātvarthakriyāyām; gośca karmatayā 'ānayana' kriyāyām anvayena tayoḥ samāsaḥ | ] sāhityasya paścādevāgamena pūrvaṃ lakṣaṇāyā anaucityācca | na ca sāhityābhāne'nyatarasyānyatarakriyānvayavivakṣāyāṃ paśya dhavam, khadiraṃ chindhīti vākyavat paśya dhavakhidirau chindhīti prayogāpattiriti vācyam, dvitvarūpaikadharmāvacchinnasyaikatrānvayasyaivaucityāt | na ca dvitvānvayayogyatāvacchedakasāhityamantareṇa dvitvānvayo durlabha iti vācyam, yogyatāvacchedakopasthiteranapekṣaṇāt, upasthite yogya eva tadanvayaniyamāt | ata eva ghaṭena jalamāharetyādau chidretarasyaiva yogyatābalenānvayaḥ, na tu cchidretaratvaprakārakaśābdabodhaḥ, prakṛtyarthatāvacchedakasyaiva dvitvacchedanādyanvaye yogyatāvacchedakatve kṣatyabhāvācca | nanu saṅkhyāyāmanvayitāvacchedakavyāpyatvaviśiṣṭaparyāptyā prakṛtyarthe'nvayo vācyaḥ, kevalaparyāptyā tadanvaye tu ekavyaktiparākāśādipadādapi dvivacanāpatteḥ, ghaṭākāśādau dvitvādeḥ paryāptisattvena pratyekamākāśādau tadabhavāsya vaktumaśakya2[fn 'na hi pratyekamaparyāptasya samudāye paryāptiḥ' iti niyamāditi bhāvaḥ | ]tvāt, pratyekāvṛtteḥ samudāyāvṛttitvāt | na caivaṃ paryāptyaṅgīkāra eva vyarthaḥ, anvayitāvacchedakavyāpyatvaviśiṣṭasamavāyasyaiva sambandhatve kṣatyabhāvāditi vācyam, samāvāyasyaikatvanaye ghaṭaniṣṭhadvitvādisamavāyasya paṭādāvapi sattvād ghaṭatvāvyāpyatvena ghaṭāvityādiprayogāṇāmaprāmāṇyāpatteḥ | tasya nānātve tu tādṛśvayāpyatvaviśiṣṭatattatsambandha eva paryāptirastu | caivamapi ghaṭadvayavṛttidvitvasya ghaṭatvavyāpyaparyāptisambandhenaikaghaṭe'pi sattvenaikaghaṭābhiprāyeṇāpi ghaṭāviti prayogāpattiriti vācyam, vyāsajyavṛttidharmodhakapadasamabhivyāhārasyānvayitāvacchedakāvacchinnayāvatsvāśrayānvayisvārthaṃbodhakāraṇatayā doṣā'bhāvāt | na ca tatsamabhivyāhārasya yāvatsvāśrayānvayisvārthabodhakatvamevāṅgīkriyatām, kiṃ vyāpyatvaniveśena, kiñca paryāptyeti vācyam, ākāśāvatreti vākyat yogyatābramaśāyāmekavyaktimātraviṣayadvitvādyanvayabodhena tathā kāryakāraṇabhāvasya kalpayitumaśakyatvād dvitvāderekatvavādimate'sambhavācc | evañca dhavakhadisau chindhītyādau sāhityabhānamāvaśyakam | anyathānvayitāvacchedakadhavatvakhadiratvādivyāpyadvitvādidvayapratītyāpatteḥ | tathā caikaikadhavakhadirāditātparyeṇa tathāprayogānupapattiriti cet, na ; yatraikadharmasyānvayitāvacchedakatā, tatraiva tādṛśaparyāpateḥ saṃsargatāniyamaḥ | yatra tvanekadharmasyaiva tathātvam, tatra kevalaparvāptestathā | samavāyasyaiva vā tattvābhyupagamād na doṣaḥ | eṣaiva ca puṣpavantādipade gatiḥ, nahi tatra sāhityabhāne mānamasti | kiñcaivamanaṅgīkāre sāhityabānāṅgīkāre'pi anupapattitādavasthyameva | tathāhi -- sāhityānvaye pratyakadharmāyorevānvayitāvacchedakatayā tattadvyāpyasāhityadvayabodhāpattiḥ | tasmāt prāguktarīritireva śaraṇam | na caivaṃ 'kṣaume vasānāvagnimādadhīyatām' ityādau samuccityoranvayalābho na syāditi vācyam, 'yatkartavyam, tadanayā saha' iti vākyāt tatsiddheḥ | yadyapi dvandve parasparānvayarūpavyapekṣāsāyarthyaṃ nāsti, tathāpi "cārthe dvanadvaḥ" [ 2|2|29 ] iti vidhisāmarthyāt samāsaḥ | samuccayānvācayayostvanabhidhānāt samāso neti spaṣṭaṃ bhāṣye | yattvekasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ karmatvādyekarupeṇānvayitvaṃ sāmarthyam, 'kṛtaḥ sarvomṛttikayā' ityādivāraṇāyaikarūpeṇeti | tat, na; samarthasūtre vākyabhedāpatteḥ | na caivaṃ vibhaktyarthānanvayaḥ pratyayānāṃ prakṛtyarthanvayitvavyutpatteḥ | atra ca yā prakṛtiḥ, na tadarthau dhavakhadirau, yadarthau ca tau, tayorna prakṛtitvamiti vācyam, pratyayānāṃ sannihitārthabodhakatvavyutpattervāṅgīkārāt | sannidhānañ cānuśāsanikam | tathā ca yaduttaraṃ yaḥ pratyayo'nuśiṣṭaḥ, sa tdaghaṭakārthagatasvārthabodhaka ityarthaḥ | atra ca padasamudāyād vibhaktiranuśiṣṭā | tatra kvacit pūrvapadārthe, kvaciduttarapadārthe, kvacidubhayatretyatra yogyatādikaṃ niyāmakamiti 'ardhapippalīm, rājapuruṣaṃ paśya' ityādau na doṣaḥ | evaṃ citragurityādibahuvrīhāvapi anyapadārthe uttarapadasyaiva lakṣaṇā | na ca gopadena gosvāmilakṣaṇāyāṃ tatra citrānvayo na syāt, 1[fn 'padārthaḥ padārthenānvete, na tu padārthaikadeśena' iti vyutpattiriti bhāvaḥ | ]padārthekadeśatvāditi vācyam, śakyārthayonvabodhottaraṃ lakṣaṇābhyupagamāt | citrapadasya tātparyagrāhakatayā gaupadenaiva citragosvāmi2[fn 'citragosvāmino lakṣaṇīyatvādvā' iti pāṭhaḥ samīcīnaḥ pratibhāti | ]lakṣaṇādvā na doṣaḥ | vyutpattinaicitryādekadeśenāpyanvayo'tra ityanye | gopadena śakyā gauḥ, lakṣaṇayā svāmī, ekapadārthayorapi parasparānvayo vyutpattivaicitryādityapare . evañca na kvāpi viśiṣṭaśakteḥ, ekārthībhāvasya vā āvaśyakatvam | etadevābhipretya bhagavatā bhāṣyakāreṇoktam, 'parasparavyapekṣāṃ sāmarthyameke icchanti' iti vadanti | ayameva ca pakṣo naiyāyikādisammataḥ || atra vadanti ----- paṅkajaśabdādāvapi pratyayādeḥ padmātvaviśiṣṭe nirūḍhalakṣamayaivopapattau rūḍhiśaktyucchedāpattiḥ, avayavamavaśaktiñcājānato'pi bodhāt, bādhācca, niyatatātparyānurodhācca, prāmāṇikānāṃ śaktivyavahārācca, sā sidhyatīti cet, samaṃ prakṛte'pi | kiñca 'kaṇṭhe kālaḥ' 'dāsyāḥ putraḥ' ityādau lakṣaṇāyāṃ mānābhāvena sundare ityādiviśeṣaṇānvayāpattidurvārā, na ca tatrāpi dāsīpadasya dāsīsambandhini lakṣaṇā, dāsīsambandhisambandhīti bodhāpatteḥ | ṣaṣṭhyantasya lakṣaṇā tu durupapādā, śakyabhāvāt | ṣaṣṭhyāḥ sambandhini lakṣaṇāyāmapi dāsīpadārthasyaikadeśatvaṃ durupapādam | api ca 'puruṣo rājasambandhī' 'bhāryāsambandhī ca ' itivad rājapuruṣo bhāryāsambandhītyasya rājasambandhī paruṣo'śvaścetivad rājapuruṣo'śvaścetyasya cāpattiḥ | samāse bhinnaiva vyutpattiriti cet, siddha ekārthībhāvaḥ | api ca kamaṇḍalupāṇiṃ chātramadrākṣīdityatra kamaṇḍaluśabdāt "itthambhūtalakṣaṇe" [ 2|3|21 ] iti tṛtīyāpattiḥ, na ca "supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ" [ 2|4|71 ] iti luk, samāsottaraṃ jāyamānatvena prātipadikānavayavatvāt, 'tanmadhyapatita'nyāyāt tadgrahaṇena grahaṇe'pi tadavayatve mānābhāvāt, 'lakṣyelakṣaṇasya' iti nyāyācceti spaṣṭam "itthambhūtalakṣaṇe" sūtre bhāṣyakaiyaṭayoḥ | api ca kṛttaddhitasamāsādisādhāraṇa1[fn kṛttaddhitaikaśeṣasanādyantadhāturūpapacavṛttayanyatamatvarūpavṛttitvalakṣaṇasyetyarthaḥ | ] vṛttilakṣaṇasya tvanmate durvacatvam, pūravoktasāmarthyavat samudāyatvasya vākye'ti prasaktatvāt | 2[fn tadabhinnabhinnatvamanyatamatvam | evañca bhedapratiyogitayā nikhilasya vastujātasya praveśād gauravamiti bhāvaḥ | ]anyatamatvasya gurutaratvācca | mama tu ekārthībhāvavat samudāyatvaṃ suvacameva | kiñca, samānārthakavākyasyānivṛttaye vā vacanārambhe tava gauravam | na ca lakṣamayā prayoge samāsaḥ, anyathā vākyamiti vyasthāyāḥ sambhavāt mamāpi tadanāvaśyakam karmadhāraye lakṣaṇāyā abhāvāt | mama tvekārthībhāve vṛttiḥ, anyathā vākyamiti nyāyasiddhārthakathanaṃ tat | api ca, 'vāpyaśvaḥ' ityādau pragṛhyatvāpattiḥ | na cātra vāpīpadasya nadadhikaraṇake lakṣamāsattvena saptamyarthamātraparyavasannatvābhāva iti na doṣa iti vācyam, 'somo gaurī adhiśritaḥ' ityādāvapyanāpatteḥ | tatrāpi vibhaktilukaḥ sattvena nāmārthayoranvayānurodhād gaurīpadasya gauryadhikaraṇake lakṣaṇāyāstulyatvāt | mama tu na doṣaḥ, itarāsaṃsṛṣṭatvenopasthitijanakatvarūpasaptamyarthamātraparyavasannatvābhāvāt | idamevābhipretya 'anahatsvārthāyāñca na doṣaḥ samudāyārtho'bhidhīyate' iti bhāṣye uktam | etena jahatsvārthataivaikārthībhāvaḥ, ajahatsvārthā ca vyapekṣaiva, "īdūtau" [1|1|19 ] iti sūtrasthamidaṃ bhāṣyañca vyapekṣāvāda evetyapāstam | api ca, ṛddhasya devasya puruṣaḥ' vākyavat karmadhārayaghaṭitaṛddhadevasya puruṣa ityāderviśiṣṭasya vaiśiṣṭyamiti viṣayatāvaśālibodha iva viśeṣye viśeṣaṇam | tatra ca viśeṣaṇāntaramiti viṣayatāśālībodha'pi sādhutvāpattiḥ | mama tu na doṣaḥ, ṛddhanakārthībhūtasya tadvāśiṣṭayenevatāranvayāt | kiñca, samudāyasyārthavatvābhāvāt prātipadikasañjñā durūpapādā | prāguktaprakārāśrayeṇa 1tūttarasūtre tadantavidhilābhona syāt | mama tvarthavatpadānuvṛttisāmarthyāt tallābha itispaṣṭamākare | tava tu, tadanuvṛttāvapi kṛttaddhitayorevārthavatvena viparīto doṣa eva syāt | kiñca, 'pūrvaśālapriyaḥ' ityādighaṭakapūrvaśālāśabde prātipadikatvāpattiḥ | parāṅgavadbhāve tu na doṣaḥ, tannimittagrahaṇādeva ṛtenetyādeḥ parāṅgavadbhāvavāraṇāt | mitrāvaruṇāvitayādestu chāndasatvāt sa bodhyaḥ | yadvā, ṛtakarmakardhanakartṛtvāt tayostannimittatvamapyastyeva | ata eva "subāmantrita" [2|9.2 ] iti sūtre 'subiti kimartham ? karoṣyaṭayana | naitadasti | asāmarthyādatra na bhaviṣyati | naiṣa doṣaḥ | 'samānādhikaraṇamasarthavat' ityasya 'adhātvabhihitam' ityevaṃ niṣedhāt' ityuktvā ṣaṣṭhyantamamantritārthaṃ prati yatkārakañca, tadeva pārāṅgavaddhavatītyarthakam 'ṣaṣṭhyāmantritakārakavacanaṃ vā kartavyam' tannimittagrahaṇaṃ vā kāryam | 'madrāṇāṃ rājan, paraśunā vṛśyan' ityatraiva yathā syāt, kṣatreṇāgne svāyuḥ saṃrabhasva, mitreṇāgne mitradheye yatasva' ityādau 'kṣatreṇa mitreṇa' ityanayormā bhūd' iti bhāṣyoktaṃ saṅgacchate, samarthaparibhāṣopasthāne hi asāmathryād evāprāptau bhāṣyāsaṅgatiḥ spaṣṭaiva || yattu ; kaiyaṭena kṣatreṇetyādau 2'kriyādvārakaṃ vyapekṣālakṣaṇaṃ sāmarthyamasti' ityuktam | tat, na; vyapekṣāvāde 'kṛtaḥ sarvo mṛttikyā' ityādau samāsāpatteḥ | evañca bho devadatta, bhago devadatta' ityādau bhośabdādeḥ parāṅgatvaṃ na bhavatyeva | yadyapi bhāṣye vacanadvayamārabdham, tathāpi tannimittagrahaṇameva jyāyaḥ, 'goṣu svāmin' ityatrāpi parāṅgavadbhavāsiddheḥ | ata eva 'vastraṃ rājñaḥ puruṣāgaccha' ityādau na parāṅgavattvam | vedabhāṣyaṃ tu phaṇibhāṣyavirodhādanādeyameveti dik | karmadhāraye tu, avayavaśaktyopastāpitapadārthayorabhedasya saṃsargavidhayaiva mānasambhavena na śaktiḥ, na vā lakṣaṇā | 'upakumbham' ityādyavyayībhāve samūpakumbhādipadānāṃ lakṣaṇā | upādipadaṃ tātparyagrāhakam | ato dhavavantamānayetyādau karmatvādyanvayavāraṇāya klṛptayā 'pratyayānāṃ sannihitapadārthagatasvārthabodhakatva'vyutpattyā virodho na | ata eva pāṇipādamitayādisamāhāradvandve'pi uttarapadasya pāṇipādādisamāhāre lakṣaṇā | yattu, samudāye lakṣaṇeti | tat, na; tasya śaktyabhāvāt | 'śakyasambandho hi lakṣaṇā' | nanu 3[fn mīmāṃsakamatamupasthāpya nirākaroti 'nanu' ityādinā | ] 'jñāpyasambandha eva lakṣaṇā, 'gabhīrāyāṃ nadyāṃ ghoṣaḥ' ityādyanurodhena tasyā evocitatvāt | tathāhi -- na tāvad gabhīrapadaṃ toralakṣakam, nadyāmityananvayāpteḥ, nahi tīraṃ nadī | ata eva na nadīpade'pi gabhīrapadītīraṃ lakṣyate, gabhīrapadaṃ lakṣaṇāyāṃ tasyaiva viśeṣyatvasambhavācca | na ca nadīpadasya dravyavācakatayā sājñātsambandhānuradhena tatraiva seti vācyam ; gabhīrapadasyāpi nityaguṇivācakatayā tenāpi sākṣāt sambandhasyaiva sattvāt | tasmādvinigamanāvirahāt padadvayalakṣaṇāyāṃ gauravāt lāghavena sudāye eva sāṅgīkāryā | ata evārthavādavākye prāśastyalakṣaṇāmāhuriti cet na ; apabhraṃśe'pi lakṣaṇāpatteḥ | tajjñāpyasya sattvavāt | kiñcaivaṃ pratyekaṃ padairvākyena ca vinigamanāvirahāt padayorvākye ca tadāpattāvatigauravaṃ syāt | api ca, 'jñāpyasambandhaḥ' ityasya svaniṣṭhajñāpakatānirūpitajñāpyatāvadarthasambandha ityarthaḥ | tatra jñāpakatvaṃ kiṃ vṛttyārthabodhajanakatvam, uttārthabodhajanakajñānaviṣayatvamātram ? nādyaḥ, vākye lakṣaṇānāpatteḥ | nāntyaḥ, pratyekavarṇānāmapyarthavattvāpattau vibhakyādyutpattyāpattiḥ | api ca evaṃ sati padaghaṭitāpyānupūrvī lakṣakatāvacchedikā vācyetyatigauravam | mama tu vākye tadvirahād na sā tatheti lāghavam | jñāpyasambandhasya lakṣaṇātve etatsambandhijñā kamidamiti jñānajyopasthitireva lakṣaṇā, janyeti paryavasitam | tathā ca samavāyādinā ghaṭādipadajñāpyākāśasambandhino'pyupasthitasya śabdabodhaviṣayatāpattirityapi vadanti | tasmāt 'śakyasambandho lakṣaṇā' ityeva yuktam | sā ca na samudāya iti spaṣṭameva | samāhārasya vādanakarmatvādikaṃ tu svāśrayavṛttitvādirūpaparamparayā bodhyam | yadvā, na tatra samāhāraḥ pratīyate, ato na lakṣaṇā | evañca sākṣādeva karmatvam | dvivacanādikaṃ tvanuśāsanenāsādhutvabodhanād na | samāhāradvandvādivyavahārastu prāṇyaṅagādidvandve ekavacanavidhānāt samāhāra iva dvandva ekavacananimittatvāditi gauṇo bodhyaḥ | evamitaretarayoge'pi sāhityaviśiṣṭhorlakṣaṇā | ata eva dvivacanādyanvayaḥ | samāhāre tu sāhityaṃ viśeṣyamiti tato bhedaḥ | yadvā, nātrāpi lakṣaṇā, ekasmṛtyupārūḍhapadadvayāt svasvaśaktyopasthitayorarthayordvitvādyanvayasambhavāt, ekakriyānvayitvayitvarūpasyaikabuddhyāvacchinnatvarūpasya vā 1[fn ekadharmāvacchinnasya ekadharmāvacchinnasaṃsargeṇa ekadharmāvacchinne'nvayaḥ sāhityam | ekadharmaśca samudāyatvarūpaḥ | evañca 'īśvaraṃ guruñca bhajasva' iti payoge īśvarasya gurośca dhyānasevanarūpavibhinnakriyāyāmanvaye sāhityasyābhāvāt samāsābhāvaḥ | ] sāhityasya paścādevāgamena pūrvaṃ lakṣaṇāyā anaucityācca | na ca sāhityābhāne'nyatarasyānyatarakriyānvayavivakṣāyāṃ paśya dhavam, khadiraṃ chindhīti vākyavat paśya dhavakhadirau chindhīti prayogāpattiriti vācyam, dvitvarūpaikadharmavacchinnasyaikatrānvayasyaivaucityāt | na ca dvitvānvayayogyatāvacchedakasāhityamantarema dvitvānvayo durlabha iti vācyam, yogyatāvacchedakopasthiteranapekṣaṇāt, upasthite yogya eva tadanvayaniyamāt | ata eva ghaṭena jalamāharetyādau chidretarasyaiva yogyatāvabalenānvayaḥ, na tu ekavyaktiparākāśādipadādapi dvivacanāpatteḥ, ghaṭākāśādau dvitvādeḥ paryāptisattvena pratyekamākāśādau tadabhāvasya vaktumaśakya2[fn 'na hi pratyekamaparyāptasya samudāye paryāptiḥ' iti niyamāditi bhāvaḥ | ]tvāt, pratyekāvṛtteḥ samudāyāvṛttitvāt | na caivameko na dvāvityato bodhānupapattiḥ ; ekasminnapi kevalaparyāpteḥ sattvena kevalaparyāptisambandhāvacchinnapratiyogitāvacchedakatākabhedasya bodhayitumaśakyatvāt, ekatvavyāpyaparyāptisambandhāvacchinnapratiyogitāvacchedakatākabhedaścāprasiddhā eveti vācyam, dvitvādiparyāpterubhāyādivṛttidharmāvacchedyatvaniyamena tadanavacchedakaikamātravṛttidharmāvacchedena tadvadbhedasya tadvati vṛttau bādhakābhāvāt | na caivaṃ paryāptyaṅgīkāra eva vyarthaḥ, anvayitāvacchedakavyāpyatvaviśiṣṭasamāvāyasyaiva sambandhatve kṣatyabhāvāditi vācyam, samavāyasyaikatvanaye ghaṭaniṣṭhadvitvādisamavāyasya paṭādāvapi sattvād ghaṭatvāvyāpyatvena ghaṭāvityādiphrayogāṇāmaprāmāṇyāpatteḥ | tasya nānātve tu tādṛśavyāpyatvaviśiṣṭatattatsambandha eva paryāptirastu | na caivamapi ghaṭadvayavṛttidvitvasya ghaṭatvāvyāpyaryāptisambandhenaikaghaṭe'pi sattvanaikaghaṭābhiprāyeṇāpi ghaṭāviti prayogāpattiriti vācyam, vyāsajyavṛttidharmabodhakapadasamabhivyāhārasyānvayitāvacchedakāvaccinnayāvatsvāśrayānvayisvārthabodhakāraṇatayā doṣā'bhāvāt | na ca tatsamabhivyāhārasya yāvatsvāśrayānvayisvārthabodhakatvamevāṅgīkriyātām, kiṃ vyāpyatvaniveśena, kiñca paryāptyeti vācyam, ākāśāvatreti vākyāt yogyatābhramadaśāyāmekavyaktimātraviṣayadvitvādyanvayabodhena tathā kāryakāraṇabhāvasya kalpayitumaśakyatvād dvitvāderekatvavādimate'sambhavācca | evañca dhavakhadirau chindhītyādau sāhityabhānamāvaśyakam | anyathānvayitāvacchedakadhavatvakhadiratvādivyāpyadvitvādidvayapratītyāpatteḥ | tathā caikekadhavakhadirāditātparyema tathāprayogānupapattiriti cet, na; yatraikadharmasyānvayitāvacchedakatā, tatraiva tādṛśaparyāpteḥ saṃsargatāniyamaḥ | yatra tvanekadharmasyaiva tathātvam, tatra kevalapardhāptestathā | samavāyasyaiva vā tattvābhyupagamād na doṣaḥ | eṣaiva ca puṣpavantādipade gatiḥ, nahi tatra sāhityabhāne mānamasti | kiñcaivamanaṅgīkāre sāhityabhānārghīkāre'pi anupapattitādavasthyameva | tathāhi --- sāhityānvaye pratyekadharmayorevānvayitāvacchedakatayā tattadvyāpyasāhityadvayabodhāpattiḥ | tasmāt prāguktarītireva śaraṇam | na caivam 'kṣaume vasānāvagnimādadhīyatām' ityādau samuccitayoranvayalābho na syāditi vācyam, 'yatkartavyam, tadanayā saha' iti vākyāt tatsaddheḥ | yadyapi dvandve parasparānvayarūpavyapekṣāsāyarthyaṃ nāsti, tathāpi "cārthe dvandvaḥ" [ 2|2|29 ] iti vidhisāmarthyāt samāsaḥ | samuccayānvācayayostvanabhidhānāt samāso neti spaṣṭaṃ bhāṣye | yattvekasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ karmatvādyekarūpeṇānvayitvaṃ sāmarthyam, 'kṛtaḥ sarvomṛttikayā' ityādivāraṇāyaikarūpeṇeti | tat, na; samarthasūtre vākyabhedāpatteḥ | na caivaṃ vibhaktyarthānanvayaḥ pratyayānāṃ prakṛtyarthānvayitvavyutpatteḥ | atra ca yā prakṛtiḥ, na tadarthau dhavakhadirau, yadarthau ca tau, tayorna prakṛtitvamiti vācyam, pratyayānāṃ sannihitārthabodhaktavavyutpatterevāṅgīkārāt | sannidhānañ cānuśāsanikam | tathā ca yaduttaraṃ yaḥ pratyayo'nuśiṣṭaḥ, sa tadghaṭakārthagatasvārthabodhaka ityarthaḥ | atra ca padasamudāyād vibhaktiranuśiṣṭā | tatra kvacit pūrvapadārthe, kvaciduttarapadārthe, kvacidubhayatretyatra yogyatādikaṃ niyāmakamiti 'ardhapippalīm, rājapuruṣaṃ paśya' ityādauna doṣaḥ | evaṃ citragurityādibahuvrīhāvapi anyapadārthe uttarapadasyaiva lakṣaṇā | na ca gopadena gosvāmilakṣaṇāyāṃ tatra citrānvayo na syāt, 1[Fn 'padārthaḥ padārthenānveti, na tu padārthaikadeśena' iti vyutpattiriti bhāvaḥ | ] padārthaikadeśatvāditi vācyam, śakyārthayoranvayabodhottaraṃ lakṣaṇābhayupagamāt | citrapadasya tātparyagrāhakatayā gopadenaiva citragosvāmi2[fn 'citragosvāmino lakṣaṇīyatvād‌vā' iti pāṭhaḥ samīcīnaḥ pratibhāti | ] lakṣaṇādvā na doṣaḥ | vyutpattivaicitryādekadeśenāpyanvayo'tra ityanye | gopadena śakyā gauḥ, lakṣaṇayā svāmī, ekapadārthayorapi parasparānvayo vyutpattivaicitryādityapare| evañca na kvāpi viśiṣṭaśakteḥ, ekārthībhāvasya vā āvaśyakatvam | etadevābhipretya bhagavatā bhāṣyakāreṇoktam 'parasparavyapekṣāṃ sāmarthyameke icchanti' iti vadanti | ayameva ca pakṣo naiyāyikādisammataḥ || atra vadanti --- paṅkajaśabdādāvapi pratyayādeḥ padmatvaviśiṣṭe nirūḍhalakṣaṇayaivopapattau rūḍhiśakyyucchedāpattiḥ, avayavamavayavaśaktiñcājānato'pi bodhāt, bādhādipratisandhānaṃ vināpi bodhācca, niyatatātparyānurodhācca, prāmāṇikānāṃ śaktivyavahārācca, sā sidhyatīti cet, samaṃ prakṛte'pi | kiñca 'kaṇṭhe kālaḥ' 'dāsyāḥ putraḥ' ityādau lakṣaṇāyāṃ mānābhāvena sundare ityādiviśeṣaṇānvayāpattidurvārā, na ca tatrāpi dāsīpadasya dāsīsambandhini lakṣaṇā, dāsīsambandhīti bodhāpatteḥ | ṣaṣṭhyāntasya lakṣaṇā tu durupapādā, śaktyābhāvāt | ṣaṣṭhyāḥ sambandhini lakṣaṇāyaumapi dāsīpadārthasyaikadeśatvaṃ durupapādam | api ca 'paruṣo rājasambandhī' 'bhāryāsambandhī ca' itivad rājapuruṣo bhāryāsambandhītyasya rājasambandhī paruṣo'śvaścetivad rājapuruṣo'śvcetyasya cāpattiḥ | samāse bhinnaiva vyutpattiriti cet, siddha ekārthībhāvaḥ | api ca kamaṇḍalupārṇiṃ chātramadrākṣīdityatra kamaṇḍaluśabdāt "itthambhūtalakṣaṇe" [ 2|3|21 ] iti tṛtīyāpattiḥ, na ca "supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ" [2|4|71 ] iti luk, samāsottaraṃ jāyamānatvena prātipadikānavayavatvāt, 'tanmadhyapatati'nyāyāt tadgrahaṇena grahaṇe'pi tadavayatve mānābhāvāt, 'lakṣye lakṣaṇasya' iti nyāyācceti spaṣṭam "ityumbhūtalakṣaṇe" sūtre bhāṣyakaiyaṭayoḥ | api ca kṛttaddhitasamāsādisādhāraṇa1[fn kṛttaddhitaikaśeṣasanādyantadhāturūpapañcavṛttyanyatamatvarūpavṛttitvalakṣaṇasyetyarthaḥ | ] vṛttilakṣaṇasya tvanmate durvacatvam, pūrvoktasāmarthyavat samudāyatvasya vākye'ti prasaktatvāt | 2[fn tadabhinnabhinnatvamanyatamatvam | evañca bhedapratiyogitayā nikhilasya vastujātasya praveśād gauravamiti bhāvaḥ | ]nyatamatvasya gurutaratvācca | mama tu ekārthībhāvavat sudāyatvaṃ suvacameva | kiñca, samānārthakavākyasyānivṛttaye vā vacanārambhe tava gauravam | na ca lakṣaṇayā prayoge samāsaḥ, anyathā vākyamiti vyavasthāyāḥ sambhavāt mamāpi tadanāvaśyakam, karmadhāraye lakṣaṇāyā abhāvāt | mama tvekārthībhāve vṛttiḥ, anyathā vākyamiti nyāyasiddhārthakathanaṃ tat | api ca, 'vāpyaśvaḥ' ityādau pragṛhyatvāpattiḥ | na cātra vāpīpadasya tadadhikaraṇake lakṣaṇāsattvena saptamyarthamātraparyavasannatvābhāva iti na doṣa iti vācyam, 'somo gaurī adhiśritaḥ' ityādāvapyanāpatteḥ | tatrāpi vibhiktilukaḥ sattvena nāmārthayoranvayānurodhād gaurīpadasya gauryadhikaraṇake lakṣaṇāyāstulyatvāt | mama tu na doṣaḥ, itarāsaṃsṛṣṭatvenopasthitijanaktavarūpasaptamyarthamātraparyavasannatvābhāvāt | idamevābhipretya'ajahatsvārthāyāñca na doṣaḥ samudāyārtho'bhidhīyate' iti bhāṣye uktam | etena jahatsvārthataivaikārthībhāvaḥ, ajahatsvārthā ca vyapekṣaiva, "īdūtau" [ 1|1|19 ] iti sūtrasthamidaṃ bhāṣyañca vyapekṣāvād evetyapāstam | api ca, 'ṛddhasya devasya puruṣaḥ' iti vākyavat karmadhārayaghaṭitaṛddhadevasya puruṣa ityāderviśiṣṭasya vaiśiṣṭyamiti viṣayatāśālidoṣa iva viśeṣye viśeṣaṇam | tatra ca viśeṣaṇāntaramiti viṣayatāśālabīdhe'pi sādhutvāpattiḥ | mama tu na doṣaḥ, ṛddhanakārthībhūtasya taddhaiśiṣṭyenanaivatarānvayāt | kiñca, samudāyasyārthavattvābhāvāt prātipadikasañjñā durupapādā | prāguktaprakārāśrayeṇa 1[fn "kṛttaddhitasamāsāśca" iti sūtra ityarthaḥ | ] tūttarasūtre tadantavidhilābho na syāt | mama tvarthavatpadānuvṛttisāmarthyāt tallābha iti spaṣṭamākare | tava tu, tadanuvṛttāvapi kṛttaddhitayorevārthavattvena viparīto doṣa eva syāt | kiñca, 'pūrvaśālāpriyaḥ' ityādighaṭapūrvaśālāśabde prātipadikatvāpattiḥ | parāṅgavadbhāve tu na doṣaḥ, tannimittagrahamādeva ṛtenatyādeḥ parāṅgavadbhāvavāraṇāt | mitrāvarūṇāvityādestu chāndasatvāt sa bodhyaḥ | yadvā, ṛtakarmakavardhanakartṛtvāt tayostannimittatvamapyastyeva | ata eva "subāmantrita" [ 2|9|2 ] iti sūtre 'subiti kimartham ? karoṣyaṭayana | naitadasti | asāmarthyādatra na bhaviṣyati | naiṣa doṣaḥ| 'samānādhikaraṇamasamarthavat' ityasya 'adhātvabhihitam' ityevaṃ niṣedhāt' ityuktvā ṣaṣṭhyantamāmantritārthaṃ prati yatkārakañca, tadeva pārāṅgavadbhavatītyarthakam 'ṣaṣṭhyāmantritakārakavacanaṃ vā kartavyam' tannimittagrahaṇaṃ vā kāryam | 'madrāṇāṃ rājan, paraśunā vṛśyan' ityatraiva yathā syāt, kṣatreṇāgne svāyuḥ saṃrabhasva, mitreṇāgne mitradheye yatasva' ityādau 'kṣatreṇa mitreṇa' ityanayormā bhūd' iti bhāṣyoktaṃ saṅgacchate, samarthaparibhāṣopasthāne hi asāmarthyād evāprāptau bhāṣyāsaṅgatiḥ spaṣṭaiva || yattu ; kaiyaṭena kṣatreṇetyādau 2[fn 'kriyādvārakaṃ tu vyapekṣālakṣaṇaṃ sāmarthyamastīīti syāt parāṅgavadbhāvaḥ | iha vacanenātiprasaṅge niraste pūrvasūtra ekārthībhāva eva sāmarthyamāśritam | anyathā tu dvividhamapi sāmarthyamāśrīyeta' ityevamānupūrvokaḥ kaiyacagranthaḥ | ] 'kriyādvārakaṃ vyapekṣālakṣaṇaṃ sāmarthyamasti' ityuktam | tat, na ; vyapekṣāvāde 'kṛtaḥ sarvo mṛttikyā' ityādau samāsāpatteḥ | evañca bho devadatta, bhago devadatta' ityādau bhośabdādeḥ parāṅgatvaṃ na bhavatyeva | yadyapi bhāṣye vacanadvayamārabdham, tathāpi tannimittagrahaṇameva jyāyaḥ,'goṣu svāmin' ityatrāpi parāṅgavadbhāvāsiddheḥ | ata eva 'vastraṃ rājñaḥ puruṣāgaccha' ityādau na parāṅgavattvam | vedabhāṣyaṃ tu phaṇibhāṣyavirodhādanādeyameveti dik | yattu, 'rājapuruḥ' ityādau pūrvapade sambandhini lakṣaṇāsvīkāre karmadhārayatvāpattiḥ, samānādhikaraṇatatpuruṣatvasyaiva tattvāt | na ca samāsapūrvadaśāyāṃ yatrābhedānvayaḥ, tatra karmadhārayaḥ, yatra bhedena, tatra tatpuruṣamātramiti vācyam, nityasamāse vigrahaśūnyatvena tādṛśatatpuruṣakarmadhārayayoravyāpteḥ, alaukikavigrahasya sattve'pi tasyānvayabodhe svarūpāyogyatvāt | na ca samāsātpūrvaṃ yatra tulyavibhaktitvam, tatraiva karmadhārayatvam, nānyatreti vācyam, pūrvāvasthāyā asamāsārthavivakṣānusāreṇaiva kalpyatayā tava samāsavākye bodhāviśeṣeṇa tadvailakṣaṇyakalpanasyāpyasambhavāditi| tat, na; yatra samāsaghaṭakapadārthasya viśaṣyatve sati tadghaṭakībhūtapadānāṃ svottaramutpattiyogyavibhaktyarthavadantarbhāveṇa lakṣaṇaṃ vinā sāmānādhikaraṇyam, tatra karmadhārayatvam, tadantarbhāveṇa lakṣaṇayā sāmānādhikaraṇye tvanya iti vibhāgasambhavāt | satyantena 'pañcamūlī' ityādivyāvṛttiḥ | yadapi 'odanaḥ pacati' ityādivāraṇāya 'prātipadikārthaprakārakabodhamātraṃ prati sup‌janyopasthitirhetuḥ' ityeva kāryakāraṇabhāvo lāghavāt, na tvabhedātiriktasaṃsargeṇetyādiniveśaḥ | nīlaṃ ghaṭamānayetyādau ca pratyekaṃ viśeṣamaviśeṣyayordvayorapi bhāvanāyāmanvayaḥ, pārṣṇikastvabhedānvayaḥ | taduktaṃ bhāṣye 'kaṭo'pi karma, bhīṣmādayo'pi' iti | nanvatra parameṇa kārakeṇa kṛtamityarthe pariniṣṭhitavibhaktyā samāsanupapattiḥ, asāmarthyāt | pārṣṇikābhedānvayamādāya sāmarthyamiti cet, alaukike tatkalpane kriyānvayanimittavibhakterapagamāpattiḥ, nimittāpagamāditi cet, na ; samānādhikaraṇaprakaraṇe samāsavidhāyakaśāstraprāmāṇyena nimittāpāye'pi naimittikasthitisvīkārāt | caitraḥ pacati, nīlo ghaṭaḥ, stokaṃ pacatītyādau prathamāderabheda evārthaḥ | na cābedasya saṃsargatayā bhānopapattau vibhaktervṛtatikalpane gauravamiti vācyam, yatrābhede viśeṣaṇavibhakterlakṣaṇā, tatra nīlo ghaṭa iti vākyādbhedaprakārakabodhasyāvyutpattyātādṛśasamabhivyāhārajñānasya dvividhabodhahetutvakalpanāpekṣayā vṛtti kalpanasya laghutvāt | na caivametanmate 'ghaṭo na nīlaḥ' iti vākyānnīlābhedābhāvapratītireva syāt, na tu nīlabhedapratītiḥ, yādṛśasamabhivyāhārānnañaḥ sattve dharmiṇi yena sambandhena yadvattvaṃ pratīyate, tādṛśasamabhivyāhārasthale nañā tatra dharmiṇi tatsambandhāvacchinnapratiyogitākatadabhāvabodhasyaiva vyutpattisiddhatvāditi vācyam, iṣṭāpatteḥ | nīlabhedapratītistvārthyeva | 1[fn atyantābhāvābhāvasya pratiyogirūpatvam, bhedābhāvābhāvasya ca pratiyogitāvacchedakarūpatvamiti siddhāntaḥ sarvairapi svīkriyate | atra ca granthakṛtā abhedābhāvasya pratiyogirūpatvaṃ svīkṛtamiti tṛtīyaḥ kaścana panthāḥ | ] atredābhāvasya pratiyogisvarūpatvācca | samaniyatābhāvānāmaikyena bhūtale ghaṭo nāstītyādau ghaṭakartṛ kasattābhāvapratītau ghaṭābhāvapratīteriva tatpratīterūpapatteśca | evañca vibhakyarthamadvārīkṛtya prātipadikārthasyānvayābhāvādrājasambandhyabhinnaḥ puruṣaḥ ityādyanvayānupapattistadavasthaiveti | tadapi na, tad dadhi tiṣṭhatītyādāvanvayānāpatteḥ | naca 2luptasmaraṇāt tatra bodhaḥ, lukamajānato bodhānāpatteḥ | na ca tatra dadhno na nāmatvamiti cet, rājño'pi supo luptatvenātathātvamiti tulyam | na ca dadhipadasya dadhikarmake lakṣaṇāghrahadaśāyāmapi tasya dvitīyetaravibhaktyantatvabhramadaśāyāṃ dadhikarmakadarśanānvayabodhānudayād dvitīyāntadadhyādipadasamabhivyāhṛtapaśyādisamabhivyāhārasya hetutvāvaśyakatvena luptadvitīyānusandhānasyāvaśyakatvamiti vācyam, rājapuruṣa ityādāvapi ṣaṣṭhyatiriktavibhakyantapadaghaṭitasamāsatvabhramadaśāyāṃ rājasambandhipuruṣa iti bodhānudayena tatrāpi luptaṣaṣṭhyanusandhānasyāvaśyakatvāt | tātparyādijñānakāraṇatayā nirvāhe tu samamasmākamiti dik | api ca, nīlo dravyañca ghaṭa ityādāviva karmadhāraye nīlaghaṭo dravyamityādāvapi ghaṭe dharmiṇyekatra dvayamiti nyāyena nīladravyayostādātmyenānvayāpattiḥ | na ca nāmārthasya tādātmyāvacchinnavidheyatayā bodhe prathamāntapadajanyopasthitirheturiti na doṣa iti vācyam, dadhi dravyamityādāvapi tathābodhānāpatteḥ | luptaprathamayā prathamāntatvaṃ tu prakṛte'pi samānam | samāse uddeśyavidheyabhāvenānvayasya dūṣayiṣyamāṇatvena nīlapadārthasyeva tasyāpi śuddhaprakāratayā tena nyāyenānvayasya durvāratvācca | api ca 'paṇḍito brāhmaṇaḥ, pācakaḥ, pāṭhakaḥ' itivat paṇṭitabrāhmaṇaḥ, pācakapāṭhaka ityādāvuddeśyavidheyabhāvenānvayavāraṇāyaikārthībhāva āvaśyakaḥ | sati hi tasmin ghaṭapaṭāt ghaṭaghaṭatvayorivetarasaṃsṛṣṭasvārthasyaivopasthityā tathānvayaniyāmikāyāḥ pṛthagupasthiterabhāvānna doṣaḥ | ata eva 'vaṣaṭkarttuḥ pratamabhakṣaḥ' ityatra vaṣaṭkarttṛviśiṣṭabhakṣānuvādena prāthamyavidhānāpattimāśaṅkya 'prathamabhakṣaḥ' iti samastamekaṃ padam | tatraikaprasaratvānnaikāṃśena vaṣaṭkartṛviśiṣṭabhakṣaṇamuddiśya aparāṃśena prāthamyavidhānaṃ yuktam, tathā sati prasārabhedāt sāmarthyavighātāt samāso na syāt | etena kevalabhakṣānuvādena prāthamyaṃ vidhīyata ityapyapāstam | na ca 1[fn saviśeṣaṇānāṃ vṛttirna, vṛttasya ca viśeṣaṇayogo na' iti niyamād vṛttirnetyarthaḥ | ] saviśeṣaṇatvād vṛttinaṃ syāt, pradhānasya sattve'pi kṣatyabhāvāt | tasmādbhakṣāntaravidhirayamiti mīmāṃsakāḥ | na cātra pakṣe uddeśyatāgamakasya prāthamyayadvṛttayogādeḥ, vidheyatābodhakapaścāttadvṛttayogādeścābhāvena kathaṃ tathānvayāpādanamiti vācyam, 'prathamo bhakṣaḥ, paṇḍito brāhmaṇaḥ' ityādāvapi tathābodhadarśanena tasya vyabhicaritatvāt | tasmāt tathānvayabodhe uddeśyavācakasamabhivyāhṛtatadasaṃsṛṣṭārthabodhakavidheyavācakapadajanyopasthitireva tantram | etena viśeṣyatayopasthitirvidheyatve niyāmiketyapi parāstam, padādviśeṣyatayaivopasthiteśca| yattu, ālaṅkārikairuddeśyānantaryābhāve'pi vidheyāvimarśa uktaḥ 'nyakkāro'yam' ityādau, tatra na vidheyatvāpratītirdūṣakatābījam, kintu viparītānupūrvīpratisandhānapūrvakaṃ bilambena tathāpratītireva | avilambitā pratītirhi kāvye uddeśyā | dhvanitañcedaṃ vṛddhisaṃjñāsūtrasthabhāṣyakaiyaṭakaustubhādiṣu | vastutastatrotsargaparityāgena sahṛdayodvegamātraṃ tathetyanyatra vistaraḥ | na ca tathā śābdabodhaṃ prati uddeśyavidheyavācakaghaṭitaikasamastapadabhinnapadajanyopasthitirheturiti pūrvokte 'pītavāsāścaturbhujaḥ' ityādau ca na doṣa iti vācyam, sakalavṛttibhedaghaṭitagurutarakāryakāraṇabhāvakalpanāpekṣayaikārthībhāvasvīkārasya laghutvāt | na caivam 'sapatadaśāratnirvājapeyasya yūpo bhavati', 'lohatoṣṇīṣā ṛtvijaḥ pracaranati', yadyapi 'caturavattī yajamānaḥ pañcāvattaiva vayā kāryā' ityādau vājapeyayūpāratnimuṣṇīvantaṃ cānūdya saptadaśatvalauhityapañcatvānāṃ vidhānaṃ na syāditi vācyam, atra yūpāratnyuṣṇīṣāvattānāmatideśaprāptatayā'tideśādupadeśasya balavattvena tatpravṛtteḥ | pūrvametairviśiṣṭavidhyaṅgīkāreṇākṣateḥ| tatparyālocanāyāṃ tu lauhityamātrasya tātparyaṃ gamyata iti tāvanmātravidhitvavyavahāraḥ | na caivamanayā rītyā prathamabhakṣa ityatrāpi bhakṣāntaravidhirna syāditi vācyam, tatrobhayorapyupadeśena tathā vaktumaśakyatvādityāhuḥ | yattu, karmadhāraye'pyuttarapadalakṣaṇayaiva viśiṣṭārthopastiternoddeśyavidheyabhāvenānvaya iti, tat, na; ṣaṣṭhītatpuriṣāt karmadhārayasya balavattvānāpatteḥ | etena karmadhāraye ekārthībhāvo nāvaśyaka iti parāstamiti dik | api ca, evaṃ dvandvasamāse 'sunadaraṃ ghaṭaṃ paṭaṃ ca' ityādau sundaramityādiviśeṣaṇavad dvandvasamāse tdavāraṇāyaikārthībhāva āvaśyakaḥ | kiñca, vigraha iva dvandve'pi ca śabdaprayogāpattiḥ | ata eva samarthasūtre bhāṣye 'vākye yathā svacayogaḥ -- rājño gauścāśvaśca puruṣaśceti | yathā ca svāmitvayogaḥ -- devadattasya ca yajñadattasya ca gauriti | tathā na samāse rājño gavāśvapuruṣā iti devadattajñadattayogauritītyuktam |' na caikakriyānvayitvarūpasāhityasya paścādevāvagamanena tatra śabdasya vṛttiriti vācyam, ekarūpeṇaikakriyānvayitvādisamaniyatasamasyamānapadārthaparyāptapadārthāntarabhūtasāhityabhānānubhavānurodhena vṛtterāvaśyakatvāt | ata eva "cārthe dvandvaḥ" [ 2|2|29 ] ityanuśāsanena tadarthe samāsavidhānaṃ saṅgacchate | na ca padārthānāṃ vastugatyaikakriyādyanvayitvarūpasāhitye sati dvandva iti tasyārthaḥ, na tu tacchaktigrāhakamiti vācyam, ekakriyānvayitve ca śabdaśaktyabhāvāt, kriyāyā vāradvayaṃ bodhāpatteśca | "anekamanyapadārthe" [ 2|2|24 ] iti sāhacaryeṇa śaktigrāhakatāyā evaucityācca sāhityābhāne dvandvasthale samuditasya devatātvānāpatteśca | sāhityaviṣayakabodha eva dvandvasādhutāyā bhāṣyakārādibhiraṅgīkārācca | kiñca, dvandvavigrahavākye'pi niyamena ca śabdaprayogānāpattiḥ, ekakriyānvayitvasya dvandve iva tatra paścādevāvagamyamānatvāt | na caikakriyānvaye sa tātparyagrāhakaḥ 'aharaharnayamāno gāmaśvaṃ puruṣaṃ paśum' ityādau tadabhāve'pyekakriyānvayadarśanāt | atha tatra sāhityam 'ca' śabdārthaḥ, tarhi vṛttivigrahayostulyārthatvanirvāhāya samāse'pi sāhityabhānamāvaśyakam | kiñca, 'paśva dhavaṃ khadiraṃ chindhi' iti vākyavat 'paśya dhavakhadiraṃ chindhi' iti prayogāpattiḥ | kiñca, 'devadattayajñadattau pacataḥ' ityādāvākhyātopāttadvitvānvaye'nvayitāvacchedakalābhāya sāhityabhānamāvaśyakam | na ca subupāttadvitvameva tathā, 'caitro maitraśca gacchataḥ' ityādau dvivacanābhāvenānanvayāpatteḥ | na ca śabda eva tadbodhakaḥ, kośabhāṣyādāvanuktatvāt | cārthe dvandvavidhānena dvandvottarañca śabdasyeva dvivacanasyāpyanāpatteśca | kiñca, 'devadatto yajñadattaśca pacati, devadattaśca yajñadattasya pacataḥ' ityekavacanadvicanavyavasthārthamiteratarayoge tadbhānamāvaśyakam | api ca, subupāttadvitvādyanvaye'nvayitāvacchedakalābhāya sāhityabhānamāvaśyakam | yattu uktam --- nānādharmāṇāmanvayitāvacchedakatve kevalaparyāptereva saṃsargatvamiti | tat, na; kālākāśapadayordvandve bahuvacanasya sādhutāpatteḥ | kālākāśaghaṭaniṣṭhabuhutvasya śuddhaparyāptyā kālākāśayorapi sattvāt | anvayitāvacchedakavyāpyaparyāpteḥ saṃsargatve tvanvayitāvacchedakapratyekadharmavyāpyāyā dvitvādiparyāpteraprasiddhyādvivacanasyāpyanāpatteḥ | na ca nānādharmasyānvayitāvacchedakatve yāvat svāśrayānvayitvavyutpatterna tathāprayoga iti vācyam, 'kālākāśau' ityato yogyātābhramadaśāyāṃ vyaktidvayamātraviṣayakabahutvabodhadarśanena tasyāḥ kalpayitumaśakyatvād, 1[fn'ayamekaḥ ayamekaḥ;' ityādyapekṣābuddhijanyā dvitvādisaṃkhyā nāsti, kintu saṃkhyātvavyāpyaḥ paricchedaka kaścana dharmaviśeṣaḥ | sa caika eveti vādināṃ mata ityarthaḥ | ] dvitvāderekatavamate'sambhavācca | sāhityābhāne tu na doṣaḥ, anvayitāvacchedakavyāpyatvaviśiṣṭaparyāpteḥ saṃsargatvābhyupagamāt | na ca sāhityānvaye'pi duravasthaiveti vācyam, dharmigrāhakamānena sāhitye yāvatsvāśrayānvayitvasyaivāṅgīkārāt puṣpavantādipade'pi sāhityamevānvayitāvacchedakam | idamevābhipretya 'ekacoktyā puṣpavantau divākaraniśākarau' ityamaraḥ | ekayoktyetyasyaikaśakyatāvacchedakaprakāreṇetyarthaḥ | yattu, puṣpavantapadaṃ candre sūrye ca śaktimitayākāraḥ śaktigrahaḥ, tatkāryatāvacchedakañca candratvaprakārakatve sati sūryatvaprakārakasmṛtitvaṃ tādṛśaśābdatvañca, candrasūryobhayaniṣṭhāyā eva tasyāḥ śakteścandratvasūryatvayorvyāsajyattyavacchedakatāsvīkārāt kevalasūryātvādiprakārakabodhe ca kevalataddharme śakyatāvacchedakatāparyāptyavagāhijñānasya hetutvāt | ubhayatra śakyatāvacchedakatāparyāptyavagāhijñānasya cobhayaprakārakabuddhitvameva kāryatāvacchedakam, ato na tata ekataramātrabodhaḥ | nānārthapade ca pratyekadharmāvacchinnasyāpi pratītyā pratyekaṃ dharme evāvacchedakatāparyāpteḥ sattvena na doṣa iti | tat, na ; avacchedakatāyā ekadharminiṣṭhaikaviśeṣyatānirūpitaviśeṣaṇatāpanneṣu nānādharmeṣveva paryāptisvīkāreṇātra tadabhāvāt prakṛte candrasūryayorbhedena tanniṣṭhaviśeṣyatāyā aikyāsambhavāt | yadi tu -- yatra nānādharmān dharmitāvacchedakīkṛtya vyāsajyavṛttidharmāntarabhānam, tatra vibhinnadharmiviśeṣaṇeṣvapi nānādhrameṣvavacchedakatāparpyāptirāvaśyakī | yathā 'ghaṭapadau na staḥ' ityatra ubhayatvāvacchinnābhavāpratītau ghaṭatvapaṭatvayostādṛsābhāvapratiyogitāvacchedakatāparyāptiriti vibhāvyate, tarhi prakṛte'pi sāhityaviśiṣṭe śaktirāvaśyakī | tatra sāhityaṃ śakyatāvacchedakameva, na śakyamityādi nāmārthoktarītyānusandheyam | na ca 'ghaṭapaṭau na staḥ' ityatrobhayatvameva pratiyogitāvacchedakam, na tu ghacatvādīti vācyam, yatkiñcidubhayavati tādṛśapratītyanāpatteriti dik | yadapi, puṣpavantādipadajanānārthānubhave tatpadajñāne nānārthānubhavajanakatvaniścayaḥ, kāraṇam, ekamātrānubhave ca pratibandhakaḥ, ato na doṣaḥ | ata eva tādṛśaniścayavirahiṇaḥ kadācicchaktyāpyekamātrabodhaḥ, ubhayadhramāvacchinne śaktigrahe'pyudbodhakavaśādekadharmāvacchinnamātrasamṛtisambhavādubhayadharmāvacchinnasmṛtāvapi yogyatāvaśādekadharmāvacchinnasyaiva śābdabodhasambhavācceti | tadapi na, bodhakatātiriktaśaktyābhāvasya nirṇītatvāt | ekadharmāvacchinnabodhakatvagrahavatastathābodhe'pi kośādivirodhād na tatra sādhutvam | yathā stryarthakadāraśabdasyaikavanādau | vastutastu puṣpavantapadaṃ candratvasūryatvobhayaprakārabodhajanakamityeva tatra śaktigraha iti naikataramātrabodhastataḥ | ekayoktyā ityasya caikayā śaktyā ityarthaḥ| 'puṣpavantau' ityasya ca puṣpavantapadapratipādyāvityarthaḥ | yadvā --- ekayoktyetsasyakoccāraṇenetyarthaḥ | nānārthasthale tu nāvṛttimantareṇa nānārthabodhaḥ | prakṛte tu śakyaikyāt sakṛduccāritāt sakṛdevārthadvayapratyaya ityanyatra vistaraḥ | yattu, ekabuddhiviṣayatvameva cārtha iti | tat, na; tasyāpi paścād grahāt, tatprakārakabodhasyānubhavaviruddhatvācca, ghaṭaḥ karttetyatra dvandvāpatteśca | buddhiveśeṣaviṣayatvaṃ tatheti cet, ananugatatvenānantaśaktyāpatteḥ | etena bhedaścārtha ityapyapāstam, tasya kevalānvayitvenāvyāvarittakatayācārtha ityasya vaiyarśyapatteśca | na ca karmadhārayaviṣaye dvandvavāraṇārthaṃ tat, 'grāmaṃ gataḥ' ityādau dvitīyātatpuruṣeṇeva tenāpi bādhasambhavāt | anyathā dvitīyātatpuruṣaviṣaye bhedasya sattvena dvandvo durnivāraḥ syāt | cārthaḥ sāhityam, paraṃ bhinnānāmevetyanyadetat | tasmāt sāhityaviṣayakabodhārtha taditi tattvam | sāhitayañcaikakālikadeśikaikakriyākartṛtvādisamaniyatam, ekarūpeṇaikakālikaikapadopasthāpyakriyānvayitvasamaniyatañca padārthāntareva | ata eva sahitābhyāṃ kṛtam, sahitau dṛṣṭau, sahitebhyo dattam, sahitayoranvaya ityādativyavahāraḥ saṅgacchate | dvandve tvaviśeṣāt sarvaṃ bhāsate | ata eva dvandve sāhityāvagamādekaṃ devatātvamiti mīmāṃsakā vyavajahruḥ | yatra tu pūrvasya bādhaḥ, yathā dhavakhadirau chindhītyādau, tatra dvitīyameva bhāsate | ādyasyāpi caikakālikatvarahitasyaikajātīyakriyākarmatvasamaniyatasya bhānam | 'pitroḥ śrāddhaṃ kuryāt' ityādau tu śāstrasthālpaviṣayatāpattibādhakāduddeśyaviśeṣaṇatvād bādhasya tyāgaḥ | ekakriyānvayitvasamaniyataṃ tu sārvatrikam | idamevābhipretya tulyavadekakriyānvayitvaṃ sāhityamiti prāñcaḥ | tulyavadityasayaikakālamekarūpeṇa cetyarthaḥ | taccataretarayoge viśeṣaṇam, vyutpattivaicitryāt | ata eva tatprakaraṇasya niyāmakatvaṃ bhāṣyādyuktaṃ saṃgacchate | tacca samudāyasamāhāradvandve tu samāhāra eva viśeṣyaḥ, sa ca samudāyaḥ, sa cātiriktaeva viśiṣṭavat | na ca samudāyina evābuddhiviṣayatvaupādhikīti vācyam, ghaṭānāṃ samāhāraḥ = samūhaḥ ityādau bhedanibandhanaṣaṣṭhyanāpatteḥ | na cāropito bhedaḥ, tāvataiva dvandvasādhutvasya vyavahārasya copapatteḥ | tasmāt samudāyo vilakṣaṇasamudāyisaṃyogajanyo'tirikta eva tadviśeṣyakabodhāyaikārthībhava āvaśyakaḥ | vastutastu udbhūtāvayavabhedasamūhasya viśeṣyatve itaretarayogaḥ | anudbhūtāvayavabhedasya tattve tu samāhāra iti bodhyam | evañca samāhārasyaikatvādevaikavacane siddhe tadarthaṃ vacanaṃ nārambhaṇīyam | ata eva tatprakaraṇasya niyāmaktavaṃ bhāṣyādyuktaṃ saṅgacchate | tacca samudāyaśakyameva, anyatarapadalakṣaṇāyāṃ vinigamanāvirahāt | na ca pratyayānāṃ sannihitapūrvapadārthagatasvārthabodhakatvavyutpattiruttarapade tatkaraṇae vinigamikā, 'rājñaḥ paruṣaḥ' ityādau ṣaṣṭhyārthasya puruṣe'nvayavāraṇāya pūrvapadārthetīti vācyam, sarvaka ityādau vyabhicārāt | dadhīyad dadātītyādau vatubarthānvayāpatteśca, sāṃnidhyasattvāt | dadhi bahuvaṭurdatātītyādau dadhni bahujarthānvayāpattiḥ, paṭānanvayāpattiśca | api ca, tathā sati dvandvasyaivānāpattiḥ | cārthe varttamānānekasubantānāmeva tadvidhānāt | anyapadārthe'pi pūrvoktarītyottarapadasyaiva lakṣaṇāyā'nyapadārthe varttamānānekasubantābhāvena citragvādau bahuvrīhyanāpatteśca | api ca, ghaṭādipadeṣvapi ghāṭididhātubhyo vihatācpratyayādirūpacaramavarṇasyaiva lakṣaṇayā śaktyā vā upapattau viśiṣṭaśaktikathaivocchidyeta | tātparyagrāhakatve'pi bodhakāraṇatāyā āvaśyakatvena śakterdurvāratvācca | na ca avayavamavayavaśaktiṃ cājānatāmapi samudāyavyutpattyā bodhāt tatra viśiṣṭe sā, prakṛte'pi tulyatvāt | ata eva rājapuruṣādau samudāyavyutpattyā samudāyārthabodhe'pi vyākaraṇavyutpattiṃ vinā padavibhāgasāmarthyābhāva ityanubhavasiddham | na ca samudāyaśaktyajñāne'vayavalakṣaṇājñānenāpi bodhād na śaktiḥ, gaṅgādipadānāṃ tīrādau śaktiṃ gṛhītavato lakṣaṇayā pravāhabodhāt, gaṅgāpadasya pravāhe śaktisiddhyanāpatteriti dik | api ca, evaṃ pratyayānāṃ prakṛtyarthānvitasvārthabodhakatvavyutpattibhaṅgaḥ, uttarapadamātrasyāprakṛtitvāt | na ca prakṛtyarthaśabdena vṛttyā prakṛtijanyajñānaviyasya grahaṇād doṣaḥ | yadvā, prakṛtitvaṃ na tatra paryāptyadhikaraṇatvam, kintu tadāśrayatvāmātram, taccāvāyavamātre'pīti vācyam, 'citragumānaya' 'daṇḍinaṃ paśya' ityādau sati tātparye vinā lakṣaṇāṃ citragodaṇḍādāvānayanakarmatādyanvayaprasaṅgāt | na ca daṇḍādīnāṃ padārthaikadeśātvād na tatrānvayaḥ, 'ṛddhasya rājñaḥ paruṣaḥ' ityādau rājādīnāmiva svātantryasyābādhāt | anyathā 'vahnimān dhūmān' ityādau, 'sannidhānañcānuśāsanikam' ityādi; tadapyāpastam | na ca daṇḍinamityādāvanāsannatvādeva nānvaya iti vācyam, na hi padāvyavadhānamāsattiḥ, giriragnimān bhuktaṃ devadattanetyarthe tātparyagrahavato'pi puṃso girirbhuktagnimān devadattenetyato vākyāda bodhānāpatteḥ | kintu padajanyapadārthopasthitimātraṃ sā | sā ca samūhālambanādirūpāstyeva | ata eva 'bhaje saroruhasadṛśaṃ bhagavataścaramāravindam' ityāditaḥ śābdabodhaḥ saṅgacchate | etena pratyayāvyavahitaprāgvarttipadajanyopasthitiviśeṣyatvaṃ prakṛtyarthatvam | tacca dvandvādāvubhayoḥ, avyayībhāvādau pūrvapadādyarthasyaiva | avyavadhānāṃśaniveśād daṇḍinamityatra prāgvarttidaṇḍapadajanyabodhaviśeṣye daṇḍenātiprasaṅga iti parāstam | 'bahupaṭuḥ, sarvakaḥ, ityādāvavyāpteḥ | dadhīyad dadātītyādau dadhni dadītūtiyīdau dadhni'vatubarthānvayāpatteśca | yasmāt pratayayavidhānāvadhitvameva prakṛvim, prakṛtivṛttyupasthitiviśeṣyatvañca prakṛtyarthatvam | nanu 'pratyāyānāṃ prakṛtyarthānvayaḥ' ityasya ko'rthaḥ ? na ca pratyayārthaviṣayakaśābdobadhe prakṛtijanyopastitirheturityartha iti vācyam, pratyayatvaprakṛtitvādyajanatāṃ tathā kāryakāraṇabhāvagrahāsambhavāt, 'ghaṭaḥ karmatvam' ityatastathāvyutpannasya bodhe vyabhicārācca | tasmād ghaṭaprakārakakarmatvaviśeṣyakabodhe ghaṭabodhakatattatpadasamabhivyāhṛtakarmatvārthakatattajjanyopastitirheturiti viśiṣyaiva sa vācya iti na doṣa iti cet, na; tattatkāraṇagrahaistasya tasya tathā tathā vyutpannasya tathā tathā bodhasambhave'pi svasvaprakṛtivṛttyupasthāpyārthānvaya eva pratyayānāṃ sādhutvam, svasvaprakṛtikapratyāyārthānvaye eva ca tattatprakṛteḥ sādhutvam nānyathetyetāvata evārthasya vicāraviṣayatvāt | nanu tatreva sādhutve kiṃ mānamiti cet, prātipadikāt karmatve'rthe 'am' bhavatītyukte pratyāsattinyāyena tallābhāt | na ca prakṛtighaṭakārthānvaye'pi tadastviti vācyam, daṇḍasya karmatvānvaye daṇḍinaṃ paśyetyādervināpi lakṣaṇāṃ sādhutvāpatteḥ | evamuddeśyavidheyabhāvenānvaye pṛthagupasthitijanakapadasamudāya eva sādhurityarthaḥ, ekā saṃjñā paraṃ kāryamityādinirdeśairbodhyate | evamanye'pi vyuttapatyaṃśāḥ sādhutvanirṇāyakāstattasūtrabhāṣyādibalāt sudhībhirunneyāḥ | uktañca hiraṇā ----- | vastuto yatra viśeṣye pratyayārthānvayabādhaḥ, tatra viśeṣaṇe'pi tadanvayaḥ | ata eva paṇḍitarūpa ityādau pāṇḍitye prāśastyānvayaḥ | yatra tu abādhaḥ, tatra viśeṣya eva | ata eva dhātvarthaphalasya vidhānasāmarthyād dvandva iti parāstam, ekārthībhāvasāmarthyasva sattvāt | ata eva samuccayānvāyayorna samāsaḥ | samuccaye hi parasparanirapekṣasyaidharmāvacchinne'nvayaḥ | viśeṣaṇatayā vā | ata eva 'devadattaḥ pacati, hasati ca' ityādau kriyāsamuccayate nāvyāptiḥ | kāla ekatvaṃ buddhiviśeṣaviṣayatvamiti bhajanadvayasyaikakālikatvābhāvāt 'īśvaraṃ guruñca bhajasva' ityādau samuccayo na syāditi na vācyam kintu samuccaye'pi sāhityabhānam | ata eva samuccaye devadatto yajñadattaśca pacatītyādau nityamekavacanāntākhyātaprayoga evetyāhuḥ | evañca cārthe'nekasubantānāṃ vṛttyabhāvāt samāsasya prāptireva nāsti | ata eva tatra naikārthībhāvaḥ | itaretarayoge milatasyaikakālamevaikadharmāvacchinne itarānvayaḥ, 'dhavakhadirau chindhi' ityādau tathaivānubhavāt | ata eva tadvigrahavākye cakāradvayaprayogaḥ | 1[fn cākareṇa hityarthaḥ | ]tena hyanyo'nyasminnanyo'nyasāhityaṃ gamyate | sāhityameva ca cārthaḥ | na ca cābhyāṃ sāhityadvayapratītyāpattiḥ, cābhyāmeva tadyotanāt | ata evetaretarayoge 'devadattaśca yajñadattaśca pacataḥ' ityādau nityaṃ dvivacanāntākhyāta eva | etenārthacatuṣṭayānusyūtaṃ sāhityameva cārtha ityapāstam | evañca tatra tadabodhanārthamekārthībhāva āvaśyaka eva | yatra tu aharaharityādivat prakārāntareṇa gṛhītatātparyācca vināpi samuccayam, tatraikacakāraprayoge'pi sāhityāvagatirbhavatyeva | spaṣṭañcedam3[fn 'ekacakāraprayoge'pi sāhityāvagatirbhavati' idañcetyarthaḥ | ] "dvivacanavibhajya" [ 5|3|57 ] ityatra bhāṣyakaiyaṭayoḥ | 'ekadharmāvacchinne' ityukteḥ 'ajāṃ grāmaṃ nayati' ityādyarthe ajāgrāmau nayatīti na prayogaḥ | ata eva ca 'vikṛtāvikṛtā dehaṃ dhanantiḥ te varttayanti ca' ityādeḥ sādhutvasiddhiḥ | sāhityāvacchinanakriyādveye prathamataḥ samudāyānvaye tadanantaraṃ pārṣṇikapratyekānvayabodhādityāhuḥ | na caivam 'yadagnaye ca prajāpataye ca' ityādau parasparasāhityāvagamena samuditasyaiva devatātvaṃ syāditi vācyam, prādhānyena casya pratyayārthe evānvayena devatātvayoreva samuccayenādoṣāt | kiñca, tatra samāse ekapadopasthāpyasamapradhānayorekakālamevetarānvayasya vyaputpittisiddhatvena puṣpavantādau klṛptatvena ca samuccayatvasyaiva bhaṅgāpatteḥ | etenānvācaye samāsāpādanaṃ nirastam, tatrānuṣaṅgikatvasya cadyotyatve'pi ekasyaiva taddyotanena cārthe'nekasubantābhāvācca | prāyeṇānvācayaścasya kriyānvaye bhavati | yatra tu kriyānvaye'pi cadvayam, yathā 'pacanti ca, hasanti ca' ityādau, tatra parasparasāhityāvagamānnānuṣaṅgikatvapratītiḥ | idamevābhipretyā 1[fn "cārthe dvandvaḥ" ityatra arthagrahaṇāsāmarthyādityarthaḥ | tatra hi -- 'ce yathā vijñāyeta -- cena kṛto'rthaścārtha iti bhāṣye uktam | ]rthagrahaṇasamarthyāt samuccayānvācayayorna samāsa iti bhāṣye uktam | 'ce dvandvaḥ' iti nyāse hi ca citrā gāvo'syeti, tathā sati 'rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ' ityādau prathamāntaparuṣapadārthasya prādhānyamiva citragavāmeva tat syāt, na ṣaṣṭhyantārthasya | anubhavasiddhañca devadattādereva prādhānyam | evaṃ hi vṛttivigrahayoḥ samānārthatvamapi nirvahatīti | tat, na; evaṃ vigrahe'pi ṣaṣṭhyarthasambandhasya bhedenāyamitaytrānvaye citragosambandhavāniti sambandhaniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitabhedasaṃsargīyasāṃsargikaviṣayatāśālī bodhaḥ | samāse tu citragoniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitasambandhiniṣṭhaviśeṣyatāśālīti bhedasya tadavasthatvāt | evaṃ ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣādāvapi | na ca vṛttivigrahayornātisamānārthatvaniyamaḥ, tarhyasmaduraktavigrahe'pi na doṣaḥ | kiñacāṣaṣṭhyarthavahuvrīhau prāptasyodakasyāyamiti vigrahe'pi udakakartṛka prāptikarma ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣādāvapi rājā cāsau puruṣaśceti vigṛhlantaḥ parāstāḥ | ṣaṣṭhīsamāsādividhāyakasyālugnavidhāyakasya tatpuruṣe "tulyārthatṛtīyā" [ 6|2|2 ] ityādīnāñca nirviṣayatāpatteḥ | nanu
