'yugapadadhaghikaraṇavacane dvandvaḥ' iti nyāsenaiva siddhe nyāsāntare pravṛttervaiyarthyāpatteḥ | 1[fn adhikriyate śabdo yatreti vigraheṇa adhikaraṇamarthaḥ | atra pratyāsattyā vigrahaghaṭakapadārtho gṛhyate | adhikaraṇaśabdasyārthaparatvam | 'yuṣmadyupapade samānādhikaraṇe madhyamaḥ' ityatrācāryevyakhyātam | ] adhikaraṇam = varttipadārthau, tayoryugapat padadvayenābhidhāne dvandvo bhavatīti tadarthaḥ | rāmapadena rāmakṛṣṇayoḥ, kṛṣṇapadena ca tarorabhidhānāt tayorabhedānvayarūpasāmarthyasyākṣateriti tadbhāvaḥ | na ca ghaṭakumbhāvitivat 'virūpāṇāmapi' ityekaśeṣeṇa vādhād rāmakṛṣṇāviti dvandvasayāsādhutāpattiḥ, dvandvavidhisāmarthyena 'samānārthānām' iti sāmarthyena ca yugapadadhikaraṇavacanatāṃ vināpi samānārthatāyāmevaikaśeṣāt | nanu "anekamanyapadārthe" [ 2|2|24 ] ityanenānekasubantānāmanyapadārthapratipadākatve bahuvrīhividhānāt citragavādipadānāṃ sarveṣāṃ tadabhidhāyakatve yugapadadhakaraṇavacanatāptatvād dvandvapattiḥ | utsargāpavādanyāyena bahuvrīhiṇā bārdhanākṣaterbodhāvṛttirapidvāviti pariharaṇīyeti cet, na; 'seyaṃ yugapadadhikaraṇavacanatā duḥkhā duripapādā ca' ityādinā bhāṣya eva tasyā dūṣitatvāt | tatra duḥkhatvam, doṣākrāntatvāt | tathāhi -- vṛddhavyāvahārāddhiśabdārthādhyavasāyaḥ | na ca plakṣaśabdasya nyagrodhābhidhāyitvaṃ loke dṛśyate | na ca plakṣaśabdasya lakṣaṇā, nyagrodhaśabdenaiva nyagrodhasya pratipāditatvāt | api ca, dvandvaikavadbhāvaprakaraṇasya niyamārthatānupapattiḥ, sarvatraiva dvivacana bahuvacanayoḥ prasaṅge ekavacanavidhānena cāritārthyāt sāhityasya samāhārasya ca tava mate'bhānāt | api ca evaṃ vigrahe caśabdaprayogānupapattiḥ | durupapādeti | duṣṭaṃ niḥsāramupapādanaṃ yasyāḥ sā tathā, niṣpramāṇetyarthaḥ | tathā hi --- na tāvad dyāvākṣāmetyādau vyāse parasparasāhacaryeṇobhābhyāmapyarthadvayapratipādanadarśanāt samāse sā svīkāryeti vācyam, dyāvākṣāmetyasya chāndasatvāt | na ca parasparānvayābhāvenaikaśeṣasamāsayoraprāptestatsiddhaye seti vācyam, vacanasāmarthyādeva tatprāpteḥ | kiñca, dhavau ca khadirau ceti na vigrahaḥ, prakriyādaśāyāṃ prathamapravṛttasyekavacanasya tyāgāyogāt | samuccayānvācayayoḥ samāsābhāvārthamityapi na, tayostadabhāvasyopapāditatvāt, ekārthībhāvasāmarthyasyaiva prāguktadiśā bhāṣye siddhāntitatvena doṣābhāvācca | na ca samāsād dvivacanabahuvacanotpattyarthaṃ tadāvaśyakatā, puṣpavantādipadavat samāsādanekārthīpratītyaiva tatsiddheḥ | na caivam 'aṅgavaṅgakaliṅgāḥ' ityādau "tadrājasya bahuṣu tenaivāstriyām" [2|4|62 ] iti lug na syāt, apatyakṛtabahutvavivakṣāyāṃ tadrājasya lugiti hi tadarthaḥ | na hi vinā yugapadadhikaraṇavacanatāṃ pratyekatadrājārthaṃ bahutvānvayaḥ, tasya vyāsajyavṛttitvāditi vācyam, tadrājasya lug bahutve'rthe, tadbuhatvaṃ tad‌rājārthenaiva kṛtaṃ cet, tadrājārtheneva bahutvānvayaścedityarthe danaṅgīkāre'pi doṣābhāvāt, "pratyekaṃ bahutvasamavāyasya sattvāt" ityādi spaṣṭamasmatkṛtaśabdenduśekhare | sarvathāpi yugapadhikaraṇavacanatāmādāya laukike'lalaukike ca vibhaktipraveśo na yukta iti dik | evañca ajahatsvārthāyāṃ vṛttau sarvatra samāsapadādavayavaśaktibhyāṃ samudāyaśaktisahakṛtābhyāṃ viśiṣṭasyaiva padārthasyopastitirbahuvrīhāvanyapadārtho'pi samudāyaśakya eva | anyapadārthaśca yasyetyādau prakṛtipratyayārthavyatyāsena sambandhyādiḥ | prāptedaka ityādau prāptādipadebhyo viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvavyatyāsenopasthitiranyapadārthakarmaṇaścepasthitiḥ samudāyaśaktisādhyaiva | ata evābhihitatvānnadvitīyādaya ityākaraḥ | evaṃ dvandve sāhityamapi samudāyaśakyameva | jahatsvārthāyāṃ tu sarvatra samudāyaśaktireva, avayavā nirarthakā eveti pakṣaniṣkarṣaḥ | sa cāyamekārthībhāvaḥ kṛttaddhitasanādyantadhātusubekaśeṣasamāseṣu | tatra samāse upapāditaḥ | kṛdante'pyupapadanimittakapadoddeśyakavidhitvena, tatraiva samarthaparibhāṣāpravṛtteḥ | ata eva sūtre padapadaṃ caritārtham | anyathā vyākaraṇasthasarvavidhīnāṃ padasambandhitvāviśeṣāt tadgrahaṇavaiyarthyaṃ spaṣṭameva | ata eva śobhanaṃ kumbhakāra iti na | na cātra samāsasyāpi nityatvena tadīyaikārthībhāvenaiva nirvāhe kṛtāmapyekārthībhāve mānābhāva iti vācyam, mūlakenopadaṃśamityādau samāsasya vaikalpikatvāt tadabhāve sundareṇa mūlakenāpadaṃśamityadermūlakenādreṇa copadaṃśamityādermūlakasyopadaṃśanaṃ sparśanaṃ ca kṛtvā bhuṅkte itivad mūlakenopadaṃśaṃ sparśaṃ ca bhuṅkte ityādeśca vāraṇāya ekārthībhāvaḥ kṛtsvāvaśyakaḥ | ata eva "tatropapadam" [ 3|2|92 ] ityatra bhāṣye uktam --- 'mahāntaṃ kumbhaṃ karotītyatrāṇ prāpnoti | naitadasti 'upapadam' iti mahatī saṃjñā kriyate -- upoccāritaṃ padamiti | yāvatā cedānīṃ padagandho'sti padavidhirayaṃ bhavati | padavidhiśca samarthānāṃ bhavati, tatrāsāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati' iti | kevalakṛtsu tu naikārthībhāvaḥ, mānābhāvāt | ata eva "karttṛ karmaṇoḥ" [ 2|3|65 ] iti sūtre kṛtapūrvīkaṭamiti pratyudāharaṇaṃ saṅgacchate | śobhanamityanvayastu na, ekārthībhāvāt | na cāsyāpi kriyaviśeṣaṇatvena kārakatvamastyeva, tattve'pyasya nityasākāṅkṣatvābhāvāt | īdṛśakārakasya cotthāpyākāṅkṣāyānvayaḥ, na tūtthitākāṅkṣayeti spaṣṭameva | spaṣṭañcedam "kutsane sa supi" [ 8|1|66 ] ityatra kaiyaṭapadamañjāryoḥ | nanu yatraikārthībhāvo mānāntarasiddhaḥ, tatra padavidhiriti sūtrārthaḥ, na tu yatra padavidhiḥ, tatraikārthībhāva iti | ekārthībhāvastu vilakṣaṇārthabodhena mānāntarasiddha iti kimucyate paribhāṣāpravṛttyā nirupapadakṛtam, tenaikārthībhāva iti cet, satyam ; vilakṣaṇārthabodha eva kveti saṃśaye yatra samarthasūtrapravṛttirdṛśyate sāhacaryādivā, tatra lakṣaṇaikacakṣuṣkairasmābhistadanumānānna doṣaḥ | vastutastu "karmaṇyaṇ" ityādisāhacakaryāt "karttari kṛt" ityāderaikarūpyāya ca sarvatra kṛtsvekārthībhāvaḥ | ata eva pācako gamanasya ceti na prayogaḥ | na caivam 'gamanakarttṛ kaḥ pākaḥ' ityarthe gamanasya pacatīti prayogavāraṇāya tiṅṣvapi sa syāditi vācyam, ākhyātārthakārakasya kriyānirūpitaviśeṣamatāyāmeva ākhyātāntaprayogasādhutāyāḥ 'kriyāpradhānamākhyātam' ityanena bodhanenākṣateḥ | tasya ca tiṅarthaṃ prati kriyaiva pradhānaṃ kriyā pradhānameva cetyarthaḥ | ata eva pacatītyādau kārakakriyayoruddeśyavidheyabhāvapratītiḥ | subanteṣu tu nadoṣaḥ | 'na kevalaḥ' iti niṣedhena tadarthānvayivibhakti vinā prātipadikaprayogasyaivābhāvāt | iteraṣu tvekārthībhāvo'styeva | etanmūlikaiva 'pratyayānāṃ prakṛtyarthānvitasvārthabodhakatva' vyutpattiḥ, 'prakṛtipratyayau saha brūtaḥ' iti ca tadarthayoreva sahānvayaḥ, tvitareṇāpīti tadarthaḥ | sa copasthitirūpaḥ, śābdabodharūpo vetyanyat | ata eva vyāpārānvayavivakṣāyāmādiḥ pācaka iti na | phalaviśeṣaṇānāṃ tvekadeśānvayo bhavatyeva | "pūjanātpūjitam" [ 8|1|67 ] iti sūtre bhāṣye 'dāruṇādhyāpakaḥ' ityatra samastādhyāpakapadārthekadeśe phale dāruṇapadārthasya kriyāviśeṣaṇatayānvayasvokārāt | kiñca, karttṛ pratyayasamabhivyāhāre phalāvacchinnavyāpārasyaiva dhātvarthatvena śobhana pacatītyādāvekadeśānvayastatrāpyāvaśyakaḥ | na ca phalavyāpārayoḥ pṛthak śaktiḥ, tathaivopasthitiśceti na doṣaḥ | ata e na śakyatāvacchedakagauravam, anyathā karmapratyasamabhivyāhāre vyāpārāvacchinnaphalabodhena tathāśakterapyāvaśyakatvena guruśakyatāvacchedakaśaktidvayakalpanāpattiriti vācyam, evaṃ hiphalavyāpārayoruddeśyavidheyāvenānvayāpatteḥ | viklittisaṃyogobhayajanakavyāpāravānityarthaḥ viklidyate, gacchatītyādiprayogāṇāmāpatteśca | kāryakāraṇabhāvādikalpanayā tatra kāryakāraṇabhāvajñānavatāṃ bodhavāraṇe'pi tadajānatāṃ jāyamānatādṛśe bodhe'pi sādhutāpattidurvāraiva | gauravañca tadavasthameva | ata eva samāsādi śaktisiddhiḥ | tasmāt phalaviśiṣṭe vyāpāre vyāpāraviśiṣṭe phale ca dhātūnāṃ śaktiḥ | karttṛ karmārthakatattatpratyayasamabhivyāhāraśca tattadbodhe niyāmakaḥ | pacatītyādau prakṛtipratyayārthayoruddheśyavidheyabhāvenānvayo bhavatyeveti | samāsataddhitādisādharaṇyenaikārthībhāvaṃ svīkuvardbhirāstheyam | na ca jyotiṣṭoṃmena dhātvarthasvargabhāvanoddeśena tadarthaphalabhūtatyāgarūpadhātvarthasya vidheyatvaṃ na syāt | yajerhi tatra tyāgakaraṇakavyāpāre svargaviṣaye śaktiḥ | yadyapi sa vyāpārastyāgaviṣayo'ti, tathā'pi tasya karaṇatvenaivopasthitirastu, surūpatvenāpuruṣārthatayānyabhāvyatvamiti bahirbhūtasvarga eva bhāvyatvenānveti | yāgasya kāraṇatvañca bhāvanābhāvyanirvattarkatvam | kuṭhārāderapi puruṣavyāpāranirvartyacchedanirvarttakatvenaiva karaṇatvāditi vācyam, vidhibodhyapravarttanāviṣayatvarūpavidheyatvasya prakṛtyarthatayā sampūrṇadhātvarthe śabdādvodhe'pi 'lohitoṣpīṣā ṛtvijaḥ pracaranti' itayādāvitarasyāprāptatvena lauhitya ivehāpi svargasya sukharūpatayā svata eveṣṭatavena tadvyāpāre svarasata eva pravṛtteḥ, siddhatvena ca viśeṣaṇe phale paryavasānenādoṣāt | idañca bhāvanāyāḥ pratyayārthatvavādimīmāṃsakamate'pyāvaśyakam | teṣāmapi samānapadopāttatvapratyāsattyā liṅarthapravarttanāyāstadupāttabhāvanāyāmevānvayena paryavasānagatyaiva dhātvarthe tadviṣayatāyāḥ svīkarttavyatvāt | pravarttanāviṣayatvopalakṣitāprāptatvasamānādhikaraṇākhaṇḍopādhirūpavidheyatvāvacchinnaviṣayatayā tadrūpaviṣayatayā cānvayastu nāstyeva | tādṛśaviṣayatayānanvaya eva cākhyātānāṃ sādhakatvāt | evañceto'pi bhāvanāpratyayārthaṃ iti mīmāṃsakamatayuktam, bhinnapadopasthāpyatvena tathānvayāpatterityalam | taddhite'pi 'sundarasyaupagavaḥ' aupagavo devadattasya' ityādivāraṇāyoddeśyavidheyabhāvenānvayāya ca sa āvaśyakaḥ | subantāt taddhitotpatteḥ padoddeśyakavidhitavaṃ spaṣṭameva | sanādyanteṣvapi 'mahāntaṃ putrīyati, pipaṭhiṣati, gantum, śobhanaṃ pipaṭhiṣati, sundaraḥ kṛṣṇati, mahāntaṃ ghaṭayati' ityādivāraṇāya sa āvaśyakaḥ | tatra "supaḥ ātmanaḥ" [3|1|8 ] ityādeḥ padoddeśyakavidhitvaṃ spaṣṭameva | sanvidhau tattvābhāvena paribhāṣāpravṛtyabhāve'pi "supaḥ ātmanaḥ" [ 3|1|8 ] ityādau tataḥ karmaṇa icchāyāmityanuvṛtterarthādhikārānurodhena sannante tatkalapnā | tathā ca bhāṣyam 'vā vacananārthakyaṃ nityatvāt sanaḥ' ---- 'iha dvau pakṣau vṛttipakṣaśca avṛttipakṣaśca | tatra svabhāvata etadbhavati ---- vākyañca vṛttiśceti | vṛtterekārthībhāvaviṣayatvāt, vākyasya vyapekṣāviṣayatvāt, bhinnārthatvena bādhyabādhakabhāvāpraśaṅgaḥ' iti kaiyaṭaḥ | "guptij" [ 3|1|5 ] iti sūtradvayavihitasan tu na, mānābhāvāt, padavidhitvābhāvācc | ata eva kaṇḍavādiyagante na, yagādīnāṃ svārthīkatvena vijātīyārthavad dvitīyābhāvena nirūpayitumaśakyatvācca | ata eva stokādīnāṃ tatprakṛtyarthe'nvayaḥ | ata eva "kṛñcānuprayujyate" [ 3|1|40 ] ityādiviṣaye naikārthībhāvaḥ | prātipadikaprakṛtikakavipaḥ 'karttuḥ kyaṅ' [ 3|1|11 ] iti sūtre upasaṅkhyānāt, pūrvottarasāhacaryācca tatraikārthībhāvaḥ | ata eva 'sarvaprātipadikebhyaḥ' ityanena siddhe 'ācāre'vagalbha' ityatra supa ityasya sambandhe bādhakābhāvena tasyaikārthībhāva eva pravṛttestatsārthakyaṃ spaṣṭameva | asmiṃstu prātipadikagrahaṇasārthyāt supa itayasyāsambandhaḥ | ata eva rājānatītyādau nalopādikaṃ netyāhuḥ | evaṃ prātipadikaprakṛtikaṇicyapi sāhacaryāt saḥ | "sutyāpa" [ 3|1|25 ] iti sūtrasthaṇijiti yogavibhāgāt tatsaṅgraheṇa tasyāpi prakaraṇasthatvāt | ata eva "hetumati ca" [ 3|1|26 ] iti sūtre bhāṣye 'tatkarotītyupasaṃkhyānam ; sūtraṃ karoti sūtrayati | iha vyākaraṇasya sūtraṃ karotīti vākye ṣaṣṭhī | vyākaraṇaṃ sūtrayatīti pratyaye dvitīyā | kenaitadevaṃ bhavati ? yo'sau sūtravyākaraṇayorabhisambandhaḥ, sa utpanne pratyaye nivartate | asti ca karotervyākaraṇena sāmarthyamiti dvitīyā bhaviṣyati' iti bhāṣyaṃ saṅgacchate | subantāṇ‌ṇici tu spaṣṭa evaṃ1[fn ekārthībhāva ityarthaḥ | ] saḥ, padavidhitvasyaiva sattvāt | ekaśeṣe'pi dvandva ityanuvartanādekārthībhāvaḥ | tathāhi --- tadvidhāyakañca "sarūpāṇāmekaśeṣa ekavibhaktau" [ 1|2|64 ] iti sūtram | tena hyevakārāpakarṣāt laukike pratyoge vibhaktitvāvacchedena vairūpyabhāvavatāmeśeṣo vidhīyate | ata eva jananīvāciparicchetṛvācinormātṛśabdayorbhyāṃmādāvapi naikaśeṣaḥ, aujasādau vairūpyāt | hariṇastrīvācakahariṇīśabdaharitavarṇaviśiṣṭastrīvācakahariṇīśabdayostvekaśeṣo bhavatyeva, puvadbhāvena taddhitādau vairūpye'pi vibhaktau vairūpyābhāvasattvāt | sa cāyamantaraṅgatvādvibhaktyutpatteḥ prāgeva, vibhakteḥ, sārūpye upalakṣaṇamātratvāt | nanu tantreṇaivedaṃ siddham, tathā hi dvividhaṃ tantram -- śabdatantram, arthatantrañca | 'arthabhodācchabdabhedaḥ' iti naye sakṛttālvoṣṭhapuṭavyāpārācchabdoccāraṇe śroturyatra vinigamanāvirahācchabdadvayajñānam, tatrādyam | tadbhede'pi śabdaikyamiti naye sakṛttālvoṣṭhapuṭavyāpāraprakāśitaikaśabdena vinigamakābhāvādanekārthabhodhe dvitīyam | yadvā, 'śveto dhāvati' iti sabhaṅgasthale ādyam, 'vidvanmānasahaṃsa' ityādāvivārthadvaye'pyekānupūrvīkatve dvitīyam | 'sakṛduccaritaḥ' iti niyame ca na mānam | tādṛśaniyamāṅgīkartṛ meta punaḥ punaranusandhānakalpane āvṛttiḥ | vastutaḥ śabdatantramevāvṛttipadenocyate | arthatantrañca tantrapadeneti bodhyam | śabdasārūpyameva cobhayatrāpi bījam | evañca tenaiva siddhe ekaśeṣo vyartha iti cet, na; 'sarūpāṇāmeka eva' iti niyamārthatvāt | tena pratyarthaṃ śabdaniveśasyāpi dṛṣṭatvena ghaṭaghaṭāvityādivāraṇārthaṃ tat, "sarūpāṇam" ityatra tantrādyāśrayaṇena 'ekavibhaktau yāni sarūpāṇyava, teṣāmeva ekaśeṣaḥ' ityaparaniyamāśrayaṇād mātṛbhyāmityādau na lokanyāyasiddhaṃ tantramapi | ayañca niyama ekārthībhāvaviṣayasahavivakṣāyāmeva 'dvandve' ityanuvartya dvandvaviṣaya eva niyamapravṛttisvīkārāt | evañca vyapekṣāyāṃ vākyaṃ bhavatyeva, anyathā ekaśeṣasya nityatvād vākyaṃ durlabhameva syāt | evañca dvandve ivaikaśeṣe'pisāhityabhānam | evañca sāhityavivakṣāyāṃ sarūpāṇāmekaśeṣa eva, na dvandvaprayogaḥ, mānasetyādau kadācit tantreṇa prayogaḥ, kadācit pṛthagapi 'vidvanmānasamāsa' iti | 'dvandve' ityananuvatyaṃ sāhityāgarbhaniyamāṅgīkāre tu ekaśeṣeṇa dvandvasyeva karmadhārayasyāpi bādhāpattau mānasamānasetyādīnāmasādhutāpattiḥ, vākyasyāsādhutāpattiśca | evañca sāhityaprakārakabodha ekaśeṣavyavahāraḥ, tadabhāve tantravyavahāraḥ | punaḥ punaramusandhānena śabdatantre āvṛttirityabhipretyaiva 'tantrāvṛttyekaśeṣāṇāmanyatamastu' iti vyavahāraḥ | kriyāpṛthaktve khalvapi dravyaikaśeṣo yathā 'akṣāḥ bhajyantām, bhakṣyantām, dīvyantām' iti "yuṣmadyupapade" [ 1|4|105 ] iti sūtrasthabhāṣye tu ekaśeṣaśabdena tatphalakatvāt tantramucyata itina virodhaḥ | vyākhyātañcaivameva 1[fn upādhyāyaiḥ = kauyaṭopādhyatairityarthaḥ | ]upādhyāyaiḥ | 'dvandve' ityasya sādhāraṇatvena samāhāradvandvaviṣaye'pyekaśeṣo bodhyaḥ | na ca napuṃsakatāpattiḥ, samāhāradvandva eva tadanuśāsanāt | ata eva 'ghaṭaghaṭam' iti prayogo na | anyathā samāhāradvandvaviṣaye ekaśeṣābhāvena durvāro dvandavo'tra syāt | evañca pratyarthaśabdaniveśapakṣe'pi 'na brāhmaṇaṃ hanyāt' ityādau sakalavyaktisaṅgrahasyaikaśeṣeṇaiva siddheḥ prativyakti lakṣaṇaṃ nāvarttyaṃ bhavatītyaparamanukūlam | samudāyasyaikatvādekavacanamevātra bodhyam | hananaṃtu tatra bādhitatvād vyaktiṣveva bhavati, 'brāhmaṇānāṃ śataṃ bhojyam' itivat | na caivam "napuṃ sakamanapuṃ sakenaikavaccāsyānyatarasyām" [ 1|2|69 ] iti sūtre ekavaditi vyartham, viśeṣasūtrāṇāṃ samāhāradvandvaviṣaye'pravṛttyarthatvāditi nirūpatiṃ śabdenduśekhare | evañca rāmāvityādau śiṣṭarāmapadanaiva sāhityaviśiṣṭarāmadvayabodhanam | yattu, dvitīyarāmaśabdasmaraṇād bodhaḥ | ata evānekārthānāṃ padānāmekārthībhavanarūpa ekārthībhāva ekaśeṣe saṅgacchate iti | tat, na; itaranivṛttimajānato bodhānāpatteḥ, pratyayānāṃ prakṛtyarthānvitasvārthabodhakatvabhaṅgāpatteśca | ekārthībhāvavyavahārastu gauṇaḥ kāraṇībhāto daṇḍa iti vadupapādyaḥ | 'dvau ca dvau ca, ekaścaikaśca' ityādāvekaśeṣadvandvāvanabhidhānānna bhavataḥ| viṃśatītyādāvekaśeṣastviṣṭa eva | nanu 'vyaktiḥ padārthaḥ' iti pakṣe yāvadvyaktiśabdaphrayoganivāraṇāya sūtrasyāvaśyakatve'pi 'jātireva padārthaḥ' iti pakṣe ekākṛtiyuktānekavyaktibodhasya tattadvibhaktisamabhivyāhāreṇa tātparyeṇa vā ekasmādapi sambhavenedaṃ vyarthamiti cet, na ; 'akṣāḥ, pādāḥ, māṣāḥ' ityādau nānākṛtiyuktānekavyaktibodhārthaṃ tatpakṣe'pi āvaśyakatvāt | na ca jātiniṣṭhajātimaṅgīkṛtya tadarthamapi sūtraṃ na kāryamiti vācyam, sarvatra tādṛśajāteḥ śakyatāvacchedakatve nānārthocchedāpatteḥ, tajjārthaṃśe pramoṣadaśāyāṃ pṛthivītvādiprakārakabodhavivakṣāyāmekaśeṣasiddhyarthaṃ sūtrasyāvaśyaktavācca | tadviṣayakodbuddhasaṃskārasya smṛteḥ, vopanāyakatvena tadaṃśe udbodhakāsamavadhānasyaiva moṣapadārthatvāt | etena 'śabdabodhe śabdasyāpi mānam' iti vādināṃ mate jātyādivat śabdasyāpi prakāratvādubhayasādhāraṇaśabdasyaiva śakyatāvacchedakatvam ityapāstam | śakteḥ padārthaghaṭitatvenārthabhedābhinnatyā śabdasyaikasambandhe nānekārthavṛttitvābhāvena tasyānugatatvābhāvācceti dik | 'vibhaktyantānāmekaśeṣaḥ' ityādipakṣadūṣaṇaṃ tu śabdenduśekhare spaṣṭam | 'brāhmaṇaśca brāhmaṇī ca brāhmaṇau' atra "pumān striyā" [ 1|2|67 ] ityekaśeṣaḥ | striyāṃ sahoktau pumān śiṣyate, strīpumarthātiriktakṛtaviśeṣaścenna bhavatīti tadarthaḥ | ata eva gaureṣa, gauścaiṣāṃ etau gāvāvityeva | ye tu, "tadarthakṛtaviśeṣasattave ekaśeṣaḥ" iti vyācakṣate, teṣāmatrāsyāprasaktau "sarūpāṇām" ityekaśeṣe kadācit strīśeṣasyāpyāpattiḥ | evamanyatrāpyūhyamityadhikaṃ śabdenduśekhare draṣṭavyam | yattu, samarthasūtre 'kimarthaṃ padagrahaṇaṃ kriyate ? varṇāśraye ānantaryamātre kāryaṃ yathā vijñāyeta, 'tiṣṭhatu dadhyaśāna tvaṃ śākena, tiṣṭhatu kumārīcchatraṃ hara devadatta' ityādinā ' bhāṣye padagrahaṇasya varṇagrahaṇa eva vyāvartyadarśanāt padaśabdenātrārthabodhakamucyate | tenārthavatsamudāyoddeśyako vidhiḥ samarthāśrita iti sūtrārthaḥ | evañcaivakaśeṣe prātipadikaprakṛtikvibādau ca na doṣaḥ, tatrāpyarthavatsamudāyasyoddeśyatvāt | ata eva "samāse'ṅguleḥ saṅgaḥ" [ 8|3|80 ] ityādau samāsagrahaṇaṃ caritārtham | tatra sakārasyaivoddeśyatvāditi bodhyam | tat, na ; viṅabhaktyante'pyekārthībhāvāpatteḥ | na ca tavāpi "nerviśaḥ" [ 1|3|17], "antarāntareṇa" [ 2|3|4 ] ityādeḥ padavidhitvādekārthībhāvābhāve apravṛttyanāpattiḥ, yatraikārthībhāvaḥ, tatraiva padoddeśyako vidhiriti tadarthāditi vācyam, sāmarthyāt pravṛtteḥ, sākṣātpadasya yatroddeśyatā, tatraiva tatparibhāṣāpravṛtteśca | ata eva pacatītyādāvuddeśyavidheyabhāvenānvayaḥ saṅgacchate | tasmādidaṃ bhāṣyaprayojanopalakṣaṇam | dhvanitañcedaṃ tatraiva bhāṣye | na caivaṃ pañcapākāśraya ityarthe 'pañcapācakaḥ' iti prayogāpattiriti vācyam, kevalakṛtsvapyekārthībhāvāhgīkārāt | kiñca, nivattabhedāyā eva kriyāyā dhātunā bodhanāt tadarthe saṅkhyānvayasya durupapādatvena na tathā prayoga iti dik | samāsatvañca saṃketaviśeṣasambandhena samāsapadavattvameva | yattu, samāsatvamarthabodhāyānanusandhīyamānavibhaktikapūrvapadakanāmasamudāyatvam, dadhi madhuramastītyādāvapi luptavibhaktyanusandhānādadoṣaḥ | ata eva bhāvanānvaye prathamāntapadajanyopasthiterhetutvaṃ saṅgacchate | nīlotpalādau tu nānusāndhānam, lopamajānato'pi bodhāt | ata eva ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣāt karmadhārayasya jyāyastvaṃ saṅgacchate | luptaṣaṣṭyādismaraṇāṅgīkāre tu lakṣaṇāvirahāt tadasaṅgatireveti | tat, na ; anantasthale vibhaktyanusandhānakalpane gauraveṇa lopamajānato bodhena ca aprathamāntapadabhinnapadajanyopasthitireva bhāvanānvayahetutvena cākṣateḥ | na ca taddadhi bhuṅkṣvetyādāvapi bhāvanānvayāpattiḥ, tasya karmatvenaivānvaye tātparyāt | anyathā tavāpi "svamornapuṃsakāt" [ 7|1|23 ] ityādiśāstrabalād vinigamanāvirahād vibhaktidvayasyāpyanusaṃdhāne doṣānuddhārastadavastha eva | kiñca, naghaṭo'stītyādyānupūrvīto bodhe vyutpannānāṃ tata eva bodhena tatrātivyāptiḥ | etenānasundhīyamānavibhaktikatvaṃ śābdabodhaprayojakānupūrvyā grāhyam | tenātra nātivyāptiḥ, ghaṭo netyādyanupūrvījñānatvenaiva bodhahetutvādityapāstam | evam 'śruterivārtham' ityādavivārthamiti samudāye'tivyāptiriti dik | evaṃ tatpuruṣatvādikamapi tena sambandhena tatpuruṣādipadavattvamevava | yattu, pūrvapadārthapradhāno'vyāyībhāvaḥ, uttarapadārthapradhānastatpuruṣaḥ, anyapadārthapradhāno bahuvrīhiḥ, ubhayapadārthapradhāno dvandva iti | tat, na ; unmattagaṅgamityanyapadārthapradhāne'vyayībhāve tallakṣaṇāvyāpteḥ, bahuvrīhilakṣaṇātivyāpteśca, tathā sūpapratītyuttarapadārthapradhāne'vyayībhāve tallakṣaṇāvyāpteḥ, tatpuruṣalakṣaṇātivyāpteśca | ardhapiplālītyāditatpuruṣe tallakṣaṇāvyāpteḥ, avyayībhāvalakṣamātivyapteśca | dvitrā ityubhayapadārthapradhānabahuvrīhau tallakṣaṇāvyāpteḥ, dvandvalakṣaṇātivyāpteśca | kiñca, asambhavo'pyeṣāṃ lakṣaṇānāṃ jahatsvārthāyāmānarthakyāt . ajahatsvārthāyāmapi padānāṃ pṛthagupasthitijanakatvābhāvena iyān pūrvapadārthaḥ, iyānutattapadārtha ityasya nirṇetumaśakyatvāt | bhūtapūrvagatilabhyamādāya tadupapādanāpekṣayā'smaduktalakṣaṇānāmeva laghutvāditi yatkiñcidetat | idaṃ punarihānyadavadheyam ---- vṛttau sarvatropasarjane viśeṣasaṅkhyāvyañjakābhāve'bhedaikatvasaṃkhyā pratīyate | saṃkhyātvena saṃkhyaiva cābhedaikatvasaṃkhyāpadena vyavahriyate | idamevābhipretya saṃkhyāviśeṣāṇāmavibhāgenāvasthānam, parityaktaviśeṣaṃ saṃkhyāsāmānyaṃ vā'bhedaikatvaṃ saṃkhyetyāhuḥ1[fn 'bharttu harayaḥ' iti śeṣaḥ | tathāhi ---- yathauṣadhirasāḥ sarve madhinyāhitaśaktayaḥ | avibhāgena varttante saṅkhyāṃ tāṃ tādaśīṃ viduḥ || iti | āhitaśaktayaḥ = samarpitā tattaddoṣavibhedanibandhanavirodharūpā śaktiryairityarthaḥ | tvaktavirodheti yāvat | ata eva avibhāgena = avirodhenetyarthaḥ | tām = abhedaikatvasaṅkhyām | tādṛśīṃ madhiniṣṭharasasthititulyāmityarthaḥ | asmin pakṣe saṃkhayātvena saṃkhyāsāmānyasyaiva bhānam, na saṃkhyāviśeṣasya | yadyapi viśeṣānāliṅgitasāmānyāsattvādidamasaṅgatamiva bhāti, tathāpi 'vandhyāsunaḥ' 'rāhoḥ śiraḥ' vikalpātmakasya saṃbhavena nāsaṅgatam | taduktam --- 'atyantāsatyapi hyarthe jñānaṃ śabdaḥ karoti hi' iti | ] | indragopādivācivarṣāsujādau tu satyapi bahuvacane saṃkhyātvenaiva saṃkhyā pratīyate, na buhutvatvādinā, ayavabahutvādyapekṣayā bahuvacanasya sattvāt | ata evaikasminnapi varṣatau jātasya bodhastataḥ saṃgacchate | spaṣṭañcedaṃ bhāṣye samarthasūtre | na ca sati prakaraṇādau 'stokābhyāṃ muktaḥ' iti samāse'luki ca sādhusyāditi vācyam, anabidhānena tatra samāsābhāvasya bhāṣye siddhāntitatvāt stokānmukta ityāditaeva prakaraṇasahakṛtāt tathā pratītiriti tadbhāvaḥ | ekavacanaṃ tvautsargikam | idamevābhipretya 'dantoṣṭhasya dantāḥ snigdhatarāḥ' ityādau pāribhāṣikadvivacanābhāvena samāhārasyaikatvena guṇabhūtavarttipadārthānāṃ ca bahutvena dvivacanopapadatvābhāvāt tarap na prāpnoti ' ityāśaṅkyā, vṛttau bhedasya parityāgādabhedalakṣaṇaikatvasaṃkhyāyāścopādānādevambhūtadantoṣṭhalakṣaṇārthadvayāśrayaḥ pratyaya iti "dvivacanavibhajyopapade" [ 5|3|57 ] iti sūtrasthabhāṣyādāvuktam | yadā tu tatrāpi prakaraṇādinā saṃkhyāviśeṣāvagamaḥ, tadā na bhavatyeva tarap | 'plakṣanyagrodhānāṃ plakṣā dīrghatamāḥ' ityādau tu na tarap | 'plakṣanayagrodhānāṃ palkṣā dīrghatamāḥ' ityādau tu na tarap, bahuvacanenāvayaveṣu saṃkhyāviśeṣasyaiva pratīteḥ | nanvasyā abhedaikatvasaṃkhyāśabdena vyavāhare kiṃ vinigamakam ? abhedadvitvādiśabdenāpi tatsaṃbhavāditi cet, 1[fn 'kapiñjalānālabheta' iti vākyena bahutvavyāpyasaṃkhyāviśiṣṭakapiñjalālambhanaṃ vidhīyate| tatra trayāṇāṃ caturādīnāṃ vā ālambhanamiti saṃśaye bahutvavyāpyatvasya tritvādiṣu sarveṣvaviśiṣṭatvād yathāprāptamevālabdhavyamiti pūrvapakṣe caturādīnāmālambhanam 'mā hiṃsyāt' iti sāmānyaśāstravihitaniṣedhasyālambhanavad vyaktītaraparatvarūpatāvatparyasaṃkocakalpane gauravād gaṇanāyāṃ prathamopasthitatritvaparatayāpi vacanasya cāratārthyāt lāghavācca bahutvena tritvameva bahuvacanārtha iti siddhāntitam | tannyāyādatrāpi saṃkhyātvenaikatvasyaiva vṛttyarthatvam, na tu dvitvādīnām, apratīyamānaviśeṣadharmakaikatvamabhedaikatvamiti vyutpatterityadhikaraṇasya tātparyam | ] kapiñjalādhikaraṇanyāyenaikatvasya prathamopasthitatvāditi gṛhāṇa | evañcaitadartho'pyekārthībhāva āvaśyaka ityāhuḥ | apare tu, nātra saṃkhyātvena saṃkhyāvat svasambandhini lakṣaṇā, mānābhāvāt, tathābodhānubhāvācca | na ca jijñāsānurodhāt tathākalpanam, na hi śabdajanyatathājñānaṃ viśeṣajijñāsāyāṃ niyāmakam | āmraphaladarśanamātreṇa viśeṣarasajijñāsānāpatteḥ, dravyasya saṃkhyā'vyabhicāreṇa tajjñānasambhavācca, jñānecchayorviśiṣya hetuhetumadbhāvānurodhena viśiṣyaiva vācyatāpatteśca | tasmāt saṃkhyāyā abhāvameva | 'abhedaikatvasaṃkhyā' ityasya cāyamarthaḥ --- bhedaśabdena tatsaddhacaritaṃ dvitvādi | tasyaikatvasya cāpratītirityeva 'varṣāsujaḥ' ityādāvapi tadbhānameva | prakaraṇādisattve tu bhavatyeva viśiṣya tadbhānam | tatra paraṃ bhavatyeva tena rūpema lakṣaṇā | dhvanitaṃ cedam "pañcamyāstokādibhyaḥ" [ 6|3|2 ] iti sūtre padamañjaryāmiti prāhuḥ | "samarthaṃ" sūtre kaiyaṭe ca matadvayamapi spaṣṭam | yattu mīmāṃsakāḥ -- "samarthaḥ padavidhiḥ" iti sūtre sāmarthyamitaranairapekṣyam, padavidhiśabdena ca padasya sampādako vidhiḥ "kartṛ karaṇayoḥ" [ 2|3|18 ] ityādiḥ gṛhyate | tathā ca padavidhividheya itaranirapekṣatvārthabodhaka ityarthaḥ | ata eva 'vrīhibhiryajeta, yavairvā yajeta' ityādivākyebhya itaranirapekṣairvrīhibhiryavaiśca yāgasiddhiḥ | itaracca sajātīyameva gṛhyate | tena 'daṇḍena cakreṇa ghaṭaṃ karoti' itiyādīnāṃ nāsādhutā | samarthasatrāvṛttyā ca bhavaduktārthasayāpi siddhiriti | tat, na; āvṛttau mānābhāvāt | 'paśya mṛgo dhāvati,' 'pacati bhavati' ityādau taduktasāmarthyapratyāyakābhāve'pi viśeṣaṇasyāyogavyavacchedānyayogavyavacchedaphalakatvena nyāyata evetaranirapekṣakarmatvādibodhasyeva vrīhibhirityādāvapi tasya saṃbhavena phalābhāvācca | gārgya ityādau pratyayavidheḥ padatvasampādakatvābhāvena tvaduktārthakaparibhāṣā'pravṛttau itaranirapekṣagargāpatyatvādibodhānāpatteśca | yathākathañcit padavidhitvāśrayeṇa tu vyākaraṇe śāstramātrasya tathātvena 'padavidhiḥ' ityasya vaiyarthyāpattiḥ, padavidhirityasya tadvidheye lakṣaṇāpatteśceti sarvaṣṭasiddhiḥ | <23> atha samastapadeṣu kliṣṭeṣu bodho likhyate pūrva bhūto bhūtapūrvaḥ | pūrnamiti ktiyāviśeṣaṇam, bhūdhāturutpattyanukūlavyāpārārthaḥ, pīrvaśabdaśca pūrvakālavṛttiparaḥ | evañca pūrvakālavṛttyatītotpattyanukūlavyāpārāśraya iti bodhaḥ | apadiśam--atra vṛttiviṣaye 'apa' śabdo madhyadyotakaḥ, diśormadhyamityarthaḥ | barau ityadhihari--atrādhiḥ adhikaraṇaśaktidyotako harirūpādhikaraṇa ityarthaḥ | upakṛṣṇamityatra upaḥ samīpadyotakaḥ kṛṣṇasamīpam ityarthaḥ | duryavanam--ityatra duḥśabdaḥ ṛddhayabhāvasya dyotakaḥ | yavanasambandho ṛddhyabhāva iti bodhaḥ | ṛddhirdhanādimattavam | nidrā sampaprati na yujyate ityatinidram--atra nidrāśabdena nidrākartṛkavarttamānayuktatvakriyābhāvo lakṣyate | etaddyotako'tiḥ |atinidramāsīdityādiprayogeṣu atinidramitya tathā vyavahāraviṣaye lakṣaṇetyāhuḥ | vṛttau viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvavaiparītyena varttamānayuktatvābhāvavatī nidreti bodha ityanye | itiharīti--hariśabdaḥ svarūpaparaḥ, itiḥ prakāśadyotakaḥ, hariśabdasambandhī prakāśa iti bodhaḥ | anurūpamityasya rūpapratiyogikayogvadityarthaḥ | yogyatādyotako'nuḥ | yathāśakti--samabhivyāhṛtapadārthānatikramo'tra yathāśabdadyotyaḥ | sahari devadattaḥ--ityatra devadattavṛttiharipratiyogikasādṛśyamiti bodhaḥ | anujyeṣṭhaṃ praṇamatītyādau jyeṣṭhakrameṇa pramamatītyarthaḥ | sacakramityatra cakrapratiyogikaikakālikatvasamaniyatasāhityavaditi bodhaḥ, yaugapadyārthena samāsavidhānāditi bodhyam | prakṛte'pi yaugapadyasya guṇatayā praveśānna doṣaḥ | sakṣatram--atra kṣatraśabdo bhāvapradhānaḥ, kṣatriyatvaviṣayā saṃpattiriti bodhaḥ | sahabdaḥ sampattyathaḥ | anurūpa ātmabhāvaḥ saṃpattiḥ--yogyasvapravṛttinimittavattavamiti yāvat | satṛmamatti--atra buddhiviśeṣaviṣayatvarūpaṃ sāhityaṃ sahārthaḥ | tṛṇasahitamityarthaḥ | tena hi sakalamabhyavahārya bhuṅkta iti pratīyate, yastṛṇāni bhaśkṣayet, kathamanyat sa parityajediti pratīteḥ | atraiva cāsya tātparyam, na tu tṛṇabhakṣaṇe | nāttityeva bodha ityapi kaścit | sāgni adhīte--atrāpi agnigranthasahitamiti vācyo'rthaḥ | tatsahitādhyayanena catadantagranthādhyayanasamāptirgamyate | etāvataivāntavacanatvaṃ sahasya | kecittu, antatvaṃ sāhityañca sahadyotyam | tenāntyāgnigranthasahitakarmakamadhyayanamiti bodha ityāhuḥ | yāvacchlokamacyutapramāmāḥ--parimāṇaparicchedyatvaṃ yāvaddyotyam, ślokaparimāṇabhūtasaṃkhyāparicchinnāḥ praṇāmā iti bodhaḥ | akṣaparītyādau viparītavarttanaṃ paryarthaḥ | vaiparītyañca jayāpekṣayā | akṣāṇāñca karaṇatvenānvayaḥ | akṣakaraṇakaviparītavarttanamiti bodhaḥ | parājaya iti yāvat | anuvanamaśanirgataḥ--atra vanaśabdasya samopaparatvam tadgatalaṇatvañcānudyotyam | evañca vanasamīpadeśaniṣṭhajñāpakatānirūpitajñāpyatāvadgamanakarmībhuto'śaniriti bodhaḥ | anugaṅga vāraṇasī--ihāyāmaḥ, tadgatalakṣaṇatvañcānudyotyam | lakṣyañca vārāṇasyāyāmaḥ, vārāṇasyāḥ svarūpeṇājñāpyatvāt | evañca gaṅkāpadena gaṅkādairghayavatī lakṣyate | dairghyajñāpakatvaṃ dairghyasya sadṛśatveneti bodhyam | pāregaṅgāpārāditi, ṣaṣṭhīsamāsena vyākhyātam | ddhimuni vyākaraṇasya--vyākaraṇasambandhivaṃśyatvavantau dvau munī iti bodhaḥ | vaṃśyatvamekārthībhāvagamyam | dvimunivyākaraṇamityatra vaiśyatvavaddvimūnyabhinnaṃ vyākaraṇamiti bodhaḥ | vidyātadvatorabhedavivakṣayāsādhu | saptagaṅgamityādau saptagaṅgāsamāhāra iti bodhaḥ | unmattagaṅgamityadau unmattagaṅgādhikaraṇībhūta iti bodhaḥ | ityavyayībhāvaḥ | <24> atha tatpuruṣavicāraḥ kṛṣṇaśritaḥ--ityādau ca kṛṣṇakarmaśrayaṇakarttetyādirītyā bodhaḥ | kṛṣṇādeḥ samudāyaśakti labhyakarmatādisaṃrgeṇottarapadārthe'nvayaḥ | evamanyatrāpyūhyam | svayaṅkṛtaḥ--ityasya svatakartṛkakṛtikarmeti bodhaḥ | ata evāyaṃ nityasarthe kartṛśaktipradhānaḥ | khaṭvārūṭhaśabdo'samīkṣyakāriṇi kevalarūṭhaḥ | ata avāyaṃ nityasamāsaḥ, vākyāt tadarthāpratīteḥ | māsapramita iti | māsaviṣayakaparicchedakartteti bodhaḥ | "ādikarmaṇi ktaḥ kattari ca" [3|4|71] | śaṅkulayā kṛtaḥ khaṇḍaḥ, śaṅkulākhaṇḍa ityādau kṛddvārakasāmarthya eva pravarttate, na sākṣāt parasparānvaye, nāpyanyakriyādvārā sāmarthye iti bhāṣye spaṣṭam | dhānyenārthaḥ, dhānyārthaḥ--prakṛtyāditvāt tṛtīyā | arthaśabdo dhanavāci, dhānyābhinnaṃ dhanamiti bodhaḥ | māsena pūrvo māsapūrvaḥ--atrāvadhyutpattikālataddhvaṃsānadhikaraṇakālotpattikaḥ pūrvaśabdārthaḥ | tadekadeśe kāle māsasyābhedenānvayaḥ | māṣeṇonaṃ māṣonam | ūnārtho'bhāvavān | tatra abhāve māṣādeḥ, pratiyogitayā'nvayaḥ | vākkalahaḥ--kalahaḥ krodhapūrvako vyāpāraḥ | tatra vācaḥ sambandhitvenānvayaḥ | ācāranipuṇaḥ--ācārahetukanaipuṇyavānityarthaḥ | guḍamiśraḥ--atra miśraśabdārthaḥ saṃyogavān | tadekadeśe saṃyoge guḍasya pratiyogitayānvayaḥ | ācāranipuṇenācāraślakṣṇo vyākhyātaḥ | ślakṣṇa ujjvalaḥ | kākapeyā nado--kākakartṛkapānakarmetyarthaḥ | pūrṇāmbhastvena stutiḥ, alpāmbhastvena nindā vā vyāṅgyā | dadhyodanaḥ--atra dadhyupasikta odana iti bodhaḥ | ekārthībhāvalabhya upasekaḥ | yūpāya dāru yupadāru | atra tādarthyacaturthyantena samāsaḥ | so'pi prakṛtivikṛtibhāva eva | aśvadhāsādayastu ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣa ityanyatra vistaraḥ | sarveṣāṃ śvtataraḥ sarvaśvetaḥ | dravyāntarādheyaśvetāpekṣayā sarveṣāṃ paṭānāmadhiko'yaṃ śveto guṇa ityarthaḥ | yadvā sarveṣāṃ madhye śvetatara ityarthaḥ | na ca tamabāpattiḥ, bahunāṃ nirdhāraṇe'pa kvacit tarapaḥ svikārādityāhuḥ | pūrvakāyo'rdhapippalītyādau kāyasambandhipūrvo'vayava ityādikrameṇa bodhaḥ | pūvapadārthaprādhānyamatra | yadā tu kīyādiśabdānāṃ tadavayave lakṣaṇā, tadā kāyāvayavābhinnaḥ pūrvo bhāga iti bodhaḥ | māso jātasya māsajātaḥ | atra yadyapi vigrahe māsaḥ pradhānam, tadāpi vṛttau jāto māsajāto dṛśyatāmityādau jātasāyaiva darśanakarmatvādipratīteḥ | idameva dhvanayituṃ vigrahe 'yasya saḥ' ityapi prayujyate kaiśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvavyatyāsaścaikārthībhāvasādhyaḥ | jātaparicchedako māsa iti bodho vigrahe, māsaparicchedyo jāta iti vṛttau | jātasya pariccedyatvaṃ tu paricchedajananāśrayatvena | asya jātasya kiyān kāla iti praśne māsajāta ityasyottaratvaṃ tvārtha vodhyam | pare tu jātottaramāsa iti vigrahe bodhaḥ| uttarakālikatvaṃ ṣaṣṭhacarthaḥ, samāse jātottaratvaṃ ca jananottaratvamādāya |idameva dhvanayitum 'yasya saḥ' ityuktam | asāmānādhikaraṇyād bahuvrīhyaprāptirityāhuḥ | tattu kvacidvacadhikaraṇānāmapi bahuvrīhidarśanāccintyam | parva snātaḥ, paścādanuliptaḥ snātābhinnaḥ snānottarakālikānulepanāśraya iti bodhaḥ | idañcaikārthībhāvagamyam | pañcānāṃ gavāṃ samāhāraḥ pañcagavam: pañcasaṃkhyākagosamāhāra ityarthaḥ | ghanaśyāmaḥ--ghanasadṛśābhinnaḥ śyāma iti, ghanābhinnaḥ śyāma iti vā bodhaḥ | iha vṛttau vigrahe ca pūrvapadaṃ tatsadṛśe lākṣaṇikam, āropitaṃ vā | idameva dhvanayituṃ vigrahe ivaḥ prayujyate | ata eva mṛgīva capalā mṛgacapaletyādausamānādhikaraṇottarapadaparatvanibandhanapuṃvadbhāvaḥ | sādś‌yañcopasthitaśyāmatvādinetyanyatra vistaraḥ | puruṣavyāghraḥ--atrottarapadaṃ tatsadṛśe lākṣaṇikam, āropitaṃ vā | pūrvapadārthaviśeṣyako bodhaḥ | "upamitaṃ vyaghrādibhiḥ sāmānyāprayoge" [2|2|56] iti samāsaḥ | prasanne dṛgabjenetyādau nopāttadharmeṇa sādṛśyam, kintvanupāttenaiveti sāmānyaprayogo'styeveti na doṣaḥ | vastuta idaṃ sūtraṃ samānaliṅgavacanatva eva pravarttate, samānādhikaraṇādhikārāt | ata eva "paravalliṅgam" [2|4|26]iti sūtre 'tatpuruṣaścāpi kaḥ prayojati, yaḥ pūrvapadārthapradhāna ekadeśisamāsaḥ' iti bhāṣyam, 'dvandvaikadeśinoḥ' iti nyāsaṃ kṛtvā tatpuruṣagrahaṇaṃ pratyākhyātañca bhāṣyoktaṃ saṃgacchate | anyathā dṛgabjenetyādau pūrvarapadarthapradhānasya dṛśyamānaparavalliṅgasya tyāge bījābhāvena tadasaṃgatiḥ spaṣṭaiva | dṛgabjamityādau tu viśeṣaṇasamāsa eva | dṛgabjena bīkṣata ityādau vīkṣaṇānvayastu pradhāne[ve] dṛktādatmyapratītyā nirbādha eva | ata evātra pariṇāmālaṅkāramāhurālaṅkarikanavyāḥ | mukhacandra ityādāvapi viśeṣaṇasamāsa eva | candrarūpakatvavyavahārastu samānavittivedyatayā candrapratiyogikābhedasyāpi mukhe pratiterārthamādāya | anyo rājāntaramityādestu mayūravyaṃsakāditvādeva paravalliṅgatā bodhyā | tatrāntaraśabdo bhinnavācī, abhedena pūrvapadārthe viśeśaṇam | pūrvapadajanyabodhaprakārāśrayabuddhisthayatkiñcit pratiyogitvañca bhede vyutpattiviśeṣabalalabhyamityāhuḥ | apare tu, "upamitam" iti samāso'pyuttarapadārthapradhāna evetyāhuḥ | nañsamāse bodhastu nañarthanirṇaye nirūpitaḥ | pragata ācāryaḥ prācāryaḥ, niṣkrantaḥ kauśāmbyā niṣkauṣāmbirityādau gatakrantādyarthabhānaṃ vṛttāvekārthībhāvabalāt | iti tatpuruṣavicāraḥ | <25> trpratha bahuvrīhivicāraḥ prāptamudakaṃ yaṃ sa prāptodako grāmaḥ | atrodakakartṛkaprāptikarmībhūto grāma iti bodho vṛttau | yatkarmakaprāptikartrudakamiti vigrahe | evamūḍharatho'naḍvānityādāvapyūhyam | tadupapattistu prāgutkaiva | daśānāṃ sanīpe ye sanpi, te upadaśāḥ | ātropaḥ samīpaparaḥ | daśapadārthasya svavṛttidaśatvapratiyogikatvasambandhena sāmīpye'nvayaḥ | daśasamīpavanta iti bodhaḥ | īdṛśasambandhenaivānvaye'sya sādhutvam, ekārthībhāvabalāt; "saṃkhyayā'vyaya " [2|2|25] ityādisūtravalācca bodhyam | ata eva navaikādaśa vā'nena pratyāyyante, na tu daśānāṃ vṛkṣādīnāṃ samīpe ye gavādayaḥ, te pratyāyyante | etenāsannarviśāḥ, adūrtriśā iti vyākhyātam | adhikacatvārriśāḥ--atra catvārriśadbhyo'dhikā ityarthaḥ | dvau vā trayo vā dvitrāḥ--atra vāśabdo vīrodhajyotakaḥ | sa caikakālikaikādhikaraṇāvṛttitvarūpavirodho bhāsate | kvacittu, 'vrīhibhiryajeta, yavairyajeta' ityādau vāśabdaṃ vināpi tātparyavaśāt tṛtīyayā nirapekṣasādhanatvavodhanena samuccayāsambhavācca vikalpo bodhyat, caṃ vināpi samuccayavat | atrāpi parasparanirapekṣasyaiva anekasya kriyāyāmanvayaḥ, ekasya kriyānvayottaramaparasyāvṛttyā tadanvayāt | evañcātra samabhivyāhṛtakārakaviśiṣṭakriyāyāṃ vibhinnakālikatvaṃ vāśabdadyotyam | kvacittu, samabhivyāhṛtārthapratiyogikābhāvo'pi vāśabdadyotyaḥ | yathā "dīrghāt padāntād vā" [6|7|276] ityādau sthaṇurnavetyādau saṃśayātmakajñānajanaka ekādhikaraṇāvṛttitvarūpa eva virodho vārthaḥ, anyatarakoṭeḥ sarvathā bādhyatvāt | bhinnabhinnakoṭyupasyitirapi vāśabdasamabhivyāhāradeva; anyathā sthāṇurnetyukte sthāṇubhinna ityeva pratītyāpattiḥ | kvacittu, ekakālika ekādheyānadhikaraśatvarūpo virodho vārthaḥ | yathā paṭe ghaṭe vā saundaryamityatra kāryānvaye ca vikalpaḥ, na tu śabdādupasthitau | ataḥ śabdānniyamena bahūnāmupasthiternityabahuvacanāntataivetyanyatra vistaraḥ | dvirāvṛttā daśa dvidaśāḥ | atra sujarthāntarbhāveṇa vṛttiḥ, ekārthībhāvabalādityāhuḥ | dakṣiṇasyāḥ pūrvasyāśca diśo'ntarālaṃ dakṣiṇapūrvā ityādau daṇipūrvobhayamadhyadigityarthaḥ, ekārthībhāvabalāt | samudāyasya hi madhyadik śakyā | keśeṣu keśeṣugṛhitvā idaṃ yuddhaṃ pravṛttaṃ kāśākeśi | atra bigrahe ktvāpratyayo'dhyāhṛtasthityādikriyāmādāya bodhyaḥ | graṇakarmatvañca pratyāsattyā keśādiviśiṣṭapuruṣayoreva | parasamaparagrahaṇādirūpaḥ karmavyatihāraḥ samudāyaśkyaḥ, yuddhādirūpakriyā ca | evañca parasparakeśādhikaraṇakatadvat puruṣakarmakagrahaṇottarakālikasthatikartṛpuruṣakartṛkā kriyā iti bodhaḥ | kriyā yuddhādirūpeti kvacit prakaraṇāt, kvacid yuddhādivācakapadasamabhivyāhārāt | yathā--- mṛdhaṃ kimachatrakadaṇḍatāṇḍavaṃ bhujābhuji kṣoṇibhṛtāṃ didṛkṣavaḥ | ityādau | etena 'karṇākarṇi prathitamayaśaḥ' iti, 'hastāhastimiṣāt spṛśan kucataṭīm' ityādi vyākhyātam | ādye karṇābhyāṃ karṇābhyāmākarṇya idaṃ pradhanaṃ pravṛttamiti vigrahaḥ, prathitamiti kriyāśeṣaṇametat | etenedṛśasamāso yuddharūpārthe eveti kaiyaṭadyuktaṃ parāstamityanyatra vistaraḥ . saputro gata ityādi sahaputreṇa gata ityanena subarthavāde nirūpitabodhena vyākhyātam | iti bahuvrihivicaraḥ | <26> atha dvandvavicāraḥ dhavakhadirau ityādau sahitau dhavakhadirāviti bodhaḥ | pāṇipādamityādau pāṇipādasamāhara iti bodhaḥ | upadaśam, dantoṣṭhamityatra daśasamīpadantoṣṭhasamāhāraḥ | samāhare daśa samīpatvaca svavṛttidaśatvasaṃkhyāpratiyogikasāmīpyavat‌saṃkhyāvadavayavakatveneti bodhyam | upadaśamityavyābhībhāvaḥ | bahuvrīhestu nānuprayogaḥ, tasya nityabahuvacanāntatvena dantoṣṭhamityanenānvayāyogyatvāt | anayaiva diśā anyatrāpyūhyam | iti dvandvavicāraḥ | iti samāsādiśaktivicāraḥ | <27> atha subantaprakṛtikakyajādyaratho nirūpyate tatra 'ghaṭamicchitīti ghaṭiyati devadattaḥ' ityatra kyajartha icchā, prakṛteśrva kartṛsambandhini ghaṭe lakṣaṇā | ata eva putrīyatyātmānaṃ devadatta iti na | ata eva 'asyākarmakatvāditaḥ karmaṇi lakāro na' iti "supa ātmanaḥ" [3|2| ] iti sūtrasthaṃ bhāṣyaṃ saṅgacchate | atra ca kyajeva tātparyagrāhakaḥ | "supa ātmanaḥ kyac" iti sūtrāt eṣitṛsambandhīchākarmavācakādicchāyāṃ kyajiti tadarthaḥ | evañca ekadevadattakarttṛ kā svasambandhighaṭakarmikeccheti bodhaḥ | karmatvaṃ tu viśiṣṭaśaktilabhyam | kāmyaci apyevameva | tathā "upamānādācāre" [3|2|220] iti sūtreṇāpi kyac | upamānavācakāt karmaṇaḥ ācāre kyajityarthaḥ | upamānañcātracaranirūpitameva gṛhyate, pratyāsatteḥ | 'viṣṇūyati dvijam' ityudāharaṇam | tatra viṣṇupadaṃ viṣṇukarmakācārasadṛśarthakam | ācāraḥ kyajarthaḥ | evañca 'ekadevadattakarttṛ ko dvijakarmako viṣṇukarmakācārasadṛśa ācāraḥ' iti bodhaḥ | tatra pratyāsattyā viṣṇukarmakācāro'pi devadattādikarttṛ ka eva, 'ātmanaḥ' ityanuvṛttervā | na caitanmate 'suparvabhiḥ śobhitaṃ triviṣṭapaṃ bhāratāyate' ityatrāpyanupapattiḥ, bhāratācārasadṛśācārasya triviṣṭabvṛtteraprasiddheḥ | suparvabhiḥ śobhitamityatra tu śleṣeṇābhedādhyavasāya eva, na sādṛśyādhyavasāya iti vācyam, ekaśabdopāttatvenābhedabuddheriva śabdarūpasādharmyeṇa sādṛśyabuddherapṭupapatteḥ | 'kṛṣṇāyate devadattaḥ' ityatra kṛṣṇa ivācaratītyarthe kyaṅ | atrāpi kyaṅprakṛteḥ kṛṣṇākartṛkācārasadṛśo'rthaḥ | kyarṅtha ācāraḥ | tathāca 'kṛṣṇakartṛkācārasadṛśa ekadevadattakartṛka ācāraḥ' iti bodhaḥ | viṣṇudvijayoḥ kṛṣṇadevadattayośrva upamānopameyabhāvo'rthād gamyate, na tu śābda iti dhyeyam | atra putrakṛṣṇādipadārthānāṃ kyajādyarthenaikārthībhāve sādhyatvenaiva bhānam, śabdaśaktisvabhāvāt | ata eva 'vyākaraṇaṃ sūtraṃ karoti' itivākye sambandhitvenānvitasyāpi vyākaraṇasya 'vyākaraṇaṃ sūtrayati' ityādau karmatvamityādyūhyam | iti kyajādyarthavicāraḥ | <28> atha subantaprakṛtikataddhitārtho nirupyate tatra "tasyāpatyam" [ 4|1|92 ] ityevañjātīyasūtrairvihitānāmapatyādyarthaḥ | ṣaṣṭhyādyarthaśca samudāyagamyaḥ | tena 'aupagavaḥ' ityādeḥ 'upagusambadhyapatyam' ityarthaḥ | atrāryekārthībhāvāṅgīkārānna viśeṣaṇādyanvaya iti nirūpitam | "sāsya devatā" [ 4|2|24 ] ityasyodāhaṇe āgneyādau devatāviśiṣṭaṃ1[fn vaiśiṣṭyañca svasvāmibhāvasambandhena, svāddeśyakatyāgākarmatvasambandhena vā bodhyam | ] deyaṃ patyayārthaḥ | prakṛtyarthaḥ pratyayārthaikadeśe abhedena viśeṣaṇam | yadvā, 2[fn devatātvañca 'diveraiśvaryakarmaṇo devatā' iti 'devāttal' iti sūtrabhāṣyād mantrakaraṇakahavistyāgajanyasvargādiphalātiriktaphalāśrayatvam, mantrastutyatvaṃ ca anukramaṇikāyāmuktam ---- yasya vākyam, sa ṛṣiḥ, yā'nenocyate sā devateti | ata eva aindro mantraḥ, aindraṃ haviriti dvividhaprayogasiddhiriti | ] devatāyāṃ pradeye ca bhinnaiva śaktiḥ, ato naikadeśānvayaḥ | evañca 'agnyābhinnadevatāsambandhī' iti bodhaḥ | pradeyañca sambandhitvenaiva pratyayārthaḥ, pradeyamiti mantrasyāpyupalakṣam | na caindrādipadaireva devatāyā upasthitatvena tatra pratyayasya śaktirvyartheti vācyam, devatātvena rūpeṇa tata upasthityabhāvāt | ābhikṣādipadaiśca sambandhitvena buddhasyaiva pradeyasya viśeṣasamarpaṇaṃ kriyata iti3[fn bhūṣaṇakārā ityarthaḥ | ] prāñcaḥ | navyāstu, caturthyādau prakṛtyarthasya prakṛtyaiva labdhasya caturthyoddeśyatvamātraṃ yathocyate | evamatrāpi devatātvaṃ pradeyaśrva pratyayārthaḥ | tatra pradeye devatātvasya nirūpakatāsambandhenānvayaḥ | evañcāgnivṛttidevatātvanirūpakamiti bodhaḥ | nanvevam-- taddhitena caturthyā vā mantravarṇona |] eva pratyayasya śaktiḥ | sūtre'pi devattyetat prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇameva | sā ceyaṃ prakṛterlakṣaṇā2 [fn tathā ca śakyādanyena rūpekhga jñāte bhavati lakṣaṇā' iti va-ddhoktedavāyā indrasvarūpāyāḥ
