dhnābhinnavāsādhikaraṇasambandhīti bodhaḥ | nivāsaśca pratyayārthasambambandhikarttṛ ka eva | ata eva kādācitkannudhnavāsakarttari na tathā prayogaḥ | ] [4|3| 9], "sāsmin paurṇamāsī" [4|2|29] ityevañjātīyakeṣūhyam | "tena dīvyāti" [4|4|2] ityādinā akṣairdīvyatyākṣika ityādau pratyayaḥ | tatra dīvyatītyatra tiṅante kriyāyāḥ prādhānye'pi vṛttau viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvavyatyāso bodhyaḥ, 'sattvapradhānāni nāmāni' iti siddhāntāt, pūrvottarasāhacaryācca, tenākṣakaraṇakadevanakartteti bodhaḥ| kālapuruṣasaṃkhyāstu na lilakṣitā eva | evamanyatrāpyūhyam | evam 'tadadhīte tadveda' [4|2|59] ityādāvapyūhyam | "tena tulyaṃ kriyā cedvatiḥ" [5|1|115] upameyasya kriyātve upamānavācakāt tṛtīyāntāt tulyamityarthe vatiriti sūtrarthaḥ | nanvevam 'brāhyaṇavadadhīte' ityādau na syat, nahi vā brāhyaṇapratiyogikasādṛśyamadhyayanakriyāyām, atyantabhedāt | na ca brāhyaṇādiśabdānāṃ tatkartṛ kādhyayane lākṣaṇikatvānna doṣaḥ, sauṣṭhavādiśca sādhāraṇī dharma iti vācyam, mandatvāt sthātavyatulyaṃ gamanaṃ sthātavyavad gamanamityādāvalākṣaṇike cāritārthyāditi cet, na; tṛtīyopāttavibhaktyarthānvayena, sādhāraṇadharmādhāratvena ca tasyāpi ttvarūpatayā sukhyakriyāvācakasyāsambhavena sāmarthyād bhūtarūrvagrahaṇe brāhyaṇavadadhīta ityādāvapyadoṣāt | evañcāsya kriyānvaya eva sādhutvam | aravindavat sundaramukhamityādau bhavatikriyā adhyāhāryā | aravindapadena ca sundarāravindabhavanaṃ lakṣyate | tathā ca sundarāravindabhavanasadṛśaṃ sundaramikhabhavanamiti śābdabodhaḥ | tataḥ paśrvādaravindamukhayoḥ saundaryadharmakasādṛśyaṃ vyañjanayā, manasā vā budhyata iti bodhyam | ata eva brāhyaṇena tulyā'sya gaurityādau na vatiḥ, "tatra tasyeva" [5|9|996] iti vatiḥ taddravyaguṇāditutrasya vistāra ityādi | tatra sādṛṣyaṃ vatyarthaḥ | muthurāpratiyogikasādṛṣyavatpāṭaliputre prākāra iti bodhaḥ | upamānopameyayoḥ samānavibhaktitvasya "upamānāni sāmānyavacanaiḥ" [2|1|55] ityanena jñāpanādupamāne saptamī | prākāraśrva sādṛśyamūlakābhedajñānaviṣayaḥ sādhāraṇo dharmaḥ | vastuto mathurāyāmiveti vākyaprākārādipadādhyāhāreṇaiva bodhaḥ |prākārayośrva upamānopameyabhāvaḥ | evañca prākāranirūpitādhikaraṇatve evobhayatrāpi saptamī | vṛttau tu mathurādipadānāṃ tadadhikaraṇakaprākārādau lakṣaṇā, mathurāpāṭaliputrayoḥ sādṛśyārthameveti bodhyam | anye tu--vigrahe'pi mathurādipadaṃ vṛttāviva lākṣaṇikam | saptamīṣaṣṭhacau tu asmādeva jñāpakāt prathamārthe | dhvanitañcedaṃ bhāṣye ityāhuḥ | vidhivat pūñyata ityatra vidhikarmakaṃ devadattakartṛkaṃ pūjanamiti bodhaḥ | vidhiśabdeva jñāpakāt prathamārthe | dhvanitañcedaṃ bhāṣye ityāhuḥ | vidhivat pūjyata ityatra vidhikarmakaṃ devadattakartṛkaṃ devadattakartṛkaṃ pūjanamiti bodhaḥ | vidhiśabdena taduktaḥ prakāra ityādyūhyam | atha bhāvapratyayārtho vicāryate-- atra kecit--ghacatvamityādau prakṛtiḥ śabdasvarūpaparā, tattadrūpeṇa prakārastvādyarthaḥ | sa cāṅkākṣāvaśāt prakṛtijanyabodhīyamikhyaviśeṣyatānirūpitaprakāratāśraya eva | tena rājapuruṣa ityādau rājatvādeḥ prakāratve'pi na kṣatiḥ | janyabodhaprakāratvaṃ tu saṃsargaḥ | evañca gotvamityādau gośabdajanyabodhaprakāro gotvamityarthaḥ | sa ca prakāraḥ pravṛttinimittabhūta eva | ata eva śābdabodhe śabdasyāpi bhānamitivādināṃ mate ghaṭatvamityādau na śabde bhāvapratyayaḥ | tathā ca bhāṣyam--'sarve bhāvāḥ svenārthena bhavanti, sa teṣāmartha iti | tadabhidhāne tvatalau bhavataḥ' iti | bhavanti vācakatvena pravarttanta iti bhāvāḥ śabdāḥ, te svasya vācyo yo'rthaḥ, tena bhavanti | vācakatvena pravarttante, arthapratyāyanārtha śabdaprayogāt |śabdabhavane'rthasya karaṇatvavivakṣayā tṛtīyā | yattadornityasambandhāt yasmādityapekṣyate | yatpravṛttinimittavaśād vācyārthena karaṇena svapratyāyanāya loke śabdāḥ prayujante, sa pravṛttinimitto'rthaḥ | prāduktasambandhena śabdasambandhī bhāvapratyayārtha iti bhāvaḥ | pravṛttinimittaṃ ghaṭādiṣu ghaṭatvādijhātiḥ, śuklādiśabdeṣu guṇāḥ, pācakādiṣu śabdeṣu kriyā, rājapurūṣādiśabdeṣu sambandhaḥ, ḍitthādiṣu śabdasvarūpameveti sarvamanubhavānurodhādavaseyam | evañca tattacchabdapravṛttinimittamityādiprakāreṇa bodhaḥ | yattu vadanti--'śabdo'pi śābdabodhe bhāsateḥ, iti nāmārthanirṇaye nirṇītam | sa ca śaktisambandhenaiva prakāraḥ | śaktiśrva śabdaikye'pi nānaiveti na nānārthocchedaḥ | astu vā, ekā śaktiḥ, tathāpi na nānārthocchedaḥ, sarvanāmavat | tathāhiyathā sarvanāmasthale'nubhavānurodhāt sarvanāmnāṃ viśiṣyopasthāpakatvamiti sarvasiddham | yathā ca tatra buddhiviṣayatvarūpeṇopasthāpitaghaṭatvapvādiśāliṣu buddhiviṣayavati śaktaṃ tat padamityeva śaktigrahaḥ | buddhiviṣayatvaṃ tūpasthitāvanugamakamātram, na tu śakyamiti na tacchābdabodhe bhāsate | kintu ghaṭatvādikameva | tathā'trāpi buddhiviṣayatvarūpeṇopasthitapāśatvavibhītakatvādiśāliṣu budadhiviṣayavati śaktamakṣapadamiti śaktigrahe'pu tattadrūpega bodhamātreṇa nānārthatvam | vastuto'tra anekajātyadīnāmapyavacchedakatvād nānārthatvaṃ sūpapādam | tasmāccabda eva tvapratyayavācyaḥ sarvatra, na tu jātyādikam | sarve śabdāḥ svenārthena svarūpaṃ prakāramāśrityartheṣu pravarttante | atastadeva bhāvapratyayārtha iti bhaṣyārtha iti | tat, na; anubhavavirodhāt | nānātvaṃ yaugapadyamityatrāpi nānādiśabdajanyabodhaprakāro'sahabhāvo yugapandrāvarthaḥ | saṃjñāśabde tu śabda eva pravṛttinimittatvamiti tatraiva bhāvapratyayaḥ | śaktigrahe dharmitāvacchedakatākhyaviṣayatvena vyaktirūpaśakyaviśeṣaṇatayā bhāsamānatvaṃ pravṛttinimittatvam | yathā ca śabdasya tattvaṃ tathoktaṃ nāmārthavāde | 'kutvaṃ kasmāt' ityādau tu kuśabdasvarūpaśaktasya kutvapadasya tadbodhyeṣu lakṣaṇayā na doṣaḥ | aupagavo rājapuruṣa ityādau ṣaṣṭhacarthasambanghasya vṛttau praveśāt, sa eva pravṛtinimittamiti tatraiva bhāvapratyayaḥ | idañca jahatsvārthāvṛttipakṣe | tadā radapuruṣādipadaṃ rājasambandhavatpuruṣe śaktamiti śaktigrahāt | ajahatsvārthāvṛttipakṣe'pi rājapuruṣapadaṃ rājasambandhavatpuruṣe śaktamityeva viśiṣṭaśaktigrahaḥ | prāptāprāptavivekanyāyena sambandhamātre viśiṣṭaśaktiḥ paryavasyatīti na sambandhasya pravṛttinimittatvahāniḥ | uktañca hariṇa--'kṛttaddhitasamāsebhyo bhāvapratyayena sambandhābhidhānam'1[fn kṛttaddhitasamāsenyo matabhedanibandhanam |] iti nyāyasiddha evāyamarthaḥ | na ca kṛti na sambandhasya pravattinimittatvam, kartṛtvādeḥ kriyākārakasambandharūpatvamityabhimānāt | idamapi prāyikam, dāmodaratvam, kṛṣṇasarpatvam, paṭe śuklatvat, sattetyādau jātiguṇaprakārakavodhasyaivālubhavasiddhatvāt | taduktam--'anyatra 2 [fn rūḍhiratra kathamapyajñātayogādarthaviśeṣaprasiddhetyarthaḥ | abhinnarūpam=pratyayāntatve'pi pratyayalukā prakṛtisamānākarāt śiṣyamāṇaṃ lupyamānārthābhidhāyi iti nyāyena prakṛtyarthānvitapratyayārthābhidhāyīrtthaḥ | avyabhicaritasambandhenyaḥ--avyabhicastiḥ=vyaktiniṣṭhātyantābhāvāpratiyogī, sambandhaḥ=samavāyātmako yasya jātādeḥ, taddhiśiṣṭavācakādityarthaḥ | ataḥ pākādinā nāśena svāayaniṣṭhābhāvapratiyoginā na tattavam |] rūḍhyabhinnarūpāvyabhicaritasambandhebhyaḥ' iti | tatra dāmodaratvamityādau rūḍhiḥ, śuklatvamityabhinnarūpam; paṭaḥ śukla ityādivyavahārāt satteti tṛtīyam | nahi satsattayoḥ sambandhaḥ kadāpi vyabhicarita iti bodhyam | yattu mīmāṃsakāḥ--daṇḍītyādau matupaḥ prakṛtyarthaviśiṣṭadravyāmātravācitvameva, sambandhasya vākyārthavidhayaṃva pratīteḥ | evaṃ pācaka ityadāvapi | na cānantadravyeṣuśaktigrahāmbhavaḥ, ekamupalakṣaṇīkṛtya saṃbhavāt | na copalakṣaṇībhūtadaṇḍādayo'pi nānā, tajvṛttijātyānugamāt | na ca tadapi daṇḍatvakuṇḍālatvarūpamanekam, prakṛtyarthatvena tadanugamāditi | tat, na; daṇḍitvamityādau sambandhapratītyanāpatteḥ | na ca tvapratyavairthyavarthyabhiyā tat kalpyate, ghaṭatvamityādau klṛptaprakṛtyarthatāvacchedakaśaktyaivopapatteḥ | 'kṛttaddhitasamāsebhyaḥ' iti na vacanam, kintu nyāyasiddhārthanuvādikā haryuktiḥ | na ca tatrānubhavānurodhāt tathāśaktikalpanamiti vācyam, śaktyantarakalpanāmekṣya inādīnāṃ klṛptaśaktāveva dharmivat sambandhaviṣayakatvakalpanayaivaupapattau pṛthak śaktikalpanāyā anucitatvāt | tathā sati klṛptapravṛttinimittaśakyaiva daṇḍitvamityādau tadbhānasambhava iti vadanti | apare tu -- prakṛtirarthaparaiva, lakṣaṇāyāṃ mānābhāvāt | vastutaḥ prakṛtijanyabodhaprakāraḥ, pravṛttinimittabhūto ghaṭatvādiḥ tattadrūpeṇa tvādyarthaḥ | tatra ghaṭatvamityatra jātiviśiṣṭā vyaktiḥ prakṛtyarthaḥ | sa ca ādhāratānirūpitavṛttitvasambandhena prākaraḥ, āṅkākṣāvaśāt | evañca ghaṭavṛttighaṭatvamityādirūpeṇa bodhaḥ | evaṃ ghaṭatvatvāmityādau ghaṭatvapadajanyabodhaprākaro ghaṭatvatvameva tvapratyayārthaḥ | na ca gauravāt tatra lakṣaṇaiva, na śaktiriti vācyam, śaktāveva tadādaraḥ, na lakṣaṇāyāmityatra vinigamakābhāvāt | kiñca, āvidyakadharmaviśeṣarūpam, ghaṭatvātvādikañca ghaṭatvapadaśakyatāvacchedakam | ato na gauravam | vastutaḥ svavṛttitvādisambandhena vyaktireva prakāraḥ, śaktirniravacchinnaiva | guṇādervācyatve tu tadgatajātiḥ śakyatāvacchedikā | na caivaṃ nānārthatāpattiḥ, iṣṭāpatteḥ | taduktaṃ bhāṣye -- 'yasya guṇasya bhāvād dravye śabdaniveśaḥ, tadabhidhāne tvalalāviti | atra guṇapadaṃ dharmamātropalakṣaṇam | 'yasya bhāvāt' ityucyamāne putrasya bhāvāt pitari pitṛśabdaprayogāt | pitṛtvamiti putre bhāvapratyayaḥ syāt | bhāvād vidyamānādityarthaḥ | dravyaśabdena viśeṣyabhūtaḥ sattvabhāvāpanno'rtha ucyate | tatra ye rūpādayo guṇamātravṛttayaḥ, tebhyo guṇavṛttijātau bhāvapratyayaḥ |' śuklādibhyo guṇiparebhyo guṇe guṇaparebhyo jātāveva | ye tvaṇvādayaḥ śabdāḥ parimāṇini varttante, tebhyaḥ parimāṇarūpe guṇe, 'pācakaḥ' ityādau kriyāviśeṣaṇakabodhāt taduttarabhāvapratyayena viśeṣyatayā saivābhidhīyate | ghaṭatvāmityādau tu jātiḥ | na ca jātervrahmasattārūpatayaikatvena ghaṭatvamityatra svavṛttitvasambandhena paṭasyāpi prakāratāpattiḥ | upādhibhedena bhinnāyā eva tasyā ghaṭatvādirūpatvāt | jātimātraparagavādibhyaḥ tadvṛttyāvidyakadharmaviśeṣarūpe gotvatvādau śaktiḥ | kaiyaṭastu --- jātimātravācibhyaḥ śabdasvarūpe bhāvapratyayaḥ | arthe jātau śabdasvarūpamadhyasyate yo gośabdaḥ, sa evārtha iti tataḥ śabdasvarūpameva pravṛttinimittam, nānyadityāha | yattu ----- dharmatvena dharmamātraṃ śakyaṃ tvādeḥ, na tu tattadrūpeṇa, nānārthatāpatteḥ | ghaṭatvāmityādau ghaṭatvatvādinā pratītistu anāditathāsaṃskārāt | na caivaṃ dharmatvasya śakyatve na mānam, śakteravacchedyatvaniyamāt | anyathā māstu tadavacchedakam | ata eva paṅkajapade padmatvaṃ prayogopādhiriti tāntrikāḥ | prayoge niyamena saṃskāravaśād yo bhāsate, sa prayogopādhirityucyate iti | tat, na; evaṃ hi ghaṭatvaṃ paṭatvamityādau pratītivaicitryānāpatteḥ | saṃskāravaśādviśeṣabhānamiti cet, tasya vṛttyaviṣayatve śābdabodhaviṣayatvānāpatteḥ | na ca śakyatāvacchedakameva bhāvapratyayaśakyaṃ cet, pūrvamatāt ko viśeṣa iti vācyam, pūrvamate śabdaḥ prakāraḥ, atra vyaktirityeva bhedādityāhuḥ | kecittu -- jātyādisādhāraṇyenaikaśaktau sambhavantyāmanekatatkalapne gauravāt, astu dharmatvena teṣāṃ vācyatā | parantu prakṛtyartho vyaktireva, svetarāvṛttitvāvacchinnā nikhilasvavṛttitvasambandhena prakāra iti svīkāreṇātiprasaṅgaḥ | sattvamityādau tu samavetatvameva sambandhaḥ | niyāmakaṃ cātrāṅkākṣāmātramiti vadanti | yavānāṃ dvau bhāgau nimānamasyodaśvidbhāgasya dviyavamudaśvid yavānām | atra "saṃkhyāyā guṇasya nimāne mayaṭ" [ 5|2|47 ] ityanena mayaṭ | guṇo bhāgaḥ, nimānaṃ mūlyam, bhāgasya mūlye varttamānāt prathamāntāt saṃkhyāvācinaḥ ṣaṣṭhyarthe mayaṭ iti tadarthaḥ | nimānasya nimeyasya ca bhāgarūpatve evāsya pravṛttiriti ākāre spaṣṭam | dviśabdasya nityasāpekṣatvād yavānāmityetatsāpekṣatve'pi pratyayaḥ | yavasambandhibhāgadvayarūpamūlyaprāpyodaśvidbhāga iti bodhaḥ | yadyapi udaśvidbhāge pratyayaḥ, tathāpi tasyāpi udaśvittvād dviyavamudaśviditi prayuktam | abhidhānasvābhāvyād vā bhāge vidhīyamāno bāgavantamāheti bodhyam | idañca sūtraṃ nimeyasaṃkhyāpekṣayā nimānasaṃkhyāyā ādhikye eva pravarttata ityanyatra vistaraḥ |1 [fn sūtreṇānena prathamāntādastyarthopādhikāt sambandhini, avikaraṇe ca matvarthīyā vidhīyante | yadyapi 'asya' ityukteḥ ṣaṣṭhyarthasambandha eva matabādividhānamābhāti, tathāpi 'gomāṃścaitraḥ' iti sāmānādhikaraṇyānurodhāt -- sambandhivācakataivati | evañca 'gomān' ityādau gonirūpitasvāmitvasambandhavān ityādyanvayabodhaḥ | ] "tadasyāsatyasminniti matup" [ 5|2|94 ] atra sūtre ubhayopādānam, tattatprakārakabodhe matupaḥ sādhutvārtham | 'asti' iti puruṣavacane na vivakṣite | tayoḥ prathamātikrame kāraṇābhāvena pravṛttyā nirdeśena śāstrasaṅkoce mānābhāvāt | kālastu varttamānatvarūpo vivakṣita eva, ata eva gavāmatītatve'nāgatatve vā matupo na sādhutvam | spaṣṭaṃ cedaṃ bhāṣye | astīti pratyayārtho'pi prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇam | evañca gomān ityato varttamānasattāśrayagosambandhīti bodhaḥ | gomānāsīt, bhavitetyādau tu tathāvyavahāraviṣaye lakṣaṇetyeke | prakārāntaramapi śabdenduśekhare spaṣṭam | īṣadasamāptyādivihitakalpavādiṣu tu īṣadasamāptyādipratyayārtho'pi prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇameva, ākāṅkṣāvaśāt prakṛtestādṛśārthe lakṣaṇāyāṃ pratyayastātparyagrāhaka ityapyāhuḥ | atiśayena paṭuḥ paṭutaraḥ --- ityatrātiśaye tarap, atiśayarūpapratyārthaśca prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇam | yadyapi prakṛtyarthasya na svarūpato'tiśayaḥ, tathāpi tarap‌gatapravṛttinimittaguṇādyatiśayenaiva tadatiśayaḥ | gotara ityadau yadyapi pravṛttinimittajāterapi prakarṣābhāvaḥ, tathāpi tatsahacaritavāhadohādigatātiśayenaiva tadatiśayo bodhyaḥ | evañca tarabādisamabhivyāhāre prakṛtteratiśayitapaṭutvādiviśiṣṭe lakṣaṇā bodhyā | tatra tarap arthadvayapratipādakaśabde upapade | yathā anayorayaṃ paṭutara iti, asmākaṃ devadattasya ca devadatatto'bhirūpatara iti bhavati | dantoṣṭhasya dantāḥ snigdhatarā ityatra vartipadasya parityaktabhedāṅgīkṛtābhedalakṣaṇe ekatvasaṃravyākadantoṣṭhalakṣaṇārthadvayapratipādakatvena na doṣaḥ | bahvarthake tūpapade tamabeva vahvarthake'pi vibhāgapratiyogini upapade tarabevaudīcyāḥ prācyebhyaḥ paṭutarā iti yathā | evaṃ bahūnāṃ madhye nirdhāraṇe ḍatamac‌katamo bhavatāṃ kaṭhaḥ | dvayornirdhāraṇe ḍatarac --- anayoḥ karato vaiṣṇavaḥ | vaiparītyamapi, bhāṣyapramāṇyāt | kākatālīyamiti | kāka eva tālimiveti vigrahe, "samāsācca tadviṣayāt" [ 6|3|106 ] iti pratyayavidhāyakaśāstraprāmāṇyād ivārthe'pi "saha supā" [ 2|1|4 ] iti samāsaḥ| tadviṣayādityuktestālakākamiti na | yattu haradattenoktam -- ayaṃ samāsa etadviṣaya eva | tena svātantryāmupādhyantarayogo vigrahaśca neti | tat, na ; kākāgaganamiva tālapatanamiva kākatālam | kākatālamiva kākatālīyamiti bhāṣyavirodhāt | tatra pūrvapadaṃ kākāgamanasadṛśe lākṣaṇikam | uttarapadañca tālapatanasadṛśe svabhāvācca kriyāntarabhāvena lakṣaṇā, tayośca sāmānādhikaraṇyenānvayaḥ | kākāgamanasadṛśasamānādhikaraṇaṃ tālapatanasadṛśamiti samāsārthaḥ | etena pūrvottarapadārthayoranvayābhāvenāsāmarthyāt samāso durlabha ityapāstam | tataḥ kākatālamivetyarthe chaḥ, tatraitadadhikārasthapratyayārthe prakṛtyarthasya pratiyogitayānvayasya klaptatvena kākatālaśabdasya tālakṛtakākamaraṇe vṛttiviṣayā nirūḍhalakṣaṇā | tatra lakṣyārthasya pratiyogitvena pratyayārthe'nvayaḥ śakyārthasya ca prayojyatvasambandhenānvayaḥ | evañca kākāgamanasadṛśasamānādhikaraṇatālapatanasadṛśaprayojyaṃ tālakṛtakākamaraṇasadṛśaṃ devadattamaraṇamiti bodhaḥ| sādṛsyañca akasmādupakatatvādinā | yadyapi ivārtha'sya vidhānam | ivārthaśca sādṛśyam, tathāpi pratyayasya vṛttau sādṛśyavat paratvaṃ bodhyam, śabdaśaktisvabhāvāt | evamanyatrāpi aśvaka ityādāvahyam | vastutaḥ ---- kākatālaśabdasya kākatālasamāgamaprayojye lakṣaṇā | tasyaiva ca pratiyogitvena chapratyayārthe'nvayaḥ | upameyāvacakatattatpadasamabhivyāhāreṇa kākatālasamāgamaprayojyatvena kadācit kākamaraṇasya, kadācit kākakṛtopabhogasya bhānam | idamevābhisandhāya chapratyayopamāyāmupamānalopa ityālaṅkārikāḥ | upamānatāvacchedakarūpeṇa bodhakābhāva ityāśayaḥ | pūrvamate'pyupamānamātravācakābhāvāt lopavyavahāra ityāhuḥ | prāci deśe iti | prāgini prācīnaṃ grāmādāmrāḥ | atrāstātyantaprāk‌śabdasya prācyāṃ diśotyarthaḥ | taccādhikaraṇaśaktipradhānāvyayatvād nirliṅgam| tataḥ khe tu tasya svabhāvena ādheyapradhānatayā avyayatvābhāvāt liṅgayogaḥ, tacca na strītvādi, prakṛtyā sahātyantavirodhāpatteḥ, svārthikānāṃ prakṛtitulyatvokteḥ, kintu napuṃsakatvameva, ekavacanameva ca | evañca grāmādhikaprāgdeśavṛttaya āmrā iti bodhaḥ | yadā prāgādiśabdānāṃ deśādivācakānāṃ tatsambandhilakṣaṇayā āmrādivṛttitvam tatāścārthe khaḥ, topasthitaviśeṣyaliṅgatyāge mānābhāvāt prācīnā āmrā ityapi ityanyatra vistaraḥ | 'pañcakṛtvo bhuṅke' atra "saṃkhyāyāḥ kriyābhyāvṛttigaṇane kṛtvasuc" [ 5|4|17 ] iti sūtreṇa kṛtvasuc | tatrābhyāvṛttirjanma | atra pañcaśabdaḥ pañcatvasaṃkhyāviśiṣṭotpattau lākṣaṇikaḥ | tasya ca kriyāyāmevānvayaḥ, sūtrasvarasāt | ākhyātena pañcasaṃkhyākotpattikāpi bhujikriyānivṛttabhedā'bhidhīyate | samudāyasyāparisamāptatvācca varttamānatvam | evañca pañcasaṃkhyotpattikā odanādikarmikā bhujikriyeti bodhaḥ | 'pañcakṛtvaḥ pacyate odanaḥ' ityatra ekaudanāśrayakaṃ pacasaṃkhyotpattikakriyājanyā viklittiriti bodhaḥ| atra bhinnā api viklittayo dhātunā nivṛtabhedā evocyante | atastadāśrayasya samudāyasyaiva karmatvāmiti karmaikyam | udbhātāvayavabhedasamudāyavivakṣāyāṃ tu 'pañcakṛtvaḥ pacyante odanāḥ' ityapi bhavatyeva, ekakartṛkāmāmekajātīyakarmakārakāṇāmekajātīyānāmeva kriyāṇāṃ janmasaṃkhyāne'sya sādhutvaṃ svabhāvāt | 'pañcakṛtvo daṇḍī' ityādi tu adhyāhṛtabhavatikriyāmādāya sādhu | 'pañcakṛtva utpadyate' ityādāvapyuttyanukūlavyāpārasya dhātvarthatvāt tadutpattigaṇanaiva budhyata ityadoṣaḥ | etenotpatterutpattyabhāvādatra doṣa ityapāstam | 'pañcakṛtvaḥ pācakaḥ' iti tu na, padārthaikadeśatvena kriyāyāstatrānvayāsambhavāt | ata eva 'pañcakṛtvaḥ pakvaḥ' ityādi na, kriyāyā evābhyāvṛttisaṃbhavena tāvataiva kriyālābhe sūtre kriyāgrahaṇena pradānībhūtakriyāyā eva grahaṇācca | viniganāvirahāt kriyāgrahaṇaṃ yatra sādhyasvabhāvaiva kriyā, tatraiva kṛtvasujityarthamapi bodhayati | tena "pañcakṛtvaḥ pākaḥ" ityapi na | 'dviḥ prayogaḥ' ityādi tu "dvirvacane'ci" [ 1|1|56 ] iti jñāpakānnirvāhyam | spaṣṭañcedaṃ sarvaṃ bhāṣye ityāhuḥ | akṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sampadyate, tathā karoti kṛṣṇīkaroti -- atra "kṛbhvastiyoge sampadyakarttari cviḥ" [ 5|4|50 ] iti sūtreṇa cviḥ pratyayaḥ | tatra 'abhūtatadbhāve iti vācyam' iti karaṇatṛtīyāntatacchabdena samāsaḥ | abhūtapadena kartṛṣaṣṭhyantena samāsaḥ| abhūtatvacca pratyāsattyā tadbhāvaśabdaghaṭakatacchabdārthakaraṇakatvenaiva grāhyam | evañca yena rūpeṇa prāgabhūtam, tena rūpeṇa tasya bhāvo'bhūtatadbhāva iti phalitam | evañca yatra prakṛtireva vikārūpatāmāpadyamānā vikārābhedena vivakṣyate, tatraivāyaṃ pratyayaḥ| vikāravācakādeva ca pratyayaḥ| evañca akṛṣṇaḥ, kṛṣṇaḥ sampadyate, tathā bhavati kṛṣṇībhavatītyatra bhavatikriyākartṛtvaṃ prakṛtibhūtasyākṛṣṇasyaiva | 'abhūtatadbhāve' iti śabdabalena tathaiva lābhāt | kiñca, kṛṣṇītyādernipātatvena dyotakatayā bhūdhātunaiva tadarthasya kroḍokāreṇa tasya kartṛtvādyasambhava eva | ata eva 'saṃghībhavanti brāhmaṇāḥ' 'tvadbhavati devadattaḥ' ityādau vacanapuruṣavyavasthā | evaṃ kṛṣṇīkarotītyādau karmatvamapi prakṛtereva | anyatra tu prakṛtivikṛtyoḥ kartṛtvādāvaniyamaḥ, 'suvarṇapiṇḍaḥ khadirāṅgārasadṛśe kuṇḍale bhavataḥ' iti paspaśāyāṃ bhāṣyaprayoge vikṛteḥ kartṛtvadarśanāt ; 'eko vṛkṣaḥ pañca naukā bhavati' iti loke prakṛterapi kartṛtvadarśanācca | evañca prakṛtervikṛtervāpi yatroktatvaṃ dvayorapi | vācakaḥ prakṛteḥ saṃkhyāṃ gṛhṇāti vikṛterna tu || iti prācīnapravādaḥ cvipratyayaviṣayaka eva | anyatrāsya yojanaṃ tu pūrvoktabhāṣyaprayīgavirodhena prāmādikam | cvyantasya ca svārthasadṛśena lakṣaṇā | ata eva tasya gauṇatvād amahān mahān bhavatītyādau "ānmahataḥ" [ 6|4|10 ] iti dīrghasyāpyanāpattiḥ, gauṇalākṣaṇike upāttaviśiṣṭarūpapadāntarasambandhanimittakāryasyaivāpravṛtteradoṣāt | 'mahadbhūtā brahmaṇī' ityatra puṃvadbhāvastu yathākathañcit sāmānādhikaraṇyamāśritya 'puṃvat' iti yogavibhāgād vā iti nirūpitaṃ śabdenduśekhare | 'goṃmatībhūtā' ityatra tu bhāṣyaprayogādeva na puṃvat | spaṣṭhañcedam "pratyayalakṣaṇa" [ 1|1|62 ] sūtre, "ot" [ 1|1|15 ] sūtre, "ānmahataḥ" [ 6|3|46 ] iti sūtre ca bhāṣyakaiyaṭādiṣu | kāraṇobhūto daṇḍaḥ, 'brahmībhūta' ityādau cvipratyayastu akāraṇatvādyāropapūrvakakāraṇatvādyāropeṇaiva bodhyaḥ | yadā tu pūrvāvāsthā, uttarāvasthā vā nāśrīyate, tadā cverabhāvaḥ | tantavo bhavanti, paṭo bhavatīti yathā | ityalaṃ vistareṇa | iti taddhitārthanirṇaya | iti nirūpīto varṇaspoṭaḥ | <29> atha padavākyasphoṭau nirūpyete evamādeśānāṃ vācakatve sthite ghaṭenetyādau vyākaraṇabhedanādeśabhedāt ; saṃhitāvaśāt prakṛtipratyayabhedānavagamena ca pratyekaṃ tābhyāmarthānusthiterviśiṣṭasyeva śaktiriti padasphoṭapakṣaḥ | tathāhi --- ghaṭenetyatra ghaṭa iti prakṛtiḥ, eneti pratyayo vā, ghaṭe iti prakṛtirneti, pratyayo vetyādiprakāreṇa vinigamakābhāvādanantaśaktatāvacchedakakalpanāpatteḥ, tattadajānatāṃ bodhānāpatteśca, vasnasādau samudāyasyaiva vidhānena tadvibhāgasya sarvathā jñātumaśkayatvācc, avaiyākaraṇānāṃ pratyekaṃ tadajñāne'pi samudāyavyutpattimātrema bodhācca | evaṃ hare'va, viṣṇo'vetyādau prāguktarītyā padayoḥ spaṣṭamajñāne'pi samṛdāya śaktyā bodhāt samudāyasyaiva viśiṣṭavākyārthe śaktiriti vākyasphoṭaḥ | arthavanti vā'narthakāni vākyāni dṛśyante ityādinā "vṛddhirādaic" [ 1|1|1| ] sūtrādiṣu bhāṣye vyavahṛto'yam | nanu anvayarūpavākyārthasyāpūrvatvāt tatra śaktigrahāsaṃbhavaḥ, tadviṣayakaśaktigrahe tasyāpūrvatvakṣatiśca | yatra tu vṛddhavyavahārāt prāthamikaśaktanirṇayo yathā manasā, tathā'trāpi padaiḥ padārthopasthitau ākāṅkṣājñānādisahakṛtamanasā tadupastithau tatra śaktigraha iti | tat, na; padānāṃ spaṣṭamajñānena padaiḥ padārthopasthityasambhavāt, ākāṅkṣāyā eva vākyaśaktitvena tadgrahātiriktaśaktigrahābhāvācca | yadapi, tātparyajñānaviṣayatayopasthite'nvayāṃśe tātkālikaśaktigrahasaṃbhavaḥ | tātparyañca tattadarthaviṣayakabodhananecchayā vaktruccāritatvam | ghaṭamānayetyādito ghaṭakarmatvaprakārakanirūpitatvasaṃrgakānayanaviśeṣyakabodhajananecchayā vaktruccāritatvābhāvajñāne, anyabodhajananeccāritatvajñāne vā tathā bodhānudayena tayoḥ pratibandhakatvakalpanāpekṣayā prāguktātātparyaprākarakaniścatvenaiva hetutāyāṃ lāghavena tasyāvaśyakatvāt | arthasya prakāratāviṣayatādiviśeṣaṇatvena bhānād yena rūpeṇa vākyād bodhaḥ, tena rūpeṇa tātparyajñānāviṣayatvena vākyārthasyāpūrvatvahāniriti | tat, na ; tasyāpūrvatve tadviṣayakaśaktigrahavat tadviṣayakatātparyaniścayasyāpyasaṃbhavāt, śaktigrahe'pi arthasya prakāratādiviśaiṣamatayaiva bhānenāpūrvatvākṣateśca, śukādivākye tātparyavyatirekaniścaye'pi śābdabodhena taddhetutvāsaṃbhavācca | na caiśvaraṃ tatra tātparyam, tasya phalaikonneyatayā prāg durjñeyatvāt | ata eveśvarāsattvaniścayavatāṃ mīmāṃsakādīnāṃ bodhaḥ, vedavākyād bodhānāpatteśca | na ca tatrādhyāpakatātparyam, mūrkhādhyāpakokte tadabhāvāt | mīmāṃsopayogastu nyāyajanyalāghavādijñānasya vedajanyaśābdabodhe, tatprāmāṇyaniścaye vā hetutvāt | na ca vijñavaktṛkavākyajanyabodhe tātparyadhiyo hetatvena śukādivākyasya vedasya cātathātvena na doṣa iti vācyam, vijñatvasyāniyatatvāt | api ca, 'asamād vākyādarthadvayaviṣayakaḥ śābdabodho jāyate prakaraṇāditastu kasyeti na jānīma iti sarvajanīnānubhavavirodhāt na tsāya śābdabodhahetutvam | ata eva 'paya ānaya' ityukte'prakaraṇajñasya dugdhaṃ vāneyam,' jalaṃ veti praśnādikaṃ saṅgacchate | na ca tatra padārthopasthitireva na śābdabodha iti vācyam, payaḥ karmatvamānayanaṃ prerameti vākyajanyapadārthopasthitāvapi tadāpatteḥ, sarvatraivamevāpattau śābdabodhocchedāpatteśca | etena mānasa eva tatra bodha iti upasthitapadārthānāmasaṃsargāgrahamātreṇa praśnādisiddhiriti ca parāstam | śābdayāmītyanuvyavasāyācca | tātparyanirṇayāderupayogastu prāmāṇyaniścāyadvārā pravṛttāviti gṛhāṇa | na caivamaśvatātparyakatvena nirṇītād gehe saindhavasamastīti vākyād gehe lavaṇamasti, na veti saṃśayasyāpyucchedāpattiḥ, tatrāprāmāṇyasaṃśayena tadunucchedāt | tadabhāve tviṣṭāpattireva | tatparatvābhāvajñānasyānyaparatvajñānasya ca phalabalāt pratibandhakatvameva kalpyam | yadi tatsatve tattadarthaviṣayabodhānanubhavaḥ, prāmāṇikagauravasyādoṣatvāditi cet, na ; vṛddhavyavahāreṇa upastitaviśiṣṭe upadeśādinā vā tadgrahasaṃbhavāt, vasnāsādau yuṣmadādyarthasya karmattvādeśca | saṃsarge śaktigrahasyaivamevopapādyatvāt | idamevābhipretya arthe viśiṣya sambandhāgrahaṇaṃ cet, samaṃ peda | lakṣaṇādadhunā cet, tatpade'rthe'pyustu | tattathā iti vaiyākaraṇamatonmajjane dīkṣitāḥ | lakṣyate'neneti lakṣaṇaṃ manaḥ ; upadeśo vā | apirbhinnakramaḥ vākye'pītyartha iti dik | evaṃ ghaṭamānayetyādau saṃsargarūpo vākyārtha eva samudāyaśakyaḥ, vṛddhavyavahārāt | prathamato viśiṣṭe vākyārthe śaktigrahe'pi āvāpodvāpābhyāṃ padārthānāṃ padeṣu śaktikalpanāt vākyasya pariśeṣema saṃsarga eva tatsiddheḥ | nanvākāṅkṣākṣsihakārema padaireva saṃsargasyāpi bhānopapattau tatra vākyasyāpi śaktikalpane mānābhāvo goravañca | āṅkākṣā ca ghaṭakarmakānayanamityādibodhe ghaṭapadottarāmpadasya , tato dhāto; tata ākhyātasya ; ityādisamabhivyāhāraviśeṣāṇāṃ jñānasya kāraṇatvarūpāttjajñāऩca kāraṇam | ata eva ghaṭaḥ karmatvamānayanaṃ kṛtirityādito viparītavyutpannasya bodhaḥ, sadvyutpannasya cābodha upapadyate | etena yatpadaṃ yadarthena saha tātparyaviṣayobhūtayādṛśā'rthānvayabodhajanakam, tatpade tasya pūrvavartitvottaravarttitvādirūpaḥ samabhivyāhāraḥ, tādṛśabodhe ākāṅkṣā, tajjñānaṃ kāraṇamiti parāstam | sadvyutpannasadvyutpannavibhāgocchedāpatteḥ | yadi tatparihārāya yādṛśabodhe yatsamabhivyāhāraḥ kāraṇam, tādṛśabodhe tatkāraṇatvajñānamapi tathetyucyate, tarhi āvaśyakatvāt saivākāṅkṣāstu | yattu, akāraṇatvaniścayaḥ pratibandhakaḥ, tatpadavyatirekaprayuktatātparyaviṣayatāvacchedakāvacchinnānvayānanubhāvakatvaniścayo vā kāraṇam | atra viśiṣṭaṃ kāraṇamityake | tādṛśaniścayatvenānvayānubhavābhāvāpratiyogitāvacchedakāvacchiviṣayakaśrotṛniṣṭhatātparyajñānatvena vā hetutve vinigamanāvirahāt pṛthagevānvayānanubhāvakatvatātparyaniścayayorhetuteti tattvamiti | tat, na; ghaṭamānayetyādito ghaṭapadāmpadayoḥ pratyekaṃ gṛhītaśaktikasya tādṛśānupūrvījñānādimato'kāraṇatvaniścayābhāvavataśca viparītavyutpannasya bodhāpatteḥ, gauravācca | etenāntyo'pi parāsta iti cet, na; padānāṃ padārtho'pi śaktisiddhyanāpatteḥ | ghaṭatvaprakārakaghaṭaviśeṣyakabodhe ghaṭapadajñānasya tatkāraṇatvajñānasya ca kāraṇatayaivādoṣāt | na ceśvarecchādiviṣayatvarūpaśakteḥ klṛptatvena na kiñcidadhikaṃ mama kalpyam, 'asmādvākyādayaṃ saṃsargo boddhavyaḥ' iti īśvarecchāviṣayatvasya mamāpi klaptatvāt | na ca sā na śaktiḥ, vinigamanāvirahāt | na ca janakatvasya bahupadārthaghaṭitatvena tasya kāraṇatāvacchedakatvāpekṣayātiriktaśaktereva tattvamucitamiti vācyama, mamāpi tulyatvāt, atiriktapadārthakalpane gauravācca | yadi tu, janakatvamevākhaṇḍopādharūpaṃ svīkṛtya tadeva śaktiriti brūṣe, tadā siddho vākyasphoṭaḥ | padajñānakāraṇatvarūpapadaśaktijñānasyeva tatsamudāyajñānakāraṇatvarūpavākyaśaktijñānasya hetutāyāḥ tvayāpyabhyupagamāt | na ca janakatāyāḥ śaktitve 'padaṃ śaktam' iti vyavahārānāpattiḥ, nahi padaṃ bodhakāraṇam, api tu tajjñānamiti vācyam, anumitau liṅgasyeva svajñānadvārā tasyāpi tattvāt | evañca vākyaśakterevākāṅkṣetiparaparibhāṣāmātramavaśiṣyate | ata eva 'saṃsargo vākyārthaḥ' iti kiṃvantī saṃgacchate | prāthamikaśaktigrahasya ca sarvathā na badhaḥ | ata eva ca samāsagrahaṇaṃ vākye'tivyāptivāraṇāyeti bhāṣyādigranthāḥ saṅgacchante | taduktaṃ hariṇā | 'aśābdo yadi vākyārthaḥ padārto'pi tadā bhavet' iti | kecittu ghaṭamānayetyādāvapyekaiva śaktirviśiṣṭavākyārthanirūpitā, samudāye vyutpannānāṃ tata eva bodhasyānubhavikatvāt | vyavahārādhīna prathamavyutpattyā samudāye viśiṣṭanirūpitāyā eva śaktegrahācca | na ca avāpodvāpābhyāmavayavaśaktinirṇayena tasyāprāmāṇikatvamiti vācyam, asaṃjātavirodhitvenottarakālajasyaiva tattvakalpanāt, hare'vetyādau tathāvaśyakatvācca | na ca viśiṣṭaśaktyājñāne'pi pragaktarītyā śaktigrahād bodhe vyabhicāraḥ, tvaduktatadagrahepi viśiṣṭaśaktigrahamātrema bodhe tavāpi vyabhicārāt | viśiṣṭaśaktigrāhake niyamatastadgrāhakatvasyāpi svīkārānna doṣa iti cet, tarhimamāpi na doṣaḥ | tathāhi --- tadādivatkārakavibhaktiviśiṣṭapadadhātupadayorviśiṣṭayoḥ kārakaviśiṣṭaṃ kriyābodhakatvamiti sāmānyataḥ śaktigrahe, anantaraṃ padaviśeṣasamabhihārajñāne sati tātparyavaśāt padārthaviśeṣaviśiṣṭakriyābodha ityabhyupagamena tvayāpi sāmānyataḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvāṅgīkāreṇa ca tattatkāryakāramabhāvagrāhakasyaiva niyamato viśiṣṭaśaktigrāhakatvasvīkārādityāhuḥ | tadapare na kṣamante, "ghaṭam" ityetāvatāpi ghaṭakarmatvabodhadarśanāt tasya tatra śakterāvaśyakatvena tathaiva tadbodhasaṃbhave punaḥ samudāyaśakterapi tadviṣayakatvakalpane mānābhāvāt, viśeṣaviśiṣṭakriyābodhāya padaśaktestavāpyāvaśyakatvācca, kārakatvavibhaktitvadhātutvādyajānatāṃ tathā śaktigrahāsambhavācca | tasmādyasya yathā śaktigrahaḥ, tasya tata eva bodhaḥ | avyavahitottaratvādiniveśena ca kāryakāraṇabhāve vyabhicāraparihāraḥ | vākyaśaktigraho'pi kasyacidviśiṣyaiva, kasyacit kārakatvādi jānataḥ prāguktarītyaiva sāmānyataḥ, kasyacit prakārāntareṇaivetyaniyata eva | sa ca tattatpadārthaniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitā tattatpadārthaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpitā ca yā sāṃsargikī viṣayatā, tadarthe samudāyaḥ śakta ityevaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvāpannārtha eva | etena svatantravṛttijñānād viśrṛṅkhapadārthopasthitau satyāṃ viśeṣyaviśeṣamabhāvyatyāsenānvayaḥ syādityapāstam | jātiśaktivāde saṃsargavṛttidharma eva vākyasyāpi śakyo bodhyaḥ | yattu, viśiṣṭaśaktigrahe padaśaktigrahaḥ kāraṇam, pratyekapadaśaktigrahābhāve vākyārthabodhasyājāyamānatvāt tatsattve'pūrvavākyaśravaṇe'pi tasya jāyamānatvācceti | tadasāram ; vākyaśaktyagrahe tadabhāvādeva tadabhāvopapatteḥ | tatsattve tu jāyata eva | ata eva samudāyavyutpattyā samudāyārthabodhe'pi vyākaraṇavyutpattiṃ vinā padavibhāgasāmarthyābhāvo'nubhavasiddhaḥ saṅgacchata ityāhuḥ | na ca vākyaśaktyaṅgīkāre samabhihārānatyena gauravam, prāmāṇikatvāt, tavāpi tāvat kāryakāraṇabhāvāvaśyakatvācca | nanu ghaṭaprakārakaśābdabodhamātre ghaṭārthakapadottarasārthakapratyayanipātānyatarajanyopastitirhetuḥ | evaṃ viśeṣyatāsambandhena karmatvaviṣayakaśābdabodhamātre karmatvārthakapratyayaprakṛtijanyopasthitirheturiti sāmānyata eva kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ | na ca 'ghaṭaḥ karmatvam' ityato viparītavyutpannasya tathā bodhād vyabhicāraḥ, ghaṭabodhakapadottarapadajanyajñānatvena karmatvabodhakapadaprāgvarttipadajanyajñānatvena ca hetutvādadoṣaḥ | na caivamapi paṭādilākṣaṇikaghaṭitaghaṭamānayeti vākyāt tathā bodhavāraṇāya ghaṭabodhakatvaṃ ghaṭabodhaphalopahitatvaṃ niveśyam | evañcānyonyāśrayāt tādṛśakāryakāraṇabhāvāgrahāsambhava iti vācyam, tatra ghaṭasya vṛttijanyopasthityabhāvādeva tathā bodhavāraṇena svarūpayogyatvaniveśe'pi kṣatyabhāvāditi cet, na ; karmatvaṃ ghaṭaḥ, 'am ghaṭaḥ' ityetādṛśasamabhivyāhāravyutpannanāṃ tatastathābodhe vyabhicārāt, sadvyutpannāsadvyutpannavibhāgocchedāpatteśca | na ca tādṛśahetutājñānasyāpi kāratvāt na doṣa iti vācyam, sāmānyavidhatajjñānasyāpi sattvāt | na ca tattadvyutpattiviśiṣṭāśābdabodhe tattadvyutpattivaiśiṣṭyañca svāvyavahitottarotpattikatva svamānādhikaraṇyokaraṇyobhayasambandheneti na doṣaḥ iti vācyam, anantakāryakāraṇabhāvatādavasthyāt | pratyayatvanipātatvādyajānatastathā kāryakāraṇabhāvagrahāsambhavācca | nanvastu vākye tadbodhakatayecchaāviṣayatvādi, parantu tasya vṛttitve kiṃ mānam ? iti ced, vinigamahanāvirahaḥ kāryakarāṇabhāvalāghavañceti gṛhāṇa | tathāhi --- mama gate1[fn nanu śabdasya jñānajanakatve sarvebhyaḥ śabdebhyo'pi nikhilaśrotṛṇāṃ bodhāpattibhiyā tadviṣayakaśābdabodhaṃ prati anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ vṛttijñānajanyopāsthiteḥ kāraṇatvamavaśyamaṅgīkarttavyam | vṛttiśca dāhaṃ prati vahanyādivat na svarūpeṇa hetuḥ, tasyāḥ svarūpataḥ sarvatra sattavāt sarveṣāṃ bodhāpattiriti jñātāyā eva tasyā hetutvamabhyupeyam, tattatpadaniṣṭhavṛttijñānaśūnyasya puruṣasya tattatpadaśravaṇe'pi bodhānudayāt | yadyapi śabdaśravaṇamātreṇa sarveṣāṃ bodho mā bhūditi tadvadviṣayakaśābdabodhaṃ prati tadvannirūpitavṛttijñānasya kāraṇatvaṃ svīkarttavyam | tathā ca paṭatvavadviṣayakabodhe paṭatvavannirūpitavṛttijñānasya hetutvāt na paṭapadāt ghaṭādibodhaḥ, nāpyajñātavṛttikād bodhaḥ, iti sarva sustham | tathāpi etādṛśakāryakāraṇabhāvasvīkāre guḍatvāvidharmavadguḍanirūpitavṛttijñānena madhurajñānena madhuratvādiprakārakabodho māṃ bhūditi prakārībhūtadharmanirūpitatvamapi vṛtteraṅgīkāryam | tathā ca yad dharmaprakārakavṛttijñānaṃ taddharmaprakāraka eva bodhaḥ | guḍapadena ca guḍatvaprakāraka bodhasyaiva ca darśanāt madhuratvādyanekadharmasattveti guḍatvaprakārikaiva guḍapade vṛttiriti na madhuratvādiprakarākabodhaḥ ityāśayaṃ manasi nidhāyāha tadadharmāvacchinnetyādi | ] taddharmāvacchinnatadviṣayakaśābdabuddhitvāvacchinnaṃ prati taddharmāvacchinnatannirūpita1[fn ayamāśayaḥ --- tārkikaiḥ śābdabodhaṃ prati vṛttijñānaṃ padajñānañca savātantryeṇa kāraṇaṃ pratipāditam | parantu pṛthak pṛthak tayoḥ kāraṇatvasvīkāre kāryakāraṇabhāvadvayakalpane mahad gauravaṃ syāditi lāghavād viśiṣṭasya kāraṇatvaṃ śābdikaiḥ svīkriyate | tadeva pratipādayati --- vṛttiviśiṣṭaiti | ] vṛttiviśiṣṭajñānaṃ hetarityekaṃ eva kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ | tava tu sāṃsargikaviṣayatāśālitadviṣayakaśābdabuddhau ākāṅākṣājñānakāryakāraṇabhāvo'dhikaḥ | vṛttijñānakāryakāraṇabhāve ca prakāratāviśeṣyatayorviśiṣyaniveśa ityaparañca gauravam | viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvavyatyāsena gṛhītaśaktikāt ghaṭatvapadāt ghaṭatvaviśiṣṭabodhavāraṇāya taddharmāvacchinneti | tadvṛttirvaiśiṣṭyañca svaviṣayakodbuddhasaṃskārasāmānādhikaraṇyasvāśrayaviṣayakatvo bhayasambandhena jñāne bodhyam | ato 2[fn vaiśiṣṭyaghaṭakaprathamasambandhasya phalamāha --- nāgṛhītavṛttikasyeti | dvitīyasya phalamāha --- nāpi padādyajñānavata iti | tādṛśasthale pade viṣayatayā padajñānāsattvāt tadātmani ca samavāyena padajñānābhāvāt | śarīrāvayavasañcālanādināpi arthajñānasambhavādativyāptivāraṇāya padetyuktiḥ | ] nāgṛhītavṛttikasya bodhaḥ, nāpi padādyajñānavata ityāhuḥ | etena viśeṣyaprakārakasaṃsargasādhāraṇaviṣayatāsattve mānābhāvena viśeṣyāditritayavyavahārānurodhena viśeṣyatāditrayasyāvaśyakatvena viṣayateti sāmānyaśabdena trayyā evābhidhānasaṃbhavācca | viṣayatātrayasya kāryakāraṇabhāve niveśāpekṣayā dvayorniveśa eva lāghavam | nanu yadyapi viṣayatā na viṣayasvarūpā, ghaṭo viṣaya ityato ghaṭo ghaṭasvarūpavānityata iva bodhānāpatteḥ, atītānāgatajñānāderviṣayarūpaviṣayatāviraheṇa nirviṣayatvaprasaṅgācca, ghaṭatvādinā nirṇaye'pi viṣayo na veti saṃdehācca, ghaṭabhūtalasaṃyogānuyogitvādinītyādisamūhālambanaghaṭadbhatalamiti viśiṣṭabuddhyorvailakṣaṇyānupapatteśca | tathāpi jñānatvarūpaiva sā, nātiriktā, mānābhāvāt, gauravācca | evañca tattajjñānasambandhena śābdatvameva kāryatāvacchedakamiti gauravam | na ca jñānasvarūpatve ghaṭavadbhūtalamityādijñānanirūpitānāṃ ghaṭabhūtalādivṛttiviṣayatānāmabhedāpattyā tādṛśajñānāntaraṃ ghaṭaprakārakajñāvānahamitivat bhūtalaprakārajñānavānahamityādyanuvyavasāyāpattiḥ | kiñca, ghaṭapaṭāviti samūhālambanajajñānasya bhramatvāpattiḥ, paṭaniṣṭhatajjñānarūpaviśeṣyatāyā ghaṭatvaprakāratānirūpitatadrūpaviśeṣyatvābhinnatvena tasya ghaṭatvādiniṣṭhaprakaratānirūpitatadabhāvavatpaṭādiniṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpakatvāt | api ca, yathājñānaṃ svarūpeṇa ghaṭādinā sambaddhamiti ghaṭāviṣayakatvavyavahāramādhatte, tathā svarūpeṇa kālādināpi sambaddhatvāttadviṣayatvavyavahāramapyādadhyāt | kiñca, jñāne ghaṭo viṣaya ityato bodhānupapattiḥ, ekasya nirūpyatvanirūpakatvayorasambhavāditi vācyam, ghaṭavadbhatalamityādijñānānāṃ ghaṭādiniṣṭhaprakāratābhūtalādiniṣṭhaviśeṣyatārūpatvāṅgīkāre'pi phalabalāt, anubhavabalācca ghaṭaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatābhūtalaniṣṭhaprakāratādyanātmakatvādadoṣaḥ | anyathātiriktatvāṅgīkāre'pi tajjñānānāṃ ghaṭādiniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpakavattanniṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpakatvaṃ kuto neti praśne mūkataiva tavottaraṃ syāt | evaṃ samūhālambanasya ghaṭatvaniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitaghaṭanniṣṭhaviśeṣyatātmakatvepi tannirūpitapaṭaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatānātmakatvāt na bhramatvam | jñānatvena nirūpakasya viśeṣyatātvena nirūpyatavsambhavācca | na ca jñānasvarūpasya jñānādyajanyatvāt, tataḥ pūrvaṃ jñāta iti pratītyāpattiriti vācyam, jñānasattve iṣṭāpatteḥ | tadabhāve svarūpābhāvādeva pratītyabhāvopapatteriti cet, na; jñānavyaktīnāmananugatatvenānugatakāryakāraṇabhāvāsambhavasya tadavasthatvādityapāstam, viṣayatātvasyātiriktasyāṅgīkāreṇānugamasambhavācca | viṣayo viṣaya ityādyanugatavyavahāreṇa prāguktakāryatāvacchekatayā cātiriktaikaviṣayatāyā apyaṅkokāre kṣatyabhāvāccetyāhuḥ | nanvākāśo'stīti vākyaṃ śrṛṇvata ākāśapadavṛtyaṃśe'nudbuddhasaṃskārasya tata eva padāt samavāyena smṛte ākāśe tadviṣayaśābdabodhāpattiriti cet, na ; prakāratāviśeṣyatānyatarasambandhena śābdaṃ prati tenaiva vṛtijanyopasthiterapi hetutvenādīṣāt | vṛttyā padajanyapadārthopasthitirevāsattipadenocyate | ata eva pratyakṣadṛṣṭasya taṇḍulādeḥ pacatītyetajjanyaśābdabodhaviṣayatā na | 'padāvyavadhānamāsattiḥ' iti tu na yuktama, girirbhuktamagnimān devadattenetyatra yojanayā'nvayabodhānāpatteḥ | yojanāvākyadevānvayabodha iti cet, na ; prathamavākyasyābodhakatvāpatteḥ | yojanāvākyañca tātparyagrāhakatvena prakaraṇādivad upayujyata iti bodhyam | na ca ghaṭamānayeti vākyaṃ hastinañca samūhālambanavidhayā smarato ghaṭapaṭādibhyo ghaṭāderhastinaśca hastipakasya samahālambanasmaraṇe iti ghaṭānayanavat hastipakasyāpi śābdabodhaviṣayatāpattiḥ, samūhālambanarūpapadārthopasthitau vṛttijanyatvasattvāditi vācyam, śaktijñānapadārthopasthityoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāve samānaviṣayatvadānenākṣateḥ | yattu ---- viṣayatayā śabdaṃ pratyeva tena sambandhena vṛttijanyopasthitirheturiti | tat, na ; anupasthitasyaiva saṃsargasya bhānamiti sakalatāntrikasiddhāntavirodhāpatteḥ | kiñca, vākyajñānakāryatāvacchedaṃ viśiṣṭabuddhitvameva vācyam, prāguktayukteḥ | tathā copasthityaiva kṛtakṛtyatayā śābdabodhocchedāpattiḥ, tādṛśajñānadvayasyānubhavaviruddhatvācca | evaṃ vasnasādau hare'vetyādau ca viviṣṭaśaktyaiva saṃsargāṃśe udbodhakasamavadhānāt prāk padārthopasthitimātram | tatastadaṃśe'pyudbodhakasamavadhāne tadviṣayako vākyārthabodhaḥ | ata evāpūrvo vākyārthaṃ iti pravādaḥ saṅgacchate | apūrvatvañca śābdabodhaprākkṣaṇavarttitajjanakaśabdajanyasmṛtyaviṣayatvamityāhuḥ | yattu, 'kiñcetyādi', tat, na ; vākyārthapratīteranubhavatvābhāvāt svarganarakādikaṃ śṛṇvato'pi tadanubhavāmītyapratīteḥ | tasmācchābdatvaṃ jātiviśeṣa evaṃ, anubhavabalāt kalpyate, nānubhavatvavyāpyam | kiñca, vākyajñānasya tādṛśavijātīyajñānatvameva kāryatāvacchedakam | ato na tataḥ smṛtiḥ | anyathā tavāpi vākyenākāṅkṣārūpasambandhasya sattvāt tataḥ smṛtijananāśaṅkā duruddhareva syāt | etadeva padārthopasthitikāryatāvacchedakam | na caivamasyāḥ smṛtitvāt samabhivyāhārakāraṇatvajñānāṃśe'nudbuddhasaṃskārasyāpi vākyārthabodhaḥ syāditi vācyam, phalānurodhena tatrāpyudbuddhasaṃskārasya hetutvakalpanāt | pādārthopasthitiśca smṛtireva | evañca kevalaghaṭapadāt ghaṭatvaviśiṣṭasmaraṇameva, na śābdabodha iti na tatra vṛttijanyopasthityapekṣā | evam 'rājapuruṣaḥ' ityādito'pi vṛttāvekārthībhāvakalpanāsāmarthyena padārthopasthitisamaya eva saṃsargāṃśe'pi niyamata udbodhakasamavadhānakalpanād viśiṣṭaviṣayaiva padārthopasthitiḥ | śabdajanyatvamātreṇa paraṃ tasayāpītarasmṛtivilakṣaṇaḥ śābdayāmīti vyavahāro bodhyaḥ, na tu vākyajñānapadārthopasthitikāryatāvacchedakībhūtajātiviśeṣākrāntatā'syā iti bodhyam | yattu --- padārthopasthiteḥ smṛtitve smārakatātiriktamūlabhūtasambandhakalpanāpattiḥ | ekasambandhijñānamaparasambandhismārakam, na tu sā eva sambandhaḥ, hastipakādiṣu tathā'darśanāt | padārthayostu bodhakataiva sambandhaḥ, tadatiriktaśaktyabhāvasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt | bodhaśca tvanmate padāt smṛtirūpa eva, nānya iti spaṣṭameveti | tat, na ; padajñānasyobhayasādhāraṇatadarthaviṣayakabodhatvaṃ kāryatāvacchedakamiti smārakatātiriktaśābdabodhajanakatvarūpasya sambandhasya klṛptatvāt | padairhi padārthopasthitau taireva vākyaśaktisahakāreṇa padārthaviṣayakaḥ, tatsaṃsargaviṣayakaśca śābdabodho janyate iti krama ityalaṃ vistareṇa | yattu mīmāṃsakāḥ -- lakṣaṇayaivopapattau vākyārthe śaktikalpanā na yuktā | na cāpūrvatvaṃ prāgavijñātaharidrānāmakanadīviśeṣaṇapuṃsā 'haridrāyāṃ na goṣaḥ' iti vākye śrute nadīpadasamabhavyāhāreṇa tadānīmeva haridrāśabdasya nadīviśeṣe śaktigrahapūrvakaṃ nadīliṅgāt tatsaṃbandhitvenāvagatatīrapratyayavat padaiḥ padārthānāmipasthitau ākāṅkṣājñānādisācivyāt tata evopasthite vākyārthe tadgrahasambhavāt | tathopasthitasyāpi vṛttyānupasthitatvāt na sa bodhaḥ śābda iti śābdatvaprakārakabodhānubhāvāt madhye lakṣaṇāgrahaḥ | sa ca svabodhyasambandhitayā tadupasthitiḥ, svabodhyasbandhinaḥ svabodhyasyopasthitereva prācīnanayena lakṣaṇātvāt | yadvā ---- svasambandhipadārthabodhakaṃ vākyamiti tadgrahaḥ, tīrambandhipravāhabodhakaṃ gaṅgāpadamitivat | lakṣakatvañca svasambandhyarthabodhakatvameva | bodhyasambandha eva ca lakṣaṇā | padajanyapadārthopasthityākāṅkṣādyasahakṛtabodhakatvaṃ cādhigatārthagantṛtvamiti na vedasyānadhigatārthagantṛtārūpaprāmāṇyahāniriti | tat, na ; tādṛgbodhadvayānanubhavāt, anupapattipratisandhānābhāvena lakṣaṇāyā ayogācca | tātparyānyathānupapattyā lakṣaṇetyapi vaktumaśakyam, tasya sarvatrāhetutvāt, niyamataḥ pūrvaṃ tātparyajñānasyāpi kalpanāpekṣayā śaktikalpanāyā evaucityāt | vastutastu 'śakyasambandha eva lakṣaṇā, na bodhyasambandha iti ekārthībhāvavāde prapañcitam | tathā ca tanmate lakṣaṇā vaktumaśakyaiveti dik |' yattu --- vākyārthe vākyasya na śaktiḥ, kintu padānāmevānvite śaktiḥ, padaireva tadarthapratītyupapattau vākye'pi śaktikalpane mānābhāvāt | kiñca, vṛttiviṣayatvaṃ vinā śābdabodhaviṣayatvāsambhavād vākyārthaviṣayāvṛttiravaśyaṃ svīkāryā | sā cātiriktā, gauravānneti klṛptapadārthaśaktireva tadviṣayā kalpyate | padānāñca sāmānyata itarānvite śaktāvapi viśeṣāviṣayasāmānyabuddhyabhāvāt | tattatpadasāmānyaśaktibhireva samabhihāraviśeṣakāraṇatvādirūpākāṅkṣājñānabalāt tattatpadārthīyaviśeṣanirūpitānvayaviśeṣabodhaḥ sidhyati | etena padānāmevetarānvitābhidhāyakatve ghaṭādipadasyetarānvite śaktigrahavato ghaṭamānayetyānupūrvījñānavataḥ prāguktakāryakāraṇabhāvāgrahavato'pi ghaṭakarmakamānayanamiti bodhāpattiḥ | kiñca, viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvo vinigamanāvirahāt sāmānyataḥ śaktyetarānvito ghaṭaḥ, itarānvitaṃ karmatvaṃ tathānayanaṃ tathākṛtirityevaṃ bodhacatuṣṭayāpattiḥ, na ghaṭīyaṃ karmatvamiti | api ca ---- ghaṭaḥ karmatvamānayanaṃ kṛtirityata itarānvitakarmatvādau śaktigrahavatastathābodhāpattiśceti nirastam | kiñca, ekapadaprayoge'pyanvayaviśeṣyasya niyamena jijñāsādarśānāt, tasyāśca anvayasāmānyajñānapūrvakatvaniyamāt tajjñānasya śabdādanyato'sambhavācchabda evānvitamabhidhatte | na cāpūrvatvam, viśeṣataḥ padārthāntaraghaṭitasya tadanvayaviśeṣarūpavākyārthasya prāganupasthitāvapi anvitatvādisāmānyadharmaprakāreṇa prāk tadutpasthiteḥ sulabhatvāt | 'itarānvite śaktiḥ' iti tvayuktameva, padārthāntarasya padāntaralabhyatāya tadaṃśāntarbhāveṇa śaktigrahasyānupayuktatvāt | ghaṭa ityato ghaṭamātrabodhastu śaktibhramādityāhuḥ | tat, na; ghaṭādipadajñānasya ghaṭānvayobhayaviṣayakaśābdatvāpekṣayā ghaṭaviṣayakaśābdatvasya kāryatāvacchedakatve lāghavāt | kiñca, tvanmate'nvaye śakteḥ svīkāre'pi viśeṣabodhāya samabhivyāhārasya kāraṇatvasvīkāre tathā kāryakāraṇabhāvāgrahavato bodhavāraṇāya tadgrahasyāpi kāraṇatvasvīkāre viparītagauravāpatteḥ, vākyaśakteḥ siddhatvācca | jijñāsāpi padārthavākyārthayorniyamasya pūrvaṃ grahāt phalaviśeṣadarśane rasaviśeṣajijñāsāvadupapanna | nanu tadvadeva tarhyatrāpi jijñāsāniyamo na syāditi cet, iṣṭāpateḥ | kiñca, anayoḥ saṃsargaviśeṣajñānaṃ me bhavatvitīcchāyāṃ tādṛśajñānadharmikeṣṭasādhanatājñānasyahetutvena tasya ca viśiṣṭavaiśiṣṭyabuddhitayā viśeṣaṇatāvacchedakasāmānyadharmajñānasyeva tathābhūtaviśeṣajñānānurodhād jñānecchayoḥ samānaviṣayatvena hetuhetumadbhāvācca viśeṣasyāpyupasthitirāvaśyakī | na ca viśeṣarūpeṇāpi jñāne siddhisattvād jijñāsocchedaḥ, ajñātarūpema tu kāraṇābhāvādeva na jijñāseti vācyam, siddhiḥ svarūpato na pratibandhikā, kintu siddhatvaprakārakajñānameva tathā | ata eva caitrasya jñānaṃ bhavatvitīcchāyāmajāte ca tasya jñāne tasya jñānaṃ jātamiti siddhatvajñānādicchānivṛttiḥ saṅgacchate | yadi tu anvayasāmānye jñāte tena viśeṣānvayasyānumānamityucyate, tarhi anvayasāmānyasyāpi tathaivopastitisambhavāt prasthitamanvitaśaktyā | na caivamanumānenaiva saṃsargopasthitisambhavena śabdaprāmāṇyocchedaḥ, nānumitam, na sākṣātkṛtam, kintu śabdādevāvagatamityanubhavāt, ākāṅkṣājñānanirvāhyaviśeṣyaviśeṣaṇābhāvānurodhācca śabdasyātiriktapramāṇatvāt, 'śrṛṇomi' 'śābdayāmi' ityādyanuvyavasāyaprayojikāyā vilakṣaṇānubhavasiddhāyāḥ śābdatvajātestadavacchinne ākāṅkṣādijñānahetutvasya ca kalpānāvaśyaktve tadvṛttyanumititvakalpane vyāptismṛtyādiklapane mānābhāvāt, gauravācca | kiñca, siddhisattve'pi śābdabodhodayenānumiteścānudayena siddhipratibandhyatāvacchedakakoṭau śābdabodhātiriktatvaviśeṣaṇadāne gauravāt | api ca -- vahnyāderaśābdānimiteraparasya śābdabodhodayenānumiteścaikadotpattivāraṇāya śābdetarānumititvācchinne śābdānumitisāmagrītvena pratibandhakatve goravam | mama tu --- anumitittvāvācchinnaṃ prati śābdasāmagrītvenaiva tattvamiti lāghavaṃspaṣṭameva | anumiterasambhavācca | na ca 'gaurastitāvān, svadharmikānvayabodhānukūlākāṅkṣādyāśrayapadopasthitatvāt, ghaṭavad, ityanumānaṃ sulabhamiti vācyam,gavādeḥ padosthāpitatvādyabhāvagrahadaśāyāṃ gaurastītyādito'nvayabodhānāpatteḥ | padajanyā hi padārtopasthitiḥ svarūpasatyevānvayabuddhāvupayujyate, na tu jñātā, pramāmābhāvāt, padairanupasthāpitasyāpi tadupasthitatvāgrahādanvayadhīprasaṅgācca | na ca gauḥ, padam, astitvavad, gojñānapūrvakoccāraṇaviṣayo'sti, padasākāṅkṣapadatvāt, yannaivam, tannaivam,yathā ākāśam ityanumānamiti vācyam, gavādipadānāṃ jñānapūrvakoccāritatvābhāvāniścayadaśāyāṃ jāyamānasarvajanīnānubhavasiddhavodhasyāsaṃgatyāpatteḥ, gavādiniṣṭhamukhyaviśeṣyatāśālibodhasyaivamapyanupapādanācca | etena paṭhitavismṛtaśāstrasya bodhādarśanācchaktismaraṇaṃ hetuḥ udbuddhaśaktisaṃskāro veti matadvaye'pi janakatāyāḥ śaktitvanaye śabdaprāmāṇyocchedaḥ | janakatāyā vyāptighaṭitatvāt, yanniyatatvādvā tattadjñāne vyāptijñānaṃ jātameveti anumānavidhayaiva prāmāṇyaṃ syādityapāstam | janakatāghaṭitavyāpteḥ kāryakāraṇayoḥ sattvena tādṛśajñāyamānapadena svakāryatādṛśabodhānumitāvapi vilakṣaṇaviṣayatāśālyarthabodhāsambhavāt | na hi vyavasāye yādṛśī viṣayatā, tādṛśī anuvyavasāye, tripuṭīpratyakṣavādināmapi 'ayaṃ ghaṭaḥ, ghaṭamahaṃ jānāmi' ityeva jñānākara ityāhuḥ | yadi tu --- anvite śaktirityasya padāntarārthenānvitaḥ padārtha eva paderanubhāvyāte, na tu padārthamātramityarthaḥ | tathāhi --- padānāmanvayānubhavajanakatvameva śaktiḥ, ekākapadārthopastitistu smṛtirūpā | ekasambandhijñānasyāpasambandhismārakatāyā hastipakādisādhāramatvāt, anvayānubhavajanakatvarūpasya mūlasambandhasya vidyamānatvādityucyate ----- tarhi siddhaiva vākyaśaktiḥ | tathāhi --- sā śaktirnaikapade, kevalaghaṭapadādapi anvayānubhavāpatteḥ | anvito ghaṭa iti bodhastu tato'nubhavaviruddha eva samudāye, tatsvīkāre tu siddhamasmanmatamityanyatra vistaraḥ | yattu --- padārthāḥ, tatsmṛtirvā śābdabodhe hetuḥ, na tu padajñānam, vyabhicārāt | tathāhi --- 1[fn 'śābdabodhaṃ prati upasthitāḥ padārthāḥ, tadupasthitirvā hetuḥ, na tu padajñānamapi' tadvināpi śābdabodhodayena vyabhicārāt | tuduktam --- paśyataḥ śvetamārūpaṃ hreṣāśabdaṃ ca śrṛṇvataḥ | khuraviśepaśabdañca śveto'śvo dhāvatīti dhīḥ || iti | tat, na ; śabdaṃ vinā jāyamānasya ghaṭādicākṣuṣasyāpi śābdatvāpatteḥ | yadi tatra 'paśyāmi, na śābdayāmi' ityanuvyasāyād na śābdatvam, tarhiprakṛte'pi samam | uktapratīteranumānenaiva nirvāhāt tatra śābdapratyayastvasiddha eveti praghaṭṭakārthaḥ | ] aśvatvādyānupahitaśvetatvaṃ paśyan tasmin deśe hre ṣāśabdenāśvaṃ khuraśabdana gamanaṃ cānumimāno'nupalabdhipramāṇena tatpradeśe śavetādyanvayayogyasya vastvantarasyābhāvaṃ jānan puruṣa evaṃ kalpayati, anyānvayasākāṅkṣāṇāṃ śvetatvādīnāṃ mitho'nvayaṃ vinā'nupapannatvadhīsahakṛtāmākāṅkṣājñānādisahakṛtaṃ ca jñānaṃ teṣāṃ mithyo'nvayaśābdabodhe kāraṇiti anupapannatvadhīścaivaṃ śvetvaṃ taddeśe dṛśyamānamaśvānyāsaṃsargitvena pramīyamānamaśvasaṃsargitvaṃ vinānupapannamiti | evaṃ dhāvane'pyanupapattidhīrbodhyā | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- arthajñānaṃ śābdasāmānye kāraṇam, viśeṣakāraṇaṃ tu kvacit padajñānādikam | tattkāryatāvacchedakañca taduttaraśābdatvam | kvacidanupapattijñānam | tatkāryatāvacchedake ca taduttaraśābdatvamiti na vyabhicāraḥ | uktañca ---- paśyataḥ śvetamārūpaṃ hreṣāśabdaṃ ca śrṛṇvataḥ | khuraviśepaśabdañca śveto'śvo dhāvatīti dhīḥ || iti | tat, na ; anumānenaiva nirvāhāt, 'śabdayāmi' ityanuvyavasāyābhāvācca | nanvemi varṇasamūharūpapadavākyayorjñānamasaṃbhavi, utpattipakṣe, abhivyaktipakṣe vā ekadā tadabhāvāt, tayoḥ kramikatvāditi cet, na ; uttaravarṇapratyakṣakāle'vyavahittottaratvasambandhena pūrvapūrvavarṇavattvaṃ taduttaravarṇe gṛhyate | evaṃ taduttaravarṇapratyakṣakāla upasthitaviśiṣṭadvarṇavattvaṃ taduttaravarṇe gṛhyate | evamuttarottaravarṇapratyakṣakāle pūrvapūrvopasthitiviśiṣṭatadvarṇavattvaṃ grahyata iti tayoḥ sugrahatvāt | ataḥ sarorasaḥ, nadī dīnajarārājetyādau bodhaviśeṣaḥ | yattu --- pratyekavarṇānubhavajanitasaṃskārasahakṛtāntyavarṇapratyakṣasāmagryā sadasadanekaviṣayā pradapratītiḥ smṛtipratyakṣātmikā'nubhavakramopahitānāmeva teṣāṃ smṛtyavagāhanān na kramavyutkramayoraviśeṣa iti | tat na; anubhavasmṛtyoḥ krame niyamābhāvāt | dṛśyate ca prapūrvedyuranubhūtamasmṛtvāpi pūrvedyuranubhūtasya smaraṇam | kiñca,saṃskārasmṛtyorasamānaviṣayatvāt kramasya ca saṃskārāviṣayatvena smaraṇāviṣayatvād, ityāhuḥ | atredaṃ bodhyam --- nirūpitasphoṭabhedatrayaṃ na vādibhedena vyavasthitam, kintu boddhṛbhedena | kasyacit prakṛtipratyayoḥ pratyekaṃ tattadarthaśaktigrahād bodhena ; kasyacit pāribhāṣikasubantādipade tadgrahād bodhena, kasyacit tatsamudāye tadgrahād bodhena, trayāṇāpyāvaśyakatvāt | kāryakāraṇabhāve vyabhicārastu avyavahitottoratvādiniveśena vāryaḥ | ityāṃstu viśeṣaḥ --- sarvasyāpi tattatsaṃsargaviṣayaḥ śaktigrahaḥ, tattatsamudāye | so'pi vijātīyabodhajanaka eva, na smāraka iti tattvam | idamevābhipretya "ādyantau ṭakitau" [ 1|1|46 ] iti sūtre 'athavā yattāvadayaṃ sāmānyenopadeṣṭuṃ śaktoti, tattāvādupadiśati prakṛtim, tato valādyarthadhātukam, tataḥ paścādikāram, tenāyaṃ viśeṣeṇa śabdāntarasamudāyaṃ pratipadyate' ityuktam | 'buddhikalpitaprakṛtitvapratyayatvāgamatvādeśādiviśṣṭopadeśe rūpeṇopāyena nityapadaṃ tatsamudāyātmakamanvākhyāyate' ityarthaḥ | atra 'samudāya' ityanana sakhaṇḍataktam, sakhaṇḍatvañca vyākaraṇaśāstrabodhitaprakṛtipratyayāgamādyavayavakatvam | na cocyāraṇabhedena varṇānāṃ bhedāt, tattadānupūrvyāśca bhedāt ; ānantyavyabhicārābhyāṃ tatra śaktatāgraho durupapāda iti vācyam, avarṇādīnāmekatvasya vibhutvasya nityatvasya ca svīkāre | tadavayavakaprakṛtyādestatsamudāyarūpasyārpyakatvenānantyavyabhicārayorabhāvāt, deśabhede'pi paṭādīnāṃ deśaghaṭitasaṃniveśābhedavat kālabhede'pi tadghaṭitānupūrvībhedābhāvācca | paṭe tantusaṃyogārabdhatvavad varṇasaṃyogārabdhatvaṃ pade'pi tulyam | guṇe guṇānāṅgīkādati tu 'ekarūpam' ityādivyavahārādanādeyameva | tadvadevātrāpi gauṇo vā vyavahāro'stu | ata eva "halo'nantarāḥ saṃyogaḥ" [ 1|1|7 ] iti mahāsaṃjñākaraṇaṃ pāṇineḥ saṅgacchate | ekavibhunityamate tasya dravyatvāṅgīkārācca | na ca jagatītalavartyavarṇānāmekatve ca mānābhāva iti vācyam, praharāt pūrvamanudbhūte'dhunānubhūyamānasya so'yamiti pratyabhijñārūpābhedapratyayasyaiva mānatvāt | na ca gatvāvacchinnapratiyogitākabhedābhāvastadviṣayaḥ, vyaktyariktagatvānaṅgīkārāt | nanu vyaktyabhinnatve matupo'nāpattiḥ, abhede tadanaṅgīkārāt, nahi bhavati ghaṭavān ghaṭa iti cet, na ; guṇaguṇinorabhede'pi rūpavān ghaṭa itivadupapatteḥ | astu vā atiriktam, tathāpi na doṣaḥ, bhinneṣu ghāṭādiṣu ghacatvāvacchinnapratiyogitākabhedābhāvasattavāt | so'yamiti pratītyāpattyā vyaktyabhedasyaiva tatra viṣayatvāvaśyakatvāt, pratyabhijñāyā vyaktiviṣatvena bādhakabhāvācca | na ca gakāra utpanna iti pratītireva bādhikā, tasyā vyañjakadhvaniniṣṭātpattayāde | paramparāsambandhena varṇaniṣṭhatayā'pyupapatteratiriktaḥ vāsādhākatvāt, paramparayā varṇaniṣṭhatvābhyupagamācca na bhramatvam | sākṣātsambandhāṃśe bhrama ityavaśiṣyate | tadapi -- soyamityatra vyaktyabhedāṃśe tava bhramatvavattulyam | parantu mamānantavarṇatatprāgabhāvadhvaṃsakalpaneti lāghavamatiricyate | tava tu tat syāditi mahadaniṣṭam | etenotpattivināśapratyayayordvayarbhramatvakalpanāpekṣayā pratyabhijñāmātrasya bhramatvakalpane lāghavamiti parāstam | kiñca, prāgasattve sati sattvarūpāyā utpatterna varṇeṣu grahamamānubhavikam | ata eva varṇucyārayatīti pratyayo vyahāraśca, na tūtpādayatīti | uccaritatvañca tālvoṣṭhapuṭasaṃyogādijanyābhivyaktiviśiṣṭatvam | tathā ca prāganubhūtenedānīntanānubhūtasya abhedasiddhau tāvatkālaṃ sthiraṃ cainaṃ kaḥ paścānnāśayiṣyati | iti nyāyena nityataiva | nanvevaṃ strīprabhavo'yam, śukaprabhavo'yamiti pratītiṛ, tacchravaṇāt śukādyanumānaṃ ca na syāt | kiñca, 'seyaṃ gurjarī,' 'seyaṃ dīpakalikā' ityādipratītesteṣāmapi nityatā syāditi cet, na ; strīśukādijanyatācchedakasya varṇavyañjakadhvaniṣu anubhūyamānasya vaijātyasya paramparayā varṇeṣu sattvenākṣateḥ | etena sānunāsikatvaniranunāsikatvodāttatvānudāttatvahrasvatvadīrghatvatāratvamandratvādiviruddhadharmādhyāsād bheda iti nirastam | yoyaṃ rāmeṇoktaḥ, sa evedānīṃ kṛṣṇenocyate, yo'yaṃ tāro mayā śrutaḥ, sa evedānāṃ manda iti pratītestāratvādervirodhābhāvācca | yadeva padmaṃ devadattāpekṣayā viṣṇunoccaiḥ paṭhitam, tadevānena tadapekṣayā mandaṃ paṭhitam, na tvidaṃ padyāntaramiti sakalānubhavavirodhācca | tatra padyāntaratvāpateśca | gurjarīdīpādisthale'pi mānāntareṇa nāśasiddheḥ so'yamityasya bhramatvam | na ca nityatve vāyutālvoṣṭhasaṃyogādeḥ kakārādipratyakṣatvaṃ kāryatāvacchedakaṃ vācyam, mama tu katvameveti lāghavamiti vācyam, anantaprāgabhāvadhvaṃsādakalpanāpekṣayā laghutvāt, gurudharmasyāpi avacchedakatāyāḥ sthāpitatvācca, pratyakṣatvāvacchinnaviṣayatayā gatvasyaiva kāryatāvacchedakatvācca | nanvevaṃ ghaṭādyapi nityaṃ syāt, kapālasaṃyogādikañca vyañjakaṃ bhaviṣyatīti cet, na; utpattipratītervinā bādhakaṃ sākṣāt sambandhāṃśe bhramatvāyogāt | varṇeṣu tadgrahaviparītagrahayoḥ sattvena tadayogaḥ, satkāryavāde iṣṭāpatteśca | na ca kakārādervinā vyañjakamanubhave'ndhakārasthaghaṭavat saṃdehāpattiriti vācyam, doṣādyabhāvāt, utpannatvādisaṃdehasya tavāpi durvāratvācca | nanvavarṇasthale dhvanisattve mānābāvaḥ, saṅkhādyabhāvena yadutpattyasaṃbhavaśceti vācyam, varṇāgrahaṇe dhvanigrahaṇasyānibhavasiddhatvāt | varṇoccāraṇasthale tattatsthāne jihvāyā īṣadantaraṃ yāte varṇānupalabdherdhvanyupalabdheśca darśanena jihvābhidhātavāyukaṇṭhasaṃyogādestajjanakatvakalpanācca, varṇotpattau tadanaṅgīkāre pratibandhyapratibandhakabhāvakalpanāgauravāpatteśca | na caivaṃ ghaṭena taratītyarthe dvyajlakṣaṇaṣṭhan na syāditi vācyam, āvṛttikṛdvyajvyapadeśena siddheḥ | aśvādipratiṣedhena tadviṣaye gauṇasyāpi grahaṇajñāpanāt | ata eva kariṇetyādau "sāvekācaḥ" [ 6|1|168 ] iti vibhaktyudāttatvaṃ na, āvṛttikṛtadvyajvyapadeśenaikājvyapadeśasya nivartitatvāt | nahi triputro dviputravyapadeśaṃ labhate | anubandhasaṅkaro'pi na, ekasyaiva devadattasya deśabhedena jaṭitvamuṇḍitvādyupadeśe teṣāṃ deśabhedena vyavasthāvat ṭittvakittvādīnāmapyupapatteḥ | na caikatve ekasya puruṣasya deśabhedena grahaṇānāpattiḥ, tadadhikaraṇasyākāśasayaikatvena deśabhedesyaivābhāvāt | aupādhikatadbhedāṅgīkāre tu vāyusaṃyogopādhikabhedasya varṇe'pi sattvenākṣateḥ | spaṣṭa cedam "aiuṇ" sūtre bhāṣyakaiyaṭayoḥ | na cābhivyakteḥ kṣaṇikatvena padapratyakṣāsaṃbhavaḥ, janyatve'pi tulyatvāt, pūrvapūrvasaṃskārasahakṛtaśrotreṇābhivyaktapūrvavarṇavaiśiṣṭyasyottarottaravarṇe grahaṇena tatsaṃbhavācca | avyavahitottaratvañcotpattyanavacchinnasvajñānādhikaraṇakṣaṇotpattikajñānāviṣayatvam | evañca padasayaikatvenānugamakākāṅkṣāyā abhāvena kāraṇatāvacchedakasyāvaśyakatvābhāvaḥ | tādātmyena tadeva cāvacchedakam | tadarthajñāpakatvajñānamapi avyavahittottarasambandhena pūrvapūrvavarṇaviśiṣṭacaramavarṇaśravaṇa eva varṇavaikalpādinā śravaṇe na bodha iti dik | iti sakhaṇḍapadāvākyasphoṭanirūpaṇam | <30> athākhaṇḍapadavākyasphoṭanirūpaṇam varṇamālāyām 'ekaṃ padamekaṃ vākyam' iti pratīteḥ 'tadevedamtadevedaṃ ghaṭamānaya'iti vākyamiti pratītekṣva varṇātiriktam 'ekamakhaṇḍaṃ prakṛtipratyayādivibhāgarahitaṃ padaṃ vākyañca varṇavyaṅgacamavaśyaṃ svīkāryam | nahīyamekatvadhīrvarṇaviṣayeti yuktam, teṣāmanekatvāt | na caikaṃ vanamitivat sā, vanarāśyāderapyatiriktatvāt | kiñca, tatraikadeśāvacchinnatvasyopādherekatvena sopādhistathāpratītirupapadyate | prakṛte copādherasambhavaḥ | na caikārthabodhahetutvaṃ tathā, vyāsasamāsayorapyaikyāpatteḥ, vākye'saṃbhavācca | varṇasamudāyaḥ padamityādi "ādyantavat" sūtrasthabhāṣyaṃ tu samudāyo'tirikta iti matena | kiñcaivaṃ sati varṇeṣvapyavayabānubhavasattavāttadatirikto varṇo'pi na sidhyet | yathā ṛkāre repho lṛkāraḥ, ekāraikairayorakārekārau | aukāraukārayorakārokārau | dīrghādiṣvapi htrasvākārādayaḥ | rki bahunā, varṇamātre "tasyādita udāttam" [2|2|32] ityādinā'vayavasattvaṃ gamyate | ata eva varṇāvayavānāṃ barṇagrahaṇena grahaṇāgrahaṇapakṣau "eoṅ" sūtre bhāṣye vyutpāditau | kiñcaivam 'ekaḥ paṭaḥ' iti vyavahārasyāpi tantusamudāyenaivopapattau tatrāpyatiriktāvayavyasiddhacāpattiḥ | yadi tatraika iti vyavahārādatiriktāvayavisiddhiḥ, rtāha prakṛte'pi samam | naca varṇeṣvayavā na santyeva, tadavabhāsastu tattaduccāraṇaviśeṣajanyatattadvarṇasamānākārakradhvaniviśeṣasantānoparāgopādhiriti vācyam, pade'pi varṇāvabhāsasyaivamevopapattau varṇoccheda eva syāt | akhaṇḍatvaṃ tu prakṛtipratyayādyavayavarāhityenaiva | sakhaṇḍapadasphoṭādyuktarītyā samudāyaśaktyaiva bodhasya jāyamānatvena tatra tatsattve mānābhāvāt | śāstre tu 'rekhāgavaya' nyāyenopapannam | paspaśāyām 'atha kaḥ śabdaḥ' iti praghaṭṭake 'yenoccāritena sāsnālāṅgūlakakudakhuraviṣāṇināṃ sampratyayaḥ iti' bhāṣya ekavacanenāyaṃ pakṣaḥ sūcitaḥ | spaṣṭakṣva kaiyaṭenoktaḥ tatraiva | taduktaṃ hariṇā-- pade na varṇā vidyante varṇeṣvavayavā iva | vākyāt padānāmatyantaṃ praviveko na kaścana || iti | atra varṇaśabdena prakṛtipratyayādikam, varṇasphoṭa ityatra varṇapadena tasyaiva prakṛtatvāt, "ādyantau" "ādyantavat" ityādisūtrasthabhāṣyeṇa tathaiva lābhācca | ye tu--'pade varṇā na santyeva | yathā ṛkārādau avayavāḥ pratīyamānā api na santi, tadvadityarthaḥ' iti vyācakṣate | teṣāmanubhavavirodhaḥ, avayavini paṭe tantūnāmiva pade varṇānāmapyanubhavasiddhatvāt | akhaṇḍatvarūpadharmaikyāt padavākyāt vākyapadayoratyantaṃ bhedo nāstītyarthaḥ | nanu varṇasattve mānābhāvaḥ, pūrvoktarītyānubhavena ca varṇasthale dhvanīnāmāvaśyakatvena taṃreva sphoṭābhivyaktisaṃbhave dhvanisphoṭayormadhye varṇāṅgakāre gauravād iti cet, bhavantu ta eva varṇā dūragatakolāhakśravaṇe ghatvādināṃ śrūyamāṇadhvanigatānāmeva dūratvadoṣeṇānabhivyaktisaṃbhavāt |ata eva 'loke pratītapadārthako dhvaniḥśabdaḥ' iti | bhāṣyaṃ saṅgacchate | tatra hi--karmadhārayaḥ | idamevābhipretyokto kāvyaprakāśe 'budhaiḥ veyākaraṇaiḥ pradhānabhūtasphoṭarūpavyaṅgacavyañjakasya dhvaniriti vyavahāraḥ kṛtaḥ' iti | atra pradhānībhūtaḥ sphoṭaḥ padavākyaprakṛtyādirūpaḥ sphoṭaḥ, tasyarthapratyāyakatvena pradhānībhūtatvam | evañcārthe gṛhītasambandhena prāguktarītyā gṛhītatrameṇa varṇasamudāyena vyañjatoktarūpādvā arthaviśeṣeṇa gṛhītasambandhāt sphoṭādarthapratyayaḥ | paryāyeṣu ca bhinnauva śaktiḥ gauravaṃ tu prāmāṇikatvānna doṣāvaham | etena kimayaṃ sphoṭaḥ svarūpato'rthapratyāyakaḥ, pratīto vā ? nādyaḥ, sarvadārthabodhāpatteḥ | antye, 'ekaṃ padam' ityādipratyakṣaṃ tadgrāhakaṃ vācyam | tatra kimayaṃ pratyayo varṇānavagāhate, na vā ? ādye, astu teṣāmevānupūrvyavacchinnānāṃ vācakatā, āvaśyakatvāt | antye pratītibādha eva | kiñca, varṇavyaṅgacaḥ sphoṭaḥ | tatra rki varṇāvalī tattadarthaviśeṣaṇe gṛhītasambandhā sphoṭavyañjikā, gṛhītasambandhā vā ? nādyaḥ, kāvyādiśravaṇe tattadartheragṛhitasambandhasyapi 'idamekaṃ padam' 'idamekaṃ vākyam' ityādisphoṭapratītyāpatteḥ | nāntyaḥ, taireva bodhottāvatiriktatatsvīkārasya vaiyarthyāpatteḥ | ekatvapratītiścaikabuddhiviṣayatvaupādhikī | na ca tadevedaṃ padamiti pratītyā tatsiddhiriti vācyam, pūrvanakhādināśottaraṃ punarutpanne nakhādau tadevedaṃ nakham, ta eva ime keśāḥ, sa evādra itivat sādṛśyenopapatteḥ | atiriktanakhādikamanubhavaruddhamiti cet, gaurityādau gakāravisargātiriktasphoṭo'pyanubhavabiruddha iti tulyam | kiñca, paryāyaśabdeṣvekaḥ sphoṭaḥ, nānā vā ? nādyaḥ, kalaśaghaṭādiparyāyābhivyakte sphoṭe gṛhītaśaktikasya puso'prasiddhapadaśravaṇe'pyarthapratyayāpatteḥ, prāggṛhītaśaktikasyaiva sphoṭasya tenāpyabhivyañjanāt | na ca tattatparyāyābhivyaktasphoṭe śaktigrahastattatparyāyaśravaṇe'rthadhīheturiti vācyam, evaṃ hi pratiparyāyaṃ śaktigrahāvaśyambhāve tattatparyāyagataśaktigrahahetutāyā eva yuktatvāt | tava tu tattatparyāyābhivyaktagataśaktigrabatve gauravāt | nāntyaḥ, anantapadārthānāṃ teṣu śakteśrva kalpanāmapekṣya klṛptavarṇeṣveva śaktikalpanasya ladhutvāt | api ca , varṇānāṃ pratyekaṃ vyāñdakatvam, samuditānāṃ vā ? nādyaḥ, pratyekāt sphoṭapratītau tāvataivārthābodhāpatteḥ | nāntyaḥ, 'taddhetoḥ' iti nyāyenārthabodhasyāpi tata evopapattau tatkalpanāvaiyarthyapattiriti nirastamityāhuḥ | apare tu--eva padārthaḥ śrotragrāhyaḥ | anantavarṇadhvanikalpane mānābhāvāt, avarṇānāmaikyam, avarṇakakārādīnāñcanekatvamityardhajaratīyasyānyāyyatvācca | katvādikaṃ cābhivyañjakavāyusaṃyoganiṣṭhameva | vijātīyavāyusaṃyogaistasyaiva katvādinā'bhivyañjanam, vijātīyaiścatadanākrāntadhvanirūpeṇetyeva yuktam | kiñca, ekaikavidātīyavāyusaṃyogaiḥ kevalakatvādinaiva tasya vyañjanam | kramotpannairbahubhistu tattatpadavākyarūpeṇābhivyaktādarthapratyayaḥ | tasyaiva padādirūpeṇābhivyaktasyārthapratyāyakatvena sphoṭatvavyavahāraḥ | na cedamayuktam, tattadvarṇotpādakatvādinābhimatavijātīyavāyusaṃyogaviśeṣābhivyaktākhaṇḍapadārtharūpaikavarṇasyaiva tattadvarṇajanakatāvacchedakatayā, vyañjakatāvacchedakatayā vā paramatasiddhasya vāyusaṃyoganiṣṭhasya vaijātyasya paramparayā varṇavṛttitvamādāyānyeṣāṃ mate tāratvādinā pratyayavad asmanmate katvādināpi pratītisambhavāt | ata eva bhāmatyām 'tāratvādivāyuniṣṭha varṇeṣvāropyate' iti devatādhikaraṇe'bhihitam | 'so'yaṃ gakāraḥ' 'tadevedaṃ padam' ityādipratyabhijñāpi gatvādyadhikaraṇavāyusaṃyogābhivyaktaṃ darpamukhavad vyañjakadharmarūṣitatayā pratīyamānamekaṃ varṇamādāyaiva bodhyā | evam 'ekaṃ padam' ityādyapi, padārthasyaikatvāt | asya nityatve'pi kakāra utpanna iti pratyayastu vyañjakaniṣṭhotpatteḥ paramparayā tatra sattvādakṣata eva |sākṣāte sambandhāṃśe tu prāgvadeva bhramatvam | etena bādhagrahe tanniṣṭhajātyādyagrahaḥ | kiñca, yena yasya dharmo gṛhyate, tena tadapīti niyamād vāyusaṃyogānāmapi śrotreṇa grahaṇāpattiriti nirastam, sākṣāt sambandhena bādhagrahe'pi paramparayā tadagrahāt | etena 'kiñcetyādyapi' apāstam | rasanādeḥ rasādimātragrāhakatāyāḥ parairabhyupagamācca | na ca vilakṣaṇavāyusaṃyoga eva vācako'pyastu, śrṛṇometyādyanubhavenātiriktasya śrotragrāhyasyāvaśyakatvāt | na ca kakārahakārayoraikyāpattiḥ, bhinnatvapratītyanāpattiśceti vācyam, vyañjakagatavaijātyena bhedāt | advaitasiddhānteviṣayasambandhajanyavṛttivaicitryeṇa vyaṅgace svarūpasukhavaicitryavat | viśeṣyāṃśamādāyābheda iṣṭa eva | tatpratītistu nāpādyā, upādhyanāliṅgitavarṇapratītyabhāvāt | etena 'yo'yaṃ hakāraḥ, sa evedānīṃ gakāra iti pratītiḥ syāt | hakāro'yaṃ na gakāra iti pratītiśca na syādityapāstam | na ca vilakṣaṇavāyusaṃyogā eva śrotrendiyagrāhyāḥ santu, kimekasyāpyatiriktasya kalpanayeti vācyam, 'eko gakāraḥ' 'ekaṃ padam' ityādipratītyanurodhena tasyavaśyakatvāt | ata eva vācaspatimiśrāstattvabindau 'gakārādatiricyamānatūrteḥ kakārasyābhāvāt' iti sphoṭavādimatamūpanyāsthan | ata eva "aiuṇ" sūtre "asyacau" [7|4|32] ityādyakārasya varṇasamāmnāyasthākārabhinnatvenāṇtvābhāvāt savarṇāgrāhakatvamāśaṅkya 'avarṇasyaikatvāt siddham' iti praghaṭṭake ekasya puṃso yugapadanekadeśeṣūpalambho na syāt, upalabhate tu ityāśaṅkya 'akāramapi nopalabhate, yataḥ 'śrotrapalabdhirbuddhinirgrāhyaḥ prayogeṇābhijvalita prayogeṇābhijvalita ākāśadeśaḥ śabdaḥ, ekañca punarākāśam, śrottopalabdhirityanena ākāśadeśatvaṃ śabdasya pratipādayati | buddhinirgrāhyaḥ pūrvapūrvadhvanyutpāditābhivyaktibhivyaktijanitasaṃskārapamparāsahakṛtāntyabuddhinigrahyiḥ, prayujyate'neneti prayogo vāyusaṃyogaḥ, kaṇṭhatālvādyabhighāto dhvanirvā | tenābhijvalitaḥ abhivyaṅga iti kaṃyaṭaḥ | tatra 'buddhibhirnigrāhyaḥ' iti samāsaḥ | nirgrāhyaḥ, niśśeṣato grāhyaḥ; śabdato'rthataścetyarthaḥ | ayamevārthaḥ prayogeṇābhijvalita ityanena sphuṭīkriyate ityanye | yatra 'beddhinirgrāhyaḥ' ityasya buddhiviṣaya ityartha iti | tat, na; 'śrotropalabdhiḥ' ityanena paunaruktyāpatteḥ | anena hi svarasata ekasyaivādyadhvanimārabhya antadhvanyantena vyaṅgacatā labhyata iti spaṣṭamvākṣaramārmikāṇām | na cedaṃ prāguktamatasiddhātiriktapadaviṣayamiti bhramitavyam, 'akāramapi nopalabhate' iti upakramavirodhāt | atrāpi pakṣe padavākyagrahaṇaprakriyā sakhaṇḍavākyasphoṭavadeva | śaktigrahaśābdabodhaprakriyāpi prāṅnirūpitarītyaiva | sā'pi boddhṛbhedenāniyataiveti prāhuḥ | nanvevaṃ śāstrāprāmāṇyaprasaṅgaḥ, padavākyayorakhaṇḍatvāt, śastrasya ca prakṛtipratyayābhyāṃ vyutpādanaparatvāditi cet, na; uttaramīmāṃsāyām annamayaprāṇamayamanomayavijñānamayānandamayarūpapañcakośāvataraṇasya sarvādhārabrahyabodhakatvavat prakṛtipratyāyādivicārasyākhaṇ‍ḍasphoṭabodhanopāyatvenādoṣatvāt | nanu śāstrajñānaṃ vināpi gāmānayeti vākyamātravyutpannasya pāmarāderapi śābdabodhena tatra sphoṭajñānasya jāyamānatvāt naitacchāstraṃ pañcakośavat sphoṭajñānopāya iti cet, na ; prakārāntareṇa tajjñānasambhave'pi prakṛtipratyayavyutpādanapūrvakavijātīyatajjñānasya svapūrvaprayogadvārā śariraśuddhiphalakasya tatphalatvenādoṣāt | taduktaṃ hariṇā-- 'taddvāramapavargasya vāṅmalānāṃ cikitsitam | iti | evañca vijātīyajñāna eva śāstrasyopayoga iti na tṛṇādivad vyabhicāraḥ | laghunopāyena sakalaśabdapratipattau ca śastrasyopayogo bodhyaḥ | na ca prakṛtipratyayavibhāgasya kālpanikatve śaśaviṣāṇaprāyatvam, pañcakośādivadasyāpisada sadvilakṣaṇatvāt | evam 'rekhāgavavaya' nyāyenāpi śāstramupāyaḥ | evañca sakhaṇḍapadasphoṭa ityasya prakṛtipratyayavibhāgatattadarthajñānapūrvakaṃ padaṃ bodhakamityarthaḥ | evaṃ hare'vetyādau pratyekapadajñānapūrvakaṃ bodha iti sakhaṇḍavākyasphoṭaḥ | prakṛtipratyayādikalpanā 'rekhāgavaya' nyāyena kadvodhitamakhaṇḍaṃ prakṛtipratyayādivibhāgānāśrayaṃ padādibodhakamityakhaṇḍapadavākyasphoṭāviti tattvam | ityakhapaḍapadavātyasphoṭanirūpaṇam | <31> atha jātisphoṭanirūpaṇam itthaṃ pañca vyaktisphoṭā nirūpitāḥ | jātisphoṭavādinastu--varṇā anantā eva, ghaṭākāśamaṭhākāśādivadupādhyāliṅgitāyā eva tatpratīterabhāvenaṃvopādhito bheda ityasya vaktuṃ śaktvāt | so'yamityādipratyabhijñā tu sājātyanibandhanā | na caivaṃ padādīnāṃ śaktigrahe ānantyavyabhicārau, ānupūrvyā tu na nivahiḥ, tasyā api puruṣabhedena kālabhedenānantatvāditi vācyam, jāteḥ śakyatāvacchedakatvavat śaktatāvacchedikāyā āpi tasyā aṅgīkāreṇa doṣābhāvāt | 'idaṃ ghaṭapadam' 'idaṃ ghaṭapadam', 'iyaṃ prakṛtiḥ' 'iyaṃ prakṛtiḥ' ityadyekākārapratītyā ghaṭapadajñānatvādinā kāraṇatve kāraṇatāvacchedakakoṭipraviṣṭatayā ca ghaṭatvādyarthagatajātivat śabdagatajātiviśeṣasyāpyāvaśkatvāt | ānupūrvyā śaktatāvacchedakatve gauravācca | taduktam-- 'śakyatve iva śaktatve jāterlāghavamīkṣyatām' | iti | śakyatve ityādestadavacchedakatve ityarthaḥ | kiñcānupūrvyaiva pratītikāraṇatvayornirvāhe ghaṭatvāderapi saṃyogaviśeṣaviśiṣṭamṛdādibhiranyathāsiddhacāpattiḥ | na ca kramikavarṇasamudāyasya yaugapadyāsambhavenānārabdhe tu gauśabde gaśabdatvaṃ kathaṃ bhavediti nyāyena tatra jātirdu rupapādeti vācyam, prāguktarītyaikabuddhiviṣayīkṛte tatsambhavāt | jātiviśeṣasya cānupūrvīviseṣaviśiṣṭā varṇā vyañjakā ākāraviśeṣa ghaṭatvādeḥ | ataḥ saro rasa ityādau na bodhāviśeṣaḥ | nanu jāteḥ pratyekaṃ varṇeṣu sattve pratyekādarthabodhāpakkiriti cet, na; anekavyaktyabhivyaṅgavarṇasamudāye tasya vyāsajyavṛttitvādakṣateḥ | taduktam-- 'anekavyaktyabhivyaṅgacā jātiḥ sphoṭa iti smṛtā' iti | na ca jāteḥ śaktatāvacchedakatve'pi tasyāḥ śaktatve mānābhāvena jātau sphoṭavyavahārānāpattiḥ, śakyatāvacchedake viṣayatayā śakteriva śaktatāvacachedake āśrayatayā tasyāḥ 'sattvenākṣateḥ | spaṣṭaṃ cedam "aiuṇ" sutre | tasmāt 'ānyabhāvyamakārasya' iti granthe bhāṣyakaiyaṭayoḥ | anye tu--ākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyenāvaśyakatvācca śaktā'pi jātireva | tādatmyena tadavacchedikā ca nikhacchinnaiva vā śaktatā, jāterekatvenānugamakākāṅkṣāyā abhāvāt | sā ca jñātaiva vācikā, vyaktivat | etena sphoṭasya sadātanatvādarthabodhārattirityapāstam | jātiścāvidyako dharmaviśeṣaḥ | tatra dupādhyavacchinna brahyasattaiva vā, taduktam-- sambandhidāt sattaiva bhijyamānā gavādiṣu | jātirityucyate tasyāṃ sarve śabdā vyavasthitāḥ || sā nityā sā mahānātmā tāmāhustvatalādayaḥ | tāṃ prātipadikārthañca dhātvarthañca pracakṣate || iti | evañca vācakaṃ brahyaiva, śāstrīyaprakriyā tu jātivyañjakabodhanārthā prāgvadeveti sarveṣṭasiddhiḥ | iti jātisphoṭanirūpaṇam | adhītya phaṇibhāṣyābdhi sughīndraharidīkṣitāt | nyāyatantraṃ rāmarāmād vādirakṣodhnarāmataḥ ||1|| vaiyākaraṇanāgeśaḥ sphoṭāyanaṛṣermatam | pariṣkṛkyoktavāṃstena prīyatāmumayā śivaḥ ||2|| dṛḍhastarke'sya nābhyāsa iti cintyaṃ na paṇḍitaiḥ | dṛṣado'pi hi santīrṇāḥ payodhau rāmayogataḥ ||3|| śabdenduśekharaṃ putraṃ majjaṣāñcaiva kanyakām | svamatau samyagutpādya śivayorarpitau mayā ||4|| iti śrimadupādhyāyopanāmakaśivabhaṭṭasutanāgeśabhaṭṭakṛto vaiyākaraṇasiddhāntamañjūṣākhyaḥ sphoṭavādaḥ samāptaḥ | vaiyākaraṇasiddhāntamañjūṣā yā kṛtā mayā | tayā śrībhagavāna sāmbaḥ śivo me prīyatāmiti || || śubhamastu ||
